sanskrit: bhāti tasyai tasmai namonamaḥmaheśaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥcārcitā taistu vāmadakṣiṇamārgibhiḥvidhiharyādyāstvāṃ tvaṃ dhyāyasi kaṃ punaḥkiṃ dhyeyaṃ tattvaṃ me kṛpayā vadavidhīndrādīnvākyametaduvācahadevayonīnāṃ dinamāyuśca tacchatamsārdhaṃ sampūrṇaṃ dharmaśāstra pramaṇataḥsamayaḥ kāyapūrakaḥmahāmāyā mayā tacchvāsanirgamaḥghaṭikayā varṣamekaṃ vidhessmṛtamsatīrupaṃ śuklaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tu pārvatīvai mahākālasya gehinītiṣṭhet samayā viṣayīkṛtaḥvilayaṃ kṛtvā bhītā natāḥ punaḥsarva īśvarā itivādinaḥna ca tvaṃ maśakāyasekathañjñeyaḥ kathayasva sadāśivayadi kṛpā devyāṃ viṣṇau sureṣu cavṛddhintasya māyākṛtañjagatprārthitohaṃ devī samprārthitā mayābhavati sa sa mārgaḥ prakāśitaḥanyāndevānvinindanti ṣaṭkarmaniratāssadāniratāstena nirdhanāḥ pretarūpiṇaḥdharmasāraṃ tantrāṇāṃ hṛdayaṃ param

sanskrit: yātantattantraṃ merusañjñitamnijasandehāndūrīkurvantaśaṅkitāḥkṣatravāyustaṃ bindurūpaṃ karoti casambhinnāste devaḥ koṭiśobhavantathaivopāsanāmārgaguṇā yānti ca devatāmdūratalaḥ syādvai tadvaddevo'pi mohitaḥnyastaḥ punarvṛṣṭiḥ punarjalamsanmārgāttaṭinīto mahānadīmvāḍavodarasaṃveśāttadvajjīvo'pi devatāmsamudrādāhṛtaḥ kaṃściddaivāttyaktastu tatra tubrahmajñānādvinirmuktā hitvā copāsanākramamtatra tatra praśaṃstikāca sarvāśyastūttamottamāsamutpannā surā kalaśadhariṇīdevī trailokyasyāpi mohinītāñjagṛhustasyāḥ kalaśācca papuḥ surāmbhuktimuktyekabhājanamrevā suraiva paramampadamstūyamānāstāśśaktyaste ca dānavāḥdhandhantarissamāyātassudhākalaśahastavānviṣṇussāntvayaṃśca pratārayannissārampuruṣāhṛtamśukrācāryo jñātavāṃstatsamagramdhigdhigjñānaṃ surārīṇāmanayā surayā hṛtamghoraṃ tiṣṭhantviha piśācavat

sanskrit: nirdahantīva lokāṃstrīnprākampanta surāsurāḥpātitaḥ śukraḥ putro'yantemiyojyatāmvimocaya punastadvarṇakāntikāṣoḍaśārṇastavākhyāto mantritāṣṭottaraṃ śatamdīkṣākramo yeṣāṃ vaṃśe devi samāgataḥpradhāno'yaṃ sa tu vāmapathaḥ smṛtaḥkulamārgapraviṣṭena sadā sevyaṃ suharṣiṇāmadhyamassyātsiddhāntī yo'varo bhavetpītamamṛtaṃ te te somapā bala darpitāḥteṣāmupāsanā proktā dakṣamārgeṇa sā dvijaiḥpaurāṇī madhyamā khyātā tāntrikī tvavarā smṛtāyadā dakṣaṃ praviśettatsu rassai tuvāmaṃ praviśet tatsurāstadātasmātsvakulamārgaṃ tu jñātvā kuryādupāsanāmmārgastatkālaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥcobhayossiddhirdevatānāṃ viḍaṃbanamnāstīha syāccopanayanādiṣunādhikāro'styataḥ kuryādātmānaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtamiti proktā prāptā cetsugurormukhātviṃśadviśvopakaguṇairyukto yaḥ sa gururbhavetsarvāṅgamārgatattvajñaḥ sarvamantravidhānavitantarmukho'bahirdṛṣṭissarvajño deśakālavitkāmye rataḥ karmaṇyaninditemaraṇāyāsaduḥkhakṛtkṣatraviṭchūdrajātīyaḥ pratilomaṃ na dīkṣayet

sanskrit: gṛhasthasya vāmamārgetivīryavāndvādaśābdaṃ tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vātha dīkṣayetlajjābhimānagarvādivarjitaṃ kulanāyakamjapadhyānābhinirataṃ mokṣamārgābhigāminamsadācāraṃ śraddhābhaktisamanvitamanukūlapriyāyuktaṃ dhīraṃ sarvopakārakamdīkṣāṃ tu lobhādyairdevatāśāpamāpnuyātsāmaye traste vyaṅge dīkṣā tu niṣphalāmantro vedāṅgañcāgamaḥ smṛtaḥsādhyate sarvaṃ grahayajñādikaṃ kilamantro nāvedo mantra īritaḥyāvantyarṇāni mantrāṇāṃ śūdrāya pratipādayetrahitaṃ dadyātpaścācca tāntrikamsaṃskṛtaistaiśca svāgamoktena vartmanādīkṣyate bhāryā yato'sau sarvadā guruḥvaiṣṇavo vāpi strīśūdrāṇāṃ namontakaḥnāmamantra iti jñātvā cāṇḍālānapi dīkṣayetpañcadhā manavaḥ khyātāḥ pradeyāścānulomataḥkāmabījaṃ bhavedvaiśyo vāgbhavaṃ śūdra īritaḥnodadyānmantraṃ tvadhikavarṇakamviprairdeyā vindhyanivāsinīnārasiṃhī kārtavīryasya nānyataḥvarṇatrayepi dātavyaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtyaghorakamlakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ vāsudevatākaṃ varāhakamsarvavarṇeṣu dātavyāḥ kālikā śyāmalā tathā

sanskrit: yakṣapatnīnāṃ traipurā baṭukādayaḥproktā śreṣṭhā tatra tu sāttvikīdakṣiṇo mārgaḥ pratimāyāṃ ca pūjanamproktaṃ pīṭhādau balidānataḥsamproktā vāmadakṣiṇayoḥ parāgopitā sarvatantreṣu kimanyacchrotumicchathaśivapraṇītavyavasthāprakāśaḥ prathamaṃḥdṛśyate kvāpi kimparatra bhaviṣyatisatyaṃ sādhakā duḥkhitāḥ kathamsaṃskārāśca kathaṃ kāryāstāntrikāṇāṃ vadasva tatkarmatrayaṃ ceti saṃskārāḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥśiṣyāṃstataḥ kuryātsiddhe mantre punastrayammantrasaṃskārāḥ ṣaḍeva parikīrtitāḥyavanakalpoktāstanmantreṣvapi te trayaḥsurāṃ vāme homādyarthaṃ prakalpayetmaithunaṃ brahmacaryaṃ ca mudrāstatkarmikāstathādakṣiṇānāmatho vāme dvitīyāṅgaṃ samācaretdevatāyā mantranyāsaṃ samācaretbhairavo bhūtvā ratikarma samācaretpañcasahasraṃ ca yatheṣṭaṃ labhate sutamtasyāssomastasya sūryo garbhastiṣṭheddharātalekurvīta atha puṃsavanaṃ budhaḥhomasthāne svadevatāḥpuruṣāṇāṃ dvayaṃdvayamsapaśuṃ dadyānniśāyāṃ bhairavaṃ balim
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturthaṣaṣṭhāṣṭameṣu māssu sanmadhyamādhamaḥdevatāmantraṃ sīmante surucā likhetgacchettāṃ bhāryāṃ devatāśāpabhītitaḥsaṃgaḥ sīmantastadadhovahaḥjātakarmābhidhaṃ vipraḥ svakalpoktena vartmanākriyāṃ kuryādviṣṇusmaraṇapūrvakamlekhanyā vilikhetkaraṇāgrayātarpayetpaścādanyatkarma tu dakṣavatsarveṣāmevamuddiṣṭaḥ sūtakānte śubhe dinemātrācakrāṇi ṣoḍaśanāma tādṛśaśced gurustadāyasmādakṣaguṇaiḥ siddhirviprāṇāṃ samprajāyateiryame ca ī u ū vahnibhe tathāpuṣye kakāraḥ sarpabhe khagauṭaṭhau tvāṣṭre svātyāṃ ḍo dvīśabhe ḍhaṇaupūrvāṣāḍhāyāṃ bakāro bhastu vaiśvabhepūrvabhādrāyāṃ ṣasahāḥ syurupāntimesādhyanāmādivarṇarkṣatrirāvṛttyā phalāni tuvyādhimāpnoti sādhakaḥ kāryasiddhayetārācakrasya phalaṃ jñātvācaredidamstrīpuṃsorvā vyastayośca gaṇacakraṃ vicārayetharyantyamitrādityenduvāyyijyakaraghoṭakāḥnṛdevayoḥ phalaṃ śīghraṃ vyastayoḥ kaṣṭataḥ phalamdevadānavayoryuddhaṃ vyastayorniṣphalambhavetyugmaṃ yugmaṃ yugmaṃ vadanti ṣaṭ

sanskrit: bhavedyatrādigo varṇaḥ phalaṃ tatra bhavedidamstrīsaukhyakṛdvātakārī bhāgyadaḥ kāryasiddhikṛtstrīśūdrapratilomānāṃ nāmamantrairupāsanāmanurgrāhyo vaidiko'tra viśeṣataḥvāyvagnibhūjalākāśapañcatattvāni vinyasetkādikāścāpi ṣaḍvargāḥ śaṣasā haśca kṣastathātasmātpunarmanurlekhyo yugapatsyātsamāpanamkaṣṭaṃ tu śatrau rūpaṃ same dalampādo mitre tu tadvattu tatkaṣṭaṃ syātkalātmakambhūtavetālāḥ piśācāścānyathā manumsalilānilayostathāsiddhādicakraṃ vakṣye'haṃ yajjñātvā nāma kārayettathā cakre kūṭaṣaṇḍhavivarjitānsvanāmākṣaramārabhya jñeyo mantrākṣarāvadhiḥsidhyati kālena sādhyaḥ siddhyati vā na vāmahāvidyāsādhane siddhimātṛkāmkramādeteṣu koṣṭheṣu mātṛkārṇānsuvinyasetpañcāṅgatithiviśve ca koṣṭhāstatra prakīrtitāḥtattatsthānāptakoṣṭhāttu pūrvāṅgulyā gurūktitaḥsusiddhasamprāptaḥ siddhārirhanti gotrajānsusiddho bhajanātsādhyāriḥ svāśrayaṃ haretsusiddhaḥ susiddhāriḥ kulāpahaḥpatnīghno'thāryariḥ sādhakāpahaḥbījātmako mantrastatra ṣaḍdalamātṛkāḥnyasenmātṛkārṇānkūṭaṣaṇḍhavivarjitān

sanskrit: sampraddāridryadhairyāṇi bandhuvigrahasaṃśayaumantrasya siddhissyādetadarthamahaṃ bruvevakṣye'tra tu yathā lekhyā aṅkā ekādaśa svarāḥtadadhodvikusaptābdhikhatrisapteṣusāgarāḥsvaravyañjanabhinnānāṃ mantrārṇānāṃ pṛthak pṛthakbhāgaśeṣāvubhau sthāpyau yāvannāmāṅkatā manoḥtāvatsaṅkhyānsamāyogānasādhyānapi sādhayetpunaḥ kuryānmantrasandīptaye punaḥyāvatsyādadhikastāvatsaṅkhyāṅkāni yadā caretpunaḥ kṛtvā tadā syātkāryasādhakaḥsarvataṃtreṣu gopitamtasyāścakre tu racayedevameva hisaṁllekhyāstadadhaḥ ṣaṇḍhavarjitāḥkacaṭādyāṁllikhedvarṇān ṅañaṇākṣaravarjitāndvayoryogaḥ kāryaścāṣṭāvaśeṣitaḥmantraṃ yantraṃ binā kaliḥṣaḍvedatrīṣusaptābdhinagadvirasakhaṃdharāḥhānirādhikye jayo gopyamidaṃ bharāḥvargāṣṭakāṅkā vahnīṣuṣaḍvedāṅkendu vahnayaḥvargabalādvargaikyaprāṇavīryataḥvahnīnduvedayugmenduraṅkāḥ pañca svarāṁllikhetpañcabhakte'dhike śeṣe jayo hīne parājayaḥbhūṣaṭpañcāgnivedāgnidvibhūkheṣu śarāḥ kṛtāḥnāmavarṇāṅkānmātrābhedakramoditānkuryātprāṇācca vargataḥ

sanskrit: rasāgnilocanayugā nāgaṣaḍgo'bdhivahnayaḥādyāstadaṅkayogotra hīne'ṣṭāṅke'dhike jayaḥrasāgnivedayugmāṅgaṣaṭkṛtāgnīnduśūnyabhūḥtaṣṭāṣṭabhiścedadhikā gadino jīvitambhavetgurumukhānnāmakarma samācaretsvakalpoktavidhānena śūdrādīnāmamantrakaḥdevāśca cakrasya pūjānteṣvavaśeṣitamkṛtavidhānasya kṣudvipattirna jāyatesarveṣāmevamuddiṣṭaṃ bālyapātakanāśanamstrīṇāmapi ca kartavyaṃ saubhāgyārogyavṛddhayekṣiptvā khaned bhūmau viśeṣo vāmināmitisamīpe nayanaṃ taccopanayanaṃ smṛtampūrvaṃ kartavyaṃ kuladīkṣaṇamlaghudaivatyā prākpaścānmahatastathāgrāhyā mantradīkṣā puraścaryāṃ samārabhetsuputraṃ vā vineṣṭaṃ dāpayenna cajāyate siddhirguroḥ śāpaḥ prajāyateprasaktā sā svavidyā rājavadbhavetyatpṛṣṭaṃ tasyādhikyaṃ tu varṇitamvaidikaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tataśca smārtamuttamamyāmalāstatsaṃgamācca mantrīśānī ca tāṇḍavamkramādapacitaṃ jñeyaṃ yathāyogyena mukhyatādadyācca sarvasmai svāṃcārātkarma kurvatemārgeṇa vaidikastāntrikaḥ punaḥvakratuṇḍādikā dakṣe ucchiṣṭādyāstu vāmake

sanskrit: mārgeṇa tatsthāne tāntrikaḥ punaḥkālabhairavabhedasya yasya kasyāpi dakṣiṇesādhakairgrāhyaḥ svarṇākarṣaṇabhairavaḥkuryādgṛhyoktamārgeṇa tasminsthāne tu tāntrikaḥpūjādimantrāṃstacchikṣāṃ taddravyaniyamāṃstathāsthāne bhaveddīkṣā sveṣṭamantre tu tāntriketāntrikaḥ kuryātsarvapāpavimokṣaṇamsatyavācā tataḥ samprārthayeditikurve devatāḥ santu sākṣiṇaḥpāpāni tiṣṭhanti mama devatāḥca yathā sandṛśyatāṃ tathādakṣakukṣisthitaṃ kṛṣṇamaṅguṣṭhaparimāṇakamgurutalpakaṭīyutamduṣṭamadhovaktraṃ sudussahampāpanaraṃ japānte prekṣayetpunaḥnirgataṃ pāpaṃ puraścaraṇayogyatāpuraścaryā kartavyā tāntrikairjanaiḥjapaṃ kuryāccakrapūjāṃ tathā niśisiddhimavāpnoti nānyathā japakoṭibhiḥvidhavāyā vivāhantu pippalenaiva kārayetcetkuryādanyamekaṃ tathā patimvaidikastāntrikastatra devasthāne svadevatāmyajamānasya mārgasthastadabhāvataḥdvijāḥ kaulamārgāścakrārcane matāḥkaulikavastūnāṃ piṇḍāśca rudhirokṣitāḥ

sanskrit: kālaḥ proktotyāvaśyakepi casārdhayāmatrayaṃ hīno'vaśyake proktalakṣaṇaḥpratidinamāmadhyāhnaṃ japaṃ carettarpaṇaṃ mārjanaṃ kṛtvā tathā brāhmaṇabhojanamdvitīyaḥ kalpastu lakṣamekaṃ japaṃ caretkalpastu sampūrṇaṃ japamācaretdaridrairdviguṇo japaḥ [kārya iti śeṣaḥ ||]tathā kalpo yasya devasya yatpriyamjapapriyāssarvadevyo vāmamārge balipriyāḥgaṇeśasya viṣṇorbrāhmaṇabhojanampuraścaryācatuṣkeṇa tridvyādyaiḥ kṣattriyādayaḥśuciḥ pūrvamupoṣitaḥsparśādimuktiparyantaṃ japenmaṃtraṃ samāhitaḥbrāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścātpuraścaryāsamantvidamhome ca saṅkhyā tantreṣu noditāmantrāṇāmevamevānyaducyatedhyātvā japenmantramayutānāṃ catuṣṭayamasiddhatvādgurordevāḥ śiṣyasiddhirna jāyatebindumanmātṛkākṣaraiḥtato homādikātsiddho bhavenmanuḥsiddhayetra ca sasvarāḥhrasvadīrghaplutairbhedaira i u ṛ tridhā matāḥdīrghaplutavibhedena hyanusvāravisargakaiḥkādikā varṇā jihvāmūlīyayukca kaḥupadhmānīyasaṃyuktaṃ pakārastena tatra ṣaṭ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: smṛtaḥanadhyāyānvarjayitvā catvāriṃśaddinaṃ tathātu bhūtalipyā puṭīkurusaṃ |] hayavaralā ādyantimadvicaturthakamtataścaivaṃ dvicatvāriṃśadakṣaraiḥgandhapuṣpādyairniśīthe parataḥ punaḥlabdhācāryādisthānamāśritaiḥbhāgyavato vāpi sukumārasya vā yathāparijñeyā varṇamāsaistu siddhidāvarṇakrameṇa tāḥ proktā anulomavilomataḥsarpadvayākṛtirmālā bhavennityaṃ tato japetsamānā maṇayaḥ protavyā sārṇasūtrakaiḥrājate sūtre ye hyatāḥ paripūjayetkvāthena nityaṃ snānaṃ caturthakaḥdvartanaṃkuryādeṣa ṣaṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥjāyatesantāpāpyāyane drāvo bodhanaṃ ca vaśīkṛtiḥsamānīya padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhetnāmārṇairmantraṃ sandarbhitaṃ likhetsādhakasya nāmāthāṣṭadaleṣu ca|] || tatsaṃveṣṭya mṛdā samyagveṣṭayedbrāhmaṇādikaḥkṣipettrimadhure tattu mṛṇmaye laghubhājaneagnisaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā sannidhau tasya taṃghaṭamaṣṭādhikasahasraṃ tu samyaktaṃ kalaśaṃ kṣipetbrāhmaṇāṃścānnaistoṣayeddakṣiṇādibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadā kuryāttatprakāra ihocyateuśīrarocanābhyāñca śilākarpūrakuṃkumaiḥjapāddhomāddrāvitaḥ phalado bhavet[aiṁbījena |] ca bījena sampuṭīkṛtya taṃ japetmahādāru haridrā ca manaḥśilābhavedvaśyo no cetkuryātprapīḍanampaṭhetturyamudāttataḥanudāttapadoccāre devaṃ dhyāyedadhaḥsthitambhūrje bhānudugdhena lekhayetmantraḥ pīḍitaḥ sa prasīdatisombījapuṭitaṃ mantraṃ likhedbhūrjasya patrakepoṣaṇamityuktamatha śoṣaṇamucyatesveṣṭamantraṃ tatkaṇṭhe dhārayeditimantrāṇāṃ caturdikṣu samāvṛtāntaddhāryaṃ kaṇṭhe dāhakriyā tviyamtu kāmākṣā yatra devatāmantraṃ hi vaṃśopari yathākramamtasyaiva mūle śailasya parvaṇiyoginīśaile dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi dhruvamjvālāmukhīsamīpe vā hiṃgulājasamāpataḥstrīsamīpe tu kāmapīṭhe manorgrahaḥpūrṇakumbhe nidhāpayettāntrikamantrāṇāṃ dīkṣāṃ śṛṇu guruṃ vinādakṣiṇāmūrteḥ sannidhau pūjayecca tamlikhitvātha mantraṃ devaṃ ca pūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭottaraśataṃ caiva mantragrahaṇamucyatedakṣiṇāmūrtito manuḥtapaḥkṣayakarāścaiva jāyante naikasiddhayaḥaṇimādiṣu magnaścenmokṣavārtātidurlabhāsiddhidvāramidaṃ tasya mayā lakṣaṇamucyatejāyeta na khyātavyaṃ guruṃ vināyānti dūrataḥsvalpanidrā sadā cittaprasannatārādhanaśaktasya prathamaṃ vatsaratrayamkarmaṇā manasā yadiprārthayantenurodhena garvitā api māninaḥprapaśyanti tejasā vibhavena canavamādvatsarādūrdhvaṃ svayaṃ siddhyati mantrarāṭdaridrasya mantrasiddhiryathā bhavetvarṇānāṃ triguṇādirvidhīyateproktastarpaṇāddviguṇo japaḥbhojayedviprānkṛtasāṅgatvasiddhayeṣaragāni casantuṣṭo mantraḥ siddhyati mantriṇaḥgāthāvā tajjapo naiva cārthakṛtteṣāṃ pātakaṃ parikīrtitamgurumukhātprāpta ekaḥ syātsarvasiddhidaḥsiddhilakṣaṇasampūrṇaḥ prāṇimātrasya yassamaḥkāryo nānyo vāme kadācanatu pāpahāniḥ prajāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puraḥ || itthaṃ proktā puraścaryā kimanyacchrotumicchathapuraścaryāprakāśaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥjanāsteṣāṃ sthirā siddhiḥ kathaṃ bhavetsādhakasya tathā vada kṛpānidhesvadharmācaraṇātsarvamanāyāsena jāyatekurvīta siddhiḥ syātputrapautrikīpādukāsanaviṇmūtramaithunādi vivarjayetmuktakeśīṃ ca kāmārtāṃ ca na nindayetnālokayetparadravyaṃ paradārāṃśca varjayetna caitāni vilaṅghayetparanindāṃ ca varjayetpurāṇāgamaśāstrāṇi manasāpi na dūṣayetsammārjanīṃ daṇḍaṃ dhvajaṃ vai turyamāyudhambhogayogyāni cānyāni yāgadravyāṇi yāni cacaitāni padā spṛśetparahiṃsātmikā yā ca na tāmavataretkvacitdevatātithipūjārthaṃ dānatopyarjayeddhanam [yatnata]stambhadīpamanuṣyāṇāmanyeṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathātyajeddūraṃ kharaśvājarajastathāpravāha yetsarvaṃ dadyādvā śivadīkṣitekāle kāmaṃ krodhaṃ viśeṣataḥlaṅghayetspṛśennaiva tatsamakṣaṃ na dhārayetlīlāṃ ca na kuryāddurusannidhauguroragre prabhāvaṃ svasya śiṣyakaḥsannidhau naiva svaguruṃ praṇamedbudhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gurordadyāttvamityādi na vā vadetkvāpi śapathaṃ gurusañjñitamnirvahedyatnādante pūjājapāhutīḥprāyaścittaṃ manoḥ kuryānmūlasyaiva sahasrakamca tāṃ giraṃ naiva bhāṣayetna gṛhṇīyātkadācanaācarannādarācchāntiṃ dīkṣitaḥ sodhigacchatisvasya mantro mahāpadyapi sādhakaiḥkuryādanātheṣu dayāṃ sadāvastavyaṃ prayāyātsaṃsmaranhṛdiyatra nindā tu tasminsthāne na vai vasetvacaḥ satyaṃ sauśīlyaṃ samatāṃ dhṛtimgamanāgamane kuryātpraṇamya gurupādukemalayuktādirahitaḥ keśaśmaśruviluñcanātbhāvayeddevatāṃ viṣṇuṃ guruvipraśarīragāmviśvāśrayo viṣṇurātmā jñeyaśca viṣṇuvatkartavyā satataṃ mantrasiddhayegurornāma devanāma taduttaramca vadennāma tithyarṇaṃ ca harermamabhajanaṃ devi karotyāpatparaṃparāmtatsaṃkhyā pañcatulyā pare dinepūjā proktā viṃśatibhedikāyugādyāśca yadaṅgaṃ devatābhavamdīkṣāyā divasaṃ navarātrakamkṛtā pūjā yasminbhavati niṣphalā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lābhe home mahotsaverogeṣvāpatsu doṣeṣu dussaṅge durnimittakeyathā deśastathā pūjāṃ samācaretvighneśaraviviṣṇvīśaśaktayaḥvarṣakṛtāpūjāphalaṃ gṛhṇāti kāmarāṭnavamī paurṇamāsyamā ca caturdaśīkṛtanityakriyaśśuddho yuktaḥ sāmayikairjanaiḥkṛtvā ṛṣyādīnvinyasettataḥṛṣigandharvadevādimohanāya namostu tesamāyāhi kṣamasva ca namostu tenetavyosi śivājñayāpūjayettatra tattanmantreṇa sādhakaḥkroṃ ratyai namaḥ ||] procya ratyai hṛccāṣṭavarṇakaḥsvagṛhamāgaccheddvitīye divase punaḥutpāṭayecchedayedvā svamūlenāstramantrataḥghore hrīmiti kīrtayetrudrarūpebhyo hrīṃśrīmiti manuḥ smṛtaḥpīṭhādau navāṃśāṃstasya kārayetcandanāgurukarpūracandanairlepayecca tāntadbījaṃ japanniha kṣamāpayettasyāṣṭadikṣu saṃsthāpyā ghaṭāḥ svarṇādinirmitāḥsvāsanapūjādiyogapīṭhāntamarcayetkuryādvṛttayugmaveṣṭitaṃ bhūpureṇa caprārthayitvā taṃ pūjayeccandanādibhiḥnityamānandaṃ janayasva me
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kālaṃ pañcaraṅgairvicitritamviśvaṃ yastasmai kālātmane namaḥmaṇḍūkādijñānātmāntāṃ pīṭhapūjāṃ samācarettathā hṛdyāṃ vṛṣāṃ cāpi dhṛtiṃ ratimkāmadevaṃ ca tadgāyatryā taduttarampracodayātpāśāṃkuśadhanurbāṇābhidhā dhyāyettataḥ paramtaruṇaṃ vāmadakṣiṇayoryutampāśastataḥ pūjyaṃ pūrvoktamanubhistrayamgauravarṇāṃ dhyāyedratiṃ śubhāmtāmbūlāsyāṃ bhajetprītiṃ ghaṭapuṣpalasatkarāmdakṣiṇe kusumākaramgaurāṅgaṃ surūpaṃ lokamohanamtatognīśarakṣovāyavyamadhyataḥhṛdayādīni ṣaḍaṅgāni prapūjayetbhasmaśarīraṃ cānaṅgamanmathameva catadagre tu lokapānāyudhāni cakāmadevaṃ ca ślokābhyāṃ prārthayeditikāmarūpa namostu teratiprītipriyāya caavāhayenmadhyakumbhe devaṃ sāṅgaṃ ca pūjayetyathālābhaṃ pūrṇaṃ parva tvadājñayākṛtvā nityahomaṃ samācaretsamāpyātha prārthayeddevatāmitideva kāmānkāmeśvareśvara
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dravyādyaistoṣayedviprānbhojayediti tadvidhiḥyaistu na kṛtaṃ tatphalaṃ tavamāsaḥ śrāvaṇo madhyamo bhavetca caturthyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pavitrakamrājataṃ tāmraṃ kalau kārpāsakaṃ śubhampadmajātaṃ saugatānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ kṣaumamiṣyatemuñjajātaṃ vratasthānāmāvikaṃ samaraiṣiṇāmparamaṃ proktaṃ tadardhaṃ madhyamaṃ smṛtampūjāvaraṇadevānāṃ tulyāni racayedbudhaḥdvādaśaiva kaniṣṭhe syurathānyacca pavitrakamśiṣyāṇāṃ pavitraṃ tadudāhṛtampūjāsthānetha sindūrakuṃkumāraktacandanaiḥgranthisthāneṣu saṃsthāpya pīṭhe tannavatantuṣunāgagurū raviścāpi śivāśivaupauruṣī vīrā gāyatrī cāparājitāpūjyaṃ mūlamantraiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakamnyāsādikaṃ tatra prāgvatpūjāṃ prakalpayetmūlamantreṇa pavitrasya samarpaṇambhūyasīṃ paścātsvayambhūñjīta vāgyataḥvakṣyāmi tatrādau śāntirucyateṣoḍhāhorātraṃ pañcameṃśe tu śāntikamtvapastattvaṃ tasmiñchāntikamācaretpūjayeccandanādyairvaṃbījena śatruśāntikedarśayettriṣūttarāsu parvāsu śāntikaṃ syāddvijanmasu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devarakṣorājalokasarpastrīhayahastināmnirmāya vaśyampūrvamukhaścarettayoḥ |] || svastikāsanamāruhya svāhāntaṃ mantramuccaretstambhampravakṣyāmi tadudyoganivāraṇamca sainyasya kruddhasya viṣadaṃṣṭriṇaḥgatvā stambhanasya kriyāṃ caretnāsādaṇḍena saṃlagno vāyuścedbhūdayo bhavetpīte maṇḍale tāṃ samarcayetmadhyame bhūyaḥ saṃlagne suprasārite ||] pradarśayetgajacarmāsanaṃ stambhe gadāmudrāhutau tathābharaṇī citrā rohiṇī cottarātrayamvidveṣaṇaṃ ghasrasyāṃśake tu dvitīyakehastayormuṣṭiyugalaṃ kuryātsā vighnanāśinī ||] bhavetvāārdrācatuṣṭayaṃ mūlaṃ jyeṣṭhā vidveṣaṇe matāśastā tṛtīyāśe dinasya tatśatroruccāṭanaṃ kuryādyaṃ bījena tamarcayetmṛgacarmādikaṃ tatra vāyavyasya ca karmaṇimanuḥvarjayedviprānanyāṃścāpi sudhārmikānrakṣārthaṃ tu tadā haretca kartavyaṃ devi taddoṣaśāntayekṛṣṇatilairvā ghṛtasaṃyutaiḥṣaṣṭhoṃśaḥ [veti śeṣaḥ |] śaranmāraṇakarmaṇidakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ kuryādbhadrakālīṃ samarcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jīvanmuktastadā jñeyaḥ sāmarthye devatāsamaḥśāpairmantrā vimucyante yānkṛtvā devanirmitaiḥprakartavyā śiṣyasya siddhihetavesvāpakāla iḍāyāmagnirūpiṇaḥsañjapto jāgṛto jāyate manuḥsavisargāṃstāṃstrikālaṃ kevalaṃ japetśābaramantrāṇāṃ jāgṛtiṃ śṛṇu pārvatiprajapedravirātrau tu yāmeyāme śatāṣṭakammantra tvaṃ bhāṣayātha turīyakecānyadeveṣu sphoṭayennārikelakambhagavānprovāca madhusūdanaḥunmattāstu tadā devāḥ śreṣṭhohamiti cābruvanvākyaṃ śāpe cānugrahe kṣamamvaco viṣṇoḥ śepuścaiva parasparamśāpamokṣeṇa kaḥ siddhiṃ prāpnuyājjanaḥniśśāpatvaṃ kathaṃ teṣu siddhiḥ syāditi me vadacaturādyaścaikabījo nidhāyaikatra saṅgamaḥśāpāttu cchidyante'sya manorathāḥdvidhā vajrī tridhā madhyaṃ dvidhāvāmadakṣamārgayorapi viśrutauhuṅkāro vā sa mantrastu śaktihīnaḥ kṛtaḥ suraiḥśaktihīnasya vāmasya maraṇannātra saṃśayaḥparāṅmukho mantro jātaḥ sūryasya śāpataḥdaivātkāryepi saṃsiddhirlokaḥ syācca parāṅmukhaḥkṛtā mantrā devācāryeṇa śāpitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: huṃkārāntena mantreṇa māhiṣaṃ vātha lohajamkuryātkṛṣṇavarṇaṃ kṛṣṇadravyaiśca pūjanamsthitaḥtiṣṭhankuryānmāraṇaṃ vā bhūmau pādaṃ niveśayetvakṣyante tvabhicārāśca tatra cavāpi śūkaryāṃ mudrayā hunetmṛgāntyacitrāmaitreṣu devadhyānantu rājasamharidrāmiśritantoyaṃ tarpaṇārthaṃ prayojayetsarvāṇi karmāṇi raudrabhe tu prasādhayetsarvarakṣamibhākāraṃ dhyāyenniścalamānasaḥdhyāyedevaṃvidhaṃ vāpi sarvakāryaṣu sādhakaḥproktaṃ pūrvā caivottarātrayamvahnikoṇasammukhastu samācaretsarvajñānaprasiddhyarthamīśānābhimukho bhavetmantro vauṣaṭpallavasaṃyutaḥyathoktadevatādhyānaṃ kuryātpauṣṭikakarmaṇimahāsukhasamāyuktadhyānaṃ vai nirbhayambhavettu phaḍantaḥ syāddhomo dhyānantu tāmasamkalpāntāgnisamaṃ yuddhe dhyāyeddevaṃ ca tāmasamsamarcayedvighnaṃ vāreśāṃśca tithīśvaramtatorcayediṣṭadevantato homaṃ samācaretjñaviṣṇū ca caturvaktrabṛhaspatīvāreśvarā devi tithīśāṃstvamatho śṛṇuvasavo nāgā dharmaḥ śivadivākarauvahnirbrahmā candraḥ śivo'ditiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāyurathendrāgnī mitraścaiva sureśvaraḥvaruṇo'jaikapādahirbudhnyapūṣakauityādi |] namasā ca samanvitāḥeteṣāṃ nāmamantrāstu grāhyāḥ pūjādisādhaneviparītāni kṛtvā nirayamāpnuyātparasyāpi kāmyakarmāṇi cācaretkurvīta nānyeṣāntu kadācanabhaktasya nyāyārjitadhanasya cakāryaṃ kuryācca deśikaḥvṛṇuyātkarmakartāraṃ dīkṣoktavidhinā tataḥjitendriyo jitakrodho mānakṣobhavivarjitaḥyathoktantu kṛtvābhyaṅgaṃ samācaretaṣṭottarasahasrañca rakṣārthaṃ prajapenmanumsuhṛdbhiḥ susnigdhairātmarakṣāntu kārayetjapahomārcanādyaiśca brāhmaṇārādhanādibhiḥprayogānkurvīta hyanyathā duḥkhamāpnuyātmuhuścāpi yathā syāttuṣṭimāstathāsiddhyantyasiddhasya devatāśāpamāpnuyātprayogasiddhirevaiṣāṃ phalamanyanna vidyateparasyāpi ṣaṭ karmāṇi susādhayetprayogadoṣaśāntyarthamātmarakṣārthameva casarvaṃ kathayeta śubhāśubhamkāryā karmakāle viśeṣataḥkṣudrāṇāṃ vāmamārgiṇāmparaniṣṭhāparāṇāntu vāmināṃ paramā gatiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na kurvanti kadācidiha ninditamkulasaṃśuddhāḥ kalpoktenaiva saṃskṛtāḥcaryā kimanya cchrotumicchasisiddhisthirīkaraṇaprakāśaḥ saptamaḥsarvadevapriyā yāśca pūjāsāphalyadāyikāḥkurute sarvā devāssyustasya saukhyadāḥtarjanī vakrā saralā cāpi madhyamāyatraikamuṣṭiraṃguṣṭho dakṣo vāmaṃ samāśritaḥvahnernayedastrāhvayāpi caaṃguṣṭhena catasrastu tarjanyāṃguṣṭhameva cacatasroṃgulayo vyastā hṛdaye tasya mantrataḥcatasroṃgulayaścāpi prasārya śirasā dhṛtāḥtena śikhāṃ spṛṣṭvā śikhāmantreṇa sādhakaiḥskandhādānābhiparyantaṃ pāṇyostu prakramo bhavettvanāmā tu vāme tryakṣadivaukasāmca sūryaviṣṇvādibhedayoḥvakṣyāmi ṣaṇmudrāṇāntu lakṣaṇammadhyame'nyonyakarayoḥ pṛṣṭhalagne pare tathānamaskāramudrā lalitāyāḥ prakīrtitākaniṣṭhāmadhyaparvasthāvaṃguṣṭhau kṣobhiṇī matākaniṣṭhāsthāvaṃguṣṭhau drāviṇī bhavetsarale śeṣā mukhayuktānukarṣiṇīkṛtamuṣṭipadau hastau kṛtvāṃguṣṭhau hṛdi nyasetkuryādūrdhvaprasaktāgre tarjanyau jyeṣṭhayā yuteprasaktāgre kaniṣṭhe tūrdhvataḥ sthite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tarjanyāvānayenmūrdhni mukhe pārśve kare hṛdisaṃyutāgre aṃguṣṭhakakaniṣṭhikeśabdayettabhyāṃ jyeṣṭhāgravalitāgrayākarayostarjanīmadhyā nāmāyuktā na vakritāḥcāpi dakṣaskandhe pradarśayetvāmāṃgulyagradakṣāṃguṣṭhasya yoge prajāyateśeṣāṃgulyāvaṃguṣṭhāvanāmikedakṣiṇaṃ nyasyāṃguṣṭhakau cālayeditianāmayormūlaparvaṇyaṃguṣṭhau nikṣipettadāsā cetsarvasaṃsthāpane kṣamāsthāpane yā syādaṃguṣṭhadvayamuktakamkriyate nyāso hyaṅgānāmaṅgine sakṛthastasya savyasya bhrāmayecca tāmanyonyagrathitāṃguṣṭhaprasāritakarāṃgulījātau tvaṃguṣṭhāvucchritau yadidvāvaṃguṣṭhau muṣṭiyogo niśchidraśca bhavedyadimadhyasaralābaddhamuṣṭikākṣiptvā baddhā muṣṭiyugaṃ tarjanyaṃguṣṭhayoryutiḥcotthitau lagnau mudrā vaśakarī matādṛḍhaṃ baddhānāmikāgre tu yojayetanyonyāṃguṣṭhakau lagnau mudrā conmādinī matāsaṃyojyānāmikāmukhyau saralau syānmahāṃkuśāmadhyamāsandhinirgatāṃguṣṭhamuṣṭikāprasṛtāsaṃyutā hastā talaṃ hastatalānvitamaṃgulyo viralā namrā nimnaṃ karatalaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaḍgaṇeśasyāṃkuśamudrā ca saptamīdakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ kṛtvādho nāmayecchanaiḥvāmahastaṃ baddhāṃguṣṭhakaniṣṭhikamśaktipriyā matākaniṣṭhāgre dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhapīḍitamhastayormuṣṭiyugalaṃ kuryādvighnavināśanamdakṣañca śirasi sthāpayeditivarādyāḥ pāśaścāṃkuśaḥ śakterdaśa smṛtāḥkaniṣṭhānāmikāntarebhūyaḥ sallaṁgne suprasāritekuryātsaṃhatā unnatāṃgulīvāmāṃguṣṭhodare śeṣā vakrācordhvaṃ kaniṣṭhikākaniṣṭhayormūlagate tarjanyau bhavato yadikaniṣṭhātarjanīgranthiḥ sthāpyau tiryaṅmukhau karaumālāvatspṛśedākaṇṭhapādakamvāmahastāmbujaṃ vā tu yadi mūrdhani vinyasetanyonyahastāṃgulayastanniṣṭhāḥ sthāpayeddhṛdisamyaksaṃyojya madhye ca tarjanībhyāṃ suveṣṭayetanyonyāntargate dakṣakarṇānte khecarī matākṛtvā tarjanyaṃguṣṭhayoryutiḥbinā sarvaṃ vṛthā pūjājapādikamsaṃyutā mithaḥ padatulye ubhayāṃgulī vareaṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ ca karayorākrameta kanisṭhikeaṃgulyagrāṇi saṃyojyādhastātsannamayeditimadhyamayā madhyāṃ nāmayediti sā bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhyamāsaṃsthamaṃguṣṭhayugalaṃ yadicakrādyāśca dhanurbāṇaparyantāśca harerimāḥdhārayettasmiṃścandrāgre sampradarśayetkamalākṛtimudrā syādubhe sto bhāskarapriyevāmāṃgulyau dakṣiṇābhirveṣṭayetsā śivapriyāprasārayeccheṣamaṃgulīnāṃ trayaṃ tadāprasārayedaṃgulīnāṃ trayaṃ japasusiddhayeanāmikāguṣṭhamadhyāgrāṇi tiryagyutāni cadakṣiṇāścenmilitā ūrdhvamucchritāḥpātravacca kuryātsā bhairavapriyāpracālayetkarṇapārśve daśaitāḥ śūlinā matāḥhastau kalikābhāvadhomukhauphaṇākārau svasvadigbhāgasaṃsthitauānayedvāmakarṇe tāṃ mudrā saubhāgyadāyinīripujihvāgrahākhyeyaṃ mudrikā śatrunāśinīuttānāvūrudeśasyāsannau namrastathā pumānyadā baddhau muṣṭī karṇavadāśritauaṃguṣṭhatarjanīyogaḥ kartayo hastayordvayoḥkaniṣṭhajāstisro'ṃguṣṭhāgraṃ tarjanīyutamanāmikāṃguṣṭhayoścedagrayogaḥ prajāyateyuktāsāsnānenantaphalapradāspṛśedeṣā dāne vastrasya dhāraṇeanāmikāṃguṣṭhayoścedagrayogaḥ prajāyatekaraṇādike skhalitadhāraṇekaniṣṭhāgre spṛśetsyādgandhadhāraṇe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tathāṃguṣṭhāgraṃ saṃyojyeti pūjanetarjanyāḥ spṛśedagraṃ ca pūrvavatspṛśedagraṃ madhyamāyāśca pūrvavatviśeṣonāmikāgrantu jyaṣṭhāgreṇa tu yojayetdarśayetpañcavāyūnāmucyante pañcamudrikāḥkaniṣṭhānāmike samyagaṃguṣṭhāgreṇa yojayetvāyurodhādyogī vimucyatevāyurdṛṣṭvā tāṃ suprasīdatitarjanīmadhyamānāmāssarvarogāpanodinīpraṇavādicaturthyantā namo'ntānāmamantrakāḥmahāyonyabhidhā mudrā sundaryānandadāyinīantarvalitamutthāpya tarjanyau sarale kṛteśaktiranayā svasthāne varadā vrajetkaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhayugalaṃ maṇibandhau ca saṃyutauhaste kākatuṇḍanibhe mukheśanaiśca sarale tarjanyo mudritāḥ parāḥtuṣṭitkrtrītatra saṃyuktārivināśinītarjanyaṃguṣṭhasaṃyogaḥ pūrṇakarmaṇi yojayetpārśvayoścāpi salagnau dvāvevābhimukhau tadādakṣiṇāniviḍā muṣṭirnāsikārpitatarjanīyamināṃ sevyā brahmābhivyaktikāriṇīprasṛtāṃgulikau dṛśyau mithaḥ śliṣṭau ca sammukhausaṃyutau kṛtvā prasṛtāṃgulikau tathāspṛśettasya tarjanībhyāṃ tadānnadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tarjanībhyāntu sarvapātakanāśinīcāntarikṣe ca sthāpitaśca nirīkṣitaḥcordhvamukhau hastau granthiraṃguṣṭhayorbhavetmadhyamānāmayoragre mūle pṛṣṭhe ca taddvayamkaniṣṭhā dakṣā syāttayorūrdhvantu vāmajepṛṣṭhānmadhyāparinipīḍitedarśayettāsāṃ devatāśca tathā phalamśaktiḥ sumukhānandadāyinīśaktirnityaviśvā viśvasyātipriyaṅkarātacchaktiḥ sarveṣāṃ hṛdayaṃgamāśaktistu vimalā tasyāḥ prabhāvādamalo bhavetyogaḥ śaktistasyāssadābhidhāśeṣamaṃgulyo bhinnāḥ śaktiḥ prabhāvatīśeṣāṃgulyastu sambhinnā līlā śaktiprakīrtitābhinnāḥ śaktiḥ śāntiśca śāntikṛtkaniṣṭhādvitayaṃ hitvā śaktirdurgā prakīrtitāsaṃyuktau śaktirasyāḥ sarasvatīcottānau viśvarūpāsti devatābaddhamuṣṭī viśākhyā śaktiratra tusaṃlagnau vāmā lopātra devatācocchritāṃguṣṭhau vāmā śaktiḥ samīritāḥvāma ūrdhvamāpyāyinī bhavetvimalā tasyāḥ śaktiḥ prakīrtitātatra śaktiḥ proktā tamomayīaṃgulyaścordhvayuktāgrāḥ śeṣāḥ śaktirhiraṇmayī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tacchaktiḥ sūkṣmā sūkṣmārthasādhikāsthāpayitvādhomukhaṃ tannāmayedviśvayonikādarśayecchaktirgadārūpā prakīrtyatedavatāstasya viphalantu kṛtaṃ bhavettathā bhaktakṛtā mudrā dṛṣṭvā hṛṣyanti devatāḥpadārtha ekaścetsādhakante śapanti camacatuṣṭayamicchanti taṃ vinā praśapanti caāvaśyakamaṃtra pañca taṃ vinā praśapanti catepi praśapanti ca sādhakammokṣaṃ labhate mudrāvinnātra saṃśayaḥtattvaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasimudrālakṣaṇaprakāśo'ṣṭamaḥśiṣyo dhanārthī gurureva cadūresmāddaihikī siddhiḥ pārakīyā kathaṃ bhavetsiddhiḥ syādvinā nindāṃ vadasva tatgranthā āgamākhyāḥ prasāritāḥsarvadevagaṇaistyaktaṃ tadā tu pṛthivītalamāgamairbhāsite deśe sopyagamyo bhaviṣyaticirajīvibhyaḥ pārthivaṃ liṅgapūjanamparatrāpi siddhiḥ karatale sthitānityaṃ vidhāyādau gacchecchuddhāṃ bhuvaṃ sudhīḥśamīgarbhāśvatthamūle nadīkūle ca nirjanevaṭādhastāttatra bhūmiṃ mantrayetprārthayeditipūjayitvā tu dharaṇīṃ prārthayeditigrahīṣyāmi prasannā tvaṃ liṅgārthaṃ bhava me sadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nidadhyātsaṃśuddhe pratyahaṃ pūjanāya tāmgṛhṇīyātsaptapūjāyāstathā guhagaṇeśayoḥnamaḥ saṃghaṭṭanaṃ bhavetvastrādyācchādite pīṭhe oṃ pinākadhṛte namaḥbhedena tatra dhyāyecchivaṃ prabhumpūjyaḥ pañcopacārakaiḥgaṇataye glauṃ gaṃ hrīṃ ca bhavākṣaraḥimānmanūn gṛhītvā tu japedaṣṭasahasrakamśuddhaḥ pradāyārghyaṃ vivasvatepiṇḍayetsveṣṭamānaṃ pātre nidhāpayetpārthivānīha pūjayemukasakhyayāgaṇeśvarasya mantreṇa kuryāddvāragaṇeśvaramsthāpayetpīṭhe tato viprassamācaretaviprāṇāñchṛṇu nyāsaṃ gopyaṃ pārthivapūjanehrauṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktirnamaḥ kīlakamucyatebījapūrvāṃstu nyāse mantrānpravinyasetcānantaśaktiśivāya cabahusthaleṣu gaditā atotra noktāḥ |] mṛttikāmkuryādaghoreṇārcayettatpuruṣeṇa cagaṇeśānaṃ pīṭhamadhye niveśayetaṃguṣṭhamānādadhikaṃ vitastyavadhisundarampakvajambūphalākāraṃ sarvakāmasamṛddhidamsyātsvalpe siddhirna jāyateavaśiṣṭamṛdā kuryātkumārantasya mantrataḥarccayanpārthivaṃ liṅgaṃ yathoktaphalabhāgbhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nūnaṃ mahākālena bhāṣitamrepho'gnibījamuddiṣṭa me-e-nnettratrayaṃ mamaśāpānnetrahīno duḥkhaśokāmayapradaḥśrūṃ vāthavā hrūṃ vā namo vā hrīṃ manuḥ sa tulatrayaṃ vā na cetsaṃstambhito manuḥduḥkhaṃ ca prāyaśo bahulaṃ bhavetyakāreṇa saṁyyuktāni manussa tutasmātsaṃskārayeddevi siddhaye sādhakottamaḥyadakṣarairantaritaḥ phaṭkāraḥ sa nigadyatesādhako naiva siddhaḥ sandṛśyate kvacitbrahmaśāpāddhīnasiddhirbhavedatyantakaṣṭadaḥmāyāśāpānmālinyakārakaḥrudraśāpātsādhyaṃ kuryāttiraskṛtamkuryādbālāśāpena bheditaḥsiṃhaśāpena proktobhīṣṭa phalāpahaḥcāmuṇḍāśāpato jāto madonmatto na śobhanaḥmūrcchitaṃ kuryādvāminaṃ tu viśeṣataḥhatavīryastu śāpena kṛtaḥ kṣīṇatvakārakaḥaṣṭādaśākṣaro hīno hānirbhairavaśāpataḥkāmaśāpena dhvaṃsayetkāmakāraṇātṣoḍaśārṇastu taruṇaḥ prauḍho vyomābdhivarṇakaḥete kālena śaptā duḥkhāni kurvatesaṃśapto nityaṃ nairāśyakārakaḥnamo vā svāhā vā nāsti vā yasya madhyamaḥsevāṃ kurvallaṁbheddeśanāśaṃ varṣatrayāditaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāntriko māsamantraistu phalārthī śivamarcayetparāprāsādabījādyaiḥ pūjayetkaulikaistu taiḥdhyāyetkāmanābhedanāttu tatdhyānamidaṃ jñeyaṃ noktaṃ vā yatra tatra catrilocanaṃ caturbāhuṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamvyāghracarmottarīyaṃ ca nāgayajñopavītakamvaradābhayahastaṃ ca namajjanavarapradamkapilaṃ dantanakhābhidyotakāriṇamsurāsuranamaskṛtamsarvavyāpinamīśānaṃ rudraṃ vai viśvarūpiṇammanuṣyaistvaṃ siddhairdevāsurādibhiḥsvāminsarvajagannātha yāvatpūjāvasānakamdeveśaṃ pārthivaṃ pūjayettataḥkārtikeyaḥ proktā pūjeyamuttamāvidhijñaiḥ sā pūjeyaṃ madhyamā tadādhūpadīpanivedyādi yathāṃśena nivedayetpaśupatiṃ tathākṣityaptejonilākāśayajamānendubhāskarāḥdhūpadīpanivedyādinamaskārapradakṣiṇaiḥoṃ namaśca śivo ṅentaḥ prasannāyedamuccaretpūjānteṣṭhottaraśataṃ japenmantramananyadhīḥekādaśāhutīḥ paścātpraṇameddaṇḍavatkṣitaupatnīṃ ṅentāṃ namonvitāmdvitīyāntaistarpayāmi bilvapatrairjalākṣataiḥbhojayedekamabhāve vedavittamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: siddhissyānnātra kāryā vicāraṇāsā pūjā snānadānādikāḥ kriyāḥtaṇḍulodbhavapiṣṭena vidyārthī tu sahasrakamvidyāṃ dhyānamasya nirūpyatecaturdikṣu tathā yaśaḥkṛṣṇāgurorliṃgaṃ pūjitaṃ dhāraṇāpradamprāgvadvrīhimayaṃ liṃgaṃ kṛtvā hanyātskhaladgiramdadhaddhastairvaṭamūlamupāśritaḥtu liṃgāni māsātsā sarvatomukhīnīlakaṇṭhastrinetraḥnadītīradvayānītamṛdā tāni ca pūjayetindranīlaśaraccandranibho bhūṣaṇapūgavānpīyūṣapūrṇakalaśaṃ dadhatpāśāṃkuśāvapipārthivānyatha vā kuryādardhalakṣamitāni tudadhibhaktastu naivedye paiṣṭenātra yathecchayādvayaṃ pūjyaṃ dhyānamatra nirūpyatelohaliṃgāni tuṣajānyatha vāpi caśmaśānamṛttikāyāstu vidveṣe yutamācaretdveṣe dhyātavyaḥ punarīdṛśaḥ|| muṇḍamālālasatkaṇṭho rāvavitrāsitākhilaḥkoṭiliṃgāni pūjayeddhyānamucyatedhyāye śivāliṅgitamaṣṭadehamdivyānbhogānavāpnoti dhyānamatra nirūpyateliṅgānyayutasaṅkhyāni dhātrī phalabhavāni tulabhate bhūmiṃ trisandhyaṃ tvekameva vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viśvavandyaṃ nikhilabhayaharaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trinetrampṛthakpṛthagbilvadalaistatra dhyānamudīryatediśatu girisutāyā vallabho no vibhūtīḥprītivṛddhayepūjayitvā bhartuḥ priyatarā bhavetgomayasyāpi vālukāyāstathā phalamniścalamanā jaganmitraṃ sa jāyatesaśāstrābhyasanādeva gurutopyadhiko bhavetpatrairnaivedyaṃ guḍamarpayetliṅgāni gomayasyaiva yo yajetsampado yāyātṣaṇmāsānevamācaretdurbhūpānāmaṣṭaśataṃ tripakṣaṃ nityamarcayet|| kruddhaṃ maheśvaraṃ dhyāyetsaparājayate ripūnsahasrāṇāṃ pañcakena mahīpatimdurganirmuktikāmastu kuryātpañcasahasrakammahādurganibaddhastu ṣaṇmāsānmokṣamāpnuyātvā pañcaśataṃ pūjayecca tripakṣakamnāsti sukhenāyāti deśataḥpañcaśatakaṃ yorcayettu tadantakaḥpūrvajanmārjitādvāpi dāridryātparimucyatemāsamātreṇa sakalaṃ kalmaṣaṃ dahetvarṣatrayaṃ tasya sarvapāpanāśaḥ prajāyatesyāttrivarṣaṃ vā pūjayetsphāṭikaṃ tathākanyakā satpatiṃ labhetsarvaguṇā jāyante samupasthitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rudrasaṅkhyaṃ varṣādgrāma patirbhavetnaktabhojī ca rudrasūktaparāyaṇaḥsaubhāgyaṃ nirdhanasyāpi vardhatepratyahaṃ cedannaṃ kṣetre bhavedbahudhattūrakusumotthāni liṅgānyekādaśārcayetcāyutasaṅkhyāni vaśīkuryājjagattrayamśeṣaḥ]phalaliṅgāni pūjyāni tena cāyutasaṅkhyayātasyālpamṛtyunāśaḥ syāttathā nīvārapiṣṭajāttāmrajaṃ liṅgaṃ tasya siddhyati pauṣṭikampūjanāttasya bahusvāmitvamāpnuyātliṅgamayutaṃ paripūjayetsaṅkalpenātra saṃśayaḥ|| dehasaugandhyalābhāya gandhakotthaṃ samarcayetpūjayedyastu dāridryātpratimucyatemudgapiṣṭānmude nityaṃ liṅgaṃ pūjyaṃ trayaṃ dvijaiḥmāṣapiṣṭamayaṃ liṅgaṃ nityapiṣṭānnasiddhidam[sīsakasya ||] liṅgaṃ priyadaṃ sarvadehināmpriyaṃ tasya liṅgaṃ kṛtvā tadāpnuyātpūjayedyastu tasya syāddviguṇākṛtiḥkāryasya siddhiṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥmatimāñchivena saha modatepāṣāṇaṃ pāṣāṇātsphāṭikaṃ paramkāśmīrātpuṣparāgotthamiṃdranīlodbhavaṃ tataḥśreṣṭhaṃ tasmācchreṣṭhaṃ tu rājatam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hīrakātpāradaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bāṇaliṅgaṃ tataḥ parambāṇāsurārcitaṃ liṅgaṃ bāṇaliṅgamitīritamcāndrāyaṇasamaṃ jñeyaṃ śambhornaivedyabhakṣaṇamjalaṃ cānnaṃ grāhyaṃ prāsādasañjñayāsarvaliṅgebhyastaddhi pajyatamaṃ matamliṅgamākhyātaṃ pañcasūtraiḥ susādhitampūjanīyaṃ na kadāpi na satphalamśālagrāmo nārmadaśca sūkṣmaḥ sūkṣmo viśiṣyatepūjayetsatataṃ liṅgaṃ tattanmaṃtreṇa sādaramśambhornacāvaidikavartmanāśraddhā pūte vaidikakarmaṇipārthivaliṅgataḥśreṣṭhaṃ pārthivaṃ tu kalau yugepūjayetpārthivaṃ liṅgaṃ śāstroktavidhinā naraḥyathākathaṃcidvidhinā ramaṇīyaṃ prakalpayetratnahemadharāsūtapiṣṭasphaṭikasambhavamtu dvikhaṇḍaṃ tu sthiraṃ smṛtampītā ca śūdrāṇāṃ kṛṣṇā vā labhyate yathāśarvāya śaśimaulinepūjāsamāptau tu dadyātpuṣpāñjalitrayamvakṣyamāṇāṃ stutiṃ paścātpaṭheddevasya tuṣṭayesarvalokānāṃ tvameva jagataḥ pitāgurustvaṃ gatiḥ sākṣī tvaṃ pitā tvaṃ pitāmahaḥdharmarūpahitāya cacaiva pāvakāmitatejase
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: somāya amṛtāya namostu tedharmagovāhanāya cabhagavānrudro vāñchitārthaṃ prayacchatuathaikādaśaliṅgānāṃ vidhānamabhidhīyatedroṇapuṣpairghṛtameva samarpayetnaivedyārthaṃ guḍassmṛtaḥtrayaṃ kṛtvā ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥpañcaśatakaṃ kanyā bhavati śobhanāpūjayedyavanaivedyaṃ puṣpāṇi campakasya tuṣaṭṣaḍbakulapuṣpaiśca naivedyaṃ kṣaudrameva capuṣpaiḥ śatapatraiḥ prapūjayetyattīrthaṃ tadbhaveddevatāpi catatra laḍḍukā upacārāśca ṣoḍaśakṛtvā naivedyaṃ pañcamāsakamkāñcanapuṣpakaiḥpratidinaṃ naivedyaṃ pañcakhādyakammuktāphalapravālādi yadiṣṭaṃ prāpnuyācca tatsampūrṇe sañjāte ca manorathevittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta tatpramāṇena nirmitamśaivayoga ekasmiṃstu dinaṃ śivamphalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥbrāhmaṇāṃścāpi homārthaṃ vṛṇuyāttataḥprāṇapratiṣṭhāpūrvantu vahnisthāpanamācaretyajelliṅgaṃ tanmitaṃ homamācarettilājyābhyāṃ careddhomametadbhinnaṃ yadarthayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mārjanaṃ kuryāttato brāhmaṇabhojanampūjayitvā dadyāttaṃ gurave punaḥbhūyasīṃ dattvā suhṛdbhissaha bhojanampārthivānāṃ sarvakāmaprapūrakaḥudyāpanena sahitaḥ kimanyacchrotumicchasipārthiva pūjāvidhiḥ varṇanaṃnāma navamaḥ prakāśaḥūrdhvāmnāyaṃ kvaciddakṣamuttaraṃ paścimaṃ kvacitkvacidbauddhaṃ pākhaṇḍaṃ ca kvacitkvacitmārgaṃ vedāntaṃ vaidikaṃ kvacitdeśadharmānkāladharmāñjātidharmānkvacitkvacitbrūhi niḥsandehā ca māṃ kurutattadādhikyaṃ sāhaṅkāraṃ bravīmi tatsarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭaṃ tattvaṃ bravīmi tatkalerdaśasahasrāṇi yadā varṣāṇi yānti cadevi jñeyaḥ kālaḥ samāgataḥśāstrāṇi tathā jānantu devatāḥtāvattanmārgiṇāṃ saukhyaṃ vedamārgodya kuṇṭhitaḥtānānayanti sve mārge yattattāvatsukhaṃ bhavetṣaḍaṅgairvedārthajñānaṃ bhavati niścitamkālamaheśasya pañcāmnāyā mayoditāḥpramāṇaṃ vedāssyustadaṃśāḥ smṛtayastathāvayaṃ yasya vācamartho'nudhāvatilakṣaṇe devi svācārādbrāhmaṇo bhavetcaturlakṣaṇahīnānāṃ mārgāssyuḥ kaulikādayaḥyathākālaṃ kartavyo dharmasaṃgrahaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yatkiñcijjanma yatkarma na japona tapaḥ kriyāḥdharmaḥ sopi vākkāyakarmabhiḥbhuktvā yātyante paramaṃ padamjīvanmuktaṃ na saṃśayaḥtanmanasā yena jīvanmuktaḥ sa eva hiduḥkhaṃ syātkarmaṇā sa vimucyatenirvāhastāvatkālaṃ parikṣipetkāmayetkiñcijjīvanmuktaḥ sa eva hitadaṃśārādhanātsaiva prasannā cedvimuñcatipratāryate ceyaṃ jīvanmuktaḥ sa ucyateviditaṃ bandhātsvayaṃ muktastadā bhavetśukavadyopratigrāhī jīvanmuktaḥ sa kopi higalito jīvanmuktassa eva hisarvaṃ yo nayetsa tu mokṣavānsambhāvayannityaṃ mahākāle layaṃ vrajetsamastairathavājñātairvañciteyaṃ na cetaraiḥmahākālaṃ jīvanmuktastadā bhavetyairjñātā gurumārgeṇa tairbandhoyaṃ vimocitaḥparityajya yetra magnāstu te hatāḥbhogopi mokṣopi bhavedyeṣāṃ ca durgatiḥbhavettejaḥ śiṣyopi labhate sukhamsyācchiṣyaḥ syādduḥkhabhājanamkuryātkiñcidbrāhmaṇatāṃ gataḥkathaṃ lapsyāmyahaṃ sukhammako nityamitthaṃ vicārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ye kecinmāse madye ratā vayampūrvoktalakṣaṇairyuktāstepi śiṣyāḥ prakīrtitaḥtathā viṣṇustasyājñāvaśavartinaḥcaturlakṣaṇasampanno vipro jñeyosti madhyamaḥphalati cādyasya kriyayā cāparasya tuphalade sto na vāmakesyātāṃ na kadācana vaidikaḥśūdrādiyavanāntānāṃ siddhirvāmapathe sthitāspṛśedvaiṣṇavaṃ vipraṃ praṇamenna ca vaidikamtadvartmatvādvratairviṣṇoḥ pūtā niṣkilviṣāstathāsatsaṅgaśca vivekaśca niścalaṃ nayanadvayamsāṃsārikasukhāsaktaṃ brahmajñosmīti vādinammāṃsaṃ surāpānaṃ matsyastrībāndhavāstathāmārge guptaṃ bhuktaṃ palādikamsadā sevyo vaidiko dharmasañcayaḥvinānyasya strīgo vāpi sa nārakīguruścaiva śiṣyaśca yoginīnāṃ bhavetpaśuḥbāhubhyāṃ tartumicchatite bhuktimuktyośca bhājanamdṛṣṭvā rājāno daṇḍayantu vālakṣmīstiṣṭhatu vā yātu na muñcāmi pathastvimānnārthalobhānna ca krodhānna dveṣānna ca matsarātnārcayeddevīṃ mārgesminvighnamāpnuyātsoyaṃ kaulo na cetaraḥpratyakṣaphaladantadevottamadarśanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvavimohitāḥityevācaraṇaṃ proktaṃ pāmarāḥ pravadanti casarve kiṃ siddhā na bhavantvimetadā mokṣo māṃsādanyanna bhuñjatemuktāssyuḥ kasya janma bhaviṣyatibhujaṅgāvaraṇaṃ nūnaṃ śakyaṃ vai kulavartmataḥjñeyaṃ vedādiṣu nirūpitampaśūnāṃ tu kaulikānāṃ mahatphalamsurāmadyaṃ sarveṣāmuttamaṃ smṛtamsurādarśanamātreṇa kuryātsūryāvalokanamājānubhyāṃ bhavetsnānaṃ nābhyāmupavasedahaḥkṛte vahnijvaladdaṇḍaṃ praveśayethanyādātmārthaṃ prāṇinaḥ priyedurācārastiryagyoniṣu jāyateca khādatyaṣṭau ca te samāḥvadhabandhādyarityekastrividho mataḥvāpi hatvā pāpairna lipyateadhikārī bhaktiyukto yo bhavedgurusevakaḥpūrvaṃ bhaktiyogaṃ tu dakṣiṇammātṛkānyāsasaṃsthāne vāme kaulikavartmanidvipamāye kamalājaladhī tathāsamudratanayāpīṭhe kṣetrayuglokamātṛkāramāguhyau padmācaraṇakau tathāaṇḍajāśca mahālakṣmīstu jarāyujalakṣmikātruṭyame ca caṇḍikā ca kalānvitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śāpena siddhihīno na siddhikṛtmūrkhatvaṃ kuryājjanmanijanmanihānirmātaṃgyāḥ śāpataḥ smṛtānāśayetsādhakabalaṃ rājñaḥ senāṃ vināśayetmantraṃ cakṣuṣā naiva paśyatitajjapādvaṃśavṛddhirna cānyathā strīsukhaṃ nahivyākulaṃ cittaṃ jāyate sādhakasya tuāliṅgitenāyaṃ japātsatvarato mṛtiḥsādhakaṃ kuryātpānādivyasanākulamrājamātaṅgyāḥ śāpāddāridryakārakaḥtenaiva mandatā jāyate nṛṇāmśāpādaṃgahīnaḥ kāmanāpūrako nahisādhyanāśaṃ kṛtvā naśyecca sādhakaḥatikruddhastajjapena svakṛte svasya saṃkṣayaḥsavrīḍāmātṛkāśāpātsavrīḍāstasya sādhakāḥyatra varṇāḥ śāpitāśchinnamastayāniṣkāmairyā jibhirjaptā saṃsārasnehanāśanāḥyajñaśāpātpauṣṭikādiṣu varjitāḥdaṇḍakākhyāḥ pīḍitāśca tajjapātkaṣṭamāpnuyātkhaṇḍīkṛtāssaptadhā te siddhikhaṇḍakarāḥ smṛtāḥjātā tu tadā dattaḥ śāpaḥ sudāruṇaḥkuryāttasmāttanmantraśodhanamgudameḍhrāntaraṃ dṛḍhamdakṣiṇaṃ gulphagranthyoranyonyamardanamviniṣpīḍya sthirakāya upāviśet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ambikāghaṭike ceva muhūrtaśca satīyutaḥsandhyā ca pārvatī rātrisaṃyutādākṣāyaṇyā tathā vāraṃ haimavatyāyutaṃ nyasetca karaṇaṃ mṛḍānyā pakṣameva caathartuparameśvaryau kālī cāyanasaṃyutāyādisthāneṣu vinyasettato vāṇī pañcakarmendriyānvitāca vāgantaḥkaraṇānvitāceti vyāpakaṃ vidyayā nyasetvadetprapañcarūpāyai śriyai nama iti kramātmātṛkānyāsasaṃproktasthāneṣu tadanantaramparāmbādevyai ca namoktyā vyāpakaṃ nyasettritāramūlamantrānte vibhāgenākṣarāṇi catu koṭi guhyapadaṃ vadetprocya proktāṅgeṣu pravinyasetsthāne sthānayugme dvayaṃ dvayamlokānāmatalaṃ vitala tathābhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca maharjanastapastathādvitīyetha cātiguhyamacintyakamyoginīsthāne rahasyaṃ jñānamagrataḥḍākinīṃ cātha mahārahasyahākinīśrīhākinīṃ paścānmahākāyaṃ ca yākinīmmalādhāraṃ svādhiṣṭhānanābhikamtritāramūlamantrānte caturdaśa tu vaṃ vadetpravakṣyāmi tatrādau praṇavatrayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yuktānproktāṅgeṣu pravinyasetdakṣapārśve tu madhusūdanaḥrukmiṇīyugvāmakaṭyāṃ kāntiyuktastu vāmanaḥekanāsāhṛṣīkeśo dakṣajānuni vinyasetdakṣāyāṃ jaṅghāyāṃ vāsudevayuksaṅkarṣaṇayutā dakṣapāde pradyumnasaṃyutāvinyasyāḥ sānusvārādipūrvakāḥdakṣapāde karabhadrābhavau matauīśānau jagatsthānasamanvitaḥjñānanādī ca tataṣṭaṅko dharāyutaḥbhavennyāsaḥ pāde brahmā ca pakṣiṇīcoruge ca sraṣṭāraṃ haritānanāmhiraṇyagarbhaṃ ca brahmarandhre pravinyasetāryāparāmbādevyai ca namasā vyāpakaṃ caretbhūtapretajanādyaiśca sa japī naiva bādhyateaṃśā na ca tṛpyanti mātaraḥca varṇānāṃ pātralakṣaṇamucyateśaṅkhasaddārukūrmādikapālālābumanmayamnātisūkṣmaṃ chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vivarjayetsuvarṇe syādduḥkhāntastārapātrataḥkūrmaje jñānaṃ śuktirmuktipradāyinīvīrasaṃsiddhiralāvau yogasiddhayaḥjambālasadṛśaṃ pacetpunardinadvayaṃ sthāpya punarevaṃ prakalpayetkuryāttāṇḍulīyā surā smṛtā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: somapānaṃ tu tatsmṛtambhavati vinā kaṣṭena vāmināmśaktisomo nigadyatetaccakrapūjānte vājapeyaphalapradampānādagnidānaphalaṃ labhetpacedanalanāmāsau mahāpātakanāśanaḥjambūtvagghātakīpuṣpaṃ tadardhaṃ nārikelajamtāvadvibhītakaṃ proktaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ kaṭutrayambhrāmayetsamyaganulomavilomataḥpākaḥ syādvāruṇīyantragaṃ pacetpūrvaṃ svayaṃ pītā tu bhairavaiḥpākassyāccheṣamanyatpuroktavatvaśyā mānuṣīṇāntu kā kathākṣaudraṃ ca bhāgaikena vivardhitammadyaṃ yoginīpānamuttamamdadhi saṃgrāhyaṃ catuḥśataguṇo guḍaḥdadhicaturthāṃśastatsammardyaghaṭe kṣipettathā paiṣṭī trividhā tu surā smṛtābrahmānandasurā yaistu vipraiḥ pītā tu kaulikaiḥbrahmaciṃtaivaṃ nityamevaṃ mataṃ satāmcāṇḍālavadbahiṣkāryo nāsau vāmī na kaulikaḥte tu tadgandhaṃ sa tu vandyo bhaveddvijaḥpaiṣṭī gauḍī bhogapradāyinīvidyāpradaikṣavī proktā khārjūrī ripunāśinīśrīdā nimbajā roganāśinī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rucikaraṃ sāmodaṃ ca manoharamdeyāstatorcayetvatsavṛkṣasya ca tu valkalambinduścāṣṭagandhābhidhāno devatāpriyaḥkuryādetatkarma na lopayetdravairvāthābhāve tarpaṇamācaretkaulikavāmānāṃ mantradevāḥ śramāturāḥca bhaktebhyo mantrā yacchanti taṃ vināvāme kṣudrā api vicārataḥmekaikaṃ tarpaṇāya prayojayetgandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ pūjā cānyathā narakaṃ vrajetpaśotvaṃ hi nāśivastvaṃ śivo hyasitadānande tasmātsevyamidaṃ priyevātha vaṭakā masūrāṇāntathaiva cakuryānmāṃsamatsyābhyāṃ vinā dravyeṇa pūjanamdevatābhāvonyathā pretavibhāvanamvaiśyirgolambhane peyaṃ śūdraiḥ strīratikarmaṇismaranpibenmadyaṃ khādenmāsaṃ na doṣa bhākmadhumāṃsāni tṛptaye cetsa pātakīvinānyatra sa mahāpātakī bhavetkaulānāṃ pūjānte na vigarhitamniṣavyante cānyathā patito bhavetpānāddevatāśāpamāpnuyāttatskandhe citāṃ veṣṭuṃ samudyataḥśakreṇa tūrṇa nirvāpito jalaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadbindupātanirdagdhā dharaṇīyaṃ tadābhavatlaghubhirbāṇaistvadaṅgāni samācchinatpīḍitaścāhaṃ yāto dharmokhilastadāpariṣvaktastava śokaśca vismṛtaḥvākyaṃ viṣṇuḥ provāca pārvatiśarīreṇa saha praveṣṭuṃ havyavāhaneśāstramanādṛtya kathaṃ deva vimohitaḥśleṣagiro'ṅgaistu satyāścedaṃ dharātalamsaṃśuddhiṃ viprāṇāṃ vāpi śuddhatāmmayā proktaṃ sammatīkṛtya viṣṇunāviprāḥ śāpanirdagdhāḥ śabdabrahmavivarjitāḥpīṭhasañjātāḥ śāpanirdagdhavipratāḥpūjyatvātkaulīnapatha ucyatetayostatrādhikāraḥ samudāhṛtaḥpāramparyamajñātvā kauladharme viśanti tehyasiddho yaḥ palaṃ vai bhoktumicchatisvairavṛtterdurātmanaḥśāstravidhimutsṛjya vartate kāmacārataḥnindyaśca vede caiva tathaiva saḥtadaṅgaromasaṅkhyātabhūtayoniṣu jāyatetapaścaryā na dharmo na ca satkriyāviṣayāsaktaḥ patatyeva na saṃśayaḥcāgatya mahāyajñavanaṃ śrayetciccandrakuṇḍalīśaktimudrayā syātsukhāśayaḥproktamitare madyapāyinaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cittaṃ palāśī sa nigadyateproktaḥ śeṣā dhīvaravṛttayaḥsevayedyastu sa bhavecchaktisevakaḥgurumukhātsamyak sevate sa ca mucyateātmasthānamanudravyadevaśuddhimprakalpayetsyādātmaśodhanamvitānadhūpadīpādyaiḥ sthānaśuddhiriyaṃ matākramotkramatrirāvṛttirmantraśuddhiriyammatādarśayeddhenumudrāṃ ca dravyaśuddhiriyammatāmūlena dīpadānaṃ pradarśayetphaladā jñeyā tvanyathā niṣphalā bhavetvidhivallikhitvā tatra pūjayetmaṇḍitaṃ yena maṇḍalaṃ tatsadāśivamcārdhacandraṃ pūrṇaṃ pūrṇagirirmataḥśāṃkhamarghyaṃ bhogapūjābalipātrāṇi pañca camantrapūtena kuleśvari vidhānavitparyuṣitocchiṣṭairdurgandhairgandhavarjitaiḥsvādiṣṭhaiśca madotsiktairdravyairamṛtasannibhaiḥsurā pāpā kalahavyādhiduḥkhadāvidhivatkuladravyaṃ tatorcayetāyuḥśrīkīrtisaubhāgyadharmavidyāvivardhinīsaṃśayaḥ || vinā dravyādhivāsena na smarenna japettathāvinā mantro na mantreṇa vināśayaḥtarpaṇayogyaṃ syāddevatāprītikārakampūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ślokānetānpaṭhetpaścāttānbravīmi śṛṇu priyenidhehyamṛtarūpiṇinidhehyasminvastuni klinnarūpiṇibhūtvāmṛtāparākāre mayi visphuraṇaṃ kuruamṛtavarṣiṇītipadaṃ vadetproktaḥ pañcatriṃśadbhirakṣaraiḥsaṃspṛśyārccanapātrantu pūjayeddhenumudrayāmahāmadyapīyūṣarasamāvahanyāsoktasarvamantraiśca svātmānaṃ plāvayettathātarpayedādau ādināthaḥ sadāśivaḥdvādaśa tataḥ siddhaughāstānpratarpayetvyāsaśca vāmadevaḥ śukastathātarpayetṣaṇnṛsiṃhaṃ ca maheśaṃ bhāskaraṃ tathāca siddhaughe mānavaughe sadāśivamāvāhayeddevīṃ mantrābhyāṃ pūjayettathāmātaradyaihi parameśvaripūjayāmīha tāvattvaṃ susthirā bhavacinmayasyāprameyasya nirguṇasyāśarīriṇaḥliṅgasthaṇḍilavahnyapsu phalake mūrdhni maṇḍalerūpiṇaṃ kṛtvā karmakāṇḍe ratā janāḥsarvagato devaḥ pratimādau virājateviśvāsātsānnidhyaṃ devatā labhetcājyaṃ punastadapi poṣayetdevo na dadāti phalaṃ nṛṇāmpratiṣṭhāpyārcayeddevi anyathā niṣphalaṃ matam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sādhayate sarvaṃ hīnamaṃgaṃ yathā tathāsarvaṃ vyarthaṃ bhavati śāmbhavisvayaṃ jātaṃ pūjitaṃ sukhadāyakamgamyatvānnaśvaratvācca tādṛk tāntrikapūjanamyantramityāhuretasmindevastu paripūjitaḥkaulādau guptametatprakāśitamdinānsarvān gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥtarpayeddadhibindubhiḥapātrasyedamaṣṭau ca tarpayeddevatāmukhamantaḥśaktimanusmṛtya tarpayeddehadevatāmtasmāttābhyāṃ tarpaṇīyaṃ yantraṃ tattu tayoḥ priyamtarjanyaṃguṣṭhayogena tarpayedābhicārikesantarpya devādīngurupaṅktiṃ prapūjayetsiddhaughairyajati gurupaṅktiṃ kṛtamatiḥkadalyādiphalānyevaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca samarpayetmukhyaḥ surādyantena nirmitamyastu mahādevaṃ prapūjayetpūjayettasmādgandhapuṣpāsavāmiṣaiḥkṣetrapatye dadyādasya manuṃ śṛṇukapilajaṭābhārabhāsurapiṃgalaphaṭ svāhā ṣaṭ catvāriṃśadarṇakaḥsantuṣṭo baṭukaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥvadetkramātpūjābaliṃ gṛhṇīta ityapicatuścatvāriṃśadarṇo mantroyaṃ parikīrtitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyomacarīprītā sadāstu mesaptadaśākṣaraḥpātālatalasaṃsthāśca śivayogena bhāvitāḥtṛpyantu prītamanaso bhūtā gṛhṇantvimaṃ balimsarvopacārasahitamimaṃ pūjābaliṃ vadetkṣetrapālasya samproktaḥ sarvasiddhividhāyakaḥbalidānena sarvarakṣāṃ karotu mebhairavādhiṣṭhitāyākṣo vadeditimahākṣetrapālāya vauṣaḍ humitikṣetrapālasya mahāprītikaraḥ paraḥimāṃ pūjābalimataḥ paramrājarājeśvarākhyasya daivatasya samarcaneprasīdatu sarvadādadyāt kṣetrapālāya dakṣiṇeaṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāntu baṭukasya bhavedbaliḥaṃgulībhiśca sarvābhirdadyādbhūtabaliṃ dvijaḥaṃguṣṭhamadhyamābhyāṃ tu rājarājeśvarasya casupiṣṭena kuryādvedāṃgulonnatānkarṣājyagrāhiṇaḥ kuryānnava saptātha pañca cakuladīpaṃ nivedayetdevi gṛhāṇa mama siddhayegurupādarajojoṣī śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥpibenmadyaṃ ceti śāstrasya niścayaḥniṣphalaṃ tasya devatā na prasīdatikhaṭakī caiva kaivartī viśvayonikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cāpi śastrījīvā tu rañjakīmantrasamāyuktāḥ samayācārapālikāḥpūjayetkulamārgasthastatra śaktimanusmaransvataḥ prāptā sā pūjyā sahasā budhaiḥśāntānukūlā muditā śuciḥca smitāsyā priyavādinīviśeṣajñā devatārādhanotsukākutsitā stabdhā nirlajjā kalahapriyāmantrayuktāṃ hi striyaṃ yogī vivarjayetmantrī devyai samarpayetkāmaṃ tato deyaṃ śeṣikāyai sa kathyatevadet || sarvavaśaṅkari svāhā caikaviṃśativarṇakaḥdevīmucchiṣṭamātaṅgī dhyāyellokaikamohinīmpātramuddhṛtya sadvitīyaṃ samarpayetkṛtvā pibettattadanujñayādvitīyena gṛhṇīyānmantramuccaretkāraṇaṃ bhairavoditambhāvānāṃ bhāvāścāntaritā rasedevīṃ pūrṇakāmaḥ pibāmyahamkuryānmadhupānaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥguruṇā śiṣyebhyaḥ śeṣado bhavetstrīgurujyeṣṭhapūjyānāṃ purataścopaviśya capibenmadyaṃ sa surāpo nigadyatekuṇḍalyākṛticidrūpe huneddravyaṃ samantrakamhomasvīkāralakṣaṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāṇānvāyuṃ samyaṅnirodhayancitsvarūpe kuṇḍalyāṃ paramātmanimantrasyākṣarāṇi kramādekaikaśastataḥtataścakre maṇipūre tvanāhatebrahmarandhraṃ somasya maṇḍalāmṛtāttatastanmantramṛṣyādinyāsapūrvaṃ japettataḥuktaśāpādvinirmuktaṃ paścādupadiśecca tamtu śāpānāṃ nāśādyarthamathocyatekastūrīkuṃkumādyaiśca vilikhetpāñcabhautikamyathoktavidhinā pūjāṃ kṛtvā cāṣṭottaraṃ śataṃsvaravyañjanabindūṃśca sargayogyākṣarāṇi cajanayenmantraṃ proktaṃ sañjananaṃ tvidamaṣṭottaraśataṃ mantravarṇānetattu jīvanamśatāvṛtyā tāḍayeccandanāmbhasāmantrāstāḍitāḥ siddhikārakāḥkaravīrasya puṣpāṇyatha samuccaretuccaranvahnibījaṃ ca bodhanaṃ tvetaducyatetatkarṇikāyāṃ mālatyā likhetkalikayaikayābodhidrupallavāṃścaiva gṛhītvā mantramuccaretnānāsugandhinopetapallavairyāvadakṣarammantraśuddhiṃ kuryānnṝṇāṃ yathā jalammanostasya dāgdhyamevaṃ vibhāvayetmāyikaḥ proktastanmantre tu malatrayamjātaḥ svamantra iti cintayetmataḥ || vimalīkaraṇaṃ tvetatprayogaṃ cāpi kārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yāvadullāsaparyaṃtamupadeśaiḥ pibenmadhutadvijānīyādyadanena samaṃ pibetpānaṃ kevalaṃ viṣabhakṣaṇamdevyagrataḥ pānaṃ vīraṃ mṛdvāsane kṛtamkaulikācāraṃ lokadvayaphalapradammitraṃ pātramelāpakāvṛtamśāntaiḥ paradravyaparāṅmukhaiḥstrīstutairdhanyaiḥ sundarairmṛduvādibhiḥprayogasiddhairdravyāḍhyairbhāgyavadbhiśca kāmukaiḥmelaṃ ca saukhyavṛddhirdvayorbhavetparāṅmukhā yānti vighnāścaiva pade pademohena devatāśāpamāpnuyātanabhijñairanarhaiśca saṃkaraṃ naiva kārayetpūrvadakṣiṇayoraikyamudakpaścimayostathāsamantrapādukāmūlamantrajaptaṃ pibettataḥpūrvavajjaptvā pibettacca guruṃ smaretsvajyeṣṭhasyāpi cocchiṣṭaṃ khādennānyasya karhicitśaktyucchiṣṭaṃ pibenmadyaṃ vīrocchiṣṭaṃ tu carvaṇambhakṣayetstrīṇāṃ nābhyaḥ svocchiṣṭamarpayettatorcayeddevīṃ tarpaṇādi samācaretsmareddhyanyonyamiti pātramelanamabhīṣṭasiddhidāṃ nātaḥ paraṃ kiñcicca vidyatelakṣmīḥ kolāsuraṃ hatvāśeṣāttadrudhiraṃ papauviṣṇunā vāpi mayāpi praṣṭumicchatāsakalaṃ jātaṃ mumūrṣuriva dṛśyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jāte brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥmunayo vidhe viśrīkatā kutaḥmahadidaṃ viṣṇustūṣṇīmupasthitaḥjātā gatā tasmādrasātalamtasmādviṣṇuḥ śivohaṃ ca yūyaṃ śakrapurogamāḥārādhayantu tāṃ devīṃ stuvantu ca mahāstavaiḥkiñcicchobhāṃ śriyo dṛṣṭvā cakrurārādhanaṃ tataḥvarṣatrayādūrdhvaṃ pratyakṣā śrīrvyajāyatahāsitaṃ viprairdevaiścākulitaṃ kutaḥmayā proktā sarvaṃ viśvaṃ tvayā tatammayā hāsyaṃ kṛtaṃ hṛdayasākṣiṇīprasīdeśe lokayātrāṃ ca nirvahabhaginī tatpradhānantu pūjanammāyāprapañcoyaṃ vṛthā bhavati māṃ vinābhogavāñchā devatātvaṃ paratra cetgopyaṃ tadvidhiṃ kathayāmyathakārye kārye vā pūrṇatāṅgateyoge vā śaktisaṅgameniśīthe vāṣṭamīyutecaturdaśyāṃ yogoyaṃ śaktisaṅgamaḥproktaṃ yathecchākrāḍanāya tudevīmabhyarcya kāmanāmsampravakṣyāmi cānukalpaṃ prakalpayettatrādau tāntrikoṣṭavidhaḥ smṛtaḥkukkuṭaśceti sāmānyaṃ pūrvapūrvataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sādhakendreṇa sadyo yoti ca sundaraḥmūlyādgṛhīto vāpīṣṭo daivataḥ svayamāgataḥbhavedbaliyogyaśca nānyaścaurādikāhṛtaḥmahākrūro nirukkṛṣṇaikavarṇakaḥdevatāyā varṇarūpo gadoñjhitaḥvigandhīkṛtya balaye yogyaḥ sarvottamastvayamprītidaśca yajñeṣyeṣa viśiṣyatevihīnāṇḍo bālo vṛddho na śasyatemāṃsabhārāttathānena samo vai sāraso varaḥvarṣādūrdhvaṃ gṛhe puṣṭo balyarthaṃ yogya ucyatemāṃsalastvekavarṇo vā tāmracūḍo viśiṣyatenītāḥ kukkuṭā balayokhilaiḥvastrasaṃveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā chedayecchurikādibhiḥpūrvapūrvatrāpi cokto viśiṣṭo devatoṣakaḥyamairyuktaḥ sakalairmūrtirātmanasarocanamatikrūradaivate vaṭakānvitamkāliyugaṃ yajñeśvari lohapadam vadetaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā tata utthāya sādhakaḥmūlamantreṇa sapuṣpākṣatacandanamcālayedgātraṃ paśustāvanna hanyatesādhakaḥ paścādimaṃ mantramudīrayetsarvarūpiṇaṃ balirūpiṇamcāmuṇḍābalirūpārthaṃ bale tubhyaṃ namostu teghātayāmyadya tasmādyajñe baṃdhovadhaḥcintayitvā nyasetpuṣpaṃ mbhakenāsya mastake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: khaḍgeti mantreṇa taṃ khaḍgaṃ paripūjayetprahāreṇa cchinno daivatatuṣṭayevarṣasyābhyantarevaśyaṃ rājyanāśaḥ prajāyaterāmā narāścordhvaṃ nimantrayetcakrapūjotsavārthaṃ tvaṃ śvo mayāmantrito hyasistrībhyaśca puruṣā nyūnā adhikāste tu hānidāḥdīkṣāniratā nimaṃtryāścakrapūjanepaśyeccakravighnaṃ tathā śubhamśāntirgāṇeśvaro homo grahāṇāṃ bhairavasya ca||] namaśca triruccārya amukakṣetrapālakacakravighnakarāṃstambhayayugmakamkṛtyaṃ nirvartya sāyaṃ cakraṃ prapūjayettatra devīmāvāhyārcanamācaretbhakṣyāṇi yojayetsopadaṃśakaiḥśaktayaśca tathā vīrāḥ pūjyāḥ puṣpākṣatādibhiḥcogragandhapuṣpādibhiryajettaddoṣaparihārārthaṃ bhairavaṃ pūjayāmyahamgṛhṇayugaṃ huṃ phaṭ svāhā dvāviṃśadakṣaraḥsamāgatya praṇameccakrasaṃsthitānpariṣiñcetsāmayikānarthaśāntistavaṃ paṭhetśirasā nāthaṃ bhairavaṃ bhairavīpriyamśrīnāthavaidyāya kulauṣadhividhāyinevinaśyantu divyacakrasya melanātkāntirmanorathaścāstu pāntu sarvāśca devatāḥśāntimbhagavānkuleśaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viśeṣapadabhedakaśāmbhavā yebhūmipatigodvijasādhulokāḥguṇāntamanaso hṛtaśokaśaṅkāḥkumāryo nandantu bhāvaniratā gurubhaktiyuktāḥyasyāṃ guroścaraṇapaṅkajameva labhyamripupakṣabhakṣaṇaparāstṛpyantu kaulārcitāḥkulamārgapālanaparāḥ śāṃtiṃ prayacchantu mepāntu vīrendravandyākulaputrakasya pibataḥ pānammadīyaṃ varamvāpi ca kauliko yadi tadā syānme jayaḥ sarvadākṣetrapālāśca mama dehe vyavasthitāḥkālājñādiśivāntañca pānayajñena tṛpyatāmkumbhasthaṃ yoginībhyaḥ pṛthak pṛthakstrīṇāmanyatamaṃ sthānaṃ puṃsāmanyatamaṃ pṛthakvā samyakcakrākāreṇa vāpunaḥvīreṣu kāryākāryaṃ na vidyatedevatāprītyai jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥproktaṃ charditaṃ bhairavo baliḥnyāso'vayavasaṃsparśo bhojanaṃ havanakriyātadullāsakṛtānāṃ ca yā ceṣṭā sā ca satkriyāvijñeyāḥ parayoginaḥkopaśamanaṃ patanaṃ gāyanaṃ tathābhāṣaṇaṃ caiva samutthānaṃ vijṛmbhaṇamyadollāsaḥ pravartatekaulikānbhairavāveśānyo vinindati mūḍhadhīḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yadyadbhaktisamāveśādadbhataṃ kaulike janedevatāsaktamanasaḥ śuddhā devi sadā hi tekaulikebhyastanmantrānprabruvanti tehasetkupyeccakre madhumadākulānkurvītanāhitaṃ ca samācaretmadākulāndṛṣṭvā cintayeddevatādhiyābhairavīcakre sarve varṇā dvijātayaḥmāhātmyaṃ devīpūjopayogataḥcakramadhye na bhedosti sarve devasamāḥ smṛtāḥsarvāśca pārvatyastasmādbhedaṃ na kārayetmahāmāyā bhagaliṅgāmṛtaṃ vināsaṃskārasaṃśuddhāṃ vihitatvādbrajetstriyamputrāptirnīrogo daśabhirbhavetsārvabhaumosau varṣamadhye bhaviṣyatisyāddhanaprāptiścakrapūjā vidhistvayammadhumattāya cakre vācakre vā puṇyabhāksa tuproktā māsādūrdhvantu niṣphalāsantoṣayektuladravyaiścakrapūjāpuraḥsarampūjayedyoginīvṛndaṃ devi taddoṣaśāntayepakṣe pratipadyekavārṣikīmnavavarṣā ca surūpā vyaṅgavarjitāgaurī durgā ca nava kīrtitāḥabhyaṅgasnānaśuddhaṃ tāṃ pūjāyatanamānayetgandhapuṣpākṣatairdhūpadīpaiśca kuladīpakaiḥkadalīnārikerādiphalaistāṃ paritoṣayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japedekottaravṛddhyā svakaṃ manumdevatābuddhyā namaskṛtya visarjayetsacaturthyantaiḥ pūjayettāḥ pṛthakpṛthaktathādau ca gandhādyaiḥ paripūjayetdakṣiṇāṃ dattvā kumārīṃ tāṃ visarjayetcātra mṛto devo bhavetsa tupūjayedbhaktyā navamātṛṣu mantraviticchājñānāṃ kriyāṃ durgāṃ baṭukaṃ ca gaṇeśvaramsarvaiśvaryasamṛddhātmā sa bhavedāvayoḥ priyaḥsarvalakṣaṇasampannāmanukūlāṃ manoharāmabhyaṅgasnānaśuddhāṅgīmāsane copaveśayetgandhapuṣpādyairalaṃkuryācca sādhakaḥkarmārcanaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpāṃśca kuladīpakānmāṃsādibhakṣyabhojyādyaistoṣayedatibhaktitaḥyauvanollāsasahitaḥ svayaṃ taddhyānatatparaḥtayā saha niśāṃ nayetnāśaḥ syātpañcabhirbhṛguvāsaraiḥnavabhirbhṛguvāraistu devasāyujyamāpnuyātviṣuvatyāṃ vāyane vā tatsamācaretrohiṇīcandrau svāhāgnī ca tathaiva canavābhyarcya pūrvoktenaiva vartmanāsaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyairmadyādyaiḥ paritoṣayetsandehastuṣṭāḥ syurnava devatāḥnavavārantu dhanārthaṃ pratimāsakampuṃstvārthamaṣṭavārānsamācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sukhotpattistadvarṣepakṣapūjanamśuklāmbaradharaḥ sāyaṃ sandhyāmupāsya cacandrāstamānaparyantaṃ japenmantramananyadhīḥyathāśakti pūjayecchaktikaulikānśuklārcanaṃ kṛtvā rātripāpaiḥ pramucyatevidhānena sarvānkāmānsamaśnutecotthāya snānaṃ sandhyāmupāsya cagandhapuṣpādyairalaṃkṛtya ca vartayetsāvaraṇāṃ sarvairupacāraiḥ prapūjayetgururūpāya matsyamāṃsādibhakṣyakamsahito nirvikalpena cetasātāṃ pūjāṃ devatāśca samudvasetkṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ ca susthiraḥyugmībhūtāstadāghasrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vyapohatisambhyarcya kīrtiryāti [tasyeti śeṣaḥ |] digantarampūjayedyastrisandhyāsu yoginyastasya vaśyagāḥvidhānena dhanalobhavivarjitaḥprayacchanti sādhakāyepsitaṃ phalamśrīkaṇṭhādivadabhyarcya tattalloke mahīyatesahasrakoṭiyoginyastāvanto bhairavā apiviśeṣeṣu sarve muditamānasāḥpūjitāḥbhaktihīnāndurācārānnāśayanti prakāśakānkule jāto jyeṣṭho yadi na dīkṣitaḥśeṣamādāya jyeṣṭhe tattu nivedayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gurau jyeṣṭhe pūjye vāpi samāgatedivā kuryādrātrau naimittikārcanamsvasvagurūnmantraṃ svasvamārgeṇa tarpayetvinā māṃsaṃ kulapūjāṃ na kārayettathā pānamekahastena nārcayetpraviśeccakraṃ vinirgacchetpraṇamya caśrīcakramekataḥ kuryādekapātre ca nārcayetcedvraṇadvandvaṃ kaulikasyākṣiyugmakamśivagaurīdhiyā sarvānbhāvayennāvamānayetcānnaṃ tadabhāve jalaṃ pibetpragṛhṇīyādanyathā narakaṃ vrajetnātibhaktaśca vivāde ca parāṅmukhaḥkuladravyasevanānnirdhano bhavetūrdhvaṃ galena pānācca devatāśāpamāpnuyātye te yānti nirayaṃ dhruvamsvajyeṣṭhe kuladeśikespaśeccakraṃ kuladravyaṃ tathā gurumsamuddhṛtya na pātraṃ paripūjayetśucidhiyā karāsyakṣālanādikammalaṃ mūtramadhovāyuvisarjanamghaṭe bhinne pātre vā skhalite tathāpralāpaṃ ca viḍambambahubhāṣaṇampātrahastaścakramadhye na nametpūrṇapātrakamspṛśetpātraṃ na ca bhindyātkadācanacālayetsthānna mudrāvarjitaṃ pibet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pātrasyāṃśadvayaṃ madyapūrṇaṃ tryaṃśantu riktakamnoddharetpātramanādhāre na nikṣipetgomaye pātraṃ namonte vipramīkṣayetca saṃgastu karaṇaṃ śrautakarmaṇāmgacchanna kurvīta kadācanajñeyo rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajetpaśyettenoktaṃ paruṣaṃ sahetbhaktyā śrīpūrvakaṃ vidvānpraṇamya parikīrtayetgurumukhāllabdhaṃ saphalaṃ syānna cānyathāsvadāravanniṣeveta kalaśāstrāṇi tāntrikaḥchinnabhinnānvyastavarṇāṃśca vaidikāndharmaśāstraviruddho ya ācāraḥ sa tu kaulikaḥkurvīta kṛtvā nirayamāpnuyātvīrabhāryāṃ kumārīṃ vratadhāriṇīmsnuṣāṃ sakṛtkāmagatā vṛddhāṃ naivāmanoharāmśyāmāṃ pūjayetkaulikāṅganāmkṣubdhāṃ vā svataḥ prārthinīṃ yabhetsahakāramaśokaṃ ca krīḍālubdhāḥ kumārikāḥraktavasanāṃ dṛṣṭvā vandeta bhaktitaḥkuladarśanaśāstrāṇi kuladravyāṇi kaulikānśikṣakānbodhakānyogiyoginīsiddhapūruṣānjugupseta na hasennāpamānayetkurūpetyatikṛṣṇeti na vadetkulayoṣitampaśyetpatitāṃ nagnāmunmattāṃ prakaṭastanīmśatāparādhāṃ vā puṣpeṇāpi na tāḍayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāmrādipātre karpūravāsitena jalena cajalaṃ tena mantreṇa kuśabindubhiḥpuraścaryākleśitānāṃ samāvartanavattvidampātrāntare ca karpūraguṭikāvāsitaṃ jalamjapedetaddīpanaṃ syātsarvamantreṣvapīṣyatesamproktāḥ sarvatantreṣu gopitāḥvakṣyamāṇā japo homaśca tarpaṇamsaṃskārāḥ kimanyacchrotumicchasisaṃskāraprakāśo dvitīyaḥtatrāvaśyakaṃ karma ceti me nirṇayaṃ vadapañcavidhaṃ tadrājñāmuttamottamambrāhmaṇānāmalpamuktaṃ yatīnāmapi cālpakamcottamādibhedānāṃ viṣayo bhavetsthalādarkāṅgulocchrāyaṃ maṇḍapasthalamīritamasthikīṭatuṣāṅgāramalahīnaṃ śubhāvahamgrāmādbahiḥsthayā tatra viprādyaiśca svavarṇayāsurekhyā tatpūrayitvā pracālayetyatronaṃ nimnayettatsthalaṃ budhaḥsūtrakarkaṭakīlāni gṛhītvā vai niśāntaretanmadhye kendrādvattaṃ samālikhetdhanuṣkuryāttataścāpaṃ dhanuṣkuryāttataḥ punaḥtrayaṃ kṛtvā dalānāṃ madhyadeśataḥyāmyapaścimayossaumyapūrvayoruparisthayoḥanyayoścāpayorevamāgneyī vāyavī bhavetbahirānīya nikhanettatra kīlakān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kulayoginyaḥ kulavṛkṣeṣu sarvadāsvapyātkulavṛkṣādho na copadravamācaretśleṣmāntakakarañjākṣanimbāśvatthakadambakāḥbhṛgoḥ proktaṃ sannyāsaṃ vratadhāraṇamekākṣarapradātāraṃ yo guruṃ cāvamanyatehananātkṣemaṃ bahūnāṃ cecchubhā gatiḥgopayeddevi nārikelaphalāmbuvataprakāśaprakāśābhyāṃ kṣīyante sampadāyuṣaḥkulācāraparibhraṣṭo rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajetśiṣye pātakī sa gururbhavetduḥkhāpahārāya kuryādaṣṭāṣṭapūjanamviśuddhātmā kṛtvā nyāsānpuroditāncaiva kaumāri vaiṣṇavī tathāsamākhyātā mayā te cāṣṭamātaraḥsaṃhāra eteṣṭau bhairavā matāḥprauḍhāntollāsaparyantaṃ kāryaṃ siddhyatyasaṃśayamtapovidyāvrataṃ kulamsadā sevyo manovākkāyakarmabhiḥkulāgamatvamārgoyaṃ guruṇā sampradarśitaḥsamyagācaritaścetsyādbhuktimuktyostu sādhanambhaktimāñchiṣya ucyateahitācaraṇācchiṣyo viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥgurumantraparityāgādrauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajetnametsantāḍito vāpi prasādamiti saṃsmaretgrāhyaṃ tasyājñayā mudā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuryādagurubhiḥ sārddhaṃ nodvahettatkulodbhavāmubhayacyuta eva na saṃśayaḥphalamāpnoti bhaktireva hi kāraṇamsyādanubhūyāttadājñayāyonimāpannaḥ kravyādaiḥ sa bhakṣyategurumitrasuhṛddāsadāsyādīnnāvamānayetnamaskuryānnānābhogāya kāmayetguruḥ sarvasya kāraṇamsvayaṃ śakto nāparaṃ preṣayetkvacittiṣṭhañjāgratsvapankhādanprapibaṃścintayedgurumjātividyādhanādibhiḥgobrāhmaṇavadhaṃ kṛtvā na yatpāpamavāpnuyātvidhyāsanaṃ kaniṣṭhānāmitareṣāṃ samāsanamdaṇḍapraṇāmaṃ kṛtvaikaṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇamācarettataḥ śiṣyaḥ pravādayetpūjyānāmañjalistadvadanyeṣāṃ bāhyavandanamvidyādhikānsvakarmasthāñchrotriyānpraṇametsadāvikarmiṇaṃ kṛtaghnaṃ cānāśramasthaṃ namenna cabhuktamamedhyaṃ syānmṛto jāyeta sūkaraḥkrośamātrasthito bhaktyā guruṃ pratidinaṃ nametyojanadvādaśāvadhitattadyojanasaṃkhyākamāseṣu praṇamedgurumpaśyecca rājānandevatāṃ gurumnārcayedvipro brahmarākṣasatāṃ vrajetkaniṣṭhānāṃ putravatparipālakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: varṇāśramajñānatapodharmāṇāṃ ca prakāśakaḥkaulikācāryastvanyaḥ kulaviḍambakaḥsamyagvijānāti sa guruścoddharetparamyovijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priyevarārohe sa guruḥ parikīrtitaḥśīlaṃ tathā śaktiraṣṭau pāśāḥ prakīrtitāḥtasmātpāśaharo yotra sa gururnānya ucyatejīvacālaphalaṃ vetti sa gururnāparaḥ priyevratopavāsaniyamairbhiyo hantā gururmataḥādirahitaṃ sa gururdurlabhaḥ kalauvṛṇuyānnāparaṃ matimānnaraḥbhakṣitā yena sa gururdurlabhaḥ kṣitaujñānalubdhastathā śiṣyo gurorgurvantaraṃ vrajetpratīkṣyaiva paścācchiṣye samarpayetsampradāyosti tāvatsyādyoginīpadamdadadgṛhṇanprāpnuyātāṃ piśācatāmtanmantraḥ saikate śālibījavatdevatāśāpamāpnoti kṛtaṃ ca viphalaṃ bhavetdarśayetsamyagdīkṣaiṣā kaulikī matāabhiṣiñcetpriyaṃ śiṣyaṃ gaṇḍuṣākhyeyamīritāsusampūrṇaśaṅkhena kalaśena vāpūrṇābhiṣekotra kulamārge prakīrtitaḥpiśācatvaṃ yāvadābhūtasamplavamdīkṣeyaṃ vidhinā guruṇā kṛtādīkṣāviddhastathā hyātmā śivatvaṃ labhate drutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: parāṃ jñānakāṣṭhāṃ nirviṇṇaḥ sa śivo bhavetdīkṣāsaṃskārasampanne jātibhedo na vidyateyathocyate mahādevastathā varṇāstu dīkṣitāḥjyeṣṭho'ntyajaḥ proktaḥ kulaśāstraviniścayepūjyā nāvamānyāḥ kadācanamārgenyathā tu patito bhavetyogyena yallabdhaṃ tacca siddhyatyasaṃśayamanulomavilomābhyāṃ ṣaṇmāsātsiddhyate manuḥkramotkramācchataṃ japtvā māsātsiddho bhavenmanuḥsandehastattvaṃ sarvaṃ tadudbhavamphalaṃ cārdhaṃ kartuścārdhaṃ na saṃśayaḥsiddhirnānyathā janmakoṭibhiḥtatparārthānusandhānaṃ kurvanmantraṃ śanairjapetjapadhyānādiyuktasya kṣipraṃ mantraḥ prasiddhyatiśāpaprasādadaṃ mantraṃ tattvalakṣamitaṃ japetjuhuyātpaścātsaṃskṛte havyavāhanetoṣayedyoginīcakraṃ yathāvidhi savistaramprayogānkurvīta tasya siddhirna saṃśayaḥjapenmantraṃ dhyānanyāsasamanvitamsvaravarṇapadadvitvabinducaitanyasūcakamprāsādabījaṃ tu taruṇādityasuprabhamparasparakarasparśamilitānandanirbharaiḥbhāvayennityaṃ sa prayogairna bādhyateśāntiryenābhijāyatesampūrṇacandramaṇḍalamadhyakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: muktāsphaṭikakarpūrakundendudhavalaṃ śubhambhāvayedevaṃ parasyātmānameva vāmaṇḍalaṃ pūjayedyadādevāḥ kadāciditi niścayaḥsāgraṃ pūjitaḥ sarvamānavaiḥgranthau tattatsthāne vicintayettatkṣaṇācchāntimāyānti sarvarogā na saṃśayaḥsañcintayenmūrdhniṃ sa bhavedajarāmaraḥparāprāsādabījaṃ tattaruṇādityasannibhamsparśākṣaraiḥ saṃvītamantrataḥsaṃsmareditthaṃ yauvanollāsasaṃyutaḥdevadānavagandharvasiddhacāraṇaguhyakānvaśīkarotyasandehaḥ kimpunarmānavādikānsmarañjapyātsa vaśyo jāyate'ciramtatkalpāgnisadṛśaṃ smaretkālānalasamaḥ sarvabhūtabhayaṃkaraḥmaṇḍalaṃ japyādaṣṭottarasahasrakambhūtogragrahavetālapiśācānbrahmarākṣasānsa mṛtyumadhigacchatipanasodumbarāśvatthaplakṣāpāmārgajaiśca vāvārdhaślokoktaistilataṇḍulasaṃyutaiḥsahasrādayutāntaṃ ca yathākāryaṃ tathācaretpauṣṭikaṃ sandhirupakāraśca sāttvikecampakadvayapālāśapāṭalaśrīkapitthajaiḥkumāryaruṇamandārajātīkuṃdajapādibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: candanāgurukarpūrarocanākuṃkumādibhiḥpṛthakchlokārdhasamproktaiḥ prāgvaddhomastu rājasemohanaṃ ca kautukaṃ rājasaṃ matamkṛṣṇavarṇaiśca hyagnikundarkṣavṛkṣakaiḥmadhyapādarajobhiśca śatroḥ pratikṛtiṃ caretsamyakpratiṣṭhitaprāṇāṃ kuṇḍasyopari lambayetmanasātyugradṛṣṭiramarṣaṇaḥsyātpiśācatāpuraskṛtya paścātkarmāṇi sādhayetp. 228) mūlamantraṃ likhenmadhye sādhyanāmasamanvitambhūgehe catuṣkoṇeṣu mantrakamekatriṣaḍvasucatuṣkalaśānsthāpayetkramātvāṣṭādaśa daśa sapta vā caturekakamvastraṃ śikhā kūrcaṃ nārikeraphalaṃ śiraḥtrimūrtiraṃśādimātaro bhairavānvitāḥvidhivanmaṃtravittamaḥāyuḥśrīkāṃtisaubhāgyavidyārogyādikaṃ bhavetakiṃcano'bhiṣiktastu mahadaiśvaryamāpnuyātbhūtāpamṛtyurogādyā vinaśyanti na saṃśayaḥpūjitaṃ devi sarvarakṣākaraṃ bhavetkulākulānusandhānanipuṇāḥ kaulikāḥ priyeyajñādisarvahetutvādāmnāya iti kīrtitaḥye tetra dharmedhikāriṇaḥkaulikoyaṃ panthā narakahetavedambhaḥ pāpaṃ gṛhe gṛhe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na hi || tathā śaktiṃ vinā devo na kiñcitkartumahatitasmātpuṃśatkisaṃyogaṃ kṛtvā mantraṃ prasādhayetśivaṃ dhyāyeddevatā śaktirūpiṇīmmātṛbuddhiḥ strībuddhiḥ kaulike pathietadrahasyamākhyātaṃ gopyaṃ mātari jāravatdadyāddevataiva mantraṃ tatprabravīmyahamyuktānsvaracatuṣkeṇāthottarottarasaṅkhyakānpunardvau ca vargau saṅketavācakausvarāstatkrameṇa paścimottaradevayoḥprakartavyaṃ vaidikena tu kiñcanagrāhyā varṇā ekādisaṅkhyakāḥyadāyāti tadā svapnaḥ prajāyatenaiva yadā pīṭhenāmāṅkayojanamgṛhītaścetsa mantro nāśako bhavet|] yathālekhya udaṅmadhye tathāntikamlikhetpaścādaśvagatyeva pūrvavatkuryātprāgvadaśvagatiṃ punaḥjāyate pūrtiḥ sarvataḥ saṃmatā kramātprakalpyātha māheśyāmantimaṃ nyasetvāyavyāṃ tu dvitīyaṃ syāttataḥ saṅkhyā yathā bhavettatpratisparddhinaḥ sthāpyāstatspardhinyāṃ tathā diśibhājyabhājakapatrāṇāmatha vā lekhayetkramamsnātvā prāksūryodayatastataḥtu nekṣeta śabdaṃ naiva prayojayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tattaddevāṣṭagandhena dale vā maṇḍale likhetlikhedyantraṃ taddine maunamācaretvilikhenmantraṃ tadudagvātha ṭhadvayampītavasane cakraṃ kṛṣṇe site tathāsaṃveṣṭayettatra snehaḥ kuḍavasambhavaḥvasā ceti pūrvādiṣveva kalpayetkarṇikāyāmuttaratotha vighnagaṇapaṃ yajetdigīśānpattreṣu pūjayitvā visarjayetdīpaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya jvālayetpūjayettataḥprāpnuyāddevatāgaṇamgurordhyāyettajjātīyāṃśca mānayetniṣpāpaḥ prāpnuyānmanummadhyaḥ ṣaṣṭhe sa pāpakaḥproktaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitamlobhātkāmātpradadyādyassa lokadvayataścyutaḥsādhakāḥ sarve siddhiṃ yānti na cānyathātiṣṭhanti bho devāstrayastriṃśanmitāni catu samuddiṣṭaṃ tatrātha hṛdayordhvataḥdakṣiṇamārgaśca siddhayenyatra vāmakaḥdevi kulamārgaḥ pravartitaḥkulaśāstraṃ tu kaulānāṃ jñānināṃ muktidāyakamhyaṇimā dīnāṃ siddhikāmaiśca gamyatāmlope tu rajastambhaḥ prajāyatejātaṃ siddhiḥ śābaracerakīnāśosya yatproktassa maheśvaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: phalaṃ tatra muktistasyopapīṭhakesāsiśca varuṇābhavatmantrāstatkālaṃ phaladāyakāḥdevāstatsiddhiḥ puraścaraṇamātrataḥtajjātaṃ gardabhakṣetramadbhutamdakṣiṇamārgasya mantrāḥ siddhipradāyakāḥvāmasya mārgasyātīva siddhikṛttasmādvāmasya mārgasya mūlasthānaṃ taducyateca sahasre dve pīṭhānāṃ ca śatatrayamsiddhidāni pīṭhānyaṣṭau ca tatra tupatitaṃ jātaṃ tadupapīṭhakamsahasrāṇi devayonīni santi hivāmanetraṃ te mahatpīṭhaṃ taducyatedevā devatādar"anaṃ bhavetvāmastasmātpīṭhottamaṃ tu tatpāradarśī syāttattvajñānī bhavettathātatra deveśi prāyaścittakarāṇi cakariṣyāmyatiguptāni kalau mlecchāvṛtāni cadakṣakarṇastu patitotīvaśobhanaḥpānāṃ hi nivāsāyopakalpitamvaidikamantrāṇāṃ siddhirdevāḥ pade padeloke prasiddhamupapīṭhakampunarlabdhāstato jātaṃ tīrthaṃ nigamabodhakamvā tadbhavedyadvarecchayāprerayāmāsa siddhiṃ ca prakaṭā dadau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantrādhiṣṭhānadevatāḥnipatitastvata eva ca vallabhaḥbhavenmuktissahasrabhagasaṅgamātmahatī jātā tayā devyā mayā sahamadbhartā sa evaiko bhaviṣyatidakṣe vighnā bhavanti hinipatitastatpīṭhe mahadadbhutamjapatasteṣāṃ siddhiḥ prajāyatetaptaṃ vidyādharairbahugranthastatra sārasvatājjapāttrivāte vasanaṃ jātaṃ prākpaścāddakṣiṇepatatvarṇo manavaḥ pauṣṭike sthitāḥsiddhyanti kāmamantrā na saṃśayaḥṣoḍaśastrīsahasrāṇāṃ bhoge sāmarthyavānbhavettatra ye mantrāḥ strīprasaṅgikāḥlabhate siddhimiṣṭāṃ manoramāmparvabhirliṅgatāṅgatāḥpuraścaraṇamātreṇa tuṣṭā bhavati devatādantāstatpīṭhaṃ mahadadbhutamtiṣṭhanti sevātassadyaḥ siddhā bhavanti hipīṭhe tu siddhayaḥ karasaṃsthitāḥpatitaṃ tatra sarvasiddhividhāyakamnāma yattatra sendreṇopāsitā purārājarājeśvarīti cayakṣiṇyāstatra syurdṛṣṭigocarāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samakarṇaṃ digantaṃ tacchuddhaṃ syāccaturasrakampañcaninādaiśca maṇḍapaṃ racayecchubhammadyamāṃsapurandhrīṇāṃ samāveśo yathā bhavetkuṇḍānāmadhikepi sapañcakesāmagryāmalpāyāṃ vedahastakaḥdaśahastaḥ syānnavahastaḥ sadā viśānmānaṃ maṇḍapānāṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitamkāle ca samutpannā yathā yavāḥśūdrāṇāṃ saṅkarādau tathā rasaiḥsvayaṃ tatra mānametadatonyathāparvaṇorantarandīrghamātrāṅgulamudāhṛtamvedikāpīṭhaśibikārathādyetatpramāṇataḥvibhajedeko bhāgo muṣṭyaṅgulaṃ tu tatyajñopavītamuñjādi kuryānmuṣṭyaṅgulena tudvādaśabhāgantu kṛtvā teṣvekamaṅgulamebhiścaturviṃśatibhirhastaḥ syādaṅgulaiḥ punaḥnārīṇāṃ kuryādgopyaṃ prakāśitamlakṣahomeṣu dikkaramvedikākoṇe maṇḍapārdhocchitā vahiḥkalaśākāraṃ taddaśāṃśena kārayettṛtīyāṃśadīrghānstambhānsuvinyasetmadhyastambhasthitaṃ kūṭaṃ mṛdaṅgābhaṃ prakalpayetdakṣadīkṣāvidhau padmanibhaṃ kūṭaṃ tu kārayetcatursrā catuṣkoṇā vedī sarvaphalapradāsyātsarvatobhadrā caturbhadrābhiṣecane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: manavassiddhyantyatra na saṃśayaḥsapāpānāṃ gamanaṃ durlabhaṃ kalaubādhante vidharmaṃ bhakṣayanti casthitā śaktirbrahmavidyāprakāśikāśaktirmukhaśuddhakarā matāśaktiḥ kaumārī jayakāriṇīvaiṣṇavyāvasthitaṃ jātamindrajāle susiddhidamvārāhyadhiṣṭhitaṃ jātaṃ śatrumardanakārakamcāmuṇḍādhiṣṭhitaṃ jātaṃ kṣudradaivatasiddhidammahālakṣmyā sūktānāṃ tatra siddhayetvadbāhupatanātpīṭho narmadādhiṣṭhito'bhavatjātā jīvanmuktā maharṣayaḥnivāsosau jyotirmantraprakāśataḥjvālayā tatra vahninā ca tapaḥ kṛtamjvālāmukhīti vikhyātaṃ sa vahnirdevatāmukhamprakartavyo mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyatedarśanādeva tannṝṇāṃ sarvasiddhividhāyakamgandharvairāgajñānakasañjñitamdveṣoccāṭanamṛtyūnāṃ prayogāstatra siddhidāḥrākṣasaistatra siddhirdevajayābhidhāyatra tacca pīṭhaṃ mahādbhutampīṭhaṃ śivamantraprakāśakamtadgaṇeśasya mantrasiddhikaraṃ matamsamastaviṣṇumantrāṇāṃ tatra siddhiradūrataḥtadadhastātkṣudraghaṇṭā patitā copapīṭhakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: upavedārthaniṣpatirbhavedrājagṛhe tathājātiduṣṭairdvijaistatra svaśarīraṃ samarpitamkalau mārgāścālitā dehasaukhyadāḥsamastavanadevānāṃ tatra siddhiradūrataḥelāpure ḍhakārobhūddakṣoruḥ patitastavamṛtyuñjayāyuṣkaraṇamantrāḥ siddhyanti tatra tujapātsiddhyerddhanurvedo na saṃśayaḥte || siddhyai kavacamantrāṇāmavantīti nigadyatevāmakā mantrāstatra siddhyanti netarevaitālikā mantrāḥ siddhiṃ yānti ca śābarāḥnūpuraścaiva tatra hipīṭhopapīṭhayostatra mantrāḥ siddhyanti bhāskarāḥnipatitastatra kṛtasādhakasiddhidampatito yatra ḍāmarañcopapīṭhakampatitastatra dṛśyate śvetamṛttikātesthīni patitāni dvijottamaiḥprāk ca bagalādyupapīṭhaṃ mahādbhutamgaṅgāyamunayormadhye rājarājeśvarīśvaramprayāgotastīrtharājaḥ pīṭharājaśca kathyatedakṣiṇaḥ patito devi pādukāsiddhiratra tudevadānavagandharvamāyāḥ siddhyanti tatra turaktāmbarādibaudhānāṃ mantrasiddhisthalantu tatsiddhā vaiṣṇavāstu viśeṣataḥsiddhetsvarṇākarṣaṇabhairavaḥpatitantatra japādvāksiddhyati dhruvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śaktimantrāṇāṃ siddhistatra na saṃśayaḥmukhyatvaṃ mantriṣu prāpnuyādapitatpīṭho vāmamārgedhikobhavatśarīrātpatitā tatra sarvasiddhiḥ prajāyateyāvantyaḥ siddhayastatra saṃsthitāḥtu labdhvābhūcchāyāpīṭhamatastu tatpatito devi tatra siddhiradūrataḥathānyatsampravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutamsiddhiḥ kutrāpi nāśa eva dinedinesuśiṣyāya deyaṃ nānyatra kutracitcaturthyantaṃ namontaṃ prajapeditiuddiṣṭo gopyaṃ mātari jāravatpūrvoktamātṛkāṇāṃ tu nyāsamādau samācaretlaghumātrāṇāṃ śrīkaṇṭhādyāḥ śivādiṣusarvatra kartavyo dehaśuddhayetatstotraṃ bhaktasthāne svayaṃ bhavetprayogāḥ siddhyanti mokṣamante labhetasaḥkurvīta mātarampiraṃ tathāduḥkhī mantragrāhī ca nirdhanaḥśāstraṃ guruṃ kuryāttadā sukhamavāpnuyātdevi kimanyācchrotumicchasitantrāṇāṃ puraścaryādinirṇayaḥpuraścaryākaulikācāraprakāśo daśamaḥkutra kalpāḥ ke ca phalapradāḥsthāsyanti kāścaiva upaśākhāstathā ca kāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vinā sindhupāramicchasti mānavāḥvinaśyanti te tu mānuṣyavarjitāḥtyaktvā jāyante yavanādhipāḥstrīmāṃsamadyanirate loke dharmaparāṅmukhepṛthivīmadhye yāvatpūrṇaḥ kalirbhavetkalkisvarūpasya viṣṇorjanma bhaviṣyatisvādhyāyābhyasanasyādau vratānyeva caturdaśapūrvavidhinā niṣpāpaḥ sansamabhyasettathaikānte namro gurvājñayā paṭhetparaṃ ca nāśnīyātprājāpatyavrataṃ tvidamcopavasedantyamatikṛcchraṃ vrataṃ tvidamupavāsaśca saptāhaṃ śiśusāntapanaṃ vratamsakṛtsnāyī taptakṛcchraṃ vrataṃ tvidamekarātropavāsaśca kṛcchrasāntapataṃ vratamupavāsastadā proktaṃ mahāsāntapanaṃ vratamvardhayeccāpi proktaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ vratamvrataṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ syādeva madhyamamcaturostamite sūrye śiśucāndrāyaṇaṃ vratamhaviṣyasya yaticāndrāyaṇaṃ vratamsthiracittopramattaśca parākākhyamidaṃ vratamsaumyakṛcchranāmakaṃ vratamuttamamtulāpuruṣavattrīṇi stomāyanamidaṃ vratamhaviṣyānnasya vaibhāgamṛṣaṣicandrāyaṇaṃ vratamvāyubhakṣaśca stomāyanamidaṃ vratampratyekaṃ pratyahaṃ pītaiḥ parṇakṛcchravrataṃ tvidam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: haviṣyāśī bhuñjanmaunaṃ samāsthitaḥācārahīnāñcchūdrāṃśca dṛṣṭvā naiva paṭhecchrutimsamāviśya jñātaṃ vedaṃ samuddharetrūpavatīṃ dṛṣṭvā dhyāyedviṣṇuṃ sanātanamnamaskāramādāvante guroścaretrātrau yattasmātpūjanīyo gaṇādhipaḥgaṇeśaṃ punarāgatāmpaṭhedanadhyāyastadā pāṭhaṃ na kārayetkārtikeyasya gātuṃ tasmātprapūjayetrātrau punardhyātvā svāgatāntāṃ punaḥ paṭhetkailāsaṃ yāti nṛtyantī pradoṣavratakāriṇīhaṭhātpaṭhati tadyāvadvṛthātvamupagacchatimaunī tryabdācchāktastu siddhyatisanakṣatrā sasūryā sāyamucyateāsannobhijitaḥ kālaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhastathā tathātvekamarpyamadhike sampradīyatetatra gāyatryā japa iṣyateprāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā gāyatryaṣṭottaraṃ śatagvakṣyāmi mantrāṇāṃ gāyatrīṃ vedamātaramvinā muktirna kasyāpi prajāyateyatprabhāvādahaṃ tvañca jātaḥ kāla ivāparaḥityuktaṃ devatā savitā smṛtaḥcakramānnyasya nyāsoyaṃ prathamaḥ smṛtaḥgulphajānvostathā sandhau tathā jānūrusandhiṣukarāṃgulīmūlasandhau maṇibandhe ca kūrpare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
