sanskrit: bhruvoḥ śīrṣṇi cūḍādho vāmakarṇakeakṣaranyāso dvitīyaḥ samprakīrtitaḥkaṇṭhahṛnnābhigulpheṣu jānvoraṃghryoratha nyasetbrahmaṇe proktaṃ viṣṇave śira īritamsadāśivāyoktamastraṃ sarvātmane smṛtampajjānukaṭinābhau ca hṛdaye kaṇṭhabhālayoḥpunarvyāhṛtinyāsoyaṃ pañcamaḥ parikīrtitaḥśikhā kavacaṃ dhīmahi smṛtamṣaṭhaḥ syātṣaḍete pāpahārakāḥgāyatryā dhyānaṃ bhaktamanoramamcakramathāraviṃdayugalaṃ hastairvahantīṃ bhajedeveśīṃ koṇāgre pūjayettataḥmāheśvarī caiva vaiṣṇavī prathamāvṛtiḥbhāskaraṃ cāpi saṃdhyāṃ ca dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ tvidamtṛtīyoktaṃ dalamadhye yajedimāḥprabhāvatīṃ jayāṃ śāṃtāṃ caturthāvaraṇaṃ tvidamkramātproktaṃ pañcamāvaraṇaṃ tvidampūjyā viśvayonirjayāvahātvaruṇā proktāprokta māvaraṇaṃ tvidamaṣṭamāvaraṇaṃ caitaccaturasradigaṣṭakesampūjayeddevīṃ tasyā mudrāḥ pradarśayetcaturviṃśatilakṣāṇi puraścaraṇamucyatesahasraṃ tu juhuyānmantrasiddhayeprayogānācaredvidvāṃstadanujñāpurassaramsarvapāpavinirmukto dīrghamāyussa vindati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dūrvānvitaistilairmantrī juhuyāttrisahasrakamśvetārkairayutaṃ niyatendriyaḥjapenmumukṣurgāyatrīṃ turyapādena saṃyutāmityuttaratrānvayosya ||]saptavyāhṛtigāyatrīnyāsādyānpūrvavaccaretbrahmātmane tu hṛdayaṃ śiro viṣṇvātmane tathānetramastraṃ sarvātmane itiyadagrataḥvedamaṃtrāṇāṃ yacca saṃsiddhikārakamgurudveṣṭre procyaśāpamavāpnuyāttānādipādasahināngāyatryāstu sadā japetsaṃyuktānantimena tu nāśakānsaṃkṣepataḥ prokto gāyatryā gopito vidhiḥsvarau digvidiśaṃ pratipatraṃ samālikhettadbahirvṛttayugalāntarāle tu samālikhetbhūrbhuvaḥsvaromiti ca yantraṃ sarvārthasiddhidamdevādīnmokṣāntaṃ sādhayejjanaḥtasya tasmādvaṃśelpāyuśca no bhavetbandhanānmṛtyormukṣīyamāmṛtātkuryānnyāsaṃ tathāṅgeṣu nābhihṛtkaṇṭhakukṣiṣujānuvṛttayugmayoḥ stanayostathāmanuvarṇāṃśca nyāsoyantu dvitīyakaḥpunaḥkuryānmātṛkānyāsapūrvakamsaṃkalya vakṣyamāṇena vartmanā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvādiprādakṣiṇyeneśānāya sūryamūrtayeśarvāya jalamūrtayebhīmāyākāśamūrtaye ṅentaṃ paśupatiṃ tathājyotsnā pūrṇeṣā pūraṇī sudhāsitā yuktā sārā sādhyā śivā niśāpañcamāvaraṇe caitāḥ ṣaṣṭhāvaraṇagā athasaptame lokapālāśca tadastrāṇi tathāṣṭamejuhuyāddaśabhirdravyairayutaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutaiḥdūrvāṃ ca tathaikena sahasrakamprayogārho jāyateyaṃ mahāmanuḥjuhuyādbrahmavṛkṣasya samidbhirbrahmatejasesamidbhirvaṭavṛkṣasya juhuyācca yathāvidhihutvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyatevidhānena na syānmṛtyurakālataḥsiddhānnaṃ hutvā kṛtyāṃ vināśayetsaṃvādaṃ kuryādvidveṣiṇormithaḥāmayānnikhilāñjitvā dīrghamāyuravāpnuyātlakṣmīmārogyaṃ vipulaṃ yaśaḥjīvedvarṣaśataṃ sukhījuhuyādbrāhmaṇānante bhojayenmadhurānvitamdīrghamāyuḥ śriyā sahaṣaṇmāsānnātra saṃśayaḥkṣīradrumasamiddhomādbrāhmaṇādīnvaśaṃ nayetsādhayediṣṭamātmanaḥmedhātithir-ṛṣiḥ prokto gāyatraṃ chanda īritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tu catvāriṃśatsahasrakampuraścaraṇametatsyātsvaśaktyā viprabhojanamsvarṇavarṇaṃ vande gandharvanāyakammahābhāṇḍārikaḥ kuryāttasya dāridryanāśanamjalandharavadhāyāhaṃ yatsmarāmi śṛṇuṣva tatpariṣadati durgāṇi viśvā nāveva sindhuṃ duritātyagniḥjātavedogniḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaretaṃguṣṭhayorgulphayośca jaṅghayorjānunostathāūrvvoḥ kaṭyorliṅganābhyorhṛdaye stanayostathābāhvoścaivopabāhvośca dvayoḥ kūrparayorapinasyakṣṇoścaiva karṇayoḥkarṇayostathāpadanyāsaḥ proktoyaṃ dhyānamucyatetatkarṇikāyāṃ ṣaṭkoṇe maṇḍukādyānsamarcayetvijayāmbhadrāṃ rudrāṃ kālīṃ ca pūrvataḥdurgāṃ yajetpaścādāsanaṃ siṃhamantrataḥṣaḍaṅgāni pūrvatoṣṭadale punaḥvaiśvānarakaumāratejasamjalātmānaṃ vahnyātmānaṃ nirātmakampūṣāvāṇyau tato vīthī śacī toyātmikā tathānāmnā proktā caiva tiraskriyānandinī ca śarīreṣuvimardinīviśālākṣī saumyā sāyaṃ nirūpyatedhūmrā ca durviṣaṃhāriraṃsukālokapālāṃstadastrāṇi pūjāṃ prāgvatsamāpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vedavedābdhisaṅkhyākaṃ tilasiddhārthacitrajaiḥ|| arkaplakṣodbhavaiścāpi ghṛtena haviṣānnakaiḥtatassantarpya satilaiḥ kṛtvā cātmābhiṣecanamsiddhe mantresminsādhakottamaḥproktaṃ vilomaprathito manuḥgnityatāridudhuṃ siṃ proccāryātra hṛdayaṃ matampūrvoktārṇavilomataḥpadanyāso japaḥ pūjā ca pūrvavatcatvāriṃśaccatuṣṭayamkuryādgāyatryā dviguṇaṃ japampauṣṭikaṃ karma kartavyamanulomataḥdvitīyaḥ karmendriyātmakaḥvarṇādi ṣaḍarṇonyaḥ ṣaṭkauśikamayo mataḥvarṇādyoṣṭamo jñeyaḥ pañcāṇā vacanādikaḥprajvalatkeśavasanā bhīmadaṃṣṭrā bhayāvahāḥprakīrtitāḥūrdhvavadanāḥ kośotthāstiryagānanāḥsarvāssmṛtāḥ klībā indriyārthodbhavāstriyaḥmanuṣyanakṣatre prārabheta vicakṣaṇaḥnandāsuriktāsvastraṃ visarjayetbhaumavāre śanivāre visarjayetrāśiṣvārambhaścareṣu syādvisarjanamcaredastraṃ visṛjecchaśinā punaḥmokṣasaṃhārau kuryātpakṣadvaye sudhīḥnakṣatravṛkṣasakalānsādhyākhyānkarmasaṃyutān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dīkṣāyāṃ guptā tryasrā tu vedikāpatrāṇi baddhā stambhagale nyasetjhañjhāmārutavṛṣṭyādibhayaṃ na syādyathā tathākapāṭaśākhekuryāddehalikāṃ ramyāṃ sāṣṭāṅgulakaradvayāmmadhyame maṇḍape kuryātsārddhāṅgulakaradvayampūrvadvārādbahirhastamātraṃ tyaktvā tu veśmataḥphalakaṃ kuryādvistṛtaṃ tadguṇāṅgulamconnataśikhaṃ dvārasyobhayapārśvayoḥmaṇḍape tau dīrghatāyāṃ kramātsārddhakaradvayamnikhanedagnimīḍeti gāyatryā pārśvayordvayoḥviṣamaṃ dvayorupari kīlayetdakṣiṇe dvāre taddvāraṃ plakṣakāṣṭhajamkuryātpaścimadvāratastvidamprakurvīta vaṭavṛkṣamayaṃ tathātiryaksthakāṣṭhānāṃ madhyato bilamśreṣṭhamadhyajaghanyeṣu śaivayāge triśūlakamvaiṣṇave dvādaśāṃśena śaṅkhacakragadāmbujamśṛṅgaṃ kiñcidvakrantu pārśvayoḥmaṇḍapasyāgre bhūmyūrddhadaśahastakaḥvistṛtaścaikahastena dīrghaḥ pañcakarairdhvajaḥghaṇṭācāmarasaṃyuktaṃ devatāvarṇavarṇakampatākāśca dhvajasyārdhapramāṇataḥtrātāramiṃdramiti ca pītavarṇāṃ harerdiśipanthāmanunā kṛṣṇavarṇā yame smṛtā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūtvā ripuryamapuraṃ vrajetvṛṣṭikāle marīcairmanunāmunāsamālikhya śatrunāma yathāvidhihanetkraddho jvarākrāntaḥ sa jāyatehiṃguṃ viṣaṃ jīrakalohitevinikṣipya yaṣṭyā viṣatarūtthayāsaptāhānmaraṇaṃ yāti śatrurjvaravimohitaḥliptāṅgaṃ dagdhaṃ bhānumarīcibhiḥtarpayedbhānumālokya śatrurmṛtyupriyo bhavetvidveṣayechatruṃ nakhenāhṛtya deśikaḥkuryātsenāyānātra saṃśayaḥvimohayecchatruṃ maricairvā sasarṣapaiḥprajuhuyājjayenmāsena vairiṇamśarānkārmukanirmuktānvahnijvālāmukhākalānbhānubimbaṃ samālokya śatroruccāṭanaṃ bhavetsenāyāsstambhanaṃ bhavetsaptāhānmaṃtravidvaśayennṛpānmantrī tasya viśvaṃ vaśaṃ bhavetvetasairmadhurāsiktairjuhuyādbṛttisiddhayemantravinnātra saṃśayaḥtathānyādyā gāni durgā prakīrtitāviśvādyā caiva maṃtresminviśvadurgā samīritātyāṃtāmagnyādikāmevamagnidurgāṃ vidurbudhāḥtatrārcayennityaṃ prāguktenaiva vartmanākṛtyārogabhayadrohabhūtāni nāśayedayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇāmantrārṇasaṃkhyayā maṃtrī ripumātmavaśaṃ nayetnivāsya pañcagavyeṣu saṃskṛte havyavāhaneviśadadhīḥ samiddhegnau yathā purākuryātsādhyaṃ tatprāśayedguruḥkṛtyā punastāneva bhakṣayetjuhuyātsampadāṃ bhūmiḥ sādhakā bhavati dhruvamjapanmantraṃ satataṃ puṣkalāmbhasidarvyā brahmatarūtthayāviśākhākṛttikāmūlahastottaramaghāsvathakurvīta sikatāsthāpanaṃ sudhīḥprasthāḍhakaghaṭonmānā madhyādiṣvavareṣvimāḥmadhyādidevīmastrāṇi kapālāntāni deśikaḥkapālaṃ svasvamantreṇa sampūjyānte baliṃ haretrakṣā yā vardhante tatra sampadaḥvidhinā nātra saṃśayaḥbrahmavṛkṣeṇa nirmitepravardhante'kālavṛṣṭyādibhiḥ sahakuryātsthāpanaṃ vidhināmunāgomūtrāttriguṇaṃ dadhikapilāḥ śvetāḥ sitadhūmrāruṇaprabhāḥekonapañcāśatkoṣṭhe phalake brahmaśākhinaḥtadūrdhvakoṣṭhamārabhya prādakṣiṇyena saṃlikhetpūrvoditaṃ phalamsādhyanāmānvitāṃ māyāṃ madhyakoṣṭhe tu saṃlikhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvoktānaṣṭau pādāṃśca tadbahiḥsarvabhūtabhayaharaṃ śrīkīrtyāyuḥpradaṃ śubhamśreṣṭhastasyādhīnaṃ jagattrayammantraṃ kṛtvāstraṃ paricakṣatesunavāma somamarātīyato nidahāti vedaḥ sa naḥ pariṣatvarṇānāmpadānāṃ nyāsa iṣyatenyāsādikaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ muniśchandaśca pūrvavatśatruṃ madhye vakraṃ viṣāhatamdinadvayājjvarākrānto ripuḥ prāṇānvimuñcatijapetsadyaḥ sa bhavedyamavallabhaḥprajapetsa mṛtyuvaśatāṃ vrajetśīghraṃ sa nīyate yamakiṅkaraiḥsmṛtastūrṇamparāsuḥ syāddinatrayātputramitrakalatrādisahito mṛtyumāpnuyātdinādarvāgyamalokaṃ sa gacchatiyamagrasto bhavedariḥśatrurjvarito maraṇaṃ vrajetmahatāviṣṭo jāyatesau yamātithiḥtarpayeddinabāṇena syādasau yamavallabhaḥjapenmantraṃ sa prayāti yamāntikamśīghraṃ taṃ yamadūto yamālayamghorāṃ siṃhaskandhaṃ niṣeduṣīmvisphuliṅgairnirdahantīṃ ripumākulavigrahamtarjayantīṃ nijaṃ śatruṃ tarjanyā bhīmarūpayāvakṣo dārayantīṃ bhayaṃkarām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: astramantrakṛtanyāsaḥ pralayāgnisamaprabhaḥtacchiraśchittvā kṣaṇādvyomasthalaṃ gatāmtu rātriṣunyasya sajīvaṃ mahiṣaṃ puraḥvahnau yathāvaddeśikottamaḥdevīṃ savitṛmaṇḍaleudyadāyudhasandīptāṃ nṛtyantīṃ siṃhamastakeraktārdramāṃsavasanāṃ ghūrṇitogratrilocanāmputramitrādibhiḥ sahabhānubimbagatāṃ durgāṃ sahasrādityasannibhāmsahasranāgabaddhāṅgīṃ trāsayantīṃ jagattrayamkālapāśena vairī muñcetsvajīvitamghorasiṃhāsanāsīnāṃ mahābhīṣaṇadāriṇīmgacchedarātirnātra saṃśayaḥviniḥkṣipya niṣpīḍya vidhinā tataḥnayanatrayasaṅgacchadvisphuliṅgaśatākulāmśatruryukto bhavati mṛtyunāvahnau mahiṣīśakṛtā kṛtāmchittvā chittvā prajahuyādajaraktānvitāṃ niśimahiṣasyāṅgaṃ bhindaṃtī ghoradarśanāmpradīptānalasaṅkāśāṃ bhramannetratrayānvitāmkhaḍgakheṭakayuktābhiḥ kanyakābhiḥ samāvṛtāmkathitaṃ rātrau kṛtyāstramucyatebrahmarandhramārgeṇa gatāṃ vyomasthalaṃ tataḥśatrurmṛtyumāpnoti mohitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ripuryamapuraṃ vrajetśaturmṛtyumeṣyati kātaraḥchittvāchittvājaraktena saptāhānmriyate ripuḥpītamacirānnihanti sakalāñjanānmāhiṣājyena saṃyuktaistanmantrākṣarasaṃkhyayācaturdaśītrayādarvākchatrurmṛtyuvaśo bhavetsaṃsmareddevīṃ jvālāgnisadṛśaprabhāmprajuhuyādanenāyutamastravitbahudhā bhinnā jvareṇāpi vimohitākṣiptaṃ kuryāduccāṭanaṃ drutamsaptamāhendradigvarjaṃ gṛhītvā prajapenmanummantradavāgninājāyate ripoḥṣaḍbinduṣaṭkaputtalyāṃ nikhanedodanānvitamśīghraṃ sakuṭumbaḥ sabāndhavaḥtāṃ prajapedastraṃ prāṇasthāpanapūrvakamgacchenmahājvaravimohitaḥchādayedraktavāsasābhaumavāre diśo madhye yathāpūrvaṃ samāhitaḥvraṇatailena hutvānte taṃ paṭaṃ punaḥtena tridinairmriyate ripuḥkuśairābaddhasarvāṅgaṃ sthāpitaṃ prāṇatejasādivasenārirgacchedyamapuraṃ pratigandhapuṣpādyairayutaṃ juhuyātsudhīḥgandhapuṣpādyaiḥ spṛśanmantraṃ tu taṃ japet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhakṣayedacirācchatrumīśvareṇābhirakṣitammantrānmṛtyuñjayādikānjuhuyādājyaistarpaṇādi tataścarettriśaktestu mantrasiddhirna jāyatecāntarikṣāya ca mahate casvāhādeśakālānurūpeṇa śreṣṭhā tvayutahomataḥtadvakṣye tejasvī ghṛtahomataḥjuhuyāddugdhaṃ vāpyatha vā dadhihutvā yatheṣṭaṃ kanakaṃ labhetjuhuyādayutasaṅkhyākaṃ sampadaṃ sa sadā labhetsamidho juhuyādrāmakāmukaḥdūrvābhiḥ ṣpaistu dhanakāmukaḥjuhuyānmantrī tvabhicāraḥ prasidhyatitatra hunetsarvavrīhibhirādarātullūkakākapakṣābhyāṃ homo vidveṣakārakaḥcaiva jāyateprajapennityaṃ guṇinaṃ labhate sutamputravatsiddhisādhanambrahmaviṣṇuśivāḥ siddhā yatprasādāddharistathāetattrayaṃ triśaktyākhyo mantraḥ proktaśatākṣaraḥvedagamyaṃ parantejosya devatāṣaḍaṅgāni prāṅnyāsāṃśca samācaretnityānandaguṇālayaṃ parataraṃ vandāmahe tanmahaḥśaktibhiḥ paścātpūjayedāvṛtitrayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: catuścatvariṃśatsaṅkhyā jātavādyāstu śaktayaḥsaṃpūjā mṛtyuñjayoktaśaktibhiḥjapeddhunetkṣīraṃ bhaktādyaistarpayettataḥkhaṇḍairjuhuyātkṣīrasaṃyutaiḥdūrvābhirdhṛtasiktābhistadeva phalamāpnuyātmahālakṣmīmavāpnoti māsaiḥ ṣadbhirvidhānavit[bilvaprasūnaiḥ |] prajuhuyādramāyā vasatirbhavetbhānusaṅkhyāndvijānnityaṃ bhojayenmadhurānvitaiḥkṛtyādrohagrahānsarvāñjitvā dīrghaṃ sa jīvatibhānumālokayetsamyaksa jīveccharadā śatamjapenmantraṃ sarvapāpavimuktayeprajapedāyurārogyavṛddhayecedṛṅmantrastvaritasiddhidaḥtasmai rudrāya namo asturudraḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni nyasetkramātdhyānamācaretsampūrṇau kalaśau hastayordvayoḥsarvakāmaphaleśānaṃ śaṅkaraṃ karuṇānidhimca śūlapāṇiṃ jaṭādharamsatyavāṇīṃ puraścaryāvidhau caretmārjanaṃ viprabhojanaṃ mantrasiddhayesamācaret || evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī prayogānkartumarhatiaudumbarairannakāmastejaskāmastu khādiraiḥgrahabādhāvināśāya japedaśvatthasannidhauhūyante samidhaḥ śuṣkāḥ svāhāntaṃ mantramuccaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa muñcatikanyārthī kanyāṃ prāpnoti rūpiṇīmharite deśe tasya viśvaṃ vaśībhavetarisainyapraśāntyarthaṃ tilānājyena sammitānmantrayitvāṣṭasāhasraṃ śarāvāṃstatra vikṣipetgrahagrāmādiśāntyarthaṃ rājyasyāpyevamācaretvāstupūjā prakartavyā catuṣṣaṣṭipadaiḥ śubhaiḥpaśūnāntu prajānāṃ śāntimāpnuyātjapedrudraṃ tvaritaṃ bahubhiḥ sahabaliṃ kuryādyasyāṃ diśi tadadbhutamjapellakṣaṃ tilahomo ghṛtānvitaḥkāryasya labhyate yogyatā yadisarvānkāmānavāpnoti tvaritasya prasādataḥkāryeṣu homaḥ kāryastathā yavaiḥśrīphalaistadvadāyuṣkāmastu dūrvayāpuṣṭikāmastu tuṣṭikāmastathā hi taiḥmadhvabjājyāmraparṇāni tīvrajvaravināśanelakṣaṃ rogiṇāntāratamyataḥjaṭhare hṛdi kaṇṭhe mukhe nasiṣoḍaśa manoriti tvaritarudriyamtatrāvṛṣṭirna jāyateaṣṭāṅgavasuvasvadriṣaḍarṇairaṅgakalpanamgudaliṅgayoḥsthale gale hastāgrayoraṃgulimūlayoḥcāsye kapolayugale nasoḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kramānnyasya mantrārṇāndhyānamācaretvibhūtyaikṛtvāṅgapūjanaṃ śeṣaṃ vāsukiṃ takṣaka punaḥkulikamindrādīnāyudhāni cajuhuyāttarpaṇādi tataścaretlabhate sammatāmakṣayāṃ śriyamdaśaśataṃ ṛṇamuktyai mahāśriyejuhuyādvṛṣṭisaṃsiddhyai mantravidvijitendriyaḥsarvairupadravaiḥsarvopadravanāśāya sarvadābhyudayāptayesādhayetsakalānkāmāñjapahomāditatparaḥjapenaiva siddhiḥ samprati vartatetāntrikāya kadācanajapenaiva nānnahīnaḥ prajāyatetāriṣa ūrjaṃ no dhehi dvipade catuṣpadejāyate cānnaṃ yaddhūtaṃ na ca varṣataḥhunedannaṃ yāvajjanmākṣayaṃ bhavetagniñcopasamādhāyodumbaryā samidhā yutambhavantyavṛṣṭāviti ca kimāścaryaṃ suvarṣaṇejuhuyāllavaṇaistathāmātā lavaṇasya varuṇaḥpitālavaṇaṃ chindati bhindatimajjāni asthibhyo maddviṣāṃ dahaśighramagniṃ lavaṇatejasālavaṇamantrapuraskṛtāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: munirākhyātaśchandonuṣṭubudāhṛtampañcatripañcavedeṣu dvyakṣaraiściṭimantrajaiḥṭhadvandvañcaturviṃśākṣaro manuḥkathyante sāvadhānatayā śṛṇudurgāmaribhaṅgadakṣāmbhūyādvibhūtyai mama bhadrakālīghṛtasiktenajuhuyādarcite'nalemantrī māraṇakarmaṇisādhyaḥ kiṃkarojāyate kṣaṇātaṣṭottarasahasraṃ yastasya sādhyo vaśo bhavetsaptabhirdivasairbhūpānvaśayedvidhināmunānātra kāryā vicāraṇāsarvajantūnāṃ prayogoyamudāhṛtaḥvahnau māse vaśyo bhavennaraḥprakurvīta saṃskṛte havyavāhanesucūrṇitaṃ prajuhuyātsaptāhādvaśayejjagatvaśayedakhilāndevānacirātkimu pārthivānvaśyaḥ syādanena vidhinācirātśuddhalavaṇena hutvā śatrūnvaśaṃ nayetjuhuyādvaśayennārīṃ narānnarapatīnapikurvīta sāṅgopāṅgāḥ samāḥ śubhāḥcakrihastamṛdānyā syādanyā tu sikatāmayīsamyaṅmiśritenāmunā punaḥprāṇānpratiṣṭhāpya pūjayetkusumādibhiḥmātṛkānyāsaṃ mantrasya samanantaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmaṇetivāruṇyāṃ sitavarṇikāsaumyāyāṃ candravarṇikāīśānapūrvayormadhye śeṣaṃ raktapatākinamvedamantro vajrapātasamassmṛtaḥnāmamantrānpraṇavādyānhṛdantakānmaṇḍapopari badhnīyādatiśvetaṃ vitānakamāmrāśvatthadalotpannayuktayā dīrghamālayāiṣṭikābhirapakvābhirhastavistṛtapiṇḍikāmsamunnatāṃ vāpi tāratamyaṃ vilokya caayutāhutihomastu vidheyaḥ sthaṇḍiloparidaśakenaikaṃ hastaṃhastaṃ vivarddhayetkuṇḍa eva vidhīyatemānaṃ bhavati śate'ratnisamaṃ bhavetlakṣe ṣaṭkaraṃ daśalakṣakeekakuṇḍavidhāne tu caturasraṃ vidhīyatenavakuṇḍavidhāne tu vahnibhāge bhagākṛtiardhacandranibhaṃ yāmye vaiśyānāṃ sarvakarmaṇitrikoṇakuṇḍaṃ nair-ṛtye ripughātakaraṃ smṛtamkṣattriyāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śāktakarmaṇiṣaṭkoṇamuccāyyati tacchedeṣu ca viśiṣyatepauṣṭike kuṇḍaṃ vṛttidaṃ tuṣṭidaṃ tathāmuktikaramaiśānyāṃ tadvidhīyateaṣṭakuṇḍīvidhāne tu kramo'yaṃ navakuṇḍakepañcakuṇḍīnāmīśāne pañcamaṃ bhavetpañcakoṇamabhicāravināśanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tārādyānvinyasedvarṇānsthāneṣveṣu samāhitaḥkukṣyornābhau kaṭidvayejānuyugme jaṅghāyugme padadvayeśuddhaḥ puttalīṃ dāruṇākṛtāmpratimāṃ pādenākrāmecca tathātmanaḥkṛtāṃ paścātputtalīṃ saṃspṛśañjapetpunarnābhau jaṭhare hṛdayāmbujekarṇayorakṣṇorlalāṭe mūrdhni vinyasetmantroktadevatāṃ rūpyapātrakemantrairetaiḥ prayogādāvante saṃyatamānasaḥniśāyāṃ mantrajaptena tṛpto bhava tayā sahalavaṇaṃ daha śatruhannamastubhyaṃ varade kāmadā bhavavaśamānaya devi meduṣṭaśatrubhyaṅkareśaraṇaṃ me bhavānagheśoṣaya tāpayatāpayamahākāli rakṣāsmānakṣarātmikeṛkpañcakaṃ samuccārya juhuyādedhitenaleśirastṛtīyamākhyātaṃ vāmahastastataḥ paramsaptamo vāmapādaḥ syāditi bhāgakramaḥ smṛtaḥkṛtvaivamarcayitvāgniṃ praṇameddaṇḍavattataḥmantrī vaśayedasurānsurānpūrvasamproktaputtalīnāṃ catuṣṭayamvakṣyamāṇena vidhānena prakalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vaśyasiddhyarthaṃ sādhyanāmāṃghrireṇubhiḥputtalīṃ samyakprāṇasthāpanamācaretkuṇḍe rātrau prajvalitenaledhārayenniśitaṃ śastraṃ savyahastena sādhakaḥprajuhuyānnirāhāro jitendriyaḥanenaiva vidhānena homaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥtrisaptāhaprayogena mārayedripumātmanaḥkhadiraḥ kuṣṭho vaṃśapippalanāgarāḥvaikaṅkataścāpi bakulaḥ saralaḥ kramātmadhūkaśca lodhromantravidhistvitivakṣyāmi siddhaye sugamā ṛcaḥtu yāsu siddhiradūrataḥsarvalokopakārārthaṃ kathayāmyatra tā ṛcaḥriṣyati pūruṣaḥbhāṇḍāgārasya vastūni caturthāṃśena homayetyaḥ kuryādakṣayostyayutena cadevā avantu śobhāyai pitaronnamadantusahasraṃ tasya śāntayetebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥsvarṇamutpadyate tataḥśerate tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥājyāhutisahasraṃ tu tena svarṇaśataṃ labhettasyāgnikṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ patati vairiṇiśatrunāmāsya grāmanāśaḥ prajāyatesahasraṃ tu sarṣapānpuṃvaśīkṛte
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratanu sahasreṇa śatena cavidhema haviṣā vayammārakaṃ hanyāddviguṇena puraḥ sthitamnānādeśodbhavaṃ hanyānmārakaṃ lakṣahomataḥnaḥprayutāvadheyuk tataḥśatagūṃsenā ajayatsākamindraḥvṛṣṇāpratihitābhirastārathānāmabhivīro abhisattvāsahojājaitramindrarathamātiṣṭhagovitdevasenānāmabhibhañjatīnāṃ jayantīnāmmaruto yantvagramjayatāmudasthātgacchāmitrānprapadyasva māmīṣāṃ kaṃcanocchiṣaḥbāhavo'nādhṛṣyā yathāsathabṛhaspatiraditiḥ śarma yacchatu viśvā hā śarma yacchatuurorvarīyo varuṇaste kṛṇotu jayantaṃ tvānudevā madantuyāyādvijayo jāyate dhruamśrutvā tasminsthale cintyonuvāko manasā dvijaiḥkuśānvāpi kṣipedrakṣā bhavatvitaḥsaptayonīrāpṛṇasva ghṛtena svāhātejasvī hunedayutasaṅkhyayāsaptatolakaparyantaṃ ṣaṇmāsābhyantare dhruvambrahmaṇasmai kṣatrāya mahiśarma yaccha svāhāvāstudoṣātpramucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sūtikāpīḍāṃ bhayaṃ naikākino bhavetp. 270) anenājyaṃ sahasrantu hutvā śatrugṛhaṃ vrajetsuvarṇavṛddhisiddhyarthaṃ ghṛtāktāḥ samidho hunetnaukāstho jale yadvanna majjatiśṛṇvannūtibhiḥ sīda sādanamsamidha audumbaryastathaiva [dvitīyārthe prathamā |] cavivardhate cātha homaṃ kuryāccatuṣpathemṛdā liṃgaṃ kṛtvā ca snāpayettathāsastanūbhirvyaśema devahitaṃ yadāyuḥbhavati ṣaṇḍhatvācca vimucyatevṛddhāyumanuvṛddhayo juṣṭā bhavantu juṣṭayaḥvṛṣṭirbhavetkālaṃ vinā tadājyotiṣāṃ jyotirekaṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṃkalpamastuśivasaṃkalpamastutanme manaḥ śivasaṃkalpamastuśivasaṃkalpamastupārthivaṃ liṃgamuttamamkroḍīkṛtyākṣatāścaivaṃ sthāpyāḥ sthānacatuṣṭayeṛcāṃ pāṭhamekaṃ kṛtvākṣatānnyasetdvitīyādipraharake dakṣiṇādyāsu vinyasetsyādāsāyaṃ tu kṛtyaṃ kṛtvā ca bhakṣayetaṣṭavāra sahasrantu jāpyā etā ṛcaḥ śubhāḥvartamānaṃ vā bhaviṣyadapi dṛśyatedāridryanāśāya nānyaktiñcinnṛṇāṃ tathahiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ jātavedo ma āvaha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hiraṇyaṃ vindeyaṃ gāmaśvaṃ puruṣānahamdevīmupahvaye śrīrmā devījuṣatāmalakṣmīrme naśyatāṃ tvā vṛṇerāṣṭesminkīrtimṛddhiṃ dadātu meabhūtimasamṛddhiṃ ca sarvā nirṇuda me gṛhātīśvarīṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tāmihopahvaye śriyamrupamannasya mayi śrīḥ śrayatāṃ yaśaḥkule mātaraṃ padmamālinīmmātaraṃ śriyaṃ vāsaya me lehiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ jātavedo ma āvahacandrāṃ hiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ jāta vedo ma āvahaprabhūtaṃ gāvo dāsyo'śvānvindeyaṃ puruṣānahamcaturdaśānāmīśānāmānandaḥ kardamastathāhiraṇyāditisṛṇāṃ cacchandonuṣṭubudāhṛtamupaitu māṃ devādyaṣṭa -ṛcāmapiprastārapaṃktiruddiṣṭā devate śrīvibhāvasūkīlakaṃ prīktaṃ tvaṃguṣṭhādiṣaḍaṅgakamhiraṇyasragdhiraṇyākṣī tathā hiraṇyavarṇikākuryāddhyānaṃ tataścaretsantataṃ śrīḥ śriye naḥāgneyakoṇatastadvattadbāhyeṣṭadaleṣvimāḥtṛptiśca jvalantī tadanantaramcāsanaṃ syādarghyapādyācamāni cadīpabhojye prodvāsanamiti kramātdattvā nīrājayecchriyam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cācamanaṃ tāṃ ma āvahamantrataḥnityapūjeyaṃ puraścaraṇamucyateādityābhimukho japtvāyāvattāvacca tarpayettāvaddvādaśasāhasraṃ japenniścalamānasaḥpadmaistrimadhuropetairghṛtāktena payondhasāsiddho bhavenmantro nātrā kāryā vicāraṇālakṣmyāścātipriyāṇi cakarotyevaṃ sa syāllakṣapatiḥ svayamhunetsudhīḥcatvāriṃśadbhirasya syānmahālakṣmīracañcalāṣaṇmāsātsyānmahendirāpriyato bhūtvā juhuyādājyamanvahamāvāhayecchriyaṃ padme pañcabhiḥ kanakethavāśālīnāṃ payasā samprakalpayetsarvauṣadhībhiḥ phāṇṭaiśca snātvābhipācitairapipaśukāmābhiṣecaneaśvapūrṇāmiti snāyādrājyakāmaḥ samāhitaḥkāryastvanantaramādityavarṇetyanayā bilvahomo vidhīyateprathamaṃ samyaganantāṃ viṃdate śriyamanuktāmavyavacchināṃ śāśvatīṃ vidate śriyamjape tu prayutaṃ samyaganantāṃ viṃdate śriyamjuhuyānnityaṃ padmānyayutaśopi casiddhiṃ sa gacchatibilvāni sasa kāmaḥ samṛddhyati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāmena homaḥ kāryaḥ kathañcanaprārthayatā ratnādyuktaiḥ śrīrijyate dhruvamvasurūpā hiraṇmayībhuktiścāpi pramuktiyukbhuvaneśī ca śuddhā ca bhoginī bhogadā tathāpraṇavādicaturthyantairnamobhiścaiva tarpayetkāryo niyamaśca nigadyatebhavejjātu kutsitānnaṃ na bhakṣayetlakṣmīpriyāścaite kadācidbuddhimāṃstataḥjambūṃ pravālañca dhārayenmūrdhni sarvadāsaprathāḥ apa naḥ śośucadaghambhūmimasapatnāmakaṇṭakāmcakṣurātatamjale japtvā teṣāṃ nāśaḥ prajāyatehiraṇyayena savitā rathenādevo yāti bhuvanāni paśyanjapedaṣṭottaraśataṃ sampūrṇāyurgadojjhitaḥhutvānayācā jyaṃ dīrghamāyuravāpnuyātnātibhave bhavasva māṃ bhavodbhavāya namaḥsarvaśarvebhyo namaste astu rudrarūpebhyaḥkalpayedraudraṃ bhūtyarthaṃ pañcaparvasusūryamtasya paramārogyavardhanamsomaṃ tasya duḥkhaṃ layaṃ vrajetvindeta candrasyaiti salokatāmvicakramāṇastredhorugāyā viṣyāvocā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viṣṇordhruvo'si || vaiṣṇavamasi viṣṇave tvāsakhāśucirbhūtvā upratiṣṭheta yonvahamprāpnoti paramaṃ sthānaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanamno dūre adyasa soyo antyagne mākiṣṭe vyathirādadharṣītavasthirā tanuhi yātujūnāṃ jāmi majāmi pramṛṇīhiviśvānyasmai sudināni rāyo dyumnānyaryauviduro abhidyautasya vacasaścikiddhi hotaryaviṣṭhasukratodanūnāḥtepāyakasaṃciyaṃconiṣadhogne tava naḥ pāntvamūḥubhāśagūṃsāsudayasatpatā terakṣasaḥ pāhyasmāduhonidomitramaho avadyātpātu naktammadaicidasya dvyarujanti bhāmānavarante parivādho adevīḥharetprāṇānbhayannaivopajāyateghoṣayitvā no mṛḍātīdṛśedvijo nityaṃ vindate kṣetramuttamamsūktasya triṣṭubantyasya devatāyathoktavidhinā prāṅmukhaḥ śuddhamānasaḥvāmapāde tu caturthīṃ dakṣiṇe nyasetvāmakaṭyāṃ vai cāṣṭamīṃ dakṣiṇe kaṭaukaṇṭhadeśe dvādaśīṃ vāmabāhukenyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā paścātpūjāṃ samācaretapsvagnau hṛdaye sūrye sthaṇḍile pratimāsu caviṣṇuryogināṃ hṛdaye hariḥpratimāsvalpabuddhīnāṃ ṣaṭprakārāśca tāḥ smṛtāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sajīvāśca pratimāssanti vai hareḥdvividhā śālagrāmotipāvanaḥdaśadhā proktāḥ śreṣṭhāstāḥ pūrvapūrvataḥmṛttikājātā citrarūpeti ca kramātyāstu mūrtayastāścalācalāḥbrāhmaṇā gāvo nirjīvaḥ pippalaḥ smṛtaḥgāyatryakṣaranyastāṅgaḥ pūjayedviṣṇumavyayamdvitīyayāsanaṃ dadyātpādyaṃ dadyāttṛtīyayāsnānaṃ prakurvīta saptamyā vastrameva cadātavyamekādaśyā tu dhūpakamnamaskāraṃ pañcadaśyā pradakṣiṇamśaktyā ṣoḍaśyā tu samarpaṇamjapitvā tu sūktaṃ tasmai nivedayetkārayetprathamenaiva dvitīyena tu prokṣaṇampañcamenājyaśrapaṇaṃ carośca śrapaṇaṃ tathācintayeddevadeveśaṃ kālānalasamaprabhamkuryātsaptamyādi yathākramamjuhuyāccaruṇā ca tataḥ punaḥagnerbhagavatastasya samīpe stotramuccarethṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa pūrvajacaraṇadvandvaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ tavacāguṇo māyāsamāvṛtaḥprāpya nistaranti manīṣiṇaḥpuruṣākāro bhaktānāṃ ca prakāśasesādhyosti vinā bhaktiṃ bhavānprabho
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paramā siddhiḥ paramaṃ te padaṃ viduḥpuṇḍarīkākṣa na jānāmi paraṃ padamcāpi vartate me mahadbhayamprāpya yadidaṃ jñānavarjitamjātasya tvadgato me manorathaḥātmajñānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yogajñānamidaṃ paramniṣpāpo jāyate manujo yadāśubhe vāre yadā caikādaśī bhavetputrakāmāya caruṃ kurvīta vaiṣṇavampuruṣasūktena prāśayetputrakāmyayāpuruṣasūktena juhuyācchiṣṭaṃ striyābhakṣayet |]mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu kramātpūjyaśca keśavaḥpadmanābho gadādharaḥhomañca pūrvavatkuryātsarvānkāmānavāpnuyātsuputraḥ syāttamupāyaṃ bravīmyahamca saghṛtamupatiṣṭheddhutāśanamkuryātpratyahaṃ vāgyataḥ śuciḥca patiṃ viṣṇuṃ namaskṛtya prabhakṣayetpravartenāvaśyaṃ garbhavatī bhavetjapedaṣṭottaraśataṃ sūktametattrikālakamdaśaśataṃ tribhirvarṣairjapeddinamtaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayamsvadharmanirato nyāyavṛttaḥ śucivrataḥsamprasupteṣu lokeṣu yogaṃ yuñjīta yogavitsaṃveśayettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturasrasya kuṇḍasya vidhirucyatedvimekhalaṃ tu śūdrāṇāṃ saṃkarāṇāṃ kumekhalamyāvatkuṇḍamiheṣṭaṃ syāttāvaddiksadhane kṛteyatkarṇo bhujā tasya karadvayīcaturhastādikepyevaṃ kuṇḍaḥ sarvatra bhūsamaḥdvādaśāṅgulavistārā cotsedhā caturaṅgulācaturbhiraṅgulairdīrghā tāvaduccā tadardhataḥekāṅgulocchritā sā tu praviṣṭābhyantare tathāaṅguṣṭhamekhalāyuktā madhye bāhye dhṛtiḥ kṣamābhavetpīṭhaṃ kuṇḍamaṣṭāṃśavistṛtamtu tadvṛttaṃ kuṇḍaṣaṣṭhaṃśamānataḥpūrvamukhā yoniḥ kuṇḍayoniñca varjayetvyāsārkabhāgatulyena tatparamkarṇikāgre bāhyavṛttābhyantareṣṭadalāni tucaturasrasya jināṃśo bhāga ucyateprakuryācca caturdhā caturasrakampātayetsūtraṃ dvayorapi tadā bhavetdaśadhā vibhajedbudhaḥkuṇḍaṃ ramaṇīyamidaṃ bhavetsaumyapṛṣṭhaṃ tato nyattra yoniḥ paścimadigmatāsarvatantreṣu proktamatra nirantaramtrayaḥ pañca trihastehyarkabhūmayaḥtryabdarāmāśca nage trikṛtisāgarāḥvedāgnidhṛtiyugmāni daśahastabhujā smṛtātāvatkarkaṭakād vṛttaṃ vṛttakuṇḍamihocyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: baddhāñjalikaraḥ svastho yogasammīlitekṣaṇaḥsamādadhyādiṃdriyāṇi manastathāprāṇānāyamya cāsīno'nudvignaściṃtayettataḥucchasecaivamasakṛttanmanā yogamunnayethṛdayādūrddhameva tuparaṃ sthānaṃ tatra taddvārapaddhatiḥyathākālaṃ nābhitaścocchvasetpunaḥmahātmānamātmānaṃ pratipadyatebrahma gatiṃ jñātvā bhavecchuciḥdevaṃ sa gacchetparamāṅgatimvā ramate manaḥjānīyātpradhvaṃse dhāraṇātmakepraviṃdetedṛgjapasya prabhāvataḥyogīśvaraṃ prāpya nirdvandvaṃ paramātparamsvarānsnātaḥ pavitramidamuttamamsukṛtī bhavetsyācchraddadhānasya kurvataḥtatsiddhirupajāyatevākyamatyantayatnena brahmābhyeti sanātanamvedagarbhaśarīreṇa sa vai nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥpretya draṣṭavyaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamambhagavāñcchruyate puruṣottamaḥāraṇyakavidhānena nirvapetpratyahaṃ carumcakṣurdivyaṃ hoturdadāti saḥbhaktavatsalaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hārī hiraṇmayavapurdhṛtaśaṃkhacakraḥsthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitameti viṣṇoḥnityaṃ jāpyena ravimaṇḍalemālatīkuśapatraṃ ca sadyastuṣṭikaraṃ hareḥprasādāttu devadevasya cakriṇaḥna yatnaḥvṛhaspatiprasūtāstā asyai sandatta vīryamriṣyati pūruṣaḥsaṅgatya vīrudhosyai sandatta vīryamdvipāccatuṣpādasmākagūṃsarvamastvanāturambrāhmaṇasta gūṃ rājanpārayāmasivaidyastvamṛtahastaḥ syādanyaḥ svastyayanaṃ bhajetjāyante tathājīrṇāni pañca vāhyoṣadhīrvipraḥ sūktametajjapetsadāvaruṇaṃ ceṣṭvā vindate dviṣadoṣadhīḥhomena ca samanvitaḥnamaskṛtya vṛṣṭiṃ vindati śobhanāmdeśadeśe thāsyantyanyāśca vai kṣitaudevāḥ kiṃ vaktavyaṃ taducyatāmmahāmāyā tviyaṃ parāmuktiśca kleśo naiva ca naiva caca tāmasaṃ rupaṃ tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ tu sāttvikamtanme jānīhi śatarudriyambhavedrudra ādityaḥ parapūruṣaḥlalāṭe ca bhruvormadhye ca haṃsa ṛk
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śantamayā giriśantābhicākaśīhivadhanvāni tanmasisahasrayojane vadhanvāni tanmasivediṣadatithirduroṇasathavāmaheśalyānāṃ mukhā śivo naḥ sumanā bhavate hetidvayaṃ bāhvoḥ prakoṣṭhayoḥgūṃ sahasrayojanevadhanvāni tanmasigūṃ sahasrayojanevadhanvāni tanmasibāhubhyāṃ tava dhanvanetayāsmānviśvatastvamayakṣmayā paribhujasahasrayojanevadhanvāni tanmasipañca hṛdaye tu nyasedimāḥvicinvatkebhyo nama ānirhatebhyaḥkukṣyostu namastakṣabhya ityapinamo namo virūpebhyo viśvarūpebhyaśca vo namaḥpuṣṭānāmpataye namo namo bamluśāyanamo namaḥ śvanibhyo mṛgayubhyaśca vo namaḥmiḍhuṣṭameti kaṭyāñca ye bhūtānāntu guhyakeiṣava ābhurasya niṣaṅgadhiḥāyudhannidhāya kṛttiṃ vasāna ācara pinākambibhradāmahiteṣāgūṃsahasrayojanevadhanvānitanmasimahāntamūrvośca eṣa te jānunornyasetparṣadatidurgāṇi viśvā nāvevasindhunduritātyagniḥ|| satīnasatvā havyobhareṣu marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtīḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rīriṣaḥpinākāvasaḥ kṛttivāsā ahigūṃsannaḥ śivotīhipathāṃ pathiraṅghryoḥ syādadhyavocaśca varmakamsarvo hyeṣa rudrastasmai rudrāya namo astuteṣāgūṃsahasrayojanevadhanvāni tanmasisarvāñjambhayansarvāśca yātu dhānyo dharācīḥ parāsuvanyasennetre tṛtīyakesattvāno hantebhyokarannamaḥparā tā bhagavo vvapaetāvanta iti ca kuryāddigbandhanantataḥteṣāgūṃsahasrayojanevadhanvāni tanmasiimannyāsamprakurvāṇaḥ pāvakepi na naśyatiproktonena kuryānnyāsānte tu namaskṛtimdakṣahaste vāmahaste nābhau pādadvaye tathānyāsastṛtīyopi procyatetra śṛṇuṣva tamtṛtīyesmiñśaivaṃ tejaḥ samāviśetdikpālāṃstattanmantreṇa vinyasethaviṣā yajāmaḥanyamasmadicchasāta ityā namo devi nir-ṛte tubhyamastunaḥdīpyamānamaśaktāste palāyante vidūrataḥnyasya mukhemarmāṇi te tathāiva pravayāmujjihānāḥ prabhānavaḥ siṣanenākamacchadevāḥurorvarīyo varuṇaste kṛṇotu jayantantvā nu devā madantu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jātavedāstacchirasi nyāmaḥ proktaścaturthakaḥsambhūta iti varma pratirathaṃ matamviśvamājānamagrejāto namo rucāya brāhmayevidyāttasya devā asanvaśema iṣāṇapañcamaḥ proktoyaṃ sarvābhīṣṭasādhakaḥtu tmanādvitīyāstṛtīyeṣu śrayadhvaṃ tṛtīyāścaturtheṣusaptamā aṣṭameṣuṣoḍaśāḥ saptadaśeṣuśrayadhvaṃ vi gūṃ śā ekavi gūṃ śeṣugūṃ śeṣuekonatrigūṃśeṣuśrayadhvaṃ dvātrigūṃśāstrayastrigūṃśebhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥsvāhānivedya rudrāyopatiṣṭhettataḥ punaḥasya dvipadaścatuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhemabharīmabhiḥśatrūnpūrbhirāyasībhirnipāhināsikāyāṃ caṃdrādityau ca netrayoḥmūrdhni cādityā mahādevaḥ śirogataḥśailī ca pārśvayoḥ śivaśaṅkarauagnijvālāmālikāśca tiṣṭhantu bahuśo mama
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: māmiti procya prapañcaṃ manasā hunetahamamṛte amṛtaṃ brahmaṇiamṛtaṃ brahmaṇiahamamṛte amṛtaṃ brahmaṇiahamamṛte amṛtaṃ brahmaṇiahamamṛte amṛtaṃ brahmaṇiamṛtaṃ brahmaṇiahamamṛte amṛtaṃ brahmaṇiamṛtaṃ brahmaṇiamṛtaṃ brahmaṇipārthivoktaprakāreṇa liṅgapūjāṃ tataścaretbhaktyā tvāṃ māṃ gṛhāṇa maheśvaraśīghrammama havyāya śarvasaḥ kṛttivāsā ahi gūṃ sannaḥ śivotī hicātra tvaṃ mama cābhimukho bhavaprītibhāvena liṅgesminsannidho bhavapaścācchuddhodakenātha tataḥ pūjanamārabhetrudrāgnāviṣṇū ityadhyāyadvayena catu yaḥ kuryātpratyahaṃ naraḥsandhyāvandanataḥ kṣīṇaṃ taccetprāgjanmajambhavetnastasyuḥ ā nā viṣṇustathaikakamyastu kuryālliṅgābhiṣecanampāpe naṣṭe lakṣmīrvivardhatecāsya yathārūpaṃ tathā toye pradṛśyateyairliṅgante na paśyanti bhāskarim

sanskrit: dhanaprado'dhanānāñca mahāpātakanāśanaḥdīkṣāyāntasya pāpakṣayaṅkaraḥsyāddṛṣṭanyāyena niṣkṛtiḥsāmarthye śaraṇāgatanāśanamyattadatirudro vināśayetpaṭhanīyau tathā tena śākhākhaṇḍaṃ na kārayetyajamānasya brāhmaṇadvārataḥ kṛtāśākhāmiśraṃ kṛtaṃ karma yajamānaṃ vināśayetcāṇḍālavajjñeyo nirdhanassaptajanmasucejjapadānābhyāṃ tadrudrāṃśosya niṣkṛtiḥdevyannabhoktā plavago mūṣako viṣṇuvittabhukaprasādaṃ na ca gṛhṇanti svayandattādṛte kvacitpūjakāste tu sukhaṃ kurvantyanuttamampaṭhedrudrantaittirīyaṃ luptaśākhastameva hivācyaṃ tāntrikāya kadācanabāhubhyāmuta te namaḥyā tava tayā no rudra mṛḍayaśantamayā giriśantābhicākaśīhikuru māhigūṃsīḥ puruṣaṃ jagatprajuhuyādgoghṛtaṃ yotra suprabhamyatkiñcitkāryamuddiśya tasya siddhiḥ prajāyategrāme naśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥpañcadaśāhantu rājyopadravanāśanaḥnaśyenmāsamātreṇa homataḥprajāyate || ayutaṃ rudrahomena mahāśāntirbhaveddhruvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prātarlakṣañjaptvā sukhī bhavetvyādhīnāṃ nāśanaṃ cetthaṃ prayogāntaramucyatekṣipedrakṣā daśadigbhyaḥ prajāyatekṣipennityaṃ pathi kṣemaṃ prajāyatesarṣapaistāḍyaḥ saptavārābhimantritaiḥgṛhītvā gacchanti kare candanameva hisamastāṃ skandādigrahapīḍā vinaśyatitadguṇo yaḥ syādanyathā tu yathā tithiḥharetsavigrahāṇāṃ ca sarṣapaistāḍanaistathātathā rātrau triśūlamabhimantrayettriśūlenāstavegāste nāśaṃ gacchanti pannagāḥkṣipettattālaśabdena pannagotsādanaṃ bhavetbhito dikṣuḥ śritāḥ sahasraśo vaiṣāgūṃheḍa īmahemṛḍayāti naḥtryabdamakṣayovibhavo [tasyeti śeṣaḥ ||] bhavetsyādghṛtasrāvācca varṣaṇamyāti savitā varado bhavetcārkasamidhāṃ śaktaścetsa jale japettu bhajatāmiṣṭāṃ siddhiṃ prayacchatikṛtvā saghṛtapāyasamkārṣāpaṇasahasrakamlakṣamekaṃ puraskṛtiḥparā tā bhagavo vapaśalyānāmmukhā śivo naḥ sumanā bhavaiṣava ābhurasya niṣaṅgadhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tayāsmānviśvatastvamayakṣmayā paribhujabāhubhyāṃ tava dhanvaneiṣudhistavāre asmannidhehi tamnirasayedgacchedgacchanti śatravaḥcoccārya śatrornāma smaranhunetjapannutsādayetsagrāmameva cavaiśyantu ṣaḍbhāgenaikajātikamviprādivaśyakāmastu dadhikṣaudraghṛtānvitāḥhīnavarṇānvaśīkartuṃ varuṇārkakavetasānsaugandhikānutpalāgnikumudāni prayacchatibhavedrājā ṣaḍbhirmantraiḥ pṛthakpṛthaklakṣamekantilānāṃ yaḥ pṛthagdhatte śivopariayutaṃ rājavṛkṣasya samidho homayettu yaḥṣaṭsahasraṃ yo dakṣiṇāmūrtisannidhauasādhyasyāpi siddhiḥ syāddhṛtvā cāṣṭasahasrakamsahasrāṣṭakametasya dravyambhavati cākṣayamlokopakārāya sāvadhānatayā śṛṇusahasraṃ tu juhuyāllokavanditaḥpuṣṭānāmpataye namonamaḥnamo namaḥ sūtāyāhantyai vanānāmpataye namonamaḥsaṃgrāmagatastasya kauśalyārthamidañjapetsūtāyāhantyai pūrvantu pariśiṣṭaṃ nigadyatevārivaskṛtāyauṣadhīnāmpataye namonamaḥuccairghoṣāyākranda yate patīnāmpataye namonamaḥtaskarāṇāmpataye namo namaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyāghracaurādikairvanenaktañcaradbhyo vikṛntānāmpataye namonamaḥnamonamaḥyā nāśakosya japaḥ smṛtaḥnamastiṣṭhadbhyo dhāvadbhyo śca vo namonamaḥvo namaḥśāntaye prajapedidamupagaṇābhyastṛ gūṃ hatībhyaśca vo namaḥnamo namo virūpebhyo viśvarūpebhyaśca vo namaḥarbhakebhyaśca vo namaḥvo namaḥdattvā japtvā caitānnirāmayaḥtrisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhedetadevaṃ varṣeṇa bhāgyavānsrotasyāya ca dīpyāya catṛptimāpnoti yanmataṃ ca parairapiślokyāya ca vasānyāya ca nama urvaryāya ca khalyāya cajñātiśreṣṭhatvamāpnoti japenaiva na saṃśayaḥśrutāya ca śrutasenāya canaśyati khaṃjatvaṃ pādukāsiddhimāpnuyātnamo nādeyāya ca vaiśantāya cajayakṛccāyamanuvākaḥ prakīrtitaḥmedhyāya ca vidyutyāya ca nama indriyāya cātathyāya caabhimantraṇametena tena toyaṃ vimuñcatiśaṅgave ca paśupataye ca nama ugrāya ca bhīmāya canamo vṛkṣebhyo hrikeśebhyo namastārāya
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāvatkarkaṭakenāpi kuryād vṛttaṃ manoharamtattribhujāṃ dattvā kuḍamevaṃ ṣaḍasravattanmadhyataḥ sūryabhāgaṃ karkaṭakena tudigvidigantarāle ca sūtrāṇyaṣṭau prapātayetnayedbāhyavṛttapūrvasūtrasya mūrddhanitasmādevamaṣṭadalāni tuṣaḍaṅgavyāsārdhavṛttaṃ tatkeśarāṇi cagurūktayuktyā nikhanedyathā padmākṛtirbhavetvālukābhiścaturasrasamaṃ yathābhrāmayed vṛttaṃ cihnānyatra digaṣṭakekuṇḍaṃ tadvatkaṇṭhaśca mekhalāḥtadvyāsārdhena vṛttaṃ syāttatra cihnāni pañca tudhanurlopātkuṇḍaṃ pañcāsrakaṃ bhavetbhrāmayettatra vṛttaṃ tu saptadhā sakalaṃ tu tatanābhikāni kuṇḍāni viyonīti śrutīritamcatvāri dikṣu kuṇḍāni tāntrikevāmapathyakaṃ yonikuṇḍakamtasmātsamyakparīkṣyedaṃ kartavyaṃ śubhamicchatāsantāpo maraṇaṃ chinnamekhalebhāryāvināśakaṃ kuṇḍaṃ proktaṃ yonyā vinā kṛtamśṛṅgārarahitaṃ yacca kuṇḍaṃ jarjaramekhalamsuhṛddveṣaḥ sūtrahīne daridratāyathoktakuṇḍepyutpātādevaṃ jāte phalaṃ tvidamjātibhede cācāryayajamānayoḥvāmamārge ca bauddhe jaine ca śābare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mayaskarāya ca namaḥ śivāya ca śivatarāya cabhasmatoyañca bhakṣayellepayettathābhaveddivyo rogaḥ kṣudro dinatrayāttattīrthaphalaṃ labhate ceha janmanikṣayāṇāya ca namaḥ kapardine ca pulastaye caharityāya ca namo lopyāya ca colpyāya casidhyatyetatprasādataḥnamontasyāgrataḥ paṭhetvarhiṣodakamārjanātdeyaṃ śokaśāntyai tu śokinepariśiṣṭaṃ caitadatra prayogeṣvapi yo japetbhūpālātprāpnuyādvarṣamadhyataḥpradātavyā gāva ekādaśaiva hitu rājalakṣmīḥ svayaṃ vasetśatapuṣpamayīṃ kṛtvā pratimāṃ rājarūpyakāmlakṣantu hutvā bhūpaśriyaṃ labhethṛtasāmantarājyaṃ sa prāpnotyeva na cānyathārāṣṭraṃ sāmantasya labheta saḥdadyādbhūtebhyaśca tathā balimcārdhapalaṃ vāpi dakṣiṇāmūrtisannidhaukapilājyena pradīpinyābhimantritamvākyaṃ sarvatra niścitambahugavāṃ sa syātkṣīyante nāsya dhenavaḥsuvarṇāṣṭakamāpnoti hyasiddho rajatāṣṭakamhaimavatī tadabhāve vibhītakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hunedyastasya lakṣmīstu svayamevopatiṣṭhatepaśūnāṃ mā bhermā roṅmocanaḥ kiñca nāmamatvāsāṃsi bhavanti ca tathātathāurṇābhāścājīvadavestanūṃ vihāya casampramantyāthaikādaśa granthayassmṛtāḥvāmahaste tu garbhiṇyāḥ sa suvīta sukhaṃ sutamsūtrantu mantreṇaivābhimantritamkadāciduttamarṇādvai bhayantasya na jāyateasminnanāturammahājvaropaghātepi mṛtakalpaḥ sa jīvatimahāgrahajvarādibhyobhicārācca pramucyatepīḍā sadya eva vinaśyatituṣānprajuhuyādayutaṃ sukhamedhatejuhuyāllakṣaṃ sarvaśaktikaraṃ smṛtamsaṃsthāpya juhuyādvaikaṅkatīghṛtaplutāḥghṛtāktānāṃ prajuhuyānmahājvaramukhā grahāḥgajaṃ vāśvaṃ muktvā gacchanti dūrataḥhānirvā tatra śāntirudīryatemahāmārīvyāghrādibhyo bhayaṃ na vaimadhyabhāge tu vahnisthāpanamācaretsthāpyāstataḥ karma sāvadhānaḥ samācarettatordharātrasamaye tvodanaṃ saghṛtantilāndadyātsthānesthāne tato balimpakṣamekaṃ sarvopadravanāśanambhavediṣṭaṃ tridinārvāṅmiletkhalu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rudrarīriṣaḥśītalādibhya ārogyaṃ jāyate kṣaṇātkāryasiddhayesaṃśodhya cātmānaṃ pūtakāyo japañcaretbhikṣāñcājyañjapastasya bhavedayutasaṃkhyakaḥtvahorātrañjapaḥ kāryo nirantarammahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ paścāttāvadeva ghṛtaṃ hunetkarma prakurvīta prāyaścittaṃ punaḥ punaḥmaraṇādiprayogāṇāmbhavetpātakamocanamsamidhāñcauṣadhyaḥ sarvakarmasujuhuyāllakṣmīkāmo vā śivadarśanātghṛtāktānāṃ sarvārthasya smṛddhayesahasrāṣṭakamādarātlabhetāṣṭasahasrakambhāryāmukī me bhavatu hyedarthe hunecchuciḥsūtā vṛṣabhaṃ vāsitāpi gauḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā tathā cāṣṭasahasrakamāyuṣmatoṣṭaputrāṃśca janayennātra saṃśayaḥāyuṣkāmoṣṭasāhasraṃ cirāyuṣṭvaṃ sa vindatesahasrāṇyaṣṭa juhuyādicchetkṣudrānyadā paśūnnṛpatirbhavedvaśyo na saṃśayaḥsamyakspṛṣṭastena spṛṣṭo yoyosau vaśago bhavethutvā lakṣaṃ tejonidhirbhavetsamidhoṣṭasahasrāṇi śatroruccāṭanaṃ bhavetsahasraṃ tu caturdikṣu kṣipettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vrajanmārge cauravyāghrabhayaṃ haretmṛḍājaritre rudrastavāno abhyante asmanniva yantu senāsmareccitte tadbhayasya vināśikāḥsahasragūṃhetanyamasmannivapantu tāḥvaśamāyāti prītiścāti prajāyateparācīnāmukhākṛdhiprakurvīta vaikaṅkatasamidvaraiḥpratyekamekādaśadhā cābhimantrya tatovanimdadyādviḍālamāṃsasya baliṃ naśyantyupadravāḥsahasrayojanevadhanvānitanmasiasminmahatyarṇave taṃ rakṣo bhavā adhi tathāteṣāgūṃsahasrayojanevadhanvānitanmasiteṣāgūṃsahasrayojanevadhanvāni tanmasiteṣāgūṃsahasrayojanevadhanvānitanmasiteṣāgūṃsahasrayojanevadhanvānitanmasiteṣāgūṃsahasrayojanevadhanvānitanmasiteṣāgūṃsahasrayojanevadhanvānitanmasiteṣāgūṃsahasrayojanevadhanvānitanmasiteṣāgūṃsahasrayojanevadhanvānitanmasihīnā jñānapradā matāḥdveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhedadhmaḥdaśaprācīrdaśa dakṣiṇā daśa pratīcīrdaśorddhvāḥdaśa prācīrdaśa dakṣiṇā daśa pratīcīrdaśorddhvāḥpratyaṅgirāyā mantrasya karma kuryādayaṃ manuḥtaittirīyenyaśākhāsu pariśiṣṭāni sapta ca
