sanskrit: śubhrairvājairniragāttamaṣṭottarasahasrantu ṣaṇmāsaṃ satyavāgbhavetjyotiśca me svaśca me yajñena kalpantāmdakṣaśca me balaṃ ca me yajñena kapantāmāyuśca me jarā ca me yajñena kalpantāmkalpantāmme sūktañca me sukṛtaṃ ca me yajñena kalpantāmśayanañca me sūṣaśca me yajñena kalpantāmsīrañca me layaśca me yajñena kalpantāmme vasīyaśca me yaśaśca me yajñena kalpantāmjaitraṃcame audbhidyaṃśca me yajñena kalpantāmkṣitaṃcamennañca me kṣucca me yajñena kalpantāmme matiśca me sumatiśca me yajñena kalpantāmme sīsaṃca me trapu ca me yajñena kalpantāmbhūtiśca me yajñena kalpantāmgatiśca me yajñena kalpantāmbṛhaspatiśca ma indraśca me yajñena kalpantāmviśve ca me devā indraśca me yajñena kalpatāmdiśaścama indraśca me yajñena kalpantāmme manthī ca me yajñena kalpantāmme pālkīvataśca me hāriyojanaśca me yajñena kalpantāmkalpantāmmeṅgulayaḥ śakvarayo diśaśca me yajñena kalpantāmbṛhadrathantare ca me yajñena kalpantāmkalpantām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yajñena kalpantāmyajñena kalpantāmbhuvanaścādhipatiśca yajñena kalpantāmvisvarovākṣaraḥ pāṭho rudrastotraṃ tu śāntayeśāntiḥ śāntiḥ || śāntiḥabhiṣiñcetpauṣṭikārthaṃ śāntikāmastu homayetbahurudrāḍhyaḥ śiva eva na cāparaḥvākyatulpāvṛtījapātsarvaṃ pāpaṃ vinaśyatianuvākamimaṃ japtvāniṣṭagraharujo jayetprocyate rudre vināyaṃ tatpuraḥ paṭhetmitrāvaruṇau bhā vibharmyahamindrāgnī ahamaśvinau bhābhūryāveśayantīmsumedhātjanāya samadaṃ kṛṇomyahaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī āviveśadivā paraśnā pṛthivyai tāvatī mahinā saṃbabhūvamantrasiddherdvijānāṃ parikīrtitaḥvinā sarve mantrā vighnaistu vighnitāḥtattu nirvighnena prajāyateityādyā mantravighnakarāḥ smṛtāḥkāryāṇi syurapratihatāni cadevo gaṇapaḥ parikīrtitaḥuttarāṇāṃ navānāñca gāyatraṃ chanda ucyateyathākāryānusārataḥśṛṇvannūtibhiḥ sīda sādanamtvatkriyate kiñcanāre mahāmarkaṃmadhañcitramarca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāram || mayā bhuvo yedakṣiṇenatuvimātramavobhiḥnaḥno vasornirbhākmakṣu jarantamna iṃdra vidmahi na hi tvā śūrameva catveti bahiśca hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgakamdvādaśa-ṛgbhistu nyāsamatra samācaretbhuje jaṭhare nābhimadhyataḥmantrarājākṣaraiścaiva tṛtīyo nyāsa eva cadgbandhaṃ pāde śirasi caikakamsampūjya ṛgbhirdvādaśabhistathānaivedyairvividhākārairmodakaiḥ siddhalaḍḍukaiḥikṣukhaṇḍairikṣurasaiḥ kadalīpanasādibhiḥtāmbūlairdakṣiṇābhiḥ samantataḥjapenmantrarājaṃ vāradvādaśakaṃ budhaḥantardvādaśapāṭhe tu mantrarājaṃ punarjapetjapaḥ saṃsiddhikārakaḥvakratuṇḍasya japa ādau prajāyateitimantraḥ |] ṣaḍakṣaraḥevamaṣṭottaraśataṃ kṛtvā sūktaṃ japaṃ harejapāddaśā.śahomastu pāyasena ghṛtena cabilvapatrairikṣudaṇḍairdāḍimaiḥ kadalīphalaiḥsarvadravyāṇāṃ juhuyāttilasarpiṣā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadabhāve guḍodakamdaśāṃśena brāhmaṇānbhojayedbahūnapūpairmaṃḍakādyaiśca saghṛtaiḥ śarkarānvitaiḥevaṃsiddhe tu sūkte tu saphalaṃ tannigadyatesamavāpnoti cānte brahmapuraṃ vrajettattadgaṇapaternūnaṃ prasādātsidhyati dhruvammahotpāte paracakrabhaye tathābandhoccāṭanayordveṣe sarṣapairlohasaṃyutaiḥśmaśānastho rātrau kuryājjapaṃ ruṣāmeṣīlomānvitaiścaiva homaḥ syānmāraṇe dhruvamākarṣaṇārthaṃ sādhyānāmunmattaphalabījakaiḥsaptavāsaraparyantantataścākarṣaṇaṃ bhavetsūryāstamanamārabhya yāvatsūryodayo bhavetprakartavyo madhupuṣpaiḥ phalaistathāraktacandanasaṃyuktairmodakaiḥ saghṛtaistilaiḥrājaputrāśca rājakīyāśca mantriṇaḥbandhamokṣāya kartavyo japo rātrau śivālayeekaviṃśatisāhasraṃ divā homaḥ śivālayehomaḥ pratyarcaṃ hi vidhānataḥpaścānmantravibhāgena pratyarcaṃ juhuyādbudhaḥprakāreṇa sarvasādhāraṇe japedevīsūktaṃ tathaiva cacecchā yatra tatprati pṛcchyatāmkalipratyayavedamantraprakāśo dvādaśaḥvedamārgeṇa kīdṛkpūjā manuśca kaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brūhi teṣāṃ pūjāvinirṇayamtu duḥkhena sarvānsampīḍayanti hicakravartisutaṃ dāsaṃ yadā te nīcasaṃsthitāḥvacaścāndrirjīvo jñānasukhe tathākheṭopāsanato martyastrikālajñaḥ prajāyatesaukhyaṃ grahaiśca saha bhuñjatedevatā tu savitā parikīrtitaḥpaśyanbhuvanasyātha mantrasya padanyāsaṃ samācaretśrīsūktokta-ṛcāṃ sthāne tato dhyāyeddivākaramsaptakhaḍgaṃ ca jātaṃ deśe kaliṅgakeraktāmbaradharaṃ raktābharaṇairupaśobhitamsakeyūraṃ maṇḍitaṃ raktacchatriṇampratyadhidaiveśvareṇāsavyayuktaṃ ca prāṅmukhamdvādaśāṃgulayukte ca śrīparṇādikapīṭhakejapenmantraṃ juhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥraktacandanamiśritaiḥmadhucchandā muniśchando gāyatryagniśca devatāviniyogastu savituḥ prītaye ceti kīrtayetratnadhātāramprītaye ceti kīrtayetagniṃ purā tanayitno savitā hiraṇyarūpamavase kṛṇudhvamyavatilaghṛtairvā madhuratrayaiḥlavaṇaṃ takraṃ divā svāpaṃ ca maithunammanau jāte nṛpāḥ syustasya kiṃkarāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cchāyāṃ paśyatyaśīrṣikāmtvṛcā pādairatha ṛktritayaiḥ svayamtrikālādyaistadā hanti duḥsādhyānapi bhāskaraḥkuśāgrāṇi tilāṃstattrayameva catāmrapātre tu kastūrīṃ keśaraṃ vidhumdṛṣṭvā sūryaṃ namaskṛtya dadyādarghyamananyadhīḥsarvaṃ bhānuvāre viśeṣataḥupakuṣṭhādayo ye ca kṛte sandhyādvayepi tesaptatidinairmaṇḍalena trisaptakaiḥca pūjayitveṣṭamāpnuyātharimāṇaṃ ca nāśayaharimāṇaṃ nidadhmasirandhayanmo ahaṃ dviṣateraghamtriṣṭubjagatyauchandasī devatā savitā mataḥhiraṇyayena savitā rathena devo yāti bhuvanāni paśyanbādhamānaḥtaviṣīndadhānaḥtasthuḥdāśuṣe vāryāṇisantuṣṭyai duṣṭo vā yasya bhāskaraḥsarvañcaikataraṃ dadyānnityaṃ bhāskarasevakaḥtu nityaṃ syāddhārayedarkamūlakamityekaṃ somo devaḥ prakīrtitaḥsaṅgatherudroktāṅgeṣu dikṣu ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuryādanyathopadravo mahānpurā kaścidbabhūva tvasurottamaḥsammukhe yātāstena tetinipīḍitāḥdivyavarṣasahasrānte devāḥ śaraṇamāgatāḥsobhyadhāvannāradena pracoditaḥmadotsikto viṣṇumāyāvimohitaḥuvāca vacanaṃ tuṣṭo vriyatāṃvriyatāmititadyuddhaṃ tvayā tu jaṭilena hituṣṭimāpannastrailokyaparameśvaraḥvacastasya śivayorbhrūpracoditaḥdeva evāparo na hidaityendrastamabhāṣatasvapratijñārthaṃ yo gacchati sa jīvatidarśayitvā dehoyaṃ vinipātyatāmmā śokaṃ bhuvo janma tavābhavatvarṇāḥ svasya bhogārthaṃ kariṣyanti navaṃ gṛhamdāsyo vināyakamukhāśca tevacassopi gartaṃ kṛtvā mahābilamnirjitāḥ devāḥ punarudgamaśaṅkayāte pūjyā gṛhavāsasukhecchayāpratimāyāṃ vā kuryādvāstoṣpate tathācānyeṣāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā prapūrayetsamatalāṃ bhūmiṃ vitastyuccāṃ ca vedikāmekāśītipadaṃ cakraṃ vaidikyastatra devatāḥāpavatsantadīśāne prāgaryamṇaṃ trikoṣṭhake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pāśapāṇiṃ dvibāhuṃ tamatrigotrasamudbhavamśvetadhvajapatākāḍhyaṃ keyūramaṇibhūṣitamvāyavyābhimukhaṃ yutamcandramarceddevadvayānvitamjapādyampūrvavatsarvamadhipratyadhidevayoḥśvetadūrvānvitaistarpyaḥ palāśasamidho hunetvā japenmantraṃ daśāṃśataḥdevatāścandraprītaye viniyojanamviśvaśambhuvamsamākhyātā niyogaścandratuṣṭayekṣīreṇārghyaṃtu śaṅkhena dadyāddevasya tuṣṭayedāntaḥ sukīrtiśca śrīmāndātā surūpavānchandastriṣṭubdevatā ca candramāḥ parikīrtitaḥvṛṣatvebhirmahitvādyumnebhidyumnyabhavonṛcakṣāḥśuciṣṭvamasi priyo na mitro dakṣāyyo aryamevāsi somajīvasettvāvataḥ sakhāāviśakaviḥnaḥsaṃgathesuśravastamaḥ sakhāvṛdhesādanyaṃ vidathyaṃ sabheyampitṛśravaṇaṃ yo dadāśadasmetvamātatanthorvantarikṣa tvaṃjyotiṣā vitamo vavarthatvā tanadīśiṣe vīryasyobhayebhyaḥ pracikitsāgamiṣṭhau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣiptvā snānañcandrasya tuṣṭayemuktāhāraṃ ca vibhave tāraṃ vā śaktito dadetphalairyuktaṃ somamūlaṃ ca dhārayetmahāpātakajānrogānsa tu nāśayituṃ kṣamaḥsamuccārya tannāśāya tato vedetṣaṣṭhyantaṃ hyṛcā kalpena coccaretśikhābandhantataḥ kṛtvā bhūtotsādanamācaretmantreṇa diśāmbandhaṃ samācaretsaśarāyāstrarājāya caturthyantaṃ sudarśanamkṛtvā prāṇasthāpanamācaretguruṃ dhyātvā nyāsaṃ kuryāttataḥ parammitro rakṣatu māntataḥvihitākaraṇātpāpādravī rakṣatu māṃ sadāsūryo rakṣatu māṃ sadāsarvabhūtebhyaḥ sarvadā māṃ ca rakṣatuniṣiddhagamanātpāpādbhānū rakṣatu māṃ sadāṛtustrīsaṅgasambhūtātpāpātpūṣābhi rakṣatumāṃ tamojātpāpataḥ sadāmukhajihvodbhavātpāpānmarīcirmāṃ sadāvatudṛksamudbhavapātakāttaddṛṣṭantatpāpātsavitāvatutvaglomasambhavātpāpādbhānurmā parirakṣatuvidveṣaṇakṛtātpāpādbhāskaro māṃ sadāvatuvinyasya prāgvaddhyāyeddivākaramgandhākṣatādipuṣpāṇi raktānyeva prayojayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praskaṇvanāmā tu cchandonuṣṭupca devatāsantarpayāmīti caivaṃ proktaṃ sitetarevadedardharcake mitraravibhyāmarghyamityapisarvatra sūryantu tarpayābhīti saṃvadettu kāryaṃ nānyatra vāsaresahasraṃ tu śītatvādimahāgadesarvanīrukprajāyatebipulāṃ lakṣmīṃ brahma prāpnotyanāmayamśrīsūryaḥ kriyayā jātaḥ pūjā tatra viśiṣyatesamabhavaccandraḥ pūjā tatra viśiṣyatedevatā ca gāyatrī chanda īritamāpāgūṃretāgūṃsi jinvatikartavyaḥ padanyāso dvitīyakaḥpūjyamānaṃ caturbāhuṃ kirīṭinamvaśiṣṭhagotrasambhūtaṃ jamadagnyarṣikaṃ kujamavantīdeśasambhūtaṃ dhyātvā devamprapūjayettatrāvāhya prapūjayetgāyatrī bhūśca devatāsaprathāḥ || apanaḥ śośucadaghamkujaprītyai japārthaṃ viniyojanamgojihvāndhārayennityaṃ bhaumavāre tu rogikaḥripavo netracchāyāgnisannibhāḥuddiṣṭaṃ devogniḥ kujatuṣṭayeharyanaḥnaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adharāṇāmabhiśriyamkratupaḥketumīmahesahaṣkṛtaḥvṛdheapāgūṃretāgūṃsi jinvatijyotīgūṃṣyarcayaḥśarmaṇigiraḥdhṛṇīmaheāhutaḥbodhinaḥihāśiṣaḥmanmabhiḥ||] || phalinībakulairyuktaṃ snānambhaumasya tuṣṭayesuraktavastramasṛjastuṣṭyai cāśvāripuṣpakambudhavāre tu jātastatra mahotsavaḥdevatāsya buddho buddhiprado mataḥpītavarṇampītagandhānulepanamdadhataṃ hastairatrigotrasamudbhavambṛhatīchandasampītacchatradhvajapatākinamyuktaṃ jñaṃ cintayāmyahamjñaṃ [budham ||] samyagāvāhya pūjayetapāmārgasamidbhiśca tarpaṇāni tataścaretmedhātithirmunistasya gāyatraṃ chanda īritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pāṃsure svāhāmunirdīrghatamāḥ proktaśchandastriṣṭubudāhṛtamvicakramāṇastredhorugāyaḥmalinaṃ dadhyādvṛddhadārujaṭāntathāpratipakṣāṇāṃ svayaṃ jetātra jāyatebṛhatītriṣṭubjagadgāyatragāni cavaḥyajñaṃ praṇayatā sakhāyaḥca śruṣṭiḥ sabharā asanno nedīya itsṛṇyaḥ pakvameyātsumnayāmudriṇaṃ vayaṃ suṣekamanu pakṣitamakṣitamdṛṃhatātammahī gauḥityanekārthadhvanimañjarīkośe ||] snapet [snapayet ||]prītaye dadyānmālatyāḥ kusumāni vāhimagorjāto budhastasyotsavotra tudevapativanditosti hi devatāpravakṣyāmi yattadasya bṛhaspateḥsauvarṇakirīṭena virājitamanuṣṭupchandasaṃ cāṅgirasagotraṃ sureḍitambrahmapratyadhidevena yutaṃ sañcitya cāhvayetharidrākṣatasaṃsiddhe maṇḍale taṃ prapūjayetkāṣṭhaiḥ syāttarpaṇaṃ pītapañcabhiḥmunirgṛtsamadastriṣṭupchanda indraśca devatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adhisañjñā gurostasya tuṣṭaye viniyojanamsudinatvamahnāmgurośceyaṃ proktā pratyadhidevatāsandhārayedbāhau brahmamūlaṃ tu dhārayetrājamānaṃ svaśaktyā vārthabodhanamityuktaṃ devatātra bṛhaspatiḥyo vīravaḥ kṛṇoti brahmaṇe rājā tamavanti devāḥmālatīpuṣpayuktāśca snānena gurutoṣaṇampradeyaṃ syādabhāve caṇakāstathāgururjātastatra kāryastadutsavaḥnigaditaṃ daityācāryastu daivatamhi māyā avasi svadhā vo bhadrā te pūṣanniha rāti rastiśuklavarṇaṃ śuklagandhānulepanamdaṇḍinaṃ ca sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍalumśvetacchatradhvajapatākinaṃ bhārgavagotrajamśvetavarṇe pañcakoṇe navāṃguledaityaguruṃ maṇḍale pūjayettataḥkāṣṭhaiśca tarpaṇādi tu candravatdevatā proktā niyogaḥ śukratuṣṭayena jarasā marate patirviśvasmādindra uttaraḥniyogosya viśvataḥ śukratuṣṭayenāmbarandadhyānmunimūlaṃ [agastyamūlam ||] ca dhārayetyātrāsiddhiḥ prakāśaśca cāntarbhūpatayo vaśāḥtriṣṭubjagatyaśchandāṃsi pūṣā daivatamucyateīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tābhirvāpi ityā sūryāsya kāmena kṛtaśrava icchayāmaḥyo devāso adaduḥ sūryāyai kāmanakṛtantavasasya camebhiryuktairjalaiḥ snāyādbhārgavasya tu tuṣṭayeghṛtandadyācchukratuṣṭyai tadabhāve tu taṇḍulānpunarvasau śukre maghāyāmetadantaramityuktaṃ devatā tu śanaiścaraḥnaḥvaradaṃ gṛdhravāhanamgāyatrīchandasaṃ devaṃ kṛṣṇābharaṇabhūṣitamyuktaṃ dhyātvā samarcayetkṛṣṇapuṣpaiścandanantu kālīyairaguruṃ hunetmantramatra tu kīrtayetgacchatyagnidūto araṃ kṛtaḥphūtkāramātreṇa vinaśyantyakhilā gadāḥpratiṣṭhā vānuṣṭupa caiva samīritāḥ[navānāmṛcām ||] japataḥ pāpaṃ kāmajātaṃ vinaśyatinaḥśaṃyorabhisravantu naḥbheṣajamviśvaśambhuvamyadvāśeṣa utānṛtammāsaṃ sṛja varcasāśanerdadyādaśaktastu lohaṃ vā maraṭānapiityuktaṃ saiṃhikeyastu devatāśaciṣṭhayā vṛtā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: khaḍgacarmaśūlabṛhaddharamkṛṣṇapūṣpaiḥ pūjyamānaṅkeyūramukuṭānvitampāṭalīgotrasaṃbhūtamanuṣṭupchandasaṃgrahamsarpādhidevatāyuktaṃ kālapratyadhidaivatamdvādaśāṃgulavistīrṇe pūjayecchyāmalākṣataiḥdravyaiḥ kaulikāṃstarpayeddvijāndevatāḥ proktā niyogo rāhutuṣṭayeprayantsvaḥbhavetkālo niyogo rāhutuṣṭayeyadīṣṭatṛṣṇayā sahanindennindyakarmasthānvaṃdīmokṣaṇamācaretsādhakājñāṃ tu sadaiva samare jayaḥgāyatrī devatā devanāyakaḥvṛtānayudbhiścarṣaṇīnāmkariṣyataḥabhīṣṭayaḥasmānviśvābhirūtibhiḥnavāmirindrotibhiḥgavyurapurīyatodyāmivoparivacāguḍūcītagaraiḥ snānaṃ pātracatuṣṭayejanayāmāsa tasmiṃstaṃ viśeṣeṇārcayenmudeproktā gāyatraṃ chanda īritamsamuṣadbhirajāyathāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhūmrākṣabāhavaḥ pāśadharāśca vikṛtānanācitrāmbarāścitravarṇāścitragandhānulepanāḥcitraguptākhyapratyadhidevatāśceti cintayetcitravarṇākṣataiḥ puṣpaistatrāvāhya samarcayetmadhuratrayasaṃyuktaiścitradravyaiḥ prapūjayetketuprītaye viniyojanamcitraguptotra niyogaḥ ketutuṣṭayeadhvarāṁ upa ye tvā gṛṇanti vahnayaḥnāśnīyāddagdhamannādi ketusevanatatparaḥbhavedgupto dṛśyo na sādhakottamaḥcandramarutau gāyatraṃ chanda ucyatekāmyaiḥvārajasaḥetadyuktajalasnānātprasīdati sadā śikhīketutuṣṭyai tu dadyādvā rājamāṣakānkāryaḥ ketūnāntu mahotsavaḥteṣāṃ siddhiḥ karatale sthitāvacmi tadbruvantviha devatāḥnavagrahakathanaprakārastrayodaśaḥmantraścedato duḥkhamavāpyateparatrāpi yena saṃlabhyate sukhamśiṣyāssukhepsavo'bhaktā hyato na kvāpi siddhayaḥsampravakṣyāmi sarvatantreṣu gopitammantratyāgavidhiṃ vakṣye yena sañjāyate sukhamprātastasya gṛhaṃ gatvā svīyaṃ duḥkhaṃ nivedayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ramyabhavane kumbhaṃ dīkṣāvidhānataḥvilomaṃtantramantreṇa tatrāvāhyeṣṭadevatāmmantrī samabhyarcyeṣṭadevatāmvāpi tataḥ santarpayedamumyavānnaiścāpi dugdhānnairdigvidikṣvadha ūrdhvataḥgṛhāṇemaṃ puṣpadhūpādikaṃ balimbalimenaṃ prayojitamgṛhāṇemaṃ suprīto varadobhavabalipūjādi mayā bhaktyā niveditampūjāṃ gṛhītvā sukhamāpnuhividhivadgṛhāṇa balimādarātprītau bhavatāṃ varadau mamapuṣpadhūpādyaiḥ prītobhava vibhūtayesarvaviprāgrya jagatkarte namostu tebhaktyā bhava tvaṃ sukhado mamaviparītena puṣpadhūpopacārakaiḥanukalpādinālocya mayā taralabuddhināmestu bhūyācchreyaḥ sanātanammaṃtreśaṃ maṃtraṃ yaṃtre vilomataḥbhaktyā paramayā yutaḥmantrapūtaiḥ punaścānyaṃ kumbhaṃ toyaiḥ prapūrayetnimnagāyāṃ ca śuddhe vānyajalāśayekṛtavidhānasya durlabhasya manorujaḥjāyate'tīvasampannā vardhate tatkulaṃ sadādṛśaḥ pātādbhūtapretādhidevatāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nair-ṛtyadigbhāge mitraṃ paścimagaṃ triṣucaiśānyāmīśaṃ koṇācca davatoḥkramādete pañca devā jñātavyāḥ savyamārgataḥvātaḥ pūṣā sāvitra eva cagṛharakṣayamau tathājayamṛgau pitṛdauvārikau tathāvaruṇāsuraśeṣāśca vāyavye īśatastvahiḥbhallāṭasomau ca bhujaṅgaścāditistathātāntrikamārge tu catuṣṣaṣṭipade tathātatpūrvāttatra koṣṭhe dvikedvikesavitā śakra indrajidrudratajjayaucāryamaṇaṃ jambhakaṃ pilipicchakamparjanyo jayantaḥ śakrabhāskaraupūṣā ca vitatho yamotha gṛharakṣakaḥnir-ṛtiścātha dauvārikaśca sugrīvakastathāvāyurnāgamukhyāstataḥ paramraktavarṇaṃ diśaḥ pītairvidiksitaiḥparidhiḥ kāryaḥ sundaraṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhavetaṣṭottaraśataṃcāṣṭottaraviṃśatimeva cakurvīta pāyasairvyañjanānvitaiḥvyādhirbhūtapretādibhīrna cakhyātaściraṃjīvati tadgṛhetu proktasiddhyai sudeśikaḥbhairavakṣetrapālānāṃ yoginīnāṃ viśeṣataḥvāmena jāyantetibubhukṣitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puṣṭiṃ samṛddhiṃ ca sādhakāya prayacchatiśuddhavākchuddho manasā tathādambhāhaṅkāramohādivikalo jñānavittamaḥmaṃtrarājamimaṃ labdhvā jāyate sa ca bhūpatiḥproktaśchandonuṣṭupprakīrtitamtvabhīṣṭeṣu tathāvidhaḥsaṃśodhya pañcagavyena vai punaḥtataḥ siddhaṃ mantraṃ kāryeṣu yojayetmaṃtrarājaḥbrāhmaṇe maṃtro viparītaphalo bhavetprakurvīta tadvidhānaṃ nigadyateśakvarī proktā śāntyarthaṃ viniyojanamdaivī svastirastu naḥdvipade śaṃ catuṣpadevātaye manaḥgāyatryaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā karma samācaretmantrāṇāṃ bījamoṃśaktiratra hrīmdevatā cāsya niyogobhīṣṭasiddhayepratyakkartāramṛcchatuhrīṃbījāntaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni mantrasya tu samācaretnābhāvūrvorjānunośca padāni padayornyasetdhyāyetsiṃhamukhīṃ muktakeśāṃ digambarāmgrasantīmahitānnudratejasā dhyānamīritamapāmārgasamidbhistu homo havyaghṛtādibhiḥlokapālāstadastrāṇi pūjayeditthamarcanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dikṣu daśamantrairbaliṃharetrājānte bhañjayatvitipaścānmārayatvityato balimsvastyayanaṃ cāstu balimantra udāhṛtaḥbaliṃ haret] dipadaṃ vadetmantrāḥ syustattaddikṣu baliṃ haretp. 334) evaṃ kṛte śatrukṛtā kṛtyā kṣipraṃ vinaśyatidevatā cāsya niyogo ripunigraheprāhiṇodihādya tvaṃ nityaṃ yojaya svastibhiḥprāgvanniyogorinivartanesyāmyatso anāgasaḥkālāgnirudrotra niyogorivināśaneprajāśca puruṣādiniyātudhānyobhicāranāśe niyojanamkṛtyānāśāya sarvāstu yātudhānyaḥpañcarcakaṃ sūktaṃ śuklāṣṭamyāṃ samācaretānayeddaṇḍamekaṃtu puruṣasya pramāṇataḥjapettadārātirdahyate sa mahāgrahaiḥaṣṭaprādeśamātrantu daṇḍaṃ baibhītakaṃ samammahāvyādhigṛhītosau mriyate nātra saṃśayaḥhunetsaptarātramaṣṭottaraṃ śatamprakurvītaripurmṛtyumavāpnuyātnāmavarṇānmantreṇa garbhitānnikhatettatkṣaṇādeva jvaraḥ satroḥ prajāyatedadyādgobhūhiraṇyādi yathā śaktyeti tadvidhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devatā cāsya niyogo ripunigrahepaśūṃścaivāsya nāśaya vīryaṃ cāsya nibarhayadevatā proktā niyogo riputakṣaṇeparāvṛtya tanuṃ kṛndhi yathā tarumdevatā prokto niyogorinikartanerakṣohā coja ekapātdevatā proktā niyogorinikṛṃtanevaśiṣṭhaśca tathaiva nāyasedhi māmdevatā proktā niyogorinikartanetantracchatagate jananajñāstejano yataḥkapilākṣīramanuvākaṃ tryahaṃ japetvijñeyāḥ kāmakrodhādayorayaḥhunedaṣṭasahasraṃ tu brahmavarcasavānbhavetdugdhāktāścāṣṭa śatakaṃ saptabhirdivasairgrahāḥpippalasya samidbhiryaśa āpnuyātrāśiṃ dhyātvāyaṃnāma cetasābhasmāhorātraṃ mantritaṃ goṣṭhake kṣipetpaurṇamāsyāmupoṣyātha rajanyāmaṃgulīyakamsa syādājñayā vibhavena catilānbhāraśataṃ dadyāddakṣiṇāṃ tesya pāṭhinecaiva viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥviddhvāgniṃ tanumṛccha svahetināniyogastu vivādādau jayāya casarasvatītyavakṛtyamacchiṣastasya kiñcanavivādādau jayāya ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vā tasya hṛdyasṛk pibadussādhyakāryasiddhyarthaṃ viniyogosya kīrtitaḥvyaneccāvyanahīnastaharasāśaniḥkṛtyāmārgasthacaurādināśe tu viniyojanamtairdevirātryāḥ kṛtye no gamayemānnikṛntayaśuklapakṣapradipadamārabhya pratyahaṃ japetbhakṣayetkapilākṣīraṃ haviṣyaudanameva casamarthodarśanādeva bhavedbhūtasya kā kathāskandagrahabrahmarakṣopasmārādigadāṃstathāsarvopadravaśāntiḥ syādbhavane sādhakasya tusarvavyādhivināśaḥ syācchivameva dinedinesarvarogāṇāṃ tvaritaṃ śāntikaṃ smṛtamcāṣṭottaraśataṃ māsaṃ tatsarvaduḥkhahṛtsvarṇāṃgulīyādi dakṣiṇā mantrapāṭhinedevognirviniyogastu sarvaśatrunikarttanevrajāsmābhiḥ kartuṃ tvaṣṭapadīgṛhānniyogastu jarābhavatu śatravevakṣyāmi taṃ pratyasmatvamṛtyaveniyogastu śatruvidveṣaṇe mataḥbrahmācapakuddhaśayāśarvatatkandhaspatimuddiṣṭaṃ niyogoripalāyanetvasindhayiṣṭāya dāvitsarpa tākṣiraḥgatvā japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatamaṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyākāṃdadyāttadvatpunarjapetbibhītadaṇḍamādhāya caikaprādeśasammitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ripukulaṃ jñātājñāvinaśyatiprajapecchatrurjvareṇa paripīḍyateputrakalatrāśvagajatādyaṃ vinayaśyatidevabhaktānāṃ jātu kuryānna vipriyamuddiṣṭaṃ niyogosyārināśanetiṣṭhati kṛtye vṛko vā vimato gṛhātcāsya niyogo'ripalāyaneśatrūnevābhinojñehi divyāvṛkṣamivāśaniḥgajā'jaturagādīnāṃ niyogo ripumohanepaścādbhara uttarato gṛheniyogastu ripūṇāṃ trāsanāya camṛgoriḥ prāṃtatvāni kartumarhatisamārabhya yāvacchuklāṣṭamī bhavetkṛtyādīnhayānāṃ hastināmapijapennaśyedaristasya rakṣitopīśvareṇa cetviṃśaddināvadhi tathā ripoḥkartavyā rudranyāsāvadhānataḥpurādīnāṃ niyogosya bhavettathāpratigṛhṇasva pramādāya hi cādbhutamrājādeḥ kopaśāntyai niyojanamrudraśca tvaṣṭā caiva prajāpatiḥniyogastu tvaritaṃ roganāśaneahorātrāstathābdāśca diśaḥ pratidiśaśca mepaśūṃścaiva cotpādayasi cādbhutamkasyāpi rakṣaṇārthamudāhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puruṣosomapasyapūrvakarmasamudbhūtamādhivyādhibhayaṃ haretjapansatatañjanturnāribhiḥ paribhūyatemohanāśāya niyogosya prakīrtitaḥkṛtyānāṃ śatruhanyāya cetasaḥchandonuṣṭubniyogosya durvadhyārivināśanevayaṃ tasya nikupnaḥ sthātujaṅgamamchandonuṣṭubniyogastu cāsya śatruvināśanepratikṛtsyāmividravaḥchandonuṣṭubniyogastu tapovighnakarāśca yelobhālasyādayo vātha dṛśyante ye tapopahāḥtapovighnakarāḥ pāṭhe svāyudhāśśamidaṃ paṭhettaistairnikapalā pāpinojīvayasyarīnpāpasya nāśāya viniyojanamjānasyānmanave kṣipraveśinaujapetpūjayedrudraṃ tasya śatrukṣayo bhavetsahasrantu japanvyādhiṃ nibarhayetsūryasyābhimukhamaṣṭāviṃśatisaṅkhyayāmananābhyāsādvidvattā sūpapadyatechandonuṣṭubniyogastu sudurlabhaprasādhanetvadanu yo mataturyāyaśritaḥuddiṣṭaṃ niyogaḥ pāpakartanegatvā pāpadhīneva no na hiniyogastu śatrūṇāṃ śoṣaṇe mataḥsa yo me pāpaṃ cikīrṣati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtābhicārādau yāmaṃyāmaṃ paṭhedidamyo me pāpaṃ cikīrṣatitathā yogo durgasthāne sukhāya casarvaṃ dhunvantu brahmavarma mamācaramhunedaṣṭottaraśataṃ ghṛtāktatilataṇḍulānhuneddevyāmṛtamaṣṭottaraṃ śatamcittaśāntiḥ prajāyatebrahmatejomayastasya bhāti dehotibhāsvaraḥvṛtāktairaṣṭasāhasraṃ hutvā pātakanāśanamvarṣamadhye prajāyatevaidikāṃśca manurvedamayo yataḥuktaḥ sarvatantreṣu gopitaḥpravakṣyāmi sarvatantreṣu gopitamtataḥ kuryāddevatyāgādipūrvakamvā samakṣaṃ vā guroḥ samprārthayetsuramdvibhujādidehī dhyātoparādhaśatakaṃ mama tatkṣamasvabhagavankṣamasvakṣamasva karuṇākara dīnabandhosiddhirjapānna ca bahiṣkṛtapūjanādyaiḥmantramūrtyādikaṃ sarvaṃ gurave tatsamarpayetdviguṇitaṃ sarvatrāpi ca taddinātdevatātyāgo mayā tubhyaṃ niveditaḥpratyaṅgirāmantrakathanaprakāśaścaturdaśaḥyantrāṇiśrotumicchāmi vāñchitārthapradāni tusmṛtirgatirnṛpāṇāṃ ca purāṇāni viśāntathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarveṣāmupari tṛṣṇā tena duḥkhaṃ prajāyatevedakarmavihīnastu vijñeyo brahmarākṣasaḥvaśīkṛtyasusevetāniśamadhyāyatatparaḥvaidikairmantrairnānyasya tu kadācanakuryāddhrīṃkāraṃ karṇikāsthitamtadagreṣu gāyatryarṇāṃstriśastriśaḥkakārādyāṃstathomāpojyotīrasomṛtaṃ brahmavā kṛtvā haste tu bandhayetsarasvatyā mahādbhutammadhye koṇaṣaṭke vāgbhavaṃ bījamālikhetmendro medhayā spṛṇotu amṛtasya devadhāraṇo bhūyāsammantravarṇānvā bahirvṛtracatuṣṭayambahirvṛtraṃ mātṛkārṇaiḥ prapūrayetkāmamākūtiṃ vācaḥ satyamasīmahisaṃyunaktiaiṃklīṃsauṃhrīṃ ca bījāni paṭasvarṇādinirmiteśrutidhārā ca nīrogaśca priyaṃvadaḥsarvajñastvabhyāso bhavati dhruvamālikhyāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tāraṃ tatkarṇikāntarekeśareṣu galeṣu tryambakākṣarānvakṣyamāṇāmṛcaṃ sādhyo nāmavarṇavibhūṣitāmmunirgṛtsamadastriṣṭupchando rudrastu devatāśṛṇomietattraiyambakaṃ yantraṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥāyurārogyasaubhāgyadharmārthasukhamokṣadam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: || labhate nātra sandeho yantrasyāsya prabhāvatahmadhyamakoṣṭhe tu sasādhyaṃ hrīṃ samālikhetmāsāṣṭakena hutvā tu siddhirbhavati bhūyasīcittaśāntiḥ prajāyate|| brahmatejomayastasya bhāti dehoti bhāsvaraḥghṛtāktairaṣṭasāhasrahomātpātakanāśanamvarṣamadhye prajāyatejapettadā tasya gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ bhavetsarvagrahakṛtā doṣā na taṃ pīḍayituṃ kṣamāḥkuṃkumendusamāyuktaṃ candanaṃ sthāpayetpuraḥvinaśyettu grahopagrahadūṣaṇampatimāpnoti kanyārthyāpnoti kanyakāmtadā mahāvṛṣṭirnagairdinaiḥhavanaṃ kāryamevaṃ sarvasukhāptayechandastvanuṣṭupsyānmuniḥ pratyāṅgirā mataḥnakhenaiva raṃjane dantadhāvanesphoṭaya padameṣāṃ kulājalibhūnnaivasyamasyadanaṃ paramasyakṣamabhisaṃdasvaśanaiścaradine cāyurārogyaiśvaryamāpnuyātprakartavyo mantrāṇāmiti nirṇayaḥmahādevi mamaśatrurvinaśyatuṣaḍaṅgānyaṃgulinyāsaṃ vakṣye nāmānyanukramātśikhāyāṃ ca mahābhairavi varmaṇisarvaparonmuktamantracchedinyathāstrake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvāṃśca mātṛkānyāsānpūrvameva samācaretvedaṃ punargāyatrikāṃ paṭhetpārayānavya iti mantraḥ |] pārayeti cadurjuhoti || gāyatrīpūrvakaṃ mūlaṃ yajanājinamityṛcamkāmanāyā vicārya cavidhau kāmaḥ siddhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥpañcarcabhiśca pañcāṅgaṃ pañcamyā punarastrakamsopi bādhyate madanādikaiḥjapatastasya śatrunāśosti tatra caśatrūṃstriśūlena kupyasva piba śoṇitamsamastaroganāśārthe niyogo nandivṛddhayebhayaṃ krodhaṃ viṣaṃ nāśaya nokṣarepūrvatatkuryādaṃgulyādiṣaḍaṅgakamgāyatryādimataistattu prāgvatsaṃdarbhitaṃ matamkāryasiddhiḥ puṇyā girāṃ tviyamtasmāttaṃ parivarjayetsyāttithau tasyāṃ bhavedbhuvikaromīti naraṃ vā devameva caguruṃ tatra pūrvābhāve paraṃ parammantrāvaraṇadevāśca jātidevaḥ kuleśvaraḥpūjayitvā praṇameddaṇḍavatkṣitaupalāśasya prāgre muṣṭestu dakṣiṇeghaṭaṃ prācyāṃ dugdhapūrṇantu paścimevedikāṃ kārayetsudhīḥdevīmāvāhya sampūjya havanaṃ caret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madyamāṃsapramattāste prāktanena pracoditāḥtāsāṃ prātastu nikaṭe yataḥsyātka japaḥ kva ca devatāḥyaḥ sa siddho'nyastu pātakībahunoktena sarvanāśastu vāmataḥśāntiṃ vidhāyaivaṃ sadasajjñānahetavebījāropaṇakarmedaṃ kartavyaṃ sarvakāmadamkuryāddakṣaḥ prāgvaruṇāyanamgomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau dakṣe'tha vāmakepañcakarā dīrghāḥ kāryāśca pañca cacatvāriṃśatkoṣṭhakāssyuścaturviṃśatikoṣṭhakaiḥpaścātkoṣṭhacatuṣkaṃ yadbrahmasthānaṃ tadīritamkṛṣṇaiśca rajobhissṛṣṭimārgataḥtadagre tu jñeyaṃ koṣṭhacatuṣṭayamḍamarukākārāścatasro viṣṇudevatāḥviṣṇusthānasya catuṣkoṣṭhe niveśayetāyāmocchrāyadīrghākhyairyuktāḥ paścānniveśayetśarāvāścatvāro bhānvaṅgulasamucchrayāḥśālipuñjeṣu gandhādidarbhakūrcāyaneṣu canādaiśca pañcabhirbrāhmaṇāśiṣāprajapenmaṃtrī dugdhena kṣālayetpunaḥmudgāḍhakyastuniṣpāvā khalvā māṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥpañcavādyabrahmaghoṣapurassaramsaṃdhyayoruyoścaiva rātrau cāpi baliṃ haretdadyāttattadyuddiśya daivatam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paścāttadyantraṃ nikhanedbhuvinakṣatragraharāśīnāṃ lokeśānāṃ baliṃ haretvidhinā nātra saṃśayaḥkartavyamanyathā duḥkhadaṃ bhavetsamuddiṣṭāsteṣāṃ yantraṃ vadāmyahamprādakṣiṇyena tadbāhye vṛttayugmāntare likhetbhuvicāstramidaṃ yantraṃ bhūtaroganivāraṇamdhārayedbāhumūle ca kaṇṭhe vā mastakepi vāsarvārthadaṃ tatra padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhetśivapañcākṣarasya tujātavedasamantrasya pūrvārdhantu dvitīyakeṭhaṃ caṃ kaṃ samiti hyauṃ yaṃ maṃ tataḥ pacamyeti saṃ kaṇṭhaṃ tāro māyā dhruvastathātryambakasyottarārdhantu pañcamethottarārdhakamlekhyamomāpojyotirityapilikhedaṣṭamapatre tu bahirvṛttadvayaṃ likhetkoṇeṣu kūṭaṃ cintāmaṇiṃ likhettataḥ paraṃ candraiḥ kūṭaṃ cintāmaṇermahatśatākṣaramanoryantraṃ bhavedīdṛśameva calakṣmīṃ sa jīveccharadāṃ śatamghṛtena tāvattu kṛtvā sampātameva cayantrametattu gosatyārogyapuṣṭidaṃrakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ vairivyāghrādibhītitaḥsasādhyaṃ praṇavaṃ likhetcāsya koṇaṣaṭke likhenmanoḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhruvaṃ dattvā svavarṇānpañca saṃlikhetvismṛtyāśaṃ caturthe tu likhedvaruṇamumoca tatsaptame tu ante svastibhiḥ sadā naḥṛṇamocanametattu yantraṃ sarvasamṛddhidamkimatrabahunoktena vāñchitārthapradaṃ nṛṇāmsādhyagarbhaṃ tāraṃ patreṣu cāṣṭasuabhisūryātha ṣaṣṭhakevṛttadvayaṃ kṛtvā mātṛkārṇāṃstadantaresuvarṇaratnadhānyādisarvasampatkaraṃ paramcaitattathā vāgvibhavapradamviṣṇugṛhiṇī bhaktānāṃ tu viśiṣyateprāgdakṣiṇena likheddalacatuṣṭayeabhīṣṭasiddhaye cāsya mantrasya viniyojanamevendrāgnītyṛcaḥ pādā lekhyāstatra vidikṣu catriṣṭupchandaścandro munirmataḥsometi-ṛco varṇāconpañcāṅgābdhiśarartavaḥlikhedvarṇānvedapañcasaptasaptagavendraṣaṭhiraṇyagarbhakastriṣṭummunyādyāstadagrimetavapraṇīti pitaro na indro devodyarannamabhajanta dhīrāḥyaktāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāmapatayo rayīṇāmsabindukāstasya veṣṭanākāratāṃ gatāḥbāhumūletha vā kaṇṭhe mūrdhni vā yadi dhārayetputrapautrādiśālinīṃ santatiṃ tadāṣaṭkoṇamadhye sādhyasya nāmayukpraṇavaṃ likhetvilikheddvandvaśaśca svarānkramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viśvāvasurdevī sadā no juṣatāṃ gṛhekṛtvā tayorantaśca veṣṭayetakārādikṣakārāntavarṇairmadhyaṃ praveṣṭayetśrīyaścaitatpriyaṃ yantraṃ sthāpitaṃ yatra mandiresatataṃ caiva tatraiva ramate ramāṣaṭkoṇamadhye praṇavaṃ sādhyanāmābhigarbhitamklīṃ aimatha tadbhāye likhedaṣṭadalaṃ punaḥmunirdevatā vātriṣṭupchandaḥ prakīrtitamṛṣirdīrghatamāstriṣṭupchando vāṇī ca devatāmunistriṣṭupchando vāgdevatā matāāsūryasya duhitā tatāśravo deveṣvamṛtamarjjayāprāgvanmunyādisarvāsāṃ niyogo vāstusiddhyekoṇeṣu vāgbhavaṃ bījamālikhetsamāvāhya pūjayitvā vidhānataḥtārkikāṇāṃ ca cakravartī bhavedasaudyusarillolakallolanibhā niryāti bhāratīpadmasya karṇikāyāntu saṃllikhetpūrvādi sukoṇeṣu aṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ krameṇa caśrīvidyāprathamaṃ kūṭaṃ ka-e-īla ca hrīmitidvitīyantu likhetkūṭaṃ tṛtīyakeproktaṃ likhetṣaṣṭhadale punaḥtataścāṣṭamapatraketadbahirvṛtrayorantarveṣṭayenmātṛkākṣaraiḥlikheddhemapaṭādau ca hemasūcyā vaśaṅkaramkamale karṇikāyāñca ṣaḍdalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīṃhrīṃklīṃglaugañca tataḥ pūrvadale likhetmebdhau vaśamānaya svāhāsaṃvādasūktasya tadidānīṃ nigadyatesamidhyasamano vasūnyā bhavabhāgaṃ yathā pūrve śannānānā upāsatesahavitameṣāṃ samanimātraṃ abhimantraye vaḥhṛdayāni vaḥ samāni vastu vo mano yathāvatsusahā satiagnirdevastathājāyasañjñānamitarāsu cajātavedase sunavetyṛcā punaḥtadbahirbhūpuraṃ kṛtvā tatra pādacatuṣṭayamkoṇeṣu ca vikoṇeṣu likhedyacca taducyaterājeti || śannobhavadvipade śañcatuṣpadevaśyaṃ kāntisaubhāgyapuṣṭidammadhye tatra koṇeṣu saṁllikhettanmadhye sādhyaṃ sādhakakarmayuksudhīḥbahiścāpi likhetpārśvadvaye punaḥbinduyutaṃ likhedatha likhetpunaḥśṛṅkhalākārarekhābhirekaikenāntarāṇi cavṛttadvayaṃ likhettatra vīthyā lekhyaṃ vilomataḥtadbāhye kuryādvīthīcatuṣṭayamdvitīyāyāṃ vilomena kuryādbāhyeṣṭakoṇakamtriśūlāni kuryātṣoḍaśasaṃkhyayāsarvasaubhāgyajananaṃ sarvaśatruvināśakṛtkartavyā pūjā yantrasya siddhaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vaidikena sulekhyaṃ kuṃkumādibhiḥādyāyāṃ tu ṣaḍaṅgāni parasyāṃ dikcatuṣṭayamtṛtīyavīthyāṃ brāhmādyāḥ pūjanīyā digaṣṭakevikarālīṃ ca dhūmāṃ sarasvatīṃ śriyammedhāṃ matiṃ kāntiṃ cāryāṃ tasya bahiḥ punaḥvidyāhrīpuṣṭayaḥ prajñā sinīvālī tathā kuhūḥkālarātrirbhadrakālī mahārātriḥ kapālinīniśumbhaśumbhamathanī mahiṣāsuramardinīdvātriṃśacchaktayastvimāḥviśālākṣīṃ samṛddhiṃ vṛddhimeva catrilokadhātrīṃ gāyatrīṃ sāvitrīṃ tridaśeśvarīmśyāmalāṃ paścādaruṇīmāruṇīṃ tathāprakṛtiṃ vikṛtiṃ sṛṣṭiṃ sthitiṃ saṃhṛtimeva cadevamātṛbhagavatyau devakīṃ kamalāsanāmcārdhamukhikāṃ bahuśiśnāṃ kṛśodarīmpātālavegāṃ ca madanāturāmviśvarūpāṃ daityabhayaṅkarāmcāpi viśveśīṃ tadbāhye ca digīśvarānkāmamāpnoti tāntrikopyanayejyayācāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ likheddhruvamkramāddaleṣu sulikhettāraṃhrīmī tathaiva cakṛtvā pūrvavīthyāṃ samālikhetca daurgaṃ yantramidaṃ smṛtamstrīṇāṃ putradaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥkṛtvāṣṭapatraṃ kamalaṃ śrīṃ bījaṃ kamalāntare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kardametyādipañcarcāmarddhamarddhaṃ daśa tvathamantrasya dvayoḥ syādardhamardhakamṛcā cādyā mātṛkārṇaiśca tatparāpañcadaśarcaṃ ca śrīkāmaḥ satataṃ japetkoṇacatuṣkeṣu śriyo mantraṃ tu vaidikamlakṣmīṃ jīvecca śaradāṃ śatamaṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyākaṃ hutvā sampātasecitamparivārayutāṃ lakṣmīṃ balidānena toṣayetsaukhyaṃ tvasaṃkhyantatra jāyateṣaṭkoṇakarṇikāmadhye tāraṃ sādhyasamanvitamsvāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena likhettatraiva sandhiṣusucakrāya ghīcakrāya caturthakaḥcaturdalaṃ tu kamalaṃ tadbahiṣkeśareṣu cavāsudevasya mantrasya trīṇitrīṇyakṣarāṇi cavāsudevāyetyaṇurdvādaśākṣaraḥekaikamakṣaraṃ tāro namo nārāyaṇāya cajayalakṣmīti priyāya nityamuditamnamo mantrassyānnṛsiṃhasya radākṣaraḥbhagavate mahāsudarśanāya capuruṣasūktasya bahirvṛttadvayaṃ caretsaṃbadhyate]puṇyaṃ putrāyuṣkāntikīrtidamjaptvā tvṛtusnātāṃ tu bhojayetsannipātikephiraṅgaśītalādyeṣu lekhanātsukhamāpnuyāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sūktasya yantraṃ sarvārthasiddhidampraṇavaṃ lekhyaṃ stasminhuṃ bījamālikhetcakramantrasya cākṣaramvarṇāṃllikhedaṣṭadale punaḥtrayatriṃśadvarṇakoyaṃ varāhasya manuḥ smṛtaḥṛcastā atra vakṣyāmi sāvadhānatayā śṛṇuyoṣayitnavā sano mūlatīdṛśekṣetrasya patirmadhumānno asya ripyaṃ attvenaṃ caremavaratrā vadhyantāṃ śunamaṣṭrāmudiṅgayāyamaste na māmupasiñcatamyathā na suphalāsasiduhāmuttarāṃ samāmśunamasmāsu dhattampulastyarṣiranuṣṭup ca triṣṭupchandosti sūktakeglauṃbījenādyavīthyāṃ tu veṣṭayenmātṛkārṇakaiḥhuṃbījaṃ yantrametacchubhe dinebhavane dvāre kṣetre vā nagarepi vāgajāśvadhenumahiṣavṛṣoṣṭrāśvatarādibhiḥvibhavairanyaiśca syātsamāgamaḥsulikhetkāmabījaṃ sādhyasamanvitamlikhitvāgre kuryātpadmaṃ caturdalamvāsudevamanovarṇā dale lekhyāstrayastrayaḥgopījanavallabhāya svāhā mantraṃ daśākṣaramramātha gopāla tato viṣadharāya caṣoḍaśadalaṃ kṛtvā tatra likhetsvarān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratidalaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ yathā bhavetnidadhāti devayamsabhāsumāvastena īśatamāghaśaṃsaḥ pāravohaṃtīsavṛjyāḥsyupendra tava vīryeakārāntāṃstadbahiśca bhūpuraṃ samyagālikhetgopālayantrametaddhi vidhinā sthāpitaṃ gṛhebahurūpāśca viśālāśca bhavanti histhirā bhūtvā nivasetsatataṃ tadāmadhyeṣṭadalapadmasya sasādhyaṃ praṇavaṃ likhetbahiṣkṛtya tadvīthyāṃ mātṛveṣṭanamgośvādivṛṣaiḥ pūrṇaṃ sadā bhavetsulikhetsādhyaṃ sapraṇavaṃ tataḥkamalaṃ tadbahiḥ keśareṣu caudyannadya ṛcaḥ pādā lekhyāstadbāhyato likhetsūryastathāditya idamekaikamakṣaramtadbāhye vīthyāṃ mātṛpraveṣṭanametadyantraṃ tu sūryasya nāśayetsakalāngrahānetadgomayaliptāyāṃ likhedāraktacandanaiḥviśiṣṭārghyaṃ prakalpyāsmai pradīyatetāmrapātre likhitvā sthāpitaṃ gṛhevismṛtiṃ ca rogāṃścaivābhicārikānprajapedudyannadyamiti tryṛcamlikhedyantraṃ navīne navanītakamrogaśāntiḥ syātsatyametanna saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samastarogāṇāṃ nāśanaṃ sūryavallabhambahistasya trikoṇaṃ tu mantrāgāreti saṃlikhettatra likhetpañcākṣarāṇi tuhuṃphaḍiti aṣṭakoṇe tato likhetlikhecśrīhrīṃmiti bījadvayaṃ punaḥputrajananaṃ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyadāyakamvidhinā dhṛte haste phalapradammayā proktaṃ sāramātharvaṇasya cabhaviṣyanti sarve kāmārthasādhakāḥsamayācāravibhraṣṭā vikṣiptāste ca nirdhanāḥdevāyantraṃ tu prakaṭīkṛtamghrāṇādikaṃ caturbhiśca indriyaistasya madhyagamkartavyamagrayoḥ śūlakadvayamhastābhidhaḥ prokto madhyaṃ kuryācca śūlavatpīṭhikāyuktau pādayostatsthale nyasetdakṣabāhāvūrdhvamaṣṭadalaṃ likhetvāmabāhūpariṣṭācca homo ityakṣaradvayamkāryā hṛdasthānaṃ tiryagūrdhvaṃ tu saṃ sadāvibhāgeṣu alīyaṃ prathamā bhavetcaturthantu vihakastattu pañcakamityaṣṭamañca nastaraṃ na tathāntimamūrdhvapaṃktau kramāllekhyaṃ ṣaṭkatrādvitayaṃ tathāpeśyābahirmama hṛdapeśyadhastāttu dakṣiṇelekhyaṃ masyā tannīlakarpaṭeādityavāsare sāyaṃ gomayenopalepayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatkarṇikāyāṃ prathamaṃ pūjayecca gaṇādhipampatreṣvindrādikānarcetkarṇikāyāṃ tu dīpikāmkuḍavonmānaṃ tilānāṃ tatra tiṣṭhatidīpikādi sāyaṃ tatropaveśayetdīpādhiṣṭhātṛdevasya tuṣṭyai sāvaraṇasya caprajvaleddīpaḥ paśyettāvadatandritaḥkāryaṃ śāntirbhavati niścitamkartavyaṃ rogī sukhamavāpnuyātmahāṃścāpi kṣaṇekṣaṇekṛtyākṛtadoṣavināśanammantrabhakṣaṇadoṣotha caturdīpairvinaśyatunaśyedetanmahādbhutamkālimavacchidraṃ vāpi pradṛśyatepūrṇamāyurvinirdeśyaṃ sa rogī naiva jīvatisvadharmatyāgināṃ naiva yantraṃ kāryaṃ tu paṇḍitaiḥyaṃtrāṇi mantrāśca siddhyantyatra na saṃśayaḥnyāyosau dharmasādhanambhūyaḥ preto vā brahmarākṣasaḥkarmaparā bhogaṃ svargaṃ prayacchatiśaṅkhaśca likhito vyāso vaśiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapo muniḥbhagavāñjamadagniśca gautamaḥteṣāṃ vijñeyo daśabhedataḥdeśaṃ jñātvā dharmaṃ samādiśetsaṃhitā horā trividhaṃ jyautiṣaṃ tathāyadyattatproktandharmasādhanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: haridrācūrṇasaṃyukto bhūtebhyoyaṃ balirmataḥlājā yakṣebhyo dadhisaṃyutāḥdadyātpadmākṣatabaliṃ paṃcame brahmaṇe mudāsaptamehni viṣṇave vinivedayetbhairavī syādajastasyā balirmataḥpaiṣṭī ca surāstatra kramānmatāḥśaśamāṃsaṃ ca yakṣebhyaḥ kukkuṭaṃ madhudineṣu ca vilokayetsamyagabhyudgame siddhiḥ kuṇṭhite vighnamāpnuyātpriyaṅgubhirjñeyā śyāmākaiḥstrīsukhaṃ bhavetsarvasammāno mudgairdevakṛpā bhavetsatkarmasiddhiḥ syānmāṣaiḥ śāntī raṇe bhavetcaitrāddīkṣāphalaṃ duḥkhaṃ pratiṣṭhāratnasiddhayevṛddhiduḥkhethākṣepā nindā iti kramātmedhāvināśaśca svarṇāptirjñānavarddhanammanastāpaḥ śriyaḥ saukhyaṃ saukhyaṃ mantrasya siddhayaḥdevamaitrī sarvahāniḥ kalahaśca mahābhayamphalaṃ bhānāṃ kramāddakṣe tha vāmakeagaurīmāntrikā bhraṣṭā vigaṇeśāśca duḥkhitāḥsamṛddhirduḥkhasiddhiśca mūrkhatā gurunāśanamśreṣṭhā naiva kṛṣṇā śubhrā śubhatarā hareḥsiddhirdhāturviśeṣeṇa putrahāniḥ pitṝnṛteputrā dhanāptirmṛtyurīritāānandādikayogānāṃ sarvatrāvikalaṃ phalamsarvasiddhirviṣṭipucche sthire tu sthiratā bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etadviruddhaṃ varṇānāmbhavenno dharma sādhanamgaṇitaṃ śakunaṃ ceti sapta cayaddarśitambhavettatra samarthaṃ puruṣārthakṛtkāmaśāstraṃ syātprāptyarthaṃ guruśāstrataḥbuddhiṃ puruṣārthaḥ praṇaśyatiprākṛtā graṃthā dharmābhāsāśca te surāḥsarvakarmavivardhanaḥkuladīpaṃ taducyate [vidhānamiti śeṣaḥ]sīmantonnayanaṃ kāryaṃ tathā puṃsavanaṃ smṛtamjātaḥ saṃskṛto brahmabījataḥsaṃskārā brāhmasiddhaye [brahmatejovarddhanāya]saṃskārāḥ kaumāre brahmakārakāḥbrāhmaṇo jñeyo maṃtrāḥ sarvepi tadvaśāḥkarmāṇi daśa te dṛṣṭvā palāyante tu dūrataḥprathamaṃ karma cocyateyogyaśiṣyaṃ dvitīyaṃ pāritoṣikampratigrahaṃ kuryāttṛtīyandhanasādhanamyadvittaṃ tallabdhaṃ pañcamaṃ smṛtamsanmaṃtrasyopadeśena yallabdhantattu saptamamkālānuguṇataḥ prāptaṃ navamaṃ pāritoṣikamdhanārjanākhyaṃ karmaitatprathamaṃ parikīrtitambhāryā mātā janayitā tataḥśvaśrūścāyaṃ poṣyavargo vipattauyacca labhyaterajyeta brāhmaṇyānna tu hīyatesābhyajaṃ ca dvitīyakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cāpi vāyavyaṃ kāyikaṃ mānasaṃ tathāaṣṭādhikasahasraṃ ca japo mukhyamidaṃ smṛtammudrikāyuktā tathā cānyā vimudrikāsandhyārghyaṃ gāyatryā sampradīyatepañcayajñāśca daśakarmeti kīrtyateproktā uttamottamamukhyakāḥdevayajñaprakāro devatarpaṇamtatsūktasya tathā japaḥvaiśvadevānte yanvatā iti mantrataḥbhūtayajñaḥ syātkṣudrabādhānivāraṇaḥdhyānamātraṃ vedānāṃ ca paṭhedṛcaḥhantakāraśca pitṛyajño dvidhā mataḥsatkulīnānāṃ mano vaidikavartmaninṝṇāṃ nṛyonistena durlabhājñānī kukkuratāṃ vrajetpratyahaṃ ca balipūjāditatparaḥdhātuvāde dhanakṣayaḥśaivādivaiṣṇavādīnāṃ dveṣānnirayagāminaḥsiddhiḥ paratrāpi parā gatiḥsarvopakārāya kimanyacchrotumicchasivaidikayantrakathanaprakāśaḥ pañcadaśaḥmantrāntarairdeva naiva siddho yathā guruḥdeveśa kīdṛksiddhistu taṃ vrajetūrdhvāmnāyī tathā nyeṣu pūrvāmnāyī pareṣu cakutrāpi gurutvaṃ ca vilokitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devatāyāstathā pūrvaḥ sārūpyaṃ labhate paraḥlobhatyāgaścopakāro hyadhoṃmārgepyudarkakṛtyathoktācaraṇāttasya siddhiḥ śiṣyasya jāyatemantraḥ syādbahuvighnadaḥpuraścaryā svataḥ siddhyenmanūttamaḥvighnamantraṃ suddhidambinduyukto dvibinduḥ pūrvamārgiṇāmca pātālāmnāya īritaḥsvāhā hṛtkamekadaṃṣṭrāya [śiraḥ] huṃphaṭnamastathā netramudīryateṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena tāntriko nyāsamācaretraktavarṇaṃ raktagandhānulepanamvāmanaṃ vighnādhīśaṃ pūjyaṃ ca śuṇḍinampadmāsanaṃ sarvabhūṣaṃ dhyāyedvighnavināyakamyantrametadbudhaḥ kuryāccaturasratrayaṃ śubhampūrvoktavidhinā maṇḍapādi prakalpayetparaṃ tvarcediṣṭadalātmakejvālinī nandābhogadā kāmarūpiṇīcāntamanāḥ pīṭhamanuṃ śṛṇuyajetpīṭhaṃ gaṇādhipamnīlavarṇaṃ keśareṣu tato yajetṣaḍaṅgāni dhyātavyāstāśca devatāḥvaradābhayadhāriṇyaḥ pradhānatanavaḥ striyaḥlambodarākhyavikaṭau vighnarāḍdhūmravarṇakautāsāṃ pravakṣyāmi proktaṃ savyakrameṇa tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: akṣamālāmayodaṇḍaṃ kuṇḍikāṃ dadhatī karaiḥcandragaurāṅgīṃ maheśīṃ bhāvayecchubhāmindragopāruṇāṃ dhyāyetkaumārīṃ karuṇālayāmvaiṣṇavīṃ dhyāyennīlameghasamaprabhāmbhāvayenmantrī nīlavarṇāṃ subhūṣaṇāmbhāvayecchaktimañjanācalasaṃnibhāmcāmuṇḍāṃ śoṇavarṇāṃ ca muṇḍamālāyutāṃ smaretdadhatīṃ hastairmahālakṣmīṃ smaretsudhīḥtadastrāṇi pūjāvighnaharasya tusamprāpto mantrosau siddhikṛdbhavetmodakaiḥ pṛthukairlājaiḥ saktubhiścekṣuparvabhiḥdviśataṃ pañcāśapramitaṃ tathāghṛtāktena homobhīṣṭaphalapradaḥsitapakṣādimārabhya pratyahaṃ juhuyātkramātghṛtasaṃyuktairhomaḥ śrīvaśyakīrtidaḥkanyāṃ putrārthī labhate sutamvaśyādau bhavedvaśyaṃ tathepsitamjñātvā homasaṃkhyāṃ kalpayecca sahasrataḥsitārkadrumamūlena kucandanasudārubhiḥsampūjya taṃ pṛṣṭvā prajapenmanumvyavahārādau samare vijayī bhavetlokāḥ syurvaśagāssadāca taddhṛtaṃ sthāpitaṃ jalesaptāhādvaśagaḥ sādhyaḥ sādhakasya bhaveddhruvammaṇḍādibhiravāpnoti mantroyaṃ praṇavādikaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dakṣiṇāmnāye lakṣmīgaṇapatiṃ surāḥcoccārya mahāgaṇapatiṃ tathāsvāhetyekonatriṃśadakṣaraḥṣaḍdīrghayuktenāṃgāni jātiyuktāni kārayetdakṣordhvakaramārabhya dakṣiṇedhaḥ karāvadhivāmāṅkeviṣṇulakṣmyā cāśliṣṭaṃ dakṣabhujena tucaturdvārasamāyuktacaturasratrayāvṛteprathamāvṛttiraṅgaiḥ syādvakratuṇḍādibhiḥ parāvaśitvaṃ ca prākāmyaṃ prāptiragrataḥkāmyakarmāṇi sādhayethomaḥ putramitrakalatradaḥcatvāriṃśaddinānmantrī vāñchitāṃ labhate śriyamnyāsadhyānādikaṃ prāgvatpūjābhedo nigadyatebibhīṣikā ca mālikātadastrāṇi pūjayetkāmyamucyatejapato dhanavṛddhiḥ prajāyateaśokakāṣṭhairjvalite vahnāvājyāktataṇḍulaiḥnarapatirlakṣmīṃ [labhate iti śeṣaḥ] pāyasahomataḥṣaḍdīrghabījayuktena ṣaḍaṃgāni samācaretadhodakṣeṇābhayadāṃ vāmena varadāyinīmsicyamānāṃ ca kṣaumavastrāṃ kirīṭinīmdharmādikalpite pīṭhe bhūpurāḍhye dalāṣṭakevibhūtirunnatiścaiva hṛṣṭiḥ kīrtiśca sannatiḥsiṃhāsanaṃ pūjyaṃ sarvaśaktimayaṃ tathāsampūjya punaraṣṭadalercayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cāniruddhaṃ ca vidiśāsu tathā kramātdevīdakṣiṇahastāgre śaṅkhākhyaṃ nidhimarcayetvimalāṃ caiva kamalāṃ vanamālikāmlokapālānāyudhāni proktametacchriyorcanampadmaistrisvādusaṃyuktaistrinavaiḥ śrīphalairapisiddhamanurmantrī sādhayennijavāñchitamdāridryātparimucyatenānyathācirāttribhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ vaśaṃ kuryānnacānyathāvaśyaṃ dhanavānarthavānbhavetrājyalakṣmīṃ sa cāyuṣpurtrāṃllabhet kam [sukham]bhavati sādhakaḥpaṭhenneva tatraiva juhuyātpunaḥskandhabhedaistasya narastiṣṭhanmūlepi saṃhunetbhavettasya kathamaśrīḥ kule bhavettryakṣaroyaṃ virāṭ chando munirbhārgava īritaḥṣaḍdīrghayuggakāreṇa tato dhyāyedgajānanambījapūraṃ svayaṃ tattu dakṣiṇe svarṇavarṇakampūjayetpīṭhe pūrvādinavaśaktikeproktā dvitīyā cāpi mātṛbhiḥjapenmantraṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥsiddhamanurmaṃtrī kāmyakarmāṇi sādhayetapūpairguḍasaṃmiśraiḥ pakkānnaiśca ghṛtaplutaiḥsannidhau mantrī juhuyāttrisahasrakammadhuhomena rājānaṃ vaśamānayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sambhojayetkanyā yadvaikāṃ sa labheta tāmtathā candragrahaṇe cābhimantrayetsvīye devatādhyānapūrvakamdhyānapūrvaṃ devatāyāḥ prātaḥ prātastadā bhavetkavittvena śaninā prativādakaḥniṣkārdhapādamānena haridrāñca vacāntathāgurum || gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā pibennārī tadauṣadhamsurūpaṃ ca buddhimantaṃ śriyā yutampūrvavacca ṣaḍaṅgāni hemābho hemavastravāndakṣordhvahastapāśaṃ cādhovāme cākṣasūtrakamgaṇeśaṃ cintayāmyahamtilairhomaṃ tarpaṇādi tataścaretmahatīṃ śrīyamāpnoti mānavaḥākhyātaśchandaḥ proktaṃ virāḍitibījena kuryādaṅgakriyāṃ budhaḥpāśāṃkuśau vilasatāṃ patrāgraṃ ca dadhatkaraiḥpūrṇacandramauliravyādgaṇeśvaraḥsyāddvitīyā cāṣṭabhirgaṇaiḥibhavaktraścaikadanto lambodara iti kramātjapenmantraṃ trisvādvaktaistilairhunetśarkarāghṛtayuktena haviṣā juhuyātsudhīḥtatprajuhuyāllakṣmīvānsādhako bhavetsarvasampatsamṛddhiḥ syātpratyahaṃ vāñchitārthakṛtbhavedaṣṭabhiśca dravyaistrimadhuraplutaiḥcatuścatvāriṃśadākhyaṃ catuḥśatamatandritaḥ

sanskrit: tryakṣaroktaprayogāṃśca kuryādatrāpi sādhakaḥākhyāto gāyatrī chanda īritamṣaḍdīrghabījayuktena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirītitaḥgajavatpaṃcabhiryuktaḥ kirīṭī cāsihastakaḥsvayantamabhayaṃ cāpi varaṃ modakameva cakoṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ dhyāyeddherambamavyayamcaturdvārasamāyuktaṃ tatrādāvāsanaṃ yajetnamaśceti proktaḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥkuryānmūrtipravartanamtadbāhye herambārcanamīritammadhuratrayasaṃyuktaistarpaṇādi samācaretmodakairiṣṭasiddhayekṣipraprasādanaproktānprayogānvā samācaretpraṇavāntoṣṭavarṇoyaṃ śaktibījādikopi vāṣaḍaṅgāni samācaretpūjyamānaṃ bhaktapātakahāriṇamhastairdadhānaṃ candrāsyaṃ nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitampūjite pīṭhe paścātsampūjayedvibhumjayantaścāgniveṣaśca kṛttikāputra eva caviśālākṣaśca samproktāḥ śaktiśūlakarā imevighnaṃ kukkuṭameva catadastrāṇi ca sampūjya subrahmaṇyārcanaṃ tvidamjuhuyānmantrī tarpayedviprapuṅgavānsamyagarcayedbrahmacāriṇamaihikāmuṣmikānbhogāṁllabhante nātra saṃśayaḥ

sanskrit: ityuktvā sarvajanapadaṃ vadetṛṣirmadana ākhyātaśchando'nuṣṭupsamīritamsaḍdīrghayuktabījena viprādīnāṃ prakīrtitaḥprāpte śuklapakṣasya mantravittāṃ samālipya snāyācchuddhajalaistataḥsvarṇāṃgulīyahāraughairbhūṣaṇaiśca śubhāmbaraiḥsumanobhistaṃ yajeddevadhiyā punaḥpūjyamānaṃ maṇisiṃhāsanasthitamkrodhamudrāṃ sṛṇiṃ pāśaṃ paraśuṃ vibhrataṃ karaiḥtaṇḍulairhutvā brāhmaṇānapi bhojayetsarpirguḍapuṭaiḥ samyagapūpairjuhuyādbahiḥbhojayettāvadbrahmacāriṇameva cakanyāmavāpnoti kanyāpi labhate varampalapramāṇagomūtre piṣṭāḥ sindhuvacāniśāḥtadauṣadhaṃ putraṃ labhate guṇasāgaramjalāgnisiṃhacaurāstrapramukhānapi rodhayetete'ṣṭau gaṇapāḥ proktā dakṣiṇāmnāyagocarāḥdakṣiṇāmnāyagaṇapatimantraprakāśaṣṣoḍaśaḥbhuktimuktipradaṃ tatra mahāgaṇapatiṃ śṛṇuaṣṭāviṃśativarṇoyaṃ gaṇakosya munirmataḥca śaktiḥ syāddīrghaṣaṭkayutastu gaḥmanorasya jātiyuktāni cācaretsvabījenāṃgulinyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni tathācaretśrotrayośca netrayoścanasormukheca vāmabāhāvapīdṛśaṃ

sanskrit: svādhiṣṭhāne mūlādhāre tadagrimānpādayorglau hṛdi punaḥ pratyaṅgaṃ bījameva canyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā hṛdi devaṃ vicintayettattaraṅgalasattoyairdhaute śīte mahītalepatadbhiḥ samalaṅkṛteanekaphalasaṅkīrṇe sevite cāpsarogaṇaiḥvilasatpadmarāgaughakuṭṭimāruṇabhūtaletasyādhastātsiṃhāsanaṃ smaretgaṇeśañca tatsaṃsthaṃ ca mahāgaṇamśūlaṃ ca bibhraṃtaṃ hastapaṅkajaiḥardhendumauliṃ tryakṣaṃ ca dīpyamānaṃ kṛpākarammaṇimuktāpravālādīnvarṣantaṃ dhārayā muhuḥkarṇatālairvārayantaṃ muhurmuhuḥnānābharaṇabhūṣitampūrvokte tīvrādinavaśaktikecaturdvārasamāyuktaṃ caturasratrayāvṛtamtrikoṇācca bahirmantrairyajetsurānyajettañca dhyāyedbilvatale sthitamhrīṃgaurahirābhyāṃ ca hṛdanto navavarṇakaḥjaṭādhastātsuvarṇarajataprabhauratikāmābhyāṃ hṛdantoyaṃ navākṣaraḥnālayuktotpaladvandvacāpapuṣpeṣusaṃyutaupriyaṅgostu mahīkolau yajettataḥlakṣmīgaṇakābhyāṃ hṛdantoyaṃ daśākṣaraḥṣaṭkoṇeṣu yajenmantramoṃgaṃ pūrvo hṛdantakaḥ

sanskrit: devatāsiddhirhānirmedhāvināśanampūrṇasiddhiḥ pratāpaśca hānirvijñānanāśanamtathā hānirvāmināṃ mithunaṃ śubhamtriṣaḍāyagatāḥ pāpāḥ śubhāḥ kendratrikoṇagāḥmantraścandrabale grāhyo'nyathā syādaghasambhavaḥsiddhiprado madhyosti nāśakṛtdāridryaṃ saure sarvasamṛddhayaḥprātaḥkṛtyaṃ nivartya cavidhānena puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥācārya-ṛtvigvaraṇasambhāro daśadhā mataḥaṣṭāṅgulasamucchrāyasahitāni samāni caviṣṭarāḥ sarvayajñeṣu lakṣaṇaṃ parikīrtitamācā modakapūritāḥmadhūkapatracchatrāṇi soṣṇīṣāṇi samācaretkṛtvaitatphalamāpnoti mahāyajñārhaṇopamamtaddviguṇaṃ dadyādācāryāya subhaktimāntasminyajñaphalaṃ svalpamanāvṛṣṭau yathā kṣiteḥvaraṇasāmagrīṃ saṅkalpya vṛṇuyādgurumsambhāṣya tvāmahaṃ ca tato vṛṇekarma kuruṣveti vadecchiśuḥbrāhmaṇānvṛṇuyādaṣṭau vedavedāṅgapāragānkuṇḍāni tadā catvāra ṛtvijo matāḥtaddvāre parīkṣāmārabhettataḥpurataḥ sthaṇḍile hastamātrakeyaddiśāsaṃsthaṃ tatredaṃ pūrvataḥ phalam

sanskrit: samṛddhyāyutamabhyarcetpramodaṃ vahnikoṇakemadanāvatyā yajedvāruṇakoṇagamvighnakarttāraṃ drāviṇyā sahitaṃ yajetraktāraktāmbarālepabhūṣaṇā madavihvalāḥśaṃkhanidhiṃ vāmercayettathālokānāṃ meghavatsadāṣaḍāvaraṇasaṃyuktamitthaṃ devaṃ samarcayetdaśāṃśaṃ juhuyādaṣṭadravyairekākṣaroditaiḥpraṇamya visṛjedevaṃ siddho bhavenmanuḥkurvīta siddhayaḥ syurna cānyathāsahasrāṣṭakamasyānte juhuyātkaravīrajaiḥbhūtvā sāmātyaḥ sanniṣevakaḥvighnāḥ syurvaśāstasya na saṃśayaḥvipulāṃ cirakālānubandhinīmlavaṇājyasurābhiśca śodhayitvāsya bhasma tubhavatyāmaraṇāṃtaṃ sā dāsītoṣyadhikaṃ vaśāmokṣamavāpnuyātvedārthakaraṇe buddhiṃ prāpnoti sādhakaḥtasyālpamṛtyurogādyā naśyantyāyuśca vardhateuccāṭayedvairisaṅghāngrāmaṃ deśaṃ purādikamraṇḍāstasya vaśyā jīvena ca dhanena caūttarapadārthasya buddhyā pravibhāgātpratyavamarśaḥ] capravadedetadamukaṃ cāmukena camantrayedaṣṭottaraṃ tacca sahasrakambhavati niścayena yamātithiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samutthāya kṣīṇacandre ca parvaṇivyāghrakroḍāricorādīnnātra kāryāvicāraṇāśikhādikarṇikākhyādi tvagjihvācakṣuṣāmalaiḥsamprajapenmantraṃ tvaṣṭādhikasahasrakamtvaṅganāyā bhakṣitaṃ vaśyakārakamdhyāyedvināyakamnigaḍānmucyate kasmādatha bilvasya puṣpakammadhunā bhāvayetsamamsiddhaguṭikā taddhūpādroganāśanamstrī syātkumārī labhate varam jalāśayeprayogaṃ kāmikaṃ śṛṇulakṣmyai payase huneccharkarayā dvijaḥyaśase homo dhanārthantilataṇḍulaiḥvaśayedbhūpamutpalaiścāpi tadvadhūmhunedvadhūrvaśyā vaṭātplakṣādudumbarātviprādyānvaśayedvarṇālloṇahomādavarṣaṇampravakṣyāmi kāmyakarmāṇi saṃsmaretdhanaprāptyai muktyai śuklaṃ ca saṃsmaretyacca prakaṭaṃ vakṣyatedhunāpūrvavannyāsasaṃyutaḥmahāpadmantaruṇādityasannibhamdhyāyenmantrī pūrvoktamantravatvinirgatyāvaruhyāha karṇikāmadhyasaṃsthitam|| pravarairgandhakusumaiḥ prāgvatsāvaraṇaṃ yajetratnadhārābhirdhyātvā devasya mūrdhani

sanskrit: bhaktyā devadevaṃ prasannadhīḥvidhiścāyaṃ śṛṇu vaidikatarpaṇambrūyādvāmācārī namo vadetprathamandaśavāraṃ pratarpayetsamuccārya mūlamantrasya tarpayetṣaṭpaṃcasaṃkhyākaṃ catuṣkantarpaṇambhavetpunarmūlena tarpayetpunarmūlambhavedevaṃ catuṣkamapi tarpaṇammūlamantreṇa catuṣkājinasaṃkhyakamtābhyāmmadhye mūlena cāṣṭadhābhūbhūcatuṣkāṃkairvedavedakṛtairmitamsantarpya mantravarṇaiśca tarpayetantarāntaramūlena caivaṃ siddhiścatuṣkikāhyāyudhānāṃ kramastvayampravadedamukāya namastvitivasudhāṃ ca gamśaktiṃ ca prāṇabandhaṃ vadettataḥproktāsteṣānnāmānyahaṃ brūvecakrābjapāśotpalāni kalabhāgraviṣāṇayukdvāviṃśasaṃkhyākantarpaṇaṃ ca prajāyatemūlāntarāntaraḥlambodaragaṇeśvarauviṃśacatuṣkāḥ syustato yugmāni tarpayetprāgvattadyugmamābhāṣya mūlenāntaritāni caṣoḍaśasaṃkhyāni catuṣkāṇi bhavantyapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūlenāntaritāścaiva catuṣkā jinasaṃkhyakāḥvasundharāśaṃkhau tarpaṇīyau ca pūrvavatpadmanidhyorbījantu tarpaṇevedavedābdhisaṃkhyakāstarpaṇakramāḥsvabījādyasvāhāntāni yugmānyevampratarpayetlaghutarpaṇamīritamṣaḍgaṇeśānnidhiyugamevametattrayodaśadviśatañcāṣṭādhikamādyantayostathātarpaṇammadhyamañcaitanmahāgaṇapatermatammūlamantrasya caikaikenākṣareṇa cagajāśvineyatulyantajjāyate ca tataḥ paramtarpayeddevammokṣārthaṃ śuddhavāribhiḥmadhunā kāmārthaṃ tarpayedvibhumrājavaśyāya devaṃ pṛṣṭhe pratarpayetprītervivṛddhyai skandhe tu payobhistarpayedvibhumjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥmārgaṃ kaliyugapriyamlokaiḥ svasvadharmo vigarhitaḥkṣudhāturastu bhūmiṣṭhandūrīkṛtya kaśerukamdharmo vāmānte kaulikādikaḥvasatiḥ kṛtā putraprasādataḥkāśīpraveśakāmārthaṃ tete santoṣitāḥ paraiḥdattantantreṣu pratipāditamvedamārge vihitācca dvijātayaḥtairabhidrutya dharmalopārthamudyatam

sanskrit: teṣāmmadhyātsamudbhūtammama liṅgaṃ mukhānvitammārgasyāyaṃ vyatikramaḥgaṅgājalādapyadhikampāvanaṃ kāraṇaṃ tvidamvayaṃ dadma uddhārārthaṃ trijanmanāmmatsyāstānebhyo dātumudyatāḥtvayā deva viṣṇunā hṛdaye kṛtākāruṇikāstāta hyetebhyo dātumudyatāḥṣaṭsugandhā ṣaḍrasāśca mudrā dātuṃ samudyatāḥsvarṇapātrasthaparamamannaṃ hitvā tṛṇāśinaḥmadvaco vīrāḥ sarvaprāṇikṛpāyutamatikṣudrādiyonīnāndaśasvekaḥ prajāyatecondurādīnāṃ viḍālādiḥ prajāyatekaścinmṛgajātiṣu jāyatekaścitkharo vā karabho bhavetkaścinnaro vākuñjaro bhavetmanuṣyāṇāmmadhyādekaḥ prajāyatetu kaścidvarṇaḥ prajāyatekaścitprāpnuyāddvijatāṃ naraḥkaścitkarmaniṣṭhaḥ prajāyatekaścidyogī bhavati bālakaḥkaścinmukto bhavati vā na vābrahmasṛṣṭivināśaśca tūrṇameva bhaviṣyatianyonyañjaghnurojasānirayamparamaṃ gatāḥpramuditairviprairyācitoyaṃ varastadā
