sanskrit: ramatāmmanaḥsvavyabhicāritamtaccātra paśubhiryācitantu yatnāthānasmānvihāyādya paśubhiḥ kinnu yācyatetyaktā paśubhirjanaiḥtenārcitontarātmāyammukto bhavati tatkṣaṇāttu tuṣṭaścedantarātmā vimucyatekleśānāśaṃ yānti vimucyatesāraḥ śapharaḥ parikīrtitaḥpaśavastantrasāramidaṃ vacaḥśatasahasrantu kṛtvā mokṣamavāpnuyātcāmuṇḍādyā mahādevyo bhairavādyā mahābalāḥtena yena mudrāṣṭakaṃ kṛtamsyātsahasrabhagadarśanāttatpātakavaśājjāto matto daśarathātmajaḥsamanuprāptaṃ viyogaścānukālikaḥjātaḥ sadā śaktiniṣevakaḥṣoḍaśastrīsahasrāṇāñjātosau bhagadarśanātvinā māsaṃ vinā matsyaṃ ca maithunampaśubhiryācitaṃ yattu kimu caitattadeva hipraphullavadanāḥ śāntipūrvaṃ vaco jaguḥsiṃhavacca sadā māsaniṣevakāḥtathāsmākaṃ na māṃsaṃ bhakṣituṃ kṣamāḥtathaiva vīrasiṃhānāṃ bhakṣyaṃ māṃsādikaṃ kilasevayituṃmicchanti paśavo viprarūpiṇaḥpītvā madyaṃ mattāstathābhavan
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tebhyo mayā proktaṃ vriyatāṃvriyatāmitibhavecchreyastandharmaṃ vada naḥ prabhoprakartavyaṃ vedoktaṃ karma nityaśaḥgrahaṇārthantu tadvattantraniṣevaṇamtṛptirjīvanaṃ ca bhavedyathānānye ca tasmāttaṃ parivarjjayetvacasteṣāṃ na mānayetsa eva nirayaḥ smṛtaḥdivodāsanissārārthaṃdevatāḥśāsanātkāmo dagdhopi punarutthitaḥmantrānpravakṣyāmi lokadvayaphalapradānṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayetnānāratnaughamukuṭabhūṣaṇairbhūṣitaṃ śubhamupaviṣṭaṃ raktapadme kāmadevaṃ vibhāvayeca ṣaṭpatre koṇeṣvaṅgāni pūjayetcaiva trāsinīṃ stambhinīṃ tataḥṣaṭpatre madanānaṅgamanmathā kusumāhvayāḥanaṅgamekhalānaṅgadīpikā ca tataḥ parampadme ṣoḍaśapatrāḍhye svāgrataḥ paripūjayetlolā līlā saudāmanī tathāceti taruṇyaḥ sasmitānanāḥvilāsavibhramau mohaṃ śokaṃ kāmasya pūjayetcūtapuṣpaṃ grīṣmaṃ tāpanamūrjakamcārpitatūṇīrāḥ śoṇastrīsaktamānasāḥsārasākṣaśca śuko meghastataḥ param
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ca catasraḥ pūjayedimāḥśvetacāmarasaddhastāḥ śyāmā bhūṣitavigrahāḥevamārādhayedyastu gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ smarampuraścaraṇametasya lakṣaṃ dvādaśa cocyatemārjanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānapi bhojayetsiddhamanurmantrī prayogānācarettataḥsahasraṃ yaḥ sarveṣāṃ sa priyo bhavetvahnau mantreṇānena mantravitājñānuvartinī sāsya bhavejjanmani janmanimantrī kanyā sāpi priyaṃ patimkāmadevāya sarvajanapriyāya cahṛdayaṃ mamakīrtayetṣaḍdīrghayataklīṃbījaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritiḥdrāmādyāṃ drāviṇīṃ devīṃ dromāyāṃ kṣobhiṇīmapiākarṣiṇīṃ ca saḥ pūrvāṃ sammohinīṃhamādikāmpañcāṅgeṣvaṃgulīṣu canāsikāṅgepyaṅgeṣvatha tataḥ paramśeṣaṃ vyāpakatvena sannyasetmātṛkārṇānāṃ bṛhannyāsaṃ samācaretsamuccārya mātṛkāṅgeṣu vinyasetkāmayuktāṃ hi kāntimantañca mohinīmnyasetkāmavardhanena samanvitāmkubjikāñcaramākāntañca kāntayānandayantaṃ pralāpinīmbhramaṇo yajinīyutaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saukhyaṃ jñānalābhaḥ kramātphalamsahasraṃ vā śataṃ viṃśatireva vādoṣāñjahijahītyevaṃ padaṃ caiva namo'ntakampunardeyaṃ punarduṣṭaṃ ca cetphalamsakṛdapi guruṃ śiṣyo vināśayetdakṣiṇānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca vāmināmsamācakṣva svapne suptasya yatphalamsvapnaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubhamrātrau svapnaṃ paśyedyathā tathāsamutthāya pādaśaucaṃ vidhāya caityarthaḥ] || śivadaivatayoraikyaṃ bhāvayettu japedidamviśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥkriyāsiddhiṃ vidhāsyāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvaradevā bhoḥ sarve sāvadhānāstu tadvidhimjuhuyāttaddaśāṃśena bilvapatrairghṛtaplutaiḥbhavenmantraḥ svapne vakti hṛdi sthitammantroyaṃ dvādaśākṣara īritaḥṣaḍbhirmāsairdviyāme tu tribhirmāsaistriyāmakephalaghnī syātsvapno vācyo na cānyathāvātādhikyādbhavet svapnassahasoḍḍānapūrvakaḥśvetaśītādi śayanādyaṃ balāsanamkaphātpravepate nityaṃ hṛddve dvandve trayaṃ triṣubhāgīrathīṃ bhānuṃ liṅginaṃ liṅgamaiśvaramkuñjaraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ mālyaṃ samudraṃ phalitadrumamvidhuṃ sūryaṃ ratnānyābharaṇāni ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mugdhayā yukto bhrāmako ramayā yutaḥbhramāvahaścañcalayā mohanodīrghajihvayāmohavardhanaśṛṅgiṇyo madanaṃ pāṭalāṃ tathābhṛṅganāyakahaṃsinyau gāyakaṃ viśvatomukhīmkāntisaṃyuktaṃ conmattaṃ kalakaṇṭhikāmsarvottamāyutaṃ lobhavardhanaṃ nyasya cintayetkartavyāḥ kṛṣṇagopālasambhavāḥtāmbūlaṃ gajapuṣkarabhakṣitamsaṃnyāsa-ekākṣaravanmunirvātsyāyano mataḥpracodayātparatrāpi ca sadgatimnārīṇāṃ hṛdayaṃ gataḥśāpito yastadā kāśyā vivāsitaḥyasmāttasmātkāmaḥ satāṃ gatiḥgaṇapastatsahāyārthamudyataḥtayoḥ prabhāveṇa dṛṣṭavānparamaṃ patimjapaṃstasthau varṣamātraṃ vimuktitaḥkāśikāyāmasau siddhivināyakaḥlobhadveṣādikānsarvānvāsayāmāsa tatra tuyatprasādāddivodāso guptasenaḥ prapañcitaḥuddhārārthamaviprāṇāṃ gāyatryeṣā mayoditāpañca mantro yobhyo mayā kṛtaḥyo vācī sa ādau praṇavo manuḥiti dvyakṣaroyaṃ tṛtīyakaḥcedvyarṇo mantraścaturthakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvyakṣaro mantraḥ pañcamaḥ parikīrtitaḥbrahmāprapañcādiḥ sa evāsya muniḥ smṛtaḥdevatāsabindumātṛkānyāso dvitīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥkeśavādikamātṝṇāṃ caturtho nyāsa ucyatemāyābījādikaḥ ṣaṣṭho mātṛkānyāsa ucyatemātṛkākāmabījādyāstannyāsaścāṣṭamo mataḥprapañcapūrvāṇāṃ mantro mātṝṇāṃ daśamaḥ smṛtaḥvyāpakatvācca kālasya na dhyānaṃ na ca pūjanamugratārādyatikrūrastārādiścaiva sādhakaḥnānyathā [anyūna ityarthaḥ] bhavettilasiddhārthājyahavirhomadravyāṣṭakaṃ matamsarvakāryāṇi prayogaḥ kathyatedhunākāryasyaivānusāreṇa hunedravyāṣṭakena cavā tadardhaṃ vā hunettataḥrasasaṅkhyasahasrāṇi huneddravyāṣṭakena cabhūtāveśagrahāveśakṛtyādīnsuvināśayetkaulike mārge grasyate bhairavādibhiḥsahasrasaṅkhyahomena svapno bhavati tatkṣaṇātapasmāraṃ smṛtibhraṃśaṃ śoṣadoṣaṃ sa nāśayetmahālakṣmīstallakṣmyā lajjatetarāmdravyāṣṭakaṃ trivarṣārvāktasya lokatrayaṃ vaśevṛddhyādikaṃ vijānīyāddhomaṃ taṃ kāryagauravāttasyāśu pralayaṃ yānti nānyathāpuṣṭido homo ghṛtahomo yaśaskaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mālatīpuṣpahomopi sarvavaśyaprado bhavetśālisamudbhūtāṃstaṇḍulānsādhu cūrṇayetkuryātsamyaksaṃpūjya tāṃ spṛśetjuhuyānmantrī tāṃ nyāsakramato niśisopyevaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇātatastasminvaṭāgnau juhuyādghṛtampūrṇauṣadhivipakvena pañcagavyena pūritetāvatsaṃkhyaṃ ca sañjapya gṛhṇīyātsarvasiddhidamdhāraṇātsadyaḥ sarve naśyantyupadravāḥśrīsaubhāgyajayapradamvāpi dadyāddhemno varasya casiddhiṃ prapañcākhyamantreṇa gaṇapasya hisarvaśāstrāṇāṃ vaktābhūjjagato guruḥmakārapañcakenaiva jātaṃ sarvatra pūjanammapaṃcamantramāhātmyādrājāpi bhrāntamānasaḥsevāto dharmaṃ paśyanti te na hisarvavidyāviśāradaḥpanthā bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥsamyagātithyaṃ kṛtvā tuṣṭāva cāgamamguruprokto yajño yāgo mapaṃcakaḥkartavyaṃ vaidikaṃ na kadācanakurvantyābhyantaraṃ karma tattvametadvicāryatāmdattvā kathaṃ saukhyaṃ pralabhyateviprāstyajyatāṃ vedakarma tattatra siddhiḥ pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyatāmidam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadagnihotrantu caryatāṃ dṛśyatāmidaṃvedamārgaṃ praviṣṭā vāmakaulayoḥpadmāsanamṛjurbhavettanmadhye cintanīyaṃ guṇātmakamtanmadhye dhyāyetsattvaguṇātmakamhakāreṇa veṣṭitaṃ tacca cintayetsamākrāntantu taddvayamprācyāṃ praticyāṃ ca kauberyāṃ dakṣiṇe tathāmadhyādipūrvatastatra jñeyāḥ paṃcāgnayo hyamīcāhavanīyogniranvāhāryaśca paṃcamaḥsthitāṃ stāṃśca kalpādityānvicintayetsaṃ ṣamiti tu jñeyā varṇāśca paṃca capaṃcaite saṃgrāme vijayapradāḥnīlendreṇa samā dhyeyā mantrasiddhipradāyakāḥbhaumasyaite dyūtakalirājadvāreṣu siddhidāḥcintanīyā vajranibhā yātrākāryaśubhaṃkarāḥvivāhādikāryādiṣu suśobhanāḥśatrunāśakarā dhyeyā manīṣibhiḥhīrakasaṃkāśā rājakāryakarā imemaṃ naṃ ṇaṃ ca ñaṃ ṅaṃ aḥ eṃ ūṃ āvasathyakekhaṃ oṃ ṛṃ ca iṃ kāramanvāhārye hunetsudhīḥsvāhetyuktvā proktakuṇḍe hunedekaikamakṣaramśabdajātaṃ sarvaṃ śāstrādikaṃ hunetsparśādikānvāyuguṇānyaṃ bījenendrakuṇḍakerasānsarvānhunetkuṇḍe tathottare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pralayānalasaṃkāśajvaladagniṣvaharniśamnityaśuddhaparānandacidrūposau virājatepañcāśatsaṅkhyayā kṛtvā nyasya tāvadyathāvidhisūryakalposau kartā hartā ca śambhuvatatharvapariśiṣṭoktairmaṃtrairetaistu pañcabhiḥvihṛtyātmānamupacaryordhvaṃ gacchantu svāhāvihṛtyātmānamupacaryordhvaudhastiryaggacchantu svāhāvihṛtyātmānamupacarya tiryagūrdhvādho gacchaṃtu svāhāsarvamaśnīyāducyate manuḥvidhānenordhvādhastiryakṣu gacchatuhomaṃ vidhāyātha saṃskṛtānnena maṃtravitpaścācchuddhācamanamācaretjagadvyāptaṃ nityamekamananyagamhavanīyena śuddhena juhuyāttena tarpitamhavirhutaṃ maṃtrī sajvalatpañcavahnikaḥgarbhasthitibhavaṃ kleśaṃ viṃdate na kadācanakācidvāmamārgeṇa sādhyate devatā tu sāviprāṇāṃ mapañcakaniṣevaṇesaṅgaścejjāto nirayamaśnutebhakṣaṇe ciṃtyaṃ hunetpaścimakuṇḍakevīryaṃ tu ghṛtarūpaṃ vicintayetevamātṛptiparyaṃtaṃ bālāyā maithunaṃ caretrātrijaṃ pāpaṃ devatā cetprasīdatituṣṭā syānna pāpairabhibhūyatepāpaṃ vai dharma eva saḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sādhakaścedbhuktimuktipradaḥ sa tuvadayugmaṃ ca vāgvādini padaṃ vadetmokṣamuccārya kuruṣva praṇavaṃ vadetnagairbāṇairjāyatesya manutrayamutpattisthitināśānāṃ kārikāstāḥ prakīrtitāḥgaṇeśasya prasādena varṇalakṣajapāddrutamvadetsakṛtsiddhiraśaktau mitabhāṣaṇātvāgvādini aimityeko navākṣaraḥcātra varṇalakṣajapo bhavetproktaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitametābhyāmeva mantrābhyāṃ bahavaḥ kaulikāḥ kṛtāḥvāmamārge ca siddhānte drutasiddhidāmnādabindusamāyuktaṃ vāgbhavaṃ kūṭamucyatekāmarājābhidhaṃ matamtṛtīyantu kūṭaṃ varṇatrayātmakamtṛtīyabīje bindvāḍhyaṃ strīṇāmuktaṃ na sargayukpaṭhanīyastathā tāsāṃ deyo mantraṃ susiddhayedevavanditapādābjā devī tripurabhairavīāhṛnmūrddhāgataṃ cāntyaṃ caivaṃ bījatrayaṃ nyasetca śiraḥ proktaṃ saurantyena śikhā matāmūrdhnyādhāre hṛdi nyasyaṃ mano kūṭatrayaṃ punaḥkarāgre ca kramānnyasetsaṃhārakramato nyasetvāme tato dakṣe karṇayościbuke tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hṛdaye kūrparadvitaye kaṭaustanayugme gale tathāiti cādyabījena vinyasethṛdaye bhruvormadhye tṛtīyakammūrtinyāsamathācaretdhareśānaṃ nyasedbudhaḥnyasedvaktre hṛdaye tu tato nyasetvāmadevarūpāya manmathasyātmane namaḥkāmadevāya nama ityapipravinyasyettataḥ pañca bāṇānaṅgeṣu vinyasetaṃguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntamaṃgulīṣu kramānnyasetbhruvormadhye mukhakarṇākṣikaṇṭhakebhagā tvanyā tṛtīyā bhagasarpiṇīproktā cānaṃgamekhalākusumbhavasanā haritkāñcikikāḥ śubhāḥkuryādbhūṣaṇākhyaṃ tataḥ sa tu nigadyaegaṇḍayoroṣṭhayordantapaṃktyorāsye nyasetsvarānkūrparayoḥ pāṇyostatpṛṣṭhadeśataḥguhye punaścorvorjānunorjaṃghayostathābalaye pānake tathājapākusumasaṅkāśāmaruṇāmbarabhūṣaṇāmviśvasaundaryasarvasvajanmasāgararūpiṇīmmaṇḍitāṅgīṃ mahādevīṃ muktājapavaṭīdharāmdhyāyettripurabhairavīmkuryānmaṇḍalaṃ gurumārgataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cāgre trikoṇe madhyame nyasetsvarālekhyā dvandvaśogradaleṣu cakramāddalānāṃ granthīśca praṇavābhyāṃ tataścaretlikhedvarṇānkramāttribhyaśca pūrvataḥthadadhānnaphavāścāpi bhasarāllaṁvaṣāṃstathācaturasratrayaṃ kuryāttadbāhye devatārcanamdvādaśaitāścādyavīthyāmekasyāṃ diśi tu trayamjñānotkriyākubjikā ca bimbā devī viṣaghnikāyūyaṃ tacchṛṇudhvaṃ samāhitāḥgaṅgātaraṅgadhavalaṃ cāmaradvayamadrije [pārvati]mallikāmālatījātīśatapatrāḍhyadāmabhiḥpaṭīñca vyajanadvandvaṃ navaratnavicitritamkarpūramṛganābhyāḍhyaṃ karpūrakṣodasaṃyutamśalākāṃ ca karaṇḍaṃ candrapūritampūrvādikramataḥ sarvāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥsākṣānmokṣadāyi na saṃśayaḥṣoḍaśārṇoyaṃ mantraḥ syātpīṭhapūjanamdhyāyettripurabhairavīmjapākusumasaṃkāśāruṇāṃ svarṇavibhūṣaṇāmsarvasvajanmasāgararūpiṇīmmaṇḍitāṅgīṃ mahādevīṃ muktājapavaṭīdharāmdevīṃ madāghūrṇitalocanāmmudrāviṃśatisaṃkhyākāstato devyai pradarśayetvāmahastatalaṃ kuryātkapālavatyonimudrāstāsāṃ lakṣaṇamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trailokyadrāviṇī cāsya trilokyākarṣṇī bhruvoḥṣaḍaṃgāvaraṇaṃ pīṭhasyoparitorcayetpaścātprītimuttarakoṇakedvaudvāvarvāgudakcaikamagre kāmāṃśca bāṇavatcādyā dvitīyānaṅgamekhalāpañcamī devī bhagāgre bhagasarpiṇībrāhmādyā bāhye cāṣṭadaladvayamkaumārikāyuktaḥ krodhaḥ syādvaiṣṇavīyutaḥcāmuṇḍābhīṣaṇau mahālakṣmīḥ saṃhārasaṃyutākramātsyuraṣṭaśaktīnāṃ pūjaneṣṭau manūttamāḥmalayastataḥ kollagiriḥ smṛtaḥdevakoṭaṃ pīṭhāṣṭakamudāhṛtambhairavaṃ tvādyaṃ dvitīyaṃ tripurāntakamtato [etadagre tūttarānvayi] bāhye tu bhūpurehṛdayāntastathaiva cayantrānvadāmyathavighnānnāśayanāśayapaṃcapaṃcādaśārṇoyaṃ svāhānto vaṭukasya tugṛhītvā vāmāṃguṣṭhena vai visṛjedbalimsvaheti dhṛtyarṇo yoginīnāṃ balau manuḥsadvīryayuktaṃ kṣaṃ procya sthāne kṣetre nipānabhūḥagneraṣṭanavārṇoyaṃ kṣetrapālabalermanuḥgīṃ gūṃ gaṇapataye vara varada śarva caekatriṃśacca manau varṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥnirmālyabhojinī cāsya devī tripuracaṇḍikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatsampradāyaśuddhātmagurorladhvā manuṃ sudhīḥtrisvāduyuktairaśvārikusumairathavā hunetcandanāgurukarpūrakṛtagātrānulepanaḥsarvabhūtasuhṛnmaunī kumārīpūjako bhavetmuktākalāpavidyākṣamālārājaccaturbhujāmtasya nānāvṛttārthaśobhanāsuratarormūlavilasanmaṇipīṭhagāmdhanuśceti ṣaḍbhujairdadhatīṃ bhajehelāvilāsasampannāṃ navayuvanasundarīmtrailokyaṃ kṣobhayedāśu pūrvavatsiddhibhāgasauakṣamālāsudhākakumbhamudrāpustakadhāriṇīmtasya kavitā bhuvi sammatākuryātsarasvatītuṣṭyai saubhāgyānāṃ gṛhaṃ hi saḥparanārīnṛpāṇāṃ ca rañjanaṃ bhavati dhruvamsiktairhunetkramāttasya kavitvamabhijāyatenaranārīnṛpāṃścaiva vaśayennātra saṃśayaḥsamṛddhiśca kamalāyā bhavedapikāśyāmevaṃ tripurabhairavīgaṇanāthena kaulikācārapūjitāmkūṭaṃ prathamaṃ parikīrtitammaṃtraḥ samākhyāto dvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgakamudyatsūryasahasrābhāṃ candracūḍāṃ trilocanāmsravadrudhiramuṇḍālilalitāṃ raktavāsasamśarānpāśānaṃkuśaṃ pustakaṃ tathādhyātvā yajetpīṭhaṃ prathamaṃ pīṭhamantrataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śvetacandanavastrāṇi śālayaḥ kuṅkumaṃ madhuphalāni siddhānnaṃ dadhi bālaṃ vilāsinambaddhamekaparaṃ puṣpaṃ sadvākyaṃ cakṣurañjanamrodanahīnaṃ ca puṇḍrāṇi ca patākikāmāṅgalyagītāni cāṅkuśaṃ yuddhadaṃ priyamvyādhyādyārte nāsti duḥkhaṃ sāmānyaḥ sukhamāpnuyātnadīṃ sindhuṃ dvijaṃ śvetāmbaraṃ tathāharmyaprāsādanāgāśvavṛṣaśailāgnirohaṇamkṛmiviṣṭhānulepaśca rudhireṇābhiṣecanampracandrakiraṇaṃ svapne kāryasiddheḥ sulakṣaṇamsvapne sā rātristasya paścimāhatyā pītayā karado bhavetsvapne tasya śrīḥ sarvatomukhītasya śrīḥ sarvatomukhībhavedbhogī rogī rogādvimucyatevardhate tasya dugdhapānadhanātyayaḥbhavetprītirgodhūmaiśca dhanāgamaḥdadhilābho dadedarthānghṛtalābhād dhruvañjayaḥliṅgānāmarcanandṛṣṭvā vyavahārotra jāyatepatre taṃ vidyātpṛthivīpatimsvapne tattathaiva bhaviṣyatimaṇḍalarājyaṃ syānnagare pārthivo bhavetgrasanaṃ śatrūṇāṃ vā vadhakriyāvaḍavāmahiṣīsiṃhīgohastinyādidohanamrājyābhiṣekaśca svaśiraśchedanaṃ mṛtiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīṃ ca devārṇaḥ pīṭhamantrakaḥjyeṣṭhāṃ ca raudrīṃ ca kālīṃ ca varalocanāmbalapramathinīñcaiva sarvabhūtadamāṃ tathāsamuddhṛtya prāgvadaṅgāni pūjayetsāyudhānparameśvarisahāvakārasaṃyuktau prathamaṃ bījamīritamvisargāṃtāstṛtīyakammukuṭordhvalasaccandrarekhāṃ raktāmbarācitāmvaradābhayaśobhāḍhyāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīmdvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgāni nyasyetsarvāṃgalakṣaṇamcaturdvāramevaṃ maṇḍalamālikhetvidhuṃ dakṣe yajedbāṇāṃśca pūrvavatanaṅgakusumādyāśca vasupatreṣu pūrvavatapāṅgabhrūvilāsau ca hāvabhāvau prapūjayet || 557 |||pūjāpi śeṣaṃ nyāsādikaṃ tathāhasāvakārasaṃyuktau prathamaṃ bījamīritamṣaḍdīrghānvitamadhyena bījenoktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakamjaṭājūṭāṃ trinetrāṃ raktavāsasampāśāṃkuśavarābhītīrdadhānāṃ ca śivāṃ śrayecātra pūrvavatparito yajetbrahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāstatra pūjā bahiḥ punaḥanaṅgakusumādyāśca brāhmyādyāśca samaṃtataḥcatuḥṣaṣṭiyoginībhyo hṛdantoyaṃ daśākṣaraḥekādaśamahākoṭiyoginībhyo namorcayetsampravakṣyāmi bhairavīṃ kamaleśvarīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tataḥ śaptā tuhināge'bhavannadīlabdhaṃ tayā duḥkhaṃ kalau khyātiṃ gamiṣyativarṇāśca bhaviṣyanti varapradāḥasyāstīre purīśvaryā na ca teṣu prasīdatitasmāddhyānādyarcanādi prāgvaddakṣiṇamārgataḥbhuvaneśvarabhairavyā bījādau hasarānpaṭhethasarādyāṃstathā vidyātprāgvatpūjādikaṃ matamādyantabījayo repharahitā hasarādikāḥbhairavīvatsarvaṃ dhyānādikaṃ matamsaṃsthātuṃ tadā devena ḍhuṇḍhinādevāstānvakṣyāmi samāsataḥsvāhāṃtaṃ mantrayugmaṃ tadīyakamdevatāsya bhuktimuktiphalapradājātiyuktairaṅgakḷptiḥ ṣaṭpadaistaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakamcaturdvārasamāyuktaṃ kuṃkumādibhiruddharetjayā caiva suprabhā ca viśuddhikāekavahniśaraklībahīnairadbhiḥ prapūjayetsiddhamanuḥ pīṭhaṃ cānena pūjayettasyāntaḥ pūjayeccandanādibhiḥdevāyudhairdigīśaiśca hetibhirdhyānamucyatecakraṃ khaḍgaṃ carma daraṃ dadhānāṃ ca kramādbhajeśraddhā medhā śrutiśceti omādyakṣarapūrvikāḥproktāni lakṣāṇāṃ pañcakaṃ japetsiddhamanurmantrī prayogānācaretsudhīḥripuṃ hanyānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śastrāṇi subahūnyapimohitaḥgaṃgāpāre tasyā manuṃ śṛṇucoccārya paścādbrūyātsthitaṃ tathāśamayāgnivadhūśceti mantro nagaguṇārṇakaḥsvakāryaṃ sādhayitvevaṃ gaṇanāthena kīlitāenāṃ japecca niṣkīlāṃ tadā siddhiḥ prajāyatemantrādau yojayedante duṃhīmomi iti mantravitprokto hyanuṣṭup chanda īritamṛtvaṣṭāṣṭabhūbāṇairmantrārṇaiḥ syātṣaḍaṅgakammūlādhāre ca jaṭhare tathānāsāgaṇḍayukkarṇayugmaketrinetrāṃ ca hyaruṇe paṅkaje sthitāmsvarṇodyatkāntivasanāṃ śaśimauliṃ vanasthitāmdhyātvā yajeddevīṃ pīṭhe pūrvodite tataḥmātṝśca lokeśānāyudhāni cakṣemyā ca vedagarbhā ca śāṅkarī cāṣṭamī matājapenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ hunettilaiḥmārjanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇārādhanaṃ tathāsiddhamanurmantrī vāñchitārthānprasādhayetśyāmalāṅgīṃ hayārermūrdhani sthitāmdadhatīṃ hastaiḥ suprasannānanāṃ bhajeca tadante ca prayogānkarttumarhatitattadasādhyamapi sādhakaḥsahasraṃ prajapenmantraṃ sādhakasattamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hunedāraṇyakatilairājikābhiśca vā hunetapasmārādikānmantrī nātra kāryā vicāraṇāvāñchitārthasiddhirbhavati nānyathāsakalaṃ mantrī hunedvañchitasiddhayekuṭutailaiḥ sahasraṃ vā hyayutaistadanantarampūrvavatprajapenmantraṃ tāñccharānapi bhūpatiḥsamantātsaphalāstadāvastrālaṅkaraṇaiścāpi toṣayejjayadāyinambhrāmyati kākavatjuhuyātpādarajobhiḥ sahavairiṇaḥpuṣpairhunetsahasraṃ ca senā saṃstambhayedbudhaḥviṣavṛkṣasamudbhūtāṃ śatroḥ pratikṛtiṃ śubhāmkṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ kakolūkavasāyutaiḥripurnūnaṃ bhavatyeva sahasrataḥviṣatrikaṭukāliptāṃ samyaguṣṇajale kṣipetdugdhābhiṣekataḥ śāntirbhavatyasya na saṃśayaḥripoḥ sadyaḥ pūrvavacchāntirīritāprajapyātha mārayedripusañcayammantrajāpena śamayecchatrusañcayamśeṣaḥ] || kāraskaradrusamidhā hyayutaṃ juhuyātsudhīḥrājavṛkṣasamiddhomādrogā naśyanti daṃtināmbhavettathā śrīghraṃ patrairādityakotthitaiḥpañcagavyena lokarakṣākaraḥ smṛtaḥjuhuyādibhasaṅghānāṃ vṛddhirbhavati nānyathādikkrameṇaiva pañcātha āyudhāni prakalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kramatopyuktamāyudhapañcakamjuhuyātsampātaṃ tatra pātayetvidadhyāddaivatānpañca pañcagavyaprapūritānmantrairbaliṃ havyaṃ nijaiḥ śubhaiḥrakṣā kamalā tatra vardhatevaśīkuryāttatpanīmutpalairapiśūdrāllaṁvaṇahomena grāmaṃ jātīprasūnakaiḥmukundaṃ ca manuprokteṣṭaliṅgakamproktaḥ prakāroyaṃ sumantribhiḥkulālasya karalagnāṃ pragṛhya caśataṃ cāṣṭādhikaṃ vaśyo bhavettu saḥvrīhimāngopayobhiśca paśumānbhavati dhruvamsarvasiddhiḥ syādannairannasamṛddhiyukdīrghāyurmantrī bhavati niścitamtu japtvā tā vikirecchatrusainyakejvarādikairmahārogaiḥ piḍitā sā nṛṇāṃ ciramhyupadravairnānāvidhairnāśaṃ prayāti camantrassarvamantrottamo mataḥvisargeṇānvitena cakapālāni ca dakṣādhaḥ krameṇa dadhatīṃ smaretpūjādikaṃ prayogādi navadurgāsamaṃ smṛtamkāśyāṃ te cārthadāstānvravīsyahamdakṣavaddevī kamalā samudīritātārādyā dhyānamasyā nirūpyatebhuvanaṃ bhāsayantīṃ sarojagām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadbāhye kamalādyaṣṭaśaktayaḥ [dvitīyārthe prathamā]evamabhyarcayellakṣmī bhavetsadyo dhanādhipaḥtaddaśāṃśaṃ sarasijaistrisvādvaktairhunetsudhīḥlakṣatrayaṃ japenmantrī bhavedarthānvito naraḥsāhasraṃ tāvadbilvairmadhuplutaiḥsaṃvatsarāddhanaṃ pūrṇaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥvāñchitārthāllaṁbhate vasudhānyasamṛddhiyukprasiddhosau gajānanaḥhakāraśca kalarā varṇapañcakamdvitīyaṃ syātproktoyaṃ tryakṣaro manuḥdevatoktā kūṭaṃ bījaṃ prakīrtitam|| atasīpuṣpasaṅkāśāṃ ratna bhūṣaṇabhūṣitāmkarābhyāṃ deveśīṃ varadābhayaśobhitāmprapūjayeddevīṃ ṣaḍaṃgāni tato yajetīśakoṇātkrameṇaiva brāhmyādyāśca dalāṣṭakeaṣṭādaśamahākoṭiyoginībhyo namostvitisamabhyarcya gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥdhyātvā trilakṣaṃ prajapetsudhīḥlakṣmīṃ sāmrājyaṃ syādasaṃśayammukhe māyānityaklinne madadavehrīṃ ca bījaṃ svathā śaktiḥ samīritāpādayośca mantrārṇānkramato nyasettāṃ cārusmaremukhāmbujāmvirājamānāṃ mukuṭalasadardhenduśekharāmbibhratīṃ padmamadhyāsīnāṃ madālasām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trikoṇamādau tasyāntaḥ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ bāhyake likhetyajeddevīṃ candanādibhiruttamaiḥdikṣu yajedaṃgāni ṣaṭ kramātdrāviṇīṃ ca drāvitāṃ cāṣṭapatrakedvārapārśveṣu koṇeṣu dikṣu dvādaśa pūjayettadbāhye tadastrāṇi tato bahiḥbandhūkapuṣpaiḥ svādvaktairjuhuyāddhaviṣātha vāātmānamabhiṣicyātha brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥprakūrvīta prayogānmantravittamaḥtadbhaktaḥ kuryāduktaṃ na cānyathākairavairaktairājñaśca svavarśaṃ nayetstambhanaṃ śatrornṛpādīnāṃ krudhopi cabhūṣāvāhanavāṇijyasiddhayaḥ syuḥ svavāṃchitāḥtattailāktairniśāmadhye tvānayedvāṃchitāṃ vadhūmmāsādarātistīvrārtijvareṇa paripīḍyatenaśyeyurdussādhyāśca cikitsakaiḥsiktairbījairaṃkolakairapivanitāṃ kāmajvarārtāmānayeddhruvamdhanamānakulairnityaṃ duṣprāpyāmānayedvadhūmhomācchālīnavāpnuyātjaṃghābhyāṃjānubhyāmūruyugmataḥhomānnaranārīnarādhipāḥmaricairjīrakairyutāmspṛśannijakāragreṇa sahasraṃ prajapenmanumnaranārīnṛpāstasya vaśyāssyurmaraṇāvadhi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sādhyanāmasphuṭaṃ kṛtvā prāgvatsampācya bhakṣaṇātkarpūravāsitaistoyairmanuṣyānvaśayetsthitānlavaṇayuktena toyena vanitā vaśānāmnaivaṃ sa tasya syādvaśe'niśamvaśyā dadyuḥ prāṇānapi priyānnameruvāsitaistoyaistarpaṇādbhūmipā vaśāḥcampakairvāsitajalaistarpaṇaṃ sarvarañjanamsarvalokacamatkārī dhruvaṃ bhavati nityaśaḥindracandanasaurabhyavāsitāmbhaḥ pratarpaṇaiḥkevaloṣṇodakaistasya tīvrajvarasamudbhavaḥjāyatenyonyavairuddhyaṃ yena te nāśamāpnuyuḥmukhyā devī śrīvidyayā samāmaimiti bījāni nityaklinne madadravecaturvargaphalapradāsamastenāṃgaṣaṭkaṃ syānnityaklinnāṃ smarettataḥvanaṃ nānākalpadrumānvitammanojñatṛṇapuṣpādyairyukte māṇikyamaṇḍapedevīmupaviṣṭāṃ ca saṃsmaretkalāṃ vīṇāṃ tryakṣāṃ nityāṃ smarāmyahamsayonikarṇikaṃ padmamaṣṭapatravirājitamsyādāhlādakāriṇyai jyeṣṭhāyai hṛdgudāsanesarvaśaktikamalāsanāya hṛdayāntataḥtatra yajedvakṣyamāṇena vartmanāmīṃ subhadrāṃ ca maṃgalāṃ vanacāriṇīmnāmamantreṇa pūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madamantharagāminyaḥ subhūṣāścārubhūṣaṇāḥṅehṛdantāṃścānaṃgādīnpūjayetkramātpañcapuṣpeṣupāśāhvanāṃkuśekṣudhanurbhṛtaḥbhūṣāyuktāḥ smaredvaktrakamalāḥ sādhu pūjayetṣaṇḍāntasvarahīnañca kakāraṃ bindubhūṣitatpūjāmantraḥ syātsarvāsāṃ cāpyanukramātdurbhatirnidhṛtirvidhṛtistuṣṭiścāpi vituṣṭikābāhye tadastrāṇi tato bahiḥtarpaṇādyaṃ ca kṛtvā saṃtoṣya deśikampūrvamantroditānsamyakpūrvoktavidhinā sudhīḥpramadājanaiḥathātosyāḥ pravakṣyāmi dvādaśārṇaṃ mahāmanummanuḥ prokto muniḥ sammohano mataḥṣaḍaṃgāni kṛtvā devīṃ vicintayetsṛṇiṃ pāśaṃ kapālaṃ bibhratīṃ karaiḥyajeddevīṃ proktāṃgāni purā yajetnīlakamalakapālāḍhyakarāmbujāmahākālīṃ samastajanamohinīmvāmamārgeṇa hyasyāḥ siddhiḥ prajāyatesvāhā śakravarṇo mantraḥ kālyā udīritaḥyatheṣṭabhakṣyapānābhyāṃ maithunena prasīdatibrāhmyādibhiḥ śaktibhiśca yuktā bhaktyā prapūjayetśaktiśūladhanurbāṇakheṭakhaḍgavarābhayāndhyātvaivaṃ siddhakaḥ sādhyaṃ sādhayenmanasi sthitamtathendrāṇī cāmuṇḍā caṇḍikāṣṭamī || 772 |||
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tamodevī mahākālī bhayāpahātataḥ kṛtvā siddho mantraḥ [tasyeti śeṣ'ḥ] prajāyatekruddho devīmantraṃ japaṃstathāhanti kālikāmantrayogataḥnāryaḥ pātivratyavratāccyutāḥpātivratyādbhraṃśitāstāḥ pāparāśirmahānabhūtsamāsādya gṛhasthāḥ sukhino bhavanmahāyoginīṃ procya gaurīmuktvā bhuveti camunirdevī gāyatrī chanda īritampunarevantrirāvṛtyā ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaretdaṃṣṭrākarālavadanāṃ trinetrāṃ sarvatojjvalāmtriśūlacakracaṣakakhaṭvāṅgavarapaṅkajāmkṛtyāṃ vidhānenapūjayenmantravittamaḥpratiṣṭhāñca tathā vidyāṃ tadbāhye tu caturdaledvibhujāṃ saumyavaradāṃ pāśāṃkuśadharāṃ śivāmjapenmantraṃ nityamaṣṭottaraṃ śatampratimāṃ māraṇe cāpyadhomukhīmcandragauraṃ vidhāyāgniṃ paristīrya śaraistṛṇaiḥjuhuyānnimbatailāktaiḥ kākolūkotthaviṭkakaiḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ caiva mamunā juhuyādbudhaḥviṣakravyamasṛktasyetthamuktvā ca nivedayettenāśaṃ tāvadasya ripormatiḥmantreṇa ripuṃ dhyātvā niruddhadṛknātra saṃśayaḥśatruḥ satyamauśanasoditam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: parastryāliṅganaṃ tasyā lābho rodanameva caraṇadyūtavimardeṣu jayo nigaḍabandhanam[mayūralābhaḥ ||] śvetavastraṃ puṣpacandanadhāraṇampaśyettadā sādhakasya jñeyā siddhiritastataḥvandhyācarmatuṣāgnyādilavaṇāṅgāramindhanamsaṃnyāsī nagnastyaktaḥ kṣudhāturaḥkārpāso garbhiṇī ca rajasvalākhañjakubjakaukāryaṃ syādrogī mṛtyumavāpnuyātsalilandṛṣṭvā naraḥ śokamavāpnuyātsnānaṃ putrabhāryāvināśanamraktagandhāmbaraḥ sragvī kṛṣṇo vā dakṣiṇāmukhaḥmaṭhe gehe dvāraṃ yasya pidhīyatesvapne tasyāyurdaśamāsakampāṣāṇaistāḍyate vāpi tasya mṛtyurna saṃśayaḥdakṣiṇāśāmprasthito yastasya mṛtyurna saṃśayaḥvṛkṣāṇāmadhikārāccyutirbhavetgṛhasammārjanaṃ lepo gomayena mṛdāpi vārogādvimucyeta hāniḥ svasthasya jāyatevāmāṅge kokilāḥ śivāḥdakṣe kākarkṣakukkurāḥdhanalābhādi bahuvyāpāraśobhanamghṛtāktānāṃ samidhāṃ cāṃ śataṃ hunetdīpandadyādvipragehe viṣṇorgehe śivālayehānireva syāccānyadevaṃ vicintayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: maricaṃ piṣṭvā tatraiva lepayetkṣipetkṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ japtvā mantraṃ sahasraśaḥvilikhenmantrī kṛṣṇasarpāsyaśoṇitaiḥkākavadbhramate dhruvamuṣṭrāsthnā ca śavāṅgāraiḥ śatroruccāṭanaṃ bhavetannaiḥ samidbhiḥ pālāśaiḥ śāntiṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥmadhuratrayasaṃsiktairebhiḥ kuryāttu vaśyakammahāvyādhipraśamanaṃ nityamaṣṭādhikaṃ śatamgajārūḍhāṃ vihaṃgamāmsalilādibhayāpahāmviṣamapyamṛtambhavetyaḥ kurute martyaḥ sa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyātsaṅgoptrīṃ samastasuratuṣṭidāmakālamṛtyumathinī sadā vijayavarddhinīāyuṣyapālinī puṣṭilakṣmīsaubhāgyavaśyakṛtmahāvyādhipraśaminī hyapasmāravināśinītiṣṭhanti ḍākinyādyā viśeṣataḥlikhetpadmaṃ yoniyuktaṃ sabindukamrasakoṇaṃ tu likhenmūlamanuṃ smarannyasyettanmadhyagaṃ kumbhaṃ vastraratnavibhūṣitamyathānyāyaṃ pāyasantu nivedayetjuhuyādājyasaṃsiktāpāmārgatilasarpiṣāsthaṇḍile vāpi homakarmma samācaretkumbhamadhye nyaseddevīṃ dakṣiṇe tu śriyaṃ smaretvāmapārśve tu pūjayedgaṇanāyakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhrūṇahatyāyāṃ madyapāne sahasrakampañcalakṣamitaṃ japetsādhayenmantramimaṃ parimalāhvayammanorasya jape kṛtepheṇikā mudgā māṃsantu vaṭakeṇḍirāḥvṛntākaśāko matsyārthe vā mādadhikasiddhidaḥprapañcepi śaktibhirbahudhā tathākedārasya tu paścimepravakṣyāmi sordhvāmnāyena siddhidamgaṇapatiṃ varayugmaṃ dāntaṃ sarvajanaṃ vadetprokto gāyatraṃ chanda īritamrudreṣupaṃcavedāṃganetravarṇairmanoḥ kramātmahāgaṇeśavatsarvaṃ prayogādikamācaretūrdhvāmnāyagaṇapatimantraprakāśaḥ saptadaśaḥviriyugmaṃ ca gaṇapate varadvayammantraḥ proktoyaṃ putrapautradaḥdṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradaḥvibhaktairmūlamantrārṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṃgāni samācaretcāṃkuśaṃ dakṣatale madhye kapālakamhastimukhaṃ dakṣiṇena kareṇa caliṃgāgrantu gaṇeśasya ūrdhvayoḥ karayordvayoḥprokte navaśaktisamanviteyajedādāvāmodādīndigambarānarcayellokapālāṁśca tadastrāṇi tato bahiḥvakṣye virivighneśvarasya tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekonaviṃśatyarṇoyaṃ nivṛcchanda udāhṛtamdhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi hyūrdhvādūrdhvakareṣu tupadmaṃ pāśabāṇānradaṃ ratnāḍhyakumbhakamāliṃgayantamaruṇaṃ sravanmadakapolakamkuṇḍalinaṃ dhyāyeddevaṃ gajānanamsaumyasthaṃ viriñcigaṇanāyakamprāgvadvadedvarādīni ṣaḍviṃśatyarṇako manuḥdhyānapūjādikaṃ prāgvadviśeṣādasya sādhakaḥprajāyeta kartā hartā yathāvidhimadhuratrayasaṃyuktaiḥ pūrvoktairaṣṭabhirhunetvaśayetsakalaṃ jagatmodakānājyasaṃyuktānhutvā vijayamāpnuyātbhakṣyabhojyādikaiḥ kṛtaḥhrīmiticchandosya virāḍbhārgava ucyateṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena ṣaḍaṃgāni prakalpayettrinetraṃ ca pāśāṃkuśadharaṃ vibhummodakāścaiva dhārayantaṃ tvanusmaretdevaṃ caturasratrayāvṛtelokapālaiḥ syādvajrādyaiśca caturthikātaddaśāṃśaṃ prajuhuyādapūpairghṛtasamplutaiḥcaturthyāṃ tu pūjayitvā vināyakammaricairjīrakaiścaiva saindhavena vimiśritaiḥvāṇī saptāhādbhavati dhruvamjuhuyāllājaistannāmāyutamantrataḥprāpte palantu kapilāghṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: niyato bhūtvā devatādhyānatatparaḥsaptāhājjāyate śīghramaparo vākpatiryathāniṣkārdhapādamānena haridrāṃ saindhavaṃ vacāmsubhakṣyabhojyaiśca bhojayitvā ca kanyakāḥsā labhate putraṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutamnigaditaśchando gāyatramucyateṣaḍaṃgāni dhyānamasya nirūpyatepāśākṣasūtradaśanāndhārayantaṃ tathāṃkuśammadhyāhnādityasaṃkāśaṃ cāruśaktyā samanvitamprathamāvṛttiraṃgaiḥ syāddalaṣaṭke tataḥ parampūjayedbāhye bhūpure lokapālakānjapenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ samāhitaḥkuryādevaṃ siddho bhavenmanuḥājyānnairjuhuyānnityamannavānvatsarādbhavetlabhetkanyāmenaṃ yo bhajate naraḥca mahetyukatvā ṅentaṃ gaṇapatiṃ punaḥākhyāto devaḥ śaktivināyakaḥmantrārṇairaṅgakḷptirihoditāpadmasṛṇī dadhānaṃ vāma ūrdhvakemaṇimayaṃ mukuṭaṃ bibhrataṃ prabhumpīṭhe virivighneśavartmanāapūpairghṛtasaṃyuktairvidhivatpūjitenalesiddhamanurmantrī prayogānvidhivaccaretnārikelaiśca homo lokavaśaṅkaraḥsaktubhiśca kṛto homo brāhmaṇānāṃ vaśaṅkaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kartavyāḥ prayogāḥ sādhakairihagaṃ hrīṃ ca vaśamānaya svāhā bhavāṇarkaḥvarekṣūnhastapaṃkajaiḥśyāmalāṅgyā liṅgapadmahastayā bhāvayeddhṛdijuhuyāttarpaṇādi tataścaretkāmyaprayogāstu tatkalpoktānprasādhayetgaṇeśo na śaktiścāpi na taṃ vināpravakṣyāmi śaktiṃ śrībhuvaneśvarīmśaktirvaśiṣṭhaśca sūtaśchandosya kathyatebhavedbījamīkāraḥ śaktirucyateṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṃgāni samācaretdevyekatāpādanāya mantranyāsotha vakṣyatehṛdaye sthāpyā gude hrīṃ ca karālikāūrdhvodagyāmyapūrvāśāpratyekastheṣu ca kramātdakṣakuce brahmāṇīṃ vāmageṃsakevinyasedbhāle gāyatryā sahitaṃ sudhīḥvāmagaṇḍe ca vāgīśvaryā yutaṃ nyasetvāme dhanapatiṃ yuktaṃ śriyā śrotrāgrake nyasetdakṣaśrotrāgrake mantrī nidhī śaktiyutau nyasetvāmāṃse hṛdidakṣiṇenyasyenmātṛraṣṭabhāle cāṃse pārśve tathodarevyāpayenmūlamantreṇa tanuṃ devīṃ tataḥ smaretmandasmitalasanmukhīmṣaṭkoṇaṃ tadbāhyeṣṭadalāmbujamcaturdvārasamopetaṃ maṇḍalaṃ proktamuttamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caivājitākhyā cāparājitāśaktayaḥ pūjyāḥ keśareṣu ca madhyakedevīmāvāhayettasyāmaṅgāvaraṇasaṃyutāmsamabhyarcya vividhābharaṇojjvalāḥagnīśāsuravāyavyakoṇeṣvagrehṛdādikāngāyatrīmaruṇābhāsāmaruṇākalpabhūṣitāmbibhratīṃ tadvadbrahmāṇaṃ purato yajetpītavasanāṃ keyūrāṅgadabhūṣitāmviṣṇuṃ rakṣaḥkoṇegrake yajetṭaṅkākṣasūtrābhayadavarayuktāṃ caturbhujāmpriyāṃkasaṃsthāṃ ca dakṣeṇāliṅgyabāhunāpītaṃ ratnaghaṭaṃ ratnakarañjaṃ bibhratīṃ yajetbāṇaguṇasṛṇicāpakarañjakamsṛṇipāśadharaṃ kāntāvarāṅgaspṛkkarāṃgulimvigaladratnasphuraccaṣakadhāriṇamāśliṣṭakāntāmaruṇāṃ puṣṭimarceddigambarāmtvanaṅgakusumā hyanaṅgakusumāturāsyācchaśiśīrṣā ca saptamīpāśāṃkuśavarābhītikarā raktāḥ subhūṣitāḥśrīdurgoṣā lakṣmīśrutyau smṛtirdhṛtiḥsamabhyarcyāḥ śaktayaḥ paricārikāḥsyādagre bhuvanapālikāceti tadbāhye tu digīśvarānraktotpalakarāṃ vāme dakṣiṇe kramatastvidamcāṃśukaṃ puṣpaṃ bibhrāṇāṃ dakṣiṇaiḥ karaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: citte caturbhirapi cottamāmadhyāstrāvaraṇaiḥ pūjāṅgalokeśatadastrakaiḥananyagatikā pūjā hyaṃgenaikena kīrtitāpāpaṃ pūjālope tathā bhavetvāmī ravau pūjāṃ na lopayetdvātriṃśallakṣamānena japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥtataḥ kuryānmantrī śāstroktavartmanādakṣiṇāmūrtimāśritaḥkṛṣṇāṣṭamīṃ samārabhya yāvatkṛṣṇā caturdaśīdadhikṣaudraghṛtābhyaktā vyāghātasamidho hunetbhavenmantro nātra kāryā vicāraṇātilasarṣapadugdhājyadravyāṇyaṣṭamitāni casiddhamanurmantrī sarvānkāmānprasādhayetbhavedvāgmī tāvajjaptāmbupānataḥtajjaptamañjanaṃ vaśyaṃ karpūrāgurumiśritamtadrātryāmiṣṭāmākarṣayetstriyam[vaśyakaramityarthaḥ ||]bṛhaspatisamomantrī sarvavidyādhipo bhavetvaśayetpadmahomena rājñastanmantriṇastathāpiṣṭakṛtāṃ pratimāṃ svādusaṃyutāmpramadāṃ vāpi yaṃ yaṃ vāñchatyanuttamamdarśayedāśu sā sukhaprasavā bhavetmaṇḍalaṃ kuryāddevīpīṭhānvitaṃ śubhamdalāgre tu svarṇaraupyasutāmrajānnijeṣṭāyai ca mantravit
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcakalaśā madhyādiṣu yajetkramātghṛtakumbhena kaṣāyeṇa tataḥ paramkvāthairabhiṣiñcettataḥ sudhīḥvaktrahastapadakṣālācamanānyapi mantravittvevaṃ śakto naro bhavetmahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ sarvadā vijayī bhavetagnimanthalakṣasevyanāmnoḥ karma viduttamaḥudumbarīpāṭalīndukubhāgāḥ parikīrtitāḥca sekāddīrghāyuruttamamdhānyasamākulamtatputrāḥ śayānāḥ pathisādhakamaṃgulyādiṣaḍaṅgāni śeṣanyāsāśca pūrvavatratnapātraṃ vāmahaste dakṣe padmaṃ tato manumtrisvāduyuktahaviṣā tarpaṇādi tataścaretbrahmavṛkṣaprasūnaiśca homo lakṣmīprado mataḥvānyaṃ vaśayennātra saṃśayaḥratnaughai rājyalakṣmīṃ ca vindatipūrvoditānprayogāṃśca kuryādatrāpi sādhakaḥaiṃhrīṃ-aimiti munyādyā jñeyāḥ pūrvoditāstathāṣaḍaṅgāni vidadhyānmantravittamaḥtrinayanāṃ pīnavakṣojanāmitāmmuktāhārasamāyuktāṃ bhāvayedbhuvaneśvarīmpūrvavatpūjyā hṛllekhādyāśca mantriṇānijanāthāṅkasthitāḥ smerānanālasāḥsaṃhāraḥ proktāstatpatayastvime
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śūlaṃ kapālaṃ pretaṃ ca kṣudradundubhimeva cavakrakeśāśca pūjākāle suṃmantriṇāsvarapatreṣu karālādyāḥ puroditāḥjapettattvalakṣaṃ brahmavṛkṣaprasūnakaiḥjuhuyāttarpaṇādīni kuryānmantrasya siddhayeekākṣaroditānsarvānprayogānācarettathāhrīṃkromiti vahnyarṇo munyādyekākṣaroditamprodyadarkakāntiṃ hṛdi vibhāvayetṣaḍaṅgāni brāhmyādyā dalamadhyataḥpūjayedbhaktyā sa bhavettu kuberavatjapettattvalakṣaṃ juhuyāttatsahasrakamśuddhaistilaiḥ payoyuktaistarpaṇādi tataścaretsamākhyātāḥ pratyekaṃ ṣaṭsahasrakamsūryasadṛśastenādhiṣṭhitamandiramsarvajanairetanmantraprasādataḥrājānaṃ rājapatnīṃ vaśaṃ nayetlakṣmīrenaṃ na santyajetpāpānāṃ nāśo mantriṇa eva himanau mantrī bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyātmantraḥ proktaścāyaṃ ṣaḍakṣaraḥsurāsuranamaskṛtaḥṣaḍbhirmantragatairvarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayetṣaḍakṣarāṇyatho nyasya sarveṇa vyāpakaṃ tathāsmerāsyamaruṇaṃ cintayeddhṛdicaturasratrayeṇātha veṣṭitaṃ ca kramāllikhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvadigdalamūleṣu śaktīraṣṭau kramādyajetpāpaghnī tathā puṇyā śaśiprabhātadvadvakratuṇḍādikānyajetsamyagvakratuṇḍārcanaṃ tvitiaṣṭadravyaiḥ purā proktairmadhurāktairyathāvidhitarpayetpūrvamārgeṇa vakratuṇḍaṃ gaṇeśvarammathitvāgnimanūcānagṛhāddharetpūrvoktavatkṛtvā mantranyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakamtatrātha nāgayajñopavītinampadmāsanasamārūḍhaṃ caturbāhuṃ trilocanammanasā samāvāhya gaṇeśvaramtataḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥtvapūpairjuhuyādvatsarāllabhate dhanamlakṣmīṃ prāpnotyayatnataḥmantribhiḥbhavanaṃ bhavedvaiśravaṇopamaḥmantrī dhanavānbhavetsajīrakairbahuguḍaiḥ śubhairatighṛtāplutaiḥlabhate mahatīmacirācchriyamapāmārgasamidbhirvā pakvaiḥ panasajaiḥ phalaiḥlājakairjuhuyādagnau sahasraṃ kanyakāptayejuhuyāllakṣaṃ mṛtyuñjayo bhavetjuhuyānmantrī māsāchatrūñjayedhruvamśmaśānāgnau juhuyānmārayedripummārayetsaptadinairnātra kāryā vicāraṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidhāyācamanantatra sāmānyārghyaṃ vidhāya cavighnāndivyānāsphoṭanena capārthivānpārṣṇighātaiśca tribhirutsārayettataḥutsārayet vighnānāṃ dadanmārgaṃ tu dakṣiṇeśākte vāmapādapuraḥsaramarghyābunā ca gavyena yāgasthāne susecayetsaṃvīkṣya mūlamanunā tvastreṇa prokṣayettataḥśrīkhaṇḍāgurumantraiśca dhūpitestreṇa saptadhāsalājānvikirenmantrī pratyūhaghnānhi maṇḍapevardhanyā īśāne sthāpayecca tānlikhetpaścātsarvatobhadramaṇḍalamdhṛtivargasamāḥ kāryāḥ koṣṭhakāścaturasrakāḥpañcabhiḥ koṣṭhaiḥ śṛṅkhalā kṛṣṇavarṇikāśṛṅkhalobhayato bhadramaruṇaṃ navabhiḥ padaiḥṣoḍaśapadmaṃ tu ruciraṃ veṣṭayedbahiḥathānyatsampravakṣyāmi kuryāttāntrikakarmaṇiṣaḍvargakoṣṭhāni mārjayettatra saṃlikhetvṛttatrayaṃ madhye samaṃ kuryādyathāvidhipatrāgraṃ tyaktabhāgataḥtribhiḥ koṣṭhaiḥ pādānkoṇeṣu vinyasetkuryānmārjayitā caturdikṣu ca madhyataḥkoṣṭhatrayeṇa caikena pratyekaṃ dvārapārśvayoḥkoṣṭhaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ kośāni kalpayetsamāḥ kāryāḥ sīmarekhā dalāni capūraṇīyāni raktenaiva dalānyapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vaḍavāmukhe vahnau mahotkaṭetridinenāsau śatrumuccāṭayeddhruvammantrī pāpaughaṃ nāśayeddhruvamdhyāyeddoṣāngrahabhavānharetjuhuyāddhānyairannārthyannairhuneddhruvampalalairguḍābhyaktairhunetsudhīḥniṣkārdhārdhapramāṇena sampiṣyaitāni nityaśaḥvatsarātsutamcūrṇaṃ vacāyāśca palārdhakammahatīṃ kavitāṃ labhate dhruvamsthāpayetkumbhaṃ pūjitaṃ candanādibhiḥjapettanmantrapravaramaṣṭottarasahasrakamprasādānnātra saṃśayaḥmunirasyāṇoranuṣṭupcchanda īritamsarvaṃ mantrī pūrvavadācaretrāyaspoṣasya dayitā nidhidoratnado mataḥjuhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥmantrī sādhayediṣṭamātmanaḥvakṣyāmi mantramanyaṃ tathāvidhamrakṣohaṇobalagahanovakratuṇḍāya hūmitivakratuṇḍagāyatrīṃ gaṇapriyāmpracodayātnityaṃ puraścaraṇakṛnnaraḥjapādyantethāṣṭasaṃkhyānanyajāpī susiddhayepūrvāmnāyagaṇapatimantraprakāśoṣṭādaśaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nānāścaryakarānkāśīsaṃsthitāngaṇanāyakāngṛhītvā tu yoginīṃ ceṭikāmapiaṣṭāvaraṇakairaṣṭau saṃsthitāḥ siddhidāyakāḥbahiṣkāśyākīrtitaḥ paridhistu saḥkṣipraprasādanasamamaṣṭānāṃ sādhanaṃ smṛtampūrvavaccātra kṣiprameva ca siddhayaḥnāndyarṇassabindustannāmamantra itīritaḥśivapatnīti śaṃ śive svakareti canirūpyatepāśaṃ dadhānāṃ prabhaje śivāmsiddhamanurmantrī ceṭikāṃ ca prasādhayetpūjayitvā japenmantrantadā nādāñchṛṇoti catadānekasurairyuktā pratyakṣākhya śivā bhavetkṣaṇenaiva manasopyativegavānmohitā bahavo janāḥvarṇalakṣampuraścaryā gaṇeśānāṃ prakīrtitānāmamantrāssmṛtā mantravarṇalakṣampuraskriyāyoginīsevanādatra na vighnaiḥ paribhūyatecātra jaṭilā viṣadhāriṇīvarṇadvitayātpātālatalavāsinīmsvasthāṃ karatālīmanoramāmjapedayutasaṃkhyākaṃ śāntātmā tālakānanekarpūrāguruyuktaiśca pūrṇaṃ tattriḥ pradakṣiṇamjapedrātrau sahasradvitayaṃ manumāyāti prakāśotīva jāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nīlāṃśukaparīdhānā kastūrīcandanapriyāmantriṇe tuṣṭā sā dadāti phalatrayamca jagatīmohanakṣamamcāsya gṛddhā syādveṣataḥ sā tapasvinīpaṃcavārṣikītyuktvā bāle vacanamādhurīmceti dhyānamasyā nirūpyatecaṃdrāvataṃsāṃ lalitavacanāṃ netrasuṃdarīmtatpaścātkuṃkumena cadhattūrakusumairhomaṃ sahasraikaṃ samācaretnagno vā siddhamantraḥ samācarettadgṛhe gatvā nagno bālāmanuṃ japetdrumārūḍhā dhāvaṃstatsannidhau vrajetjihvā rasasandohinī bhavetvyāghrādipaśujātīnāṃ mohanaṃ tadvaco bhavetnamaśceti prokto mantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥgajānteti tile dehiyugaṃ vadetvahnermantraḥ samākhyāto nāganetramitākṣaraḥtādṛgvanavibhūṣitehomaṃ kuryāddaśāṃśataḥtathāṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe vidhau niśibhīṣayanti na bhetavyaṃ tadā kvacitsamārabdhe tadā kātyāyanī svayamsiñcettataḥ sāpi prayāti cagajamuṇḍañcarvayantī vamantī śoṇitambhuvibhairavāṃstāṃśca tato bhālodbhavāsṛjā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nagarendirārudravarṇoyaṃ mantraḥ proktosya yoginīharitālākṣī mantraḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥvahnijāyāṃ dhyānamasyā nirūpyateharitālākṣīṃ siddhidāṃ śaṃ vitanvatīmdhruvam || ādime divase rātrau gatvā vai nirjane vanejapedayutasaṃkhyakamkuryātkuliṅgena haritālarasaspṛśāsādhakastāṃ na viśvasetratikalāṃ sādhakāya prayacchatikhecaraṃ kurvatī sadyo nayeddeśe vicintitemantriṇo vaśamādarātnānā vastu pradarśayethayagrīvā bhavenmāsopavāsinīnāgavāhane phurphurvahnigehinīca phūtkārāhatabhūruhāmsiddhiḥ prajāyatehunettasya daśāṃśataḥlambo dṛśyate yugaviṃśakaḥpurastāttasya nirbhītyā sthātavyaṃ tena mantriṇāvaktrācchataṃ jvālā nissaranti punaḥ punaḥdhūmapatriṇaścāpi śākhinaḥdṛśyate devī tannāgaphaṇasaṃsthitābhūmiṣṭhānvāṇī satyā prajāyatemadhuvāsinī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: coccārya klīṃsvāheti manuḥ smṛtaḥdhyāyennavarasāṃ devīṃ mṛgākṣīṃ brahmasaukhyadāmmadhupuṣpairathāpi vāsitāṣṭamyāmekāṃte nirjane japetprāgvatsahasraṃ syājjapennavasahasrakamviṣāṇena dakṣahastena sampibanyakṣo hi latāvṛkṣādi gulmakānprāpnuyāttasmānmithyātrāsādibhistadāyakṣe devī vṛkṣatale tadāvitastimātrantena syātsarvamohanakārakaḥprayacchanti tasmai kāmavimohitāḥproktā maṃtro jinamitākṣaraḥtuṃ ghaṃ maṃ vahnigehinīmjapākusumaśoṇāṃgī mama cittasya mantharāracayitvā śubhaṃ sthalam || 90 |||mallāriṣaṣṭhīrātrau tu japetsome śatadvayammadhupātraṃ hi divyamādhvīkamiśritamspaṣṭayā dadyātpūjāṃte yanmanogatamsandeho manorasya prabhāvataḥtāṃ devīṃ madhupānaiḥ prapūjayetrasapañcasamīpe tu bhūmipūjāṃ viṣetaḥkuṃkumaiścādisindūrai raktacandanavandanaiḥtāvadbhiḥ paripūjayetbhagavate pūrvaṃ ṅentantannāma coccarettatra nāpitīrūpadhāriṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: siddhimicchettadyuktāya padaṃ vadetmahāgaṇapavatsarvaṃ tatastāṃ siddhimāpnuyāthyeṣā mūrtikārūpadhāriṇīhaṃsageṃbodhamiti vākchrībījāgni vallabhāḥvaradābhayahastāṃ ca saṃseve haṃsagāminīmhomaṃ padmākṣairājyasaṃyutaiḥhiraṇyakaśipuprāṇanāśakālatithau dhruvamhotavyaṃ padmākṣaiḥ khakhakhāṣṭakamtasmai padmamālāṃ prayacchatikāśyā yāmye durgavināyakaḥdurgāyai hṛdayāntoṣṭavarṇakaḥyayā durgavadhārthaṃ sevito gaṇaḥ [gaṇeśaḥ]kramādādyantayormāyāṃ durgāyai ceti madhyataḥpallavādyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni ceti mantrāḥ prakīrtitāḥśaṅkhacakradhanurbāṇāndadhatīṃ trīkṣaṇāṃ bhajeśaktisamarcanamvijayā pūrvadalātsarvārthasiddhidāvajranakhadaṃṣṭāyudhāyaproktvāmahāpadamsamākhyātastena siṃhaṃ prapūjayetprathamāvṛttiraṅgaiḥ syāddvitīyā tu prabhādibhiḥṅentairnamontaistṛtīyāvaraṇaṃ parikīrtitammedhā śrutiścāpi caturthāvaraṇaṃ kramātbāhyavīthīdvaye lokapālānastrāṇi ca kramātsvādulolitairvā payondhasāmantrī prayogānācaretsudhīḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcaratnasamāyuktānnavasthāneṣu vinyasetsamabhyarcya dhūpadīpaiśca mantravitvijayaśrīsamāyukto rājā bhavati nānyathāputraṃ vinītaṃ prāpnuyācchubhambahvāyuścāghanāśanamtasyāḥ sādhanamucyatedadhānāṃ ca pīnonnatapayodharāmsahośīrairdaśāṃśaṃ homamācaretbilvavṛkṣāṇāmekāntepyatha vā sudhīḥhunetprāgvaddevīṃ tathā yajetmantriṇe śīghraṃ sphaṭikākhyaṃ manoharamparasyāpi sarvajño jāyate naraḥtvaṣṭavaktrāsya vaṇikkarma prakurvatī [prakurute |]svāhetyudito manuḥkamalākṣairbhaveddhomastattatkāmyaṃ samācaretjapenmantraṃ samastāṃ rātrimantataḥvastrairājamandiragairapikoṭarākṣyasya ceṭī syāddadhidugdhadāsvāheti mantrotha tasya dhyānamihocyatesvarṇakuṇḍalakṣiptāḍhyagaṇḍāntaṃ vidhipūrvakamtrimadhuraiḥ prayogaṃ tata ācaretdvitīyāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe niśāntaresāyantanaṃ karma kuśūlaṃ pūjayettataḥbaddhāsano yogī śītavādhāmupekṣya hitrinetrāṃ ca paśyedaṣṭabhujāṃ śivām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatastasmai jalenāsecayetsutamtatkālaṃ tattatkarma karoti cabhavetkubjā vyālagrāhā svarūpataḥtasmānmahiṣamardinyā mantraṃ vakṣye samāsataḥmahiṣamarddinīpaṃcāṅgāni prakalpayetmāhiṣe śīrṣe naumi bhālavilocanāmkārmukaṃ kheṭakaṃ hastairbibhratīṃ śaśiśekharāmpītāmbaradharāṃ devīṃ pīnonnatakucadvayāmprathamāvṛttiraṅgaiḥ syāddurgādyābhiḥ pareritākanakākhyātu kṛttikā cābhayapradāklībāntarahitaṃ cātra grāhyaṃ dīrghasvarāṣṭakamprocya tṛtīyāvaraṇe yajetprajapedvasulakṣaṃ ca tatsahasraṃ tilairhunettilahomādvaśīkāro nṛṇāṃ strīṇāṃ bhavet dhruvamrājñaḥ saṃgrāme vijayo bhavetbrahmavṛkṣotthakusumairlabhate puṣṭimuttamāmmaricahomataḥupāsitopāsitātinikaṭe drutasiddhidātatra saṃsthitādaśākṣaro manuḥ prokto bhajatāmiṣṭasiddhidaḥjātiyuktā cāṅgakḷptiḥ kāmyakarma hyathocyatesyācchikhā varmma bhūtarakṣākṣi kīrtitamtrinetrāṃ siṃhavāhinīmtaddaśāṃśaṃ hunedghṛtaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: siddhamanurmantrī prayogānācarettataḥhanyānnātra kāryā vicāraṇāpatākādhvajadundubhiḥsaṃmuhyetsa ca saṃgrāme labhate vijayaṃ khalujāyate tārānnama uktvā ca pūrvavatpūrvavatproktaṃ dhyānapūjādikaṃ tathākāśīprāntasthitā ete kīrtitā gaṇanāyakā.ḥkāśyāṃ vai vedakarmapravartakāḥvedastvanādistasyātra drutaṃ siddhiḥ prajāyatepāpahartā ca vāmamārgaprasādhakaḥnidhidātā dvijādhipaḥnāmāni sarvasiddhikarāṇi canāmānusāriṇī siddhiravaśyaṃ syānna saṃśayaḥsīmāvināyakā aṣṭau mantrasteṣāṃ nirūpyatetannāmagaṃ procyahṛdayānto manuḥ smṛtaḥdhātrīrūpaṃ samāśritāḥśūlinīti vadedduṣṭagrahe tataḥmunirdīrghatamāśchandaḥ kakubuktaṃ ca devatāsyāddhṛdayaṃ śīrṣaṃ varade vindhyavāsinīvadetpaścāttrāsaya rūpamīritamvarmāstrāntāḥ prakīrtitāḥśarīrādau dhyāyeddurgāṃ surairnutāmpāśadhanurdigbhirhastaiśca bibhratīmkanyakābhiḥ parivṛtāṃ tryakṣāṃ bhūṣaṇabhūṣitāmdurgāpīṭhe purā prokte dhyātvā devīṃ prapūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: varadā vindhyavāsinya suramardinīsumahāyogeśvarīti gaditāśca tāḥpāśaṃ devyagrataścaitānpūjayecca pradakṣiṇamjapenmantraṃ juhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥviprānvidhivadbhaktyābhyarcya guruṃ tataḥvidhānena gurorājñāpuraḥsaramvicintya prajapenmantraṃ yastaṃ spṛṣṭvā vidhānataḥtadānīṃ ca bhūtasaṅghaḥ palāyatevidravantyāśu grahāścopagrahādayaḥprajuhuyācchatruryamasyātithyamāpnuyātśaktirasyāpratihatā vatsarātprāgbhavedalamsamyagaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvospitamupavrajettrisahasramitaṃ japtaṃ yiyāsordvārisaṅkhanetnikhātaṃ ca senāstambhaṃ karotyalampānīyānnakarāṃ caiva prasannāṃ prajapenmanumsahasrabhṛtyavargeṇa sahito nātra śaṃśayaḥvaśyāstathāśvatthasamidvaraiḥdurgākalpoditānsarvānprayogānsādhayetsudhīḥsādhakābhīṣṭadāyinīvṛtte svāhānto dvinakhākṣaraḥanyacchūlinidurgāvatsavarmasyāḥ prakīrtitamsvadaṃṣṭrā yoginī cāsya nānāsaṅgītakovidālakṣamito mataḥviśālalocanāṃ vande nīrakṣīravidhāyinīmpūrvānvayi] bhūmau tu kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimātithau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pītapādāḥ sarvavarṇairviniścayātupaśobhāśca vipreṇa pītagarbhāśca kṛṣṇataḥpatramūlaphalākārāmaṇḍitā hṛdayaṅgamāḥkalpavallīśca pītaraktena keśarānkoṇāni bahī rekhātrayaṃ tataḥsarvatantreṣvidaṃ proktaṃ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalamtatra koṣṭhakāravivargakāḥpaṃktyā bhavetpīṭhaṃ dvāraśobhāstu pūrvavatpīṭhapādāḥ paridhayaḥ padmādyaṃ pūrvavanmatampaṅkajaṃ madhye tadbāhye vīthikā tu vāpadmāni caturbhiḥ koṣṭhakaiścaretcatuṣkapadmavīthīnāṃ madhye svastikasannibhamśuklahāridraraktanīlaiḥ prapūrayethyetannavanāgaṃ suśobhanamekakoṣṭhacatuṣkādyaṃ pañcapadmaṃ pravakṣyatepūryā vīthikā tu pīṭhe tu surayoniṣucaturasraṃ catuṣṣaṣṭikoṣṭhakaṃ yo niveśayetmadhyasthacaturasrāṇi dvāssthākhyāni tu pūrvataḥkoṇakoṣṭhaṃ vihāyaikaṃ pañca te pādasañjñitāḥāgneyītaḥ koṇakoṣṭhānyāraktaharitāsitaiḥcatvāri madhye vṛttāni kārayetkarṇikākāraṃ sitarekhāvṛtaṃ tataḥpītaraktaśvetavarṇamūlamadhyāgrakesaramtṛtīyāṃśatulyavyāsaṃ ca vartulamkṛṣṇavarṇaṃ prāgvadrekhāṃ sitāṃ kuru
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahāśabdaḥ prasannāsmīti śobhanaḥnīrānvitaṃ tataḥ kṣīraṃ jāyate kṣīramādarātkṛtvā kāśyāṃ sadā ratāṅentamuktvāsvāhāntoṣṭādaśākṣaraḥpuraścaraṇamasya tujapenmahāmatrī rātrau valmīkabhūmiṣusamastaviṣanāśinīmceṭī tatsādhanaṃ bruvesaptadaśārṇoyaṃ japedvarṇasahasrakamkaṇṭhamātreyutaṃ caikaṃ dhyāyandevīṃ samāhitaḥvṛṣṭirāyāti sā hi pañcadināvadhiśaktirmantrādyasya nirūpyatevirāṭ chando devatā tu sarasvatīśrotrayonasordṛṣṭayoḥ kapolāsye tathendriyevāgdevīṃ candraśekharāmsvaradvandvaṃ tatorcayetyogasandhyā ca vimalā jñānavṛddhiḥ smṛtistathātadāyudhāni pūjyāni bhūpurādau yathākramamjuhuyāttaddaśāṃśaistu śuddhaiścātha tilairhunetmanau mantrī brahmacaryavrate sthitaḥbhavetkavīnāmagraṇīrdhruvamsandeho vāksiddhimatulāṃ naraḥkavīnāmagraṇīrbhavetbṛhattuṇḍā tālavādanatatparāyasyāmantargatā mantrāstrayastriṃśacca koṭayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samastāgamamantrāṇāṃ dātānāstyatra saṃśayaḥdevīṃ yayā sarvamidaṃ tatambījānyacaḥ proktāḥ śaktayaḥ kīlakaṃ bhavetprāguktamātṛkā nyāsāssarve mukhyā bhavanti capañcāśadarṇavyāptāṃgīṃ candrārdhāṃkitaśekharāmmuktāvṛtasphuradbhūṣāṃ bhaje mātṛsarasvatīmśubhaṃ padmaṃ bhūpuratritayāvṛtamkacaḍhādikavargāṃśca likhedaṣṭadaleṣu capūjāpīṭhamidaṃ proktamādāvaṃgāni saṃyajetsvaradvandvaṃ tato vargānkeśareṣu yajedimāḥvidyeśvarī madhyamāṃte pūjyāḥ pīṭhe tataḥ paramkleśinī cāpi dhāriṇī mālinī tathālokeśvarānagre vīthyāmastrāṇi pūjayetśuddhaistarpaṇādi kṛtvā siddho bhavenmanuḥsaṃgare syājjayāyasamyaksa mūrkhopi kavitvabhākbhakṣitaṃ kavitāpradamsutāgryamkṣayosyāḥ [nivāsaḥ]mameṣṭaṃ dehi durbhugnī śikhivallabhākuryātprātastu nīrājjayati sukhakarānsādhakendro gatosaudadāti sā devī sustrīvittāmbarādikamvakratuṇḍādyāśceṭīśaktisamanvitāḥvakratuṇḍavidhiḥ pūrvamuktoṣṭānāṃ sa eva hiyoginīti dehi dehi vadettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vīṇātantrīsphuraddhastāṃ tannādacalakuṇḍalāmhunetsiddho bhavenmanuḥmanuṃ devyā japedaṣṭasahasrakamvīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgānāṃ kinnarīṇāñca bhūyasaḥyoginīrūpā pratyakṣā mantriṇo bhavetbrahmabhūyāya kalpateraktākṣī gānavādaratā sāañjanaṃ ca dehiyugmaṃ nidhiṃ vadetshāheti kathito manuḥghṛtāktaguggulairhomo devatāṃ sādhayettataḥśatatrayamghṛtāktaguggulairhomaṃ tataḥ kuryācchatatrayamsadyo bhavati bhūpatiḥpaṅkajākṣī prakīrtitāsyādabhāve ca samidvaraiḥkāryakarī nānālaṃkāraśobhitākṛṣṇāṣṭamyāñcaitramāse bhaume śukre thavā niśidadāti phalamuttamamsadguruḥprārthitaḥpunaḥhyekatriṃśākṣaro manuḥvāḍavaṃ vahniṃ ca śamaya dvayamkārye hunetsaghṛtapāyasamśyāmāmbaraparīdhānā me cittestu payodinībṛhaspatau vāpi śukre vā tatra vāsareayutamprajapenmantrampāyasairhomamācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dadāti varakāṃ caikāmmantriṇe toṣa māgatākartavyandhyātvādevīṃ bhavejjalamhaṃsavāgīśvarīśaktirmantrādyasya nirūpyateśaktiśca devyādirgāyatrī chanda īritamvidvāṃstṛtīyabījena ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaretmantrākṣarāṇi vinyasya cintayediṣṭadevatāmcandrānanāṃ mandahāsā candrārdhakṛtaśekharāmyajetpīṭhe mātṛkā yāḥ puroditāḥtāṃ devīmarcayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥdevīmitthaṃ prapūjayetsumatīḥ svastiraṣṭau tacchaktayo matāḥkuryātsādhako niyatavrataḥlakṣmīyaśaḥkāntiyutaḥ kavitvasyālayaṃ bhavetvakṣye yattasyāḥ ṣoḍaśārṇakamvāgdevī svāhānto mantra īritaḥpadairmantrasya ṣaḍdbhiḥ syātṣaḍaṅgaṃ caiva jātimatvyākhyāṃ mudrāṃ pustakameva cacandrārdhabhālāṃ ca pīnonnatapayodharāmjapenmantraṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥājyāplutaistaparṇādi sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaretsaṃvatsarādbhavedvidvānnātra kāryā vicāraṇāmantrametaṃ ca puṣpagandhādikaṃ sudhīḥnityaṃ bhavettasya na saṃśayaḥdaśākṣaravadasyānyatpañcāṃgaṃ tu manoḥ paraiḥnamrāṃ stanabhāreṇa tāmbhaje
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prakurvīta pūrvavadvai daśārṇavattryarṇā ceṭītrayānvitāsaṃjapyaḥ kṣattriyaiḥ paratāpakaiḥṛṣyādikaṃ daśārṇoktaṃ devī tryarṇā sarasvatīvidhāyātha dhyāyeddevīṃ sarasvatīmratnakumbhaṃ tvakṣamālāṃ ca pustakampīnottuṅgakucānamrāṃ śvetābjasthāṃ sarasvatīmpratyahaṃ yaḥ sa bhavedvākpatirdhruvamājyāktahaviṣā vahnau daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāttataḥsiddhamanurmantrī prayogānkartumarhatiso'pratimāṃ siddhimacirāllabhate dhruvamnaṃdyāvartodbhavaiḥ kundasaṃyutaiḥ kusumairhunetjapenmantrī sabhāyāṃ jayamāpnuyātca yaḥ khādetsa medhāṃ vāñchitāṃ labhetpāṇḍavīti bagale tataśca bagalāmukhisphrīṃ svāheti triṃśārṇo mantro dhyānaṃ nirūpyatepītavarṇāṃ vicitrāṃ pāṇḍavīṃ bhajepuraścaryāṃ paścātsādhanamācaretbaddhaṃ gatistambhaḥ prajāyatetailayuktairbhaveddhomaḥ pṛthumadhyā prasīdatipañcabhūtāni tatpīṭhaṃ tena khe gatiḥkārtikeyaguhākhelāṃ pṛthumadhyāṃ bhajāmyaham || 351 |||tāruṇyaṃ kuruyugmaṃ ca dhaṃ ca dhamvṛṣṭikāle caturdaśyāṃ niśāntarehomaḥ kadalīkhaṇḍakaistathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pārthivīṃ devīṃ tāruṇyāṅkapradāṃ śivāmjarāmaraṇarāhityaṃ sambhaveccaiva sarvagaḥceṭī kaṃkālikā matāsvāhāntaḥsthitivarṇoyaṃ lakṣamasya japo mataḥtatsādhakasya tadekaṃ sā prayacchatiyoginī cāsya ceṭikā paṃkavāsinīcaikatriṃśākṣaro manuḥdevyā dhyānaṃ nirūpyatemānase ma vasa smaradevi pratyahaṃ kamalakānanasaṃsthecaikaṃ kalpapuṣpāti gandhavat |rājastriyo bhūpāḥ paṇḍitā devatā apimahāśmaśānamāvṛtya shitānabhayadāyakānbhavennāma yoginī vasuvikramātanmantraḥ prokta ekādaśākṣaraḥmāṃ sarasvatyai hṛdayānto manurmataḥsiddhyanti pūrvoktāḥ sarva eva hicoktvā vāmalocana ityapivahnijāyānto manuḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadarṇakaḥsthirāṃ devīṃ sambhaje tāṃ varānanāmsahasratritayaṃ homaḥ śaṅkhaiścāpi kapardakaiḥsthāpayedyatra kaṇādīnāṃ kuśūlakedhānyāntaraṃ sthāpyaṃ vṛddhistatrāpi jāyatepṛthivyāveṣṭanakarī saptakoṭeśvarī matācaṇḍikāṃ ca saḥ kaḥ saptākṣaro manuḥsaptakoṭeśvarī devī vāgaiśvaryakarī matā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ tripurāvatprakīrtitamsyāttāvanmantrañjapejjalepūrṇacandraprabhābhantadamāmpūrṇāṃ karoti cakāśmīracārutāṭaṅkāṃ dhyāyāmi śivavallabhāmyoginī tu putradārūpadhāriṇīsamākhyātā tasyāḥ sādhanamucyatepaṃktiśchandosya devatāsarve kartavyāstatphalāptayeyasyā iti vigrahaḥ ||]tripurabhairavyāstryakṣarāyāśca tatsamamnitya kāmyasiddhyarthamucyatemūḍhasya śilārūpasya nānyathāhavanānmohayenmantrī lokatrayanivāsinaḥśriyamāpnuyātrājanāgendradevānāṃ purandhrīrvaśamānayetsamidbhirjāyate kṣīraṃ madhunā mṛtyunāśanamkahlārahavanādbhāgyaṃ madhuratrayaraktayukhutaṃ tadalpamṛtyośca rogāṇāṃ cāpi nāśanamraktotpalairjagadvaśyaṃ lakṣmīrbhāgyaṃ sitotpalaiḥsaṃśayaḥlākṣāsiddhayaṣṭīkadalīphalahomataḥlakṣaṃ ceddhutognirnṛpavadbhavetphalairlakṣahomādvaśyāḥ śataṃ nṛpāḥtilājyābhyāṃ candanena tu śatravaḥtu homena vāgvaśyaṃ jāyate nṛṇām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nīlataṇḍulahomena śāntirbhavati mandiredhānyasiddhirbhaveddhruvamvaṭakairupasargānvināśayetjapāpuṣpairjagadvaśyaṃ bāṇapuṣpaiśca mohanamdaśāgadhūpahomācca saubhāgyamatulaṃ bhavetśrīphalairatulā lakṣmīrikṣudaṇḍaiḥ sukhaṃ bhavetvaradāḥ sarvaśaktayaḥpaurṇamāsyāṃ viśākhādityasaṃgamekāṃtāśatāsaṃge nāsau skhalati mānavaḥsadyaḥ sambhaje vāmalocanāmstambhaya dviścoktvā nāde mākuru cocyatelakṣajapātsidhyedvā vāmalocanāpure vasati yoginīaukāreṇa samanvitāḥcaitanyabhairavītulyaṃ viśeṣoyaṃ ca pūjanepaścādanyatsarvaṃ yathoktavat||] sādhanaṃ vacmi tadekāṃte nadītaṭeyamaṃ kālaṃ viṣṇumīśaṃ krameṇa cahomastrirelāyāḥ phalairbhavetraviṇā vāpi yadā yuktā bhavettadātadakṣayyaṃ dhyānamasyā nirūpyatecitraveṣāṃ tāṃ sambhaje parameśvarīmyugalaṃ śrīṃ svāhā tridvivarṇakaḥlakṣaṇajñāsya nāmnā rudhiravāhinīhasakalarakārāṃśca ḍakāraikārasaṃyutān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhairavīvatsarvaṃ nyāsādikaṃ matamkāśyāṃ sthāpitastvanayā purācaitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ vasante niśi sañjapetdevī tadā dadyācca maṃtriṇepakṣimṛgādīnāmuragāṇā ca mohanamśivāṅkasthā raktakañcukadhāraṇīmantroyaṃ manvarṇaḥ [caturdaśākṣaraḥ ||] parikīrtitaḥathātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi dantihastaṃ vināyakamśaktiścihnagamyā ca ceṭikāṛṣiḥ kāmastu gāyatrī chando bāṇeśvarī surīekākṣareṇa sarvaiśca manorvarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakamca sūryābhāṃ bāṇeśīṃ sundarīṃ bhajejapeddhomo bandhūkakusumairmataḥprayogādyaṃ sarvamasyāstripurāvatprakīrtitamhemantrindivyabhogānapi dhruvamtithivarṇoyaṃ dhyāyetkaṇṭhebjakamrajāmsampravakṣyāmi piciṇḍilavināyakamkarmakarī ceṭī cāsya trilocanāmantraḥ] tāraṃ tato nārīṃ ramyā kamalavāsinīmprārthitāṃ śambhuviṣṇubrahmādikaiḥ suraiḥjapetpaścānnāraṅgairhomamācaretbhavetstrīṇāṃ nārīṃ ramyāṃ tadā japetmantro'syāstithivarṇakaḥca mantroyaṃ dhyāyeddevīṃ trimālinīmāṣāḍhaśuklasaptamyāṃ caturthyāṃ vā samāhitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: palāśamūlairatyantaiḥ komalerhomamācaretsiddhirarcayitvā gaṇeśvaramśaktibhiśceṭikābhiśca yuktāngambījapūrvakānhṛdayāntastathāṣṭānāṃ mantroyaṃ parikīrtitaḥklīṃ aiṃ brūmiti procya śrīṃ mantraḥ pañcavarṇakaḥrītyāhṛdayādinyāsamapi kuryāt]pāśāṃkuśaśarānakṣamālikāmabhyaṃ dhanuḥpūjādikaṃ bhavetsiddhikarī naṣṭaveṣāsya ceṭikāstrīṃ svāhā viśvavarṇo mantro dhyānaṃ nirūpyatepretāsanāṃ mahādevīṃ naṣṭaveṣāṃ bhajāmyahamgajadantena daśāṃśastuṣyati tviyambhūtapretapiśācādīnkhelansaṃvaśayedapiklīṃ aiṃ sauśca manurmataḥ||] || pañcakāmāṃśca vinyasya mūlena vyāpakaṃ caretsphuradratnadukūlāḍhyāṃ nānālaṅkāra bhūṣitāmpūjayetpaścātṣaḍaṅgāni prapūjayettato bhairavāṣṭakañcāpi mātaraḥpuraścaraṇakṛtyādi kāmyakarma tathākhilamstrīṃ vahnigehinīmtāṃ cañcalākṣīṃ mahānādāṃ bhajāmyahamkṛṣṇāyāṃ niśi kurvīta tattīre cāyutaṃ japamdevī prasīdatibhavenmatrī trilokīgamanakṣamaḥcāsya dhātuvādakriyākarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śyāmapītāruṇaśvetaistadantastūpabāhyataḥdaṇḍakhaḍgapāśāṅkuśagadā likhetmaunī ṛjukāyo jitendriyaḥvāmabhāge tu sthāpayetkalaśaṃ śubhamnidhāyātha dīpānprajvālayecchubhānsaṃskuryāttāni sarvāṇi vakṣyamāṇavidhānataḥ||] || śaramantreṇa digbandhaṃ kuryānmaṃtrī samāhitaḥbhūtaśuddhintataḥ kṛtvā prāṇasthāpanamācaretmūrdhni cchando vaktragataṃ nyasetvinyasenmantrī paṃcāṅgaṃ vā yathāvidhiaṅgairvihīnasya manoraṅgaṃ tenaiva kalpayetmantrajño yogapīṭhaṃ prakalpayettato mudrāḥ sthāpayedarghyamuttamamtatrālpamalpaṃ śaṅkhāmbu tattaddevarato nyasetmantri prokṣaṇyadbhiḥ samāhitaḥprokṣayedgandhapuṣpādyairdeśe sve deśikottamaḥtatastatra pūjayediṣṭadevatāmtathādhāre caraṇe sarvagātrakesarvopacāraistañceṣṭaṃ gurvādiṣṭena vartmanāpānīyaṃprokṣaṇīsaṃsthaṃ tyaktvā saṃsicya pūrvavatpūrvaṃ śālibhistaṇḍulaistataḥchinnamūlāḥ kuśā dīrghāḥ saptaviṃśatisaṅkhyakāḥyajedādhāraśaktyādipīṭhamantrāvasānakamtriguṇātmakasūtreṇa veṣṭitaṃ sarvato bahiḥcātra sthāpayeddeśikottamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sammohanaśchando gāyatrī devatā matāṣaḍaṅgāni ṣaḍdīrghānvitamūlataḥpūrvoktapañcabāṇāṃśca nyaseddhyānaṃ samācaretnānālaṅkāraśubhagāṃ mohayantīṃ jagattrayamkṣobhiṇīṃ caiva śaśinīṃ stambhinīṃ tathāsamāvāhyārcayenmudrāśca darśayetanaṅgarūpiṇī | anaṅgamadanā ityādi] madanā tathātadvaddvipikāṣṭau samīritāḥvijñeyāstripureśyā yathā tathāgaṇeśāntrājamātaṅyā saṃbadhānyoginīyutānnamontā manavasteṣāṃ kramānnāmāni vacmyahamvināyakaścaiva tathā gajavināyakaḥathāntargṛhamāvṛtya sthitāñchṛṇu vināyakāngajakarṇaścitraghaṇṭaḥ syānmaṅgalavināyakaḥte vakṣyante mayādhunājñānapūrvo dvāravighneśa eva cakīrtyante pretavāhanāḥ [idaṃ parānvayi]dhūrttaviśvāsā vyomaikacaraṇārdhadṛksthūlanāsā mārjārī kaṃṭhapūraṇāyoginyo ṅentaṃ nāma namontakamsampravakṣyāmi śaktimeṣāṃ susiddhidāmśrīṃ manavaḥ proktā bhagavatīpradaṃ vadetsarvamukharāji sarvamukheti casarvastrīpuruṣetyuktvā vaśaṃkari padaṃ vadetsarvalokamuktvāmukaṃ vadet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekaviṃśadviśvadhṛtidhṛtiviśvakarairmanoḥṣaḍaṅganyāsa uditaḥ padanyāsaṃ bravīmyahambāhvorjaṭhare nābhimaṇḍalegude nyasya padānyaṣṭādaśa kramātvedāgnīndudvitrinetrairvarṇairmantrapadāni tumūlādhāre pūrvabījatrayaṃ prītyai padaṃ vadetmano bhavāyai ca namo vadetśirovadanahṛdguhyapādeṣu kramato nyasetmahocchuṣmāṃ svanāmādivarṇabījapurassarāmmūrdhapādāsyaguhye hṛdaye drāviṇīṃ kramātbījatrayādyāṃ mātaṃgī padāṃte manmathaṃ mukhedakṣapārśve manobhavamanaṃgādyāḥ sthāneṣveṣveva vinyasetsambhavā bhuvanapālinīprītiṃ kīrtiśāṃtyau puṣṭiṃ tuṣṭiṃ krameṇa cabhruvormadhye śirasyevaṃ ca vinyasetmūlādhāre tvadhiṣṭhāne nābhau hṛdi gale mukhemātaṃgyantānnyasetpaścānmātaṃgyaṃtā imāṃ apiraudrīṃ tathā śāṃtiṃ hṛdaye siddhidāṃ galekalāpade sṛṣṭiṃ rodhikāyāṃ tathā nyasetviṣṇuśaktiṃ dhruvamaṇḍalake nyasetcatasraḥ śaktayo nyasyā mātaṃgī śirasi nyasetsiddhalakṣmīṃ tathā mūle mūlādhāre pravinyasetnyastaśarīrosau cintayenmantradevatāmmaṇḍape ratnanirmite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ratnasiṃhāsane śubhetrikoṇaṃ syādaṣṭapadaṃ tato bahiḥsacaturdvāraṃ maṇḍalaṃ proktamuttamamkadambamālābharaṇāṃ pūjitāṃ ca surāsuraiḥtilakopetāmīṣatprahasitānanāmvalītaraṃgamadhyābhāṃ romarājīvirājitāmnānāmaṇigaṇonnaddhakaṭisūtrairalaṃkṛtāmdvibhujāṃ bālāṃ madāghūrṇitalocanāmsvarṇottaṃsavirājatāmcatuṣṣaṣṭikalārūpāṃ pārśvasthaśukasārikāmpītavarṇāṃ vā dhyāyenmātaṃginīṃ parāmaiṃhrīṃśrīṃbījapūrvāśca ṅemātaṃginamontakāḥpuṣṭirutkṛṣṭir-ṛddhiśca mātaṅgyā nava śaktayaḥityuktvā mātaṃgyāḥ pīṭhamarcayettasyāmāvāhaddevīmarcayettadanantarambahusthaleṣvalekhiṣam ||] pradarśayetśvetābhā prathamāyāntu sāñjaliḥtrikoṇakāṣṭadalayorantarāle tu pūjayetmantrajñaḥ paṃcabāṇāstatorcayetamalāruṇabhāyuktāndhanurbāṇāyudhāṃstathāguṇasṛṇyabhayeṣṭāni dhārayantyoruṇaprabhāḥhemapradā padmākarā kausumbhakāmbarāpuṣpabāṇekṣuhastā cāmalalocanākuṇḍasamā padmacinmudrākaraśālinī[varā'bhayeti pā0] puṣṭiḥ pītāṅgā cārubhūṣaṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjyā manmathādyā madoddhatāḥpatrasaṃsthā mātarastu tadagre cāṣṭa bhairavāḥbrāhmyādyā hrasvādyā bhairavā apiādarśaratnadīpaṃ ca vyajanaṃ ca tataḥ paramvāsomālyātapatrāṇābharaṇāśukaśālikaiḥvāmahastaiśca deveśāḥ khaḍgapāṇayaḥvīṇāñcatuḥpatre tatorcayetalaṃkṛtabhujā raktā dvitīyā cendusannibhhāpāśāṃkuśasarojāni yonimudrāñca vibhratīca dhyātavyā mantrisattamaiḥgaṇeśadurgāvaṭukakṣetrapālānbahiryajet[padadvayamuttarānvayi]kṛtvā brāhmaṇārādhanantathājuhuyājjātīmallikānāgakeśaraiḥpaṅkajaiḥ svāṃ śriyamāpnotyanuttamāmjapābandhūkabakulairvajravṛkṣasamudbhavaiḥjuhuyāttasya sarvasiddhirbhavatyalamjuhuyādvṛṣṭikāmastu guḍūcībhirjvaraṃ haretcānnavāñjāyatecirātyatproktaṃ trisvādvaktaṃ tu tadbhavetnimbaprasūnahomācca kamalāṃ vāñchitāṃ labhetcandanāgurukarpūrarocanākuṃkumairapiaṣṭābhirjapitairetaistilakaṃ janamohanamsaṃśayaḥhomādvāñchitamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rañjanīṃ klīṃ tato vadetvarṇāṃstu catvāriṃśatkramāttataḥdvyūnaśataṃ mantre varṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥduṣprāpyo'kṛtapuṇyaiśca munīndrādyaiśca sevitaḥpūrvamuditā mantrasyāsya bhavanti hipañcabāṇānaṃgulīṣu talayormakaradhvajammakaradhvaja ityetatklīṃ namontaḥ prakīrtitaḥśrotrayorghrāṇayorvaktre gaṇḍayoḥ kakudi kramātmūlādhāre padorapiṣaḍaṣṭakaikacandrāṣṭanavāṣṭādaśapatribhiḥekonaviṃśatiyutānmantrārṇānāditaḥ kramātkāmaśaktīṃdirābījānyuktāni ca śikhā manoḥpunaḥ pañca kukṣau pārśvadvaye hṛdidakṣapādāṃgulīmūle gulphasandhau ca jānunitato lakṣmyādikā nyasetvāmahastāṃgulīmūle dakṣahastāṃgulītaṭebhruvormadhye netrayoḥ śrotrayogudemūlādhāre tvadhiṣṭhāne tālau vāmādikā nyasetmātaṅyādicatuṣkaṃ ca hṛdi nābhau śirogude[kaṃ śiraḥ] mūle ca mantreṇa vyāpakaṃ caretbhruvormadhye dakṣapāde tathottaresamudre tu ratnadvīpe mahāvanemaṇisiṃhāsanasyordhvamupaviṣṭāṃ vicintayetśubhrāṃśuvadanāṃ nīpapuṣpagumphitaveṇikāmkastūrītilakāṃ candramukuṭāmunnatastanīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: valayāṅgadahārādimañjīraraśanānvitāmpūrvokte ca śubhe pīṭhe yantrametatprakalpayetvedatalaṃ caturasraṃ manoharamyajeddevīṃ mantrī śṛṅgāraveṣataḥmātāṅgīpīṭhamabhyarcya kṛtvā mūlaprakalpanamprāgvatṣaḍaṅgāni prapūjayetgaṇeśādicatuṣkaṃ ca caturdvāreṣu cārcayettadbāhye nyāsapūrvaṃ japenmanumsadugdhaiśca nivedyātha devīṃ natvā tato balimbhagavatītyuktvā mātaṅgeśvari tatparamuttarato vāyavyādisakoṇakeparameṣṭhigurubhyaśca paramācāryagurubhyaḥpañcasthāneṣu gurūnsampūjayeditipalāśapuṣpaistrisvāduyuktairante'yutaṃ hunetkumārīrbhojayeccāpi vaśayetkṣobhayejjayatsthaṇḍile vāpi vidheyaṃ kāmyakarmakamghṛtāktaguggulorhomādrājñaśca vaśayetsudhīḥbilvapatraiśca hunetpadmairviśeṣataḥprākṛtavācā chītū?ranāmāsya prasiddham] homayetjuhuyādannairdhānyārthī śālitaṇḍulaiḥnandyāvarttaprasūnaiśca vāgarthī juhuyādathaśatrorunmādakṛddhoma unmattakusumairapiulūkakākagṛddhrotthapakṣaistailapariplutaiḥpāyasairguḍasammiśraiḥ khaṇḍairikṣudalaistathālāktaṃ kāśaśvāsajvarāpaham

sanskrit: nirguṇḍīmūlahomena nigaḍasya vimocanamsādhyanāmāmukasthāne sādhye prāṇāṃśca tatra cajapenmūlemukasthāne sādhyanāma tu yojayettadrūpaṃ tatra sthāne niveśayetuttānāmatha piṣṭotthāṃ svāsanādhastathā khanetsahaitāstu tisraḥ pūryāstataḥ paramtato madhūcchiṣṭamayīmūrdhvapādāmadhomukhīmputtalīntena kārayetsaṃhārabhāgena nyāsamācaretīritaḥdakṣastṛtīyaḥ syāccaturtho mastakammatamsyātsaptamastathorvādipādāṃtaḥ savyadehataḥgulphadvayaṃ tathā jānudvayaṃ jaṃghādvayaṃ tathāśarīramekādaśadhā hyasādhyasyātha vakṣyatejuhuyādbhāgaṃ smarañchatruṃ niśāmukhenāryaḥ saṃkṣubdhā madanāturāḥkṣamasveti paśya māmmā parityajyamantriṇo yoṣitaḥ sadāharidrācūrṇasaṃyuktaṃ lavaṇaṃ stambhane matamtathā tisraḥ pañca saptātha vā punaḥmantrajñaiḥ kanyakāścaiva sarvadātathā piṣṭamayāndīpāṃśca kalpayetmātaṃgīprītaye maṃtrī yoginyaṣṭakamāyajetḍākinīṃ kālikāṃ kālarātriñceśānagocarāmrākṣasīṃ vīrakumārīṃ vahnikoṇagām

sanskrit: tripurāṃtā krodhinīṃ ca durmadāṃ dhvaṃsinīṃ yameādityāṃ cāpi khaṭvāṃgīṃ kālāgnimiti nair-ṛtehaṃkālīṃ yamadūtīṃ ca kaumārīṃ ca kapālinīmkāmukīṃ vāyau lomakādhomukhīṃ tathāghorograrūpavikaṭāṃ codagdiśi kapālinīmpṛthvīśvarāṃstadardhena vaśayennātra saṃśayaḥsarvā āyāntyayutajāpataḥsahasratritayātsarvavāñchitāptirbhaveddhruvamaṣṭāśītyakṣare mantre sarvasattvavaśaṅkaripunaḥ sarvalokādikaṃ vadetkravyādikampūrvamuktaṃ ṣaḍbījaiśca ṣaḍaṅgakamdhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvamaṣṭāśītimanormatamathānyatsampravakṣyāmi catuḥpañcāśadakṣaramgauryevaṃ gāndhārīti padaṃ vadetgheṃgheṃ vā vāgnigehinīṣaḍaṅgāni tu māyayābheda ekaṣaṣṭikavarṇakaḥbhavetpraṇavahīnoyammantraḥ sarvatra pūrvavatsamākhyāto vijayasya padaṃ vademantro nivṛcchando hyajo muniḥmantrākṣaraiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni dhyānamasyā nirūpyatetrinayanāṃ svarṇalekhāṃ bhajāmyahamādāvaṅgāni ṣaṭkoṇe brāhmyādyāstvaṣṭapatrakeprajapenmantraṃ juhuyātpāyasairghṛtaiḥprayogāṃścānnapūrṇāyā mātaṅgyā vā samācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rājābhimukhī vaśyamukhīti cadevādhidevi sarveti janasya mukhamuccaretdiksaptakratuvaideṣumaitrārṇairaṅgakalpanamjāniyādviśeṣādvaśyakṛttvayamnyāsapūjādikaṃ bhavetpāyasahomaśca prayogādyaṃ ca pūrvavatvāgbhavaṃ hṛdayaṃ cātha śrīmātaṅgīpadaṃ vedetsatyaṃ kathaya yugmakamvāgbhavenātra pūjādyaṃ ca kṛtākṛtamkathayeddevī pṛcchakasya śubhāśubhammantraḥ sarvakāryaprasādhakaḥcāsya devatā parikīrtitādviruktaiśca ṣaḍaṅgasya vidhiḥ pūjājapādikambandhūkapuṣpairhomaḥ syātsitayā pāyasena casamastamantradānādau siddhaḥ syātsādhakottamaḥsvāhāṣṭākṣaroyamudīritaḥcāṅgaṃ dvirāvṛttipadairbhavetcandrāvataṃsāṃ vividhairgāyanairviśvamohinīmpūjyāḥ keśareṣvaṅgapūjanamvajrādyaissaptāvṛttiriyaṃ matāmadhūkajaistrimadhvaktaiḥ sarvaṃ sammohayejjagatathocchiṣṭāṃ pravakṣyāmi mātaṅgīṃ gojavarṇikāmsvāhā mantroyaṃ mohayejjagatmāgaṅgī cocchiṣṭā gobjavarṇikāsyurmantravarṇaistato dhāyeddhṛdambuje
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: muktāpravālamālāḍhyā śaṅkhakuṇḍaladhāriṇīmpañcabāṇāstathāṅgāni brāhmyādyāścāṣṭapatrakelokapālāstadastrāṇi tato bahiḥpūrvaṃ vā japenmantrāvetayormadano muniḥpūjājapādikaṃ prāgvadbhedāṃścāsyāparāñcchṛṇuvāgmitvaṃ ca kavitvaṃ ca gānaśaktiṃ karoti caāṃhrīṃkroṃbhirdvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaretnīlacūḍāṃ ca vādayantīṃ ca vallakīmtrikoṇaṃ pañcakoṇañca bahiraṣṭadaladvayamtathā nāma vadeducchiṣṭapādukāmratyādyāḥ koṇānte tu triśaktayaḥdrāviṇyādyāḥ pañcakoṇe sampūjyāḥ kāmaśaktayaḥbrāhmyādyāḥ kanyakānāmnyo dvitīyeṣṭadale tathāṣoḍaśāre kanyakākhyāḥ prapūjayetsukeśī mañjughoṣā nāgakanyakāparakāyapraveśinyāḥ kanyakāṃ dūradarśanāmdvāreṣu pūjayeddvāradevatāḥgaṇeśaṃ ca kṣetrapālaṃ ca yoginīmsvanāmādyakṣaraṃ bījaṃ kṛtvāgneyādike yajetsarve śrutiyutā vāmabhāge tataḥ paramabhyarcetparameśvaryāḥ pāśvaryoḥ śukasārikebālāyāḥ sādhakasya śubhaṃ bhavetmanorucchiṣṭamātaṅgyā dattvādau pūjayenmanumgauravāllāghavādvāpi kartavyantu yathocitamucchiṣṭabhaktena baliṃ niśi nityaṃ nivedayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dūrvācandanasaṃyuktaṃ vinyaseddakṣiṇānvitammūlamantrañjapannante cintayannaikyamātmanaḥpañcāśadoṣadhīkvāthaiḥ pūrayettadanantaramcandanañcāpi raktākhyaṃ candanañcāgurustathājātiphalaṃ jaṭāmāṃsī murā tathācitrakañca mudgaparṇī kuśāḥ punaḥśaṅkhapuṣpī mayūrasya śikhā tathāpāṣāṇabhedakaḥ kṛṣṇā śaśipuṣpī ca rohiṇīindravallī bhṛṅgībhirānṛpāḥśrīdevakanyākhyābhāgatho bhadramustakamdugdhavṛkṣatvacāṃ kvāthairbrahmabhūruktvagudbhavaiḥkvāthāditoyairāpūrya śaṅkhantasminviloḍayetcandanāgurukarpūrarocanākuṅkumaṃ madaḥjaṭāmāṃsī vaiṣṇavaṃ tadudīritamśāktaṃ gandhāṣṭakaṃ viduḥtagarāgurukarpūraiḥ śāmbhavaṃ cāṣṭagandhakamtagarāgurukarpūraiḥ sauraṃ gandhāṣṭakaṃ viduḥmadābhyāñca vāridena ca patrajamsaśaktikañjalaṃ kumbhe bhavedevaṃ vidurbudhāḥdhūmrā marīcirjvālinī ruciḥkalāṣoḍaśakañcāndraṃ yajetpaścād gurūttamaḥśaśinī candrikā kāntirjyotsnā śīḥprītiraṃgadāvedādibhede sañjātāḥ kalāḥ pañcāśabinduyukpratiṣṭhā vidyā śāntir-ṛddhiśca dīpikājñānāmṛtāpyāyanī ca vyāpinī vyomarūpikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: palāśakusumaiḥ svāduyuktairhomaṃ tathātra tuproktaṃ kuryāttadapi sādhakaḥucchiṣṭabhaktaśeṣeṇa rātrau tasyai baliṃ haretpūjanīyā nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥstrī yācitānaṅgabhogikātathā dūrvā musalī madhuyaṣṭikāsamproktā pṛthagetāḥ spṛśañjapetnṛpo vātha dhatte harṣasamūhakamśataśatametāḥ saṃyojya peṣayetdhṛtāḥ samyaksarvastrījanarañjikāḥbhavanti sarvalokasya dakṣārañjanakarmaṇica kṛṣṇājyayuktayā kajjalaṃ dhṛtamjagadvaśyaṃ nārīsaṃkṣobhakārakampūrvoktairdaśabhirdravyaiḥ pañcagavyaiśca kāpilaiḥlalāṭe bhuvanaṃ vaśayeccaiva nānyathāviṣṇvāhvākumudaśyāmapadmareṇusugarbhitāmātaṅgīmanunā japtā netrāktā rañjanī nṛṇāmsaviṣṇudayitālakṣmīrbhṛṅgarājodbhavaṃ rajaḥmaṣīpūrvaṃ phaladā nātra saṃśayaḥvaśayatyeṣāmaṣī tatsambhavā bhṛśamnīraiśca tantubhirveṣṭayetphalamābhaumavārasaṃjaptaṃ karpūraṃ tatphalaṃ tataḥsasūrakamitā etāḥ khāditā vaśyadāḥ paramnareśāya sa vaśyo nātra saṃśayaḥsampravakṣyāmi dvātriṃśadvarṇakaṃ manum

sanskrit: śrīmātaṅgi tatheśvarimunirasyoktonuṣṭupcchandaśca devatā|| ṣaḍaṣṭabāhubhiśceti dhyāyecchyāmāṃ sulocanāmvādayantīṃ tāṃ mātaṅgīṃ hṛdi bhāvayetyajetpīṭhe vakṣyamāṇavidhānataḥyajettasminpīṭhaśaktīrnaveṣṭadāḥtāramāyāvāgramādyaḥ pīṭhamantraḥ kalārṇakaḥpīṭhapūjānte kuryādāvaraṇārcanamṣaḍaṃgāni mātṝśca dalamadhyagāḥvāmākhyā jyeṣṭhā raudrī praśāntikāsṛṣṭimohinyau prathamācāriṇī tathāṣoḍaśī tu pūjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥmahālakṣmīḥ punarvahnyādikoṇataḥsarvāvaraṇaśaktīnāṃ ṅentaṃ nāma hṛdaṃtakampūjanīyāssyuritthaṃ siddhirmanorbhavetphalairvā vaśyā syājjanatā brahmavṛkṣajaiḥlavaṇairvidyāttagarairvetasairjalamniśācūrṇayutaiḥ kāśairhomātsyātstambhanaṃ dviṣāmgandhāṣṭakamudīritametatpiṣṭvāyutaṃ japtvā tilakena jagatpriyaḥmātaṅgī pūjitā kāmadā nṛṇāmhūyādaṣṭottaraśataṃ khādirāgnau naro niśikṛṣṇabhūtaniśi dhvāṃkṣodare kṣiptvā śubhaprabhāmtadvahniṃ yasmai dadyātsa dāsavatmunidevyādisevyānāṃ kāśyāṃ saṅkhyā na vidyate
