sanskrit: svabījākhyairvarṇalakṣajapasteṣāmudāhṛtaḥprakartavyo madhuratrayasaṃyutaiḥbaṭukā devatāstāḥ phalapradāḥvadeddhastipiśācīti liḥliḥsvāhā navākṣaraḥproktassarvasampatpradāyakaḥproktaḥ kāmyakarmāṇyatha bruvesādhyāṃguṣṭhapramāṇāṃ ca gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥṣaṣṭhyāṃ caiva caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe ca mantravitvaśamāyāti sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥtatpatraṃ hastakṛṣṭiriyaṃ matāsmṛtvā japenmantraṃ sarvalokaṃ vaśaṃ nayetrājapatnīṃ vā karṣayettatkṣaṇātsudhīḥdadyādiṣṭāya nānyathāśrīkhaṇḍadhūpadānena rājānaṃ vaśamānayetśatruṃ sa uccāṭayati nānyathāśmaśānāgnau tu juhuyādvidveṣaḥ snigdhayorbhavetkuryātsarvāvayavaśobhitāmprāṇapratiṣṭhāntu viṣaraktāḍhyapātrakesandeho devatābhiḥ surakṣitaḥrocanākuṃkumābhaṃ ca bhūrje nāma samālikhetsamyaksneho bhavati tatkṣaṇātprayogāśca varṇalakṣamito japaḥca samuccārya hrīṃ huṃgheṃgheṃ tathā ca phaṭtrinetrāmitamanurbhavati ||] hastimukhadadamātraṃ yadoccaretmunyādidevatocchiṣṭagaṇanāthaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: athānyatsampravakṣyāmi mantraṃ ṣaḍviṃśavarṇakamtathocchiṣṭamahātmaneca pūjanamhastipiśāci likhetsvāheti mantrakaḥpuraścaryārkalakṣāsyātprayogādi ca pūrvavatsarvamasya daśārṇavatekonaviṃśavarṇaḥ syāttadā mantraḥ susiddhikṛtsyātṣaḍaṅgakamhastimukheti ca ṅentaṃ lambodaraṃ vadethaṃ ghedvayaṃ cāpi ucchiṣṭāyāgnigehinīucchiṣṭagaṇanāthasya mantreṣveṣu na śodhanamsadā gopyā na prakāśyā itastataḥnirdhanatvaṃ vaṃśacchedonyathā bhavetsadā gopyā viśeṣādvedakarmaṇaḥvatrayaṃ binduvisargābhyāṃ ca saṃyutamtiṣṭhati mantroyaṃ na sa vighnaistu bādhyateraktālaṅkārasaṃyuktāṃ guṇahāravirājitāmbaliṃ dattvā japettadgatamānasaḥjapato hyasya jāyante sarvasiddhayaḥpūjayenmaṇḍalaṃ devyā mūlamantreṇa mantravitrājā bhavati vaśyagaḥvidyāṃ śastraśāstravaśīkṛtāmvidhānena bhavanti dhanasiddhayaḥmāsāttasya bhavantyeva siddhā vidyāścaturdaśamahādevi trailokyaṃ vaśamānayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: siddhayoṣṭau bhavanti cabhavadākarṣaṇaṃ dhurvamvidyāvittavarānāḥkokilākākapakṣaiśca homācchatrūnvināśayetvidhānena citākāṣṭhahutāśaneśatrūnvidveṣayeddveṣṭā cānyonyakalahākulānvidhānena kuryāddhorma samāhitaḥputraṃ cirañjīvinamuttamamprayogeṇa bhavedākarṣaṇaṃ dhruvamkāmārttā balādāliṅgayanti tammahāvidyāṃ śāstraughadaśaśālinīmvidyāvāndhanavānvāpi sarvaśāstravaśaṃkaraḥmantramucchiṣṭena japetsadādevī pratyakṣā bhavati dhruvamkartavyā kāyena ca dhanena caviṣṇuprārthanayā sarvatantreṣu gopitampaśavopyasurāścāpi bhakṣyaṃ pānaṃ ca maithunamhi bādhante mamānandavanemutaḥtatkathaṃ manujāḥ śreṣṭhāstra tvāṃ prabravīmi canṛdehāttadbhavedyasmāttasmācchreṣṭhā narā matāḥyāvatpuṇyaṃ vaseddividīkṣyate sa sabhāntarejapecca bahujīvatiniṣkāmā sakāmā bhavabījakamvāmaṃ vijānāti sa eva paramo guruḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vaśiṣṭhādyāḥ śakrādyāḥ pādasammitamjānaṃti koṭayaścātra jāyaṃte kṛmiyoniṣuprakurute trailokyakaraṇakṣamaḥbhakṣayate yastu sa siddhīnāṃ patirbhavetcārthatritayaṃ sāttviko rājasastathāvijānanti te muktā nātra saṃśayaḥcintayatā dṛṣṭassamuniśca nirūpitaḥvāmamārgī bhuktimuktyoḥ sa bhājanamyaḥ pāpī viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ || 84 |||caikantu śrīkṛṣṇāya tathā paramvṛṣṇikādyāśca vāmamārgeṇa mocitāḥlokeṣu sandāya devaloke praveśitāḥsaṃsāre cānyeṣāṃ tu kathāsti kātāntu jīvaṃ tasyaipradarśayetśiraścandrāmṛtaṃ tasyāmukhaṃ yātyetadīritampunaḥ pītvā deho bhavati kāṣṭhavatsādhakaḥ syānmaheśvaraḥvyahaṅkārastu karmataḥduḥkhaṃ bhavati jñānināṃ dehatāḍanevṛddhistathāsya dehasya vyāpāraḥ sampravarttatecandrasurāmattaḥ kāmādyairnānubhūyatesurataṃ nāma kīrtitamyatsaukhyaṃ tasmātkuṭiguṇaṃ tu tatproktamanyatsyādrāsabhaṃ ratammatsyabhakṣaṇamityuktaṃ muktimārganidarśakaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhāraṇādhyānasamādhyākhyāstu mokṣadāḥjīvo dehapāśena badhyateajñānanāśājjñānasyodayānmokṣaḥ prajāyatevāmamārgeṇa mokṣo bhavati sarvathāyattallabhate hīti śāstreṣu niścayaḥbhūtānāṃ nivṛttiśca mahāphalāspṛśenmadyaṃ vaidike vartmani sthitaḥniṣevitamsamutpannaṃ tena madyaṃ viṣāyatekuladvayaviśuddhena vaidikenaiva vartmanāsyātpretya rākṣasatāṃ vrajetkiñcitsukhaṃ prāpya pretya lakṣādhipo bhavetmādhvī ca surā ityabhidhīyatepunaḥ stanyaṃ na pibetsa payo naraḥjātastasyoddhāro mayocyatenānyaviprasya kutracitdevatāñcintayecchaktiṃ tāṃ pumānsvayameva hiprāṇasyāyamanādvāpi bheṣajānmantratastathātaddaśāṃśena skhalanaṃ homa eva tatratānmārjanañca etadaṣṭadinaiścaretkṛte vidhāne ca devatā varadā bhavettrirātrantimibhistṛptiḥ śṛṃgyā vāpi dinadvayamsupakvasya grāhyaṃ bhāgacatuṣṭayamtathā yogyaṃ surayā marditaṃ dṛḍhamtacchaktimudreyamīritā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: māṣāḍhakīmasūraiśca caṇakānnaiḥ samanvitamkaṭutailena pakvāḥ syānmudrikā parāvā madyamāsavaṃ vā na cetaratjale sthāpyaṃ yāvadamlaṃ prajāyatemudrā śaktīnāmatitṛptidādakṣamārgasthaśaktīnāṃ mudrikāḥ parikīrtitāḥharimanthānaṃ dvidalena ca melayetdattvā maricāni ca patrajamvāmamārgagaṇeśānāṃ mudrā paramatoṣakṛtsamyakpiṣṭvā nibaddhaṃ ca dadhi dattvā viloḍitamelādikasugandhaiścoddhūlikā mudrikā matābhānukiraṇairājye pakvasya ṣaḍguṇepriyā toṣakarī sadātena tulyaṃ caṇakacūrṇakammudrikā ceyaṃ gaṇeśānāṃ priyaṃkarāgaṇeśasya prītidā mudrikā matājñeyaṃ tryahaṃ kālīyakasya tukhādyamāṃsaṃ daivatāyai samyaktacca nivedayetkeśarahimarocanābhiḥ samālikhetṣaṇmāsapūjanāttasya tvaritaṃ siddhimāpnuyāttaruṇyāstu nīrogāyā rajo matamnikṣipya gharṣitaṃ raktacandanamsurayā ghṛtaraktakacandanaiḥprakāśesti vāmamārge surottamāḥbhakṣayennātra saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kartavyo vāmamārgaḥ kṣayāvahaḥbhagaḥ śaktirgāṃgaṃ vāri jalaṃ matambuddhirnocennirayamāpnuyātpāpakṣayārthaṃ gamanāya cahana hanāmyahampūrvajanmani yairvāmibhiḥ kṛtaṃ yadupāsanamtyaktvā prāṇānyāṃti surālayamkaṭhoraṃ vāpriyaṃ naiva susaṃvadettāśca bhoktavyā eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥcāṇḍālīnāmapi strīṇāṃ sparśadoṣaṃ na mānayetsurayā homastatpratyakṣaṃ samācaretgṛhāṇeti manobhīṣṭantu yorcayettiṣṭhanti devatāḥtīrthayātrāṃ na kurvīta gaṅgāsnānaṃ na cācaretkṛtvā japansiddhimavāpnuyātsiddhiranyathā pretavadbhavetpravakṣyāmi sūkṣmasādhanamadbhutamkṛtvā gacchedaśvatthabhūmikāmdevatāyāḥ samācaretkuryāccairaṇḍatailenābhāve kāpilahavyakaiḥkuryādaṣṭaśatasūtrāṇāṃ vartikā matādṛṣṭvā japenmantraṃ nānyatastu vilokayetbhinnaśabdāḥ sādhakaṃ bhīṣayanti tenānyadṛṣtiḥ prapaśyeddīpameva hibalindattvā stutvā saṃyācayedvaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: grāhyaṃ tatra devīṃ prapūjya cadattvākṣṇoḥ kajjalaṃ tacca prayogānācarettataḥsamyaṅnocedbhavati bhairavaḥvaktavyaṃ kimataḥ paramsarahasyā mahāmantrāḥ kalau siddhipradāyakāḥbrūhi tasya ca ke mantrāḥ keṣvāmnāyeṣu kīrtitāḥyathāyaṃ pāvanaṃ vipraṃ svayameva karaiḥ spṛśetcaturyugeṣu pratyakṣo devoyaṃ sarvasammataḥtasya mantrānpravakṣyāmi sāvadhānā bhavāmbikedevabhāgo muniśchando gāyatrī devatā raviḥhṛnmantraḥ [satyatejojvālāmaṇe huṃ phaṭ svāhā hṛdayāya namaḥ || ] satyapūrvoyaṃ brahmapūrva [ brahmatejojvālāmaṇe huṃphaṭ svāhā śirase svāhā || ] śiromanuḥp. 486) agnipūrvo [agnitejojvālāmaṇe huṃphaṭ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ] netramanurastraṃ [sarvatejovālāmaṇe huṃphaṭsvāhā astrāya phaṭ | iti ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vidhāya mūrtinyāsaṃ vidadhīta sa yathā || ] sarvapadairbhavetmastakānanahṛdguhyapādadeśeṣu deśikaḥsūryyastataśca mantrārṇānpraṇavādyānnyasedbudhaḥ [atha mantrākṣaranyāsaḥ oṃ ghṛśīrṣaṇi, oṃ ṇiḥ mukhe, oṃ sū kaṇṭhe, oṃ ryyaḥ hṛdaye, oṃ ākukṣau, oṃ di liṅge, oṃ tyaḥ pādayoḥ, itthaṃ nyāsānkṛtvā dhyāyet || ]padme caiva samāsīnaṃ varakeyūrabhūṣaṇampūjayitvā yogapīṭhantatpīṭhe cārcayedravimīśānānmadhyaparyyantaṃ samārādhyaṃ prabhūtakamtadbāhyeṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā dalamūleṣu cārcayetbhadrā vibhūtirvimalā hyamoghā vidyutā tathāāsāṃ bījāni rāṃrīṃrūṃraiṃroṃrauṃtu krameṇa casaurāya yogapīṭhāya hṛdantoṣṭādaśākṣaraḥmūrtti ca kalpayāmīti cokttvā mūrti prakalpayettadbāhyeṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā digdaleṣu yajedimānādyārṇabījā hṛnṅentā vidikpatre yajedimāḥsūryyasyāgreruṇaḥ pūjyopyatha vidhvādayo grahāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lakṣmīrdyutiḥ sthirācchittissiddhirjarā ca pālinītīkṣṇā ca raudrī ca bhayā nidrā ca tandrikātathānantā madhyemadhye prapūjayetgāyatrīṃ viṣṇoryoniṃ tathaiva cakalādaśakamāvāhya sṛṣṭyādyaṃ sannidhāpya caprāṇasaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā kalānāṃ pūjayecca tāḥnivṛttyādyāścāpi yajeduktayuktyā vicakṣaṇaḥsapta dhruvaṃ bhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥtvaśvatthapanasacūtānāṃ pallavāndṛḍhamtaṃ ca bhāvayetkalaśoparikalpavṛkṣaphalaṃ hyetatsthāpayedanayā dhiyāetatpradhānakumbhasya sthāpanaṃ parikīrtitammaṇḍalāni kuryādaṣṭadalāni capūrṇakalaśaṃ tatra caitānprapūjayetcāgneyyāṃ dikṣu kumbhāṃstu vinyasetrudrādikāṣṭhāsukramādrudrādikānyajetpuṇḍarīkaṃ vāmanaṃ kumudāñjanausvavedyāṃ tu gatvā svasyāsane viśetsamāvāhya pūjayediṣṭadevatāmcaitanyaṃ nāsikāgravinirgatamsamutthāpya tasyāmāvāhayettataḥsammukhakiraṇaṃ cāpi śakalīkaraṇaṃ tataḥkuryātkramaśastasya mudrikāḥāsanādiprasūnāntānupacārānprakalpya calokapālānāṃ tadastrāṇāṃ ca pūjanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadastrāṇi ca tadbāhye bhāskarārcanamīritamjuhuyāttatsahasrāṇi dugdhāktaiḥ sādhakottamaḥsvābhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥraktāmbaradharo raktamālyo raktānulepanaḥbhikṣāhārastathā vītasaṅgaḥ santoṣavānsadārathamabhyarcya bhāsvantañcārghyaṃ tasmai nivedayetagre maṇḍalamālikhya yajetpīṭhaṃ yathāvidhiramyaṃ prasthajalagrāhi mūlamantraṃ samuccaretrocanāṃ rājikāṃ raktacandanaṃ vaṃśataṇḍulānsañcintya devatātmaikyaṃ bhāskaraṃ samyagarcayetsamyagaṣṭottaraśataṃ bhūyaḥ puṣpādibhiryajetdṛṣṭiṃ nidhāya vyomnyarkaṃ sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ smaretarghyaṃ prasannacetāḥ sandadyācca sumanoñjalimarghādikaṃ samādatte japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatamanena tu prayogeṇa bhavedāyurnirugṇatātanmantrasahitāmbhobhiḥ saptadhāñjalisecanamsthaṇḍile sthāpayetkumbhaṃ tīrthodakasupūritamdevaṃ saparivārantu prāguktavidhinā tataḥpacettenaiva juhuyādravyājyasahitena caṛtusnātāṃ suniyatāṃ pūrvāṅgasamupoṣitāmabhiṣiñcetkumbhajalairdadyāttasyai tu mantravitnaropi sūryya evāhamiti dhyātvā tayā sahaatha mantrāntaraṃ vakṣye dineśasya ṣaḍakṣarammunirbrahmā ca gāyatraṃ chandaḥ savitṛdaivatamsūkṣmākārāyāgnivadhūriti mantreṇa śīrṣakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sūkṣmākārāya huṃphaḍityevaṃ śastraṃ prakīrttitamraktapadmadvayaṃ hastairbibhratañca varābhayepūrvokte pūjayet pīṭhe devamāvāhya mantravitjuhuyāttaddaśāṃśena bilvairatha palāśajaiḥudumbarasamudbhūtaistrimadhvaktaiḥ samidvaraiḥarghādikaṃ ca kurvīta pūrvavadvāñchitāptayena bhāskarasamaḥ kaścidbhuktimuktipradāyakaḥnyāso dhyānaṃ ca pūjā ca prāgvadeva samīritābhavettannyāsapūjādi dhyānādyaṅgaṃ ṣaḍarṇavattanno raviḥ pracodayātbhagnatrānāṃ rājaputrāṇāṃ kṣatratejovidhāyinīparastrībhiryaccharīraṃ puraścaryyācatuṣṭayamsārvabhaumatvamāpnoti brāhmaṇānpratipālayetṛṣirbrahmā ca gāyatrī chandaḥ sūryyaśca devatādedīpyamānaratnaughamukuṭena virājitamnavaśaktisamāyukte pīṭhe pūrvodite yajetsampūjya tasyāva raṇānyarcayetkramataḥ sudhīḥmahocchuṣmā pañcamī ca madhyātpūrvādike yajetketurvidikṣu pūjyāśca caturthāvaraṇaṃ raveḥṅentaṃ hṛdantaṃ kheṭasya nāmapūjāmanurmataḥcatulakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ juhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥ || brahmavṛkṣasamadbhūtaiḥ puṣpaistrimadhuraplutaiḥevaṃ sādhitamantrastu kāmyakarmmāṇi sādhayetdadyādarghadvayamapi bhavettasyoditaṃ phalamtryakṣarosya tu hrāṃhrīṃsaḥ proktaḥ sarvārthadāyakaḥdevatāsya manoḥ proktaḥ savitā surapūjitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūrdhādikaṇṭhaparyyantaṃ mantrārṇānvinyasetsudhīḥsthitaḥ padmeruṇe tryakṣoruṇavarṇasubhūṣaṇaḥpūrvodite yajetpīṭhe navaśaktisamanvitedikpālaiśca tṛtīyaṃ syāccaturthantu tadāyudhaiḥghṛtāktamadhurāktaiśca yavānnaiścaiva tādṛśaiḥ [ghṛtamadhvaktairyavaiḥ || ]dadyātpūrvoditaṃ cārghyaṃ dineśāya susādhakaḥkaroti ratnavastrādibhūṣaṇāni vivardhayetpatramadhye karṇikāyāṃ tāṃśca toyena pūrayetprajapyānyeṣu tanmantrāñchatakṛtvo japetsudhīḥmucyate nātra sandehaḥ sādhako grahadoṣataḥgrahahomaḥ prakarttavyo grahāṇāṃ vai kṛte tathāvigrahādau bhaye cāpi ghorarūpe mahāgadesvadikṣu cāgnīnsaṃsthāpya juhuyācca samidvaraiḥśamīdūrvākuśodbhūtaiḥ kramāddhomaḥ samīritaḥante cānyavyāhṛtibhirhutvā homaṃ samāpayetdadyācca bhojayedviprānsaṃgrāme vijayī bhavetkṛtyādrohārikāṇāñca śāntirevāśu jāyateathānyatsampravakṣyāmi saṃgrāmavijayābhidhamsarvaṃ pūjādikañcāsya śreyojanakamantravatbrahmā muniḥ samuddiṣṭo gāyatraṃ chanda ucyateṣaḍdīrgheṇa sakāreṇa haṃpūrveṇa ṣaḍaṅgakamkarairdadhānaṃ padmasthaṃ haraṃ gauryyaṅkagambhajetatra devaṃ yajenmūrtiṃ mūlenākalpya mantravitṛtuṃ vasuṃ narañcāpi parañca vidiśāsu catato lokeśvarāṃścāpi tadagre cāyudhānyapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvoditena vidhinā sūryyāyārghaṃ nivedayetsūryyāṣṭagandhairatha vā candanābhyāṃ manuntvimamtīrthādijalasampūrṇantasyordhvaṃ sthāpayetkaramjapetsudhāmayantañca kalaśaṃ hṛdi bhāvayetgatarogo dīrghajīvī vipadbādhāparicyutaḥādau tena vidhātavyaḥ kareṇa karakaḥ śubhaḥviṣiṇaṃ nirviṣo bhūyātsthāvarājjaṅgamādapivinyasyeddaṃśino mūrdhni mantrayitvā viṣaṃ haretplutañcāmṛtadhārābhirbhāvayitvā manuñjapetapasmṛtintridoṣotthānrogānhanyānna saṃśayaḥsañcintya prajapennityaṃ kṣepayetpalitañjarāmdvitīyañcandradhārābhirmārjjayettena mantravithakāro rephasaṃyuktaḥ pakāreṇa samanvitaḥbinduyuktaṃ kūṭamuktaṃ mārtaṇḍasya trivarṇakamvāmamārgeṇa bhajatāmādeśyaṃ kimidaṃ budhaiḥdevatoktotha haṃbījaṃ binduḥ śaktiḥ prakīrttitāravirdivākaraścāpi nyastavyā hyaṃgulīṣu tāḥśirovadanahṛdguhyapādadeśeṣu tā nyasetvyāpakaṃ mūlabījena kurvīta tadanantarammukhemukhe trinayanaṃ maṇivanmukuṭānvitamakṣamālāṃ kapālaṃ ca dadhataṃ karapaṃkajaiḥpadmasthitaṃ hāsyamukhaṃ mārtaṇḍaṃ dyumaṇiṃ bhajeādāvaṃgāni sampūjya karṇikāyāmuṣādikāḥnetramīśānakoṇe ca tadbāhye khecarānapidaśāṃśaṃ kamalaiḥ phullairjuhuyānmadhurokṣitaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturaṃgulasaṃbhūteḥ sumanobhiḥ śriyaṃ labhetjuhuyānmātuluṃgaiśca labhaterthaṃ suvāṃchitamputro lakṣmīśca saubhāgyaṃ sarvadā vijayo bhavetśrīṃ mantroyaṃ daśārṇastupañcāmnāyeṣu kīrttitaḥduṣṭagrahāstu saumyāḥ syū rājamānyaḥ sajāyatebhāskaraḥ sarvatulyastu sarvoṣāṃ phaladāyakaḥityetattubhyamākhyātaṃ kiṃ vācyamatha tadvadaiti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte sūryyamantraprakāśa ekaviśaḥśrotumicchāmi ca manūnsaprayogāṃśca tānvadakālena kathitaṃ mahyaṃ tanmayā kīrtyatedhunātattvato naiva jānanti kimpunaḥ śaktito janāḥtathā mama grahā rūpaṃ tava māyeti kīrttitamp. 493) tuṣṭaṃ bhavati ruṣṭeṣu śatrutvamupajāyatena tu grahakṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ saukhyaṃ mithyāprajāyatesadīrghanijabījena [āṃsauṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ, īṃsauṃ śirase svāhā, ūṃsauṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ, aiṃsauṃ kavacāyahum auṃ sauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ, aḥ sauṃ astrāya phaṭ imaṃ nyāsaṃ kṛtvā cāṃ cīṃ cūṃ caiṃ cauṃ caḥ ebhiḥ ṣaḍakṣarairaṅguṣṭhādi nyāsaṃ hṛadayādinyāsaṃ ca vidadhīta sa yathā - cāṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ, cīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ, cūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ, caiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ, cauṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ, caḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | cāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ, cīṃ śirase svāhā, ityādi || ] ṣaḍaṃgāni samācaretdadhānaṃ bhāvayedevaṃ mṛgāṃkaṃ maṇimaulikamcandramaṇḍalaparyyaṃtaṃ tataḥ sampūjayedvidhumāpyāyinī candrikā ca hlādinī nava śaktayaḥcitrā ca kṛttikā kāntiḥ śravaṇā pīṭhaśaktayaḥanena pīṭhaṃ sampūjya nāmamantraiśca śaktayaḥrātrirārdrā tathā jyotsnā kalā dhyānamathocyatemuktāhārālaṃkṛtāṃgyaḥ pāṇyañjalipuṭāḥ śubhāḥprasannacandravadanāḥ phullendīvaralocanāḥvajrādīni tato bāhyepyevaṃ pūjā samīritātataḥ siddho bhavenmantraḥ prayogānācarettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 494) trisahasraṃ tena labhate rājyaiśvaryyamakiñcanaḥdharāgataṃ nidhānaṃ sa dhruvaṃ prāpnoti tatkṣaṇātayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ yacchāṃtiracirādbhavetsaubhāgyārogyasampattibhājanaṃ manujo bhavetlipte bhūmaṇḍale kṛtvā niṣīdetpaścime tataḥagrasthamaṇḍale padmasaṃyute pūrvavadyajetśuddhagopayasā mantrī spṛśanpātraṃ manuṃ japetkāntiṃ yathepsitāṃ kanyāṃ satkīrtiṃ labhate dhruvasmukhi śirontastārādyo vidyāmanurayaṃ smṛtaḥsomaḥ śrīśchanda uddiṣṭamekatattvo munirmataḥbījenaiva ṣaḍaṅgāni dhyānapūjādipūrvavatamṛtaṃ nissṛtaṃ tena plāvitaṃ sakalaṃ vapuḥsamastaviṣarogādyakālamṛtyuvināśanampāpakṣayāyurvṛddhī ca valīpalitanāśanamdaśākṣaraścandramantro japyaścāgre dayāyutaiḥete proktāścandramantrā sarvakalyāṇadāyakāḥaṃ ca aṅgārako ṅento hṛdantaścāṣṭavarṇakaḥaṅgaṣaṭkantvasya manorādi [amiti bījena ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ || ] bījena sammatamjānusthavāmahastāḍhyaṃbhājanetarapāṇikamlakṣāṣṭako japaḥ proktaḥ khādirairindhanairhunetanugrahāttasya lokastvanṛṇī vyādhivicyutaḥdaśākṣaro manuḥ prokto virūpākṣo munirmataḥhrīṃbījaṃ śrīśca śaktiḥ syātkīlakaṃ klīṃ prakīrttitamṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena aṃgulyādiṣaḍaṅgakamliṃge gude ca mantrasya daśavarṇānkramānnyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthirāsano mahākāyaḥ sarvakarmmāvarodhakaḥdharātmajaḥ kujo bhaumo bhūmido bhūminandanaḥvṛṣṭikarttāpahartā ca sarvakarmmaphalapradaḥmukhe ca cibuke kaṇṭhe skandhayorbhujayostathājānvośca jaṅghayoraṃghryoḥ kramānnāmāni vinyasettato dhyāyedraktavarṇaṃ raktamālyāṃśukāvṛtammaṃgalānāṃ maṃgalañca sarvakāmaphalapradamjapāprasūnaiḥ purubhirmadhuratritayānvitaiḥvidhinā bhūmitanayaṃ sarvāṃbhīṣṭaphalapradamekaviṃśatikoṣṭheṣu tato cāṣṭau grahānnyasetmāheśvarī ca cāmuṇḍā kaumārī cāparājitāpūjyā vidhānataḥ sarve mantriṇaibhirmanūttamaiḥkapālinaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ ca tathā saṃhārabhairavamevaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogānkartumarhatisvāgato vāmapādena pravrajyāṣṭottaraṃ śatambrāhmaṇaṃ bhojayedekaṃ guḍapracuravastubhiḥlabhate mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ vatsareṇa na saṃśayaḥjuhuyāttarppayenmantrī prāpnuyānnijavāñchitamtatastṛtīyarekhhantu cihnābhyāṃ lāñchayettataḥdvitīyāgre samākṛṣya tṛtīyāṃcihnayornyasetturyyā cihnadvayenātha tribhiścihnaiśca pañcamīturyyāgre yojayetsamyakpañcamyāścihnayordvayoḥevamekādhikā samyakkoṣṭhānāṃ viṃśatirbhavetmaṅgalādyāṃstārapūrvānnamontānekaviṃśatimatha mantrāntaraṃvakṣye bhāmajasya mahādbhutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṅentaṃ hṛdantaṃ rudrārṇaiḥ prokto bhaumapriyo manuḥbhagavandevadeveśa ehyehi tvaṃmahāprabhoraktagandhādivastraiśca naivedyaṃ ca guḍodanamgodhūmacūrṇajāstatra sthāpayitvā prabhakṣayetbhaumastotrapurāṇādicarcayā tu dinaṃ nayetyācanīyaṃ yogyavastu satvarañca prayacchatioṃhāṃhaṃsaḥ khaṃkha iti mantraḥ proktaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥṣaḍbhirvarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni manoḥ kurvīta sādhakaḥmeṣasaṃsthaṃ raktavastraṃ taṃ vandehaṃ dharātmajamśaivapīṭhe yajedbhaumaṃ prāgaṅgāni tu pūjayetitthaṃ susiddhaṃ mantreśaṃ sveṣṭasiddhyai prayojayetlabhate nātra sandehaḥ putraṃ sarvaguṇānvitamdantāndhāveddvedamārgasamidhā maunasevitāvidhijñaṃ vipramāhūya bhaumamarcettadājñayāmaṅgalādīni nāmāni svapratīkeṣu vinyasetvāmabāhau dakṣabāhau gale ca vadane nasoḥbāhudvayetha mūrddhādipādaparyyantavigraheevaṃ nyastaśarīrosau dhyāyeddharaṇinandanamekaviṃśatikoṣṭhāḍhye trikoṇe tāmrapātrakeaṅgāni pūjayetprāgvadekaviṃśatikoṣṭhataḥbrāhmyādyā mātṛkā bāhye śakrādīnāyudhānyapiphalaṃ nidhāya mantrābhyāṃ bhaumāyārghyaṃ nivedayetsutārthinī tvāṃ prapannā gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namostu tepradakṣiṇā vidhātavyā tāvadbhirnagapātmajevāmapādena mantrābhyāmetābhyāṃ tatpramārjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtarekhātrayaṃ vāmapādenaiva pramārjmyahammārjayāmyasitā rekhāstisro janmatrayodbhavāḥdhyāyantī caraṇāmbhojaṃ pūjāsāṅgatvasiddhayekumāraṃ śaktihastaṃ ca maṅgalaṃ praṇamāmyahamnamo vidyotamānāya sarvakalyāṇakāriṇesukhaṃ yānti yatastasmai namo dharaṇisūnavepūjitaḥ sukhasaubhāgye tasmai kṣmāsūnave namaḥmeṣavāhana rudrātmanputraṃ dehi dhanaṃ yaśaḥgurave dakṣiṇāndattvā bhuñjītānnaṃ niveditamtilairvidhāya homaṃ ca śatārdhaṃ bhojayeddvijānmaṇḍalasthe ghaṭebhyarcya sutasaubhāgyasiddhayetanno bhaumaḥ pracodayātetasyāstu japādeva prasīdati dharāsutaḥdaśākṣaro bhaumamantro japyaścāyaṃ navāyutambuṃ ṅento budhaśabdaśca hṛdayāntaḥ ṣaḍarṇakaḥṣaḍaṅgāni svabījena vinyasyaivaṃ vicintayetjānusthavāmahastābjaṃ sābhayetarapāṇikamarcanaṃ tvaṅgakheṭāśāpatibhistryāvṛtaṃ smṛtamdaśākṣaraḥ saumyamantro japo lakṣaikasaṅkhyayāvahnistrīviśvavarṇoyaṃ japyaḥ pañcadaśāyutamchandonuṣṭummunirbrahmā devaḥ prokto bṛhaspatiḥsuvarṇābhaṃ pītavastraṃ ratnasvarṇāmbarādikamspṛśantaṃ samyagaparaṃ vṛṣaṇau kanakādikamjapitvāśītisāhasraṃ hutvā tena ghṛtena vāsiddhe manau prakurvīta prayogāniṣṭasiddhaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saptaviṃśacchatānmantrī vāsāṃsi labhate maṇīnjuhuyātpippalotthābhissamidbhistannivṛttayevastraṃ [vastraṃ me dehi śuṃ śukrāya namaḥ | iti ekādaśākṣaro mantraḥ |] me dehi śukrāya hṛdayāntaḥ śumādikaḥbrahmā munirdevatā tu śukro daityātipūjitaḥśukraṃ namāmyāsanasthaṃ muktābharaṇabhūṣitamaṅgagrahāśeśaheticaturāvaraṇaṃ [aṅgagrahadikpālatadāyudhairmantrasya caturāvaraṇapūjanam |] manoḥbhavanti mantramāhātmyānnaśyante ca kṣa yādayaḥaṅgendrādyāyudhaiḥ pūjā trirāvṛtyāsya kīrttitāetanmantropāsakānā prabhutvamupajāyatedaśākṣaraḥ śukramantro japyoyaṃ dvādaśāyutambhūpaiḥ kṛtā vinaśyanti strīsaukhyamupajāyateṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaretvāmajānusthitaṃ vāmakaraṃ dakṣe varaṃ dadhatśanaiścarasya bhaktānāmāpado na daridratāṅentaṃ svāhā dvādaśārṇo japaḥ prayutasammitaḥklībānatrānayetyuktaṃ sādhakosya prabhāvataḥmunyādyā brahmagāyatrīrāhavaḥ parikīrttitāḥvikṛtāsyaṃ raktanetraṃ dhūmrālaṅkāramanvahamrāhorupāsako bhūpaḥ saṃgrāme vijayī bhavetdaśākṣaro rāhumantro japyaścāyaṃ daśāyutamkaṃ ketave hṛdityevaṃ ketumantraḥ ṣaḍarṇakaḥkaṃ bījaṃ ketuśaktiśca bījenaiva ṣaḍaṃgakamvāmorunyastasaddhastaṃ sābhayetarapāṇikamatra tu grahapūjāyāṃ pūjyaṃ madhye niveśayetoṃ prāṃprīṃprauṃ sabinduḥ saketave vahnigehinī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tato maṇḍalamparitaḥ kramātdakṣabhāge kṛtvā sthaṇḍilamuttamamyathāvidhi tatastatra gandhādyairdevatāṃ yajetjuhuyānmūlamantreṇa pāyasena ghṛtena catāṃ candanādyaiḥ pīṭhamūrtau nidhāpayetpārṣadebhyaścandanādipuṣpākṣatasamanvitampunaryajeccopacāraiḥ pañcabhirdarśayettataḥsahasraṃ ca japenmantrī mūlamantraṃ samāhitaḥpūrvaṃ sthāpito vikirotra cadevatāṃ ghorarūpiṇīmtiṣṭhansampūjya ca tato gṛhītvā tampradakṣiṇamdevatāntārayettataḥbhūyastaṃ gandhādyairdeśikottamaḥdevateṣṭādijepātre kṣālite ca śarāṇunātithiprasṛtimānena śarāṇūnprapacetkṣipetmūlamantreṇa deśikottamaḥsruvasaṃsthena ghṛtenāthāvatārayettvekandevatāyai paraṃ vahnau nivedayetprādeśamātraṃ hṛjjaptaṃ yathoktaṃ dantadhāvanamśiṣyāya dadyātsa radānviśodhya kṣālitaṃ tyajetṛtvijaśca gacchedyajñagṛhaṃ pratimanunā hyaṣṭottarasahasrakamsnātaṃ pañcagavyaṃ pāyayenmantravittamaḥhṛtpuṇḍarīkacaitanyaṃ śiṣyasyātmani yojayetkalāstattvabhuvanārṇapadā mantrapūrvikāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daśākṣaraḥ ketumantro japtoyaṃ dvādaśāyutamupāsakānāmetasya ketavogre calanti higrahamātari ruṣṭāyāṃ sugrahaiḥ kiṃ prayojanamulkā siddhā saṃkaṭā ca vikaṭāgarbhapālikāphalaṃ nāmani rūpaṃ syādekopacayatā dvayoḥtuṣṭā cecchatruvargasya ruṣṭā kuryyāttu sādhakedīrghaṣaṭkayujā [kṣāṃ kṣīṃ kṣūṃ kṣaiṃ kṣauṃ kṣaḥ | ebhirakṣaraiḥ ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ caret || ] pūrvabījenaiva ṣaḍaṃgakamhastābhyāṃ dadhatīṃ padmayugalaṃ tāṃ bhajāmyahamjapāpuṣpāṇi śastāni dhūpo guggulasambhavaḥalaṃkārastathā raktāstathā vastrāṇi candanamtarppayetparameśānīṃ tattanmantraiḥ sahasradhākṛtvā yantraṃ yathoktantu yoginīṃ tatra pūjayetsaptāhena prajāyeta trividhotpātavāraṇamatha vā sthaṇḍile śuddhe sulipte gomayāmbubhiḥanyāsāṃ daśavārāṃstu viruddhāyāḥ sahasradhāsahasramayutaṃ vāpi lakṣaṃ vā kāmanākramāticchāṃ jñānaṃ kriyāśaktiṃ triṣu koṇeṣu pūjayettadbāhye bhūpure lokapālānastrāṇi pūjayetviśeṣaḥ punaratrāsti śatrūcchedābhicārakaiḥgaruḍāsanamāsīnāṃ vairinigrahakariṇīmsarvaśatruvināśaḥ syādduḥkhaṃ nāpnoti kutracitmāyādyo [hrīṃ maṃgale maṃgalālayai svāhā || ] vahnijāyānto maṅgale maṅgalālayekṛtvādyena ṣaḍaṅgāni dīrghaṣaṭkayujā tathādarasmeramukhāmbhojāṃ sindūrasundarādharāmsuguñjanmañjumañjīrāṃ kāñcīguṇavirājitām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tato lakṣaṃ manuṃ japtvā tāramāyāpuraḥsaramsarvāsāmeva pūjānte maṅgalaivaṃ prasīdatiduryoginyanukūlārthaṃ japettatsaṅkhyakāyutamprāptaye prajapettāvatsahasrantu manuṃ sudhīḥtuṣṭāyā varṇaśatakai rogiṇaṃ cābhimantrayettasyāḥ pīḍāni vṛttiḥ syādvarṇābhyantargatairjapaiḥyoginī tulyaphaladā vāme mārge ca dakṣiṇebhrāmaya klīṃ ṣaḍdaśārṇo mantrosyāḥ parikīrtitaḥmantrayitvā tathā mārge daśadikṣu ca santyajetśulkino duṣṭabhūpāśca nityamevaṃ samācaretyojanaikaṃ japanmantraṃ sa bhramecca vasundharāmblaṃ bījaṃ toyabhṛyogājjātamādau samuccaretpunaśca parabhadrāṇi nāśayadvitayaṃ tataḥṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena [blāṃ, blīṃ, blūṃ, blaiṃ, blauṃ, blaḥ, ebhiḥ ṣaḍakṣaraiḥ ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ caret | yathā blāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ, blīṃ śirase svāhā ityādi || ] ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥpiṅgalāvatsamuddiṣṭaṃ japādyaṃ proktavartmanāśrīṃ [śrīṃ dhanade dhānye svāhā iti mantraḥ || ] dhanade samuccāryya dhānye svāhāṣṭavarṇakaḥnāsti dhānyāsamākācidiha loke dhanapradādahettu dhānyā dadate dhanyatvaṃ sādhakāya capuraścaryyāṃ tatra kṛtvā yaśodhanyaḥ prajāyatehrīṃ [hrīṃ siddhide sarvaṃ mama sādhayasādhaya namaḥ || ] siddhide sarvaṃ mama samuktvā sādhayadvayamnāsti siddhopāsakānāṃ karmmāsiddhistu kutracitsidhyet ṣaṭkarmma martyasya manorārādhanaṃ vināmantraḥ proktaḥ prajaptoyaṃ dhanārogyaprado mataḥsarvarogāpaho mantro mārjanātsaṃprapadyateśītalāyā mahāmāryā mahiṣaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: utsṛjettaṃ yamāśāyāmupadravaśamo bhavethrīṃ saṅkaṭe ca rogaṃ me paramaṃ nāśayadvayamkārāgṛhe japellakṣaṃ bandhamokṣaḥ prajāyatetatra ṣoḍaśalakṣāṇi japtvā homastu dūrvayāamukasyāmukaṃ kaṣṭaṃ gataṃ tadgatameva hitāro [oṃ namo bhagavati vikaṭe vīrapālike prasīdaprasīda || ] namo bhagavati vikaṭe vīrapālikekāśyāṃ vīreśvarāsannā paścime vikaṭā sthitāudaraṃ cāpi bandhyāyāḥ prajāvatyāstathā śiraḥsādhakasya karaspṛṣṭā nīrogāścira jīvinaḥnavagrahaprakāśo dvāviṃśaḥbrāhmyādyaṣṭau bhāskarasya taṭe tiṣṭhanti śaktayaḥsvarṇaṃ yāśca prayacchanti tanmanūnbrūhi śaṅkarayogināṃ muktidātrī sā bhogināṃ bhogadā matāgāyatrī chanda uddiṣṭaṃ vaḥ śaktiḥ kīlakaṃ caraḥakṣamālāvarābhītikamaṇḍalukarāruṇāmṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni śaktayorcyāḥ kalādalemahatpūrvāścasaptaitāssarasvatyaḥ prakīrttitāḥvāgīśvarīrudraviṣṇumukhānte cākṣayā matātattanmantraiḥ pūjanīyā bāhye dikpāḥsahetayaḥtatpuṣpayuktasalilaistarppayenmārjjayetkuśaiḥlakṣamātraṃ japenmantraṃ kāryyasiddhiḥ prajāyatetāraṃ [oṃ hrīṃ hraiṃ hrīṃ oṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ iti ekādaśākṣaramantraḥ || ] māyāṃ ca hasarānaikārāḍhyānsabindukānpunarmāyāṃ ca tāraṃ ca vadenṅentāṃ sarasvatīmtriṣṭupchando muniḥ kaṃṭhaścintāmaṇi sarasvatīsvarasampuṭitaiḥ [aṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ āṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ iṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ yaṃ īṃ śirase svāhā itthaṃ nyāsakalpanam | punaḥ aiṃ hrīṃ bījābhyāṃsaṃpuṭitaiḥ shrāṃ, shrīṃ, shrūṃ, shraiṃ, shrauṃ, shraḥ, ebhiḥ kūṭākṣarairnyāsīnkuryyāt yathā oṃ hrīṃ shrāṃ oṃ hrīṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādi || ] kādivargaiḥ syādaṃgakalpanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūrddhabhrūmadhyakarṇākṣināsikāsyagudāṃghriṣu [oṃ mūrdhni hrīṃ bhrūmadhye, shraiṃ dakṣakarṇe, hrīṃ vāmakarṇe, oṃ dakṣanetre, sa vāmanetre, ranāsikāyām svamukhe, tyai gude, na dakṣapāde, maḥ vāmapāde, ityakṣaranyāsaḥ || ]vīṇāmṛtaghaṭākṣasragdīptahastāmbujasthitāmvāgdevyau pārśvayoḥ pūjye saṃskṛtaprākṛtāhvayeprajñāṃ medhāṃ śrutiṃ caiva smṛtiṃ śaktiṃ tatorcayetdikpālaiśca caturthaṃ syājjapeddvādaśalakṣakamevaṃ siddhamanurmantrī kāmyakarmāṇi sādhayetsahasratritayaṃ yastu trimāsātsyānmahākaviḥaikārayuktā hasarā bindvantāḥ pūrvabījakamvisargāntāstṛtīyaṃ syādbījaṃ jñānaprado manuḥantabījaṃ bhavecchaktirādyabījantu kīlakamdakṣiṇe ca kare vāme dvaye bījatrayaṃ punaḥhṛdayādi ca śīrṣāntaṃ kramādbījatrayaṃ nyasetpīnottuṃgastanīṃ pūrṇacandrāsyāmaruṇāmbarāmnavayonitrikoṇeṣu vāmā jyeṣṭhādikā yajetādyā bahvī viṣaghnī syāttato dūratarā matāāgneyeśānanair-ṛtyavāyavye paścime kramātsandīptasammohanakau tathā conmādanontimaḥkrameṇa śaktayaḥ pūjyāḥ śubhagā ca tathā bhagāanaṃgamadanā ceti dhyānamāsāṃ [dhyānamāha] nirūpyatedivyāṃbarāḥ sarvabhūṣāḥ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyikāḥbhairavānasitāṃgādyāñchakrādīnāyudhānyapihunetpalāśapuṣpaiśca daśāṃśaṃ vā śatāṃśakampalāśapuṣpairayutaṃ saubhāgyāya ca homayetbhavanti sakalā lokā vaśyā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥpṛthakprayogo dhyānaṃ ca paṃcāśadvarṇaśobhitām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mudrākapālavidyākṣamālārājanmahābhujāmkavitā tasya jāyate nānāvṛttārthaśobhitāsṛṇipāśakapāleṣumātuluṃgadhanuṣkarāmhelāvilāsasambhinnāṃ navayauvanasundarīmtrailokyaṃ kṣobhayedāśu pūrvavatsiddhibhāgasaunavakundendusaṃkāśāṃ rājanmauktikabhūṣaṇāmyo japetprāya etasya kavitā bhuvi sammatātāto [oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ shrauṃ huṃ phaṭ nīlasarasvatyai svāhā | iti caturdaśākṣaro mantraḥ || ] lakṣmīśca hṛllekhā hasāvoṃṅkārasaṃyutauṛṣyādyā brahmagāyatryau tathā nīlasarasvatīmantrotthitairatho dhyāyeddevīṃ sarveṣṭasiddhidāmpothayantīṃ pādatale paśuṃ candrakalādharāmviśeṣājjayadā vāde vidyeyaṃ sādhitā nṛbhiḥśrīmadekajaṭe nīlasarasvati padaṃ vadetbhūtapiśācarākṣasāngrasa yugmaṃ mameti cadvipaṃcāśallipiścāyaṃ dhyānapūjādipūrvavathrīṃśrīṃhumiti munyādyaṃ yathā tripurabhairavī [tripurabhairavīmantrasye tyarthaḥ || ]trīṃhuṃphaṭ ca navārṇoyaṃ dhyānapūjādi pūrvavathasakhapharavarṇāśca [haṃsphreṃ hsrauṃ hauṃsphrauṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ drāṃ hrīṃ klīṃ blūṃ saḥ ghīṃ ghaṭasarasvati ghaṭe vadavada tura tura rudrājñayā mamābhilāṣaṃ kuru kuru svāhā ayaṃ vahnivedārṇaḥ || ] aiṃkāreṇa samanvitāḥvisargāntā dvitīyaṃ syāddhasau pho rapha eva cavācaṃ māyāṃ ramāṃ drāṃ hrīṃ kāmaṃ blūṃ saṃstathaiva caghaṭe vadadvayampaścāttvarayugmaṃ vadettataḥsvāhāntognikṛtārṇoyaṃ prāgvatpūjādikaṃ bhavetvāmācāreṇa phaladāṃ vāgbījaṃ haiṃ samuccaretcāmuṇḍāmantravatsarvaṃ japanyāsādikaṃ bhavetvācaṃ māyāmantarikṣasarasvatyagnigehinī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śṛṇuyādīpsitāṃ vārtāṃ dūrasthāmapi sādhakaḥaiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ samuccārya sauṃklīṃhrīṃ aiṃ punarvadetdrāṃhrīṃklīṃblūṃ sa uccāryya aiṃhrīṃśrīṃklīṃ punarvadetbrahmānuṣṭupsarasvatyo munyādyāḥ parikīrttitāḥnavāsanāṃ sarppabhūṣāṃ kartrīṃ cāpi kapālakammuṇḍamālādharāṃ tryakṣāṃ bhaje nīlasarasvatīmdaśāṃśaṃ juhuyātpūjāṃ pīṭhe kuryyācca socyatedvātriṃśatpatramante syāccatuḥṣaṣṭidalaṃ tathāevaṃ yantraṃ samālikhya bāhyataḥ pūjanaṃ caretvāyukoṇe kṣetrapālamaiśāne bhairavaṃ tathābhūgṛhasyādyarekhāyāmaṇimā laghimā tathāgarimā prāptirityetāḥ pūjyāḥ pūrvādidikkramātbhūmigehe tṛtīyāyā rekhāyāṃ mātaraḥ [brāhmī, māheśvarī, kaumārī, vaiṣṇavī, vārāhī, indrāṇī, cāmuṇḍā, mahālakṣmīḥ imā aṣṭau mātaraḥ || ] punaḥcatuḥṣaṣṭidale padme śaktīrarccecca tāvatīḥumāśrīśāntayaścaṇḍā dhūmrā kālī karālinīvāgvādinī ca nakulī bhadrakālī śaśiprabhākhecarī bhūcarī siddhā kāmākṣī hiṃgulābalāvilāsinī tathā ghorā citrā mugdhā dhaneśvarīvedagarbhā tathā bhīmā ugrā vaidyā ca sadgatiḥkulikā mālinī [kāminī iti kvacitpāṭhaḥ || ] kāmyā jñānavatyatha ḍākinīhākinī ca catuḥṣaṣṭiśaktayaḥ siddhidāyikāḥdvātriṃśatpatramadhye tu pūjyā etāstu śaktayaḥūrdhvakeśī ca mātaṃgī mohinī vaṃśavarddhinīśarvarī chatrahastā ca raktanetrā vicarcikāśāntirvityā vajrahastā dhūmrā śvetā sumaṅgalā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tataḥ śoḍaśapatreṣu pūjyāḥ ṣoḍaśaśaktayaḥratiḥ prītistathā bālā sumukhī śyāmalāvilāsarveśvarīti sampūjya sṛṇimudrāṃ [aṃkuśamudrā || ] pradarśayetnamaḥ [oṃ namaḥ padmāsane padmarūpe aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ vadavada vāgvādini svāhā | iti mantraḥ || ] padmāsane padmarūpe vāgbhuvaneśvarīmahākavirvarṇalakṣajapātprācyāṃ ca pūjanamcitreśvarīti vāgbījaṃ svāhānto dvādaśākṣaraḥstrīvaśyakṛttathānena vahni koṇe prapūjayetekādaśārṇamantreṇa kulajāṃ dakṣiṇercayettrayodaśārṇena yajennair-ṛtye kīrttināyikāmvāyavyakoṇe pūrvoktāṃ [ghaṭasarasvatīmantraḥ pūrvaṃ liṃkhitaḥ || ] yajeddhaṭasarasvatīmpaṃcamyāvṛttimārādhya [aiṃ heṃ hīṃ kiṇi kiṇi vicce kiṇi sarasvatyāṃ ayaṃ navākṣaro mantraḥ || ] kṣobhamudāṃ pradarśayetdarśayeddrāviṇīṃ mudrāṃ ṣaṣṭhāvaraṇapūjanedarśayetkarṣiṇīṃ mudrāṃ pūjā cetthaṃ prakīrtitātārāyai cāpi vitaredbaliṃ nityaṃ catuṣpathebalidravyaṃ samākhyātaṃ yeneṣṭaṃ sā prayacchaticaturvaktrāmaṣṭabhujairdadhānāṃ mudrikāṃ bhajeśabdapāthonidhau dhyāyetsṛṣṭidhyānamudīritamraktāmbarāṃ ratnasiṃhāsanasthāṃ hemabhūṣitāmśvevadvīpasthitāṃ dhyāyetsthitidhyānamitīritamnavavaktrāmbhujairaṣṭādaśabhirdadhatīṃ varambhindipālañca muśalaṃ kartrīṃ śaktiṃ triśīrśakamraktāmbhodhau sthitāndhyāyetsaṃhāradhyānamīritamevaṃ siddhe manau mantrī girā vācaspatirbhavetsamprāpte soṣṭame varṣe sarvaśāstrajñatāmiyātdvādaśe vatsare prāpte bhakṣitā sā kavitvakṛt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uparāge jalastho yo'śnīyādvācaspatirbhavetjapecchavaṃ samāruhya vidyāntatparamānasaḥpārago bhava vidyānāṃ sarvasiddhimavāpnuhiupaviśya tayormurdhni karau dattvā japenmanumyaḥ kautukī sa āścaryyaṃ vidyāyāḥ paśyatu dhruvamtatrāsīno japedvidyāmarkalakṣaṃ vidhānataḥpunnāgacampakāśokarambhāvipinasaṃsthitāmevaṃ kurvannaraḥ sarvamabhīṣṭaṃ labhate dhruvamayutaṃ kṛṣṇabhūtāhe sa vāksiddhimavāpnuyātrūpaṃ kāmayamānena sevyeyantu sarasvatīśrīṃhrīṃklīmiti mantrosyāstribījaḥ parikīrttitaḥchando nivṛcca gāyatrī devī lokeśvarī matādhyānamasyāḥ pravakṣyāmi nānāratnacaye sthitaḥtasyādhastādratnamaye sthitāṃ siṃhāsanoparikeyūrahāramukuṭarasanānūpurānvitāmabhītiṃ puṣpabāṇāṃśca dadhānāṃ karapallavaiḥcāmarādarśakarakatāmbūlakaracārubhiḥsūryyalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ hunettrimadhurānvitaiḥṣaṭkoṇamadhye deveśīṃ koṇeṣvaṅgāni pūjayetpārśvadvaye śaṅkhapadmanidhī pūjyautadanantaramcaturthaṃ pañcamanteṣāmāyudhairiti pūjanamtāvaddhunedbilvaphalaiḥ sampattiḥ paramā bhavetjapākusumahomastu samastajanavaśyakṛtathātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tripurāṃ śivasañjñitāmtulyaṃ jñānasarasvatyā dhyānanyāsārcanādikam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: oṃ vāṃśrīṃhrīṃ [oṃ vāṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ sphreṃsauṃ svāhā || ] samuccāryya sphreṃsauṃ svāhāntako manuḥrudravāgīśvarī devī gāyatrī chanda īritamsāṃsīṃsūṃ [vāmityādiprāgabhāvādhikaraṇakṣaṇe oṃ sāṃsīmiti saṃyojya taiḥ ṣaḍaṅganyāsānkurvīta yathā- sām oṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ, sīṃvāṃ śirase svāhā, sūṃ śrīṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ, saiṃ hrīṃ kavacāya hum, sauṃsphreṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ, saḥ sauṃ astrāya phaṭ || ] cāpi saiṃsauṃsaḥ pūrvakairaṃgakalpanamtṛptetyuktvā vadavada anādibodhavajriṇesahajātirūpiṇe cānantaśaktibaliṃ vadetsarvakāmapradaścaivaṃ dhyānamasyā nirūpyatejapapūjāprayogādi jñeyaṃ vāgvādinīsamamoṃ śrīṃsphuṃ śrīṃ namaśceti ṣaḍarṇo mantra ucyateśrīṃbījena ṣaḍaṅgāni dhyānamasyā nirūpyateasyā pūjādikaṃ ṣaṣṭhavarṇavāgvādinīsamamhrīṃ vācaspate amṛtaplūḥ plūṃhrīṃsauṃ ca saṃvadetviṣṇuvāgīśvarī devī virāṭ chandaḥ prakīrttitamvācaspate amṛteti netraṃ plūḥ plūṃ tathāstrakamsaṃvatsaraṃ haviṣyāśī sahasrampratyahañjapettena lokottarā medhā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥbhūtambhavyaṃ varttamānaṃ sarvaṃ jānāti sādhakaḥculukaikammantritantu daśavārammalatrayamsakṛcchrutantu yattena na ca vismaryyate kvacithrīṃ ca padmāvati svāhā saptārṇaḥ parikīrttitaḥprakuryyānmāyayāṅgāni [hrīṃ bījena ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ kuryyāt] dhyānamasyā nirūpyatebandhūkābhāṃ trinayanāṃ nānākalpojjvalāṃ smaretlokapālāṃstadastrāṇi padmāvatyarcanaṃ smṛtampadmāvatīsamānyā tu nāsti saubhāgyadā bhuvitāramuktvā [oṃ ehi parameśvari svāhā | iti mantraḥ || ] tathā caihi parameśvaryyagnigehinīmaśvārūḍhā ṣaḍaṃṅgāni tārādyaistripadairdvidhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: badhvānayantīṃ vāmena dakṣe kanakavetrikāmmātṝrindrādidigbāhye tadastrāṇi tato bahiḥitthaṃ dhyātvaiva sakalaṃ viśvaṃ vaśayate'cirāttrimadhvaktaistathā lonairvaśyā bhūpā hunettu yaḥanayā vidyayā sarppirhomaḥ kāñcanado mataḥpūrvoktenaiva homena nārīmākarṣayeddhruvamṣaḍdīrghamāyayaivāsya ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥdvibhūbhūtrīṣuyugmaiśca ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥindrādibāhyāvaraṇe prokto brāhmyā vidhistvayamoṃ hrīṃnamo bhagavati māheśvaryyehi saṃvadettārādirekaviṃśārṇo'śvārūḍhāvatparaṃ matamdadhatīṃ śūlaḍamaruṃ mahāhivalayāṃ bhajejuhuyāttaddaśāṃśena paramaiśvaryyavānbhavetādau bālāṃ tathā śaktiṃ nityaklinnāgnivāsinīmvajreśvarīṃ ca tvaritāṃ śivadūtīṃ trikaṇṭikāmtato dikpāṃstadastrāṇi cetthaṃ māheśvarī matāvākkāmasaustribījāni sauḥ klīṃ aiṃ ca punaḥ paṭhetgāyatrī chanda uddiṣṭaṃ devī tripurabālikāraktā tryakṣā candrabhālā dhyeyā bālā surārcitājapellakṣaṃ daśāṃśena homaḥ puṣpairhayārijaiḥprabhādibhirdigīśāstraiḥ prayogaḥ pūrvavanmataḥdhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvaproktaṣaḍarṇavatbālatripure svāheti daśārṇo'nyacca pūrvavattataśca bāle tripure siddhiṃ dehi namastvitiprayogāścātra sidhyanti trivarṇoktāstathākhilāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntistathaiva caguruḥ śiṣyaṃ spṛśankuṇḍe svake hunetśodhayāmidviṭhāntena mantreṇāṣṭāhutīrhunetliṅgapradeśesya tattvādhvānaṃ vicintayetśivaśaktī ca sadāśivamaheśvaraukalā rāgaḥ kālo niyatireva camanaścendriyadaśakaṃ tanmātrā bhūtapañcakammanobuddhistanmātrā bhūtapañcakamsaṅkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaścāniruddhakaḥprakṛtirbuddhiriti ca caturviṃśatisammitāḥtathātmeti cātmā vidyā śivā punaḥvilīnaṃ tu cintayed bhuvanādhvanipātālarasātalamahātalamhomavyūhastu pūrvavatakārādikṣakārāntānvarṇānsañcintayeddhṛdiprāgvadevātra lalāṭe cintayettataḥyadādhvātrohahomādi prāgvadeva samācaretmantrādhvā cintayecchiṣyamūrddhanisthitandhyāyedetatsyādadhvaśodhanamhunenmahāvyāhṛtibhistato deśikasattamaḥbrahmārpaṇākhyamantreṇa sarvakarmacchide sudhīḥmantrī stutvā mūlāṇunā tataḥpuṣpantatra prapātayetmāṃsamāṣābhyāṃ tīrthāhvābhyāṃ ca pūrṇatāmdakṣapādampuraskṛtya dakṣaḥ pūrṇāhutiñcaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhārati kavitvaṃ dehi svāhānto'nyacca pūrvavatsvāhāntoṣṭādaśārṇoyaṃ nyāsādyaṃ syātṣaḍarṇavatvidyāṃ kuru namaḥ svāhā viṃśatyarṇaśca pūrvavattripure sarvamityuktvā īpsitaṃ sādhayeti casiddhe mantre lakṣajapādabhīṣṭaṃ sidhyati dhruvamtripure lalite procya madīpsitāṃ ca yoṣitamaṣṭāviṃśativarṇoyaṃ śrīdaḥ sarvantu pūrvavatāṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃklīṃ ca hrī ca śrīmamaṣṭākṣaro manuḥstrīvaśyā karṣaṇādau ca viniyoga udāhṛtaḥaṣṭāṅgaṃ vinyasenmantraṃ mūlena vyāpakaṃ caretbibhratīṃ dorbhiraruṇāṃ kucāḍhyāṃ hṛdi bhāvayetmātṛbhirlokapālaiśca vajrādyaiḥ pañcamāvṛtiḥnityaklinnāmatho vacmi nityaklinne madadravenityaklinnā devatā ca triṣṭup chanda udāhṛtamklinne svāhā śikhā nityaklinne ca kavacaṃ matampūjādikamatho mantrī pūrvavatparikalpayetprāgvatprayogāḥ sevyeyaṃ dāridre sukhakāriṇīoṃ hrīṃ ca vahnivāsinyai namaśceti munirmataḥśaktibījantu śaktissyātkīlakaṃ madhyameritammāyāntena ṣaḍaṅgāni kuryyānmantrī karāṅgayoḥmantrākṣarāṇi vinyasya sarveṇa vyāpakaṃ caretcārusmeramukhāmbhojāṃ vilasannayanatrayāmvāmahasteṣu ratnābjaṃ śaṅkhaṃ puṇḍrekṣujaṃ dhanuḥpuṣpeṣṭaṃ mātuluṅgaṃ ca svasamānasakhīvṛtāmaṣṭayoniṣu sampūjyāstadagrāstu pradakṣiṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kamalā kitavā viśvā vividhā ceti śaktayaḥmeṣā vṛṣā ca mithunā karkaṭādyāśca tā matāḥghasmarāṃ sarvabhakṣāṃ ca viśvākhyā vividhodbhavāmacintyāṃ vai bhavastutāṃ tadagre lokapālakānekalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādghṛtaiḥsiddhamantraḥ prakurvīta prayogānnijavāñchitānśālitaṇḍulamādāya prasthaṃ bhāṇḍe nave kṣipetjaptvā homo vidhātavyo mahālakṣmīkaro bhavetśukle sahasrāṇyaṣṭau ca varṣamevaṃ samācaretghṛtahomādavāpnoti sakalaṃ vāñchitaṃ phalamathātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi hyannapūrṇeśvarīmanummāheśvari cānnapūrṇe svāhā viṃśativarṇakaḥhrīṃbījaṃ cāpi śaktiḥ śrīṃ kīlakaṃ klīṃ prakīrtitambrahmarandhre ca sīmante bhāle bhrūmadhyayornasiādhāre sphigdvaye bāhudvaye jānudvaye tathāpunarmūrdhani bhāle ca bhrūmadhye ca mukhe galevyutkrameṇa punaḥpāyuliṅganābhyādiṣu nyasetvyāpakaṃ ca tataḥ kuryyātsarvamantreṇa sādhakaḥnavaratnaprabhādīptamukuṭāṃ kuṃkumāruṇāmnṛtyantīmīśamaniśaṃ dṛṣṭvānandamayīṃ parāmannadānaratāṃ nityāṃ bhūmiśrībhyāṃ namaskṛtāmdakṣiṇe tu kare devyā darvīṃ dhyāyetsuvarṇajāmkalāpatraṃ ca bhūbimbaṃ caturasratrayāvṛtamoṃ hrāṃ śivāyeti pūjāmantroyaṃ vai nagākṣaraḥgokṣīradhāmadhavalaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nṛtyantamīśvaraṃ devaṃ trikoṇāgre sureśvaramtāro namo bhagavate varāhapadamuccaretvarāhapūjane prokto mantro rāmāgnivarṇakaḥvāmadakṣiṇayoḥ pūjye bhūśriyau svasvamantrataḥannādhipataye ceti mamānnaṃ ca pradāpayaśrīpūjane śīpuṭaḥ syāccatuṣpatre tatorcayetbhuvaneśī svabījena [hrīṃbījena || ] ramayā [śrīṃbījena || ] kamalā tathācandramaṇḍalarūpiṇyaḥ paścimādikrameṇa catannāmānte namaścoktvā iti mantreṇa pūjayetśrīśca svāhā svadhā jyotsnā tato haimavatī bhavetbhūpure lokapālāśca tadastrāṇi tadagrataḥramyapāyasasarpirbhyāṃ siddhidā bhavati dhruvamannapūrṇeśvarī devī pūjitānnasuvarṇadāmāyātārādikā cānyā gaditāṣṭādaśākṣarāaṣṭanāgendravajrādyaiḥ sādhayetpūrvavacca tāḥṛṣirbrahmākṛtiśchando devate bhūśriyau matekṣīrābdhau svarṇarajatadravadvīpe surānvitevittapasyāgratastatra svāsīne vasudhāśriyauāvāhya vaiṣṇave pīṭhe devyā gandhādibhiryajetdigdaleṣu kramātkhaṃ ca vāyumagniṃ tathā jalamvidyāṃ śāntiṃ tato bāhyeṣṭadale cāṣṭa śaktayaḥindrādayastadastrāṇi pūjā caivaṃ samīritāguruṃ santoṣya yatnena mantrasiddhimavāpnuyātchatradhānyānnaratnaughasamṛddho bhavati dhruvamnabho bhagavatītyuktvā māheśvari mameti ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: annapūrṇe vahnijāyā caikatriṃśārṇako manuḥdhyānapūjāprayogādi prāgvatsarvaṃ samīritamtāro ramā ca hṛllekhā namo bhagavatīti caannapūrṇegnijāyāṃto manvarṇairaṃgakalpanamsarvaṃ prāgvatparijñeyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ japataḥ phalamhrīṃ gaurirudradayite yogeśvaripadaṃ vadetajosya munirākhyātonuṣṭupchandosti devatāṣaḍdīrghamāyayā kuryyātṣaḍaṅgāni manorathapāśāṃkuśau sarvabhūṣāṃ tāṃ gaurīṃ sarvadā smaretaṅgāni pūrvamabhyarcya subhagādyāstato yajetpāśāṃkuśā darppaṇākhyā cāñjanā ca śalākikāśakrādayastadastrāṇi gaurīpūjā samīritātarppaṇādi tataḥ kuryyādguruṃ santoṣya yatnataḥvāmākṣīṇāmakṣimaṣyā vāmorau sulikhenmanumśataṃ sahasraṃ lolākṣīmānayetkāmamohitāmdattaṃ saṃsevitaṃ sarvajanatāvaśyakārakamkāṃkṣitastrīvaśaṅkari subhage ca pṛthagdvayamgauṃ gaurīmūrttaye hṛcca pīṭhamantra udāhṛtaḥtanno gaurī pracodayātaṅgāni pūrvamabhyarcya subhagādyāstato yajetsabinduṅentaṃ tannāma namontaṃ tanmanurmataḥvāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca guhyaśaktiḥ kramādimāḥjapenmantraṃ śataṃ cāpi sa vaśyo bhavati dhruvammāyā namaśca brahmaśrīrājite rājapūjitena vaśaṅkari cetyuktvā sarvalokavaśaṃkari
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṛṣirbrahmā nivṛcchando gaurī devī prakīrttitāindradigvasuhastāśārudrārṇairdhyānamucyateśoṇalepāṃ jagadvandyāṃ kusumbhāruṇavastrikāmlokapālāṃstadastrāṇi pūjākrama udāhṛtaḥmadhuratrayasaṃyuktairhomaḥ syāttilataṇḍulaiḥdinatrayaṃ sahasraṃ tu śīghraṃ vaśyakaraḥ smṛtaḥdhyātvā cāṣṭottaraśataṃ japetsarvajagadvaśamoṃ rājamukhi rājādhimukhi vaśyamukhīti camahādevīti devādhidevi sarvajanasya camatravaṇastu hṛdayaṃ triṃśadbhiḥ śira īritamvarmmāṣṭabhiḥ śarairnetraṃ meghairastraṃ prakīrttitamsarvajanapadasthāne sādhyanāma niyojayetmadhuratrayasaṃyuktamaṣṭottaraśataṃ hunettadbhasmanā prayogastu samastajanavaśyakṛtaṣṭacatvāriṃśadarṇo mantrastadvatsamīritaḥmeghaiścāpi manorvarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥsampātājyantu sādhyasya prāṇināṃ vaśakārakamtasyā manuṃ pratiṣṭhāpya prāṅgaṇe nikhanecca tāmjapāpuṣpairniśīthinyāṃ juhuyātsapta vāsarānnikhanetsādhakastasya sādhyo dāso bhaved dhruvamvāgbījaṃ cāpi hṛllekhā nityaklinne madadravetriṣṭupchando devatā ca vajraprastāriṇī matāasyā pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ nityaklinnāvadācarethrīṃ klīṃ klinne tathā kroṃ ca paścānnityamadadraveṛṣirbrahmā ca gāyatrī chando vajreśvarī surī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāgbhavaṃ kīlakaṃ jñeyaṃ hrīṃ klīṃ hrīṃ ca hṛnmanuḥhrīṃ nityaklinne hrīṃ netraṃ hrīṃ made hrīmitīritamityevaṃ śaktipuṭitānmantrārṇāndaśa vinyasettataḥ sañcintayeddevīṃ sarvasaukhyapradāyinīmcaturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalāmdadhānāṃ bāhubhirnetrairdarppaṇāmodaśītalaiḥcakramadhye sukhāsīnāṃ smeravaktrasaroruhāmsiṃhāsane'bhitaḥ preṅkhatpotasthābhiśca śaktibhiḥtatra cakraṃ tatra devīṃ samyagāvāhya pūjayetśaktiṃ sampūjya devyāstu vāmakoṇāditorcayetlākinīṃ kākinīṃ caiva śākinīṃ hākinīṃ tathāhṛllekhāṃ kledinīṃ klinnāṃ kṣobhiṇīṃ madanāturāmmekhalā drāviṇīṃ vegavatīṃ dvādakṣaśaktikāḥkṛtyāṃ kāntāṃ ca kalitāṃ kautākhyāṃ ca kirātikāmkātarāṃ kakaṭāṃ kīrttiṃ kumārīṃ kuṃkumāmapikramādyajeddvārayorddhekoṇekoṇe tathaikikāmyajedāśādhipānbāhye tadaṇāstri tato bahiḥrogāpamṛtyudaurbhāgyajarāśokādivicyutaḥāragvadhaprasūnairvā prasūnairbakulodbhaveḥātmānamabhiṣicyātha tarppayedbrāhmaṇānapigurubhaktaḥ prakurvīta prayogānnijavāñchitānyaḥ sopi kāmyānkurvīta prayogānnijavāñchitānanarthakleśarogādi pīḍāḥ prāpnoti niścitamṣaṇmāsāllabhate lakṣmīṃ mahatīṃ ślāghyavigrahāmjuhuyānnityaśo bhaktyā sahasraṃ vikacaiḥ śubhaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāvajjapecca homānte yāvatsaṃkhyaṃ hutaṃ kṛtamlabhate svarṇaniṣkāṇāṃ śataṃ māsena pūvavatdarśādimāsāllabhate citrāṇi vasanāni cavastūni labhate hṛdyairvastubhirbhāgayogibhiḥtena śālisamṛddhiḥ syānmāsaiḥ ṣaḍbhirasaṃśayamnirātaṅko mahābhāgo śataṃ varṣāṇi jīvaticirāyuḥ śrīyaśobhāgyapuṇyadṛṣṭyādibhāgbhavetāyurārogyavibhavairjanamānyo bhavettadāṣaṇmāsādabdato vāpi rogamuktaḥ sukhī bhavetpākādyamapi tenaiva kuryyādrogavimuktayekṛtvā puttalikāntaistu hṛdayena ca saṃyutāmśatayojanadūrādapyānayedvanitā balātkleśaistaiḥ sa vinirmuktaḥ sukhī jīvati bhūtalevairī ghorajvareṇārttaḥ kṛte prāgvatsukhī bhavettadvidhānena sahiteśatrurunmādavānbhavetoṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ kheṃ ceṃ kṣaiṃ kṣaḥ śrīṃ hrūṃ kṣeṃ hrīṃ phaṭ manurbhavetvirāṭ chandaśca oṃ bījaṃhrīṃ śaktistvaritā surīkṣaiṃ kṣaḥ śikhā ca varmma śrīṃ hrūṃ kṣeṃ netramprakīrttitamjaṅghayoḥ pādayormantrī sarveṇa vyāpakañcarettāṭaṅkātaṅkavidyotiraśanānūpurātmakaiḥdvidvikramādaṣṭanāgaiḥ kalpitodyatsubhūṣaṇāmvalayairbhūṣitabhujāmmāṇikyamukuṭojjvalāmguñjāphalalasaddhāravilasatkucamaṇḍalāmvarābhayakarāṃ gaṇḍadvayāmmukuṭaśobhitāmāsane hemaracite tvaṣṭasiṃhavṛte'bhitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣaṃhruṃhaṃvajradeheti [kṣaṃhuṃ haṃ vajradeha kṣiṃ kurukuru garjagarja huṃhuṃchāṃ pañcānanāya namaḥ || ] kṣiṃ coktvātha kurudvayamnamaḥ ṣaḍviṃśadarṇoyaṃ kuryyādaṣṭadalantataḥṣaḍaṅgāni praṇītāṃ ca tadgāyatrīkramādyajethūṃkārīṃ vā śacīṃ kṣemakarīṃ pūrvādipatrakephaṭkārīṃ pūjayeddvāramadhye devyāstu kiṅkarīmjayāṃ ca vijayāṃ dvārapārśvayorvetradhāriṇīmkiṅkarāya rakṣarakṣa tvaritājñāsthiro bhavagāyatryṛcā ca sampūjya devasānnidhyakāriṇīmtanno devī pracodayāmmohanaḥ sarvalokānāntena mohananāmakaḥsarvasiddhipradātṛtvātsarvasiddhīśvaro mataḥdhūpadīpādibhirnṛtyagītaiḥ sampūjayeñchivāmśataṃ vā kṛtahomastu prāgvatpūjāṃ samāpayetmadhvaktabilvasamidho juhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥātmānamabhiṣicyātha brāhmaṇānapi bhojayetnamaskriyāmprakurvanti nātra kāryyā vicāraṇāsiddhavidyādhāraṇāṃ ca yoṣitopsarasastathāpraskhalatpadavinyāsāḥ saṃsphuraddaśanāṃśukāḥtadaiva vāñchitantasmai dadāti tvaritākhilamsantāḍya śīrṣe sahasā mṛtamutthāpayedasaukṛtvā yoniṃ kuṇḍamadhye samādhāyāgnimatra vaitilasarṣapagodhūmaśālidhānyayavairhunetbakulaiścampakai raktaiḥ kahlārairaruṇotpalaiḥaśokaiḥ pāṭalairbilvaistattadāpnoti niścitamsitājyalakṣakaṃ hutvā rogānmukto naro'cirāt [bhavediti śeṣaḥ || ]
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: acalāṃ labhate lakṣmīṃ bhoktā ca bhavati dhruvamekaikairvanitā vaśyā yāvajjīvaṃ dhanādibhiḥkṣīrāktaistairhunenmartyo vaśe tiṣṭhantyaśeṣataḥtaduktavairiṇo nityammāṣairapi ca tatkṛtekāraskaraghṛtopetaṃ phaṇiśīrṣasrucā hunetniśāyāṃ juhuyātsadyo nihantuṃ vairiṇaṃ haṭhātsaptarātrādarātestu gajāśvā rogamāpnuyuḥsaptāhādrogamāpnoti duḥkhārtto naiva saṃśayaḥtajjaptamaṣṭadhā tāvadyajjalaṃ culukodakāttatkarṇarandhrajāpācca naśyeyuśca viṣagrahāḥathātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi śivadūtīmanumparamṛṣī rudrosya gāyatrī chandaḥ syāddevatā śivāṣaḍdīrghayuktamanunā ṣaḍaṃgavidhirīritaḥpṛṣṭhe manasi vinyasya vyāpakaṃ vidyayā caretnavaratnakirīṭāṃ ca trīkṣaṇāmaruṇāmbarāmśucismitāmaṣṭabhujāṃ stūyamānāmmaharṣibhiḥdakṣiṇairaṃkuśaṃ khaḍgakuṭhāraṃ kamalantathādhyātvaivampūjayeddevīṃ dūtīṃ duritanāśinīmicchājñānakriyāśaktīstriṣu koṇeṣu pūjayetsiddhā vāṇī pūrṇasiddhāgre vigrahavatī tathāḍākinyādyāstadagre tu yajedaṣṭadalāmbujesumukhīṃ sundarīṃ sārāṃ sumanāṃ ca sarasvatīmvāgīśāṃ varadāṃ viśvāṃ vinadāṃ vighnakāriṇīmdvārasya dakṣiṇambhāgaṃ samārabhya pradakṣiṇampramodāṃ kautukāṃ puṇyāṃ lokeśāstrāṇi tadbahiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tarppayedgandhasalilairātmānamabhiṣecayetnārikelaphalopetairguḍairlakṣmīmavāpnuyāttrimadhvaktaiścampakaiśca prasūnairbakulodbhavaiḥpunnāgajairhutairvastrāṇyājyairiṣṭamavāpnuyātavāpnoti hutairājyairamlai ratnādi sādhakaḥhṛddeśenyasya sādhyākhyāmpacettailājyayorniśidāsavacca samāyāti priyaṃ prāṇādi cārpayettrisaptarātrānmahatīmavāpnoti śriyaṃ naraḥpadmākṣairjuhuyāllakṣmīmavāpnoti tribhirdinaiḥśrīkarā śivarūpāhvā proktā sarvasamṛddhidāhuṃkheṃkṣaḥ phaṭ ceti mantra ṛṣyādi tvaritāsamampādādinābhiparyyantamaruṇāṃ nābhito galamhasteṣu śaṅkhacakre ca dīpau candrārdhaśekharāmvarṇalakṣaṃ japedante daśāṃśena ghṛtairhunetśūlamudrāṃ grahagrastāndṛṣṭvemamprajapenmanumnātaḥ paratarā vidyā grahanirvāpaṇakṣamākheṃstrīṃkṣeṃ tryarṇamantroyaṃ nikhilaṃ tvāratāsamamkauṃ kaumāryyai nama iti ṣaḍarṇo mantra īritaḥdevatā kaumidaṃ bījaṃ kaumāryye śaktirucyateśaktyakṣasragvarābhītikarāṃ bandhūkasannibhāmharitkañcukikāṃ ramyāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitāmahalyāndraupadīṃ sītāntārā mandodarīmapimukhyā pūjā bhavedasyāḥ kumāryyā eva nānyataḥlakṣaṣaṭkañjapaḥ proktaḥ pañcakhādyaistathā hunettarpaṇammārjanaṃ kṛtvā kumārīrapi bhojayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gandhādyairmūlamantreṇa mantravitsāvaraṇāṃ tatra pūjayecca yathāvidhipariṣicyāgniṃ prārthayīta tato guruḥsamprāpte sānnidhyaṃ kuru sādarambrahmāṇamudvāsya brāhmaṇāya prapādayettaṇḍulaistatsamāpūrya sahiraṇyaṃ sadakṣiṇamparistarānagnau paridhīnnikṣipenna tunetramantreṇa śiṣyanetraṃ nibadhyateprapūryāsya hyañjalīnkṣepayeddharenetrabandhamapāsyopaveśayetkuśasaṃstarebrūyācchiṣyaḥ ślokañca tatra vaiyena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥnyāsāndehe parinyasettantroktavartmanā tatra sakalākṛtimācaretkumbhāsyasthasuradruṃśca mūrddhanyasya śiśorguruḥniyatātmānaṃ siñcetkalaśapuṣpakaiḥtoyairakṣarasaṃyuktairghaṭaistenaiva vartmanāgṛhītvābhyarcitaṃ pūrvaṃ karakaṃ mantrarūpiṇamśiṣṭena śiśuṃ gururācāmayettataḥparidhāyājñayā guroḥvadedvidvānviprasyoṅkārapūrvakamvidyāṅgacchantīṃ bhāvayed guruḥkṣiṣyaḥ prajaped guruṇoditamgurudevātmamantrāṇāmaikyaṃ śiṣyo vibhāvayetsāṣṭāṅgaścātha pañcāṅgaḥ pūjākarmasu sammataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhāryayā sādhakendrasya pātivratyādiyuktayāalaṃkṛtāḥ pavitrāstā ekapaṃktyopaveśayettāḥ sampūjya mahatpātraṃ pavitraṃ ca tathā caretdugdhaṃ ca nikṣipettatra naivedyantatra nikṣipettanmanthanānmaheśāni devāveśaḥ prajāyatesarvaṃ manogataṃ vakti devatā suprasīdatinakhairbhavedvivāhastu pañcāśadbhiḥ sutāstathāaṣṭottaraśatenāpi sādhakena tu melayetakacaṭatapayaśairvaiṣṇavyā mantra īritaḥchandastu vaiṣṇavī devī nyāsaḥ praṇavapūrvakaḥvinyasedakṣarāṇyaṣṭāvoṅkāraṃ ca tathā smaretlasatkāñcanasambhūtakuṇḍalojjvalaśālinīmkṛṣṇaśuklāruṇairnetraistribhiścāpi vibhūṣitāmkambugrīvāṃ viśālākṣīṃ sūryyakoṭisamaprabhāmdakṣiṇābhyāṃ karābhyā tu khaḍgaṃ ca japamālikāmgātreṇa ratnastambhaṃ ca samyagālambya saṃsthitāmpañcānanaṃ puraḥ saṃsthaṃ nirīkṣantīṃ svavāhanamsvabīje sumano dadyātsāhamevaṃ vicintayetāvāhanaṃ tataḥ kuryyādgāyatryā śirasā sahatanno devī pracodayātnaivedyaṃ ca tato dadyānmodakaṃ pāyasaṃ tathāevaṃ sampūjya madhye tu mantreṇāṃgāni pūjayetkālarātriṃ ca dikpatreṣvarcayeccandanādibhiḥmahāgaurīṃ cāgnikoṇanair-ṛtyādiṣu pūjayetmahāmāyāṃ namāmīti mūlamantreṇa cāṣṭadhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭabhiśca mahāmāyāṃ namāmīti ca mantrataḥlakṣadvayaṃ bhavedasya puraścaraṇakarmma tuaśucirna mahāmāyāṃ pūjayettu kadācanadantarakte samutpanne smaraṇaṃ na cavidyatedhūmodvāre maithune ca sūtake mṛtake ca vaikāmājjāteṅganāsparśe mṛte pitari vatsaramākarṣe mātṛmaraṇe ṣaṇmāsaṃ ca gurau mṛtena smarecca mahāmāyāṃ śucitāpatyasiddhidāmprāgvanmunyādikaṃ proktaṃ pūjājapamukhaṃ tathāmantrārṇairatra cāṅgāni śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaretamite padamuccāryya tadagre cāparājitesiddhasmṛte mahāvidye anekāṃse ume dhruvemānastoke sarasvati ramaṇī rāmaṇīti caditīti vinate ceti gauri gandhāri saṃvadetbrahmavādini kālīti kapālini karāli caantarikṣagataṃ ceti jalagataṃ vadetpunaḥsarvopadraveṣu svāhā tārādyanto manurmataḥaghoravaiṣṇavī devī cāyutaṃ japa īritaḥyasyāḥ praṇaśyetpuṣpaṃ hi garbhaścāpi patedyadibhūrjjapatre tvimā vidyāṃ likhitvā dhārayedyadipumāṃśca dhārayedyaśca sobhīṣṭaṃ phalamāpnuyātagnicaurabhaye ghore nityaṃ tasya jayo bhavetśirorogajvarāṇāṃ ca nāśanaṃ sarvadehināmvaiṣṇavīṃ candravedāgnivarṇāṃ sādhakasiddhidāmmāsikadvimāsiketi vātikapaittikeṣu ca

sanskrit: viṣajvaragraharkṣādisarvadoṣāntakāriṇividyāśāle tālamāle rudrarūpe paca dvayamrajanī sandhye dundubhināde mānasa ityapiviśveśvarī drāviḍīti vaded draviḍikeśi cavimarddini padaṃ paścādvadetsādhakasattamaḥmātaṅgī praṇavaṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ kṣauṃ kuruyugaṃ tathāsarvānhanayugaṃ coktvā damayugmaṃ pacadvayamdviḥśoṣayotsādaya dvirbrahmāṣaḍiti ca saṃvadetāgneyīti ca cāmuṇḍe vāruṇī vāyavī tathājaye ca vijaye śānti svastipuṣṭi dhṛtīti casarvakāma phaletyuktvā prade sarvapadaṃ vadetprāgvaddhomaphalaṃ cāsya sādhakaḥ sāttviko bhavetdarśanādeva naśyanti bhūtādyā bhairavā apitāramākarṣiṇipadaṃ āveśini padaṃ vadetdhāriṇī tapanītyuktvā tāpini madonmādinitathā nīlapatāketi mahānīle mahāpriyevajriṇīti tathādityādye ca jāhnavi saṃvadetsurabhi surotpanne ca sarasvati padaṃ tataḥkāryyaṃ tanmama siddhyatviti svāhāntoyaṃ manurmataḥjapedvarṇaśataṃ homādikaṃ pūrvavadācarettārādyā vahnijāyāntā pṛthak ca ṣaḍyugaṃ vadetyata evāgataṃ pāpaṃ tatraiva pratigacchatusvāhāntaḥ ṣaḍbāṇavarṇo lakṣamekaṃ japaḥ smṛtaḥhomapūjādikaṃ prāgvadyena siddhyati devatāvasudevasahasrāṇi cāvadānāni tatra tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prākkarmmapratibaddhāpi vaiṣṇavītrāsatastu sāupāsitā tadā japtā lalitā lalitā [abhūditi śeṣaḥ || ] ca sābalātkāreṇa kāmasya vaśīkṛtya yayā punaḥmantreṇānena juhuyāttattatkarmma prasiddhyatimāraṇoccāṭane cāpi na prayojyā kadācanaaiṃlauṃṭhaṃṭhaṃṭhamiti huṃsvāhāntoṣṭākṣaro manuḥvārāhyatra ṣaḍaṅgāni kramādvidvīndubhū?kabhiḥdadhānāmaṃkuśaṃ pāśaṃ mudgaraṃ śaktimeva caaṅgaṣaṭkadiśādhīśāyudhānītyāvṛtitrayamdhātrīphalairbhṛṅgarājaiḥ kaśaiścāpi daśāśataḥevaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogānkarttumarhatimudgareṇa ghnatīṃ mūrdhni tāṃ smarannayutaṃ japetvāpīkapataḍāgādau tatpānīyasya pānataḥsthānaṃ tyaktvā ca gacchanti nātra kāryyā vicāraṇāoṃ aiṃ glauṃ aiṃ namaścoktvā tato bhagavatīti caglauṃ aiṃ andhe andhinīti namo rundhe ca rundhininamaḥ stambhe stambhinīti nama aiṃglauṃ ca vāgbhavamcittacakṣurmukhagalajihvāstambhaṃ kurudvayamhuṃphaṭsvāheti mantroyaṃ vedarudrākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥvārāhyasya ṣaḍaṅgāni vārttālī hṛdayaṃ smṛtamandhe andhini varmmoktaṃ rundhe rundhini netrakamraktābjakarṇikāyāntu śavāsanasamāsthitāmabhayaṃ musalañcāpi phalañcāpi varantathājapenmantraṃ sahasrāṇi bandhūkakusumaistilaiḥpīṭhe svarṇamaye raupye tāmre bhūrjjetha vāruṇe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yonipañcāsraṣaṭkoṇāṣṭapatraśatapatrakamkailāsācalamadhyasthaṃ pīṭhametadvicintayettrikoṇamadhye deveśīṃ ṣaḍaṅgānyapi tatra tujṛmbhiṇī mohinī caiva stambhinī pañcakoṇakeḍākinyādyāḥ pārśvayośca stambhinīṃ krodhinīmapiśūlaṃ muṇḍañca ḍamaruṃ kapālaṃ dadhataṃ karaiḥaṣṭapatre tu vārtālīmukhaṃ devyaṣṭakaṃ yajetśatakoṇāgrataḥ siṃhaḥ pūjyo mahiṣasaṃyutaḥkroṃ vārāhyai nama iti pūjāmantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥyoginīṃ gaṇanāthañca tattanmantraiḥ prapūjayetkṣeṃ kṣetrapālāya namoṣṭārṇaḥ kṣetrapapūjanegaṃ gaṇapataye namoṣṭavarṇoyaṃ gaṇeśituḥpūjānte baṭukādibhyo balimantraibaliṃ haretkapilajaṭābhāreti bhāsureti vadettataḥnāśayadvitayaṃ sarvopacārasahitaṃ balimbaṭukasya baliṃ dadyādanena śraddhayānvitaḥsvāhāntaḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuktaḥ kṣādyastridvimitārṇakaḥgāṃgīṃgūṃgamiti [gāṃ gīṃ gūṃ gaṃ gaṇapataye varavarada sarvajanaṃ me vaśamānaya sarvopacārasahitaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇagṛhṇa svāhā || ] procya ṅentaṃ gaṇapatiṃ tathāsarvopacārasahitaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇayugaṃ punaḥevaṃ tebhyo baliṃ dattvā svasvamudrāḥ pradarśayetkiñcidvakrīkṛtā madhyā gaṇanāthabalau smṛtāyoginīnāṃ balermantraṃ sādhanānte paṭhedimamyoṃ yoginībhyaḥ svāheti saptārṇaḥ sragdharā tviyamkṣetre pīṭhopapīṭhādiṣu ca kṛtapadā dhūpadīpādikena prītā devyassadā naḥ śubhayutavidhinā yāntu vīrendravandyāḥsiddhamantraḥ prakarvīta prayogāñchivabhāṣitān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūreṇa vividhairmāṃsairjuhuyādiṣṭasiddhayesphāṭikaiḥ padmabījaiśca rudrākṣaiḥ śubhakarmmaṇivārāhīṃ tarppayetsarvakāmaṃ sampūrayennaraḥlājacūrṇatilaiḥ kuryyādvarameṣāsṛganvitaiḥsampannamadanaṃ sāṅgametasyai vinivedayetekaviṃśatirātrīṣu lājai raktasamanvitaiḥevaṃ vārttālikāyāstu sādhanaṃ vāmamārgataḥoṃ [oṃ hrīṃ namo vārāhighore svapnaṃ ṭhaḥṭhaḥ svāhā || ] hrīṃ namaśca vārāhi ghore svapnaṃ visargayukīśvarosya muniḥ prokto jagatī chanda īritamhṛllekhāśaktiruddiṣṭāṭhadvayaṃ kīlakaṃ matampādayorvyañjane kaṭyoḥ kaṇṭhe gaṇḍadvaye tathātato dhyāyedghanaśyāmāṃ trinetrāmunnatastanīmaśvārūḍhāṃ ca kolāsyāṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitāmṣoḍaśāre yajecchaktīrvakṣyamāṇāśca ṣoḍaśamāraṇī māriṇīśī ca bhīṣaṇī bhīṣaṇīśvarīāśāvivartinī paścādāśāvivarttinīśvarīetāḥpūjyāścaturthyantāḥ praṇavādyā namontakāḥlokapālāndaśadale dvitaye hetisaṃyutānevaṃ siddhamanurmantrī kāmyakarmmāṇi sādhayetānayettaruṇīṃ varṣātsarvakāmasamṛddhayecatuṣpathānnadīkūladvayātkulālaveśmanaḥracayetputtalīṃ ramyāṃ sādhyāsusthāpanānvitāmpītāṅgārayujā yoniṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ bhūpurānvitamsahasraṃ cāṣṭakaṃ bhūyaḥ pūjayettāṃ samāhitaḥsiṃhā gajā mṛgāḥ krūrā bhaveyurvaśagā dhruvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yathā bhāvi tathā devī svapne vadati mantriṇeiṃ indrāṇyai nama iti mantraḥ proktaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥiṃbījaṃ śaktirindrāṇī namaḥ kīlakamucyatecaturdantagajānalpacchāyāsaṃsthāṃ hiraṇyabhāmbagalāṃ chinnamastāṃ ca tārāṃ dakṣiṇakālikāmtattanmantraistu tadbāhye lokeśānāyudhānyapitrimadhvaktaistāvadeva rājyārthaṃ rājavṛkṣajaiḥtāraṃ māyāṃ samuccāryya vadecca bagalāmukhistambhayetipadaṃ [oṃhrīṃ bagalāmukhi sarvaduṣṭānāṃ vācaṃ mukhaṃ stambhaya jihvā kīlaya buddhiṃ vināśaya hrīṃ oṃ svāhā || ] jihvāṃ kīlayeti tataḥ paramviniyogosya vikhyātaḥ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayeśikhātu sarvaduṣṭānāṃ tato vācammukhampadambuddhiṃ vināśayāstraṃ syātṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥgaṇḍadvaye tathā coṣṭhe'dharāsyacibukeṣu caaṃgulīnāntathā mūle hastāgre caivameva hidakṣajānuni gulphe cāṃgulimūle padāgrataḥcaturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ kamalāsanasaṃsthitāmpītāmbaradharāṃ sāndravṛttapīnapayodharāmpītabhūṣaṇabhūṣāñca svarṇasiṃhāsanasthitāmbhūpradeśe manoramye puṣpāmodasudhūpitesauvarṇe vātha raupye vā paittale vāpi bhūrjjakelikhedyantraṃ prayatnena lekhanyā hematārayoḥcaturasratrayaṃ bāhye caturdvāropaśobhitamtatra māyoditaṃ pīṭhaṃ jñeyāstā eva śaktayaḥtatrāvāhya yejeddevīṃ supītairupacārakaiḥgaṇeśaṃ baṭukaṃ cāpi yoginīḥ kṣetrapālakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bagalāṃ pūrvapatre tu stambhinīṃ ca tataḥ parambhrāmikāṃ mandagamanāṃ bhogyākhyāṃ caiva yogikāmṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyuktāḥ sampradāyātkulāgamepūrvādbrāhmyādikā aṣṭau vāhanāyudhasaṃyutāḥyonimadhye mūladevīṃ trirañjalibhirarccayetnīrājya vidhivatpaścādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ nivedayetdeyaṃ cāpi sitānnena pratyahaṃ balipañcakampītāsanaḥ smaretpītaṃ cāyutaṃ japamācaretsarvapītopacāreṇa mantraḥ siddhyati mantriṇaḥgatistambhakarī vidyā aristambhanakāriṇīekānte parame ramye śucau deśetha vā gṛhetathākarṣaṇakāmastu loṇaṃ trimadhurānvitamstambhane homayeddevīṃ prajñāyāśca gatermateḥgṛdhrāṇāmapi kākānāṃ gṛhadhūmayutena vaipūrvā kulālamṛttāvatyeraṇḍaścaturaṃgulaḥlakṣamekaṃ japeddevi brahmacārī dṛḍhavrataḥsaṅgame ca mahānadyorniśāyāmapi sādhayetalaktasya ca rāgeṇa rañjitāñca haridrayāśatayojanamātrantu sa gaccheccintite pathipiṣṭvābhimantrya lakṣaikaṃ sarvāṅge lepane kṛtesurabherekavarṇāyā dhārotthaṃ kṣīramāharetpāyayitvā tu harate viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamamdaśāṃśena kṛte home ebhirdravyaiḥ pṛthakpṛthakindrāṇyāḥ paramāṃ śaktiṃ chinnamastāṃ maheśvarīmvajravairocanīye hrīṃ hrīṃ phaṭ svāhā dhanākṣaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: chinnamastā bhaveddevī vāmamārgeṇa siddhidāūṃ vajrāya śikhā proktā aiṃ pāśāya tanucchadamsvāhāntā sarva evaite tato dhyānaṃ samācaretratikāmasamārūḍhāṃ vikīrṇasakalālakāmḍākinīvarṇinībhyāñca sakhībhyāṃ paridhāritāmpīṭhe jayākhyā vijayā ajitā cāparājitādikṣu madhye ca sampūjyā navapīṭhasya śaktayaḥsiddhiprade ḍākinīye praṇavaṃ vajraṃ vai vadetpīṭhamantro vedavahnivarṇaḥ pīṭhārcane mataḥbāhyāvaraṇamārabhya pūjayetpratilomataḥtadantaḥ surarājādīn dvāreṣu dvārapānyajetekaliṅgāṃ yoginīñca ḍākinīmbhairavīṃ tathāmahābhairavikendrākṣyāvasitāṅgīñca hāriṇīm [saṃ punarhāriṇīmekatrakaraṇena saṃhāriṇīmiti siddhamḍākinī [oṃ aiṃ ḍākinyai namaḥ || oṃ aiṃ varṇinyai namaḥ iti mantraḥ || ] varṇinī tāravāgbhyāṃ tatpārśvayoryajetpālāśābalvajarvāpi juhuyātkusumaiḥ phalaiḥśrīpuṣpairlabhate lakṣmīṃ tatphalaiśca samīhitammāsamekantu vaśagāstasya syuḥ sarvapārthivāḥrogajālaṃ parābhūya sukhī jīvecchataṃ samāḥphalairhutvāpnuyāllakṣmīmudumbarapalāśajaiḥbandhūkakusumairbhāgyaṃ karṇikāraiḥ samīhitamnārīrajobhirākṛṣṭaṃ mṛgamāṃsaiḥ samīhitam [vāñchitam || ]unmattakāṣṭhadīptegnau tatphalaṃ vāyasacchadaiḥvijayaṃ labhate mantrī dhyāyeddevīṃ japanmanumraktāṃ vaśye matau dhūmrāṃ stambhane kanakaprabhāmgopanīyaḥ prayogotha procyate sarvasiddhidaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: snātvā raktāmbaradharo raktamālyānulepanaḥsundarīṃ yauvanākrāntāṃ narapañcakagāminīmvivastrāṃ pūjayitvaināṃ cāyutaṃ prajapenmanumbhojayedvividhairannairbrāhmaṇāndevatādhiyānārīmāyuściraṃ dharmmamiṣṭamanyadavāpnuyātmanoratheṣu cānyeṣu gacchettāṃ prajapenmanumśāstrajñānaṃ pāpanāśaḥ sarvasaukhyaṃ labheddhruvamaṅgamāsāntare mantrī kavitvena jayetkavimmāyā tārapaṭāṃ mantre japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatameṣa nūnaṃ vidhirgopyaḥ siddhikāmena mantriṇāatha vakṣye ṣoḍaśārṇaṃ caturbhedaṃ manūttamamdahanasya tithirvarṇo lakṣmībījādiko [śrīṃ bījamādau saṃyojya pūrvoktamantro dhanāptikara iti bhāvaḥ || ] dhanevāgbījādyena mokṣaḥ syāccatvāraḥ praṇavādikāḥupāsyāścaturāmnāyairmunirbrahmā samīritaḥdharmmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ gurureva samāśrayaḥdadātyaṣṭau mahāsiddhīḥ kimpunaḥ kṣullakāḥ priyāḥkāmyakarmmaṇi sarvatra dhyānaṃ syātpuṣpavarṇakamsadākālaṃ japenmantramāpattasya na vidyatestambhayetpaśuśastrāṇi yāvanmuṣṭiṃ na muñcativimucyate haṭhādrogānmuktarogaḥ sukhī bhavetdhyānapūjādikaṃ prāgvatkiñcitkāmyamudīryyatemahoragasatairdaṣṭaṃ mṛtamutthāpayennaraḥpītena stambhayennityaṃ naukāvājigajādikammārayedapyayatnena kṛṣṇadhyānānna saṃśayaḥghṛtena madhunā vāpi surayā tatra sādhakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dṛṣṭyā tathā caiva cittenāṣṭāṅga īritaḥācāryājñāṃ sadā kuryāttattaḥ śiṣyo vicārya caīśvarārpaṇabuddhyā ca dvijāśīrbhiśca nanditaḥvā pradadyācca vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥdadyādvittanusārataḥnityaṃ taccintanaparāyaṇaḥnānāvidhairbhakṣyairlehyaiścoṣyaistathāparaiḥkriyāmayī dīkṣā sampaddātrī nirūpitā|| ayandīkṣākramaḥ prokto bhogayuk siddhimicchatāmyatprakṛtyātmatattvañca varṇānāṃ samudīritamśiśornyasyedarṇāndeśikasattamaḥsvasāmarthyāddāpayeddevatātmatāmkalādīkṣāmaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhidāmkupañcāśatkalā vāme siddhamantragurostu sānivṛttipramukhā bhūtānāṃ pañca ceritāḥpādādijānuparyantaṃ nivṛttissaṃsthitā kalānābhitaḥ kaṇṭhaparyantaṃ vidyākhyā saṃsthitā kalābhālācchirovadhi proktā śāntyatītā kalā tathāsvīyājñayācaiva dīkṣā pañcakalā smṛtākādikā varṇā yatra dvādaśa saṃsthitāḥsūryasya ṣoḍaśāśu vidhostathāvarṇakalānāntu varṇasthānācca saṃhṛtiḥvāmamārge cāvedadikṣā phalapradāvedamayīṃ vakṣye yāṃ labdhvā sukhadāñjanaḥśiṣyasya dhyāyetkañjaṃ caturdalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tarppaṇasya vidhānena haṭhātsiddhaḥ prajāyateśrīphalānāṃ ca homena tathaivodumbarasya caśatamaṣṭottaraṃ kṛtvā [japamiti śeṣaḥ |] juhuyāttarppaṇottaramnityamaṣṭottaraśataṃ māsaṣaṭkaṃ samācaretājyayuktaḥ sāmiṣaśca homānte pratyahaṃ baliḥmadhvaktatilapuṣpaistu bhavetsampattiruttamāsājyairbandhūkakusumairayutaiḥ subhago bhavetraktacandanaraktāśvamārapuṣpairnṛpo vaśaḥsamyaggurumukhātprāptān vāmācāreṇa sādhitānjyeṣṭhaputrāya dātavyo nānyebhyaśca kadācanasvaputrādau pradātavyā dakṣiṇā na kadācanavāmamārgopāsanantu tau dvau lokadvayāccyutaumunirakṣobhyasaṃjñosya bṛhatī chanda īritamṣaḍdīrghayuglajjayātra [hrāṃhrīṃhrūṃhraiṃhrauṃhraḥ eṣvekaikena ṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ kuryyāt || ] ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥtatrādau prathamo nyāsaḥ [śrīkaṇṭhādinyāsastu pūrvamuktaḥ tenātra nāvāci || ] śrīkaṇṭhādiḥ puroditaḥśrīkaṇṭhādisapatnīkaṃ namontaṃ mātṛkāsthaleasminnyāse kriyamāṇe devīmevaṃvidhā smaretardhenduśekharāṃ nānābhūṣaṇāḍhyāṃ caturbhujāmtribījasvarapūrvaṃ tu raktaṃ sūryyaṃ hṛdi nyasetevammantravidhānajñaḥ kavargādyañca maṅgalambudhaṃ śyāmaṃ nyasetpītaṃ ṭavargādyaṃ gale gurumnīlavarṇaṃ pavargādyaṃ nābhideśe śanaiścaramlakṣādyaṃ dhūmravarṇābhaṃ ketuṃ nābhau punarnyasetsamānavarṇānuccāryya [hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ aṃ iṃ uṃ ṛṃ ḷṃ aiṃ oṃ aṃ mūrdhniṃ pūrve indrāya namaḥ, hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ āṃ īṃ ūṃ ṝṃ ḹṃ aiṃ auṃ aḥ mūrdhnyāgneyyāmagnaye namaḥ, hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ dakṣiṇe yamāya namo mukhe, ityādi || ] prāgindrāya namostu kedakṣiṇe yamāya namaḥ kavargādyaṃ lalāṭake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṭavargādyaṃ gale paścādvaruṇāya namastvitipavargādyaṃ kuberāya namo vai dakṣiṇe karehuṃ lakṣādyaṃ pṛthivyai hṛtpādayoriti vinyasethrīṃtrīṃhuṃpūrvakaḥ kārya indriyāghaharaḥ paraḥmūlādhāre [hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ ḍākinīyuktāya brahmaṇe namaḥ mūlādhāre, hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ śākinīyuktaviṣṇave namaḥ svādhiṣṭhāne, ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ paṃ phaṃ lākinīyukta rudrāya namaḥ maṇipūrake || ] nyaseccaiva caturdalasamanvitesvādhiṣṭhānābhidhe cakre liṅgasthe ṣaḍdale nyasetnyaseccakre daśadale nābhisthe maṇipūrakevinyaseddvādaśadale hṛdayasthe tvanāhatekaṇṭhasthe ṣoḍaśadale viśuddhākhye pravinyasethakṣārṇapūrvaṃ bhrūmadhyasaṃsthitetimanohareaṃ āṃkavargaṃ [hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ aṃ āṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ tārāyai namaḥ brahmarandhre, hrīṃḥ trīṃ huṃ iṃ īṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ ugrāyai namaḥ lalāṭe, hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ uṃ ūṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ mahogrāyai namo bhruvoḥ, agrepyevaṃ jñeyam || ] hrīṃtrīṃhuṃ tārāyai nama ucyatehrīṃtrīṃhuṃ nama ugrāyai lalāṭe cāpi vinyasethrīṃtrīṃhuṃ ca vajrāyai namontaṃ sakaleṣvapiomauṃ savaraṃ hrīṃtrīṃhuṃ kāmeśvaryyai ca liṅgakemūlādhāre nyasetpaścātpīṭhanyāsaṃ samācarethṛdi jālandharaṃ pīṭha [hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ āṃ īṃ ūṃ ṛṃ ḷṃ aiṃ auṃ aḥ jālandharapīṭhāya namaḥ hṛdi || ] dīrghapūrvaṃ pravinyasetuḍḍiyānaṃ [hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ uḍḍiyānapīṭhāya namaḥ keśasandhau || ] cavargāhyaṃ keśasandhau pravinyasettavargapūrvikāṃ [hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ avantīpīṭhāya namaḥ nayanadvaye ityādi || ] nyasyedavantīṃ nayanadvayekaṇṭhe tu mathurāpīṭhaṃ yavargādyaṃ pravinyasetkaṭau kāñcīpurīpīṭhaṃ daśamantu pravinyasetmahāpralayapānīye lasacchvetāmbujasthitāmsarppakāñcīṃ sarppakarāṃ sarppakaṃkaṇakuṇḍalāmpiṅgograikajaṭāṃ tryakṣāṃ vyāghratvakparidhāyinīmnarāsthipaṭṭaṃ badhnantīṃ bhāle'kṣobhyamunīśvarāmnānāprakārapūjāsyāstantretantre prakāśitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃskārā vaidikā yasya tasmai vidyā na sidhyatiubhayoḥ kulanāśaḥ syāddaridro janmajanmanisādhitā vāmamārgeṇa devānāṃ vijayāya casvavikramaṃ khyāpayitvā śakro devapatiḥ kṛtaḥkṛtvā tu tāntrikasnānampūjārthaṃ jalamāharetupānatpāduke tyaktvā pūjako jalamāharettāraṃ [oṃ hrīṃ suviśuddhadharmmasarvapāpāniśāmyāśeṣavikalpānayanāya svāhā || ] māyāṃ suviśuddhadharmmasarvapadaṃ vadetyaḥ svāheti ca ṣaḍviṃśadarṇa ācamane manuḥdharivajriṇi śikhariṇi ca sarvavaśaṅkarebhūmiśuddhiṃ navārṇena tataḥ kuryyāttu sādhakaḥtrayodaśārṇamantreṇa vighnānutsārayettataḥoṃsarvavighnānutsāraya [oṃ sarvavighnānutsāraya huṃphaṭ svāhā || ] huṃphaṭ jvalanapriyātadutthenāgninā dehandahetsārddhaṃ svapāpmanāpavanena tadutthena pāpabhasma kṣipedbhuvianayā bhūtaśuddhyā tu devīsādṛśyamāpnuyātpavitravajra [oṃ pavitravajrabhūme huṃphaṭsvāhā || ] bhūme huṃsvāhā mantro bhavākṣaraḥāsure [oṃ āsurekhe vajrarekhe huṃ svāhā || ] khe vajrarekhe huṃsvāhāpraṇavādikaḥtārādihuṁphaṭsvāhānto nṛpavarṇo manurmataḥoṃ [oṃ oṃ hrīṃ svāhā || ] āṃ hrīṃ vahnigṛhiṇī pañcārṇaścittaśodhanebhūmiṃ pūrvoktamantreṇa maṇḍalasya tu maṇḍalamkuryyāttatrādhāraśaktiṃ kūrmmaṃ śeṣaṃ ca saṃyajetādhāraṃ pūjayettatra vaṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya [oṃ vaṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya namaḥ || ] cahuṃphaṭmantreṇa saṃkṣālya sthīṃbījena niveśayetekādaśākṣaro mantrastenapūjādikammatamdvādaśārṇenātrabhavetkapālārcā dvitīyikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekādaśārṇonenoktā kapālārccā tṛtīyikātato dhārāya sarvāya tathā sarvodbhavāya carāruṇāya ca śubhrāyetisurābhājanāya caṣaṭpañcāśatkavarṇoyaṃ kapālasya tu pūjaneoṃsūryyamaṇḍalāyeti namontoyaṃ navākṣaraḥmūlamantraṃ [oṃ hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ phaṭ || ] paṭhaṃstasminsudhābuddhyā surāṃ kṣipetmudrāṃ sā tu karau vyastāvaṃguṣṭhau kārayetsamaukaniṣṭhike nijasthāne trikhaṇḍāhvānakarmmaṇiekādaśārṇena tataḥ śaṃkhatoyantu mantrayethsau rhumiti vāgādyo mantra ekādaśākṣaraḥśaṃkhamudrāṃ [vāmāṃguṣṭhaṃ tu saṃgṛhya dakṣahastasya muṣṭinā | kṛtottānāṃ tathāmuṣṭimaṃguṣṭhaṃ tu prasārayet || vāmāguṃlyastathā śiṣṭāḥ saṃyutāḥ saprasāditāḥ || dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhake lagnā mudrā śaṃkhasya bhūtidā || ] yonimudrāṃ [mithaḥ kaniṣṭhike badhvā | tarjanībhyāmanāmike || anāmikordhvaṃ saṃśliṣṭadīrghāmadhyamayoradha || aṃguṣṭhāgradyaṃ prasya yonimudreyamīritā |] śaṃkhatoyāya darśayetpūrvoktāṃ pūjayitvaināṃ mūlenātha pratarppayetsāṃguṣṭhābhiścaturvāraṃ mahāśaṃkhasthite jaleoṃhrauṃhsauṃ ca namontoyaṃ mantro bhairavapūjaneyonimudrāṃ pradarśyātha praṇamedbhavatāriṇīmdharāgṛhāvṛte pīṭhamādāvarcyaṃ saśaktikamcaturdaśākṣaro mantraḥ proktaḥ pīṭhasya pūjanevidyeśvarīti samproktā pīṭhasya nava śaktayaḥkṣetrapālaṃ yoginīṃ ca dhyātvā samyakprapūjayetalaṃkāracayopetaṃ gaṇeśaṃ prākprapūjayetśvayūthaveṣṭitaṃ ramyaṃ baṭukaṃ dakṣiṇe'rcayetkṛṣṇaṃ digambaraṃ krūraṃ kṣetrapaṃ paścime yajetraktamālyāṃ raktavastrāṃ yoginīmuttare yajetmuniṃ dvādaśavarṇena manunā sa nigadyateatha sampūjayetkoṇaṣaṭkadevyā ṣaḍaṅgakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: padmanābhaṃ śaṃkhapāṇḍuraṃ pūrvādau samarcayetpāṇḍurāṃ tārakāṃ cāpi bhūgṛhadvāratorcayetvighnāntakaṃ narāntaṃ ca vakṣyante manavorcanesambuddhyataṃ ca tannāma vajrapuṣpampratīccha caśakrādīṃścāpi vajrādīn pūjayettadanantarammadyāmbumīnapiśitamudrāpiṣṭambhavedyathāśrīmadekajaṭe [oṃ hrīṃ śrīmadekajaṭe nīlasarasvati mahogratāre devi khakhasarvabhūtapiśācarākṣasān grasagrasa mama jāḍyaṃ chedayachedaya śrīṃhrīṃphaṭsvāhā || ] nīlasarasvati mahogra catāre devi khakhetyuktvā sarvabhūtapiśācarākṣasān grasagrasa mama jāḍyaṃ chedayachedayabhaveddvipañcāśadarṇaḥ pūjaiveṣṭārṇatāmiyātmadyaṃ māṃsaṃ ca tāmbūlañjapellakṣacatuṣṭayamādau yantrampūjayitvā japasthāne japañcaretna kāryyaḥ subhruvāṃ dveṣo yatnataḥ paripūjayetśmaśāne śūnyasadane devāgāretha nirjanesamare śatrunihataṃ yadā ṣaṇmāsikaṃ śiśumevaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogānkarttumarhatijihvāyāṃ sa likhenmantrammadhvājyābhyāṃ śalākayāgateṣṭamebde bālosau jāyate kavirāḍ dhruvamtaracca jalamadhye tatsamānīya taṭe punaḥmadhutailasurābhiśca saṃlikhetpadminīdalenikhāya taddalaṃ kuṇḍe caturasre samekhalehomānte tena manunā pūrvadravyairbaliṃ haretsvāhāntaḥ praṇavādiśca mantroyaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥnivāso bhāratīlakṣmyorjanatārañjanakṣamaḥlalāṭe tilakaṃ kṛtvā yaṃ paśyetsa tu dāsavatkṛṣṇāmbareṇa saṃveṣṭya nibaddhaṃ raktatantubhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uccāṭayati saptāhātsakuṭumbaṃ na saṃśayaḥravivāre niśīthinyāṃ sahasramabhimantrayetkṣetre kṣiptaṃ sasyahānyai javahṛtturagālayeoṃ [oṃ trīṃhrīṃhrūṃhrīṃhuṃ phaṭ || ] trīṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ samuccāryahrīṃhuṃphaṭ saptavarṇakaḥśvetāmbarāṃ candrakānticandrārdhakṛtaśekharāmnānālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyāṃ trīkṣaṇāmpadmasaṃsthitāmmadhupuṣkarapatrānnahomādvidyānidhirbhavetuccāṭane dhūmra varṇāṃ śāntau śvetāṃ vicintayetbrahmaṇopāsitāntārāṃ dvādaśārṇāṃ sudurlabhāmtāre huṃphaḍiti prokto mantroyaṃ dvādaśākṣaraḥhiraṇyakaśipordātuṃ varaṃ saptārṇasammitāmhuṃphaḍantaḥ sarvamasya nyāsādyampūrvavadbhavetbauddhamārgapracārārthaṃ siddhidā dvādaśākṣarīsauruktvā sādhitā vidyā dvādaśārṇātibuddhidātasyāstu pūrvavajjñeyaṃ nyāsadhyānajapādikamlakṣmīprabhṛtirā [rāsasamaye lakṣmīnāmagopyādivilāsārtham || ] sārthaṃ tayā mattastadā halītyaktvā tatra sauścoktvā vidyā rāmeṇa [dāśarathinā || ] sevitādhyānapūjādikamprāgvatprayogādikameva capañcārṇāṃ yatprabhāveṇa daityānāṃ kadanaṃ kṛtameṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ tu munirviṣṇuḥ prāgvajjapādikamdattā ca raviṇādityai sā vidyā tu ṣaḍakṣarījñeyaṃ nyāsādikaṃ pūrvaṃ prayogādi ca pūrvavatjalandharavadhārthaṃ tu mayā siddhīkṛtaṃ purāmayā pañcamukhairjapto dakṣamārgeṇa bhoḥ surāḥyamānāṃ niyamānāṃ ca tatrasthā nānyadevatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dakṣiṇārādhitā devā raṇasāhāyyakārakāḥkṣatriyāṇāṃ kṣayārthaṃ tu mayā rāmāya cārpitāḥmatsyasthāne khaṇḍakādyaṃ dharmmapatnyāṃ rataṃ matamkastu tārāṃ na seveta lokadvayaparīpsayātārāyāḥ sadgurau siddhiḥ strīrate bhrāntatā bhavetsiddhā mārgadvayenāpi varṇavarṇādhikārataḥtārāyai sakaletyuktvā dustarāttārayadvayamnyāsapujājapādyaṃ tu prāgvatsarvaṃ samācaretkrīṃ [krīṃ krīṃ krīṃ huṃ huṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ dakṣiṇe kālike krīṃ krīṃ krīṃ huṃ huṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ svāhā || ] krīṃ krīṃ huṃ dviruccāryya lajjābījadvayaṃ tathākrameṇaivāgnigṛhiṇī mantro dvāviṃśadarṇakaḥdevatā kālikā devī hrīṃ bījaṃ huṃ ca śaktikāṣaḍaṅgāni nyasenmantrī dviḥ sakṛdvā yathāvidhidaśabhirdaśabhiḥ kuryyāttathā jaṅghādvaye kramātsaptabhiścāpi mantrārṇarvyāpakaṃ ca samantataḥkālikāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ divyāṃ muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitāmmahāmeghaprabhāṃ śyāmāṃ tathā caiva digambarāmkarṇāvataṃsatānītaśavayugmavirājitāmśavānāṃ karasaṅgātaiḥ kṛtakāñcīṃ hasanmukhīmghorarūpāṃ mahāraudrīṃ śmaśānālayavāsinīmśavarūpamahādevahṛdayoparisaṃsthitāmmahākālasamāyuktāṃ śarvopariratānvitāmevaṃ sañcintayetkālīṃ śmaśānālayavāsinīmpadmamaṣṭadalaṃ bāhye bhūpuraṃ tatra pūjayetmahākālaṃ ca tatraiva nyasedeṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥkālīṃ kapālinīṃ kullāṃ prathame tu trikoṇake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kurukullāvirodhinyau vipracittāṃ tṛtīyakemātrāṃ murdrā ca mitrāṃ ca trikoṇe pañcame yajettarjjanīṃ vāmahastena dhārayanti ca sasmitāḥsampūjya yatnataścāpi baliṃ sampratipādayetnirmālyaṃ vai śucau deśe dhārayecca sadaiva hidaśāṃśaṃ juhuyādājyaistarpayedabhiṣecayettataḥ prayogānkurvīta kāmyāniṣṭaphalāptayedevīmevaṃ ca sañcintya mahākālasamīpagāmante tu mūlamantrasya japapūjādikaṃ caretsvaṃsvaṃ santyajya bharttāramāliṅganti sadaiva tamdhyātvā sampūjayetpuṣpaiḥ pītairākarṣaṇaṃ bhavetdhyātvaivaṃ sarvamantrānte ṭhadvayaṃ parikīrtayetmaraṇaṃ tu bhavettasya yamuddiśya kṛtā kriyāvidrāvayati śuṣkāsyā pronmattayati ghūrṇikāsaṅkocayati saṃruddhā viruddhā ca virodhayetuccāṭanaṃ vinānyatra sarvatra surataṃ matamavākyo muktakeśaśca tena syuḥ sarvasiddhayaḥsa bhavetsarvasiddhīnāṃ pāragaḥ sarvadaiva higadyapadyamayī vāṇī tasya sarvavidhā bhavetprajapedayutaṃ tāvadevaṃ pratinidhirbhavetanarghakavitā tasya gadyapadyamayī bhavetprayāti maithunaṃ yosau dhanadhānyasutānvitaḥyadi yoṣitprasaṅgena retaḥ patati yatnataḥśmaśānāṅgāramādāya muktakeśo digambaraḥpretamāruhya tatraiva yo japenmantravittamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa yāti paramāṃ siddhiṃ devairapi sudurlabhāmśmaśāne'bhyarcayeddevīṃ vāgīśasamatāṃ vrajetśmaśāne'bhyarcayeddevīṃ sarvāṃ siddhiṃ sa vindatisukhī syānnātra sandeho mahākālavaco yathāraktacandanadigdhāṅgīṃ raktapuṣpairalaṅkṛtāmtato gatvāpnuyādrājyaṃ yadyasau na bibheti vaiasakṛttu japenmantraṃ sarvasiddhiprado [mantra iti vā puruṣaḥ iti vā śiṣyate mantraśeṣapakṣe tasyetyarghyāhāryamiti gauravam 2 || tadanyatra neti jñeyam || ?] bhavettristrirmantrānudīryyaivaṃ sarvasiddhirbhavettataḥretobhiśca tathā tadvat svakīyena kacena camūṣamārjjāraraktena vāgmitvaṃ tasya jāyatevacasā sa bhavejjīvo dhanena ca dhanādhipaḥbalena pavano jyeṣṭhassarvatattvārthasādhakaḥmūṣamāṃsaṃ meṣamāṃsaṃ chāgaṃ māhiṣameva canivedayecchamaśāne tatsarvasiddhiprado [karmeti śeṣaḥ || ] bhavetpratyekaṃ prajapenmantraṃ tatastaddhomayedbudhaḥsarvasiddhirbhavettasya vāgmī dhīrassa jāyateyonirūpaṃ hi kṛtvā tu kuṇḍaṃ vitastyaratnitaḥtatra kāryyā hi mantreṇa vahnisthāpanikāḥ kriyāḥsruveṇājyena māṃsena bhaktena rudhireṇa caāmiṣādibhirapyevaṃ juhuyācca śmaśānakedivā sarvaṃ prakurvīta sarvakāmārthasiddhayeprakurvīta prayatnena sarvakāmārthasiddhayeśūdrāṇāṃ caiva saṃprokto rātrāveva vidhirmayātridhā vibhajya mantrādyairyatnātsādhakasattamaḥājyaṃ ceti prayatnena hotavyaṃ sarvasiddhaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yadyatprārthayate jantustattatprāpnoti nityaśaḥhavanāt sarvamāpnoti nityamevamatandritaḥhomaṃ tu raktapuṣpeṇa kuṇḍe kuryyādyathāvidhipitṛmātṛvadhādyaiśca kimanyaiḥ kṣudrapātakaiḥyaṃyaṃ spṛṣṭvā japenmantrī sa taṃ taṃ vaśamānayetkuryyānnṛpaṃ vaśe mantrī nāsādhyaṃ bhuvanatrayebrahmacārī haviṣyāśī bhavedindrasamo japātayutaṃ juhuyānmantrī sahasratritayaṃ punaḥtarpayecca punastadvaddevīṃ dhyātvā hutāśaneghṛtāktamālatīpuṣpairhomāddrutakavirbhavetdevyārādhanaśaktiśca gurubhaktasya nānyathādakṣiṇe kālike svāhā mantroṣṭākṣara īritaḥmahākālaratāsaktāṃ śivābhirdikṣu veṣṭitāmtathāparājayā nityā vilāsinyapi kīrttitāhrīṃkālikāyogapīṭhātmane nama udāhṛtaḥkālīṃ kapālinīṃ kullāṃ kurukullāṃ virodhinīmugrāmugraprabhāṃ dīptāṃ nīlāṃ ghanāṃ vācālikāmpūrvoktabhūpure pūjyā bhairavyoṣṭau ca bhairavīḥdhūmrākhyā bhairavī turyyā pañcamī bhīmabhairavīsaptamī bhairavī khyātāṣṭamī mohanabhairavīpuraścaryyādikaṃ prāgvatprayogānācarettathāātmano hitamanvicchankālībhakto vivarjayettasya syuracirādeva karasthāḥ sarvasiddhayaḥsādhakena hi ktiyugmamasya nyāsādi pūrvavatpañcamapratimityāyaṃ [pañcamakārapratimityā || ] dakṣiṇāmnāyasiddhidaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trirāvarṇamayīṃ devīṃ vidyutpuñjasvarūpiṇīmaṇoraṇīyasīṃ devīṃ cakraṣaṭkaprabhedinīmsāntavādidalasthārṇānpadmasthāne samāharetphāntaḍādyarṇasaṃyukte digdale vedhayetsvayamṭhāntakādyarṇapatrābje vedhayedīśvare svayampadme svarānsaṃyojya yatnataḥlakṣasaṃyukte vedhayitvā tu deśikaḥśiṣyo dagdhājñānastadā kṣitausvayaṃbhūyātsatyameva na saṃśayaḥsvayaṃ guruṃ dhyāyet svahaste śivarūpiṇammastake dattvā kṛpayā dakṣiṇaṃ karamcidrūpe guruścittaṃ nidhāpayetgurostu kṛpayā kevalohaṃ sadāśivaḥdhyātvā paramātmani devatāmprasannacittaḥ sanpaścādupadiśeditigurorālokamātreṇa bhāṣaṇātsparśanādapibhuktimuktiprasiddhyarthamparīkṣya vidhivad guruḥdadyādgṛhṇātyanyāyataśca yaḥguruśiṣyāvubhau mohādaparīkṣya parasparamaśāstrīyopadeśantu yo gṛhṇāti dadāti yaḥasaṃskṛtyopadeśaṃ tu yaḥ karoti vimūḍhadhīḥmantravijñānaṃ na tiṣṭhati kadācanasacchiṣyāyātibhaktāya vijñānamupadiśyatedhanecchābhayalībhādyairayogyaṃ yadi dīkṣayetgururdīkṣāṃ kuryātpūrṇābhiṣecanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
