sanskrit: krīṃ huṃ hrīṃ dakṣiṇe kālike krīṃhuṃhrīṃ dahanapriyāviśeṣānnasurādīnāmayamākarṣaṇakṣamaḥhuṃca trirdviśca lajjā svāhetyākṛtivarṇavānjapādetasya bhūtiśca sarvamanyattu pūrvavatdakṣiṇe kālike svāhā nṛpavarṇaḥ [ṣoḍaśārṇaḥ || ] prakīrttitaḥviśeṣāṅgatarājyānāmayaṃ rājyaprado mataḥupavāsaparaścaivamekāhātsiddhimāpnuyātārdroṣṇīṣa ārdravāsāstena mantraḥ prasidhyatiathavā prajapenmantraṃ śmaśāne vigatajvaraḥjapapūjādiprāgvadviśeṣādbhogamokṣadamnyāsapūjādikaṃ prāgvaddviśeṣādbhogado mataḥprāgvajjapādikaṃ cāsya viśeṣātsantatipradaḥnyāsadhyānādikaṃ prāgvadviśeṣādbhūtanāśanaḥprāgvannyāsādikaṃ sarvaṃ viśeṣācchāntikārakaḥdhūṃdhūṃ dhūmāvati svāhā mantroṣṭākṣara īritaḥṣaḍ dīrghabinduyuktena dhakāreṇa ṣaḍaṅgakamaṃguṣṭhādiṣaḍaṅgeṣu punardevīṃ vicintayetvimuktakuntalāṃ dīrghāṃ vidhavāṃ viraladvijāmśūrppahastāṃ tu rūkṣākṣīṃ dhūtahastāṃ tvarānvitāmkṣutpipāsārditāṃ nityaṃ sadā kalahatatparāmpūrvokte pūjayetpīṭhe jyeṣṭhāṃ śatrunivarttaneakṣameti tato devā indrādyā āyudhānvitāḥśūnyāgāre śmaśāne vā kāntāre bhūdharethavāevaṃ lakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ nāśayedacirādarīnjuhuyāllavaṇopetāṃ rājikāṃ niśi tatphalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sahasrādūrdhvataḥ śatrujvareṇa parigṛhyatedvitīyāntaṃ manau śatrornāmaivaṃ manumālikhetunmādo jāyate śatrormanorayutajāpataḥvirodhināmnāṣṭāśāsu kṣipramuccāṭanaṃ ripoḥvirodhināma saṃruddhaṃ kṛṣṇapuṣpaiḥ samarcayetmahiṣīrūpeṇāgatya svapne śatruṃ vināśayetsamuccāṭayate tūrṇaṃ nātra kāryyā vicāraṇādhūmāvatīmanuṃ mantrī śatruryamapuraṃ vrajetjalasthaḥ prajapenmantraṃ huṃkārānnāśayedarīnbhagavanniti sambhāṣya manasā karmma cintayetcitākāṣṭhānale kṣīrahomācchāntiḥ prajāyatemārayatyarimāgatya śāntirnirmālyadhūpataḥaśvatthapatradhūpena śāntirbhavati nānyathākṣīreṇa śāntirbhavati madhuratritayena vājaptvā padadvaye mantrī khaneduccāṭanaṃ ripoḥvāyasebhyo baliṃ dattvā śatroruccāṭanaṃ bhavetśatrugehepi sañjaptāṃ śatroruccāṭanaṃ bhavetgardabhāvāsabhūmau vā pretasthāne catuṣpatheśmaśānastho viniḥkṣipya citāgnau marjayettathāsenāmadhyepi sarveṣāṃ kṣaṇāduccāṭanaṃ bhavetbhramate kākavatsarvāṃ mahīmāvaraṇādiṣuāyāsairmantramāvṛtya vakṣyamāṇaiḥ praveṣṭayetsaptarātreṇa tasyāpi bhaveduccāṭanaṃ dhruvammantreṇa damitau sādhyau bhaumavārodaye raveḥvyatyasya pṛṣṭhato baddhvā keśapāśena taṃ japet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidveṣaṇaṃ bhavetsadyo gaurīśaṃkarayorapianyadviṣatarostadvajjapitvoddhṛtya vinyasetete prayogāḥ kathitā dhūmāvatyā mayā surāḥcaturdaśākṣaro mantro bhadrakālyā udāhṛtaḥdhyātavyeyaṃ sadā devī bhadrakālī bhayāpahāmaṣīmukhī muktakeśī jagadvasanalālasājapapūjāprayogādyaṃ yo viśeṣaḥ sa ucyateiyaṃ devī mahādevī śatruvigrahakāriṇīgṛdhrakarṇi [gṛdhrakarṇi virūpākṣi lambastani mahodari utpādayotpādaya upari vetti vetti huṃphaṭ svāhā || ] virūpākṣi lambastani mahodaridvidhā vetti padaṃ huṃphaṭ svāhā saptāgnivarṇakaḥbhadrakālī devatā syāddvirutpādaya hṛtsmṛtamhuṃphaḍbhyāṃ kavacaṃ proktaṃ svāhayāstramudīritamsuvṛttanayanāṃ śūrāṃ dīrghaghoṇāṃ madāturāmkuṭilabhrukuṭīdīptāṃ mahāradanabhīṣaṇāmtriśūlavyagradordaṇḍāṃ narakīṃ pippalāśinīmśiromālābhūṣitāṅgīṃ pibantīṃ śoṇitāsavampiśācaskandhamāruhya bhramantīṃ vasudhātaleitthaṃbhūtāṃ bhadrakālīṃ mātṛbhiḥ parivāritāmayutaṃ mantrasiddhyarthaṃ mātṛkānyāsatatparaḥdhūmāvatyā ca yatproktamanayāpi tadācaretviṣavṛkṣaṃ samādāya tato homaṃ samācaretviṣavṛkṣendhanenāgniṃ prajvālyāvāhayetsudhīḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ vahnau taṃ daṇḍaṃ nikṣipedbudhaḥdikṣu sarvāsu saṃsthāpyāḥ svamedāḥ khaḍgahastakāḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā daṇḍāgraṃ jātavedasi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: agnyādīṃścāpi santoṣya balidānena devatāmśūlāgraprotasiṃhāṃ ca naramālāvibhūṣitāmulkāhastāṃ śatrusaṅghaṃ śilāyāṃ nighnatīṃ muhuḥgatvā dūreṇa visṛjettaṃ daṇḍaṃ dhyānamāsthitaḥsnātvāvaśyaṃ śucirbhūtvā kaṇṭhamātrodake sthitaḥaṣṭottarasahasrantu japedanyacchataṃ śatampādayugmaṃ samālambya varṇalakṣaṃ japenmanumdakṣiṇā vidhivaddattvā śāntihomañca kārayetkṛtvābhiṣekaṃ tābhyāntu śaktito bhojayeddvijānrudradaṇḍaprayogoyaṃ dāruṇoragasūdanaḥuccāṭanaṃ bhavetkṣipramacalasyāpi kiṃ nṛṇāṃtrikoṇeripratikṛtiṃ likhetsamyagadhomukhīmpādapāto yathā śatroḥ syāttathoccāṭayedbalātoṃ kṣreṃ kṣreṃ kremataḥ kreṃ ca paśuṃ gṛhāṇa coccaretnāsya munyādikanyāsaḥ siddhamantrasya vidyatebāhmyādibhiśca dūtībhiryuktāṃ sampūjya bhaktitaḥpañcavaktrāṃ mahāraudrīṃ prativaktraṃ trilocanāmvāmadakṣabhujairdevīṃ bibhrāṇāṃ bhogibhūṣaṇāmpicumandasya samidho ghṛtāktā juhuyāttataḥevaṃ siddhamanurmantrī mārayedacirādripūnsmaredananyamanasā mānavo mānamāpnuyāthuṃsa uktvā huṃ tathāstraṃ svāhāntaḥ ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥmahāvāyurmahāpṛthvī mahākāśastathaiva camahāgniśceti hūṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ parikīrtitāmantradevāṃstato mantrī dhyāyetsusthiramānasaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyāghrādipaśubhirvyāptaṃ sānuyuktaṃ giriṃ smaretghanatoyaṃ sakallolamakūpāraṃ vicintayetpītavarṇaṃ mahāvahniṃ saṃsmarecchatruśāntayepavanaṃ saṃsmaredviśvajīvanaṃ prāṇarūpataḥādhārabhūtā jagato dhyeyā pṛthvīha mantriṇānirmalaṃ gaganaṃ dhyāyetprāṇināmāśrayapradamjapenmantraṃ daśāṃśena ṣaḍdravyairhomamācaretetānhutvā yathābhāgaṃ pīṭhe pūrvodite yajetśatrūpadrava āpanne yuñjītātra mahāmanumpatanonmukhamatyugraṃ prācyāṃ diśi vicintayetsamudrarūpiṇaṃ bhīmaṃ pratīcyāṃ diśi cintayetśatruvargaṃ ca badhnantau cintayenniyatātmavānnirundhānaṃ smarenmantrī vidadhadripumākulampratyekaṃ tu nirundhānaṃ cintayetsādhakottamaḥutthāpya vahniṃ taddehaṃ pradahetsa manuṃ smaretmaṇḍalatritayādarvāgdārayettena vidviṣamsaṃśodhayitvā cātmānaṃ svarakṣāyai hariṃ smaretoṃ [oṃ hrīṃ namaḥ kṛṣṇavāsase stute viśvasahasrahiṃsini sahasrāvane mahabaleparājite pratyaṅgire parasainyaparakarmmavidhvaṃsini paramantrotsādini sarvabhūtadamani sarvadevānbandhabandha sarvavidyāṃ chindhi chindhi kṣobhayakṣobhaya parayantrāṇi sphoṭayasphoṭaya sarvaśṛṃkhalāṃ troṭayatroṭaya jvalajvālājihve karālavadane pratyaṃgire hrīṃ namaḥ || ] hrīṃ namaḥ kṛṣṇavāsase stute viśvasahasrapratyaṅgire parasainyapara karmmapadaṃ vadetsarvabhūteti damani sarvadevānvadettataḥparayantrāṇīti vadetsphoṭayadvitayaṃ tataḥjvālājihve karāleti vadane pratyaṅuccaretbrahmānuṣṭummuniśchando devī pratyaṅgirā matāṣaḍaṅgānāṃ vidhiścātra ṣaḍdīrghānvitamāyayāśūlaśastrakarā khaḍgaṃ dadhatī yā tu tāṃ bhaje
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hutvā siddhamanurmantrī prayogeṣu śataṃ japetvināśayetparakṛtaṃ yantramantrādisādhanamnavadurgātmakaṃ yasya sevanādbhuktimuktikesaṃsārabandhanirnāśi jñānamāptaṃ samādhinājapādyasya phalaṃ dadyāttaṃ manuṃ vacmi sāmpratamvicce navārṇamantroyaṃ śaktimantrottamottamaḥgāyatryuṣṇiganuṣṭup ca cchandastrayamudīritamnandāśākambharībhīmāśaktitrayamudāhṛtamagnivāyubhagāstattvaṃ prāgvadṛṣyādikaṃ nyasettata ekādaśanyāsānkuryyādiṣṭaphalapradānkṛtena yena devasya sārūpyaṃ yāti mānavaḥbījatrayaṃ [oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ namaḥ kaniṣṭhāyugme, oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ namaḥ anāmikāyugme, oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ namaḥ madhyamāyugme, asyaiva ṣaḍakṣarasya nyāsāccheṣasthāneṣvapi kuryyāt || ] tu mantrādyaṃ tārādihṛdayāntakamkaniṣṭhānāmikāmadhyātarjanyaṃguṣṭhayugmakehṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgeṣu jātiyuktaṃ punarnyasetnyāsaḥ kāryaḥ saptaśatyāḥ paṭhetkāmaviśeṣataḥmāyābījādikā [hlīṃ brāhmī māṃ pūrvataḥ pātu, hrīṃ māheśvarī āgneyyāṃ pātu evamanyatranyasyet || ] brāhmī pūrvataḥ pātu māṃ sadāaiśānye tu mahālakṣmīrūrdhvaṃ vyomeśvarī tathātṛtīyesminkṛte nyāse trailokye vijayī bhavetnandajā pātu pūrvāṅgaṃ kamalāṃkuśamaṇḍitāpṛṣṭhe śākambharī pātu puṣpapallavasaṃyutāśiraḥpātrakarā bhīmā mastakāccaraṇāvadhituryyaṃ nyāsaṃ naraḥ kurvañjarāmṛtyuṃ vyapohatipādādinābhiparyantaṃ brahmā pātu sanātanaḥviśuddherbrahmarandhrāntampātu rudrastrilocanaḥcakṣuṣī vṛṣabhaḥ pātu sarvāṅgāni gajānanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtesminpañcame nyāse sarvakāmānavāpnuyātmadhyaṃ pātu mahālakṣmīraṣṭādaśabhujānvitāadhaḥ pātu mahākālī daśabāhusamanvitāsiṃho hastadvayampātu parahaṃsokṣiyugmakammahiṣaścaṇḍikāyuktaḥ savārṅgāni mamāvatumūlākṣaranyāsarūpantataḥ kurvīta saptamambrahmarandhre [aiṃnamaḥ brahmarandhre, hrīṃnamaḥ dakṣanetre, klīṃnamaḥ vāmanetre || evamanyatrāpi śeṣeṣu nyaset || ] netrayuge śrutyornāsikayormukhenamontānsaptamesmiṃstu kṛte rogakṣayo bhavetkṛtesminnaṣṭame nyāse sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ vinaśyatimastakāccaraṇaṃ yāvaccaraṇānmastakāvadhimūlamantrakṛto nyāso navamo devatāptikṛtkṛtesmindaśame nyāse trailokyaṃ vaśamānayetanyanyāsoktaphaladaṃ kuryādekādaśantataḥādyaṃ kṛṣṇataraṃ bījaṃ dhyātvā sarvāṅgake nyasetpaṭhitvā sūryasadṛśaṃ dvitīyaṃ pṛṣṭhato nyasetśikhāyāṃ netrayoḥ śrutyornasorvaktre gude nyasettato devītrayaṃ dhyāyetkālikādhyānamucyateindranīladyutiṃ khaḍgaṃ [khaṅgaṃ] cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ śiraḥ śarānmadhukaiṭabhanāśārthaṃ sālaṅkārāṃ trivīkṣaṇāmsamastadevatātejojātāṃ padmāsanasthitāmkhaḍgaṃ vajraṃ gadāṃ cakrandakṣahaste kamaṇḍalumcarmadaṇḍau surāpātraṃ ghaṃṭāṃ pāśaṃ triśūlakamśaṃkhaṃ ca muśalaṃ cakraṃ dakṣahasteṣu bibhratīmgaurīdehasamudbhūtāṃ nṛṇāmānandadāyinīmadhiṣṭhātrīṃ tṛtīyaṃ hi caritraṃ ca smaretsadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pāyasānnena juhuyātpūjite hemaretasietadyantraṃ vṛttatryasraṣaṭkoṇāṣṭadalānvitamvidārayantaṃ mahiṣaṃ prākkoṇe mṛgapaṃ yajetśākambharīṃ tathā durgāṃ bhīmāṃ ca bhrāmarīṃ yajetsarvāsāmeva śaktīnāṃ nāmamantrā yataḥ smṛtāḥvaiṣṇavīṃ cāpi vārāhīṃ tathendrāṇīṃ prapūjayetviṣṇu māyāṃ cetanāṃ ca buddhiṃ nidrāṃ kṣudhāntathālajjāṃ śāntiṃ tathā śraddhāṃ kāntiṃ lakṣmīṃ dhṛtiṃ tathāpuṣṭiṃ ca mātaraṃ bhrāntimarcayedbhūpureṣu cayoginīśca sureśādyāṃstadbāhye cāyudhāni capuṭitaṃ mūlamantreṇa japannāpnoti vāñchitamvāmadakṣiṇamārgābhyāmadhikāriphalapradāupasargavināśāya madhyamaṃ yojayedbudhaḥcaritradvayaśīlasya na vaṃśaśchidyate kvacitanādyaṃ paṭhate yastu mārayedacirādripūnyastu mantreṇa puṭitaṃ tatpṛṭhāṅkasya saṃkhyayāsvaśatrūndaityabhāvena svamitrāndevatādhiyāmṛtā vā mṛtakalpā vā śatravaḥ syurna saṃśayaḥjapellakṣamanuṃ homaḥ khādyaistrimadhurāplutaiḥviprāngurūnsamārādhya vāñchitaṃ labhate drutamchando gāyatramuditaṃ mahākālī tu devatāprayogāṇāntu navatirmāraṇe mohanetra tuuṣṇik chando mahālakṣmīrdevatā bījamadrijāuccāṭe stambhane cātra prayogāṇāṃ śatadvayammahāsarasvatī devī triṣṭup chanda udāhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidveṣavaśyayoścātra prayogā dikkṛtairmitāḥtasmātsaptaśatītyevaṃ vyāsena parikīrtitātasmātsaptaśatītyevaṃ proktā vyāsena dhīmatātasmātsaptaśatītyevaṃ proktā vyāsena dhīmatāupāsyā devatā yāstā iha saptaśatī hyataḥsarasvatī ceti sapta hyupāsyā vāmamārgataḥbālā kubhreti manavaḥ sūcitāḥ samprakīrtitāḥtattanmantroktasaṅketairmantraśaktiḥ prajāyatecarite śaktayassapta cāmuṇḍāntāḥ prakīrtitāḥbrahmāṇyādyāḥ saptasaṃkhyā vartamānāśca tatra hiśaktyaḥ proktāḥ svayaṃ devyāstasmātsaptaśatī smṛtāpādonaṃ śrīharirvetti vettyardhantu prajāpatiḥyathāmantrastu siddyarthaṃ yojyate kriyatethavāvarṇānāṃ ca padānāṃ ca vyatyāsastu vyavasthitaḥśabdaśāstrāviruddhastu pāṭhaḥ śantikapauṣṭikejapedaṣṭaśatammūlaṃ devatāyai nivedayetśatacaṇḍīvidhānantu pravakṣye ca priyaṃ nṛṇāmativṛṣṭyāmanāvṛṣṭau paracakrabhaye kṣayerogāṇāṃ vairiṇāṃ nāśo dhanaputrasamṛddhayaḥtatra kuṇḍaṃ prakurvīta pratīcyāmmadhyatopi vāvyutpannāṃścaṇḍikāpāṭhe ratāṃllajjādayāvataḥpādyārghyamāsanammālāṃ dadyāttebhyopi bhojanammārkaṇḍeyapurāṇoktaṃ daśakṛtvaḥ sacetasaḥyajamānaḥ pūjayecca kanyānāṃ navakaṃ śubhamnādhikāṅgīṃ na hīnāṅgīṃ kuṣṭhinīṃ ca vraṇāṅkitām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dāsījātāmbhogayuktāmiṣṭāṃ kanyāṃ na pūjayetvaiśyajāṃ dhanalābhāya putrāptyai śūdrajāṃ yajetcaturabdā tu kalyāṇī pañcavarṣā tu rohiṇīaṣṭavarṣā śāmbhavī syāddurgā tu navahāyanāekābdāṃ hyaprītibhāvādrudrābdāntu vivarjjayetmantrākṣaramayīṃ lakṣmīṃ mātṝṇāṃ rūpadhāriṇīmkumārikādi nyānāmpūjāmantrānbruve'dhunāpūjāṃ gṛhāṇa kaumāri jaganmātarnamostu tetrailokyavanditāṃ devīṃ trimūrtiṃ pūjayāmyahamkalyāṇajananīnnityāṃ kalyāṇīṃ pūjayāmyahamkāmadāṃ karuṇodārāṃ kālikāmpūjayāmyahampūjayāmi sadā devīṃ caṇḍikāṃ caṇḍavikramāmsarvabhūtātmikāṃ lakṣmīṃ śāmbhavīṃpūjayāmyahamsundarīṃ pūjayedbhaktyā durgāndurgārtināśinīmsubhadrajananīṃ devīṃ subhadrāmpūjayāmyahamgandhaiḥ puṣpairbhakṣyakhādyairvastrairābharaṇairapighaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivattatrāvāhyārcayecchivāmupacāraiśca vidhivatpūrvoktāvaraṇānyapipāyasānnaistrimadhvaktairdrākṣārambhāphalairapijātīphalairāmraphalairanyairmadhuravastubhiḥayutaṃ ca navārṇena sthāpitegnau vidhānataḥkṛtvā pūrṇāhutiṃ samyagdevamagniṃ visṛjya caniṣkaṃ suvarṇamatha vā pratyekandakṣiṇāṃ diśettebhyopi dakṣiṇāndattvā gṛhṇīyādāśiṣaḥ śubhāḥrājyaṃ dhanaṃ yaśaḥ putrāniṣṭamanyallabheta ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nāpnoti sadgatiñca samīhitāmvipulāṃścakrānmaṇḍapetimanoharekalaśāṃstatra vastrahemasamanvitānmadhye cānteṣu sāṅgāvaraṇadevatāḥcaturo vedāṃstatastena jalena tusarvatantrāṇi tantrebhyo munayastathābhavedācāryanāmā ca kuryānnāmāntaraṃ guruḥsarvamantrapradhāneṣu samarthaḥ sa tu jāyatevidhistasya mārgaḥ syāddakṣiṇābhidhaḥyamunāyāśca sarasvatyā mahodadheḥsarayūcarmaṇvatyośca puṣkarātkurukṣetrasyagaṇḍakyāḥ pūrṇāyā mānasasya caabhiṣiktastu taistoyaiḥ siddho vai mānavotra tutīrthaghaṭaṃ sthāpya śeṣāstoyaghaṭā matāḥsānnidhyaṃ mantrarūpāśca tanmukhenāmito mūrddhā tasya mṛtyurna saṃśayaḥnirahaṅkāraḥ sadā daivatatparaḥsyādanyo nirayabhājanamkriyādīkṣāvidhiṃkuryādyathāśaktyā gurūktitaḥetattattvaṃ samākhyātaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchathadīkṣāprakāśastṛtīyaḥtadiṣṭasiddhaye tatra devaṃ saivaṃ vyajijñapatsaṃśayaṃ chindhi tvadṛtenyaḥ pumānna hitadbhedā bhinnāḥ kasmādvadasva naḥdevatāḥ santi mantrā eva tu devatāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidyāvataḥ sadācārānbrāhmaṇānvṛṇuyācchatamayutaṃ ca japeyuste pratyekaṃ ca navārṇakamevaṃ daśāhaṃ sampādya homaṃ kuryyātprayatnataḥlakṣasaṃkhyaṃ navārṇaṃ ca pūrvoktadravyasañcayaiḥsahasrasammitānsādhūndevyārādhanatatparānnārīdurbhagarogādyā naśyanti vyasanoccayāḥevaṃ sāvarṇikā tuṣṭā brahmaśrotṝnprarakṣatiaiṃhrīṃśrīṃklīṃ vedavarṇo mantraścāsyā udāhṛtaḥekākṣaravidhānena tadaṅgāni prakalpayetpadmadvayaṃ ca hasteṣu bibhratī nṛpasevitāpūrvatroktaprayogāṃśca kuryyānmantrī yathāvidhivisargāntāḥ pañcamantu bījametadudāhṛtampraṇavādirayammantraḥ syāttrayodaśavarṇakaḥsaṃśodhya manunā pāṇiṃ praṇavādyaṃ hṛdantakammantraśeṣaṃ japenmantrī talayorubhayorapiśeṣaṃ saptārṇakaṃ mantrī vinyaseddhṛdayādiṣucaturthaṃ jñānamukhyaiśca yuktaṃ kuryātṣaḍaṅgakamevaṃ nyasenmanuṃ mantrī cintayediṣṭadevatāmmandāndolitakarpūrakadalīvṛndamaṇḍitammallikāyūthikākundamadayantīsugandhikamnamerubhirlavaṅgaiśca candanai raktacandanaiḥnārikelaiśca kharjjūraiḥ pūgaiḥ kurabakairvṛtamnaṃdyāvarttairmadanakaiḥ sarvarttukusumojjvalampramadaiḥ picumandaiśca mandārairupaśobhitammallikāyūthikākundajātīmālatikāvṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kekikekāravākīrṇaṃ lakṣmaṇāsārasāvṛtamphullaiḥ sarasijai ramyaiḥ kahlāraiḥ kairavairapisarvartuśobhibhiḥ kalpadrumairmaṇḍitamujjvalamsamudyadarkasandohakiraṇadyutibhāskaramprollasadgalitasvarṇaprākārasumanoharamnūtanodyanmahāratnaracitaṃ tuṅgagopuramvaiḍūryyādimahāratnaracitastambharājitamhemadaṇḍasphuraddvīpasahasraṃ sumanoharamvicitravasanodbhūtairyutaṃ candrāyutairapighanasārāgurunakhakastūrīkuṃkumairapikramādevaṃ caturdvāraṃ maṇḍapaṃ paricintayetnānāratnagaṇākīrṇaṃ tatra devīṃ vicintayetmuktāhārojjvalāṃ ramyāṃ ratnākalpavibhūṣitāmpadmadvayaṃ kaustubhaṃ ca sasmitāsyasaroruhāmkvaṇannūpurasamphullaraktotpalapadadvayāmbalitrayalasadvedimadhyadeśasuśobhitāmyakṣakardamasaṃliptapīnonnataghanastanīmkṣaumottarāsaṅgavatīṃ puṣpadāmavibhūṣitāmkāñcanodyatpadmarāgamaṇisaṃbaddhakaṅkaṇāmkambukaṇṭhakalārāvāṃ svarṇagraiveyarājitāmudyadarkaprabhābhāsvadratnatāṭaṃkaśobhitāmpañcasāyakakodaṇḍajidbhrūyugavirājitāmkarṇapūrīkṛtasvarṇabaddharatnāṃkurāṃ śubhāmśekhare prollasadratnaraśanāvaliśobhitāmkāntakuñcitasaṃsnigdhanīlamañjulamūrdhajām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saundaryyasalilāmbhodhiṃ ratnasāravibhūṣitāmvāmādhaḥkaramārabhya sādhyadakṣakarāvadhidadyādbījenāsanaṃ ca svāṇunā mūrttikalpanamsumanoñjalihastaṃ ca puṣpābharaṇamarcayetaṣṭapatre sthitā pūjyā hyumā śrīśca sarasvatīnānālaṃkaraṇāḍhyāssyurambhojadvayapāṇayaḥpūjanīye prayatnena karābhyāṃ dhṛtacāmareparitaśca yajedrāśīngrahānnava tatorcayetlokapālāṃstadastrāṇi tattadbāhye yajetpunaḥtaddaśāṃśaṃ prajuhuyādvṛtaistrisvādusaṃyutaiḥsuśītaiḥ śucibhistoyaistarppayedayutadvayamkuryyātkāmyāni karmāṇi svābhīṣṭāni ca mantravitsahasraṃ daśarātraṃ ca samiddhe havyāvāhanesaptāhaṃ juhuyājjīvedvatsarāṇāṃ śataṃ sudhīḥkaṇṭhamātre jale sthitvā mahālakṣmīmiti smaretsa vāñchitārthaṃ labhate tathārogyaṃ ca sādhakaḥsocirāllabhate lakṣmīṃ mahatīṃ sādhakottamaḥśvetasarṣapakairājyaplutairvā juhuyādbudhaḥmānyate ca tathā sarvairjantubhirnānyathātra caguḍayuktaghṛtaiḥ pakvairapūpairjuhuyātsudhīḥguḍamiśrahaviṣyasya homādannasamṛddhimānsahitaṃ tilakaṃ kuryyātsarvaṃ vaśyaṃ [tasyeti śeṣaḥ] bhaveddhruvamvaśyā bhaveyurmukharā vaśinastasya mantriṇaḥjuhuyādaruṇāmbhojairvaśyāssyustasya viśvagāḥvaśayetpramadā vidvānmadhūkakusumairhunet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhye yantraṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ kalpayecca yathāvidhiśubhāṃścandanakāśmīraliptānsarvāṅgasundarānpūjayecca yathāvattānvāsitaistīrthapuṣkaraiḥkarṇikāmadhyavilasattatra padmaṃ tu kārayetkhādirośīrakāśmīracandrāgurutamālakamkalaśeṣu ca sarveṣu yathāvidhi viloḍayetapāmāgarsya patrāṇi musalī vajravallarīśālimāṣāṃśca satilānyavānprakṣālya niḥkṣipetphalāni padmabakulajātīsaugandhikāni capuṣpāṇi ketakasyātha tulasīpallavāṃstathāprakṣipya ca ghaṭānvastraiśchādayeccampakaiḥ śubhaiḥteṣu madhyasthakalaśe samāvāhya maheśvarīmśeṣeṣvaṣṭasu kumbheṣu kramānukramato yajetbhakṣyabhojyanivedyaiśca yathāvidhi yajetsudhīḥtataḥ sādhyaṃ samānīya saṃyataṃ sthaṇḍile śubhemanoharairalaṅkārairvividhairvasanairapisuvāsinībhirjāyābhirarcitānāṃ dvijanmanāmvedaghoṣeṇa ca saha lagne caiva tu śobhanemūlamantraṃ japansiñcetsādhyaśīrṣṇi tatoparaiḥsaṃspṛśanvedagaditāmāśiṣaṃ saṃprayacchatiprasīdatu mahālakṣmīḥ sakalā devatā apiitthaṃ dattvāśiṣaṃ paścādvāsasī paridhāya canānāvidhaiśca vasanairnānālaṅkaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥdāsībhirdevatābuddhyā guruṃ santoṣayetsudhīḥdīnāndhakṛpaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhojayecca dvijanmanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahātrilokaramyaśca tataḥ sa nṛvaraḥ svayamrājā śatrūn vijayatebhiṣiktaśca yathāvidhimahāmatiṃ ca labhate nātra kāryyā vicāraṇākṛtyādrohādidoṣe ca prakuryyādabhiṣecanamsarvāpadvāraṇaṃ caiva sarvasaukhyāni niścitamtāro [oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kamale kamalālaye prasīda prasīda śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ mahālakṣmi namaḥ || ] ramā śakti lakṣmi kamale kamalālayegāyatrīchanda uddiṣṭaṃ munirdakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥvarṇaistripañcarāmāgnirāmairdhyānamatho dhruvearghapātraṃ ca dadhatīṃ saddhāramukuṭānvitāmlāvaṇyabhūmikāṃ vande sundarāṅgadabāhukāmpuroṅgāni yajetpaścācchrīdharādīṃstataḥ paramvāsudevaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaśca pradyumnāniruddhakaubrāhmī satī dikṣu caitā āgneyādividikṣu tucatvārastu gajā ete tṛtīyeṣṭadalercayetharṣo balaśca tejasvī yajellokeśvarānbahiḥevaṃ sampūjayellakṣmīṃ yo martyaḥ sa dhanī bhavetdaśāhaṃ saṃskṛte vahnau prākproktenaiva vartmanācandanāktaiḥ sarasijairlakṣaṃ prajuhuyātsudhīḥtathā svaṃ prāpyate nityaṃ nātra kāryyā vicāraṇābhadrāṃ madhuvratāṃ śakravallīṃ śālmalimūsalīkuṣṭhakaṅkolakāśmīraṃ haridrāśikharī samepūrvoktāścātra siddhyanti prayogā vāñchitārthadāḥcaturdaśākṣaro mantro lakṣmīhṛdayanāmakaḥjapastrilakṣametasya padmairhomo daśāṃśataḥetasyopāsakānāṃ tu na vaṃśe syāddaridratā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekādaśārṇo mantroyaṃ jamadagnirmato muniḥyauṃ nauṃ mauṃ nama aiṃ namo hṛdayāya namostu hṛtyauṃ nauṃ mauṃ nama aiṃ vaṣaṭ śikhāyai ca vaṣaṭ śikhāśriyai netrāya vauṣaṭ ca procya netre tuṃ vinyasetdhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ mahālakṣmīvadācarettena siddho bhavenmantraḥ sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥkṛtvā brāhmaṇabhojāntaṃ mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyateaṣṭottarasahasraṃ sa labhate vāñchitaṃ phalammāsatrayaṃ japitvā ca grāmaṃ mantrī tathāpnuyātpadaiścaturbhiḥ sarveṇa pañcāṅgaṃ gaditaṃ manoḥiyaṃ siddhā mahāvidyā bhaktānāṃ kalpavallikāādau [śrīṃ sh klhrīṃ śrīmititryakṣaramantraḥ || ] śrībījamuccāryya sahakalaharāstataḥpunaśca śrīṃ samuccāryya mantrastryakṣara īritaḥtathaiva mohinī lakṣmīssarvasāmrājyadāyinīṣaḍbhirdīrghaiḥ [āṃ īṃ ūṃ aiṃ auṃ aḥ ebhiḥ ṣaḍakṣaraiḥ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ kuryāt | yathā āṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ īṃśirase svāhā ityādi || ] svarairvidvānṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyasetśaṅkhacakragadāpadmaśārṅgabāṇadharāṃ karaiḥpūjayāmi jagaddhātrīṃ binduṣakoṇameva caasminsamāvāhya devīṃ pūjayedupacārakaiḥagre yajecca gāyatrīṃ sāvitrīṃ ca sarasvatīmaṣṭādaśamahākoṭiyoginībhyo namastvitipunardevīṃ samabhyarcya gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥevamaṣṭabhujāṃ dhyātvā trilakṣaṃ prajapetsudhīḥtarppaṇaṃ mārjjanaṃ kuryyādbrāhmaṇānapi bhojayethṛdayaṃ [namaḥ] brahmatanaye mantroyaṃ parikīrttitaḥdhyānapūjāpuraścaryyādikamekākṣaroditam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hrīṃ jyeṣṭhāyai namaḥ procya mantraḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥdevatā jyeṣṭhalakṣmīśca śrīmāye śaktibījaketrivedābdhīndvagniyugmavarṇairaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāthṛnnābhyādhārajānvaṃghrau padānāṃ pañcakaṃ nyasetkuṃkumakṣodaliptāṅgīṃ praphullakamalekṣaṇāmdhanapūrṇaṃ sṛṇiṃ pāśaṃ dadhatīṃ bhujapallavaiḥsamyagdharmmādibhiḥ pīṭhaṃ mantravitparikalpayetpūrvādidalamadhyeṣu madhye cārcyāḥ kramādimāḥtanno lakṣmīḥ pracodayātaṅgāni mātṛlokeśāṃstadastrāṇi prapūjayetpāyasena susiddhena sarpiḥsiktena sādhakaḥiha vaṃśaṃ ca sampattiṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ labhate mṛtaḥekādaśākṣarairūnaṃ taṃ śatatrayavarṇakamsarvasiddhimātṛkābhyo namo nityoditā vadetkulacakranāmikāyai bhagavatyai padaṃ vadetoṃkṣauṃkrauṃ nama ityuktvā parameti ca haṃsinīpraśamani padaṃ procya sakaletipadaṃ vadetsarvāpadāmbhodhitāriṇītyuktvā sakaleti cahaṃsayugmaṃ balāyugmaṃ nareti rudhirāṃtra cakhādakhāda triśūlaṃ no bhindhimindhi vadettataḥchedayadvitayaṃ procya tāvadyāvanmameti casādhayadvitayānte tu vadetparama ityapikāruṇike bhagavati mahābhairavarūpadhāriṇi tridaśa cetyuktvā vareti namite vadetjaneti vatsaledevi mahākālipadaṃ vadetkurukuru surāsurakanyakāṃ hrīṃ vasupriyā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trilocanamuniścātijagatīchanda ucyatetārādikantu hṛdayaṃ vadetparamahaṃsiniviṣamopaplavapraśamani dhruvādyā śikhā matāsarvāpadāmbhodhitāriṇīti netraṃ dhruvādikamevaṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍaṅgāni vaktranyāsaṃ samācaretīśānavaktrāya namaḥ pūrvavaktre tu vinyasettatpuruṣeti vaktrāya namaḥ procya nyasedavākaghoravaktrāya namaḥ paścime tu mukhe nyasetvāmadevavakrāyeti namaścodaṅmukhe nyasetsadyojāteti vaktrāya namaścordhvamukhe nyasettaḍitkoṭisamaprakhyāṃ sindūrāruṇavigrahāmkheṭaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ svarṇapāśaṃ sāṃkuśaṃ varadābhayesarvasiddhipradāṃ devīṃ siddhilakṣmīṃ vicintayetvāme tu bhuvaneśvaryyā aṅgaiḥ syātprathamāvṛtiḥsatyabhogayogapūrvā lakṣmyo'ṣṭau ca dalāṣṭakecaturthamasitāṅgādyairlokapālaiśca pañcamamhomayedguggulājyābhyāṃ prayogānatha vacmyahamsahasrantu japenmantraṃ grahapīḍādiśāntayebilvaṃ vā pūjayeddevīṃ japedaṣṭasahasrakamśālibhiḥ svarṇalābhaḥ syādgodhūmaiḥ puṣṭireva cakumudairjanavātsalyaṃ bakulairatulāḥ śriyaḥmāṣahomena mūkaḥ syātkodravairvyādhiyugbhavetkaṭutailena vidveṣaḥ stambhaḥ prītaprakārakaiḥhomo'nyeṣāṃ padārthānāmaṣṭottarasahasrakamsarasīruhahomena sāmrājyaṃ bhalate naraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āyuṣe dūrvayā homo vaṭahomena yakṣiṇīmahābhaye samutpanne mahāriṣṭasamudbhavetilataṇḍulahomena mahābhayanivāraṇamśvetapadmakahomena vidyārthī labhate ca tāmjvarāścāturthikādyāśca vyādhayo vividhā grahāḥsaptajaptodakānāntu naśyantyabhyukṣaṇāt kṣaṇāt ekaviṃśatijaptāmbupānātsarvaviṣāpahamtilakaṃ saptajapitaṃ sarvavaśyakarambhavetityaṣṭa mātṛkāḥ proktāḥ kimanyacchrotumicchasiiti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte brāhmādyaṣṭamātṛkāmantraprakāśastrayoviṃśaḥdigīśāstanmanūnbrūhi phalaṃ cāpi maheśvaraimindrāya namaśceti śakramantraḥṣaḍakṣaraḥindrāya śaktirimbījaṃ bījenaiva ṣaḍaṅgakamsarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ naumīndrandikpatīśvaramtadbāhyeṣṭadale proktamantrairetaiḥ kramādyajetvaṃ varuṇaṃ yaṃ ca vāyuṃ saṃ somaṃ ceśamaṃ tvitiprajapellakṣamekantu bilvājyaṃ juhuyāttataḥmaṇḍalantu catuṣkoṇaṃ kṛtvā tanmadhyagaṃlikhetavraṇaṃ sthāpayetkumbhaṃ suvarṇodakapūritam [sugandhodakamiti vā pā ||]tajjalaṃ sthāpayettena rājyabhraṣṭo nṛpo labhetnasnāpayeddharmahīnambhaktiśraddhādivicyutambhūrbhuvaḥsvaragne ca jātaveda ihāvahaṛṣirbhṛgurbhavecchando gāyatraṃ devatānalaḥdhyāyedagniṃ kaṇṭhagatasvarṇamālāvirājitamp. 587)jvālāpuñjakṛtātāpaṃ śvetavastraṃ ca bibhratamsruksruvau ca varābhītī raktābhaṃ dahanambhajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japedbhānusahasrāṇi śuddhācāro jitendriyaḥbhakṣyairbhojyairyathāśakti dadyāttebhyaśca dakṣiṇāḥaparaṃ dinamārabhya homaṃ kuryādatandritaḥnityamaṣṭottaraśataṃ juhuyāddinaśaḥ sudhīḥsampūjya tarpayedviprairyathāvibhavamādarātvāsāsi dhanadhānyādi natvā samprīṇayedgurumrucirā jvalinī proktāḥ kramaśo nava śaktayaḥatra sampūjayedvahniṃ vidhinā proktalakṣaṇamjātavedāḥ saptajihvo havyavāhanasañjñakaḥkaumāratejāḥ syādvi"vamukho devamukhaḥ paraḥlokeśānarcayedbāhye vajrādyāyudhasaṃyutānjāyate vatsarādarvāgdhanadhānyasamṛddhimāntasya sañjāyate lakṣmīḥ kīrtistrailokyavanditākaravīraprasūnairvā maṇḍalātsyātsamṛddhimāntilahomena mahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti mānavaḥvikaṃkatāragvadhayoḥ samidbhiḥ karavīrajaiḥp. 588) jātīprasūnairdūrvābhirnityamaṣṭottaraṃ śatamsādhayedakhilānkāmānṣaṇmāsānnātra saṃśayaḥuttiṣṭha puruṣa brūyāddharipiṅgalatatparamcaturviṃśatyakṣarātmā samṛddhimanurīritaḥṣaṭśarābdhitrivedadvimitairdhyāyeddhutāśanamromavallīlasajjvālaṃ kāntājanavimohanamdaśāṃśaṃ juhuyādvahnau turagāgnimanuṃ smaretāśāpālaistadīyāstrairabhyarcya havyavāhanamjitvā rogānsa jīveta śriyā varṣaśataṃ naraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mukhyaṃ svarūpaṃ teṣāṃ tu mantrā eva na cetaratjanmāntare bhaveyuśca bījarūpā na saṃśayaḥdurgatimavāpnoti teṣāṃ saṃsevanānnaraḥsuvarṇaṃ durbuddhyā grāmyavattāracāriṇaḥna sadbījā bhavāntareyadvadvaṭodumbarapippalāḥyathā drākṣākharjūrapanasādayaḥtacchreyo yathā nāḍyonnajaṃ rasamgrahastadvacchreyassaṃvahate suraḥpoṣayeddaivikānmantrānitarānhanti vāmavatsitasyāpi vāmānāmapi puṣṭidāsarvamantrāṇāṃ puṣṭikṛcca tatastriṣugurornāḍī satvaraṃ mantrasiddhidāketunāḍī tu sadbhūte mantradevakṛttantre pratyakṣāgnisvarūpakamphalaṃ dhatte bhūmau vai viśvarūpakaḥkuṇḍasaṃskārānaṣṭādaśa samācaretkuśaissantāḍayetkuṇḍamastramantraṃ paṭhaṃstridhākhananaṃ kuṇḍasyāṅgulamātrataḥśuddhamṛdā taṃ ca pūrayeddhṛdayāṇunākuṭṭayettanmantreṇa syāttathā dṛḍhamgomayādbhiḥ kavacenaiva kārayettrisūtrīkṛtasūtreṇa veṣṭayetpratimekhalamtāraścāmukakuṇḍāya āsanāya namastvitimekhalānāṃ ca kuryādevaṃ prapūjanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: catuḥsahasraṃ prajapennityaṃ saṃvatsarāvadhikleśānnirjitya tejasvī jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sudhīḥdadhnā ca samidbhirvā pratipatsu bhaveddhanamtilairjyotiṣmatībhūtai ripurāṣṭrañjayennṛpaḥkanyāmiṣṭāmavāpnoti sāpi taṃ prāpnuyādvaramsānnaiḥ sahasramacirānmahatīṃ śriyamāpnuyātājyāktadūrvāhomena jīvedvarṣaśataṃ naraḥjuhvatā labhyate lakṣmīrdhanadhānyasamṛddhidāśrīrbhavenmahatī tasya ṣaṇmāsādanapāyinīp. 589) juhuyādvatsarādarvāk sa bhavedindirāpatiḥvatsaraṃ juhvatastaiḥ syāllakṣmīrindreṇa vāñchitātrisahasraṃ pratidinammantrasiddhyai jitendriyaḥjīvedvarṣaśataṃ bhūtvā tejasā bhāskaraprabhaḥprasūnaiḥ kusumaiḥ phullaiḥ kuṭajairjātisambhavaiḥāpnuyānmahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ vatsarādvāñchitādhikāmgodugdhena haviḥ kṛtvā kavalantena kalpayetgandhamālyādibhiḥ samyagjapitvāṣṭottaraṃ śatamjāyate vatsarādeva lakṣmīstrailokyamohinībhāratī nivasettasya mukhāmbhojetiniścalājāṭharāgnirbhavettasya ghṛtenaiva hutāśanaḥkṣīravṛkṣasamudbhūtaiḥ kvāthaistānpūrayetkramātkumbheṣu dhūpadīpādyaiḥ puṣpadhūpairmanoharaiḥabhiṣiñcettataḥ sādhyaṃ vinītaṃ dattadakṣiṇamagnerārādhanaṃ cetthaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakamoṃ-kroṃ-hrīṃ-āṃ [oṃ-kroṃ hrīṃ āṃ vaiṃ vaivasvatāya dharmarājāya bhaktānugrahakṛte namaḥ ||] ca tadbījaṃ ṅentaṃ vaivasvataṃ vadet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturviśativarṇoyaṃ yamamantrokhileṣṭadaḥmeghaśyāmaṃ prasannāsyaṃ nānālaṅkārasaṃyutamnānārūpadharairdūtaiḥ śvetavastraṃ bhajedyamamdigīśāṃśca yamasthāne citraguptaṃ prapūjayetvarṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ hunedājyānvitaistilaiḥtasya saṃsmaraṇādeva sakalāpannivāraṇamyametyuktvā ca vahikādhikāriṇe vadettataḥukārasvarasaṃyuktāssacandrāḥ kūṭamucyatesaptaṣaṇmanuvasvaṅganetrārṇairaṅgakalpanamlekhakaṃ pāpapuṇyānāṃ citraguptamahambhajerājadvāre vivāde ca saṃgrāme jayadāyakaḥmānyāṃ kīrtiṃ ca vaṃśaṃ ca saṃsthāpya svargagāminaḥoṃ kṣaṃ nirṛtaye rakṣodhipataye padaṃ vadetṅentastataśca hṛdayaṃ triṃśadarṇo manurmataḥnānārakṣogaṇaiḥ sevyaṃ khaḍgacarmadharaṃ bhajeoṃ [oṃ kṣaṃ nirṛtaye namaḥ hṛdayāya namaḥ, oṃ kṣaṃ rakṣodhipataye namaḥ śirase svāhā, oṃ kṣaṃ dhūmravarṇāya namaḥ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ, oṃ kṣaṃ khaḍgahastāya namaḥ kavacāyahum, oṃ kṣaṃ pretavāhanāya namaḥ netratrayāya vauṣaḍityādi ||] kṣamādyairhṛdantaiśca pañcāṅgaiḥ pañcabhiḥ padaiḥpañcakoṇeṣu mañcāṅgamaṣṭapatre yajedimāḥrākṣasīṃ bhītidāṃ kṛtyāṃ kheṭānastrāṇi tadbahiḥevaṃ tu siddhe mantresminnabhayaṃ jāyate vanemanuṣyā api ye vanyā mṛgādīnāṃ tu kā kathāsvayameva palāyante sādhakasya raṇādapiparehni vā guḍādyaṃ ca kānane vicaredbudhaḥna bhayaṃ jāyate tatra vyāghracauroragādijamjanmāntare dvijo bhūtvā kāśīṃ prāpya vimucyatekalau drutaphalaścaitatsadṛśo nāsti cāgame
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tato rakte padaṃ brūyāttatpaścādraktavāsaseaghorakarmake devi amukasya gatiṃ dahasuptasyeti procya mano dahayugmaṃ vadettataḥpacayugmaṃ tāvaditi dahayugmaṃ paceti caproktoyamāsurīmantro daśottaraśatākṣaraḥhuṃphaṭsvāhāntakairmantravarṇaih pratyaṅgakalpanamahiyajñopavītāṃ tāmāsurīṃ saṃsmarāmyahamgṛhītvā tu sapañcāṅgamāsurīṃ mantreyacca tāmmadhvāktāmāsurīṃ hutvā sahasraṃ vaśayejjagatnāryāḥ pratikṛtervāmapādādihavanaṃ caretp. 592) dāsavajjāyate sādhyastriliṅgo hyapi tadvaśenāmayuṅmanunā hutvā jvariṇaṃ kurute ripumarkadugdhāktataddhomānnetranāśaḥ [riporiti sambandhimahimnā bodhyaḥ ||] prajāyatekṣattriyaṃ tu guḍābhyaktarājikābhirvaśaṃ nayetśūdro lavaṇayugghomātpratyahaṃ sāṣṭakaṃ śatamāsurīsamidho hutvā madhvaktā labhate nidhimāvāhya cāsurīṃ tatra pūjayedupacārakaiḥtenābhiṣikto bhavati vyādhyādhibhyāṃ vivarjitaḥāsuryāścāpi puṣpāṇi priyaṃgu ca samaṃsamamguñjānibhā [kāryā itiśeṣaḥ | agre ca tāsāṃ madhye ekāpi guṭikā yasya śirasi nyastā sa tasya vaśavartītyarthaḥ ||]yasya mūrdhni sthāpitaikā vaśastu saḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ yāmyābhimukho mārayedarīnsarvepi kuṇṭhitā mantrā nāsurī parameśvarītāraṃ vaṃ varuṇāyeti jalādhipataye vadetaoṃ mamādyairnamontaiśca pañcāgaṃ pañcabhiḥ padaiḥtundilaśca prasannāsyo varuṇo nidhidostu me
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japedvarṇasahasraṃ tu homaḥ padmākṣakaiḥ smṛtaḥgodāvarīṃ ca kālindīṃ samudrāstadanantarammahāpadmaḥ śaṅkhapālaḥ kulikoṣṭadale tataḥprayogāścātra siddhyanti devamantroditāḥ pareyasyopāsanato vaśyaṃ mṛtyuḥ kāśyāṃ prajāyatenama oṃ tithivarṇoyaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥmantrārṇaiḥ syātṣaḍaṅgāni [mūloktasaṃkhyākrameṇa nimnalikhitanyāsā vidheyāste yathā - oṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ, aiṃ hrīṃ śirase svāhā, śrīṃ klīṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭa, oṃ maṃ kavacāya hum, maṇikarṇike netratrayāya vauṣaṭ, namaḥ oṃ astrāya phaṭ ||] dhyāyettāṃ paścimāmukhīmśvetavastrāvṛtāṃ tryakṣāṃ dhyāyedbaddhāñjaliḥ parāmlikhedaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu ṣaḍdalamvidhiṃ sūryaṃ parvateśaṃ menāṃ cāpi bhagīrathammakarāṃścāpi haṃsāṃśca tathā kāraṇḍavānapiindrādīṃścāpi vajrādīnmantroyaṃ dakṣamārgiṇāmmantroyaṃ mṛtyukāle tu kāśyāṃ muktiprado dhruvambhavedyasya prasādena tāraṃ maṃ maṇikarṇikeupāsanādhyānapūjāḥ svīyāmnāyena kalpayetpuraścaryāprayogādi pūrvamantrasamaṃ matampañcāmnāyaistatkrameṇa copāsyaṃ siddhikārakammiliyugmaṃ ca gaṅge māṃ pāvayadvitayaṃ dviṭhaḥtrivedāṅgāgniṣaṇnetrairmantrārṇairaṅgakalpanam [tricatuṣaṭtriṣaḍdvimantravarṇairnyāsāḥ kāryāḥ tegre darśyante - oṃ namo hṛdayāya namaḥ, bhagavati śirase svāhā, aiṃ hili hili mili mili śikhāyai vaṣaṭ, gaṃge māṃ kavacāya hum, pāvayapāvaya netratrayāya vauṣaṭ, svāhā astrāyaphaṭ ||]abhayaṃ kalaśaṃ vāmakarayormakarasthitāmnānālaṅkāraśobhāḍhyāṃ prasannavadanāṃ bhajetilājyābhyāṃ bhaveddhomo mantroyaṃ bhuktimuktidaḥūrdhvāmnāyena sādhyaḥ syātṣaḍaṅgāni śaraiḥ kṛtaiḥsarvapāpakṣayakaro bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥtāro namaḥ śivāyai ca nārāyaṇyai padaṃ vadet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vedavyāso muniśchandaḥ kṛtirgaṅgā ca devatānikhilaṃ pūrvavatkuryānnikhilābhīṣṭado manuḥoṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hṛdbhagavati gaṅge ca dayite namaḥtridvyabdhīṣudvidvivarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥvarṇalakṣaṃ japeddhomaḥ prāgvatsammatkarastvayamhilidvandvaṃ milidvandvaṃ gaṅge devi namastathātridvidvyakṣiyugadvyarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥnarmadāyai nama iti ṣaḍarṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥp. 595) lasaddhastāṃ svarṇakāntiṃ sālaṅkārāṃ bhajāmyahamṣaḍaṅgāni [ekaikākṣarairhṛdayādinyāsāḥ yathā-nahṛdayāya namaḥ rmaśirase svāhā, dā śikhāyai vaṣaṭ ityādi ||] ca mantrārṇaiḥ prajapedvarṇasaṅkhyayāiha saukhyaṃ paratrāpi śivaloke mahīyatesarasvatītaṭe japtāstvaritaṃ siddhidāyakāḥgaṅgāśabdasya pūrve te godāyā manavaḥ smṛtāḥśrīkṛṣṇakheladyunadi trāhi māṃ tvaṃ bhavārṇavātchandonuṣṭupṣaḍaṅgāni pādārdhārdhakrameṇa catilājyābhyāṃ hunenmantrī bhāskariṃ naiva vīkṣateamukadvīpāvarakāmukadravyodadhe vadetsamudramantra uddiṣṭaḥ sindhudvīpo munirmataḥpadairmanoḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni tattadrūpaṃ vicintayettattadantargataṃ vastu labhate sādhako dhruvamtāraṃ [oṃ yaṃ vāyave prāṇādhipataye kṛṣṇavarṇāyāṃkuśahastāya mṛgavāhanāya namaḥ ||] yaṃ vāyave prāṇādhipataye padaṃ vadetya namo godvivarṇoyaṃ vāyumantra udīritaḥpañcāṅgāni manorasya oṃ yaṃ bījādikaiḥ padaiḥpāśāṃkuśakarampretakṛtyāparisarānvitamsiddhamantrastu tatkālambhavedbhūmau balādhikaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 596) yasya vijñānamātreṇa nāsādhyambhuvanatrayebhayaṃkari tathā huṃ ca ṣoḍaśārṇo mato manuḥsiṃhavaktrā mahākṛtyā bhītidoktā ca devatāśikhākavacanetrāstraṃ punarevaṃ prakalpayetdaṃṣṭrākarālavadanāṃ trinetrāṃ sarvatojvalāmtriśūlacakracaṣakakhaṭvāṅgakarapaṃkajāmmāraṇe kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ ca kṛṣṇapuṣpāmbarāvṛtāmpūrvasmiñchāṃkarīṃ nāma śubhravarṇāmbarāvṛtāmdakṣiṇe mārikāṃ nāma lambajihvāmadhomukhīmcaturbhujāṃ siṃhanādāṃ jvalacchūlakapālinīmpaścime vāruṇīṃ nāma svarṇavarṇāṃ hasanmukhīmudīcibhītikāṃ nāma caturvaktrāṃ bhayaṃkarāmtataḥ prayoge kurvīta sveṣṭaṃ sa ca nigadyatevarṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ nityamaṣṭottaraṃ śatamsarvakṛtyāṃ bhīṣaṇīṃ ca śrīmatīṃ ca pratiṣṭhitāmtasyādho mekhalāyuktaṃ trikoṇaṃ vahnikūcakamvibhītakaparidhyā ca kalpayedyasya māraṇamp. 597) dārayainaṃ śoṣayainaṃ mārayetyabhidhāya cahomānte vidhivatkṛtyāmārādhyāgneśca sannidhaubhuṃkṣva kravyamasṛk tasya pibetyuktvā nivedayetjuhvantiṣṭhati yāvatsa tāvadasya ripormṛtiḥjale saṃloḍya mantreṇa ripuṃ dhyātvā niruddhadṛknavarātrottare śatrurmriyate nātra saṃśayaḥjuhvato mriyate śatruḥ satyamauśanasaṃ matamphaṭkāraṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā śivanirmālyake kṣipet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sadyovagāhanaṃ kṛtvā tasyāmeva vicakṣaṇaḥṣaṇmāsānmriyate śatruḥ sandhyayorubhayorapiuṣṭrāsthnā ca śavāṅgāraiḥ śatroruccāṭanaṃ bhavetannaiḥ samidbhiḥ pālāśaiḥ śāntiṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥmadhuratrayasaṃsiktairebhiḥ kuryācca vaśyakammahāvyādhipraśamanaṃ nityamaṣṭottaraṃ śatammanasā cintayetkṛtyāṃ gajārūḍhāmibhadravīmcauravyāghramṛgādīnāṃ salilāderbhayāpahammedhāvī ca bhavedvāgmī tāvajjāpābhiṣekataḥp. 598) pakṣammāsaṃ dvimāsaṃ vā ṣaṇmāsaṃ vatsaraṃ tu vākṛtyāṃ samarcayeddhaste yathā vidhipuraḥsaramtanmadhyeṣṭadalaṃ nyasya yakārādīnnyasetkramātcandrabimbaṃ likhetpadmaṃ tasyordhvaṃ pratimāṃ likhetkumbhamadhye nyasetkṛtyāṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutāmparitoṣya ca tānnyasyedasitāṅgādibhairavānlokeśāntaṃ yajeddevi tadagre homamācaretkumbhamadhye nyaseddevīṃ dakṣiṇe tu śriyaṃ smaretayutaṃ mūlamantrantu japenmṛtyuvināśanammahāśāntikare [yasmāt iti śeṣaḥ ||] loke duḥkhadāridryanāśanaḥyakṣāya [yakṣāya kuberāya vaiśravaṇāya dhanadhānyādhipataye dhanadhānyasamṛddhiṃ me dehi dāpaya svāhā ||] ca kuberāya vadedvaiśravaṇāya casamṛddhiṃ me dehi vadeddāpayāgnipriyāntakaḥchandastu bṛhatī [yakṣāya hṛdayāya namaḥ kuberāya śirase svāhā, vaiśravaṇāya śikhāyai vaṣaṭ, dhanadhānyādhipataye kavacāya hum, dhanadhānyasamṛddhiṃ me netratrayāya vauṣaṭ, dehi dāpaya svāhā astrāyaphaṭ ||] tryabdhīṣvaṣṭāṣṭāgaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakamvaraṅgadāñca dadhatantundilaṃ yakṣasevitamdharmādipīṭhe prayajedaṅgalokeśahetikambilvamūlopaviṣṭena japto lakṣaṃ dhanarddhidaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīṃ-hrīṃ-klīṃ-oṃ ca viṃ vitteśvarāya nama ityapip. 599) pañcākṣibhyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ syāddhyānapūjādi pūrvavatsvāhāntaiḥ praṇavādyaiśca pañcabhirmantravarṇakaiḥhastābhyāṃ bibhrataṃ kharvakarapādaṃ ca tundilamsevanādasya bhavati yakṣiṇyādyāstathā vaśepraṇavaṃ haṃ samuccārya ceśānāya vadettataḥvarṇoya śūlahastāya ṅentaśca vṛṣavāhanaḥoṃ hamādyairnamontaiśca pañcāṅgaṃ paṃcābhaḥ padaiḥbhavanti naiva phaladā yathā nārī naraṃ vināubhayopāsanaṃ devi bhuktimuktipradāyakamgaṇeśena sarasvatyā yakṣiṇyādyābhirātmanaḥvāme tu bhairavairmaṃntraiḥ śeṣāmnāyeṣvayaṃ manuḥtāraṃ pāśaṃ brahmaṇe ca lokādhipataye vadetnamontobāṇarāmārṇo mantroyaṃ parikīrtitaḥnāsya pūjāvidhiḥ prāyo japosya parikīrtitaḥna tatra mama śāposti śāpaḥ kevalapūjanegauravarṇāyātalādisaptalokeśvarāya caekacatvāriṃśadarṇo mantronantasya kīrtitaḥp. 600) dugdhaṃ hutvāthaviprendrānbhojayecca caturdaśarājyabhraṣṭa iyādrājyaṃ vidyākāmastu paṇḍitaḥevamuktā dikpamantrāḥ kimanyacchrotumicchasiitiśrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte daśadigīśamantraprakāśaścaturviṃśaḥtathā dīpasya me mantraṃ phalañca kṛpayā vadaādau gaṇeśadīpastu kāryākāryavinirṇayemohoccāṭau dveṣaṇañca teṣu dīpañcaretkramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛṣṇanīlāruṇāraktaharitkapiśasūtrakaiḥsammukhantu mukhaṃ kuryātsādhakaḥ svasvakarmaṇimahiṣyājyamumātailaṃ vasātailaṃ kusumbhajamdīpasya diśamārabhya gaṇeśaṃ tatra pūjayetlambodaraśca vikaṭo vighnanāśo vināyakaḥdvādaśaitāni nāmāni yaḥ paṭhecchruṇuyādapietānatra yajedvidvānpaścāddīpaṃ pradāpayettiryakkampena kāryaṃ syātsamyagjyotiṣi satvaramjātāṃ devagaṇe kanyāṃ kumāraṃ vā samānayetp. 601) adhastātsthāpeyatpūtaṃ vistīrṇaṃ kāsyabhājanamkāryānusāraṃ sā paśyetputtalīnāṃ ca kautukamkṛtena yena vighnaugho vilayaṃ yāti mantriṇaḥekīkṛtya vidhatavyo dīpaḥ susnigdhaśobhanaḥgavyamājyañca kausumbhaṃ tailaṃ vā dīpakarmaṇiharidrayā raktavastraṃ paridhāya śuciḥ kṣamīuttarāsammukho bhūtvā haridrāliptabhūtaleghṛtamāpūrya vartiṃ ca dīpaṃ prajvālayetsudhīḥsaṃkalpanyāsapūrvaṃ tu japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatamkṣobhayetstambhayeccāpi dveṣayetprakṣipedapitāraṃ māyāṃ ramāṃ kāmammāyāṃ lakṣmīṃ ca vāgbhavambaṭuketi imaṃ dīpaṃ gṛhāṇa padamuccaretduṣṭānnāśaya yugmañca trāsayadvitayaṃjapetsvāhā phaṭ ṣaṣṭhivarṇoyaṃ dīpamantra udāhṛtaḥtena vartiḥ prakartavyā mantrārṇamitasūtrakaiḥpaścātkuryāttu sādhye tu kāryaproktantu dīpakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: asādhyenaiva kartavyo dīpastrāsaprado bhavettadeva sarvaṃ vijñeyaṃ dvipalaṃ pātra mucyatekāryantu dvividhaṃ proktaṃ śubhaṃ cāsubhameva cap. 602) tatrocyate bhairavasya dhyānaṃ śvetaṃ caturbhujamdhyātvā mukuṭamauliṃ ca śvetakaupīnavāsasamvairiṇāṃ duḥkhajanakamaśubhaṃ māraṇādikekiṅkiṇīmālayā yuktaṃ trinetraṃ ca bhayānakaṃvaraṃ kapālaṃ dadhataṃ dhyāyettaṃ krūravigrahamkartavyaṃ kuḍavagrāhi śodhayecchvetaparvatamdīpapātraṃ sādhakastu bhairavaṃ kavacaṃ paṭhettisraḥ pañca tathā sapta vartayaḥ kāryagauravātuttarābhimukhaḥ śāntau prāṅmukhaḥ pauṣṭike mataḥmahattrikoṇakasyordhvaṅkoṇeṣvasya ca saṃlikhetlikhedaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ dīpayantramudāhṛtampuṣpaṃ vāsitatailaṃ vā sarvakāmaphalapradamtairnirmitandīpapātraṃ sarvakāmaphalapradamnikaṭe bhairavasyāpi śālagrāmasya sannidhauaśvatthatarumūle ca sarvakamasamṛddhayemadhyameṣṭāṃśarahitaiḥ sādhyeṣṭāviṃśasammitaiḥśatatrayeṇa kartavyā laghukārye śatena tudīpaṃ kuryānnṛpadvāre varṣātsyānmahatī ramāpathikāgamanārthantu tilatailena dīpakamvarṇataścaiva dhavalaṃ vighnamārgādikaṃ jayetrājadvāre careddīpaṃ vartiḥ kauśumbharaktikāhanumatsannidhau dīpo vartiḥ kausumbharaktikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vahnerjvālānirāsāya hṛnmantreṇa kuśaistataḥkuśairastramantritaiḥ kuṇḍabhittiṣuproktāḥ saṃskārā dhṛtisammitāḥsaṃskārā ādyāścatvāra eva hiprāṅmukhāgrāṇāṃ devā viṣṇvīśavāsavāḥvilikheddarbhakāṇḍena vāmamārgestramantrataḥviṣṇvīśavāsavādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ tatra tu pūjanampraṇavenātha yogapīṭhaṃ samarcayettasyordhvaṃ śaktiyuktaṃ vicintayetśvetadvīpaṃ tatra cintyaṃ sudhāsindhusuveṣṭitamkalpavṛkṣāṃśca tatraiva ciṃtayetpūjayedapitanmadhye tasya pādānvicintayetaiśvaryamapi cāṅgāni pīṭhasyoktāni tatra tutasyoktā vikāramayakesarāḥpāvakasya maṇḍalatritayaṃ tataḥantarātmayutaścātmā paramātmā tataḥ paramvidyātattvaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ yogapīṭhamitīritampūjayedetā jayāñca vijayāṃ tathādogdhrīmaghorāñca tathā maṅgalāmatha tatra tukuṇḍe pūjayedbhuvaneśvarīmtatra devīmṛtumatīṃ tathāsaure lakṣmīmṛtumatīṃ smaretvipragehādvā dadyādagniṃ kumārikācāpihite tāmrapātrādike śubhepātregniṃ kavacena vidhāya ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dīpaṃ dadyānmāraṇārthaṃ rājadvāre piturgṛheśatrormṛtyukare kārye vartiḥ syātkṛṣṇatantubhiḥvartiśca kṛṣṇasūtrasya rājadvāre caredimamcatuṣpathe dīpadānaṃ vartiḥ syādatra karburāpradīpe tilatailaṃ syānnṛpadvāre caredimamdurgāyāḥ sannidhau deyā raktasūtraiśca vartikādīpañca saṅgame dadyādvartitriguṇarūpikāmpātraṃ ca mṛṇmayaṃ kuryāddīpadāne catuṣpatheśailakūle devatāyāḥ sannidhau dīpamācaretmāhiṣeṇa ghṛtenaiva pātraṃ narakapālajamśvetāṃ vartiṃ goghṛtena caturthyāṃ tu samācaretpātre tu tāmraje dīpaṃ dhūmravarṇāṃ tu vartikāmśubhāśubhādicihnāni yaiḥ kāryākāryanirṇayaḥpūrṇā pādonitārdhā ca pādatulyātha vartikāmadhyamaṃ nīlakaṇṭhādeḥ śrīkīrtivijayapradamaṣṭabhirdivasaistasya kāryasiddhirna saṃśayaḥp. 604) kṛṣṇā jvālā tadā śatroḥ kāryaṃ naiva prajāyateyadā caracareddīpaḥ kāryaṃ naṣṭaṃ tadā bhavetdīpavaryeṣu taddīpanayanānmandanetratāetaddīpavidhānaṃ tu baṭukasya prakīrtitampātre trikoṇe śaktyarthaṃ dīpadānaṃ prakalpayetūrdhvāmnāye piṣṭapātraṃ kācapāṣāṇasambhavamnṛkapālaṃ vāmagānāṃ kramādvai goghṛtaṃ tathāśvetaraktaharitpītakṛṣṇasūtrāstu vartikāḥdevāgāre sarittīre rājagehe catuṣpathe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gaṇeśavatparīkṣātra kāryākāryavinirṇayesarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvopadravanāśanambilvapatrodbhavaṃ pātraṃ dadyaddīpaṃ śivālayetasya vaṃśe na dāridryaṃ nākālamaraṇaṃ bhavetpaścime vṛṣṭaye deyaḥ śeṣakāryeṣu cottaretilatailenābhicāre tāratamyaṃ vicārayetkuryātsvarṇamaye pātre tadabhāvepi tāmrakedvādaśāṃguladīrghā sā kuḍavantu ghṛtaṃ smṛtamghṛtaṃ prajvālya śāntaścedroganāśastadā dhruvamkalpayeddīpadravyasya mānaṃ lokānusārataḥsarvakāmo goghṛtena māraṇaṃ māhiṣeṇa catāmrajaṃ lohajaṃ kācaṃ kramāttriṣu ca karmasuduḥsvapnotpātabhūtāni naśyantyacyutadīpataḥgopanīyaṃ prayatnena na vācyaṃ yasya kasyacitmantravarṇasya divase kramāddīpamprakalpayetyāvajjvalati dīposau tāvattasya manuṃ japetpunardīpe kṛte yā tu dīpaṃ saṃpaśyati sphuṭātadādidevatā tuṣṭā guptametatprakāśitamtantreṣu taddīpavidhirbahudhā samprakīrtitaḥataḥ paraṃ yadiṣṭaṃ tvaṃ pṛccha tattacca māṃ pratiiti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śrīśivapraṇīte dīpavidhiprakāśaḥ pañcaviṃśaḥdaśāvatārāḥ śrīviṣṇostānsamastānvada prabhotasya mantrampravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradāyakamdvādaśākṣaramantroyaṃ munirbrahmā samīritaḥbhagavānsa ramānātho bījaṃ śrīṃ maṃ ca kīlakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ghanaśyāmaścaturbāhuḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥpadmacihnitasarvāṅgaḥ sundaraścārulocanaḥpratyahaṃ taddaśāṃśena vaiśākhe kārtike tathāārabhya bhādrabahulāmaṣṭamīṃ ṣoḍaśāhakamp. 606) tathaiva homaḥ kartavyastathānyadivaseṣu tuādyantayoḥ śatānyaṣṭau tarpayecca tathā śriyamevaṃ kṛte caikavarṣānmaṃtrasiddhiḥ prajāyatebhojayetpūjanaṃ cāsya carettoyāśaye sadāṣaṭpatreṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni yajedbāhyacaturdaletadbāhyagadale pūjyāḥ kṣīrādyāḥ saptasindhavaḥtasya bāhye śakradale ratnāni tu caturdaśagaṅgādyāḥ ṣoḍaśa tato pūjayecca mahāpagāḥdigīśāṃśca tadastrāṇi navāvaraṇapūjanametaṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ mantrañjapedaṣṭottaraṃ śatamakuṇṭhitaḥ prayogeṇa na punastasya saṃskṛtiḥetatsampuṭitāḥ sarve vaidikāḥ siddhidāḥ kalaugāṇeśā vaiṣṇavāḥ saurāḥ siddhiṃ dadyurvidarbhitāḥtasmātprokto nānyatantre merutantre prakāśitaḥekaḥ kūrmāvatārobhūnmathyamāne mahodadhaudhurandharāya natyantaḥ siddhavarṇo manuḥ smṛtaḥdevatā bhagavānviṣṇurjātaḥ kacchaparūpadhṛkniyogo devatādhyānaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharamdīrghagrīvaṃ mahāgrāhaṃ girantaṃ raktalocanamājyahomastarpaṇantu candanotpalavāribhiḥtadbāhye tu caturdikṣu madanaṃ babhrukaṃ [brahmāṇam ||] harim
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dharāṃ śeṣaṃ kṣīranidhiṃ maṇḍūkaṃ devatādrumambhūpure tasya bāhye tu hetayo vā samīritāḥśmaśāne kūrmacakrasya śatrunāmādivargataḥrājikāpratimāṃ kuryācchatrupāṃśusamanvitāmādau vāmaṃ tato dakṣaṃ striyā caitadviparyayātpārṣṇigulphakajaṃghoruyugaṃ sakthiyugaṃ tathākaṭitrikaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ hunetpārśvadvayaṃ tataḥrekhāsthānāni coccārya maṇibandhaprakoṣṭhakauhanudvayaṃ tathā coṣṭhau cordhvādhaḥsthaṃ radadvayamnetre bhrūmadhyakaṃ bhālaṃ brahmarandhramiti kramātna brāhmaṇe prayoktavyā yatosau viṣṇudaivatamharidrayā kṛtaṃ cedaṃ stambhayedakhilaṃ jagatśmaśānasya mṛdoccāṭe godhūmairvaśyatā bhavetsatkārye prajapenmantraṃ siddhiḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥkalpajātāścaturvarṇā avatārā ramāpateḥrūpāya bhūrbhuvaḥ suvaḥ pataye bhūpatīti caṛṣyādyā bhārgavānuṣṭubvarāhāḥ parikīrtitāḥp. 608) māṃvyolkāya namaḥśīrṣe tejodhipataye namaḥmahādaṃṣṭrāya ca namostrametatpallavānvitamnyāsaḥ keśavamātrākhyo nyāso nityastu vaiṣṇaveānābhikarpūranibhaṃ nābhitastu galāvadhiśaṅkhārikhaḍgāṃśca gadāṃ varaśaktī tathaiva cavāgīśāṃ huṃkṛtau bāhvoścandrasūryau śivaṃ mukhedaṃṣṭrāyāṃ tasya vasudhāṃ dikpatreṣu yajetkramātpunaḥ koṇeṣu pūjyāni rakṣaḥprācyantarāntimam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gadā śaktiṃ varaṃ caiva cāpaṃ bāhyeṣu dikpitīnlakṣaṃ japecca padmāni svādvaktāni ca homayetathāsyānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyatedaśāṃśaṃ juhuyādagnau puraścaraṇavānbhavetdhanadhānyadharālakṣmyo bhavantyatra na saṃśayaḥvāruṇe mṛtyutaḥ śāntirāgneye jvaravaśyatāathātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi maṇḍaladhyānamadbhūtamnandyāvartāṃśca koṇeṣu cintayedbhumimaṇḍalamvāruṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śvetaṃ madhye vaṃbījalāñchitamtaijasaṃ maṇḍalaṃ proktaṃ dhyeyaṃ bhāvukasattamaiḥsamīramaṇḍalaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ dhyeyaṃ sadā janaiḥnīlavarṇaṃ mahāśūnyamanāhataravaṃ smaretp. 609) pañcagavyaparikṣiptāṃ japitāmayutena caśatrūṇāṃ sannirodho hi kṣetraṃ cāsya vinaśyativairiruddhādapi kṣetrānmṛdamānīya yatnataḥpākapāṃtraṃ dvitīyaṃ ca payasyanne tathāparamtatra devaṃ yathāvacca dhūpadīpādibhiryajetevaṃ bhaumāṣṭavāreṣu kuryānniyatadhīḥ kramātahno mukhe bhaumavāre mṛdaṃ saṃgṛhya pūrvavatbaliṃ ca dadyātkṣetrasya virodho naśyati kṣaṇātsaptabhirdivasaiścātra ḍākinīvikṛtiṃ haretaṣṭādhikaśataṃ mantrī śālibhirdviniśaṃ sudhīḥanena juhuyādājyaṃ sahasraṃ pratyahaṃ naraḥsahasraṃ svādusaṃyuktairvāsasāṃ siddhirucyatejinādikṣetramāsādya vādinaḥ prajayetsadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ kṛte tatastasya bhūmivādo vinaśyatiaṅgāravāre prajapetkṣetraṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇamvindate mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ śamayetsarvakaṇṭakānmahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti mahārājo bhavatyalamsaptadvīpānavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇāāmraparṇairhutenityaṃ jvaraśāntiḥ prajāyateevamprokto varāhasya manuḥ sarvārthasiddhidaḥoṃ bhūrvarāhāya namo munirbrahmā samīritaḥpadaiḥ samastamantreṇa pañcāṅgāni prakalpayetpṛthvīśaktiyutaṃ dhyāyecchaṃkhacakrāmbujaṃ [dadhānamiti śeṣaḥ] gadāmcarmāsimadbhiśca kalau drutasiddhipradāyakamevammanuṃ yaḥ prabhajetsa bhavecca dharāpatiḥhayagrīvo muniḥ proktaśchandonuṣṭup ca devatāprāgvaddhyāyedraktavarṇaṃ pūjādyaṃ pūrvavadbhavetpītavarṇaṃ sadādhyāyeddvāpare drutasiddhidamkramādvakṣye hi tanmantrānvarāhasya priyānatidhṛṣe svāheti mantroyamūnaviṃśativarṇakaḥtryabdhitrīṣudvidvivarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥdharāmpadmāsanāṃ dhyāyennānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitāmtato yajedaṣṭadale pūrvataḥ kuṃ ca bhūkalāḥindrādīṃścāpi vajrādīniti pūjāvidhiḥ smṛtaḥvidhinā tena saṃsiddhe manau kāmyāni kārayetiṣṭāṃ bhuvamavāpnoti tadvannīlotpalairhunetbahudhānyadharāśrīṇāṃ satyambhavati bhājanamdharāpatirbhavenmantrī maṇḍalena na saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śuddhatoye samāloḍya tāṃ ca tatra paceccarummāsaṣaṭkaṃ bhṛgorvāre hyevaṃ kṛtvā labheddharāmoṃ-mahīṃ [oṃ glauṃ namaḥ bhagavatyai dharāyai dharaṇi dharedhare svāhā glauṃ hrīṃ oṃ m ||] glauṃ namaḥ procya bhagavatyai padaṃ vadetglauṃ hrīṃ tāraṃ samuccārya caturviṃśākṣaro manuḥeṣa uktastu vārāho mantraḥ siddhokhileṣṭadaḥṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥsarvaṃ prāgvatṣaḍaṅgāni dīrghaṣaṭkānvitena capratimanvantaraṃ vāyamavatāro harerbhavetākalpaṃ vidyate tatra bhaktānugrahakārakaḥdvātriṃśadarṇako gopyo bhuktimuktiprado mataḥnṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ rudraṃ? mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyahamprathamo nyāsa uddiṣṭaḥ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakaḥṣaḍaṅgākhyo dvitīyoyamaṅganyāsa udāhṛtaḥdakṣiṇe bāhumūle ca tanmadhye maṇibandhaketanmadhye maṇibandhe cāṃgulīmūle tadantakekaṇṭhe hṛdi tathā nābhau dakṣapārśve ca vāmaketṛtīyo nyāsa uditaḥ sākṣāddevamayo bhavetvāmāṃ kaniṣṭhāmārabhya vāmāṃguṣṭhāvadhi nyasetp. 612) pātakaṃ turya udito nyāsoṃgulyādikaḥ paraḥnayane nayanādhaśca kapole karṇamūlakekaṇṭhe nābhau bhuje dakṣe vāme ca hṛdaye staneliṅge corau tathā jānau jaṅghāyāṃ cāpi guhyakesarvāṅge romakūpeṣu raktahṛtpalalāsthiṣuayantu pañcamo nyāsaḥ sarvāriṣṭanivārakaḥūrvoḥ kaṭidvaye nābhau hṛhi bāhvostathā gale
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pādādivarṇanyāsoyaṃ pañcamaḥ parikīrttitaḥhṛdi nābhau kaṭau jānvoḥ pādayoḥ kramato nyasetasminnyāse kṛte dehe rogaiḥ sthātuṃ na śakyatebāhvoścaraṇayornyasyenmantrārṇānācatuṣkakamdharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ dāyako nātra saṃśayaḥpādanyāsoṣṭamaścāyaṃ siṃhavyāghrabhayāpahaḥarddhanyāsoyamudito navamoghasamūhahṛtante brūyānnavasthāne nyasedāsye ca mastakenābhau kaṭyādipādāntaṃ nyāsoyaṃ daśamaḥ smṛtaḥnamāmyahaṃ tataḥ procya navasvaṅgeṣu vinyasetayamekādaśo nyāso nṛhareratipāvanaḥnyāsaścāṣṭavidhopyevamūnaviṃśaprakārakaḥp. 613) nābherhṛdayaparyantaṃ nyasedvarṇacatuṣṭayammūrddhādipādaparyantaṃ cintayennṛhariṃ vibhumevaṃ viṃśatiruddiṣṭā nyāsānāṃ pātakāpahātatkālaṃ kurute kopaṃ vikṣiptaṃ kurute jagatnyāsairbhavati nāśo'taḥ sarvanyāsānsamācaretgrasantaṃ daityarājānaṃ kṛśānūpamatejasāsuraiśca munibhirlakṣmyā kṛtāñjalikayā śubhamvāmāṅge nṛhareḥ pūjyā lakṣmīrbhūṣaṇabhūṣitāāśliṣyantī śāntimūrtistatoṅgāni prapūjayettṛtīyeṣṭadale pūjyaṃ nṛsiṃhānāntathāṣṭakamnṛsiṃhastambhanākhyaṃ tu śvetamprācyāṃ samarcayetbāṇacāpadharaṃ lakṣmyā sevitammakaradhvajamvidveṣoccāṭanakaraṃ nīlotpalasamaprabham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viprāṇāṃ puṣṭidaṃ netratritayālaṃkṛtānanamgadāṃ nidhiṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ lakṣmyā yuktaṃ nidhipradampāśāṃkuśasphuradbāhuṃ śaṃkhacakradharamprabhumlakṣmyā yuktaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ pūjayetsādhakaḥ sadāśaṃkhaṃ kheṭaṃ gadāṃ śārṅgaṃ pūjayeddevavāmataḥlakṣmīdakṣiṇatastuṣṭiṃ vāme tatraiva kaustubhampītāmbaraṃ brahmasūtraṃ nābhipadmaṃ kirīṭakamṣaṣṭhīśraddhādibhiḥ śraddhā medhā tuṣṭiśca kārmukāevaṃ sampūjya vidhivatsādhakobhīṣṭamāpnuyāttatsahasraṃ prajuhuyādghṛtāktahaviṣānalekuryātsaṃsiddhamantrastu prayogānācarettataḥudyatsahasrārkabhāsaṃ trinetrambhīṣaṇākṛtimnakhairdāritadaityeśaṃ raktadhārāktakāyakamviśvarūpamayaṃ dhyānaṃ nṛhareḥ procyatedhunāantramālādharaṃ raudraṃ kaṇṭhe hāreṇa śobhitamcandramauliṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ prativaktre trilocanamakṣasūtraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ śaṅkhaṃ gokṣīrasannibhamkhaḍgaṃ śūlaṃ ca bāṇaṃ ca nṛhariṃ rudragopanamevamugrahariṃ dhyāyetsarvavyādhinivṛttayenṛsiṃhaḥ sarvalokeśaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥśaṃkhacakradharau ramyāvanyau bāṇadhanurdharaupāśāṃkuśadharāvanyau dvau ripormukuṭārpitaudhyāyedambujanīlābhamugrakarmaṇyananyadhīḥnṛsiṃhaḥ sarvabhūṣāḍhyaḥ sarvasiddhikaraḥ prabhuḥhalaṃ ca musalaṃ samyagabhayaṃ cāṃkuśantathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāmabhāgakaraiḥ śaṃkhaṃ khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ ca śūlakamkaradvandvaiḥ kramācchatrorjānumastakapattalamadhaḥsthitābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ hiraṇyakavidāraṇamnṛsiṃhaṃ saṃsmarennityaṃ mahāmṛtyubhayāpahamviṣarogabhiyāṃ mṛtyorharaṃ śatrubhayāpahamsumukhaṃ vidyudābhāsaṃ netratrayavirājitamapamṛtyumahākṛtyānāśakaṃ nṛhariṃ smaretayutaṃ madhurādyaiśca daridro na bhavetkalauapūpalakṣahomena dhanadena samo bhavetsadyo nairmalyamāpnoti prasādaṃ cādhigacchatimadhūkapuṣpahomena ceṣṭasiddhiḥ prajāyateśatahomena kālīnāṃ vaśīkaraṇamuttamambadarīphalahomena sarvavighnaḥ praṇaśyatijuhuyādayutaṃ yosau cirañjīvati vatsarānjapejjitvā sa mṛtyuṃ vai śatavarṣāṇi jīvatidūrvāhomādarogī syāllakṣmīvāñchrīphalairbhavetvaśitā prātarutthāya vāksiddhiṃ sā prayacchatiaṣṭottaraśataṃ nityaṃ dūrvābhirjuhuyātsudhīḥrakṣāṃ karoti duṣṭebhyo dustarebhyopi mantriṇaḥgadānanyānbhayotpātaduḥkhāni harate dhruvamkrūraṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ sañcintya śatruñca mṛgaśāvakamsabāndhavasya jhaṭiti tasyoccāṭaḥ prajāyatenakharairdīryamāṇaṃ taṃ saṃsmarenniśitairdrutambhavenmaṇḍalamadhyeyaṃ divākarasutātithiḥripusaṃghakṣayakaraṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ candanādibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuryādvyādhihānibhayāvahammūlamantreṇa sthāpayedagrataḥ sudhīḥpradīpakalikākāraṃ teja āvāhayettataḥsmṛtvāgnibījantenātha caitanyaṃ yojayettataḥśareṇātha kavacenāvaguṇṭhayettataḥ svasya saṃmukhaṃ svīyakuṇḍalejñātvā nikṣipedāśuśukṣaṇimprabhāṣyaiva kṛśānuṃ jvālayettataḥsuvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ sarvatomukhamdhamedagnimmukhādeṣa vyajāyatasuvinyasejjihvā dehe mantrairvibhāvasoḥjihvāstā vakṣyante trividhātmikāḥcātiraktā jihvāḥ sapteti sāttvikāḥpravinyasedbhūyo vahneraṅgāni vai kramātsaptajihvo dhanurdhara itīritāḥmūrddhāsyapārśvakaṭyaṃghrikaṭipārśvāṃsakeṣu cahavyavāhastṛtīyakaḥmūrtayoṣṭau prakīrtitāḥmekhaloparisaṃśuddhaiḥ punardarbhacatuṣṭayaiḥekamekhalake kuṇḍe mekhalādhaḥ paristaretsikatānāṃ tu bāhyabhūmau paristaretvidvānmadhyamāmekhalopariekavṛkṣodbhavānārdrānparidhīnbāhumātrakānsvagṛhyoktavidhānena vāyudeśācca pūrvataḥājyasthālīñca paridhīṃstathaiva kuśamuṣṭayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sahasramekaṃ ca manuṃ bhakṣayecchatrumutkaṭamjuhuyātsaptadivasāṃstato rājñaścamūṃ sudhīḥprasthāpayettāṃ sudṛḍhāṃ rakṣitāṃ balibhirnaraiḥbhakṣayantaṃ yajenmantrī kuryādāyāti sā camūḥāgacchedbhūpatiḥ śūraḥ paścānmantriṇamādarātmantriṇo yadi santoṣo na bhavedbhapatestadāathātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi dvitīyaṃ nṛhariṃ vibhumgāyatrī chanda uddiṣṭaṃ devatā nṛhariḥ smṛtaḥekalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥtarpayetkṣudrasalilaiḥ kṛtvā cātmābhiṣecanammantrarājoditānsarvānprayogānatra sādhakaḥvipārtamabhiṣiñceta mucyate hi viṣeṇa saḥbahupadbṛścikotthaiśca viṣairmukto bhaveddhruvamp. 617) śirokṣikarṇahṛtkukṣikaṇṭharogānvināśayetśamayedbhasmasaṃliptaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇāaṣṭādhikasahasrañca mriyate ripurasya hiayamekākṣaro mantraḥ proktassarvasamṛddhidaḥāṃ hrīṃ jroṃ kroṃ hrāṃ phaḍiti ṣaḍarṇo mantra īritaḥmantravarṇairaṅgaṣaṭkaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyennṛsiṃhakamsomasūryāgninetraśca nānāmaṇivibhūṣitaḥvajraṃ gadāṃ dārayantaṃ dvābhyāṃ daityeśvarodaramtasyāṃ sampūjya nṛhariṃ kuryādāvaraṇārcanamtadbāhye ṣaḍdaleṃ'ṅgāni tadastrāṇyaṣṭapatrakekhaḍgaṃ kheṭaṃ ca tadbāhye bhūpuraṃ tu digīśvarānlakṣaṣaṭkaṃ japenmantraṃ kevalena ghṛtena ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogānācarettataḥjuhuyācca sahasraikaṃ saptāhaṃ bhūtaśāntayecaturdinaṃ prajuhuyājjvaraśāntiḥ prajāyatemantrajāpī vatsareṇa dhanadhānyasamṛddhiyuksahasradvādaśamitaṃ hutvā sarvajanapriyaḥvarārthinī labhetāśu varaṃ sarvamanoharamkalatramitraputrādyairdhanadhānyasamanvitaḥjvālāmālaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ tu śatrubhūtādināśakamjvāleti māline dīptadaṃṣtāyāgnipadaṃ vadetbhūtavināśano ṅentaḥ sarvaghoravināśanaḥhuṃphaṭsvāheti mantroyaṃ ṣaṣṭiṣaṭkākṣaro mataḥviśvadigbhavadhṛtyāśāvedārṇaiḥ syātṣaḍaṅgakamśaṃkhaṃ cakramasiṃ kheṭaṃ dadhānaṃ daivataistutamlakṣaṃ japeddaśāṃśaṃ tu kapilāsarpiṣā hunetviśeṣatoyaṃ bhūtādijvarahā parikīrtitaḥmanvantare salakṣmīkaḥ sevyate yo gṛhasthitaiḥpramuditapadaṃ procya cetase ca tato vadetdevavarṇo manuḥ prokto japatāṃ sarvakāmadaḥmuniḥ prajāpatiḥ proktaḥ śrīṃbījena ṣaḍaṅgakampaścānnārāyaṇaḥ śaśvannīlajīmūtasannibhaḥgovindo dakṣiṇe pārśve dhanvī candraprabho mahānāgneyyāmaravindākṣo musalī madhusadanaḥvāyavyāṃ vāmano vajrī taruṇādityadīptimānvidyutprabho hṛṣīkeśo vāyavyāṃ diśi mūrdhanisarvāyudhaḥ sarvaśaktiḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sabāhyābhyantaraṃ dehaṃ vyāpya dāmodaraḥ sthitaḥpraviṣṭohaṃ na me kiñcidbhayamasti kadācanasarpendrabhāgeśayanaḥ sarpendrābhogachatravānpadmacakravarābhīti dharastryakṣenduśekharaḥaṅgāni ṣaḍdalebhyarcya śaktīścāṣṭadale yajetramā kāntirdhṛtiśceti bhūpure tu digīśvarānyaṣṭyuttaraṃ trilakṣaṃ ca prajapettatsahasrakamabhyarcya salile devaṃ tarpayenmantranāmataḥtataḥ prayogānkurvīta sādhako nijavāñchitānanuṣṭubuktāṃstatrāpi sarvānkuryādgṛhāśramīlakṣmyā saha nṛsiṃho yastanmantraṃ sarvakāmadammuniḥ prajāpatiśchando lakṣmīrvā nṛhariḥ suraḥdhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ ṣaḍakṣaravadīritampāyasairjuhuyāttatra mantratarpaṇamācaretjaya jayaśrīnṛsiṃha manuraṣṭākṣaro mataḥekārṇavatprayogāṃśca gṛhasthaḥ sādhayecchuciḥdaśāvatāro nṛharirdakṣasāvarṇikotra cetoṃ kṣauṃ ca matsyarūpāya oṃ kṣauṃ kuṃrmopi ṅentakaḥtaśā nṛsiṃharūpāya oṃkṣrauṃ vāmanatastathārūpāya oṃ-oṃ-oṃ-kṣrauṃ-kṣrauṃ-kṣrauṃ rāmāyeti kīrtayetnayaśabdadvayānte tu śālagrāmanivāsinepuruṣāya nama oṃ-kṣrauṃ ekonaśatavarṇakaḥdaśāvatāranṛharirdevatā sarvakāmadaḥmantrarājavadetasya dhyānapūjādikaṃ bhavetayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ sādhayeddhaviṣā tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāmyakarmāṇi sarvāṇi mantrarājavadeva hinṛsiṃharūpatāṃ prāpya jātāḥ sthāne nṛsiṃhakāḥjāyante koṭiśo mantrāḥ śūdrasiddhividhāyakāḥekaṃ śreyaskaraṃ proktaṃ nṛharernāmagarjanamnarasiṃho vīranāmā śṛṇu tatsādhanaṃ priyetāro namo bhagavate vīrānte nṛpadaṃ vadetpīnordhvāṅgāya cetyuktvā cāgninetrāya saṃvadetrakṣayugmaṃ ca hrīṃyugmaṃ rakṣarakṣāgnigehinīvarṇāṃstrayodaśa [oṃ namo bhagavate vīranṛsiṃhāya nīladīptadaṃṣṭrāya agni netrāya sarvarakṣoghnāya sarvabhūtavināśanāya sarvaghoravināśāya hanahana dahadaha pacapaca vadhavadha phaṭ svāhā ||] procya nīladīptapadaṃ vadetghnāyoktvā sarvabhūteti vaded ṅentaṃ vināśanamp. 621) pacayugmaṃ vadhayugmaṃ phaṭsvāhānto dvitīyakaḥsarvabhūteti samprocya ṅentaṃ caiva vināśanamrakṣoghnāya padaṃ coktvā hanadvandvaṃ dahadvayamhuṃ-phaṭ-svāhā tṛtīyoyaṃ mantraścātra samuddhṛtaḥmālāmantrā ime khyātā dvaitasiddhividhāyakāḥoṃ-kṣrauṃ mahānṛsiṃhāya namonto daśavarṇakaḥṣaḍdīrghayuksvabījena ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaretvarṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ prayogoṣṭākṣaroditaḥtrayodaśārṇa uddiṣṭo bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥdhyānapūjāprayogādi ṣaḍakṣaravadīritamkāśyāṃ sa nityaṃ vasate duṣṭabuddhipracārakaḥhuṃphaṭsvāhā conaviṃśavarṇo mantra udīritaḥsudarśananṛsiṃhosya devatā parikīrtitaḥjagaccakrāya ca śikhā kavacaṃ tvasya sammatamsudarśanāyeti manuḥ pañcāṅgaṃ samudīritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taptakāñcanasaṅkāśaṃ trinetraṃ cādyavigrahamp. 622) vidikṣvagre ca pañcāṅgaṃ kramāddikṣu prapūjayetsahasrāṃ siddhisañjñāṃ ca lokeśānāyudhāni cahunetpuṣpaistataścāpi catvāriṃśatsahasrakaiḥtarpaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā prayogānācaretpunaḥtasmindeśe samārādhya sudarśananṛsiṃhakam |sahasraṃ mūlamantreṇa hyapāmārgasamidvaraiḥdāsavatkurute śatrūnsarvānnāstyatra saṃśayaḥayutaṃ jayamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇātasyāgre vartule kuṇḍe hotavyājyādibhiḥ śamīmjayamāpnoti saṃgrāme nityamparaśurāmavattenāṃgulīyakaṃ kṛtvā japahomādisādhitamrājñaḥ sakāśātpūjāṃ ca labhate dhārayetsadāpunarnavāśiphāniṣkatrayaṃ lavaṇasaṃyutaṃkṛtvā sampūjayeddevaṃ rājayakṣmā praṇaśyatinetrarogaḥ sahasreṇa padmahomena naśyatidaśadhā japatoyena karakeṇaiva secayetsaptāhamadhyātsadyo hi nāśayettu visarpakānapasmārādikānsarvāngrahānanyānvināśayetyathāvaccintayettatra pūjayedupacārakaiḥtathā spṛśedvāmahastaṃ hyaṅgasparśādviṣaṃ haretjātaṃ trayodaśe devaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ kṣrauṃ tu sampuṭamasya pūjāprayogādyamekākṣarasamaṃ bhavetabhayākṣo nṛsiṃhoyaṃ samastabhayanāśanaḥtejastejasa ityuktvā āvirāvirbhaveti ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tamodvirgrasavahnistrīṃ vadedabhayamātmanimuniḥ śukotijagatī chandaḥ prāgvaddivākhilamtadatra kathitaṃ devi bhuktimuktipradāyakammanvantarantu pratyekaṃ sureśādapahṛtya vaiekamanvantare śakraḥ svayamevābhavadbaliḥoṃ [oṃ namo viṣṇave surapataye mahābalāya svāhā ||] namo viṣṇave brūyātsurānte pataye mahāmunirindurvirāṭ chando devatā caiva vāmanaḥbhrūmadhyakaṇṭhahṛdayanābhyaṃghryādhārakeṣu camūrdhni netradvaye karṇadvaye nasi mukhe tathājānvośca pādayoragnikāṣṭhāṅganyāsa īritaḥpāde pṛṣṭhe nyasedvarṇānvarṇanyāsoyamīritaḥpūrṇacandranibhaṃ dhyāyecchrībhūmyāśliṣṭapārśvakamvaiṣṇave pūjayatpāṭha tatra sūryāgnimaṇḍalemantro hyoṅkārahṛtpūrvaḥ svāhānto navavarṇakaḥtataḥ ṣaḍdalamadhye tu pūjayedvāmanaṃ vibhumpūṣā sumanasā prītiḥ puṣṭistuṣṭistathaiva caśaśinī subhagā caiva lakṣmīricchā tathaiva catataścāṣṭadale pūjet pūjādyairvāsudevakamdaśāśaṃ pāyasaṃ hutvā tarpaṇādi samācaretdaghyodanaṃ niśāpakvaṃ naivedyaṃ syādvibhūtikṛtsitānnaṃ ghṛtasammiśraṃ prāpnuyādannamakṣayamalakṣmīrnāśamāyāti [tasyetyavyāhāryam ||] mahatīṃ śriyamāpnuyātannaparvatamāpnoti yatrayatra sa gacchativasudhārāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ varṣādvarṣati tatra cajuhuyātpāyasaṃ mantrī sākṣādvāgīśvaro bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatkāṣṭhadīpite vahnau sa satputramavāpnuyāthunedayutasaṃkhyaiśca sarvatra vijayī bhavetdhyātvā caindrapadaṃ rājyaṃ labhetāśu hyakaṇṭakamayutaṃ sādhyanāmādyaṃ sa vaśyo bhavati dhruvamsaptāhānmucyate rogaistāvadevaṃ japetsudhīḥayutaṃ juhuyāttāvajjapedāyurlabhet vaip. 625) japānnirmuktabandhaḥ syādvāmanasya prasādataḥathātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi sarvajñeśvaravāmanamcyavano munirākhyāto gāyatraṃ chanda īritamdvāviṃśatyarṇakoṅgāni ṣaḍdīrghānvitakāmataḥprasannañca sunetrañca cārusmitamanoharamcintayejjagatāṃ nāthaṃ sarvasyārtiharaṃ harimkuryāttato mantrasiddhaḥ kāmyānsvābhīṣṭadāyakānsahasraṃ haviṣā homo lakṣmīdo dhānyalābhakṛtsahasrahomādbhītīnāṃ nāśo bhavati niścitamtraivikramaṃ vāmanasya rūpaṃ dhyāyenmanuṃ smaretmahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti yadyadanyadabhīpsitamtāro namo bhagavate viṣṇave ca daśākṣaraḥṛṣiḥ kapila ākhyāto gāyatraṃ chanda īritamtrivedatriṣubāṇadvimantrārṇairaṅgakalpanamsarvānbhogandadātyeṣa bhaktānāṃ bhogavāmanaḥetādṛśastu nāstyanyo janmanyasminphalapradaḥtāro hṛdayamāye ca bālakānte vidhe padamtryaṃkaṣaṭpañcapañcadvimantrārṇairaṅgakalpanamyajñopavītī nīlābho dhyātavyaśchadmavāmanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: annavidyābhūmidoyaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradaḥśrāddhānnaṃ karkaṭīṃ caiva bhakṣayenna kadācanatuṣakārpāsabījāni na spṛśecca kadācanaṃevaṃ yo niyamairyuktastasya mantraḥ prasidhyatitadagrime pūrvamantraḥ ṣaḍviṃśatyakṣaro manuḥsvāhā śaktirdevatā śrīmāyābālakavāmanaḥannavidyābhūmidoyaṃ bhaktānāmabhayaṅkaraḥtāro namo bhagavate vadecca balivāmanamtataḥ śrībījamābhāṣya trayoviṃśativarṇakaḥpadaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni śeṣaṃ pūrvavadīritamduṣṭakṣatratamodhvaṃsī reṇukodbhūtabhāskaraḥtanno rāmaḥ pracodayātaṣṭeṣutryakṣivedārṇairmanoḥ proktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakamstanayorbhujayoḥ pārśvadvayeṃ'ghryorvinyasetpadamke dṛśi śrotranāsāyāṃ kapole hanuvaktrayoḥnābhikaṭyorgude liṅge ūrvorvā jānujaṃghayoḥsāttvike śvetavarṇaṃ ca bhasmoddhulitavigrahampītāmbaradharaṃ kāmarūpaṃ bālānirīkṣitamāraktanetrakarṇasthabrahmasūtraṃ yamaprabhamcaturbāhuṃ musalinaṃ rājasaṃ kuddhameva cajamadagniṃ ca kālaṃ ca reṇukāṃ kāmamarcayetdikṣu vedānvidikpatreṣūpavedāṃstato yajetbrahmāstraṃ vaiṣṇavāstraṃ ca raudraṃ vāyavyameva caaindrapālikamastraṃ ca mahāpāśupataṃ tathākaśyapaṃ ca bharadvājaṃ viśvāmitraṃ ca gautamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yājñavalkyaṃ bhārgavaṃ ca ṣoḍaśāre tato yajetsāṃkhyaṃ pātañjalaṃ śilpaṃ vedāṅgāni ca ṣaṭ kramātsmṛtīstu bhūpurāgre ca digīśānāyudhāni cahunedbrāhmaṇabhojyāntaṃ kṛtvā siddho bhavenmanuḥsa eva jāyate siddho nānyavipraḥ kadācanalakṣaṃ prāgvaddhunedrāmaṃ sāttvikaṃ tatra cintayetviṣayārthaṃ dhanārthaṃ ca vāksiddhyarthamudāhṛtamsādhyakṛcchretikṛcchre ca daivasādhye tvasādhyakehomaḥ sarvatra vijñeyaḥ pratyavāyanirākṛtaumanāgapi na kartavyo brahmadveṣaḥ kadācanatilaudanājyaṃ rāmaṃ tu rājasaṃ tatra bhāvayetrakṣaṇaṃ syānmahāmārīśītalāśāntaye tathāp. 628) homaḥ sarṣapatailāktaistāmasaṃ cintayedvibhumevaṃ kuryādyamuddiśya tasya nāśo bhaveddhruvambhavedasya mahāpūjā tāṃ bhaktaḥ prayataścaretavaśyaṃ sa ripūñjitvā kuśalī svagṛhaṃ vrajetsa tu siddhiprado jñeyo nāsti tasya puraskriyāyantraṃ mantrotha vā vidyā tatsiddhaṃ nāsti saṃśayaḥkuladvayaviśuddhaṃ tu rāmamantrādhikāriṇamrāmabhaktaṃ pradṛṣṭvaiva trasyanti praṇamanti caśāntaṃ śatrumadaṃ kuryātkusumāni ca vai hunetsaptāhārvāktasya sainyaṃ naṣṭaṃ tāvanmitaṃ bhavetvarṣādarvāk tasya rāmaḥ pratyakṣo jāyate ddhruvamsūrpārake paurṇamāsyāṃ prayāge tu mṛge ravausūryyagrahe kurukṣetre rāmo gacchati sarvadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paraśvadhadharo dātā mātṛhā mātṛjīvakaḥgotrāṇakṛdgopradātā viprakṣatriyakarmakṛtnāpamṛtyurna dāridryaṃ naca vaṃśakṣayo bhavetrājyakṛtkalibhūpānāṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitārāmamantrānsa bhagavanpratimanvantare hyabhūtatato hyasya pravakṣyāmi mantrarājaṃ ṣaḍakṣaramp. 629)śrīṃtārādyaśca ṣaḍvarṇo mantroyaṃ ṣaḍvidho mataḥagastyaḥ śrīśivaḥ proktā munayonukramādimepañcāśanmātṛkāmantravarṇapratyekapūrvakaḥrāmacandramanorbhedāḥ śatadvayamitā amīramābījādikānāṃ tu viśvāmitro munirmataḥkāmabījādipūrvāṇāṃ muniḥ sammohano mataḥrāmabhadro rāmacandaḥ ṣoḍhā ṣaḍvarṇa ucyateṣoḍhā syādvahnijāyāntaḥ sa evaṃ ṣaḍvidho mataḥcaturviṃśatisaṃkhyākā bhedāstena nirūpitāḥbījaiḥ ṣaḍdīrghasaṃyuktaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥvāmorunyastataddhastaṃ sītālakṣmaṇasaṃyutambilvapatraiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaistilairvā paṅkajairhunetśrīṃ sītāyai dviṭhāntena vāmapārśvagatāṃ yajettatastrikoṇakośāgre pṛṣṭhato lakṣmaṇaṃ yajettataḥ ṣaḍdalamadhye tu ṣaḍaṅgāni prapūjayettadbāhyeṣṭadalaṃ proktaṃ pūjayediṣṭadikṣu capratiṣṭhāṃ paramātmānaṃ tato vidyāṃ prapūjayetnānātmānaṃ tathā śāntiṃ keśareṣu prapūjayetśāntiṃ pradyumnamagreniruddhaṃ ca ratimarcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gandhapuṣpākṣatādīni sarvāṇyāsādayettataḥprokṣaṇīpātrayugalaṃ paripūrya śubhāmbunātatpātraṃ praṇītetyucyate budhaiḥyajñasādhanasambhārān prokṣayenmūlamantrataḥdakṣiṇe bhāge veśayettaṃ kuśāsanedīkṣāṅgabhūtahomesminbrāhmaṇaṃ tvāṃ vṛṇe tviticāpi labhyate brāhmaṇo na cetnānākeśarasaṃyuktaṃ caturdvārasamāvṛtamtadvahnestatra maṇḍalakādināprādakṣiṇyena madhyāntaṃ pītāṃ śvetāṃ tathāruṇāmrucirāṃ jvālinīñceti sarvapīṭhamprapūjayetsamastapīṭhapūjāyāṃ vahnimantra udāhṛtaḥsaṃyuktairbhujaiḥ samyagvirājitamtrinetrañca jaṭāmaulimpītavastrāruṇasrajamp. 60) vaiśvānara jātaveda ihāvaha lohitākṣasaptaviṃśatyakṣaroyaṃ mantraḥ syādvahnipūjanejihvājvālārucaḥ sarvā varābhayakarāstathāvaiḍūryavarṇā kanakā prācyāṃ stambhanakāryavṛtkṛṣṇāñjanacayaprakhyā nair-ṛtyāṃ māraṇakṣamājayābhāsā vaśye vāyudiśaṅgatāanekakāryasaṃsiddhirnāśakartrī ca sā matātathā siddhirviparīte viparyayaḥlelihā ceti jihvā vaiṣṇavakarmaṇisakalā jihvā varadābhayasatkarāḥṣaḍaṅgāni patreṣvāvṛttidevatāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hanūmantaṃ ca sugrīvaṃ bharataṃ ca bibhīṣaṇamāñjaneyaṃ tadagre ca vācayantaṃ kṛtāñjalimakopaṃ dharmapālākhyaṃ mantriṇaśca kramādyajetbharadvājaṃ kāśyapaṃ ca vālmīkiṃ kauśikaṃ tathāsanatkumāraṃ ca yajettadbāhye dvādaśārakedvividaṃ ca gavākṣaṃ ca sakirīṭaṃ sakuṇḍalamarcayetṣoḍaśadale pūrvatastu kṛtāñjalīnpratyūṣaśca prabhātaśca vasavoṣṭau prakīrttitāḥajaikapādahirbudhnyaḥ pinākī cāparājitaḥsthāṇurbhagaśca bhagavānrudrā ekādaśa smṛtāḥgabhastistu yamaḥ sarvasākṣī cāpi divākaraḥcitro viṣṇuriti proktā ādityā dvādaśa kramātdhātāramante prayajeddvātriṃśatpatrake ṣvimānindrādīnbhūgṛhe bāhye tadastrāṇi ca saṃyajetevaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogānkarttumarhatibhaveddhanādhipativannīlotpalahutena cavaśayedviśvamakhilaṃ bilvapuṣpairghanātyayehutā dīrghāyuṣe dūrvā raktābjairdhanavṛddhayetato devaṃ samavāhya pūjayedupacārakaiḥagniṃ hutvālaye samyagyajñiyairathavandhanaiḥtatra sampūjayetsamyagrāghavaṃ proktavartmanātilairhutvā yadyadiṣṭaṃ tattadevāpnuyānnaraḥbilvaprasūnairaiśvaryyamarcitegnau hute bhavetpalāśakusumairhutvā mantrī vai vedavidbhavetnirāmayaśca dīrghāyurbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 631)kavacasya prayoge yo japahomādikarmasuupaiti sadṛśīṃ kanyāṃ lājahomena sādhakaḥsarvādhipatyaṃ vai dravyaṃ bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥārātsaṃvatsaraṃ yāvatṣaṭsahasraṃ dinedineayamevānnado loke sarveṣāmapi jāyatehutvā tu labhate lakṣmīmacirādatra sādhakaḥvairājyenādhipatyena martyānāmuttamo bhavetsaṃvatsaraṃ prakurvīta japahomādikaṃ budhaḥbrāhmaṇānbhojayitvā tu vratametatsamāpayetbhuktimmuktiṃ ca labhate tvihaloke paratra caabhīṣṭalokavaśyārthaṃ juhuyādarcitenalepatrairbilvaprasūnairvā daśāṃśaṃ juhuyātsudhīḥpāyasenājyayuktena hutvā vidyānidhirbhavettadeva punarāyāti svādhipatyaṃ na saṃśayaḥjātīpuṣpāṇi madhuratritayāktāni saṃhunetvaiśākhe rāghavaṃ kuryyātpaśyannanimiṣe kṣaṇaḥdaśāṃśaṃ kamalairhutvā sa cārogī bhaved dhruvamjapellakṣaṃ ca juhuyātpāyasenārcitenaleśrīrāmasadṛśaḥ putrapautrāḍhyopi prajāyatetadā hanahanetyuktvā tannāmāntaritaṃ japetākarṇasaśarākṛṣṭakodaṇḍabhujamaṇḍitamraktanetrammahāvīravaryyamaindre rathe sthitamkoṭikoṭimahāvīraiḥ karoddhṛtatarūttamaiḥnadadbhirabhidhāvadbhiḥ samarerigaṇaṃ pratiatyantasusamṛddhopi na śatruravaśiṣyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidhāya pūrvavatsarvamanāyāsena mārayetdaśāṃśaṃ ca tilairhutvā stambhayecchatrusaṃhatimjapenmantraṃ nirāhāro juhuyācca tilairapirāmabhadraṃ ciraṃ sākṣādrāvaṇaṃ cāpi vairiṇamsugrīvādibhiranyaiśca daivatairnāradādibhiḥbibhīṣaṇāyāgatāya dadataṃ śaraṇārthinesvasthānamānayecchīghraṃ rājānamathavā prabhumpramodayantaṃ sahasā tvacirādānayetpriyamsaṃmohayati vegena rājānamapi vā prabhumtārādyaiḥ puṭitānmantrānsarvārthānviniyojayetrāmasyaikākṣaraṃ mantraṃ kīrtyate sa tu rāmitimūrttipañjaranāmānaṃ tattvanyāsaṃ ca kārayetp. 633)dhyānapūjādikaṃ prāgvadrāmalakṣaṃ japenmanumrāma ityeṣa kathito dvyakṣaro bhuktimuktidaḥdhyānapūjāprayogādi sarvaṃ jñeyaṃ ṣaḍarṇavatupacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhī rāmaṃ dhyātvā yathāvidhijāyante tena kāryyāṇi hyanuślokadalaiḥ priyeṣaḍkarmāṇi vinaśyanti kṛtyāścāripraṇoditāḥvidhānaṃ vā mahāsiddhirbhavedvā cakravarttitādvyakṣaro mantrarājastu tryakṣaraḥ parijāyatenyāsapūjāprayogādi sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaretrāmāya nama ityeṣa mantraḥ pañcākṣaro mataḥrāmabhadro bījaśaktī prathamārṇastatontimaḥṣaḍaṅgaṃ pūrvavatkāryyaṃ mantrārṇairmanunāstrakamavekṣamāṇaṃ jānakyā kṛtavyajanamīśvaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lakṣmaṇena dhṛtacchatramatha vā puṣpakopariprāgvaddhomastarpaṇādi prayoṃgādyaṃ ca sādhayetrāmacandro rāmabhadro ṅento natiyuto dvidhādhyānapūjāprayogādi nikhilantu ṣaḍarṇavattārādiṣaḍbhiḥ saṃyukto dvidhā saptākṣaro mataḥp. 634)sarvaṃ ṣaḍarṇavajjñeyaṃ dhyānapūjājapādikamtāro rāmaścaturthyantaḥ krodhānto vahnivallabhaḥnāśanaḥ sarvadoṣāṇāṃ saṃgrāme vijayapradaḥkrūṃhrīṃ namaśca rāmāya hrīmityaṣṭākṣaraḥ paraḥrāmacandrosya mantrasya devatā parikīrttitaḥdīrghayā māyayāṅgāni tārapañcārṇayuktayābhasmoddhūlitasarvāṅgaṃ kapardinamupāsmaherāmaśaktintu sītākhyāṃ varṇalakṣaṃ japenmanumviśeṣato bhogadosau saṃgrāme vijayapradaḥsaptārṇo yo manuḥ proktaḥ ṣaḍbhistārādikaiḥ pṛthakdhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ teṣāṃ saptārṇavaccaretjānakīvallabho ṅentaḥ svāhāntaśca humādikaḥchandaśca devatā rāmaḥ sītāpāṇiparigrahaḥśirolalāṭabhrūmadhyanetrakaṇṭhastaneṣvapiayodhyānagare caiva vicitre svarṇamaṇḍapesiṃhāsane samārūḍhaṃ puṣpakopari rāghavamsaṃstūyamānaṃ munibhiḥ prahṛṣṭairupasevitamśyāmaṃ prasannavadanaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamjapapūjāprayogādi sarvamasya ṣaḍarṇavatrāmo ṅento dhanuṣpāṇistathā syādvahnisundarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rākṣasāntakaro rāmo rāṃ bījaṃ parikīrttitamvarṇanyāsaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ puraścaryyāvidhiṃ tathāviśeṣājjayadaścāyaṃ sarvavāñchitadāyakaḥoṃ hṛdbhagavate rāmacandrāyeti manurmataḥdaśākṣaravadeva syādayaṃ kalyāṇakārakaḥśrīrāma jayarāmeti jayarāma jayeti capadatrayairdvirāvṛttyā cāṅganyāsaṃ samācaretpuruṣāya padaṃ paścādviṭhāntoṣṭādaśākṣaraḥdaśāsyadarppadalano rāmabhadraḥ prakīrttitaḥmūlamantraiḥ kośalendraḥ satyasandhastataḥ paramśaśvatprasannavadanaścaturthīṃ namasāvadetramye sugandhapuṣpādyairvṛkṣavṛndaiśca maṇḍitepavitrarūpe parito jayamaṅgalabhāṣitedevagandharvanārībhirgāyatryādivibhūṣitesaumitrisītāsahitaṃ jaṭāmukuṭaśobhitamhatvā rāvaṇamāyāntaṃ kṛtatrailokyarakṣaṇamhomapūjāprayogādi sarvaṃ jñeyaṃ ṣaḍarṇavatrājyaśriyāḥ pradātāraṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradamp. 636)daśāsyāntaka rāṃ rakṣa dehi dāpaya me śriyamchando'nuṣṭubdevatā tu rāmabhadraḥ prakīrttitaḥmastake ca lalāṭe ca netrayoḥ karṇayostathākūrparadvitaye vāpi maṇibandhadvaye tathāmeḍhre pāyāvūrumūladvaye jānvośca gulphayoḥpītaṃ vā cintayedrāmaṃ dhanārthaṃ yo manuṃ japettāro namo bhagavate ḍentaḥ syādraghunandanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prasannavadanāyeti tataścāmitatejasesaptacatvāriṃśadarṇo mālāmantra udīritaḥrājyābhiṣikto rāmaścoṃ bījaṃ śaktirnamastvitiśiromukhabhrūmadhyeṣu netrayoḥ karṇayornasoḥtathā kūrparayorasya tathaiva maṇibandhayoḥkaṇṭhe hṛdi stanadvandve pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhake kareūrvorjānvostathāṃghryośca sarvāṅgepi nyasetkramātbilvaprasūnaiḥ patrairvā tilaistrimadhunā yutaiḥmārjanaṃ bhojayedviprānprayogādi ca pūrvavatjayadāṃ rāmagāyatrīṃ japitāṃ sūryavaṃśajaiḥya dhīmahīti tanno rā tadagre maḥ pracodayātjanmaprabhṛti yatpāpaṃ daśabhiryāti saṃkṣayamcaturlakṣaṃ japedyastu mokṣabhāk sa na saṃśayaḥtārādireṣā gāyatrī muktimeva prayacchatimanmathenāpi saṃyuktā saṃmohayati medinīmśrīrāmāya huṃphaṭ ca svāhāntoyaṃ navākṣaraḥśrīmaddāśarathī rāmo devatā parikīrttitaḥsabindubhiryakārādyaiḥ pañcāṅganyāsa īritaḥpītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ cāpabāṇavibhūṣitamvāmabhāge jagadyoniṃ prakṛtiṃ parameśvarīmdhanurbāṇakaraṃ devaṃ sītāṃ padmakarāṃ smaretsītālakṣmaṇasaṃyuktaṃ dhyāyetkalpataroradhaḥṣaṭkoṇamadhye rāmaṃ ca koṇeṣvaṅgāni cārcayethanūmantaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ ca jāmbavantaṃ krameṇa casītāṃ ca sugrīvāgre tu dikpālānhetibhiḥ saha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tarpaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā prayogārho bhavenmanuḥvā kaṃjapatrairjuhuyāddhomoyaṃ lokavaśyakṛtmallikābhirjagadvaśyaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥnavabhirdevakanyābhirdevavatsa pramodatekapilājyaṃ pibedyastu dūrvārasavimiśritamśuddhabrāhmīrasaṃ vāpi sa sarvajño bhaveddrutamp. 638)māsena mahadaiśvaryaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥdhanavāñjāyate mantrī dvitīya iva yakṣarāṭlakṣamekaṃ vidhisthāne nidhilābho bhaveddhruvamjñānapradaṃ mahāmantraṃ sanakādyairupāsitamuttamaślokavaryyāya nyastadaṇḍārcitāṃghrayeśrīrāmo devatā bījaṃ rāṃ varyyaḥ śaktirucyatevāgvaddhyānādikaṃ lakṣaṃ puraścaryā prakīrttitāprayogāḥ pūrvamantroktā mokṣārthī sādhayedamumyena kārāgṛhānmukto rāvaṇasya sureśvaraḥbandīvimuktaśṛṃkhale svāhā dvāviṃśadakṣaraḥpadairasya ṣaḍaṅgāni japellakṣamitaṃ sadāsaptāhājjāyate mokṣo [tasyeti śeṣaḥ ||] nātra kāryyā vicāraṇāśrīsītāyai namaḥ svāhā sītāmantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥdīrghasvarayutādyena ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayetsvarṇābhāmambujakarāṃ rāmālokanatatparāmśrīphalāni tilānmuktyai bhuktyai ca juhuyātsadākṛṣṇaḥ sa eva bhagavānkalidvāparasandhigaḥekasaptatirūposau pratimanvantarebhavatp. 639)iti tattvaṃ samākhyātaṃ viṣṇoḥ sandhibhavasya ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: satkarma kurvatāṃ pātastaduktirmokṣasādhanamtasya mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktiprasādhanamnāradosya muniḥ prokto virāṭ chanda udāhṛtamacakrāya hṛdākhyātaṃ vicakrāya śiropi cacakrāya kavacaṃ proktamasurāntakaśabdataḥsarvāṅgeṣu manuṃ nyasya mantranyāsaṃ samācarethṛdaye śīrṣake caiva śikhāyāṃ kavace tathātataḥ karatale pṛṣṭe vyāpakatvena vinyasetvāmāṃguṣṭhaṃ samārabhya dakṣāṃguṣṭhāntakaṃ nyaseteṣa saṃhāranāmā tu nyāsaḥ prathama īritaḥaṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ samārabhya kaniṣṭhāntaṃ sthitirbhavetevaṃ nyāsatrayañceti pañcanyāsāḥ prakīrttitāḥnyaseddaśāṃgulīṣvevaṃ ṣaṣṭho nyāsaḥ prakīrttitaḥviparītaṃ punarmūlaṃ saptamaḥ parikīrtitaḥpunarhṛdi ca sarvāṅge sarvāṅgasakalāṅgaketattvanyāsoṣṭamoyaṃ hi mayā tubhyaṃ prakīrttitaḥvilomatattvanyāsoyaṃ navamaḥ parikīrttitaḥtārasaṃpuṭitammantraṃ trivāraṃ daśamastvayamsabindukānmantra varṇānsaṃhāroyaṃ śironvitaḥmantravarṇāndvādaśoyaṃ sṛṣṭinyāsaḥ prakīrttitaḥsthitinyāsaḥ samākhyāto mūlasyāyaṃ trayodaśaḥaṃsayorūruyugme ca nyāsoyaṃ syāccaturdaśaḥpṛṣṭhegre ca nyasenmantravarṇānpañcadaśastvayamgaṇḍayośca nyasedvarṇānnyāsoyaṃ ṣoḍaśaḥ smṛtaḥmūlāṃgulīnāmagre ca tathāṃguṣṭhādipañcasu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: itthaṃ vāmakare nyasya nyāsastvaṣṭādaśo bhavetaṃgulyagre tathāṃguṣṭhādau nyāsastūnaviṃśakaḥbāhuyugye sandhiyugme nyāsoyañcaikaviṃśakaḥliṅge jānuni pāde ca dvāviṃśoyaṃ prakīrttitaḥyugmanyāsoyamākhyātastrayoviṃśatisaṃkhyakaḥvibhūtipañjaro nāma caiṣa eva prakīrttitaḥbhuktimuktiprado bhaktiprado viṣṇoḥ padāmbujemūrttipañjaranāmākhyaṃ proktaṃ pāpapraṇāśanamproktamādyaprakāreṇa nyāsānāmupakalpaneevaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena mantrī mantrakalevarampūrvaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ smaretpuṣpavirājitammadhupaiḥ kṛtarāṅkāraiḥ kīrādyaiśca nināditamtasminvane kalpataruṃ navapallavaśobhitamdivyāmṛtaughavarṣeṇa siñcantaṃ viśvamucchritamṣaḍūrmirahitāṃ dhyāyettasyādhastādvasundharāmpadmamaṣṭadalaṃ tatra yathoktaṃ ratnaparṇakamudyadādityasaṅkāśaṃ prasannavadanaṃ vibhummāyūreṇa supicchena rājamānaśubhāṅgakamkuṭilālakavibhrājadāsyaṃ karṇakṛtotpalampadmanetraṃ dīptamaṇiṃ makarākṛtikuṇḍalamatyadbhutonnāsikaṃ ca pakvabimbaphalādharamāraṇyaiḥ pallavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kṛtagraiveyasampadamśrīvatsāṅkāṅkitoraskaṃ vṛṣaskandhaṃ ca hāriṇamkṣudraghaṇṭikayā baddhakaṭiṃ graiveyarājitamkuliśapramukhaiścihnairaṅkitasvacchapattalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
