sanskrit: tanmṛdudhvanisantānavivaśīkṛtamānasammukhapadmasamāsaktasvāntanetrābhirājitamkavalīkṛtasantyaktanyāsaleśābhirapyalamḍiṇḍīravābhisaṃyuktadravairdṛṣṭimanoharaiḥuttambhanīkṛtaśrotrapuṭayugmaiśca tarṇakaiḥparasparavimardārthakhuraspṛṣṭamahītalaiḥp. 642)vatsīvatsasamūhaiśca saṃvataṃ tadanantaramuccakarṇapuṭaiḥ pītavaṃśaśabdasudhārasaiḥmadhurākṛtibhiḥ sarvaiḥ pīyūṣādbhutabhāṣaṇaiḥtato gopapurandhrīṇāṃ smaredvandaṃ samāhitaḥvallavīvallavagavāṃ devavṛndaṃ bahiḥ smaretṛṣisaṅghaṃ tathā dakṣe vedādhyayanatatparamvāmabhāge ca yogīndrānyakṣagandharvakinnarānanekaśrutisampūrṇavīṇāvādanatatparamevaṃ dhyātvā yajetpīṭhe dehe mānasikārcanamnyāsoktaṃ kramataḥ paścādgandhādyairdevamarcayetādau svīye pīṭhamaye dehe mānasikārcanamvaṃśaṃ ca vanamālāṃ ca śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ tathākarṇikāyāṃ caturdikṣu devasya paritorcayettejorūpadharāṃścaitānkesareṣvaṅgapūjanamrukmiṇīṃ satyabhāmāṃ ca nagnajittanayārkajekamalaṃ cārghapātraṃ ca bibhratīrdakṣiṇānyayoḥstanabhāranatā nānāratnajālavibhūṣaṇāḥnandagopo yaśodā ca balabhadraḥ subhadrikāsvarṇābho vasudevastu rakto nandaḥ prakīrttitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tataścādhomukhau kṛtvāsruksruvau ca pratāpayetmūlaistridhā caiva mārjayitvā pratāpayetkarāgreṇa punaḥ santāpayeccatausruksruvau paścāddhṛtasaṃskāramācaretsamāpūrya vīkṣaṇādisusaṃskṛtamsamuddiṣṭaṃ kuśadvayamata kṣipetdarśayettaṃ hṛdā kṣipetmantrajñaḥ kuryādutplavanaṃ tataḥaṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ ca gṛhītvā ghṛtamutplavettatsyātsamplavanaṃ ṣaṭ saṃskārā itīritāḥadhamaṃ chāgalījātaṃ niṣiddhaṃ tveḍakādijamghṛte nyasya tataḥ prādeśasammitamvāma iḍāṃ dakṣe piṅgalāṃ madhyatastataḥdakṣabhāgātsruveṇājyaṃ pragṛhṇīyāddhṛdāṇunāvāmabhāgāttadvadvāmegnilocanegṛhītvājyaṃ madhyato madhyalocanedakṣabhāgātpunastvājyaṃ hṛnmaṃtreṇa samāharetsatārābhirvyāhṛtibhirājyena juhuyātpunaḥgarbhādhānādikāṃ vahnessamudvāhāvasānikāḥpūrvamuccārya karmanāma samuccaretpuṃsavanaṃ sīmaṃtaṃ jātakarma cacaulopanayanaṃ vahnermahānāmavrataṃ tathāśākte vāgbhavapūrvakāḥvisṛjyātha mūlāgreṣu ghṛtaplutāḥsabījasvasvanāmnā vai caikaikāmāhutiṃ hunet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 643)muktāhāradhare ratnakuṇḍalādivibhūṣitenānopāyanahastābjagopāpatyaiḥ supūjitaḥsantānaṃ kalpavṛkṣaṃ ca candanaṃ ca prapūjayettadāyudhāni vidhinā kramataḥ samyagarcayetnālikeraṃ guḍaṃ pūrīrnavanītaṃ sitopalamoṃ namaḥ parametyuktvātmane nirupamaṃ vadetsamaye ca nivedyaṃ hi kuryādanyatpuroktavatmūlamantreṇa mantrajño mūrtiṃ nirmāya mantrakaiḥmūlamantraṃ samuccāryya pādapadmadvayaṃ vibhoḥambhojayugmataḥ paścāduttamāṅge nivedayetdevasya dakṣiṇe dadyācchetapuṣpāṇi mantravitsarvasampatkaraṃ puṃsāṃ bhogamokṣaphalapradamsaṃkṣepapūjanaṃ tena kṛtvā kṛṣṇāṣṭakaṃ yajetdāmodarāya govinda hṛṣīkeśa kubhārahṛtetaireva vidhātavyā kṛṣṇārcā hyathavā budhaiḥsampūjya sve hṛdambhoje samudvāsya namettataḥmantrārthaṃ cintayanmantrī niyamastho jitendriyaḥpaścānmantrasya śuddhyarthaṃ daśalakṣaṃ japetsudhīḥśarkarāghṛtasaṃyuktairabjairvā juhuyādvaraiḥātmābhiṣekaṃ kṛtvātha bhūdevānpūjayettataḥtato nijaguruṃ samyakpraṇipatya yathāvidhitoṣayetparayā bhaktyā nijakāryasya siddhayekuryādbhaktiyutaḥ samyaṅ-nityanaimittike rataḥdadhataṃ pītavasanaṃ sundaraṃ gaganaprabhamvīryaṃ prajñāṃ smṛtiṃ prāpya kavināmagraṇīrbhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhyātvā kṣīradhiyāṃ toyaistarpayellabhate sutamchinnamarmapraṇādāḍhyāṃ tadā naśyanti rākṣasāḥdhyāyettatastāḥ kṛṣṇasya hutaśeṣāṃstu prāśayetgrahapīḍādimuktiḥ syādbālānāṃ rugvināśanamayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ vighnasaṃghāḥ śamaṃ yayuḥdadhānaṃ kiṅkiṇīsaṃghaṃ lasatsvacchavibhūṣaṇamsantoṣya guruviprāśca vyādhyādirahito bhavettenāpi mantritaṃ toyaṃ kṣiptvā pīḍāṃ vyapohativeṇuṃ dhamantaṃ govindaṃ dhyāyetpūrvoditaṃ phalamsudhādṛṣṭyā vīkṣamāṇaṃ tadrātrau prajapenmanumsukhīkaroti dhiṣaṇaṃ kāladaṣṭamapi kṣaṇātaṣṭottaraśataṃ snāyādviṣārto nirviṣo bhavetdakṣiṇena vrajaprāṇiprāṇasantrāṇasūcakamp. 645)bhītidāstaṃ na bādhante viṣavarṣaṇavāyuvatayutaṃ lavaṇaiḥ śuddhaiṃranāvṛṣṭirbhaveddhruvambhūyasīṃ vṛṣṭimiṣṭāṃ hi kuryādasamayepi saḥmantraṃ japettadānīṃ tu sukhī bhavati nānyathāātmabhūtaparābhūtairjanaiḥ sarvaiḥ stutaṃ tathāmahāghoragraho duṣṭastadānīṃ nāśamāpnuyātkṣīrācchinākhaṇḍahomātsarvaṃ krūrajvaraṃ haretdhyātvā spṛśejjapannārtaṃ pāṇibhyāṃ sa sukhī bhavetdhyātvā dugdhaguḍūcībhirapamṛtyurvinaśyatidhyātvā pārthayutaṃ mantraṃ japetputrasamṛddhayeayutaṃ labhate putrānnīrogāṃścirajīvinaḥpūjayitvāyutaṃ japtvā śatayoṣāpatirvrajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ katipayairmāsairvandhyāpi labhate sutammaunaṃ kṛtvā pibennārī prāgvarṣāllabhate sutamparājityātmacakreṇa kāśīṃ tadbhavavahninājuhuyānniśi siddhārthaiḥ svīyatailavilolitaiḥkṛtyā bhūyastamevāśu kṣapayennātra saṃśayaḥghaṇṭākarṇaṃ ca hastābhyāṃ spṛśantaṃ saṃsmareddharimaśeṣapāpanāśārthaṃ puṣṭyarthaṃ ca japettathādhāvamānaṃ [dhāvu gatiśuddhyorityataḥ śānac ||] ripugaṇamanudhāvantamāśugamsaptāhādvairiṇāṃ bhūyo hyuccāṭo deśato bhavetkṛṣṇaṃ dhyātvāyutaṃ japto manuruccāṭakṛdripoḥayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ hunedvā tatsamaṃ budhaḥśatrurnidhanamāpnoti sudhābhakṣopi nānyathāyāminyāmayutaṃ svastho ripuryamapuraṃ vrajetevaṃ tailantu juhuyācchmaśāne niśi māraṇehunecca tāvaddhaviṣā tatpātakanivṛttayekṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyañjapallaṁkṣaṃ sarvato jayamāpnuyātdhyātvā dharmasya vṛddhiḥ syādyogasiddhiśca jāyatetrisvāduyuktairlakṣaṃ yaḥ kaṇḍakaprasavairhunetmahākaviḥ sa vāgīśo vedavedāṅgapāragaḥdehagehapuragrāmavāsturakṣā bhaveddhruvamāraṇyakāruṇaiḥ puṣpairmadhyāhne vidhinārcayethariṃ gṛhe japetsāṣṭasahasraṃ dvijavaśyakṛtkṛṣṇamabhyarcya nṛpatīnvaśannayati dāsavatatra dhyāyecca gāyantaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ janamohanamanvahaṃ saptaśatakaṃ hutvā tadbhasma dhārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadbhasmadhāraṇānnārī svapumāṃsaṃ vaśaṃ nayetpuruṣaśca tathā nārīṃ dāsīṃ kuryānna saṃśayaḥsahasramabhimantryātha yebhyo dadyācca te vaśāḥp. 647)japitvā'ṣṭottaraśataṃ barībhartti ca sadvacaḥrāsakrīḍārataṃ dhyātvā japennityaṃ sahasrakamjapetkanyāmaṇḍalena labhate vāñchitaṃ varamhutvā vaśīkarotyeva bhūpālānsaparicchadānraktotpalairvā kusumaiścampakaiḥ pāṭalodbhavaiḥaśvamāraprasūnairyo madhvaktaḥ pratyahaṃ hunetpañcabāṇapraviddhāṅgaṃ dāsīkuryyānna saṃśayaḥhomaṃ kuvāta rātrau ca vahnau viprānvaśaṃ nayetpadmaiḥ sataṇḍulairhomāttarppaṇācchrīḥ sthirā bhavetsamādāya kadambantu samārūḍhaṃ vicintayetśacīmapyānayenmantrī kimanyāṃ narayoṣitamathātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi dvitīye yastu jāyatetārasampuṭitaścāyaṃ mantraḥ syāddvādaśākṣaraḥpuraścaryājapanyāsapūjādyaṃ pūrvavadbhavetprayogāśca viśeṣeṇa prayogotra nirūpyatearikambugadāpadmaṃ bāhudaṇḍaiśca bibhratampītāmbaralasadgātraṃ taruṇaṃ munisevitamsvahṛtpadmagataṃ devaṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ navamlakṣadvādaśakaṃ japtvā tatsahastraṃ samidvaraiḥmadhvādilolitenāpi haviṣā vā jitendriyaḥbhavāndhakāradyumaṇiṃ svīye hṛtsarasīruhetrisahasraṃ japenmantrī japetsandhyoktavartmanā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃsārābdhiṃ samullaṃghya jīvanmuktaḥ sa jāyateayonijaśarīreṇa prakaṭo jāyate bhuvidaśākṣaroyaṃ yāmādistasya mantro bhavākṣaraḥkāmadevo muniḥ prāgvadanyatsarvaṃ samīritamharaśiṣya iti khyāto vāmamārgapravarttakaḥdaśākṣaroyaṃ lajjādistasya mantro bhavākṣaraḥprāgvatsarvaṃ vinā śaktiṃ nāyaṃ mantrosya sidhyatisudāmadāridryaharo mantroyaṃ tadupāsitaḥdaśākṣaroyaṃ lakṣmyādyo bhavedekādaśākṣaraḥnyāsapūjāprayogādi pūrvavatparikīrttitamsaṃsārānandasandohadarśakosya manustvayamevamaṣṭādaśārṇoyaṃ mantraḥ proktokhileṣṭadaḥkṛṣṇo devastu gāyatrī chandaḥ syānnārado muniḥsvāhā śaktiśca klīṃ bījaṃ vedābdhyabdhivilocanaiḥmūlamantreṇa sarvāṅge trivāraṃ vyāpakaṃ caretetānyaṅgāni vinyasya praṇavena tataḥ punaḥke lalāṭe bhruvormadhye karṇayornetrayornasijānuyugme padadvandve nyasedekaikamakṣaramśirovadanahṛdguhyapādeṣu manuvittamaḥnyāsāntarādikaṃ sarvaṃ daśavarṇoktavadbhavetayutadvayasaṃkhyātamadhikārārthamādarāttarppaṇādi tataḥ sarvaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā carettrikālārcāvidhiṃ vakṣye govindasya jagatpateḥramyaṃ ratnamayaṃ divyaṃ smaretkalpataroradhaḥyathoktapadmamadhyasthaṃ vāsudevaṃ vicintayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: snigdhavastraṃ lalāṭāntaluṭhanmūddhajasañcayamindīvaradalākāraśobhinetradvayānvitamraktādharaṃ sunāsaṃ ca hasantaṃ hṛtamānasamgodhūlidhamaroraskaṃ śārdūlanakhadhāriṇamkaṭideśalasajjaṃghādvaye baddhamanoharamtiraskarantaṃ vanajabandhūkaprasavaśriyamdakṣiṇottarayoḥ pārṣṇyorvahantaṃ sādhu suspṛhampūtanāśakaṭādīnāṃ vināśāya kṛtodyamamākhaṇḍalamurkhairdevaiḥ ||sevitaṃ kāmatatparaiḥprāgukta eva pīṭhemuṃ hariṃ saṃpūjayetprabhumsvāṅgāvaraṇamādyaṃ syāddvitīyaṃ lokapālakaiḥmelayitvā sunaivedyaṃ nivedya prīṇayedvibhumśrīkṛṣṇaṃ pūjayedyatra pūjopakaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥdehānte viṣṇusāyujyaṃ prayāti niyataṃ kṛtīgavyaṃ dadhi nivedyāsmai guḍayuktamathāpi vāaṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu mūlamantraṃ japettataḥindrādidevasiddhaiśca sevitaṃ khacaraistathānīlāmbuvāhasatkāntiviśiṣṭāṅgaśriyaṃ vibhumudbhramadbhrūlataṃ devaṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇampītavastradharaṃ cārumuktāhāravibhūṣitamalaṃkṛtaśarīraṃ taṃ piśaṅgāmbarasaṃvṛtamkāmabāṇapraviddhāṅgaṃ veṇuvādanatatparamabhirāmataraṃ dakṣaṃ ratnaśreṣṭhamabhīṣṭakamdāmādyairaṅgakaiścāpi mahiṣībhiśca tatparamindrādyaiśca tadastraiśca saptāvaraṇasaṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: naivedyaṃ kāñcane pātre pūrvoktaṃ ca nivedayetśarkarāghṛtayaktena baliṃ paścātprakalpayetdevāgrabhāgamārabhya savyamārgādbalirmataḥsahasraṃ śatamānaṃ vā sāṣṭakaṃ pūjayejjapangīrvāṇavṛndavandyosau sammataḥ sarvajantuṣusarvaiśvaryyasametotra sukhaṃ bhuktvā hariṃ vrajetdaśākṣareṇa manunā rātrau pūjanamācaretgṛhaiḥ ṣoḍaśasāhasraiḥ sarvataḥ pariveṣṭitehaṃsādipakṣibhirvyāptaiḥ saṃvṛtādbhutamandirekomalāstaraṇe divyasvarṇapaṃkajamaṇḍitenāradādimuniśreṣṭhaiḥ saṃvṛtaṃ mokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥagnirūpaṃ paraṃ tejo diśantaṃ mantragauravātsarojadalasaṃkāśanetraṃ makarakuṇḍalamatyantamadhurākāraṃ prasannamukhapaṃkajamdūrīkṛtadharābhāraṃ prasannahṛdayaṃ vibhumitthaṃ sañcintya deveśaṃ govindaṃ samyagarcayetparvataṃ viṣṇuniśaṭhaṃ vṛddhavṛndārakaṃ tathālokapālāṃstadastrāṇi pañcamāvaraṇārcanamkhaṇḍāktakṣīrasadbuddhyā nīraiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tu tarppayetsarvārcāsu hunenmantrī madhyāhne tu yathāvidhinyasyeddevamayo bhūtvā svātmānaṃ pūjayettataḥiha bhogānbahūnbhuktvā vrajeccānte sa sadgatimrāsakrīḍāsamākrāntaṃ ballavīcakraveṣṭitamkālindīsaikate śubhre śītale tāpahāriṇicaladbhṛṅgāṅganāśabdavācālitadigantare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ākāśe sañcaradbhistaiḥ puṣpavṛṣṭikṛtādbhutenārīṇāṃ yugmayordevaṃ pratyekaṃ cāntarāgatamromodgamasamākrāntanāgavallītaruṃ muhuḥkṛtacārusvanaiḥ sarvālaṃkārairhṛdayaṃgamammaṇiśaṅkhau suvistīrṇe raktapadmagataṃ prabhumtadānīṃ raktaphullāravindacchadavilocanamśitikaṇṭhaśikhaṇḍaiśca baddhamūrddhajasañcayamratnakuṇḍalasaṃśobhigaṇḍamaṇḍalamaṇḍitamnānāratnasamākḷptasaṃbhūṣaṇasubhūṣitamnavapravālarucirahastapādatalaṃ vibhumaṅganākucasaṃśleṣalagnakuṃkumavakṣasamitthaṃ dhyātvā yajetpīṭhe cāṅgāvaraṇasaṃyutamindrādyā bhūpure pūjyā vajrādīnyāyudhānyapirājate bhājane samyaksaṃskṛtya vinivedayetpratyekaṃ mithunebhyaścānyatsarvaṃ pūrvavanmatamindirāmandiro bhūtvā sarvārādhyaḥ subhuktimāntulyaṃ phalaṃ sa cāpnoti bhavābdheḥ pārago bhavetpuroktānāṃ ca kāmyānāṃ sādhakeṣu phalapradampīṭhādbhistarppaṇādau tu kṛtvā mūlena caikaśaḥdhenumudrāṃ pradarśyātra smṛtvā tarppaṇasādhakamsamyagañjalinā devaṃ tarpayenmūlamuccarettattatkālocitānpaścāttarpayetparivārakānguḍayuktaṃ dadhi prātarnavanītayutaṃ hareḥsitopalavimiśraṃ tu tarpaṇadravyamīritamtatprasādajalaiḥ siñcedātmānamiha mantravit
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: harimudvāsya mantrajño japenmantrantu tanmayaḥbhajeduktaprakāreṣu samālabhyaikameva tupaścātṣoḍaśabhirdravyaiḥ pratyekaṃ ca catuṣṭayamguḍo bhaktaṃ ca dugdhaṃ ca dadhyatho navanītakammṛdvī modakapūryaśca pṛthukāścaiva lājakāḥprātarevaṃ tarppayedyaḥ sāyaṃ vā saptasaṃkhyayātasya maṇḍalamātreṇa vāñchitaṃ bhavati dhruvamdhāroṣṇaṃ kvathitaṃ dugdhaṃ dadhi dadhyudakaṃ punaḥpañcāmṛtaṃ navaitāni pratyekaṃ śatamaṣṭa cakhaṇḍamiśritadhāroṣṇa dugdhabuddhyā jalaiḥ śubhaiḥsa tu nānārasopetaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca vindatiiha santarpaṇādeva phalamāpnoti vāñchitambhatvā nānāvidhairbhāvairabhirāmairmuhurmuhuḥbalād gṛhṇandadadbhikṣāmāyāti mahatīṃ tulāmkṛṣṇaṃ sañcintya mantrajño japedaṣṭādaśākṣaramhutvāyutaṃ japettāvatkanyāmiṣṭāṃ labheta saḥmadhuplutakuśairvāpi hunedvā tilataṇḍulaiḥevamaṣṭādaśārṇasya prayogaḥ kathito mayāpratyakṣo jāyate mantraḥ klīṃ kṛṣṇāya namastvitiṣaḍdīrghānvitabījena [klīṃmitibījena ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ yathā-klīṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ klīṃ śirase svāhetyādi ||] ṣaḍaṅgāni ca pūjanamsampatprado viśeṣeṇa mantroyaṃ parikīrttitaḥekāvatāre sampūrṇe sūkṣmarūpī janārdanaḥpunaśca kalidharmāṇā vṛttyarthaṃ ca janārdanaḥbhaktebhyaścābhayaṃ dattvā mohayitvā ca duṣkṛtāndarśayitvā ca martyānāṃ punastatraiva yātyasau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: syādyoṣṭame kaliyuge sarvasiddhividhāyakaḥvakṣyamāṇasya kṛṣṇa dvādaśārṇamanoḥ samamklīṃ kṛṣṇāya govindāya mantrosyāṣṭākṣaro mataḥpādaiḥ karāṅganyāsastu prayogādyaṃ ca pūrvavatjātaḥ kṛṣṇastasya manuroṃ namo ṅentakṛṣṇakaḥnāradosya muniśchandonuṣṭup kṛṣṇastu devatāvarṇalakṣaṃ japenmantramanyatproktaṃ daśārṇavatsvayameva munirjātaḥ svagāyatryupadeśataḥśūdropi rājyaṃ samprāpya gāyatrīṃ samyagabhyasettasya vaṃśe sthiraṃ rājyaṃ mṛto viṣṇupadaṃ vrajettannaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pracodayātpañcatripañcarāmābdhivedavarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakamprayogāṃścātra gāyatryāstathā kuryyānna saṃśayaḥnandagopakumārākhyaḥ prakaṭobhūjjarnādanaḥrūpāya ca balāyeti gopījanapadaṃ vadetṣaḍdīrghāḍhyādyabījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥaṣṭādaśārṇamantrasya prayogānācarettathāgopānāṃ madhyato gopaścamatkārapradarśakaḥkenedṛśī tu bhavatā siddhirlabdhā tu tadvadatvāmeva praṇamantisma krīḍannārīśataistadākāmārttaḥ kathyate nātaḥ sarvajñastvaṃ kathaṃ punaḥevamukto haristatra svapnalabdhaṃ manuṃ jagautarato rūḍhato khyāto na khyāto devakīsutaḥvarṇalakṣajapena prāgjanmapāpaṃ vinaśyatisarve pratyakṣatāṃ yānti sādhakānāṃ tu mantriṇām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devamukhāya svāhā ||] juhuyādvahnermūrtyaṣṭakaṃ tathāpūrvoktenāgnimantreṇa vauṣaḍantena vai tataḥdaśāhutīḥpañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyakamātmāgnidevatānāṃ ca cintayannaikyamātmavitnāḍīsandhānametaddhi proktaṃ deśikasttamaiḥsarvāsukuṇḍeṣu ca yathāvidhisarvartvijaścandanādyaissampūjya proktadevatāmsarpissaṃyutena priyāndhasāhotavyaṃ tīrtheṇārṣeṇa vā tathāmandāgnyāmayasaṃyukto daridraścāpi jāyatevārāṇāṃ rāśīnāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthakvārebhyaścātha sarvebhyo bhūtebhyaśca namo vadetgūḍhamapi vakṣyāmi śaraṇāgatānhomavidhi prakāśaścaturthaḥparadeśasthitānāṃ ca kārāgehādivāsināmkāryāṅgavastvabhāve vā vāmikānāṃ kṛpānidhecāpi dinacaryāṃ vada prabhoyatsarvatantreṣu gopitamsarve bho devāḥ sādhakānāṃ prasiddhidamadhikārivibhedena tadapi trividhaṃ bhavetpratyavāyo na galite saphalañjanaiḥyatinā kṛtaṃ tacchuddhamiṣyatepathikenāpi kārāgṛhagatena vāvā vittasaṃkṣayādanyakāryataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lokānāṃ vaśamāyānti tatsmṛtaṃ kathayanti cayogino yoginīsaṃgho brahmaviṣṇvādidarśanamprāpyate candradevena śrīkṛṣṇasya sarūpatāmsiddhā yajjapamātreṇa purāneke maharṣayaḥgomāno gagano mā go yakṣagatyatyagakṣayanivasankundakuṃjeṣu mukundo yaḥ prakīrtitaḥahaṃ prapadye mantroyaṃ proktaścāṣṭādaśākṣaraḥdaśārṇavatpūjanaṃ syādaṅgendrādi tadāyudhaiḥpalāśapuṣpaistaccūrṇaistarppaṇādi tataścaretsadyaḥ śrutidharo mantrī jāyate vedapāragaḥphaḍantoyaṃ mahāmantraḥ ṣoḍaśākṣara ucyatechando gāyatramuddiṣṭaṃ bālakṛṣṇastu devatāpūjā cāṅgasvavargādyaiḥ puraścaryādi pūrvavatannarūpa rasarūpa tuṣṭirūpa namonamaḥprayacchāgnivadhūrmantrastriṃśadvarṇonnadāyakaḥannādhipatikṛṣṇosya devatāparikīrttitaḥannado jāyate mantrī mantrametaṃ sadā japettāro namo bhagavate vāsudevāya huṃ ca phaṭmunirbrahmā grahaghnākhyo devatā devakīsutaḥarcanāṅgairlokapālairgrahādyaiśca samīritāathātaḥ samprakṣyāmi ūnaviṃśe manuṃ parampuruṣottama āyurme dehītyuktvā ca viṣṇavep. 657)prabhaviṣṇava ityuktvā namontastriṃśadarṇakaḥpañcāṅgaṃ dvādaśānte hi hṛdānandātmane tu hṛtdvādaśārṇānta āyurme dehi syājjyotirātmane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: namaścidātmane netraṃ pañcāṅgavidhirīritaḥlakṣamekaṃ daśāṃśena juhuyātpāyasaiḥ śubhaiḥprāgvaddaśārṇamantroktāṅganyāsaṃ tu samācaretbālavapuṣe svāheti saptārṇoyaṃ manurmataḥmunyādyaṃ dhyānapūjādi sarvaṃ syādbālakṛṣṇavatbālānāṃ bhayanāśārthaṃ rakṣārthaṃ ca tato japetgopālakapadaṃ brūyāttato vedadharāya canāradosya muniśchando gāyatraṃ kṛṣṇadevatāgrahagopālarakṣādau praśastaḥ śāntikepi cayaḥ kāliyaphaṇāmadhye divyaṃ nṛtyaṃ karoti tamkālīyamardanaḥ kṛṣṇo devatā parikīrtitaḥaṅgairindrādibhiḥ paścādvajrādyairarcayecca tamviṣanāśakarā yogāḥ kartavyā manunāmunāetanmantrasamo loke viṣaghno naiva vidyatenetre cāñjanamātreṇa saiṣā viṣavināśinīśrīmāyākāmabījāni [śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ kṛṣṇāya govindāya svāhā ||] ṅentaṃ kṛṣṇamudīrayetbhūbhūbhūrāmavedākṣimantrārṇairaṅgakalpanambahubhiḥ kalpatarubhirveṣṭite ratnamaṇḍapepuṣparāgadharāśobhiratnavidyotitāntareadho vai kalpavṛkṣasya śākhāvyāptasya patriṇaḥtadyoge ravibimbābharatnasiṃhāsanāmbujesamegharavicandrodyadvidyutkoṭinibhacchavimariśaṃkhagadāpadmadhāriṇaṃ pītavāsasamrukmiṇīsatyabhāme dve dakṣe vāme sthite prabhoḥsuśīlā lakṣmaṇā ceti samāvṛtya striyaḥ sthitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: smartavyāḥ svarṇaratnādidharā dugdhalasatkarāḥtatogre dikpatīndevānpūjayedapi pūrvavatpūrvoditaprakāreṇa pīṭhanyāsāvasānakamprāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā ṛṣyādinyāsamācaretvyāpakaṃ mūlamantreṇa vinyasya ca karātpunaḥpuṭitaṃ mūlamantreṇa mātṛkāvatpravinyasetp. 659)mūrtipañjarakasthāne mūrtipañjaramācaretgomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau pīṭhaṃ pravinyasetkāmabījaṃ karṇikāyāṃ sasādhyaṃ sulikhettataḥśakrarākṣasavāyūnāṃ koṇe śrībījamālikhetkoṇasandhiṣu ṣaḍvarṇamantrasyaikaikamakṣarambahiraṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ keśareṣu triśastriśaḥsulikhetkāmataḥ paścādvarṇānatha daleṣu calikhedvarṇāndhṛtidale bahirvṛttadvayaṃ likhetdharāpure caturdikṣu ramāṃ māyāṃ ca koṇagāmsamyaksaṃpūjya prajapeddhṛtaṃ ca manujottamaiḥkaromi lokapūjyaṃ taṃ rājavaśyaṃ ca sarvadātatra mūrtti prakalpyāsyāṃ kṛṣṇamāvāhya pūjayetcaturthe'ṅgācca mūlāntaṃ bhūṣaṇādi prapūjayetdakṣordhvahaste cakrāya vāmordhve kambave namaḥskandhādipādaparyantaṃ nābhyantopari mālikāmṣaṭsu pūrvādikoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni samarcayetśāntiṃ śriyaṃ bhāratīṃ ca ratiṃ digdalakeśaredakṣavāmakramātpaścāddevadevaṃ samarcayetdalāgrasthāstataḥ pūjyāḥ pūjanīyāḥ [pūjanīyāḥ kramādamītyeteṣāmuttaratra sambandhaḥ] kramādamī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 660)śaṅkhapadmau ca tadbāhye lokeśānāyudhānyapihareḥ pāyasakhaṇḍādidadhibhiḥ parikīrttitampunaḥ sañcintya sampūjya prajapecchaktito manumsarpiṣā juhuyātpaścāddaśāṃśaṃ tarpayettataḥitthaṃ sādhitamantrastu prayogānvidadhīta vaiayutaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktairhutvā tadbhasma dhārayetmantrārṇairlakṣasaṅkhyaṃ yo hunenmadhurasānvitaiḥraktādivasanākāṃkṣī hunetpuṣpaiśca tādṛśaiḥmadhunā saṃyutaiścaiva sugandhāṣṭakasaṃyutaiḥrājñaḥ purohito bhūtvā bhuktibhāṅnātra saṃśayaḥmantreṇānena kurvīta tābhyāṃ mantrottamādvarātjāyate hastagā tasya sakalā vasudhā ciramante yāti paraṃ dhāma vaiṣṇavaṃ munidurlabhamlakṣmīśaktimanojātabījānte daśavarṇakamṛṣyādikaṃ daśārṇoktaṃ pañcāṅgamapi tādṛśamabjotpalalasaddhastapadmayāliṅgitaṃ mudāevaṃ dhyātvā japenmantraṃ daśalakṣaṃ samāhitaḥtarpaṇādyairbhavenmantraḥ siddhośeṣaphalapradaḥp. 661)daśārṇavajjapaścāpi vidheyo nātra saṃśayaḥmāyāśrīsahito mantro daśārṇo dvādaśākṣaraḥvidhānamasya vijñeyaṃ ṣoḍaśārṇoktavartmanādevaḥ prāguktavattatra mantrasiddhirdrutaṃ bhavetye mantrā daśavarṇasya bhedāḥ siddhividhāyakāḥlakṣmīmāyāsmarādyaśca mantrarājo daśākṣaraḥmunyādyantu vidhisteṣāṃ paṅktyāmuktavidhānataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viṃśārṇoktaṃ dvitīye tu prathametha nigadyatevaṃśamādāya hastābhyāṃ vādayantaṃ mudānvitamaṅgendrādikavajrādyairarcanā sarvasiddhidātarpaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā siddhamantraḥ samācaretdaśāṣṭādaśavarṇoktānaṣṭāviṃśe kalāvitiaṣṭādaśākṣaro mantraḥ kāmāntotra prakīrttitaḥṣaḍdīrghānvitakāmena ṣaḍaṃgavidhirīritaḥvāme navīnamājyasya piṇḍaṃ sundaramadbhutamtarppaṇādi tataḥ kuryyātprāgvadbrāhmaṇabhojanamaṃgalokeśavajrādyairarcanāsya samīritatātasyaiva strīmukhāmbhojamarcayenmantramuccaranyadyadicchati tatsarvaṃ tarppaṇenaiva sidhyatiaiṃklīṃ kṛṣṇāya cetyuktvā govindāya ramāṃ vadetaṣṭādaśalipiḥ proktaṃ munyādyaṃ cāṅgakalpanamadhaḥkarābhyāṃ muralīṃ vādayantaṃ manoharammayūrapakṣasambaddhakeśajālaśriyānvitampañcapañceṣuvedatrivarṇai(ṃ)ḥ pañcāṅgakalpanamtarpaṇādi tataḥ kuryānmantrī pūrvoktavartmanādevasyānugrahāttasya sukhaṃ padmākṣikodbhavamgadyapadyātmikā tasya bruvato bhāratī sadādhyānaṃ pūrvoktamapyante dehaṃ tyaktvā hari vrajettāro namo bhagavate nandaputrāya nanda casvāhāṣṭāviṃśadarṇoyaṃ munirasya tu nāradaḥācakrādipadaiḥ prāgvatpañcāṅgaṃ parikīrtitambahantaṃ madhyagaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ strībhyāmāliṅgitaṃ sadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lakṣaṃ japetprajuhuyāddhaviṣā sarvasiddhayenandaputrasya [nandaputrāya śyāmalāṅgāya bālavapuṣe kṛṣṇagovindāyagopījanavallabhāyasvāhā ||] śabdānte śyāmalāṅgāya kīrtayetgovindāya daśārṇaṃ ca dvātriṃśadvarṇa īritaḥaṣṭādaśārṇakaproktaprayogā iha varṇitāḥoṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ hṛdbhagavate nandaputrāya bālavadvicatvāriṃśadarṇoyaṃ chandonuṣṭubvidhirmuniḥrāmaikādaśapañceṣudhṛtyarṇairaṅgakalpanammantroyaṃ sakalaiśvaryakāṃkṣitārthaikasādhanaḥtāro namo bhagavate rukmiṇīvallabhāya cachandonuṣṭubdevatāsya rukmiṇīvallabhaḥ smṛtaḥkalayā śyāmalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nānālaṅkāramaṇḍitampītakauśeyasadvastraṃ svarṇavetravibhūṣitamvāmahastadhṛtāmbhojāṃ tāṃ samāliṅgitāṃ priyāmpūjanaṃ dharmakarmārthaṃ niḥśreyasaphalapradamdaśāṃśaṃ kamalaiḥ paścāttarpaṇādi samācaretabhīṣṭakṛtprayogādyaṃ vijñeyantu daśārṇavatlīlādaṇḍaṃ suśikṣantaṃ gopījanapadaṃ vrajetbhagavanprabhaviṣṇo syādevantu triṃśadakṣaraḥlīlādaṇḍadharaḥ kṛṣṇo devastu parikīrtitaḥpurāṅganāśca sākūtaṃ mohayantaṃ mahāprabhumhatakaṃsaṃ smaretkṛṣṇamaprameyaparākramamtrimadhvaktairhunetpaścānmārjanādi samācaretp. 664) śubhagaḥ sa jagadvandyo ramāyā bhavanaṃ bhavetgovallabhāya svāheti mantraḥ saptākṣaro mataḥdaśārṇoktavidhānena pañcāṅgavidhirīritaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarppāripicchanikaraiḥ samyakkḷptāvataṃsakamkapilāṃ vanamadhyasthāmāhvayantaṃ ca gāṃ mudāādāvaṅgāni sampūjya pūjayedyo gaṇāṣṭakamkālaḥ karṇātmakaśceti tataḥ proktaṃ gaṇāṣṭakampurandaramukhāsteṣāmāyudhāni tataḥ paramtatsahasraṃ hunenmantrī godugdhena puroktavatmokṣārthaṃ ca gavāṃ vṛddhirjāyate tasya bhūyasīsarve prayogāḥ siddhyanti sampūrṇāḥ syurmanorathāḥtāro namo bhagavate śrīgovindāya saṃvadetgāyatrī chanda uddiṣṭaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo devatā manoḥkalpadrumatale ramye ratnasiṃhāsane śubheprasnutastanabhāreṇa govṛndena yutaṃ bhajetpadmāyatākṣaṃ śakrasya hastikumbhāmṛtasya turukmiṇīsatyabhāmādibhāgayorvāmadakṣayoḥrudrādivaruṇānteṣu keśareṣu caturṣvapināgnajitī sunandā ca mitravindā sulakṣaṇāāgneyādiṣu sampūjyāḥ kiṃkiṇīdāmayaṣṭikāḥvanamālāṃ bhūpuretha devāgrādipradakṣiṇamnandaṃ yaśodāṃ dhenūśca gopālāṃścāpi gopikāḥpuṇḍarīkaṃ vāmanaṃ ca śaṃkukarṇaṃ tataḥ paramdevasyāntarato vāme viṣvaksenaṃ samarcayettatsahasrāṇi gokṣīrairjuhuyāttarpayettataḥdinādāvatha madhyāhne samayatritayethavābhaktyā paramayopeto gopālāṁśca samarcayettasmādbhajedamuṃ mantraṃ drutaṃ siddhipradaṃ śive
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vadedgokulanāthāya namontoṣṭākṣaro manuḥvarṇadvayena pañcāṅgaṃ sakalena prakalpayetprañcāntike ca dhāvantaṃ madanena purānvitamnānāmunigaṇairdṛṣṭaṃ sevitaṃ sarvalīlayācaturaṅgāni sampūjya cāstraṃ koṇeṣu pūjayettadbahirlokapālānāṃ vajrādīnāṃ ca pūjanamtarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā samṛddhirmahatī bhavettāraṃ ramāṃ hriyaṃ kāmaṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya tato vadetṅento bījatrayaṃ cādyaṃ pañcaviṃśākṣaro manuḥvedavedeṣu gorāmasampūrṇena ṣaḍaṅgakampūjājapaprayogādi sarvaṃ jñeyaṃ daśārṇavatekacchandarṣidevādiprayoganyāsakāvapināradosya munirdevo gāyatraṃ chanda ucyateṣaḍaṅgāni tato dhyāyetsaṃsthitaṃ kamalādikehastābhyāṃ navanītaṃ ca pāyasaṃ cāpi bibhratammeghaśyāmaṃ ca parito gopagopījanāvṛtamhṛdādikavacāntāni cārcedaṅgāni sādhakaḥākhaṇḍalamukhāṃścaiva vajrādīnyāyudhāni cakṛtvā brāhmaṇabhojyāntaṃ svepsitārthāllaṁbhennaraḥviprādipādajāntāstu nāmamantrādhikāriṇaḥoṃkṛṣṇa iti mantroyaṃ trivarṇaḥ parikīrttitaḥmunibhistu viśeṣeṇa saṃsevyo bhuktimuktidaḥmunyādikaṃ prayogāntaṃ sarvaṃ prāgvatsamācaretkṛṣṇāya hṛdayaṃ pañcavarṇaḥ prāgvajjapādikammadhyekṛṣṇāya pañcārṇaḥ sarvaṃ pūrvavadeva hi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaḍakṣaroyaṃ munyādiprayogāntaṃ ca pūrvavatṣaḍakṣaro mantrarājo japadhyānādi pūrvavatgovindāyeti saptārṇaḥ prāgvanmunyādikaṃ matamkṛṣṇāya kāmabījaṃ ca prāgvatsaptākṣaro manuḥbhakṣaṇāya dviṭhāntoyamaṣṭavarṇaḥ prakīrttitaḥaṣṭavarṇaḥ samākhyāto munyādyaṃ pūrvavanmatamgovindāya punaḥ kāmo navārṇaḥ parikīrttitaḥṅentaśca hṛdayāntaśca manuḥ prokto navākṣaraḥśyāmalāṅgāya hṛdayaṃ daśārṇaḥ parikīrttitaḥkṛṣṇāya vahnijāyānto mantraḥ prokto daśākṣaraḥnandeti bālavapuṣe svāhā paṃcadaśākṣaraḥkāmabījadvayaṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ vedārṇa ucyatetadvaddhyānaṃ viśeṣotra kalpavṛkṣatale sthitammahāpadmaśca padmaśca śaṅkho makarakacchapaulokapālaiśca vajrādyaiḥ paścādāvaraṇadvayamdaśāṃśaṃ juhuyādagnau śrīphalairmadhuraplutaiḥmadhuratrayasadbuddhyā śuddhatoyairdināgamebhuktiprado muktidaśca sarvakāmapradastvitikṛṣṇasyādau dvayoḥ kāmabījayoraṃkayojanātṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena tādṛśenāṅgakalpanamkiṃṅkiṇīsaṃvṛtakaṭiṃ nīlakuñcitamūrddhajamp. 668) prāgvatpūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ puraścaryyā tatheritātarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā guruṃ yatnena toṣayetmaṇḍalātsarvasasyādi vastujātaṃ tadā bhavetvāglajjāklīṃramāhrīṃgrīṃjrīṃtrīṃjayajayeti [oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ hrīṃ grīṃ jrīṃ trīṃ jayajaya kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa nirantaraṃ krīṃ trīṃ nityapramuditaretasre nityakriyāya kṛṣṇāya klīṃ gopījanavallabhāya svāhā grīṃ hrīṃ ||] ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: krīṃ trīṃ nityapramuditaretase padamuccaretya svāhā grīṃ ca hrīṃ ceti dvipañcāśallipirmanuḥsammohanahariḥ prokto mantravarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakamaṣṭabhī ravibhirnetrairnavabhiśca nakhendubhiḥhastadvaye daśārṇoktavidhinā nyāsamācarettrivāraṃ mūlamantreṇa vyāpakaṃ ca tataścaretdaśatattvādikaṃ nyasya tadante mūrtipañjaramsarvamanyatpuroktena vidhānena vidhāya vaipure ca maṇije ramye parvatāmbudhimadhyageudyānavāpikāvāṭīnānājanamanoharenānāratnagaṇākīrṇe gehe sañcintayeddharimnānāsugandharuciramaṅkanyastakarāmbujamāliṃgya tāṃ ca bāhubhyāṃ śvetamuktāvibhūṣitamp. 669) cakravajjāmbavatyā ca śliṣṭaṃ vāmasthayā tathāpadmaṃ gadāṃ śaṃkhacakre caturbhirdadhataṃ karaiḥcaturdikṣu bahirdevairmunibhiḥ sevakairvṛtamviṃśārṇoditayantraṃ ca samyagatra sulekhayethrīṃtrīṃhrīṃtrīṃ ca bījāni śiṣṭairvarṇaiḥ praveṣṭayetṣaṭkoṇetha kramāllekhyaṃ aiṃhrīṃśrīmīśakoṇataḥarghyapātrādi saṃsthāpya madhyabīje hariṃ yajetaṅgāni ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu vāmāṃke sarvagāṃ yajetyajetkṛṣṇāgramadhye tu pṛṣṭhagaṃ cāṃjanaṃ dhanuḥsarvadā cāpi varṣantau dhārābhirvastusañcayamviṣvaksenaṃ ca koṇeṣu varṇagānpakṣiṇo yajettadbahirvāsavādīnāṃ vajrādīnāṃ ca pūjanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yacca ekānte niyamena cayadvācayitvā śraddhābhaktiṃ vidhāya calokānāṃ yācitaṃ devanāmataḥsamāśritya kaulaṃ dharmaṃ vicārya cayatkāmataḥ karma caihikaṃ pāralaukikamyatpānaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ kāmato ratammokṣaḥ syātsvargaḥ syānmiśrasattvataḥsyādrājasācchuddhātkāmaḥ syānmiśrarājasātsāttvikāttāmasāddevayonitvaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥpañcavidhaṃ proktaṃ pañcadhā muktidāyakamsammārjanopalepādisaṃskārā devamandirepūjāsādhanasāmagryā melanaṃ bhaktasevanampīṭhapūrvāṅgapūrvañca ṣoḍaśādyupacārakaiḥtacchāstrādhyayanaṃ samyakkṛtvā mantrārthabhājanamgurudevātmakālānāṃ samyagaikyavibhāvanamyāme smarediṣṭāṃ ca devatāmgṛhādbahirgatvā kṛtvāvaśyakamādarātācamya śuddhadehaḥ syāddevatāyogamandirenivedyātha dadyādvai dantadhāvanamproṃchanāyātha dadyādvāso'malaṃ śubhamsmarettatra śrīguruṃ nijarūpiṇamvarābhayajñānamudrāpustakairvyāvṛtaiḥ karaiḥvāmāṅkagatayā śaktyāliṅgitaṃ raktavarṇayāvāmalīlākamalayāliṅgaṃtyā dakṣiṇena catatpādapadmayugalacyutapīyūṣadhārayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: varjayetprajapellakṣaṃ strīmātrasya gurorapitarppaṇaṃ mārjjanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥsamarcayati gīrvāṇāṁllokānandakaraśca saḥanvahaṃ tarppayedyastu śataṃ sāgraṃ bhaveddhruvamcandracandanapaṃkāktamālatīkusumairyavaiḥtrailokyaṃ tadvaśe tiṣṭhetkhyātaḥ kavivaro bhavetvaśyā bhavaṃti satataṃ smarārtāḥ surayoṣitaḥgrahendirā sadasyā syātsevane bhaktitatparāvipattiduḥkhadaurbhāgyamṛtyvādirahitaḥ sadāsampannaḥ sarvasampatyā yaśasvī dīrghajīvanaḥyajjapādeva putrāderutpattirbhavati dhruvamdehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥchandonuṣṭubdevatā ca kṛṣṇaḥ santānadāyakaḥśaṅkhacakradharaṃ devaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ caturbhujamsamarppayantaṃ viprāya naṣṭānānīya bālakānarcanā cendravajrādyairuditāsya mahātmanaḥtarppaṇādi tataḥ kuryyānmantraḥ siddhyati mantriṇaḥputrārthaṃ śāntikaṃ kṛtvā tatrastho viṣṇumarccayetsa varṣāllabhate putraṃ vinītaṃ cirajīvinamvāsudevāya huṃphaṭ ca svāhā viṃśārṇako manuḥnyāsadhyānajapārccādi daśavarṇoktavadbhavetkamabījātmako mantro munirmohananāradaḥṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena ṣaḍaṃgāni prakalpayetaṃgulīṣu nyasedaṃgaṃ hastayostalayorapibījasampuṭitānnyasya mātṛkārṇānanantaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaḍaṅgāni punarnyasya yathāsthāne śarānnyasetśeṣatatpramukhānetānpañcabījaprapūrvakānmūle lasatsthalīrājadratnasiṃhāsanopariariśaṅkhasṛṇīnpāśaṃ puṣpabāṇekṣukārmukamghūrṇanetraṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ hāriṇaṃ sukirīṭinamāliṅgantaṃ vāmabāhudhṛtapadmāvaliṃ vibhumpaścādaṅgāni bāṇāṃñca nyāsamārgeṇa pūjayetcakrādyaṃ triṣu hasteṣu śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ tathāpītāmbaraṃ mahālakṣmīṃ vāmāṃke bījapūrvikāmtato bahiścarānbāṇāndikṣu koṇeṣu pūjayetindrādīnpūjayedbāhye vajrādīnyāyudhānyapitrisvādvaktaistarppayecca sahasradvādaśāvadhianena manunā toyairmohinīpuṣpasaṃyutaiḥtrailokyaṃ mohayedyastu japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥp. 672) ayutaṃ sarpiṣā hutvā sasampātaṃ hutāśaneyastu tadvaśagā sā syātsāpi taṃ vaśamānayetathātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi rāmaṣaṣṭimite kalautanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayātnāśayetsarvapāpāni siddheyaṃ kalpavallikāyathāyogyaṃ japetsādhyamasādhyaṃ ca prasiddhyatiglaumityekākṣaro mantro jagatī chanda īritambījaṃ gakāra oṃ kāraḥ śaktiḥ proktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakamglauṃ nābhau tu tathauṃ gulphe binduṃ pādadvaye nyasetpadmopari sthitaṃ vande veṇuṃ gāyantamīśvaramgopībhirgopavṛndaiśca sevitaṃ kṛṣṇamarccayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lakṣāyutasahasrāṇi catvāryyasya japo manoḥevaṃ saṃsiddhamantrastu daśārṇoktaprayogakānkuryyādiha tu saubhāgyamante yāti hareḥ puramkāmabījāntare kṛṣṇamantroyaṃ tryakṣaro mataḥkṛṣṇaḥ kakāro bījaṃ syādīkāraḥ śaktirucyatedhyānapūjā prayogādi piṅgagopālavanmatamtāro namaśca kṛṣṇāya mantro rasamitārṇakaḥp. 673)athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi vasuṣaṣṭimite kalauhuṃ bhīṣayadvayaṃ hṛcca humantaṃ trāsayadvayamvarma pradhvaṃsayayugaṃ varmāntaṃ rakṣayadvayamaṣṭāṅgāni nyasenmantrī mantravarṇairyathāvidhividadhyātkarayornyāsaṃ mantrārṇairaṣṭabhiḥ sudhīḥsṛṣṭiretadvaiparītyaṃ saṃhāro gaditaḥ sthitiḥdrāvaṇyādyabījayutāmaṃguṣṭhādiṣu vinyasettāto bāṇārṇapuṭitāṃ mātṛkāṃ ca pravinyasetteja āpo dharā ceti tattvāṣṭakamudīritammukhe śīrṣe hṛdi punarhṛdaye sakalāṅgakeeṣā sṛṣṭiśca nābhyādyā hṛdantā sthitirīritāmantrārṇānāmayaṃ proktastridhā nyāso dhanapradaḥmantrārṇānvinyasenmatrī nyāsoyaṃ dārḍhyakārakaḥpṛṣṭhe ca vinyasedvarṇānnyāsoyaṃ śubhakārakaḥkūrpare cāṃsake nyasya manorvarṇāndhanapradānmantrasya vinyasedvarṇānnyāsoyaṃ kāmyakaḥ smṛtaḥaṃguṣṭhādau nyasedvarṇānpañcamo dharmavṛddhikṛtdakṣorumūle jānau ca gulphe pañcāṃgulīṣu ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dakṣāṃguṣṭhaṃ samārabhya vāmamadhyācca vinyasetevantu pādayornyasyennyāsoyaṃ daśamo bhavetpādayośca nyasedvarṇānnyāsa ekādaśaḥ smṛtaḥkarmaṇā vinyasedvarṇānnyāsoyaṃ dvādaśaḥ smṛtaḥdakṣasphici ca jaṃghāyāṃ pādeyantu trayodaśaḥprathamārṇaṃ pādatale padapādāgrajānuṣuvakṣaḥ pṛṣṭhahṛdayeṣu kaṇṭhe vaktre nasostalesarvopadravahantāyaṃ nyāsaḥ pañcadaśaḥ smṛtaḥṣoḍaśoyamiti proktastattvapañjarasajñakaḥnṛsiṃhaṃ pañcame proktamāceranmūrtipañjaramūrvorvaiśyaṃ śūdravarṇaṃ pādayoriti vinyasetgraiveyaṃ kaustumaṃ kaṇṭhe hṛdi śrīvatsahārakamkaṅkaṇe hastayornyasya mekhalāṃ ca kaṭau nyasetparidhāne cottarīyaṃ pādayornūpuraṃ tathāadhaḥpāṇyorgadāpadme tato dhyānaṃ samācaretvanaṃ sañcintayettatra sakalarttusamanvitamsurāsurarṣipramukhaiḥ sevitaṃ cāpsarogaṇaiḥpūrvoktapīṭhe mūlena mūrtiṃ saṅkalya cāhvayetśriyaṃ pītāmbarāktāṃ ca dhṛtiṃ kāntiṃ sitāsiteaṣṭalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ niyamastho jitendriyaḥjalaiḥ saghṛtadugdhānnaistarppaṇādi samācarettataḥ kurvīta mantrajñaḥ prayogāṃśca prasiddhayemadhuratrayasaṃyuktaiḥ palāśakusumairhunettrisvāduyuktaṃ lavaṇaṃ hunenniśi sahasrakamayutaṃ juhuyādājyaṃ dūrvābhaktaiśca śodhitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vastrālaṅkaraṇādyaiśca brāhmaṇānapi bhojayetsūryyabimbe nyastadṛṣṭirabdena satataṃ japetaṣṭādhikaṃ sahasraṃ tu sa bhavedgoramānvitaḥṣaṭkarmāṇi ca siddhyanti yāti viṣṇoḥ parampadamyajjapenāvatārotra sarvakālaphalapradaḥnāvatāraḥ sa evātra devaḥ pratyakṣatā gataḥavatārotra mantrastu śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ mamadhyānapūjāprayogādi daśākṣaravadīritamsabhyatvānna dvijātīnāmadhikārosti karhicitgolakāśca tathā jātyā kāyasthādaya eva capatitānāmayaṃ mantraḥ samproktaḥ śaraṇapradaḥp. 676)kalikālādahaṃ bhītaḥ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃgataḥṣaḍaṅgavidhirākhyātaḥ sarveṇa vyāpakaṃ caretgauraṃ muṇḍitasarvāṅgaṃ dhyānastimitalocanamindrādilokapālaiśca tāmravarṇāmbarāvṛtamkarṇikāyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni dale śiṣyānyajetkramātsarvajñaṃ sugataṃ buddhaṃ pārśvanāthaṃ tathāgatamkāminīṃ ca mahāmāyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ca vināyakamṣaḍabhijñaṃ daśabalaṃ śāstāraṃ śrīghanaṃ kṣayamtadbāhye bhūpure dikpāṃstadastrāṇi ca pūjayettulasīmiśratoyaiśca bhagavantaṃ pratarppayetevaṃ tu vartamānasya vāksiddhyādi prajāyatebhūtapretādipīḍāyāṃ mahāgadabhaye tathākaṃkalkine hṛdantoyaṃ mantraḥ proktaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥmantroyamatigopyastu stutyaśca nṛpanāśakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahāmudrāḍhyahastaṃ ca kaustubhoddāmakaṇṭhakamantarhitairdevamunigandharvaiḥ saṃstutaṃ harimṣaḍaṅgāni ca patreṣu pūjayettasya sevakānkālaṃ nīlaṃ lokapālānbhūpure hetayastathā [pūjyā iti śeṣaḥ ||]tarpayetsalilaiḥ śuddhaiḥ prīṇayedbhūsurānapietatsādhakamālokya dūrato duḥkṣitīśvarāḥdinedine vardhate śrīrmṛto vaikuṇṭhamāpnuyātdaśāvatārarūpasya kimanyacchrotumicchasiiti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte daśāvatāramantraprakāśaḥ ṣaḍviṃśaḥcaturviṃśatimūrttināṃ mantrāṃśca medhunā vadabhuktimuktipradān viprairārādhyānsacaturthakaiḥvarṇatrayātmako mantraḥ keśavaḥ parikīrttitaḥānābhipādaparyyantaṃ maṅgalaṃ madhusammitambhujaiṣṣaḍbhirdadhānaṃ ca raktavarṇaṃ ca satkaṭimmayūramukuṭaṃ ramyaṃ makarākṛtikuṇḍalamsanakādīnkarṇikāyāṃ gaṇeśaṃ nandikeśvaramdalāgreṣu kramāccāpi prahrādaṃ nāradaṃ balimagradakṣakramādgāṃ ca haṃsaṃ pakṣīśvaraṃ tathājapellakṣatrayaṃ mantraṃ madhuratritayairhunetiha loke sukhaṃ prāpya mṛto mokṣamavāpnuyātnamo nārāyaṇāyeti tārādyaṣṭākṣaro manuḥdevatā paramātmāsya pañcāṅgavidhirucyatepañcāṅgamantrāḥ samproktā aṃguṣṭhādāvapi nyasetsṛṣṭinyāsoyamuddiṣṭassaṃhāraścāraṇādikaḥmūrdhni netradvaye caiva sumukhānte tathā hṛdi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvanyāseṣu tāreṇa puṭitārṇānpravinyasetnabhideśe prathamako nyāsoya parikīrttitaḥpṛṣṭhe ceti dvitīyoyaṃ nyāsastu parikīrttitaḥkrameṇa vinyasedvarṇānnyāsoyaṃ syāttṛtīyakaḥdaśahaste caturthaḥ syādvāmabāhau ca pañcamaḥnyāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhoyamudito vāmāṃghrau saptamaḥ smṛtaḥhṛdi dhyātvā nyasedvarṇānnyāsoyaṃ cāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥpādayośca nyasedvarṇānnyāsoyaṃ navamaḥ smṛtaḥvāmordhvakaragaṃ cakraṃ dakṣedhaḥ karaśaṃkhakamvibhūtipañjarākhyoyaṃ nyāso daśavidhaḥ smṛtaḥtattvāṣṭakamidaṃ binduyugvarṇāḍyaṃ tathoktavatpalliṅgahṛnmukhe śīrṣe netrahṛdvyāpakeṣu cabindunādaśaktiśāntirūpamātmacatuṣṭayammūrttipañjaravinyāsaṃ praṇavādyaṃ samācaretiṃ mādhavāya mitrāya namaḥ procya hṛdi nyasetuṃ viṣṇave cāṃśumate namo dakṣiṇapārśvakeeṃ trivikramāya vivasvate hṛddakṣagaṇḍakeoṃ śrīdharāya pūṣṇe ca namo vāmāṃsake nyasetdamodarāya kakudi sargānto viṣṇave namaḥśaṃkhacakragadāpadmahastaṃ pītāmbarāvṛtamātmajyotiḥsampradīptasahasrādityatejasamdvisaptatyakṣaro mantro vyāpakatvena coditaḥtāroktyā khādikān varṇān sabindūn hṛdayāntakānjīvaṃ prāṇaṃ sarvatanau nyasedevaṃ dvayaṃ budhaḥmastakānanahṛdguhyapādāṃseṣu ca vaikramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrotratvagakṣijihvākhyaghrāṇānāṃ tattvapañcakamvākpāṇipāyupādākhyopasthānāṃ tattvapañcakamākāśavāyutejāṃsi jalakṣmātattvapañcakamtatastu hṛdaye nyasyenmaṇḍalatritayaṃ punaḥhaṃsaraṃ varṇapūrvaṃ ca yojayitvā ca pūrvavatnyasedoṃkhāṃnamaḥ proktā parāya parameṣṭhinetāroyaṃ nama ityuktvā puruṣāyapadaṃ vadetoṃraṃ namaḥ parāyeti nivṛttiṃ ṅentanāmanioṃlaṃ namaḥ parāyeti śarvāyeti padaṃ vadetoṃkṣrauṃ namaḥ parāyeti nṛsiṃhāya padaṃ vadetevaṃ vinyasya vidhivatsākṣānnārāyāṇo bhavetvaiṣṇavīrdarśayenmudrāḥ pūrvoktāśca tataḥ paramūrdhvaṃ cādho dakṣabhedād ghaṇṭāṃ ca kamalaṃ gadāmkeyūrahāramukuṭaṃ sapītāmbarakuṇḍalamnavaśaktisamāyukte pīṭhe devaṃ yajettataḥprabhā satyā tatheśānānugrahā nava śaktayaḥsarvātmane vāsudevāya sākṣiṇe padamuccaretpīṭhamantraḥ samākhyātaḥ saptatriṃśadbhirakṣaraiḥtubhyaṃ tamabhidhāsyāmi mantramāvāhanasya cayajñabhāgaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ vāsudeva namostu tekarṇikāyāṃ yathāsthānaṃ yajedaṅgāni pūrvavatdikpatreṣvarcayedvāsudevaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ tathāgaurahāridrakṛṣṇākhyaśuklanīlanibhānkramātśuklasvarṇapayaḥśyāmasaṅkāśāścārubhūṣaṇāḥarcenmusalakhaḍgau ca vanamālāṃ dalāgrataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ataḥ śaṅkhanidhi padmanidhī raktotha raktabhākāgneyādidaleṣvete pūjyāścāgre digīśvarāḥnārāyaṇasya gāyatrīṃ bravīmyekamanāḥ śruṇutanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayātyogyaḥ syādviṣṇudīkṣāyāṃ dvijavatpāpavarjitaḥp. 681)juhuyāttarppayetkṛṣṇacandraṃ ca keśarāmbubhiḥevaṃ siddhamanurmantrī prayogantu samācaretsammukhīkaraṇe dhyāyedviṣṇuṃ garuḍagāminamguḍūcīrayutaṃ hutvā mṛtyumevātitarjjayetjapedaṣṭottaraśataṃ sa bhavedapamṛtyujitnirastapātako bhūtvā nīrogo jñānavānbhavetjapitvā yastu bhuñjāno dhīmānārogyavānbhavetyaḥ pibellabhate medhāṃ kavitābodhanaṃ ca saḥdhārayeddakṣiṇe haste sarvataḥ syātsurakṣitaḥete hyaṣṭau mantravarṇā mantrāṣṭakamudīryyatejamadagnirvaśiṣṭhaśca kaśyapotrirghaṭodbhavaḥtriṣṭup ca jagatī caiva virāṭ chandāṃsyanukramātpratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vijñeyā devatāḥ kramāttattvāni saptalokāstu kṣetrāṇi khacarātmakāḥpadmakiñjalkanīlābhaṃ raktavarṇāṣṭako mataḥpracayastricaturvarṇairnihataṃ pañcamākṣaramsāntarāḥ syuḥ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakarāḥ kramātaṅgānyantimapatre tu madhyasthaṃ punararcayetdvitīyāvaraṇaṃ proktamantravarṇāṣṭamūrttibhiḥtṛtīyeṣṭadale proktā ratiścāpi dhṛtistathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vajrādibhiścaturthī syātprāgvatṣaṣṭhī sapañcamīnākārāvṛttipūjāyāmāvṛttitrayapūjanetṛtīyāvaraṇe pūjyā śrīrmāyā ca manonmanīyavarṇamūrtipūjāyāntulyamevāvṛtidvayamśokāramūrttipūjāyāṃ prāgvadāvaraṇadvayamśaṃkhapālaśca kulikaḥ proktamatrāvṛtidvayamvāsudevādibhiḥ śāntyādiyuktairamayā matācaturthyāmaṣṭapatre tu vajrādīnāṃ samarcanamṣaṣṭhyāmindrādikāścāgre tadastrāṇīti pūjanamiha loke sukhaṃ prāpya viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyātnārāyaṇasya caraṇau śaraṇaṃ ca tato vadetnamo jinārṇako mantro munyādyaṃ pūrvavanmatamdhyānapūjāprayogādi pūrvavatparikīrttitamkṣiprasiddhikaraḥ kāśyāṃ yadvāsau dhruvapūrvakaḥdvādaśārṇo mahāmantraḥ pañcāṅgāni kramātpadaiḥbaddhāñjalī ramā vāme vādayantī ca vallakīmprasannavadanaṃ dhyāyedvaradānasamudyatampañcāṅgapūrvamabhyarcya yajedaṣṭadale kramātgaṅgāmasīṃ ca varuṇāṃ gaṇḍakīṃ ca dalāṣṭakevibhīṣaṇaṃ ca prahrādaṃ bāhye ṣoḍaśapatrakeḍhuṇḍhirājaṃ viśālākṣaṃ ḍhuṇḍhibhairavamīśvaramjainendraṃ ca mahāmāyaṃ bhūpure dikpatīnapiśāntyādiguṇasampanno dhavanānmuktibhāgbhavetgovindāya namaśceti ṣaḍarṇo manurīritaḥṣaḍaṅgaṃ mantravarṇaiḥ syātsarveṇa vyāpakaṃ caret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: arcayedgandhapuṣpādyairbāhyasthairmānasaistu vāhṛnmanunā bhāvayettallayaṃ hṛdisuṣumṇāṃtaṃ sahasravisasannibhamviciṃtyātha prāṇāyāmatra yaṃ caretvidhāyā'tha hṛdi devaṃ vicintayetdharāṃ śvāsayuktaṃ pādaṃ nidhāpayetpādasparśaṃ kṣamasvamesmaredastrandūre [phaṭ iti mantram |] yāyād dvijālayātkīṭayoṣādirahitaṃ śaucasthānamidampaṭhetparitastyajyatāṃ sthānaṃ viṇmūtrotsarjanāya metatra vāsasā kaṃ [jalam |] praviśya caliṅge gude sapta daśa vāmakare tathākaradvaye caikā pādayorathavā caretgaṇḍūṣānpūrīṣotsarjanāntare [viṣṭhātyage |]dantadhāvanakāṣṭhaṃ tu proktaṃ tantravicakṣaṇaiḥmūlānuno nityaṃ lakṣayetsiddhihetaveyāyājjalaniketanamkṛtvā taṭaṃ tatra caikabhāge vicakṣaṇaḥmattikāgomayābhyāñca kaṭyantaṃ snānamācaretvaidikasnānaṃ tadaṅgaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathāsamādāyāstramantreṇa mantrayitvā tṛṇādikammūrddhādipādaparyantaṃ vilipya praṇamejjalamtato jātāstā āpaḥ praṇamāmyahamtūṣṇīmutthāya nābhimātre jale naraḥmūlamantreṇa prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: garuḍopari saṃsthaṃ ca sanakādyairupāsitamlokarakṣākaraṃ divyaṃ divyamālyānulepanamdevamāvāhya mantrāṅgaiḥ prathamāvṛtirīritāsanakaḥ syāttatopyagre sanandanasanātanauśaunakoṣṭama eva syāccaturthī lokapālakaiḥlakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ huned ghṛtaiḥevaṃ kṛtaprayogasya roganāśo bhaviṣyativastrārthī puṣpahomena ārogyārthī tilairhunetaṣṭottarasahasrāṇi jvaranāśo bhaveddhruvamdhyāyellabhedramāṃ [ramayatīti ramā tām sundarīmiti yāvat ||] kanyāṃ kulīnāṃ ca kuṭumbinīmviṣṇave nama ityeṣa mantraḥ paṃcākṣaro mataḥp. 684)pañcavarṇaiḥ samastena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥpītāmbaraṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ dhyāyettaṃ bhūṣaṇānvitambaliṃ vibhīṣaṇaṃ bhīṣmaṃ prahlādaṃ nāradārjunaubhūpure dikpatīniṣṭvā tadastrāṇi tato bahiḥtarppaṇairmārjanairviprabhojanairāśu siddhyatina kadāciddaridraḥ syāddūrvābhiḥ syādarogatācampakaiḥ striyamāpnoti mālatyāpi sukhī bhavetpārijātaistu saundaryyaṃ nātaḥ parataro manuḥtāro namo bhagavate ṅentaśca madhusūdanaḥchandonuṣṭubdevatā tu bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥśeṣatalpaprasuptaṃ tu lakṣmīsaṃvāhitāṃghrikampītāmbaraṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ madhukaiṭabhamārakamyoganidrāṃ mahāmāyāṃ kālarātriṃ ca kālikāmevaṃ sampūjya deveśaṃ japellakṣacatuṣṭayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tarppaṇaṃ mārjanaṃ kuryāmantrasiddhiḥ prajāyatepalāśakusumairhutvā śatrūṇāṃ stambhayedbalammālatyā cātulā lakṣmīranyatpūrvavadevatutāraṃ namo bhagavate vyāhṛtitritayaṃ vadetvyāpakāya padaṃ paścānṅentaṃ cāpi trivikramampadapañcakasarveṇa ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥp. 685)devatā viśvarūposya trivikrama udāhṛtaḥdakṣiṇaṃ punarutthāpya svargavyāptakaraṃ harimgaṅgaughadhautapādābjaṃ dhyāyedbrahmādikaiḥ stutamlakṣmīṃ bhuvaṃ bhūpure tu digīśānāyudhāni catrimadhvaktairhunetpaścāttarppaṇādyaṃ ca kārayetevaṃ siddhamanurmantrī labhate vāñchitaṃ phalamtāro namo bhagavate balisarvasvahāriṇemāyāṃ ramāṃ samuccāryya mantro dvātriṃśadarṇakaḥsaptāṣṭārkatribhūcandraiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥpūrṇakāmāvubhau dhyāyediti prītisamanvitaulakṣaṃ hunedbilvaphalairmadhuratrayasaṃyutaiḥtaddaśāṃśaṃ ca mantrasya siddhiḥ syātpāpanāśikābhāvayedvāñchitaṃ svārthaṃ sa dadyānnātra saṃśayaḥprātastadā svayaṃ mantraṃ sādhakāya prayacchatiramāṃ śaktiṃ kāmabījaṃ śrīdharāya tato vadetṛṣirbrahmā bhavecchando gāyatraṃ śrīdharassuraḥdugdhābdhau ca site dvīpe sarvarttuphalitadrumeśaṅkhacakragadāpadmapāṇiṃ cāmīkaradyutimp. 686)hṛdi lakṣmīdharaṃ dhyāyecchrīdharaṃ puruṣārthadam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaḍaṅgāni yajettatra devāṅgeṣu tato yajetvāme ca kaustubhāyeti grīvāyāṃ pūjayettataḥbhāle ca karṇikāyāṃ ca pakṣirājāya vai namaḥpuruṣottamakaṃ lakṣmīnivāsaṃ tadanantaramsarvastrīhṛdayonmādaṃ madonmādaka mevacatadutsaṅgagatāṃ devīṃ pūjayecchrīṃ śriyai namaḥlakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ ghṛtairhunettataḥ siddhamanurmantrī kāmyakarma samācaretbhajate śrīdharaṃ yastu sa ca lokadvaye sukhīkāmabījaṃ hṛṣīkeśo ṅehṛdanto gajākṣaraḥṣaḍdīrghayuktakāmena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritiḥgaruḍopari saṃviṣṭaṃ śubhravarṇaṃ subhūṣaṇamājyāktaiḥ kamalaiḥ pūrṇaistarppaṇādi tataścaretvijayāyāḥ prasūnaiśca tarppaṇaṃ sarvakāmadamyajjapādeva sidhyanti sādhakābhīṣṭakoṭayaḥrakṣāṃsi bhītāni diśo dravanti sarve namasyanti ca siddhasaṃghāḥhṛṣīkeśokhilaṃ sarvaṃ jñeyaṃ vai pūrvamantravatpralayābdhau śeṣatalpe lakṣmīsaṃvāhitāṃghrikampadmaṃ kaumodakīṃ hastairdadhataṃ dīptatejasamdhyātvārcayecchrīdharoktapīṭhe tadvajjapādikamprayogāṃśca vijānīyātpadmanābhārcanaṃ tvitinavākṣaro mahāmantro bhogabhājāṃ susiddhidaḥrādhādāmodaraḥ sākṣādbhuktimuktiphalapradaḥvāmotsaṅgagatāṃ rādhāṃ cāliṅgantaṃ mudānvitamṣaḍaṅgaṃ kāmabījena yajeddevaṃ saśaktikam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmādikānpadmamadhye patrāgre tu hriyaṃ ratimdigīśāṃścāpi vajrādīnevaṃ pūjā samīritātarppaṇaṃ mārjanaṃ kṛtvā dampatyorbhojanaṃ caretpuraścaraṇavatkuryājjapādyaṃ kāryyasiddhayeathātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi saṃkarṣaṇamanuṃ paramtataścāpratirūpāya parāya ca vadetpadamtraimunistu muniśchando mitaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ suraḥaṃkuśaṃ dakṣiṇe haste vāmenābhayameva canāradādiyutaṃ dhyāyedvāṇīlakṣmyau ca pārśvayoḥyajecca vaiṣṇave pīṭhe navalakṣaṃ japenmanumhunettilaistrimadhurāplutaiḥ syāttarppaṇādikamsamastaroganāśastu lakṣmīḥ padmākṣahomataḥdīrghāyuṣyaṃ goghṛtena mahiṣeṇāpi manmathaḥvanghyāpi labhate putraṃ homasaṃkhyāyutādikamtāro namo bhagavate vāsudevāyasaṃsmṛtaḥmunirdevo vāsudevaḥ pañcāṅgavidhirīritaḥpādayostu manorvarṇānnyasedbindūnnamontakāntriśastāratripuṭitamūlena vyāpakaṃ caretkayolakarṇadṛkkaṇṭhadorhṛjjaṭharanābhiṣuhṛdādikoyaṃ śīrṣāntaḥ sthitinyāsa udāhṛtaḥeṣa kramo yatīnāṃ tu vyastato brahmacāriṇāmsthitau ca śāntivinyāsaḥ sa syātkāryastridhā budhaiḥbuddhitattvātmanecyutāya namo netrayornyasetkarṇe hratpadmatattvāya vadetsaṃkarṣaṇāya catato nyasedvāmabāhau tatṣoḍaśakalātmane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: agnimaṇḍalatattvāya ṅento nārāyaṇo mataḥsaṃkarṣaṇākhyatattvāya liṅge syādviṣṇave namaḥdakṣapāde ca vāmeniruddhatattvātmane nyasetmūrttipañjaranāmānaṃ keśavādikamācaretdugdhāmbhodhau sitadvīpe divyayoṣāvirājitetatra kalpadrumādhastādratnamaṃce tu paṅkajamcandrakāntiṃ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmalasatkaramsakaustubhaṃ pītavastraṃ dhṛtagraiveyakaṃ kaṇamyajennārāyaṇe pīṭhe mūrttiṃ mūlena kalpayettatsahasraṃ ca kamalairjuhuyānmadhuraplutaiḥkṣīravṛkṣasamidbhiśca homaḥ syātpāpamuktayenārāyaṇoktānnikhilānprayogānācarettataḥtāraṃ māyādvayaṃ lakṣmīdvayaṃ lakṣmīpadaṃ vadetṛṣiḥ prajāpatiśchando gāyatrī bījakaṃ dhruvaḥdvidvidvīṣudvibhirvarṇestārādyairaṅgakalpanamlakṣmyāliṅganataścaikībhūtaṃ cāṅkagatāṃ [paśyantamiti śeṣaḥ ||] hi tāmdadhatīṃ śaṃkhacakrābjagadāhastaṃ gadādharamdaśāṃśaṃ paṅkajairhomo madhuratrayasaṃyutaiḥmadhurāktaistilairhutvā sarvakāryāṇi sādhayetklīṃ pradyumnāya hṛdayaṃ manuḥ saptākṣaro mataḥniyogaḥ samare jetuṃ kāmayuddhe tathā striyāḥāliṅgitaṃ prabhāvatyā nānārūpaṃ subhūṣitamgandharvairabhito gītaṃ prasannamukhapaṃkajamśaratkāle vasante vā dinānāmekaviṃśatimevaṃ sidhyati mantroyaṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yakṣiṇyo vaśagāścaiva vaśyaḥ syād yoginīgaṇaḥviprāḥ palāśakusumaiḥ sevantībhirnṛpāstathāturuṣkā yānti dāsatvaṃ jayantyāḥ kusumairhunetuṣāhṛdayaruddhāya kāmarūpāya te namaḥsmareduṣāgṛhe taṃ ca citralekhādisaṃyuteāliṅgitapriyoṣaṃ ca strīkautukaramānvitamkāmapīṭhe yajed devaṃ varṇalakṣaṃ japenmanumjuhuyānmantrarājasya siddhitosya jagadvaśamdāsībhūtāḥ sādhakasya japedṛtumatīṃ yabhetpratyakṣībhūya kāryāṇi kurvate dāsavaccirammāyāramātārakāmabījaṃ hṛtpuruṣottamajagatkṣobhaṇa sarva strīhṛdayeti vidāraṇa [idamuttarānvayi]manujasundarītyuktvā manonmathamanāṃsi cadvirmāraya stambhaya dvirdvirnāśayapadaṃ vadet [idamuttarānvayi]paramoktvā ca surabhe saubhāgyakara sarva cacakreṇa gadayā ceti khaḍgeneti samuccaretbandhabandhetyaṃkuśena dvistrāsaya kurudvayamme siddhaṃ bhavati klīṃ huṃ phaṭ namo hrīṃ ramāṃ vadetbhedānasya pravakṣyāmi kāmanāvarṇabhedataḥjñānadīkṣī ca sannyāsī yastu kevalavaiṣṇavaḥstambhayadvitayaṃ brūyāttathā sammohayadvayampūrvaṃ samastaśabdaṃ ca yojayeddvidhareti casthāne lakṣmyā iti procya bhedāścatvāra eva hitrailokhyamohano nāma devatā puruṣottamaḥṣaḍaṅgeṣu padānyatra vadecca puruṣottama
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sakalajagatkṣobhaṇeti lakṣmīdayita śīrṣakekavacaṃ syātparamasubhagasarvapadaṃ vadetatraiva kavacānte tu nyasedastraṃ surāsurasarvapraharaṇetyuktvā dhara sarvamanāṃsi vāmahānanteti cāsyānte netre maṃ phaṭ ca kīrtyatehanayugmaṃ dārayadvirme vidyāṃ vaśamānayakaniṣṭhayornetramanumastraṃ tu karapṛṣṭhayoḥnyasetkarāṃguliṣu ca kāmabījāni śaktikāḥvaśīkarāṃ klīṃ kandarppaṃ klīṃ bījaṃmakaradhvajamkāmabījaprapuṭitaṃ mātṛkānyāsamācaretvinyasenmātṛkānyāsaṃ pūrvoktaṃ ca tataścaretsaṃhārākhyaṃ ca sṛṣṭyākhyaṃ sthāneṣveteṣu ca kramātjānunorgulphayoḥ sarvāṅguliṣviti tataḥ kramātsaṃhārasṛṣṭisthityākhyāṃstathā nārāyaṇoditamsiddhyanti sarvakāryyāṇi japādviṣṇuprasādataḥtanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayātmaṇibandhāṃgulīmūle cāṃgulyagre pravinyasetaṃgulyagre tathā vāme bhujamūlādike nyasetnyāsānkuryyāttathā kāmabāṇanyāsamataḥ paramsvāṃ lakṣmyai ca namaḥ ke svīṃ sarasvatyai namo mukhekakudi svaiṃ namaḥ kīrttyai svauṃ kāntyai ca namo hṛditataśca mūlamantreṇa prāgvadvyāpakamācaretkāmabījairnyasetpaścācchrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ tathāūrdhvāṃguṣṭhau tvathāśliṣṭau mūrttimūrddhani yojayetevaṃ nyasya śarīrādau dhyāyecchrīpuruṣottamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvāṅgasundaraṃ saumyaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamcakraṃ śaṃkhaṃ dhanuḥ khaḍgaṃgadāṃ musalamaṃkuśamsarvabhūṣāḍhyayā padmakarayāliṅgitaṃ smaretp. 693)pakṣirājāyasvāheti tasya pūjāmanurmataḥtadvāmorau pūjanīyā mantriṇā śrīḥ śriye namaḥkramādabhyarccayedaṅgaṣaṭkaṃ syātprathamāvṛtiḥtṛtīyāvaraṇe lakṣmīvāgratiprītikīrttayaḥindrādyāṃścāpi vajrādīnpañcame ceti pūjanamādau klīmatra trailokyamohanāya tato vadetnamontaiḥ pañca puṣpāṇāmañjalīṃśca samarppayetpaṃca nāmānīti cātra puruṣottapūjanebilvairvā kamalaiḥ paścāttarppaṇādyairbhavenmanuḥ [idamuttarānvayi ||]samastādhau prajuhuyādaṣṭottarasahasrakamaṣṭādhikaśataṃ japtvā sarvalokapriyo bhavetrājāno vaśagāḥ sarve māsamātrānna saṃśayaḥpalāśapuṣpahomena prāgvadviprāśca vaśyakāḥdinādau sā vaśībhūyāddāsyasmītyādivādinīaśvatthotthasamidbhistu hunetpakṣatrayaṃ yamīcauro yāti dhanaṃ dattvā praṇamya svagṛhaṃ pratinikhātaṃ śatrusadane śatrumuccāṭayeddhruvamkrūra vāre ca lagnepi śatrumuccāṭayeddhruvamśuklaṃ raktaṃ keśayuktaṃ ripumuccāṭayeddhruvamripurnidhanamāyāti sāṣṭādhikasahasrataḥyadvā jyotiṣmatītailaṃ hunedaṣṭasahasrakammantrī vivikte bhūdeśe japahomārcane rataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tataḥ pūrvācca madhyāhne pāvakāccandrasannibhāanenaivātha śirasi sa bhavetkhecaraḥ sadāājyāktābhiśca dūrvābhirhomo bhayavināśakaḥśamayedāpadastasya nātra kāryyā vicāraṇāayaṃ manuvaro gopyo na deyaḥ pāpine kvacittāraṃ māraṃ ramāṃ ṅentaṃ vadecca puruṣottamambrahmā muniśca gāyatrī chandosau puruṣottamaḥbhūbhūbhūṣaḍdvidvivarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥśaṅkhacakrotpalagadādhāriṇaṃ puruṣottamamvāsudevādīni dikṣu śaktīrvai koṇagā yajetdigīśāṃśca tadastrāṇi prāgvatṣaḍvarṇapūjanamtarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyateramā tāraṃ hriyaṃ kāmaṃ hṛd ṅentassyādadhokṣajaḥsādhakānāṃ kāmadāyī devatā syādadhokṣajaḥśaṅkhacakragadāpadmapāṇiṃ pītāmbarāvṛtamvāsukipramukhairnāgaiḥ sevitaṃ ramayā yutamsanakādīnnāradaṃ ca jayaṃ ca vijayaṃ tathānāgāṣṭakaṃ digīśāṃśca bhūpure hetisaṃyutāntarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā sahasraṃ bhojayeddvijānviṣārttāya ca sarppādidaṣṭakāya pradāpayetkuṣṭhādikagadairyukto mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥnityapramuditetyuktvā cetase pravadettataḥchandotijagatī devo nṛhariḥ śaktiradrijāramābījaṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni śrībījena prakalpayethastairdadhānaṃ sarppasya phaṇācitravirājitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: varṣāhatulyasāhasraṃ japo'sya parikīrttitaḥtarppaṇādi tataḥ kuryyādaṅgaiḥ syātprathamāvṛtiḥkāntī ruciścāṣṭapatre bhūpure divyahetayaḥmallikākusumairhomaścāyutaṃ tviṣṭadāyakaḥanyānapi prayogāṃśca kuryyādaṣṭārṇakoditāntāro [namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya namastejastejase āvirāvirbhava vajranakha vajradaṃṣṭhra karmāśayān rodhayarodhaya tamo grasagrasa svāhā abhayamātmani bhūyiṣṭhāḥ oṃ kṣraum ||] namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya hṛdvadevajranakha vajradaṃṣṭra tataḥ karmmāśayānvadetsvāhāṃ tathābhayaṃ cātmani bhūyiṣṭhā dhruvaṃ vadetśukadevo muniḥ prokto'mitaṃ chandaśca devatādaśāvatāra nṛharestulyaṃ lakṣamito japaḥbrahmā ṛṣiranuṣṭup cacchando devo janārddanaḥvarābhaye cakragade dadhataṃ pītavāsasamasya pūjāprayogādi japahomādikaṃ bhavettathā saṃsevite muktirājanmabrahmacāribhiḥupendramantraṃ praṇavamumupendrāya hṛnnamaḥpaṃktiśchanda upendrastu devo bījaṃ tathā smṛtamdhyānapujāprayogādyaṃ balivāmanavadbhavetharaye nama ityeṣa mantraḥ pañcākṣaromataḥśrībījādyastu dāridrye sarvanāśāya pakṣirāṭaiṃsamanvitamantroyaṃ drutaṃ vidyāpradāyakaḥjapankāmādikaṃ tatra mohayeddhanināṃ gaṇānhūṅkārapūrvakaṃ japtvā samare vijayī bhavetkāmapūrvaṃ ca japato vaṃśaḥ kaśyapavadbhavetharirdevastvādyapadaṃ bījaśaktī manormatemeghaśyāmaṃ sunayanaṃ kākapakṣavirājitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hastamātre tajjale parikalpitedeveśa tīrthaṃ dehi divākarabhitvārkamaṇḍalaṃ tasmāttīrthānyāvāhayedihasminsannidihiṃ kurutanmantreṇa ca pūjayetgaṅgāsindhusaridvarādisahitāṃ śrītīrthaśaktiṃ bhajevahnigehinīgāṅgamantreṇa mantrayedaṣṭavārakam|| p. 67) ambālike mahāmālinyehyehi bhagavatyathaca gaṅge gaṅgāmbike dviṭhaḥdevatāṃ tatra sāṅgāṃ sāvaraṇāntathāsmarenmūlamantraṃsnāyājjale triśaḥtribhirlokairmūlamantraistārakaṃ bījapūrvakaiḥsarvabhūtānāmāpo devyaḥ punantu māmnijasparśādāpo devyaḥ punantu māmkarṇayorakṣṇorāpastad ghnantu vo namaḥsantarpya toyamadhyāttaṭaṃ vrajetmṛdādbhistata ācamya devasnānavidhissmṛtaḥdurge kāyāsvāsthye ca vārddhakediśaḥ prāgvatsaṃśodhyopāviśettataḥmātṛkādīṃstathā mūlamantranyāsānaśeṣataḥkevalādudakasnānātsaṃskāraparivarjitāttatpādodakajāṃ dhārāṃ nipatantīṃ svamūrddhanitasmātsaṃkṣālayetsarvametaddehagataṃ malamsnānavaraṃ mantrasnānādaṣṭaguṇaṃ matam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 697)vicitraparidhiṃ vaṃśīṃ dadhataṃ vāmadakṣayoḥhomaḥ pañcāmṛtenātha prayogosya nigadyateekāyutādipañcāntaṃ puraścaraṇavajjapetkāmo govallabho ṅento mohitākhilayoṣitamkākapakṣadharaṃ nānākelikautukakārakamvāsudevaṃ rukmiṇīṃ ca tathā saṃkarṣaṇābhidhamjāmbavatīṃ ca tadbāhye bhūpure dikpatīnathabrahmavṛkṣasamidbhiśca hunedaṣṭasahasrakamvidadhīta prayogāṃśca pūrvānkṛṣṇamanūditānuktāḥ kecicca tantreṣu vaktavyaṃ kimataḥ paramiti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte caturviṃśatimūrtimanukathanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśaḥ prakāśaḥtanmantrāñchrotumicchāmi bhuktimuktipradāyakānmama viṣṇoḥ priyatamaṃ mantraṃ hariharātmakamnārāyaṇāya ca namo hoṃhrīṃ oṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥṣaḍdīrghayuṅgmāyayā ca ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayetsvasvarūpārdhanīlārdhadehaṃ hariharaṃ bhajelakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ bhūmiṃ dharākhyāmambikāṃ tathāp. 698)lokeśānapi cendrādīnvarṇalakṣaṃ japenmanumevaṃ siddhamanurmantrī hṛdi kṛtvā tu vāñchitamlabhate vāñchitānarthānsadyaḥ prītikaro manuḥsahāvukārasaṃyuktau bindūnā pariśobhitauhasāvaukārasaṃyuktau sabindū kṣatriyasya catriṣṭupchando munirbrahmā hayagrīvosya devatākamalaṃ japamālāṃ cābhayaṃ kameva cabhaktapriyaṃ hayagrīvaṃ vandehaṃ dānavāntakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantrādhikārī bhavati devamāvāhayettayātanno haṃsaḥ pracodayātprajñā medhā smṛtirvidyā śrīrvāgīśā hayānanaḥlakṣmyādibhistṛtīyā syāttāśca lakṣmīḥ sarasvatītryāvṛttiḥ kumudādyaiḥ syātproktāste dadhivāmanevedalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādghṛtaiḥsiddho mantraḥ prayogārho jāyate bhuktimuktidaḥkaraṃ dhyātvā nyasedvaktre sabhāpūjyaḥ sajāyateprātarharati lūtādidaurbhāgyaṃ pañcadhā viṣamsaptāhājjāyate tasya divyā vāṇī manoramāpītaṃ cāpi mukhaṃ dhyātvā stambhayetparabhāratīmsaṃlikheddarbhamūlena bharjapatre haridrayāp. 699)veṣṭitaṃ pītasūtreṇa mūkatvaṃ kurutecirātjvālāmālākulaṃ dhyāyetstambhanaṃ paramaṃ matamsaṃhārakamidaṃ dhyānaṃ viṣādīnāṃ na saṃśayaḥāpyāyate kare hyetatsarvarogavināśanamdhyāyeddhṛtpadmamadhyasthaṃ nirviṣīkaraṇamparammahārakṣā bhavedeṣā sarvadoṣavināśakṛthakāradvayamadhyasthaṃ japtaṃ māsantu vairakṛtudgiratpraṇavodgītha sarvavāgīśvareśvarasvabījapraṇavābhyāṃ ca ślokamenaṃ puṭedathachandonuṣṭummunirbrahmā hayagrīvastu devatāśaṅkhāripāṇimaśvāsyaṃ jānunyastakaraṃ bhajetyajedaṣṭadale padme devāgrādipradakṣiṇamvedāṅgāni smṛtiṃ nyāyaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇi cārccayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūpure lokapālāṃśca tadastrāṇi tato yajethomayettarppaṇādyantaṃ kṛtvā siddho bhavenmanuḥśrīkāmo juhuyānnityaṃ kundaistrimadhuraplutaiḥsevitaṃ vidhinā prātaratibuddhikaraṃ tvidambhakṣayetsarvaśāstrāṇāṃ vyākhyātā bhavati dhruvamṛgyajussāmarūpāya vedābharaṇakarmmaṇep. 700)atha mantrāntaraṃ vakṣye tīkṣṇabuddhikaraṃ parambilvottīrṇasvātmarūpacinmayānandarūpiṇesvāhā sohaṃ ca haṃsādiraṣṭatriṃśākṣaro manuḥpuraścaryyā tu ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣamanyacca pūrvavatsvabījaṃ hayaśirase namaścāṣṭākṣaro manuḥhastairdadhānaṃ mālāṃ ca pustakaṃ varapaṅkajamevaṃ dhyātvākhilaṃ karyyādekakarṇoktavartmanābhavākṣaro manuḥ prokto bhavarogaikabheṣajamṣaḍaṅgavidhiruktosya dviruktairmanu nāmabhiḥsarvāyudhairupetaṃ ca garuḍo parisaṃsthitamśrībhūmi sahitaṃ devamudyadādityasannibhamsarvalokasya rakṣārthamanantaṃ nityameva higovindamanuvaloktampañcāvaraṇasaṃyutamtarppaṇādi tataḥ kuryādroganāśaḥ [tasyeti śeṣaḥ ||] prajāyatevastrārthī puṣpahomaṃ ca nairujyārthī tilairhunetaṣṭottarasahasrantu jvaranāśo bhaviṣyatidhyāyellabhecchubhāṃ kanyāṃ kulīnāṃ ca kuṭumbinīmanantāya namaśceti ṣaḍvarṇoyamudāhṛtaḥniyogo roganāśārthamanyadgovindavadbhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vedavyāsasya vidyādipradaṃ padamihoccaretmunirbrahmā tathānuṣṭupchandaḥ satyavatīsutaḥṣaḍdīrghādyena bījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥyogapaṭṭāsanārūḍhaṃ praphullakusumadyatimnānāśiṣyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanambhajepūrvokte tu yajetpīṭhe pūrvamaṅgāni pūjayetsumantuṃ koṇabhāgeṣu śrīśukaṃ lomaharṣaṇamindrādīṃśca tadastrāṇi pūjā caivaṃ samīritātrikāleṣṭottaraśataṃ kavitvaṃ śobhanāḥ prajāḥvyākhyānaśaktiṃ kīrtiṃ ca labhate sampadonvayamtāraṃ namaḥ samābhāṣya mantrametantato vadetkahoḍosya munirdevī gāyatrī chanda īritamhakārastu ṣaḍaṅgārthaṃ dhyānapūjādi pūrvavatkaṣṭhādikamahāroganāśārthaṃ lakṣamekakamsvalpamṛtyuvināśaśca pūrṇamāyuḥ prajāyatetatra vrātyā dvijā ye ca saputrā ye ca va?(vai)ṣṇavāḥpakṣirājasya sarveṣāṃ nṛṇāmiṣṭasusiddhayetanno garuḍaḥ pracodayātdhyānapūjādirahitā japamātraphalapradātāro namo bhagavate mahāgaruḍaṅentakampūjitāya vajranakhavajratuṇḍapadaṃ vadetehyehi mahāgaruḍa duṣṭanāgānpadaṃ vadetdvirbhindhyāveśayayugaṃ baddho huṃphaḍ vasupriyāgāyatrī chanda uddiṣṭaṃ devatā garuḍo mataḥmantroktaviṣanāśārthaṃ viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kapilākṣastathā nāgagaralāntakaro mataḥetaiḥ ṣaṇnāmabhirnyāsaścāṅgulyādirhṛdādikaḥdīrghabāhuṃ vṛṣaskandhaṃ nāgābharaṇabhūṣitamtakṣakaḥ kaṭisūtraṃ ca hāraḥ karkoṭa ucyateśaṅkhapālaḥ śirodeśe kulikastu bhujāntareākaṇṭhādraktavarṇaṃ ca viṣṇadhvajagataṃ bhajemantrārṇasaṅkhyāśatato japaḥ saptaguṇo mataḥnāśamāyānti rogāśca visarppādyā na saṃśayaḥpañcākṣaro manuḥ paṃktiśchandonanto mato muniḥsvāhānto hṛdaye nyasya jvalajvala mahāmategaruḍānte śikhe svāhā śikhāyā manurīritaḥdviḥ prabhedaya vitrāsayadvayaṃ dvirvimardayaugrarūpadharetyuktvā sarvaviṣahareti cabhasmīkurukuru svāhādantavarṇo manurmataḥtrāsanānte vadeddhuṃphaṭ svāhāntoṣṭādaśākṣaraḥp. 703) taptasvarṇanibhaṃ nāgaprajñaptāṅgavibhūṣaṇampakṣoccāritasatsāma gānaṃ viṣaharaṃ bhajepūjayenmātṛkā padme garuḍaṃ vedavigrahamananto vāsukistakṣakākhyaḥ karkoṭapadmakautadāyudhāni bhūgehe pañcalakṣaṃ japenmanumdarśanāddūragastasya sarppo naśyedviṣadvayam [cetyadhyāhāryyam ||]iha loke sukhī dīrghajīvī bhūpatipūjitaḥgaditā manavo devi kimanyacchrotumicchasiiti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte viṣṇupriyamantrakathanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśaḥ prakāśaḥmantrāstānvidhi pūrvānme brūhi yatsādhanājjayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sudarśanaṃ nāma yacca mayā prāgviṣṇaverppitamyatsaparyāstu laṅkeśaḥ sahasrābdaṃ cacāra hatāraḥ sahasrāra huṃphaṭ tasya mantro navākṣaraḥcakrāyāntairāviśuddhisujvālāvakulaiḥ pṛthakaindraṃ cakreṇa badhnāti namaścakrāgnigehinīdiśāsu tarjanyaṃguṣṭhayogenātra sthaleṣu caphaṭsvāheti dvādaśārṇo vahniprākārasaṃjñitaḥprākāraṃ parikalpyātha nyāsānanyānsamācaretīṃmadhyānanahṛdguhyajānugulphataleṣu cadakṣādyūrdhvakramādaṣṭabhujairāyudhadhāriṇampāśamaṃkuśamādīptaṃ bhīmadaṃṣṭraṃ raviprabhamkarṇikāyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni cakrādyastrāṇikeśarebhūpure lokapālāṃśca tadastrāṇi tadagrataḥtristhāne cakagāyatryācakamudrāṃ ca tāṃ śṛṇutannaścakraṃ pracodayāttilaistrimadhuropetaiḥ sarṣapairmadhurānvitaiḥtataśca kevalājyena tarppaṇādi tataścaretkhātādiśodhitaṃ sthānaṃ gomayenopalepayetvṛttaveṣṭitaṣaṭkoṇaṃ tadbāhye bhūpurāvṛtamtadantarālaṃ śyāmena śeṣaṃ śvetena pūrayetādāvuttaracakre ca dakṣiṇe ca tato nyasetdīkṣāvidhiprakāreṇa pīṭhapūjāṃ samācaretsampūjya sāṃgāvaraṇamanyacakre tatastathāpratidravyaṃ bhaveddhomaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikaṃ śatamhaviṣpṛthakpaṃcagavyaṃ hunedājyaṃ tu tatkramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kumbhopari nidhāyātha sādhyaṃ samupaveśayetp. 705)bhrāmayitvā tataścodaṅmārjjanaṃ kalaśaṃ kṣipethutaśiṣṭānnena dadyādbaliṃ ca manunāmunābhyo baliṃ pratigṛhṇantu śāntyai hṛttattvavarṇakaḥjvarādirogasaṃghātānpraogoyaṃ vināśayetrakṣobhūtādipīḍāṃ ca nāśayetsa tvayaṃ vidhiḥkṛtvā mantrī paṃcagavyaiḥ pūjayetsādhyamatra cavipravaryyaiḥ kārayecca homaṃ pūrvoditaṃ kramāteṣa yogaḥ sarvarogāpamṛtyudrohanāśakaḥtribhiḥ sampūritairjaptaiḥ kumbhaiḥ sampātasaṃyutaiḥabhiṣiñcedbhānudine cāmayādyāturaṃ tathāghṛtaṃ [bhakṣayediti śeṣaḥ ||] pakvaṃ pañcagavyairjapite manunāmunāmantraṃ japeddaśaśataṃ pañcagavyaṃ spṛśetsudhīḥrakṣā bhavati tadgehe sampadvṛddhiḥ prajāyateghusṛṇaṃ ca haridrāṃ ca rocanaṃ bilvarājikekṛṣṇāṃ ca tulasīṃ proktāṃ javamarkadrumaṃ tathākamalaṃ rocanāṃ pañcagavye saṃkvāthayenmuhuḥjapitaṃ manunānena samyakca śirasā dhṛtamāpannāśakametatsyādvaśyadaṃ śivadaṃ paramprasthaṃ ca kalkadravyāṇi mustā śuṇṭhī niśā tathāmāṃsyāhvā ca viḍaṅgaṃ ca mañjiṣṭhā kaṭurohiṇībhūtapretapiśācādibhayaghnaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥguṭikāṃ gugguloḥ kṛtvā hunedaṣṭasahasrakambhavetsarvopadravāṇāṃ nāśo mantragadasya cabhūtajvarabhayavyādhikṛtyāpasmāranāśanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ājyāktābhiśca dūrvābhirhomāddīrghāyurāpnuyātvastrārthī śvetakumudairājyāktairjuhuyānnaraḥaudumbarasamiddhomātputralābho bhaved dhruvamsamidvarairmahārogamuktayeyaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥekopi durjayo yuddhe bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥbhavet triṃśaddinaiścātha prāpnoti maraṇaṃ dhruvamsaṃsmaredyasya śīrṣe tu tasyoccāṭo daśāhataḥmūrdhni smarecca saptāhāduccāṭo vā mṛtirbhavetsakāraṃ saṃsmarenmūrdhni sa jīveccharadāṃ śatamkarṇikāyāṃ tathā ṭhaṃ ca śeṣamantrārṇakaṃ tathāāpannivāraṇaṃ yantraṃ bhūtapretabhayāpahamtāro [oṃ namo bhagavate mahāsudarśanāya huṃ phaṭ ||] namo bhagavate mahāsudarśanaṃ vadettathā nyāsaśca pūjāyāṃ sarva rakṣākaro manoḥcaturviṃśacchatānīti tilāṃścāpi sasarṣapānanurūpajapadhyānānmantroyaṃ vāñchitapradaḥekaikaṃ sulikhedvarṇaṃ bahirbhūpuraveṣṭanamunmādagrahabhūtādīnabhicārāṃśca nāśayettāro namo [namo bhagavate mahāsudarśanāya mahācakrāya mahājvālāya dīptarūpāya sarvanātha rakṣarakṣa māmahābalāya svāhā huṃ phaṭ ||] bhagavate mahāpūrvapadatrayamdīptarūpaṃ sarvanātha rakṣayugmaṃ ca māṃ mahādhyānapūjādikaṃ prāgvajjapo varṇasahasrakamoṃklīṃ sudarśanamahācakrarāja [oṃ klīṃ sudarśana mahācakrarāja dahadaha sarvaduṣṭabhayaṃ kurukuru chindhichindhi bhindibhindi vidārayavidāraya paramantrān grasagrasa bhakṣayabhakṣaya bhūtāni trāsayatrāsaya huṃphaṭ svāhā cakrāya namaḥ || iti mantraḥ ||] dahadvayamvidārayadvayaṃ procya paramantrāngrasadvayamhuṃphaṭ svāheti cakrāya namo vedanugākṣaraḥdhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ jñeyamasya ṣaḍarṇavatjaptvādau cāṣṭasāhasraṃ raṇe gaccheddrutaṃ jayī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: oṃklīṃ jalacarāyeti svāhāntoyaṃ navārṇakaḥpūjānte prajapenmantramaṣṭottarasahasrakamkuryādevaṃ māsaṣaṭkaṃ tataḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥdhyātvābhivādayecchaṃkhaṃ raṇe vijayakārakamdvādaśārṇaḥ khaḍgamantro yo japeddvādaśākṣaramkhaḍgasiddhistasya bhavenna kadācitparājayaḥpūjayitvā tataḥ koṇe sthāpayetpraṇamedapiśārṅgāya [śārṅgāya saśarāya huṃ phaṭ ||] saśarāyeti huṃphaṭ japyo navāyutamajeyo jāyate dhanvī śārṅgamantraṃ samuccaretkaumodaki mahāsarvabale sarvāsurāntikejapellakṣamimaṃ mantraṃ pūjayennityaśo gadāmsādhako vā gajārūḍho gadāhasto viśedraṇambhayabhītāḥ palāyante caturaṅgabalā apihuṃphaṭ svāhāntako mantra ūnaviṃśativarṇakaḥghṛtāktāścāyutaṃ mantrasiddhistasya prajāyatepalāyantesya ripavo dakṣo rudrādyathā tathākuryādarervā gadādeḥ stambhaḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥkaṃcudvayaṃ ca varmmāstraṃ svāhānto viśvavarṇakaḥdevaścātrāṃkuśo viṣṇurūpī gajavimardakaḥp. 709)kevalāṃkuśapūjātra japo lakṣaṃ trayodaśatrāsayennātra sandeho bhavanti vacanādvaśephaṭsvāhetyūnaviṃśārṇo varuṇo munirucyatenetrairaṅgāni taṃ caiva dhyāyedvaruṇahastagammāraṇāya madhusite dveṣe tailaṃ tato guḍammunirmantraśca chandosya gāyatrī devatā haraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āraktakalaśaṃ dhyāyenmastake sve ca pūjayettarppaṇādyaṃ tataḥ kuryyācchatramantrasya siddhayeekopi sa ripūñjitvā rājyaṃ tu labhate drutamcāmarasya grahāveśadṛṣṭyādikanivāraṇamprotsārayāśu duritaṃ cāmara śrīṃ namostu tehutvā siddho bhavenmantro nityaṃ cāmaramarcayetsaptāhamarjjitāḥ sāyaṃ prātaḥ syurdoṣavarjjitāḥśakraketave ca mahāvīryyāya śyāma varṇakamgaruḍāsana rakṣadvirāyudhāni ripūndahadhvajamantraṃ japetpañcasahasraṃ siddhaye hunetdhvajaṃ tu pūjayennityaṃ śatrubhītinivāraṇamhiraṇyakaśiporyuddhe pūtane daivatāsurekālahaṃ trirdahadvandvaṃ ripūnsarvānpatākikep. 710) tatastrimadhurairhomādikaiḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥsthitaprāṇāṃ ca tā dṛṣṭvā ripuryāti diśo daśatriśūlāya namaśceti mantraḥ saptākṣaro mataḥhomastu bilvapatraiḥ syātsiddho mantrastvayaṃ bhavetśūlākṛṣṭe caṇḍi [ṅyāporiti hrasvaḥ ||] vṛte sarvaduṣṭanibarhiṇikṣurike rakṣa māṃ nityaṃ sarvāśubhavināśinijaptvā varṇasahasraṃ ca siddhaḥ śatrunivāraṇaḥśastriṇāmeva sarveṣāṃ yosti rakṣākaraḥ paraḥmama dehaṃ sadā rakṣa kaṭāraka namostu tetatra sampūjayettacca nāgnicaurādijaṃ bhayamgṛhāṇa jīvanaṃ teṣāṃ mama sainyaṃ ca rakṣa māmdigaṣṭake raṇe yātvā ripūṇāṃ kadanaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mānasikasnānaṃ manasā mūlamantrataḥśivātmakairmantraiḥ kṛtvā tīrthaṃ śivātmakamkriyāḥ śuddhāḥ sarvāḥ siddhiṃ prayānti catilakaṃ kuryājjātervā daivatasya cabrāhmaṇasyordhvapuṇḍraṃ syātkṣatriyasya tripuṇḍrakamūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ mṛdā kuryāttripuṇḍraṃ caiva bhasmanāvaiṣṇavasyordhvapuṇḍraṃ syāttripuṇḍraṃ śivasevaneyastu candraṃ tasya triśūlakamvibhūtiḥ syādvidhinā vidhṛtā yadisaṅgrāhyamagnīṣomodbhavantu vāśakṛdvastragṛhītaṃ gagane patatapiṇḍīkṛtya śivāgnau tu tatkṣipenmūlamantrataḥvāsasā'loḍya bhasmādhāre viniḥkṣipetyasmāccaṇḍabhasma prajāyatepañcākṣareṇa tulalāṭe vijñeyo hṛdaye havyavāhanaḥbāhumadhye ca śaśī ca maṇibandhanevasavaḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe hariḥ smṛtaḥkastūryādikasaṃyuktaṃ bhasma syāttattu dhārayetkārayedbhāle brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakamanāmāmadhyamāṅguṣṭhairathavāsyāttripuṇḍrakambaddhvā tu mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caretsaptavārantataḥ parampratyarṇaṃ prokṣayenmūrdhni kuśairmūlena ca tridhātoyamāmantrairbījairbhūtātmakaistathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: varmmañcharmaprada tvaṃ māṃ rakṣarakṣa samantataḥājyaistāvaddhunetsiddhastatsampātena saṃskṛtamtatraiva svīyavarṣāṇāmaṃkayantraṃ kṣitipradamjapamātreṇa saṃsiddhirhunecca ghṛtapāyasaiḥp. 711)tanno daṇḍaḥ pracodayātkoṭyantaṃ prajapenmantrī sarvadaṇḍairvimucyatetithyakṣaroyaṃ paraśormantraḥ saṃgrāmasiddhidaḥgopitā bahutantreṣu kimanyacchrotumicchasiiti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte āyudhamantrakathanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśaḥ prakāśaḥnacāstīti purā proktamatra śaktīrvadādhunāyatibhiḥ kevalo devaḥ sevyo nānyaistathā tribhiḥyatastu dharmmapatito vāmamārgī pumānmataḥteṣāṃ bhuktiśca muktiśca tadante tvaṃ manuṃ śṛṇuvadayugmaṃ ca citreśe vāgbījaṃ dahanāṅganācitreśvarī devatā syācchando gāyatramucyatenīlotpaladalaśyāmāṃ madāghūrṇitalocanāmkrīḍantīṃ hariṇā sārdhaṃ sthagitāṃ ca vanevanenopāsyā jātu cidviprairvāmamārgaprabhāvataḥsevyā kaulikamārgeṇa tadadhīnastadā hariḥekādaśākṣaro mantro muniḥ syādvāmakeśvaraḥpañcāṅgaṃ syātpañcapadairaṃguṣṭhādiṣu vinyasetkrīḍantī hariṇā sārdhaṃ mahāvaṭasamāśritābhagapūjāṃ viśeṣeṇa kuryyādvīrāṃśca bhojayetlakṣamātraṃ japedyastu trikālajñaḥ sa jāyateṣaṇmāsaṃ niyataṃ devīṃ vāgbuddhistasya jāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rājamānyo mahātejāḥ pūjyate sakalairjanaiḥmāyāśrīkāmabījāni kṛṣṇāyeti padaṃ vadetpañcamaṃ ca tato bījamebhiḥ saptamakūṭakamgopījanavallabhāya tataśca kamalatrayamtrayoviṃśākṣaro mantro bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥchandastu devī gāyatrī devo gopālasundarīṣaḍaṅgavidhiruddiṣṭo mantravarṇānnyasettanaumūrdhni bhāle bhruvorakṣṇoḥ karṇayornāsayormukhenābhau liṅge gude sakthnorjānunorjaṅghayorapihṛdayādyo bhujāntaśca nyāsoyaṃ sthitisañjñakaḥevaṃ nyāsatrayaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ sṛṣṭisthitiṃ carethrīṃ śrīṃpūrvaṃ aṃ ca āṃ ca svarau nyasyetkrameṇa tumāyāṃ ramāṃ tathā hrīṃ ca kāmabījaṃ hakārayukmāyāṃ lakṣmīṃ samuccāryya hasayuktāni coccaretnamontaḥ śakravarṇoyaṃ vinyasejjānunostathānamaḥ procya nyaselliṅge rudravarṇoyamīritaḥmeghavaṇa vadenṅentaṃ sabinduṃ ṣaṇmitasvaramtadeva bījaṃ vaśinī devatāyai namastathākavargaṃ bindusaṃyuktaṃ kāmaṃ kāmeśvarīṃ tathābinduturyyānsvaropetānṣaṣṭhaṃ bījamudāhṛtambhrūmadhye vinyasenmantraṃ ṭavargaṃ bindusaṃyutamvimalāvāgdevatāyai namaśceti gale nyasetbinduturyyasvaropetānbījaṃ proktaṃ tathāruṇāpavargabindusaṃyukta mādyamantyaṃ ca paṃcamamjayantīvāgdevatāyai namoyaṃ nṛpavarṇakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: binduṣaṣṭhasvaropetaṃ kūṭakāntamudāhṛtammūlādhāre nyasedenaṃ savargaṃ bindusaṃyutamnyasedūrvādipādāntaṃ nyāsaṃ vāgdevatābhidhamkūṭatrayadvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgaṃ punarācaretkṣīrāmbhodhau sitadvīpe vane kalpadrumādibhiḥmaṇḍape tatra śrīpīṭhe sthitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vibhāvayetbhujairdadhānaṃ vāmaistu cāpaṃ pāśaṃ tathāṃkuśampītāmbaradharaṃ gopīsamūhaiḥ parito vṛtampūrvādikadale vāsudevaṃ śāntiṃ kramādyajetaniruddhaṃ ratiṃ patrāgreṣvarcyā aṣṭanāyikāḥmitravindā lakṣmaṇā ca satyā nāgnajitī tathāmahāpadmaśca padmaśca śaṃkho makarakacchapauyoginyastu rahasyākhyāstadagreṣṭadalercayetjayinī caiva sarveśī kaulinītyaṣṭa śaktayaḥsarvajñā sarvaśaktiśca sarvaiśvaryyaphalapradāsarvādhārasvarūpā ca sarvapāpaharāparāsarvepsitārthaphaladā paścimādivilomagāḥsarvasiddhipradā tvādyā sarvasampatpradāparāsarvakāmapradā paścātsarvaduḥkhavimocinīsarvāṅgasundarī caiva sarvasaubhāgyadāyinīpaścimādivilomena pūjayetkramatastu tāḥsarvākarṣiṇikāṃ proktāṃ sarvāhlādakarāṃ tathāsarvajṛmbhaṇikāṃ proktāṃ tataḥ sarvavaśaṃkarīmsarvārthasādhinīṃ caiva sarvasampattirūpiṇīmtatoṣṭāre pu(?)rā proktā yoganīḥ paripūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anaṅgakusumā tvādyā dvitīyānaṅgamekhalāanaṅgalekhā cānaṅgavegānaṅgāṃkuśā tathātadagre ṣoḍaśāre tu paścimādivilomataḥahaṅkārākarṣiṇī ca śabdākarṣiṇikā tathārasākarṣiṇikā proktā gandhākarṣiṇikā matānāmākarṣiṇikā caiva bījākarṣiṇikā tathāśarīrākarṣiṇī paścādātmākarṣiṇikā tathākṣobhaṇadrāvaṇākarṣamanonmādamahāṃkuśāḥtadvaccādhaḥ samabhyarcya tadbahirbhūpure yajetdvāre dvayaṃ prāgaṇimā mahimā laghimeśitārasasiddhiśca daśamī saparyyaivaṃ samīritātarppaṇādi tataḥ kuryyānmantrasiddhaḥ prajāyatekaravīrajapuṣpaiśca homānmohayate jagatcampakaiḥ pāṭalairbilvairvaśamānayate cirātbilvaiḥ syādatulā lakṣmīrikṣukhaṇḍaistathā vaśāḥniśi [niśi cchāgapalairiti vā niśi śākaphalairiti pustakāśuddhyā pāṭho na jñāyate tadahyaṃ yathāmati sudhībhiḥ ||] svarṇaphalairhomo ripusenāvināśakṛtārogyaṃ sampadaṃ kāmaṃ dhanaṃ śarkkarayā sukhamkṣatriyo mātuluṅgaiśca vaiśyo nāriṅgajaiḥ phalaiḥpanasānāṃ lakṣahomādvaśyāḥ syuścakravartinaḥnārikeraistu pāṇḍityaṃ tilaiḥ sarveṣṭasiddhayaḥpāyasairdhanadhānyādi bandhūkaiḥ prāṇino vaśāḥlavaṇai rājikāyuktairhomādduṣṭavināśanamghṛtahe mādīpsitāptiḥ śaktiḥ syāttilataṇḍulaiḥkṛṣṇasya śaktiṃ sumukhīṃ dvijānāṃ nādhikāritā [nacetiśeṣaḥ ||]cini hrīṃ ṭhaścaṭhaḥṭhaśca dvāviṃśatyakṣaro manuḥ

sanskrit: munirāmadviṣaṭcandrabandhvarṇairaṅgakalpanamraktāmbarāṃ raktavarṇāṃ raktapuṣpānulepanāmśavāsanāṃ pīnakucāṃ devīṃ śrīsumukhīṃ bhajeaṣṭapatre ṣoḍaśāre vṛttabhūpuraśobhitecandrāṃ candrānanāṃ cārumukhīṃ cāmīkaraprabhāmbrāhmyādyā aṣṭapatreṣu ṣoḍaśāre kalādikāḥkulā kulīnā kalyāṇī kumārī kalabhāṣiṇībhaktocchiṣṭo'yutaṃ japtvā jāyate sampadāṃ padamgavyājyāktaiḥ prajuhuyāllakṣaṃ siddhārthataṇḍulaiḥśāstrāṇi vaśagāni syurhomaṃ mārjjāramāṃsataḥmadhupāyasasaṃyuktastrīrajoyuktavāsasāmadhusarpiryutairnāgavallīpatrairmahāśriyaḥyuktenāntyajakoṇādyairhutairākarṣati striyaḥummattatarujairdīptacitāgnau juhuyācchadaiḥgarbhapātaḥ sagarbhāyā ulūkacchadahomataḥsaubhāgyārthaṃ durbhagāyā bandhūkakusumairhunetucchiṣṭasya ca sā devī pratyakṣā jāyatecirātvāmamārgeṇa sumukhī kṣipraṃ kāmavidhāyinīna kṣipraphaladā devī sumukhī sudṛḍhāparākṛṣṇapriyāmekajaṭāṃ hrīṃtrīṃhuṃphaṭ ca hṛnmanuḥtadvatprayogakaraṇaṃ kṛṣṇaśaktiriyamparāpuṣpaṃ pratīkṣasva svāhā dvāviṃśatyakṣaro manuḥdhyānapūjāprayogādi sarvaṃ pūrvoktavadbhavetkṛtvā svaṃ śābaraṃ rūpaṃ vāmamārgeṇa sevitājarāsandhabhayātkṛṣṇo yadā sindhuṃ samāśritaḥ

sanskrit: tāmāvāhya sa kṛṣṇopi bhogena paryyatoṣayatsambhoge tu japenmantrī yathā santoṣayetstriyampraṇavaḥ kamalā māyā kraumaiṃ pañcākṣaro manuḥpañcavarṇaiḥ samastena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥratnamaṇḍapamadhyasthavedikāyāṃ sthitāṃ smaretkodaṇḍabāṇau karayornavavalkaladhāriṇīmyajedaṣṭadale padme karṇikāyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgakamstrī tuṅkārī kṣemakārī tadagre bhūpure yajetbilvakāṣṭhaidhite vahnau hunedbilvaphalaistathāmallīpuṣpairhuto vaśyamikṣudaṇḍairdhanāptayep. 718)annādiratnaiḥ sakalaṃ madhūkairvāṃchitaṃ bhavetṣoḍaśastrīsahasrāṇā yatprabhāvātprabhurbhavettāro [oṃ hrīṃ yogini yogeśvari yogeśvari yoge bhayaṃkari sakalasthāvajaṅgamasya mukhaṃ hṛdayaṃ mama vaśyamākarṣayākarṣaya svāhā ||] hrīṃ yoginī dvedhā yogeśvariyugaṃ vadetjaṅgamasya mukhaṃ procya hṛdayammama coccaretpitāmaho muniḥ proktaśchandotijagatī matāoṃ hrāṃ jagattrayavaśyamohinyai hṛdayāya hṛturaṅgavaśyamohinyai oṃ hraimādyaṃ śikhā bhavetoṃ hrauṃ sarvastrīpuruṣamohinyai ceti netrakamtataśca mūlamantreṇa sarvāṅge vyāpakaṃ carettattatsukhecchayā kṛṣṇarūpaṃ jagrāha mohanammohitā svasvarūpañca kṛtvāṣṭaguṇasundaramjagau maṅgalagītāni yāvatsyānmaithunālayaḥdevyai madhūkajāmmālā nāgahāraṃ harorppayattasmai devī varaṃ prādāttena jātā haripriyāaṣṭadaśadigbhūpāladantāṣṭakṛtisammitaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadbāhye caturasrasya dikṣu medhāṃ yajettataḥdvidvisvarānaṣṭadale śakrādīndigdale punaḥtārādyena namontena śrībījena yajecchriyamaṣṭākṣareṇa manunā radapatre śivāṃ yajetnavākṣareṇa tripurāṃ cataṣṣaṣṭidalercayetyoginīṃ pūjayeditthaṃ navāvaraṇapūjanamevaṃ yo bhajate devīṃ vaśyāstasyāmitā janāḥlabhate vāñchitāṃ kanyāṃ dhanamānasamanvitāmdakṣamārgeṇa saṃsiddhā vāmenaite prakīrttitāḥsiddhirmadhye yadā mṛtyustadā janmāntare bhavettanmārgiṇāṃ mahāpāpaṃ pāpātmānotra ye sthitāḥyasminbhuktiśca muktiśca kiṃ vaktavyamataḥ paramiti śrīmahāmāyāmāhākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte viṣṇuśaktimanukathanaṃ nāma triṃśaḥ prakāśaḥindānīṃ śrotumicchāmi tava mantrānsasiddhidānyānsādhayitvā bhogāṃstu bhuktvā mokṣamavāpnuyātṣaḍakṣaroyaṃ viprāṇāṃ bhuktimuktiprasādhakaḥṣaḍarṇaistu ṣaḍaṅgāni pañcārṇairaṅgapañcakamtarjjanyorvinyasennaṃ tatpuruṣāya namastvitivāmuktvā vāmadevāya namothāṃguṣṭhayornyasethṛdaye pādayorguhye nyāsoyaṃ syāttṛtīyakaḥevameva nyasetprokto nyāsoyaṃ pañcamoghahṛtnamuktvā nityatṛpteti śaktidhāmne śiro bhavetśimanantaśaktidhāmne kavacāya namastvitiyamanantaśaktidhāmne vadedastrāya phaṭ tathāhṛdi vaktre dakṣiṇāṃse vāmāṃse dakṣiṇoruke
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pārśve ca vāmapārśve ca pṛṣṭhe hṛdi dvitīyakaḥdakṣanāsāpuṭe vāmanasi proktastṛtīyakaḥmadhyeṃgulīnāmagre ca caturthaḥ parikīrttitaḥdakṣorumūle madhye ca gulphe cāṃgulimūlakepañcamoyaṃ bhavennyāso mūrdhni vaktre hṛdi nyasetvāmorumūlapādāgraparyyantaḥ ṣaṣṭhakastvayampunarvaktrāṃsahṛtpādadvayorujaṭhare nyasetevaṃ dvādaśadhā nyasya vāmena paṅkajaṃ caretcaturmūrttivapussthāya bhasitāṅgāya śambhavecārucandrakalārājajjaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitamśārdūlacarmmavasanaṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitamvāmordhvahaste hariṇandadhānamabhayamparebrahmaviṣṇumaheśādyaiḥ stutaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ surāsuraiḥdhyātvārcayettataḥ pīṭhe ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥvāmā jyeṣṭhā tato raudrī kālī kalavikarṇikāp. 721)sarvabhūtadamanyākhyā tataḥ proktā manonmanīguṇātmaśaktiyuktāya yogapīṭhātmane namaḥāvāhya devaṃ sampūjya puṣpāntairupacārakaiḥtatpuruṣo hyaghoraśca saghojātastataḥ paramnivṛttiṃ ca pratiṣṭhāṃ ca vidyāṃ śāntiṃ tu madhyataḥagnīśāsuravāyavyamadhye sarvatra keśareekaruṇḍaṃ trimūrttiṃ ca śrīkaṇṭhaṃ ca śikhaṇḍinamkirīṭārpitabālendūnpadmasthāṃścārubhūṣaṇānumāṃ caṇḍeśvaraṃ nandimahākālau maheśvaramuttaradalamālabhya bījanīlāhṛtānsitān

sanskrit: tadbāhye caturasre ca yajedindrādidikpatīntatpārśve tadvāhanāni bāhyestrāṇi prapūjayettatsahasraṃ prajuhuyāttilaiḥ śuddhairghṛtaplutaiḥtāvatsaṃkhyātilaiḥ śubhraistarppayecca tathāsitaiḥevaṃ saṃsādhito mantraḥ sarvānkāmānprayacchatitaddaśāṃśena pūrṇāyurnīrogaḥ sādhako bhavetāmrairhunettaddaśāṃśairdīghāyuśca yuvā bhavetarkairaṣṭaśataṃ nityaṃ hunedrogairvimucyate722)ayutaṃ rogahīnaḥ syādatha pūrvoditairyajetnityaṃ tasya mahārogā nāśaṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥayutaṃ tajjalaiḥ snānaṃ rogāṇāmauṣadhaṃ smṛtamhuneccārupalāśaiśca tāvadārogyamāpnuyātaudarairāmayaiḥ sarvairmāsenaikena mucyatebhakṣyaṃ coṣyaṃ tathā peyaṃ viṣamapyamṛtaṃ bhavetyāvadgrahaṇamokṣastu tāvannadyāṃ samāhitaḥaṣṭottarasahasreṇa pibedbrāhmīrasaṃ tataḥsārasvatī bhaveddevī tasya vāgatimānuṣītilājyairaṣṭasāhasraṃ grahapīḍā vinaśyatighṛtenāṣṭaśataṃ hutvā duḥsvapnaphalanāśanamyatkiñcitprārthayettasya nikaṭena tadāpnuyātsamidbhirjuhuyānmāsamayutaṃ vyādhiśāntayepalāśasya samidbhistu tasya śāntirbhaviṣyatipradhvaṃsayati tacchaktiṃ śatrustasya mariṣyatiparāpakāraḥ pāpāya śṛṇu tatpāpanāśanamsandhyopāsanavicchede sahasraikaṃ japettathā
