sanskrit: spṛṣṭamannaṃ na bhuñjīta tatra cāṣṭaśataṃ japetyonijeṣu tadardhaṃ syāttadardhaṃ bhūpayonikejitendriyo japellakṣapañcakaṃ śivadṛṅmanāḥnigṛhītendriyaḥ pañcalakṣaṃ japtvendriyaṃ jayetmadhyarātreyutaṃ japtvā nikaṭe brahmasiddhibhākmadhyarātre vivaśyaśca tadvaśo bhavati dhruvamsahasradvayajāpena mahārogaiḥ pramucyatecatussahasrajāpena vāñchitāni samāpnuyātmāsaṃ hutvā vinaśyettu rogastasya na sambhavetlakṣamekaṃ puraścaryyā munayomī prakīrttitāḥbharadvājotha chandāṃsi paṃktigāyatryanuṣṭubhaḥparabrahmendraviṣṇū ca vidhātryaśviguhāḥ kramātpītoruṇaḥ kramādvarṇā devatānāṃ prakīrttitāḥaiśvaryyāya ca vidyāyai nijapāpakṣayāya caṣaḍarṇaścāṣṭavarṇaḥ syādevaṃ mantradvayaṃ bhavettāraṣaḍdīrghamāyādyaiḥ syānmantrārṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakamśūlaṃ kapālamabhayaṃ varaṃ ca dadhataṃ karaiḥsmeravaktraṃ trinayanaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamādau pañcadale padme keśareṣvaṅgaṣaṭkakamhṛllekhā gaganāyuktā caturthī tu kulālikāpāśāṃkuśavarābhītidhāriṇyomitabhūṣaṇāḥsamyagdhyātvā kramādarcyā devāgrādipradakṣiṇamsarvābharaṇasandīptaṃ sākṣācchandassvarūpiṇamkṣetrapālaṃ trinayanaṃ digambaramathārcayetraktākāraṃ trinayanaṃ caṇḍīśaṃ paripūjayet

sanskrit: punaḥ saptavāraṃ mūlena mantrayetsamprokṣya kampaṭhenmūlamantrakamśiṣṭena tejorūpeṇa tena tudakṣanāsāpuṭenaitatsmṛtvā dakṣiṇahastakamhastāvācamya mūlamantreṇa mantravitravimaṇḍalasaṃsthāya sveṣṭadevāya tarpayettarpaṇīyaṃ vāmakaiḥ kāraṇena tubrāhmīṃ tu vaidikaṃ matamāśritaḥcārpayedevaṃ stutvā natveṣṭadevatāmpraṇamediti sandhyā tu tāntrikīlopaśca tadā mūlaṃ śataṃ japetkṛtvā tatastāntrikamācaretṛṣyāditritayasyātha purato dhenumudrayādevaṃ dhyātvā mūlaṃ samuccaretviṃśatyaṣṭayuktamukhābjaketadāvaraṇadevāṃśca tadvadekaikavārakamdigīśāṃśca khagānnatā bhāṇḍaṃ kare dadhatvīkṣeta yāvatprāpnoti vai gṛhamprakṣālyācamya pūjāyā gṛhadvārāntare sthitaḥpraṇamediṣṭadevaṃ svaṃ dikpālānapi cetasātatpāpasyāpanodārthaṃ mantradvayamudīrayetcittānme pāpaṃ phaṭ huṃ ca te namaḥśubhāśubhasyeha karmaṇo nṛṣu sākṣikāḥevaṃkṛte prathamataḥ pāpotsādanakarmaṇipūjanaṃ sthānaṃ svaṃ prayātu punaścatat

sanskrit: durgāṃ prapūjayetsaumyāṃ trinetrāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇāmvighnanāśakamabhyarceccandrārddhakṛtaśekharamtrinetraṃ raktavastrāḍhyaṃ senāpatimathārccayettadbahiścaturastrāṇi trīṇi tadvīthikādvayemanulakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tatsahasraṃ yathāvidhitarppaṇaṃ mārjjanaṃ prāgvadviprasantarppaṇantathāetatsaṃsādhanātsampatsantatiḥ samprajāyatevāmadevo muniśchandaḥ paṃktirdevaḥ sadāśivaḥṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥyasminkṛte tu pañcatve jāte pañcamukho bhavetayantu prathamo nyāso devatāprītikārakaḥsa eva devo bhūpaṃktyanuṣṭapchandāṃsi cintayetīśānaṃ trīkṣaṇaṃ śuddhaṃ nāgayajñopavītinamāpo devyosya gāyatrī chando dhyānaṃ nirūpyatecaturmukhaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ trinetraṃ vṛṣagāminamanuṣṭupchanda ākhyātaṃ deva āpaḥ prakīrttitāḥkhaḍgaṃ kapālaṃ hastaiśca dadhataṃ trīkṣaṇaṃ bhajep. 725)varābhayākṣavalayakuṭhāraṃ dadhataṃ karaiḥnānābhīmagaṇairyuktamaghoraṃ cintayeddhṛdivikṛtiśchanda uddiṣṭaṃ bhargo devaḥ prakīrttitaḥtraiṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ ca tathāhaṃ kṣaiṃ huṃ hauṃ ca śrītrayaṃ vadetamṛtatejojvāleti māline ca padaṃ tataḥjvalitaśikhiśikhāyānādibodhāya tacchriyesauṃcauṃsaumiti saṃbhāṣya munaye'luptaśaktayeśrīṃ paraśuṃ ca ṅentaṃ huṃ phaṭ tathānantaśaktaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mukheṣu vinyasedīśānādīnpañca hi ca kramātnyasettiryyakchirovaktrahṛdayāṃghriṣu pañcamaḥaṣṭatriṃśatkalānyāsaṃ kuryyāttejobhivṛddhayepraṇavādyaṃ mantrapadaṃ kalā ṅentā namontakāḥīśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāmaṅgadākhyā tataḥ paramśivo metrāstu mārīcī caturthī kathitā kalātatpuruṣāya vidmahe śāntiṃ pūrvamukhe nyasettanno rudraḥ pratiṣṭhākhyāṃ yāmyāsye tvaṣṭamīṃ nyasetaghorebhyastāmasīṃ tu daśamīṃ hṛdi vinyasetdakṣiṇāṃse ghorarūpāṃ vinyaseddvādaśīṃ kalāmsarvebhyo nābhimadhye tu vyācitākhyāṃ caturdaśīmnamaste astu pṛṣṭhe tu sudhākhyā ṣoḍaśī kalāvāmadevāya virajāṃ guhye tvaṣṭādaśīṃ nyasetśreṣṭhāya nama ityuktvā vāmāṃse tu ratiṃ nyasetkālāya namo dvāviṃśasaṃjñāṃ vāmoruke nyasetnyasecchriyaṃ vikarṇāya namo vāme ca jānuninyasejjñānāṃ vikarṇāya namo vāme ca jaṃghakekaṭyāṃ balapramathanāya namo guhyake nyasetvāmapārśve manonmanāya namaścobhayaṃ nyasetṛddhiṃ codakpādatale sadyojātāya vai namaḥvāmahastatale lakṣmīṃ catustriṃśatkalāṃ nyasetṣaṭtriṃśīṃ mūrddhani kṣāntiṃ vinyasecca bhuje ramāmudbhavāya namaḥ procya tiryyagvāmabhuje nyasetsadyojātādikānnyasya vyāpakanyāsamācaretavasthitaṃ śivohaṃ ca dhyātvāntaḥ pūjanaṃ caret

sanskrit: prathamāvaraṇaṃ jñeyaṃ dvitīyaṃ syātṣaḍaṅgakaiḥindrādyaiḥ paṃcamaṃ cāpi vajrādyaiḥ ṣaṣṭhakaṃ matampaṃcaviṃśatisāhasrasammitaiḥ karavīrajaiḥkṛtvā saṃsiddhamantrastu kuryyātkāmyāni pūrvavatdevaḥ sadāśivaḥ proktaḥ paṃktiśchanda udāhṛtamṣaḍbhistathā mantravarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni sajātibhiḥṭaṃkaṃ mṛgaṃ tathā devīṃ cāliṅgantaṃ varapradampītavṛttaghanottuṅgastanīṃ vāmāṃkasaṃsthitāmevandhyātvā ca paṃcārṇapīṭhe tadvadyajeddharamghṛtāplutaiḥ pāyasānnaistarppaṇādi tataścaretevaṃ siddhamanuḥ kuryyātprayogānhi ṣaḍarṇavatṛṣiḥ kahoḍo devyādigāyatrī chanda īritamṣaḍdīrghayuktabhṛguṇā ṣaḍaṅgāni samācarethasteṣu jñānamudrāṃ ca pāśarudrā kṣamālikeardhāṅgaṃ bahubhūṣāḍhyaṃ kāntābhiśca vimohitamaṅgendrādyaistadastraiśca trirāvaraṇapūjanamevaṃ saṃsiddhamantrastu prayogānvaicaredathaārādhitāgnau juhuyādvidhivadvijitendriyaḥāyurārogyasampattiyaśaḥputrānvivadhayetityuktaiḥ saptabhirdravyairjuhuyātsapta vāsarānbhojayenmadhurāktaiśca sarvarogaiḥ pramucyateguruṃ samprīṇayetpaścāddhanādyairdevatādhiyāvimuktaḥ suciraṃ jīvetsādhikaṃ śaradāṃ śatamhomoyaṃ śāntidaḥ proktaḥ sarvasampatpradāyakaḥbhojayenmadhurairbhojyairbrāhmaṇānvedapāragān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samidvaraiḥ kṛto homaḥ sarvamṛtyugadāpahaḥapāmārgasamiddhomaḥ sarvāmayavināśanaḥoṃṅkāramāyābījābhyāṃ [oṃ hrīṃ dakṣiṇāmūrttaye tubhyaṃ vaṭamūlanivāsine || dhyānaikaniratāṃgāya namo rudrāya śambhave oṃ hrīṃ ||] puṭaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣaramdhyānaikaniratāṅgāya namo rudrāya śambhavedevatā jagatāmādirdakṣiṇāmūrttiravyayaḥviniyogaḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayerasanetrāṣṭakavasu bāṇavahnimitaiḥ kramātṣaḍdīrghaistāramāyāntaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaretmūrdhni bhāle dakṣanetre vāme caiva tu karṇayoḥliṅge dakṣorumūle ca jānumūle ca gulphakeevaṃ vāmorumadhyādau kuryyānnyāsoyamīritaḥnānādrumaiḥ puṣpaphalapatropetairvirājiteśukādimunibhiryukte vaṭaṃ tatra vicintayetnavaratnamayākalpaistoraṇādyairalaṃkṛtamāsīnamamitākalpaṃ śaraccandranibhānanamp. 729)jaṭāmukuṭinaṃ vīrāsanaṃ nāsāvalokanamdakṣiṇordhvakare ṭaṅkaṃ vyākhyāmudrāmadhaḥ kareprākprokte pūjayetpīṭhe prathame tu dale yajetpūjayedaṣṭapatreṣu pūjayedvṛṣabhādikānpuraścaraṇasiddhyarthaṃ prajapedayutāṣṭakamtarppaṇādi tataḥ kuryyātprayogārho bhavenmanuḥmantraṃ pratidinaṃ mantrī vidvattvaṃ labhate dhruvamakhilānāṃ ca śāstrāṇāṃ vyākhyātā ca mahākaviḥsugandhadravyasaṃyuktairnandikeśvarakalpitaiḥanena mantravaryyeṇa jīvitaṃtvayutāvadhi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāntirakṣāyuṣyadaṃ ca gaditaṃ sarvasiddhikṛttāro namo bhagavate dakṣiṇāmūrttaye vadetmedhāsthāne paṭhetprajñāṃ phalaṃ nāmānusārataḥbījadvayālpito mantraḥ siddhyate vāmamārgiṇāmdevatā śrīmahādevo dakṣiṇāmūrttisañjñakaḥmedhāpadaṃ kīlakaṃ syātpuruṣārthe niyojanamśirorumadhyavaktreṣu hṛdi nābhau ca guhyakeoṣṭhe dante ca jihvāyāṃ cubukāgreṃsayorgalepādapāṇyośca sarvāṅge tato devaṃ vicintayetgaṅgādharaṃ śaraccandrakarollasitaśekharamdivyāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ gandhamālyairalaṃkṛtammuktākṣamālāṃ dakṣordhve jñānamudrāmadhaḥ karedadhānaṃ cintayeddevaṃ munivṛndaniṣevitampadmatrayasamopete bhūgehatritayānvitesvarānṣoḍaśa tatraiva dvandvaśaḥ keśarasthitānsarasvatīṃ caturvakraṃ sanakaṃ ca sanandanamvyāsaṃ ca paratoṣṭau tu pārvatīṃ śubhagāṃ tathācaturasre catuṣkoṇamāgneye śāṃtamarccayetindrādīṃśca tadastrāṇi prāgvadvīthīdvaye yajettarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā kāmyakarmmāṇisādhayetpratyahaṃ maṇḍalādarvākkavīnāmagraṇīrbhavetsarvāpannāśakaṃ caiva sarvarogavināśanammaunī gatvārcayeddevaṃ vidyāyuḥ parivṛddhayeśrīkāmo jalajairbilvairnandyāvarttaiḥ sadā hunetgurave gāṃ ca mahiṣīṃ tasya mṛtyubhayaṃ kutaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūlamantreṇa mantrajñaḥ sarvadoṣairna bādhyatepalāśapuṣpairacirātkavirhomādibhirbhavetayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ bhūyasīṃ śrīyamāpnuyātbhikṣānnamatha vā mantramayutadvitayaṃ japetevamārādhito mantro bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥhaṃsa ityasya gāyatrī chando brahmā munirmataḥhasavyañjanayoryoge ṣaḍdīrghāṃdyaṅgakalpanamdvātriṃśadakṣaraproktadakṣiṇāmūrttimantravatjñānapradaśca bhavati tathā mokṣapradopi cadakṣiṇāmūrttibhedasya tasya mantracatuṣṭayamūrdhvapaścimayoḥ saumyaprāgāmnāyoktasiddhikṛtvāmo munirvirāṭ chando devatā vāmanāyakaḥliṅganyastamahākāliṃ madirāsaktamānasamdadhataṃ bharjjitammatsyaṃ caṣakaṃ rudhirasya caitthaṃ saṃcintya deveśaṃ kālapīṭhe samarcayetliṅgasthitaṃ liṅgabhagamātmānaṃ cātmamekhalammadonmattaṃ ratikaraṃ calanmadhyaṃ skhalatpadamtatra sthitaṃ ca tadbāhye pūjayennavayonikehomāddhi māṃsaśakalairmantrasiddhiḥ prajāyatetadā na kāryyaṃ bhavati vāmamārgeṇa sādhitammahyaṃ medhāṃ vadetprajñāṃ prayacchānalavallabhāmdevatā dakṣiṇā medhā gāyatrī chanda ucyateniyogotha ṣaḍaṅgāni āṃ īṃ ūṃ aiṃ ca auṃ ca aḥvyākhyāpīṭhetiśubhraṃ ca bhasmoddhalitavigrahamprāgvatpūjādika sarvaṃ puraścaraṇamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇāṃ japātsyācca puraskriyāpāpādhikyānna cetsiddhistadaivantu samācaretlakṣamekaṃ manuñjaptvā hutvājyaṃ siddhibhāgbhavetyamuddiśyāyutaṃ sopi mūrkho vidyānidhirbhavetpratyahaṃ maṇḍalādarvākkavīnāmagraṇīrbhavetaśrutaṃ vedaśāstrādi vyācaṣṭe nātra saṃśayaḥmāsaṣaṭkaṃ tasya vidyā bhavedgaṅgāpravāhavatmantraṃ śarabhasañjñasya drutasiddhipradāyakamśāntāya pakṣirājāya huṃ phaṭ svāhā namo manuḥkālāgnirudraḥ śarabho devatā parikīrtitaḥvedāṃkadaśasaptāgasāgarairaṅgakalpanamcandrārkāgnitrinayanaṃ kālīdurgādvipakṣakamvyādhimṛtyuripughnaṃ ca caṇḍavātātiveginammṛgendratvakcharīresya pakṣābhyāṃ caṃcunā ravaḥkālāntadahanaprakhyo nīlajīmūtaniḥsvanaḥaṣṭapādāya rudrāya namaḥ śarabhamūrttayepratyahaṃ māsaṣaṭkena mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyatenaśyanti darśanādeva cādhayo vyādhayastathātāro namo bhagavate ṅentaṃ śarabha śālva canivāraṇāya jvāleti ṅentaṃ mālāsvarūpakamkālarudrasvarūpāṣṭamūrttaye ca tathā vadetkrūrabhūtoccāṭanāyetyapratiśayanāya cagṛhṇayugmaṃ khādayugmaṃ tāraṃ huṃ phaḍvasupriyāmpratyahaṃ māsaṣaṭkena siddhaḥ syāttatphalaṃ śṛṇupānārthaṃ tatprasādena dātavyaṃ lāpayettathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saptāhāttatprayogeṇa nātra kāryyā vicāraṇāmāyāṃ sphuradvayaṃ caiva prasphuradvitayaṃ vadetpracaṭadvitayaṃ paścātkahadvandvaṃ mahadvayammanuḥ proktoghoramuniruṣṇik chandosya devatāvarṇaiḥ kuryyātṣaḍaṅgāni padanyāsotha vakṣyatesajaṃghapādayoścaiva padānyekādaśa nyasetrasanetramitairvarṇaistatpadaiśca bhavatyasau [padanyāsa iti śeṣaḥ ||]bhujaṅgabhūṣaṇaṃ raktavasanālepaśobhitam"damaruṃ kheṭakaṃ cāpaṃ nṛkapālaṃ ca bibhratamnigrahe grahabhūtādimuktau muktānibhaṃ smaretṣaṭkoṇāntasthite padmadvitaye bhūpurairvṛteḍamaruṃ paraśuṃ khaḍgaṃ kheṭaṃ bāṇaṃ tathā dhanuḥvīthīdvaye lokapālāṃstadastrāṇi ca pūjayetjuhuyāttaddaśāṃśena tilaiḥ śuddhaghṛtaplutaiḥevaṃ siddhe mantravare kāmyakarmmāṇi sādhayethomoyaṃ nāśayetsadyo bhūtakṛtyādināyakānsamidvaraiḥ kṛto homaḥ pūrvavaddrutaśāntidaḥpṛthaksahasrahomena bhūtānāṃ nigraho bhavethutvā sahasraṃ pratyakaṃ pātre sampātayeddruteaghorāstrāhvayo mantraḥ sarvakāmyāni sādhayettāraḥ śrīṃ paśuśabdānte huṃphaḍmantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥmantrārṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhiraṅgāni huṃphaḍantaiḥ sabindukaiḥdhyāyetpaśupatiṃ samyaṅmantrī caikāgramānasaḥagnijvālānibhaśmaśrumūrddhajaṃ bhīmadaṃṣṭrakamdadhānaṃ dakṣiṇairhastairūrdhvādikramataḥ paraiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nānābharaṇasandīptaṃ bālacandrairalaṃkṛtampadmamaṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā karṇikākeśarānvitamevaṃ pātre samālikhya svarṇaraupyādike śubhesarvopacārairārādhya yajedaṅgāni pūrvavatpūjayedvidhinānena sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāttarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā prayogārho bhavenmanuḥsadyastanmuñcati krandatyaho mantraprabhāvataḥevaṃ mantrastu saṃsiddho bhuktimuktiprado bhavetbhavedaṣṭākṣaro mantro munyādyaṃ pūrvavanmatampraṇavādyaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni prāgvaddhyātvā ca pūjayetṣaḍaṅgaiśca dvitīyāsyāttadastrādyaistṛtīyikāṣaṣṭhī cendrādibhiḥ proktā saptamī ca tadāyudhaiḥanyatsarvaṃ prayogādi pūrvavatparikīrttitamśaṃnīṃṭha iti mantroyaṃ trivarṇaḥ sarvakāmadaḥnīlakaṇṭhaḥ śaṃ ca bījaṃ ṭhaḥ śaktiḥ parikīrttitānīlakaṇṭhāyeti śikhā kavacaṃ kālakūṭaviastraṃ ca śitikaṇṭhāya svāhāntā iti sammatāḥmūrdhni kaṇṭhe ca hṛdaye nyasedbījatrayaṃ punaḥjaṭābhūtalasaccandrākārakaiḥ phaṇisattamaiḥśūlaṃ kapālaṃ khaṭvāṅgamakṣamālāṃ ca bibhratampadmamadhye samāsīnamatisundaravigrahampadme vasudale ramye caturasratrayāvṛteevaṃ prapūjayemantrī sarvakāmasya siddhayetaddaśāṃśaṃ tarppaṇādi bhojayenmadhurairdvijānspṛṣṭvā japedviṣagrastaṃ tatkṣaṇānnirviṣo bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bījābhyāṃ prathamāntyābhyāṃ pārśvayorviṣamāharettakṣakeṇāpi sandaṣṭastatkṣaṇānnirviṣo bhavetviṣadvayānmucyatesāvacirānnātra saṃśayaḥmanuvarṇatrayaṃ nyasya devatārūpakaṃ gurummantrākṣaratrayaṃ nyasya tadaṃgulibhiruttamampradarśya mantraṃ prajapetpañcāśadvāramatra turogagrahādyapasmārānapamṛtyuṃ ca nāśayetmunirbrahmā ca gāyatrī chando devaḥ prakirttitaḥprayogāśca viśeṣeṇa mahāviṣaharāḥ smṛtāḥaruṇosya muniśchando gāyatraṃ devatāmahānhuṃ namo nīlakaṇṭhāya śiraḥ svāhā namastvitisvāhā namo netramiti oṃ namostraṃ samīritamvargāṣṭakaṃ nyasenmantrī pādorugulphasandhiṣupūrvādyairānanairyyuktaḥ pītaśvetāruṇāsitaiḥdhyeyo devosya pārśvasthā gaurī cāpyatisundarīdaśalakṣaṃ puraścaryyā sarvatrākṣaravanmatāhṛdi bāhvornetrayośca mastake ca kramādyajetjapenmantraṃ dṛśā sarvaviṣāṇāṃ vāraṇambhavettāro namo bhagavate sarvajñetipadaṃ vadetḍentaṃ dviḥ kṣipa oṃ svāhā conatriṃśākṣaro manuḥamalākhyo nīlakaṇṭho rudro devaḥ prakīrttitaḥsaptabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ ṣaḍbhiścaturbhiścāpi saptabhiḥlakṣamekaṃ puraścaryyā hunedājyaṃ daśāṃśataḥduṣṭaṃ viṣaṃ dravyasaṃsthaṃ haredatra na saṃśayaḥviṣamūṣīviṣaṃ hanti japaḥ saptadaśonmitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pāpāsyakāmamiṣṭaṃ kṣaṇādbhavetdineśāya tatprakāra ihocyatetataḥ paścādupaviśya nijāsaneprāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā sūryamantreṇa mantravittathendrādīndhyātvā sūryamananyadhīḥsamastajagatāmadhipaṃ bhajāmikṛtvā jalena caturasrakamgandhapuṣpākṣatāndarbhadūrvāsarṣapasaṃyutāntatpātraṃ spṛśannaṣṭottaraṃ śatamsūryamantreṇa dadyādarghyaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥtataścayogakaraṇe parivṛttāsaneti cacatustriṃśadakṣaroyaṃ sūryasyārghyanivedanesūryaṃ dhyāyeddeśikasattamaḥvidhivaddvārapūjāṃ samācarettaddakṣiṇe mahālakṣmīṃ vāme cāpi sarasvatīmūrdhvabhāgottaraṃ yāvatpañcapañcavibhāgakedevānetānprapūjayetśaṅkhanidhiṃ dakṣe vāme vasumatīyutamhṛcchaktiṃ gaṅgāṃ ca yamunāṃ tathāpaścimadvārapūjā ceyamprakāśitāsampūjyaivamudagdvāraṃ prāgyāmye ca prapūjayettathā skanda umācaṇḍeśvarau tathāprabalaścaiva bhadraścāpi subhadrakaḥtu yoginyoṣṭāvetā dvārapālikāḥtathendrāṇī cāmuṇḍā ca śriyā saha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: apūpopari saṃlekhyaṃ ghṛtena caturasrakamamukaṃ mocayetyevaṃ dikṣu hrīṃkāramālikhetmokṣaṃ kuruyugaṃ svāhā dhṛtivarṇo manuḥ smṛtaḥkārāniketanasthāya pradadyātsuhṛde ca tamtasminsaṃbhakṣite baddho macyate bandhanāddrutamvaṃ vahnaye namaśceti tārādiḥ saptavarṇavānhṛcchaktistārako bījaṃ satārārṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakamrakto raktāṃśuko raktapravarākalpabhaṣitaḥjayantaścāgnikeśaśca kṛttikāputra eva cacitrākṣo bhūpure śakrādikapūjā prakīrttitātarppaṇādyairmanuḥ siddhaḥ śrīrakṣājayaputradaḥśītaleti ca vikhyātā tasyā mantraṃ susiddhidamupamanyurmuniśchando bṛhatī śītalā surīdhyāyecca śītalāṃ devīṃ rāsabhasthāṃ digambarāmp. 762)tailādimalasaṃyuktavastrapoṭaliśīrṣikāmśarāvikāṃ ca koṇeṣu bhūpure tvaṣṭabhairavānhutvā kṛtvā tarppaṇādi mantrī siddhaḥ prajāyatetena sammārjitāścaiva sphoṭā naśyanti tatkṣaṇāttenābhimantritaṃ bhasma yadgṛhe tatra sā na hitāraḥ prāsādabījaṃ yaṃ vaṃ vyomavyāpine dviṭhaḥ [svāhādvayam ||]daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādājyaistarppaṇādi tataścaretyathoktaguṇatāmeti nirvīryyamapi nānyathārogibhyo bheṣajaṃ dattaṃ tattatpūrṇaguṇaṃ bhavetvalīpalitanirmukto jīvedvarṣaśataṃ yuvājale caikādaśāhena rogahṛjjāyate manuḥ

sanskrit: sarvavaśaṅkare svāhā vāgbījādyo nakhārṇakaḥdevatā tu laghuśyāmā vāgbījaṃ bījamucyatevākpūrvikāṃ ratiṃ mūrdhni prītiṃ māyādikāṃ hṛdiicchāśaktiṃ jñānaśaktiṃ kriyāśaktiṃ kramānnyasetdrāṃ drāvaṇaṃ nyasecchīrṣe drāṃ ca śoṣaṇamāsyakesa utpādanakaṃ pāde tataḥ kuryyātṣaḍaṅgakamāṃkṣābrāhmīkanyakāyai namomūrdhni pravinyasetkūṃ-hāṃ kaumārīkanyakāyai namo dakṣāṃsake nyasetoṃ sāṃ cendrāṇīkanyāyai namo dakṣiṇapārśvakeaḥ lāmuktvā mahālakṣmīkanyāyai ca namo hṛdibhrūmadhye kaṇṭhahṛnnābhimūlādhārāṃtareṣu cavaśitā cātha prākāmyaṃ prāptirityaṣṭasiddhayaḥke bhāle netrayorvaktre karṇayoḥ kakudi dhruvamsukeśīṃ mañjughoṣāṃ ca mahāraṅgavatīṃ tathāvidyādharakimpuruṣapiśācānāṃ krameṇa caguhye cādhāradeśe ca klīmādyāśca namontakāḥnyasetsandhiṣu sāgreṣu karayoḥ pādayorapikarasya sandhayaścaite sphigjānu ca tato bhavetnyāsānevaṃ vidhānkṛtvā laghuśyāmāṃ tataḥ smaretmāṇikyābharaṇāṃ smerāṃ nīlotpalanibhāmbarāmtryakṣāṃ tāmbūlapūrṇāsyāṃ smarecca śaśiśekharāmtrikoṇe pañcakoṇeṣu dale ṣoḍaśapatrakeicchājñānakriyāśaktīstadagre bāṇapañcakamaṇimādyāśca yantrāgre yajetṣoḍaśapatrakegajānanāṃ siṃhamukhīṃ gṛdhrāsyāṃ kākatuṇḍikām

sanskrit: p. 764)ulakīṃ ca śivārāvāṃ mayūrīṃ vikaṭānanāmsamarcayeddiśi prācyāmetāḥ ṣoḍaśa yoginīḥtryakṣā ca kekarākṣī ca bṛhattuṇḍā surāpriyāpāśahastā daṇḍahastā pracaṇḍeti ca dakṣiṇeśiśughnī pāpahantrī ca kālī rudhirapāyinīśūlakeśī bṛhatkukṣī sarppāsyā pretavāhinīvyāghrāsyā bhīmaniḥśvāsā vyomaikacaraṇārdhadṛkvidyutprabhā balākāsyā mārjjārī kaṭilānanākramāḍḍākinya etāśca pūjyā vahnyādikoṇakedurgāṃ tadbahirindrādīnvajrādīnyapi pūjayetsuciraṃ ceti pūjoktā dvādaśāvaraṇairiyammātaṅgīmantrasamproktāḥ prayogāścātra kīrtitāḥyāgadravyaṃ ca bhūpālastadvaśe rājaputrakāḥdevīvanmānanīyāśca striyo nindyā na jātucitkāmasya bāṇabījānāṃ mantroyaṃ parikīrtitaḥbāṇeśī sarvavyastena manunoktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakamnyastavyāḥ pañcabajrādyā drāvaṇī kṣobhaṇī tathābāṇāndhanuḥ sṛṇiṃ pāśaṃ hastaissandadhatīrbhajebāṇeśīyogapīṭhāya namo mūlādiko manuḥādau ṣaḍaṅgānyārādhya dikṣvagre drāviṇīmukhāḥanaṅgamanmathānaṅgakusumā madanāturāanaṅgabhūmikā bhūmipure dikpāśca sāyudhāḥtarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā prayogārho manurbhavetsahasraṃ juhuyāttasya vaśyāḥ syuḥ prāṇinokhilāḥkanyāpi vaśamāyāti māsadvitayamadhyataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: namastubhyamanujñāṃ dātumarhasisaṃskuryādāsanasthānaṃ caturbhirvīkṣaṇādibhiḥādhāraśaktimārabhya svāsanaṃ tatra vinyasetvidhivatsmaredviṣṇuṃ guruṃ tathādevatā proktā viniyogo nijāsanedhāraya māṃ devi pavitraṃ kuru cāsanamīśāne kṣaṃ kṣetrapataye namaḥ |] samarcayet|] vāpi ṛjukāyo manassthiraḥsuvāsitāmbusampūrṇaṃ savye kumbhaṃ suśobhanamghṛtādijvalitāndīpānsthāpayetparitaḥ śubhānsaṃsthāpya saṃskuryāttāni cātmavānnārācamudrayā dṛṣṭvā samayāṃśca vilokayanaspṛśyasparśanaṃ vāpi yadanyāyārjitañca vātatpūrvannāśamāyāti naivedyādyavalokanātsyācchubhado dīpo niṣkravyādaḥ sukhapradaḥvasāmajjādisambhūtairghṛtādyairupayojitamdīrghayā bhavet ||] saṃspṛśetpāṇinā dhṛtvā vāmapārśvasthitaṃ ghaṭamjalāśayaśavasparśājjalaṃ sthāne ca saṅgatamkṛtāñjaliḥ pūto vāmadakṣiṇapārśvayoḥsugandhapuṣpāṇyādāya candanāktāni mantravitvāmahastena samādāya ca mastakampūrvampaṭhecchokamimaṃ sādhakasattamaḥmṛtyurogabhayakleśāḥ patantu ripumastaketyajet || karaśuddhiṃ tatostreṇa kuryāttālatrayaṃ tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ājyaṃ sampātitaṃ dadyātstriyai saṃpādya tattvidamsugandhakusumairhutvā dhanamāpnoti vāñchitamtāro namaḥ śivāye ca nārāyaṇyai padaṃ vadetvyāso muniḥ kṛtiśchando devī gaṅgā prakīrttitācaturbhujāṃ trinetrāṃ ca sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitāmcāmarairvījyamānāṃ ca śvetacchatropaśobhitāmjayādiśaktibhiryukte pīṭhe bhāgīrathīṃ yajetsūryyaṃ himācalaṃ menā bhagīrathamapāṃ patimhaṃsānkāraṇḍavāṃścakravākānsārasakānyajetevaṃ saṃsādhito mantrobhīṣṭaṃ yacchati mantriṇedadyāddaśabhyo viprebhyo daśaprasthamitāṃstilānp. 766)sarvabhogasamāyukto jāyate mānavo bhuviśrībījapūrvamanunā tasya śrīḥ sarvatomukhītilairhutvā dahetpāpaṃ dūrvābhiśca mahāgadānarcayitvā tu yo gaṅgāṃ tulasīmaṃjarīṃ kṣipetgaṃgāpravāhavattasya syādvāgbhūtivijṛmbhitābahiryajanakarttāraḥ siddhāḥ syuryatprabhāvataḥhilidvayaṃ ca gaṃge māṃ pāvayadvitayaṃ vadetrāmavedeṣusaptāṃganetrārṇairaṃgakalpanamsadaiva sarvapāpasya nāśāya suniṣevitāmtatobdhyasre tu kāverīṃ yamunāṃ gaṇḍakīmapisurāsindhumāsavābdhiṃ dugdhasindhuṃ madhūdbhavammādhvīsindhuṃ kṣārasindhuṃ sudhāyāḥ sindhumudbhavamalobhādvāmamārgepi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vināśayetevaṃsiddhamanurmantrī marvādinirjalasthale
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: homādi sarvaṃ irvartya gaṃgāmāvāhayettataḥkalpasthāpitatoyaughaṃ samastagadanāśanamprāgvanmunyādikaṃ bāṇavedatritritribāhubhiḥhomadravyādikaṃ prāgvatsiddhamantraḥ samācaretp. 767)tryahādavarṣākālepi vṛṣṭirbhavati bhūyasīsampātājyaṃ pibedyā strī gaurvā kṣīranidhirbhavettasyāḥ putrāḥ prajāyante bhīṣmatulyaparākramāḥbhūtāviṣṭasya tatkālaṃ mukto bhavati nānyathātithivarṇosya munyādipūjā pūrvavadīritāetasya bhajanājjantornātīrthe maraṇambhavetsambuddhau gaṅgadayite namo varma tathāstrakamjapādinā siddhamantraḥ prayogānācaredathaguḍūcyā roganāśaḥ syādramā padmādihomataḥjātīprasūnairvaśyaṃ syājjapāpuṣpairjayo bhavetvāgbījaṃ prathamaṃ hṛcca nāradosya manormuniḥbījapūrvaiśca ṣaḍdīrghaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥkarairdadhānāṃ mīnasthāṃ muktābharaṇabhūṣitāmprabhāvatīṃ bhānumatīṃ bhūpure tu digīśvarāntarppaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā siddhamantraḥ prajāyatemadhunā svarṇalekhanyā soṣṭavarṣaḥ kavirbhavetdvitīyādapratigrāhī bhikṣāśī vātha maunavānvāksiddhiṃ labhatevaśyaṃ dātā bhoktā tvayācakaḥnamo mameti ca padaṃ dhāraṇāṃ ca dhiyantathāmunyādikantathā pūjā puraścaryyā ca pūrvavatvacākalkena mantraṃ tu likhitvā bhānuvāsare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saptabhirbhānuvāraiśca sākṣātsyāddhiṣaṇopamaḥravau tu pāyase mantraṃ likhetsvarṇaśalākayāsvapne tamarthaṃ śṛṇuyātprātarbījaṃ svayaṃ smarettāro vāghrīṃ ramākāmastāro maṃ maṇikarṇikemunirvyāsotiśakvarī chandaḥ syānmaṇikarṇikābījapūraṃ dakṣahaste vāme cendīvarasrajampaścimābhimukhī smerāpadmasthā padmamālikālakṣatrayaṃ japenmantraṃ juhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥāvāhya kalaśe devīṃ pūjayedayutaṃ japetpāyasaṃ bhakṣayenmuktī rogapīḍā ca naśyativaṃśavṛddhikaraḥ proktaḥ kāśīvāsapradāyakaḥnamaścaturdaśārṇoyaṃ munyādyaṃ pūrvavanmatamaiṃ-śrīṃ mekalakanyāyai narmadāyai hṛdādikamhṛdādiṣu prakalpāyai hṛdayaṃ devavarṇakaḥḍentaiḥ pṛthak pañcapadaiḥ samastairaṅgakalpanampadmābhayasudhākumbhavarādyānbibhratīṃkaraiḥghoṇāṃ jyotiṣmatīṃ cāpi vāmadakṣiṇato yajetlakṣaṃ japeddhunedyo vai bhuktiṃmuktiṃ tato bhajetiti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte bhairavādimanukathanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśaḥ prakāśaḥdurgrahāśca yathā duḥkhaṃ dātuṃ śaktānavidviṣaḥsādhakaistu prakartavyā kathaṃ siddhiḥ prajāyatesiddhasya lekhanādeva yantrasiddhiḥ prajāyateduḥsvapnadarśanaṃ pūrvaṃ tadā yantranna kārayetsvapyāttridivasaṃ bhūmau haviṣyāśī japettataḥkṛtvā pradoṣasamaye likhettridivasaṃ bhuvi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tathaivājñāṃ gṛhītvā tu satsvapno vā likhedbudhaḥjīvasaṃsthāpanaṃ yantre kuryyādyena phalaṃ labhetdvitīyāntaṃ sādhyamadhye kurudvandvaṃ ca pārśvayoḥhaṃsaḥ sohaṃ manorasya likhedekaikamakṣaramṭhadvayaṃ vāmapārśve ca likhetpūrvāditaḥ kramātevaṃ dikpālabījāni vinyaseddikṣu ca kramāttanno yantrampracodayātp. 770)evantu likhitaṃ yantraṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakamyantraṃ sulikhya guṭikāṃ baddhvā sūtreṇa veṣṭayetyaddevatākaṃ yantraṃ syāttadbījena ca pūjayetaṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu mūlaṃ japtvā hunedghṛtammūrdhni bāhau gale vāpi tattadiṣṭārthasiddhayeakleśenaiva sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ siddhimāpnuyātakpratyāhāramuccāryya roṃ-rauṃ-ḍauṃ-ḍauṃ tato vadetvargāntyamādyadvitryabdhivarṇānvargacatuṣṭayeṛṣiḥ syāddakṣiṇāmūrttirgāyatrī chanda īritamsvarahīnairhayābdhyaśvairmantrārṇaiḥ pañcapañcabhiḥśirasi brahmarandhre ca kramānnyasyā nava svarāḥhaṃ-yaṃ-ṭaṃ-raṃ-vaṃ-lamiti nyasedbījāni vai kramātdakṣavāmakrameṇaiva ṭādivargaṃ tathādimamtathā sandhāvaṃgulīnāṃ gulphe sargādinādikānguhye hṛtkakudormadhye śaṣasānvinyasetkramātvarākṣamālāpadmāni kapālaṃ bibhratīṃ karaiḥśrīvidyārādhane cāpi samartho jāyate naraḥbhūrjapatre likhedyantraṃ kuṃkumena madena ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: amukaṃ cetyadhaḥ sthāne vaśaṃ kurviti pārśvayoḥṣaṭṣaḍbhāge keśarāṇāṃ gāṃ-gīṃ-gūṃ-gaiṃ ca gaumitiherambamālāmantraṃ ca gaṃ namo vahnigehinīmsarvārthasiddhidāyeti sarvaduḥkhapadaṃ vadetsaṃkṣobhayadvayaṃ hrīṃ-gāṃ namo jvalanagehinīpadmādvahiḥ prakarttavyaṃ varttuladvitayantataḥlakṣmībījāni parata aiṃ-bījena praveṣṭayetakṛtvā cāgnisambandhaṃtāṃtrilohe nidhāpayetamitaṃ chanda ityuktaṃ yantraṃ dayādabhīpsitamsādhyanāma ca tanmadhye tadbāhyeṣṭadalaṃ likhetglauṃbījaṃ taddale lekhyaṃ tadbāhye ca likhetpunaḥcaturviṃśatyakṣaraṃ ca gaṇeśasya manuṃ śṛṇunaṃ me vaśametyuktvā naya svāhā manurmataḥkādikāṃstānmātṛvarṇānsabindūṃstasya bāhyataḥtasya koṇeṣu laṃ bījaṃ likhettasya bahiṣpunaḥtadveṣṭayedbaṃbījena tadbahirvṛttayugmakambījaṃ cādyantayorlekhyaṃ mahāgaṇapateridamgorocanā gomayantu kastūrī keśaraṃ tathāetadyantraṃ dhṛtaṃ yena satvajeyo naro bhavetgṛhe vane jalādau vā sarvadā sa jayī bhavetraktapuṣpādimiścaiva naivedyaiḥ paripūjayetp. 772)pratāpayecca dīpāgnau saptāhātstriyamāpnuyātavaśyaṃ vaśayennārīṃ vidveṣaṇamathocyatelikhedyantraṃ tu mṛtakavastrapuṅkhe bahiṣkṛtesthāpayedvairisaṅghasya vidveṣo jāyate mahān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pītadravyaiḥ pītapuṣpairarkapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayetvākstambhaṃ vā gatistambhaṃ senāstambhaṃ karoti tatnarāsthni krodhasaṃyuktaḥ pūjayeccandanādibhiḥmahāgaṇapateryantraṃ proktaṃ ṣaṭkarmasiddhidamkṛtvā ṣaṭkoṇamādau tu tasya madhye trikoṇakamtrikoṇordhvaṃ caturdikṣu śrīṃ-hrīṃ-klīṃ-glauṃ samālikhetoṃ-śrīṃ-hrīṃ-klīṃ-glauṃ ca gaṃ ca likhitvā ṣaḍdale kramātgaṇapataya ityādi varṇaikaṃ cāṣṭame dalevīthyagre tu hyakārādīnkṣakārāntāndvitīyakeaiṃbījairveṣṭayetturyyaṃ hrīṃbījena tato bahiḥpuruṣārthakṛtaṃ yantraṃ tvaṣṭāsreṇaiva veṣṭayetalaktaṃ caiva kāśmīrakastūrīrocanānvitamāyurārogyasampattikīrttikṛtprītivardhanamlikhedaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu vartulampraṇavasyottare glauṃ cāgre tasya jaṭhare tu gamp. 773)bhūbījodaragaṃ haṃ ca pūrvāśādiṣu vinyasetkamalaṃ vā tato lekhyaṃ caturasradvayākṛtitasya garbhe vakāraṃ ca sabinduṃ koṇamastaketadbahiścaturasraṃ ca glauṃ tatkoṇeṣu saṃlikhetādityabudhaśukrāṇāṃ madhye kasyāpi vāsarepradīpadīpite tatra tathaivārdrakasaṃyutāmsthānāṣṭake gaṇeśasya variṣṭhāṃ pādasammitāmpaścātsaṃśodhayitvā tāṃ pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyayāpaścāttāṃ lepayenmantrī śubhe sūkṣme sitembareatra prāṇānpratiṣṭhāpya pūjitaṃ guṭikīkṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vinirmāya tribhirbhāgairniśāyāṃ taddhṛdi kṣipetgandhapuṣpādinaivedyairabhyarcya gaṇanāyakamsaṃjapya pūjayedbhaktyā pītavarṇaiśca puṣpakaiḥtaṇḍulāñcchālisambhūtānprasthamānamitāñcchubhānguḍaṃ caiva tathā bhūyo nārikelaṃ ca tatsamamtadardhaṃ jīrakaṃ cājyaṃ kuḍavārdhasamaṃ bhavetpacetsiddhaudanaścāyaṃ gaṇeśasya mahāpriyaḥkarpūravāsitaiḥ pūgaistāmbūlaiścandanādibhiḥpraṇameddaṇḍavadbhūmau stutvā stutibhirādarātstambhayetsādhakaḥ satyaṃ yuddhabhūmau mahāniśitattatsthānagatānsarvāñjanānsastaṃmbhayennaraḥaśvavāraṇaśālāsu kṣaṇātsarvānupadravānstambhayedakhilaṃ viśvaṃ kimpunarvāñchitaṃ janamharidrāṃ śodhayedveśmamṛdā proktena vartmanātasya madhye sādhyanāma praṇavāveṣṭitaṃ likhettadveṣṭayetsādhyanāma hraṃgaṃbhyāṃ haridakṣaraiḥhrīṃkārairveṣṭanaṃ kṛtvā likhedaṣṭadale punaḥvidikpātraṃ veṣṭayecca pūrvavaccāṣṭakoṣṭhakamvidikpatreṣu saṃlikhya śūlānkoṣṭhāgrato likhetsampuṭīkṛtya saṃlikhya māyayā koṇayugmakekṛtaprāṇapratiṣṭhaṃ taddharidrāvighnakukṣigamcakrihastamṛdāpohya gaṇeśāgāramṛttikāmvinyasya taṃ gaṇeśānaṃ kusumairaruṇairyajetdvitīyena śarāveṇa vidadhīta susādhakaḥsādhakasya samāyāti sannidhau vāñchito janaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āgacchanti na sandeho mantriṇaḥ klinnacetasaḥpūjitaṃ sthāpitaprāṇaṃ dugdhenaivābhiṣecayetp. 775)tadānīmānayennūnaṃ kāmayānāṃ tu sundarīmsvinnena mardayitvā tu kṛtvā sādhyākṛtiṃ śubhāmkṣaṇādāyāti kāmārttā vāñchitā varavarṇinīsīmantinī samāyāti śīghraṃ yauvanagarvitāyamuddiśyātra tasyāpi kṣaṇādākṛṣṭikārakamśatayojanadūrāttu sādhyamākarṣayeddhruvammanumenaṃ vidhānena sa tadākarṣayeddhi tamtatsthāne kāmabījaṃ ca kāmamadhye tu gaṃ likhetveṣṭayetkāmabījena śeṣaṃ pūrvavadeva hividhinā sthāpitaprāṇaṃ śare vinyasya taṃ japetmanau sādhyābhidhāṃ dattvā sthānepūrvasamīritesādhyadiksammukho bhūttvā mantraṃ mantrī samāhitaḥevaṃ dinatrayaṃ kurvansaptabhirdivasairbudhaḥvaśayetsādhakaḥ śīghraṃ yāvajjīvaṃ na saṃśayaḥacalāṃ kamalāṃ labdhvā vaśayedviśvamañjasātatsamena guḍenāpi madhunā saindhavena canirmāya gaṇapaṃ tena yantraṃ taddhṛdiniḥkṣipetpratimāṃ bhakṣayetpaścātsādhyā vaśyā bhaveddhruvamaṣṭādhikaśataṃ japtvā pūjitāṃ sthāpitānilāmvaśayedvāñchitaṃ sādhyaṃ sadā sarvasvadāyinamlakṣeṇa vaśayetsādhyaṃ vasumātrasya sādhakammṛgebhamadasaṃyuktā hyaṣṭāṅgaṃ vighnanāśanearccanādi tathā kṛtvā japitvāṣṭottaraṃ śatam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īkṣaṇātsparśanātsadyastrilokīṃ vaśamānayetcandanenaiva vā kuryyādvidhimenaṃ phalapradambandhūkavālakośīraviṣṇukrāntābalāstathāsarvauṣadhirasenaiva niśā bhāgārdhasammitāprāṇasaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā japedaṣṭasahasrakamtrailokyasampadā sopi tiraskuryyāddhanādhipamādāya brahmacaryyeṇa bheṣajairuditaṃ samamghṛtaplutaṃ dahenmantrī śoṣayitvaidhitenalesamīraṇaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya gaṇapaṃ tatra pūjayetnidhāya lepayedbhasma lalāṭādiṣu sādhakaḥlabdhvā lokapriyo bhūtvā dīrghajīvī bhaveddhruvamkuryyādāyuṣyavṛddhyarthaṃ yo vai vijayasampadep. 777)raktāmbarasuvarṇaistu proktabheṣajapūrvakamdīpaṃ prajvālya tenaiva japenmantraṃ punaḥ punaḥnetre dattvā ca vaśayennikhilaṃ viśvamojasāabhimantrya naraṃ yaṃ vā tilakaṃ prakaroti yāaṅgānuvarttinaṃ kuryyādyāvañjīvaṃ na saṃśayaḥproktaṃ gaṇapatermantraṃ naro japtvā sahasrakamśikhāyāṃ bandhayennityaṃ sarvato jayamāpnuyātāpaṇavyavahāreṣu dyūte vāde mahārṇaveparāṅganāsamūheṣu śobhate manmatho yathāakhilaṃ vāñchitaṃ sādhyaṃ vaśyaṃ nayati tatkṣaṇātabhimantrya śataṃ sāgraṃ lakṣayedvaśayejjagatsampātaṃ lakṣayedyantraṃ vaśamāyāti socirātvaśīkaraṇamantrasya prayogoyamudāhṛtaḥ

sanskrit: uktarītyā likhedyantraṃ huṃkāraṃ tasya madhyataḥtasya madhye sādhyanāma yaṃ likhetpatramadhyataḥkoṇekoṇe triśūlañca śūlāgreṣu niveśitamṣaḍbījasthāna ālikhyaṃ yaṃbījena ca veṣṭitamp. 778)yantrametatsamālikhya sthāpayedīraṇaṃ tataḥśmaśānavahnau saṃdahya bhasmādāya tadudbhavamyantramadhye pravinyasya punastadguṭikīkṛtampeṣayecca citāṅgāraṃ kapikacchuṃ ca vānarīmtattasyā madhyagaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ prāṇānpraveśayetśarāvayugalaṃ mantrī nirmāyānyatra cobhayoḥmanāvuccāṭayadvandvaṃ yojayitvā japenmanumnikhanedyasya ca dvāri māsenoccāṭayecca tamyantraṃ pūrvadine lekhyaṃ madhye yaṃ ca sabījakamtriśūlāgre tu haṃkāraṃ haṃkāreṇa tu veṣṭayetdvitritridviguṇaṃ piṣṭvā hemapatrāmbunā tataḥpañcāṅgaṃ pāribhadrasya kākiṇīñca tathā punaḥsaṃvṛtya vighnarājasya kukṣau pūrvavadarcayetvidveṣayadvayaṃ mantre japetsaṃyojya sāṣṭakamprītayorvidhinānena vidveṣo bhavati dhruvamvairamprajāyate śīghraṃ deśanāśo bhaveddvayoḥgacchatāṃ pādasaṃsparśādvivādastu mahānbhavetvairaṃ ca prāṇivattatra svairaṃ bhavati sarvadābhāgaikaṃ maricasyāpi niśāyāśca tathaiva cap. 779)iti vidveṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ māraṇaṃ kathyatedhunālekhyaṃ daleṣvagnibījaṃ tadbāhyeṣṭāsrakaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tejo vahniprākāramudrayātataḥ kuryāttatprakāramatha bruvepītavarṇaṃ ca bhūsthānaṃ brahmadaivatamjīvānāmevaṃ rūpaṃ vicintayetardhacandranibhaṃ śṛṅgadvayaṃ tatpadmalāñchitampratiṣṭhākalayā yuktaṃ dhyāyettadviṣṇudaivatamkalayā yutaṃ vidyākhyayā tathāmahāpralayavatsthānaṃ vahnitattvaṃ vicintayetṣaḍbindulāñchitaṃ vṛttaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇakamyaṃbījarūpaṃ dhyātvetthaṃ prāṇarūpaṃ vicintayetvṛttākārandhūmravarṇaṃ mahoccadhvajalāñchitamdhyātvetthaṃ dehe bhūtāni vinyasettatkarṇikāsaṃsthaṃ pradīpakalikānibhamsohaṃmantreṇa sādhakaḥcintayetpāpapūruṣambrahmahatyāśiraskandhaṃ svarṇasteyabhujadvayamtatsaṃsargapadadvandvamaṅgapratyaṅgapātakamkrūraṃ ruṣṭaṃ pāpaṃ vicintayetprāṇasaṃrodhaṃ vāyubījena vāyunādvātriṃśanmātrayā tataḥcandrabījaṃ kundendvayutasuprabhamcatuṣṣaṣṭimātrayā toyabījakamdehaṃ vicintyaivaṃ manasā piṅgalādhvanāsañjāte sakale dehe devatopāsanakṣamehṛdayāmbhojādānayetparamātmanaḥ

sanskrit: trikoṇaṃ tadbahiḥ kāryaṃ trikoṇe ca vare likhettadvahirvahnikoṇeṣu vahnibījaṃ samālikhetcitāṅgārotthaya maṣyā kākapakṣaśalākayākaṇārāmaṭhacavyākhyaniśāmaricasadvacāḥkāraskarasya pañcāṅgairaṇḍabījānvitāmṛtāmsamīraṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpya kṛtvā gaṇapatiṃ tataḥmātṛsadmasamudbhūtāṃ gaṇeśāgāramṛttikāmśmaśānamṛttikāṃ tadvatkaravīradrumūlajām [druśabdo vṛkṣaparyāyaḥ ||]piṣṭvā śarāvayugalaṃ kṛtvā cānyatra cobhayoḥkāraskarabhavaiḥ patrairnaivedyaiśca yathā purāmānayetpūjayeccaiva sahasraṃ sāṣṭakaṃ japetcatvare pretabhūmau ca mātṛvighnagṛhetha vāsādhyo yamapuraṃ yāti saptāhājjvarapīḍitaḥbhūdevavyatirikteṣu rājavairiṣu yojayetkarttāpi taddaśāṃśena prāyaścittaṃ samācaretṣaṭṣaṭkarmakarāṇyāśu gopanīyāni yatnataḥaṣṭapatraṃ likhetpūrvaṃ mātakūṭaṃ tu madhyataḥtasyordhvaṃ bhūpuraṃ kuryāṃdracaneyaṃ pradarśitāprātarmūrdhni śirobindumadhyasthaṃ sarvasampadeabhiṣekācca dhanakṛtpūjanāllokavaśyakṛtsauvarṇe rājate tāmre paṭṭe vā yantramuddharetyantramadhye mahādevaṃ samyagdhyātvā tu tatra caspṛṣṭvā yantraṃ japenmantramaṣṭottarasahasrakamtatra samyakpūjayitvā mṛdā bhūmiṃ ca pūjayetsānnidhyaṃ devatāyāḥ syātsādhakaḥ sukhamāpnuyāt

sanskrit: likhedaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tanmadhye jñānino manumjñānimantraṃ vasudale pūrvādiṣu likhetkramātiṃ-īṃ-uṃ-ūṃ ca aiṃ lekhyaṃ cāṣṭapatreṣu mantriṇāyantrakoṣṭhe tatra saṃsthairvarṇaiḥ sādhyasya nāmakamvṛttena yantramuktaṃ tanmātṛkāyāstathaiva casarvaśāntikaraṃ rāhorohiṇyāmudite satietasyā eva devyāstu vakṣya uccāṭamāraṇamhaṃkāpeśvarāya namaḥ proktaścāṣṭākṣarastvihayaṃ śaṃ vaṃ haṃ ca prācyāṃ hi prāgvadvā saṃ samālikhetbahistu te veṣṭanīyā vāyumaṇḍalacakrataḥp. 781)vāyumaṇḍalametatsyātsnātvā mandodaye satiyadā tadā bhavecchatroruccāṭo nātra saṃśayaḥkarau svaṭhau naiphaḍ namo manuraṣṭākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥuṃ īṃ khaṃ chaṃ ṭhaṃ ca yaṃ ca haṃsaṃ ceti praveṣṭayetsiddhādicakre kathitā ye varṇāstaiśca saṃyutamśmaśānāṅgārakeṇāpi sa sādhyaḥ syādyamātithiḥkāśmīrīyāvakābhyāntu bhūrjjapatre likhetpunaḥsarvatra kurute rakṣāṃ yantrametatsudurlabhamtatkarṇikāyāṃ tu likhedoṃ-voṃ-viṃ-viṃ vidhuntudāprādakṣiṇyena pūrvādau varṇānbījena saṃyutānprāgvatsādhyaṃ ca mitrārṇayuktaṃ samyak kramāllikhettatastu veṣṭayetsarvamadhacandraiḥ suśobhanaiḥkucandanodakenaitadbhuktambhakṣyeṇa bhāgyadamlikhedaṣṭadale prāgvatprādakṣiṇyena saṃpuṭānsādhyanāmārṇakānmitravarṇādyānapi cāgrataḥ

sanskrit: likhitaṃ gairikairetatsarvopadravanāśanamnavayonyātmakaṃ samyaktrikoṇantasya madhyataḥsasārvakūṭamekaikaṃ likhettāni vadāmyahamnādavindusamāyuktaṃ madhyayonāvidaṃ likhetnādabinduyutau caiva taddale ca samālikhetvisargādyamidaṃ kūṭaṃ tṛtīye sulikhettataḥvṛttadvayantu tadbāhye vīthikāyāmpraveṣṭayetcaturasradvayenaiva karttavyantatra saṃlikhetlākṣayā ca trilohena homasampātasādhitamathānyattraipuraṃ vakṣye bhūrjje ṣaṭkoṇamālikhetkuryyātpatreṣu sulikhetkāmabījāni tadvahiḥtadvahiścaturasrantu kuryyādyantraṃ sulekhataḥkaroti kavitākīrttiṃ sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥādau likhitvā ṣaṭkoṇantanmadhye kāmabījakamṣaṭkoṇasandhau huṃkāraṃ sarvaṃ strīṃkāraveṣṭitamtannaḥ klīṃ pracodayāttena yantraṃ bhavetsiddhamīritaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥyantraṃ pañcadalaṃ cādau kṛtvā tatra tu saṃlikhetagnyādiprādakṣiṇyena drāṃ-drīṃ-klīṃ-klūṃ-sa-ityapiveṣṭayetprathamāṃ vīthīṃ drāṃ-drīṃ-klīṃ-blūṃ-sa ityapicaturasreśakoṇāttu kāmabījaṃ samālikhetdadyādyathepsitānkāmānsādhakāya raṇe drutamp. 783)suvarṇaracite paṭṭe lekhanyā svarṇarūpyayākāśmīrīrocanaiṇeyayutacandanavārimiḥsādhyanāmānvitaṃ tatra hrīṃ klīṃbījadvayaṃ likhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṃ namaḥ prathame patre'nyasminbhagavatīti cacaturthe pañcame patre syātsarvamukharañjinīetāmapi likhettatra sarvarāja vaśaṃkarāmtṛtīye sarvaduṣṭeti likhenmṛgavaśaṅkarāmpañcame sarvaloketi likhenmantraṃvaśaṃkarāmsvāhā saptamapatresya śrīṃ hrīṃ-aiṃ-sauṃ ca klīṃ ca aiṃbījaṣaṭkoṇake proktamaṣṭapatraṃ dvitīyaketatoṣṭapatrajairvarṇairlikheccaivāgratastadāsādhyanāmākṣarayutānmātṛkārṇānkramātkramātsādhyanāmayutaṃ kāmabījamatyantaśuddhimatetadyantraṃ likheccaiva japtvā mantramananyadhīḥpūjyate tridaśādyaiśca kiṃ punarmānavottamaiḥavaśyameva labhate puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥkuryyācca ṣaḍdalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ ca hṛllikhetbahirvṛttadvayaṃ kṛtvā vīthikāyā praveṣṭayetbhūpuraṃ yantrametattu vandhyānāmapi putradamp. 784)ādau sulikhya ṣaṭkoṇaṃ māyāṃ sādhyasamanvitāmetadyantraṃ vaśyakaraṃ pūjitaṃ bāhumadhyagamādau kuryyācca ṣaṭkoṇaṃ koṇā vajrasamanvitāḥvṛttatrayaṃ bahiṣkuryyāttatra vīthīdvayaṃ bhavetśrīkhaṇḍarocanābhyāṃ tu lekhyaṃ sarvajayapradammāyāsthāne tu mantraṃ vā bhuvaneśyāḥ samālikhetaṣṭapatraṃ likhetpadmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ samālikhetlikhetsvarānpatramadhye kādivargāṣṭakaṃ likhetsarvavāñchāpradaṃ yantraṃ sampatsantatidaṃ param
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūrjjapatre likhetpadmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ dhruvaṃ nyasettatkesareṣu saṃlekhyaṃ śrīṃ-hrīṃ-klīṃ ca digaṣṭakevācaṃ māyāṃ ramāṃ kāmaṃ hasanau iti kūṭakamtadbāhye ṣoḍaśadale kesareṣu dvayaṃdvayamtāro hrīṃ kavacaṃ keṃ-keṃ-kṣeṃ-kṣeṃ-śrīṃ-hrīṃ tataḥ paramsarvasaubhāgyadaṃ cāpi sarvaduḥkhavimocanamṣaṭkoṇamadhye sādhyākhyāṃ bhuveneśīṃ samālikhetbahirdvādaśapatre ca varṇānetānsamālikhetdrāṃ-drīṃ-klīṃ-blūṃ-sa ityetairbāṇabījaiḥ praveṣṭayetsvāhetyekādaśārṇena veṣṭayenmātṛkārṇakaiḥ tṛtīyā tadbahiḥ kuryyādbhūpure caiva śaṅkaramkoṣṭhe likheccakārantu sādhyanāmāsya codarejñāṃ saṃ caṃ vaṃ tathaikaikamakṣaraṃ ceśakoṇataḥevameva ca nairṛtyādvāyavyāntaṃ punarlikhetoṃ-hrīṃ-hraṃ-kheṃ ca kṣeṃ kṣaḥ strīṃ-hraṃ-kṣaṃ-hrīṃ ca vaṣaṇmanuḥcaṃ mālikāṃ tu tadbāhye kumbhaṃ kuryyātsuśobhanamkuṃkumairlākṣayā cāpi likhitaṃ svarṇapaṭṭakesampūjya japasaṃsiddhiṃ prāpnuyādyatra tatra vaigajāśvapaśavastvanye sukhinaḥ prāṇino bhṛśamalakṣmī śāntaye cāśu siddhaye sarvasampadāmetadyantrottamaṃ proktaṃ tvaritāyā ghaṭārgalamhrīṃkāraṃ tasya madhye tu sādhyanāma samālikhettvaritāyā bahiḥ kuryātṣaṭkoṇaṃ ca bahiścaretrakṣojayaḥ syātsaṃgrāme vivāde vijayastathānavavyūhābhidhaṃ yantraṃ navavargādināmakekṛtvā cāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāntu hrīṃ likhet

sanskrit: tataścāṣṭadale lekhyamauṃ hrīṃ phaṭkāravarjitamhrīṃkāraistasya bāhye tu lekhyā cauṃkāraśṛṅkhalāevamasyaiva mantrasya karṇikāyāṃ samālikhettathā tārādivarṇāṃśca prāgvatpatreṣu saṃlikhethrīṃkārapuṭitānvarṇānoṃkārāntāndaleṣu caśubhalakṣmīyaśodhānyavāsasāṃ purudāyakamekādaśānāṃ vargeṇa tulyā lekhyāstathāgraketasya madhye sādhyanāma caturdikkoṣṭhakeṣu cakṣaṃstrīṃhraṃkṣaṃ tathā phaṭ ca bāhye prākārake tataḥāmadhyāntaṃ dhruvaṃ varma kaṃ khaṃ caṃ cheti varṇakānsavyāsavye tathā haṃ-khaṃ-vaṃ-kṣeṃ varṇacatuṣṭayamhraṃ-kṣaṃ ceti trayo varṇālekhyā vāme ca dakṣiṇehrasvairvarṇaiḥ savyamapasavyaṃ caiva tathā likhethraṃkāraṃ pañcame dhyātvā prākāre kevalaṃ dhruvammāyāhīnāṃśca dvidvyarṇāṃstvaritāyā manoḥ kramātpraveśamārgatasturyyatulyasaṃkhyāvṛtirbhavetgrahabhītiharaṃ nityaṃ jayalakṣmīyaśaḥpradamśatrūṇāṃ yatkṣamaṃ yantraṃ yanna kvāpi ca kuṇṭhitamcatasṛṣu likhedbījacatuṣkantannigadyatesamālikhecchalokarūpaṃ tathā naiṛtyakoṇataḥveṣṭayedyamamantreṇābhicāryyaścetpumānbhavetyaṃ-raṃ-bhyāṃ veṣṭayedduḥkhaṃ kālīyamamanū yathāmododenanadedomorakṣamatvatvamakṣaravāmomūririmūmovāṭīṭalīlalalīṭaṭīviṣamaṣyā samālekhyaṃ lekhinyā kākapakṣayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śatrurduḥkhamavāpnoti sadyo yantraprabhāvataḥpūritaṃ karivṛkṣādhaḥ putrastrīṇāṃ viyogakṛttvaritāyantramaparaṃ tūrddhvādhoṣṭāṣṭakoṣṭhakampaścācca yamamantrārṇairveṣṭayeccaiva taddhruvamkālīmantreṇāvaguṃṭhya yantramāveṣṭayedbahiḥkapikacchvā punarliptvā japitavyamadhomukhamśmaśānāṅgāranimbādyaniryāso gehadhūmakaḥkoṣṭhamadhye tu nāmāni bahūnāṃ yatprayojanamupadravā mahāmārī tvasādhyā tatra jāyatebhūrjjapatre samālekhyaṃ haritālaniśārasaiḥṣaṭtriṃśadakṣaro mantro bagalāyāḥ sa ucyateduṣṭānāmiti coccāryya vācammukhamatho padambuddhiṃ vināśayānte tu tārabījāgnisundarīḥveṣṭayetpītasūtreṇa kulālasya gṛhaṃ vrajetkārayecca mṛdā tatra haritālena lepayetduṣṭānāṃ stambhayedvācaṃ sākṣādvācaspaterapipaṭṭe vāpyatha pāṣāṇe hrīṃkārapuṭitaṃ likhetpūrvamantreṇa saṃveṣṭya cordhvaṃ trivalayaṃ likhetathānyadvakṣyate yantraṃ śmaśānasthamadhomukhammantritaṃ nihitambhūmau ripūṇāṃ stambhayedgatimpūjitampītapuṣpaistadvācaṃ saṃstambhayeddviṣāmvilikhya tāraṃ sādhyākhyāṃ glauṃbījena praveṣṭayetvajrādikantathā tasya prānte praṇavamālikhetdharābījena saṃveṣṭya bhūpuraṃ mūlavidyayāvārttāli vārāhiyugaṃ vārāhamukhi vāgbhavam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: namo jṛmbhe jṛmbhiṇīti namo mohe ca mohinisarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭānāṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvavāgvadethuṃphaṭ svāheti mūlākhyā vidyā vedeśavarṇikāhuṃkāreṇa dvitīyāntu vīthikāmpariveṣṭayetripumuccāṭayecchīghraṃ sthitaṃ varṣaśatādapisantrastāstadravaṃ śrutvā palāyante virodhinaḥdṛṣṭvā ca śatravaḥ sarve palāyante na saṃśayaḥdaśāradvitayampañcadaśāsrabhūgṛhadvayamṣaṭkoṇe pūrvato vācaṃ ca hrīṃkrīṃśrīṃ ca huṃ tathāuccāṭanīśvarīṃ cāpi śoṣiṇīṃ śoṣiṇīśvarīmtrāsinīṃ trāsinīśīṃ ca kampinīṃ kampinīśvarīmvastujāteśavrīṃ paścātsarvasampādinīśvarīmdaśāre vinyasetsvasya bījapūrvāndigīśvarāndvitīye daśapatre tu vajrādīnyāyudhāni caoṃhrīṃ namaśca vārāhi ghore svapnaṃ visargayuketadyantraṃ punaḥ samyaṅmātṛkārṇaiḥ praveṣṭayetbhūrjjādau yantramālikhya japasampātasādhitambahunā kimihoktena vārāhīṣṭaṃ prayacchatihakāramadhye vilikhetsakāraṃ sādhyasaṃyutamṣaḍdīrghayukkṣakāreṇa bahistadveṣṭayetpurerakṣā bhavati yatraitaddhanaṃ svarṇādiveṣṭitambhūrjjapatre likhedyantramalaktakarasena tutadbahiścāṣṭapatrasya keśareṣu dviṣaṭḥ svarānpītāmbareṇa saṃveṣṭya badhnīyātpaṭṭasūtrataḥvāmabāhau tu nārīṇāṃ baddhaṃ putrapradaṃ matam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 790)jñānadaṃ jñānamicchūnāṃ rājñāṃ tu vijayapradamcaturasradalenaiva kuryyādaṣṭadalaṃ budhaḥveṣṭayeccaturasreṇa catuṣkoṇeṣu vaṃ likhetjātīkāṣṭhasya lekhanyā vaśyakṛtparamaṃ matamcatuṣpatrasya padmasya karṇikāyāṃ samālikhetekaikamakṣaraṃ tasya bāhye'ṣṭadalamālikhetvṛttadvayaṃ tu tadbahye madhyavīthyāṃ samālikhetsauraṃ yantramidannṛṇāṃ sarvāmayavināśanamdhanadhānyapradaṃ vaśyaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ paramṣaṭkoṇaṃ vilikhettasya madhye pūrvādita kramātmadhyapūrvakrameṇaiva lekhyamekaikamakṣaramarcitaṃ vā dhṛtaṃ dehe nāśayedvividhaṃ viṣamoṃhrīṃ ca mekhale svāhā saptārṇoyaṃ manurmataḥsamyaksuniṣṭhito gehe kalahādi na jāyatesamantraṃ tripurāyantraṃ pañcapañcālayaṃ likhetkuryyāddalāni catvāri koṣṭhārdhaṃ ca tathā taleadhaḥ koṣṭhacatuṣke tu haṃkāraṃ tu samālikhetaṣṭasaptamayorlekhyaṃ sādhyanāmno dvayaṃ dvayamp. 791)likheddhūpaṃ tato dattvā kaṇṭhe yantraṃ tu dhārayetgarbhaṃstambhayayugmaṃ ca ḍākinīdoṣamityapi dvirmuñcayāgnigṛhiṇīkutrivarṇo manurmataḥcaturdaśāsitāṃstantūṃstantunā tena bandhayettriḥ kaṭyāṃ veṣṭayedbhāryyāgarbharakṣākaraṃ paramādau ṣaṭkoṇamālikhya tanmadhye praṇavaṃ likhetsahasrāre huṃphaḍiti koṇeṣvekaikamakṣaramcakrāya svāheti padaṃ tadā ṣaṇmantrasambhavaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturdalantu kramato dvidvivarṇāndaledalekeśareṣu likhitvātha patramadhye tato likhetrāharūpāya bhūrbhuvaḥ saṃlikhecca dvitīyakeme dehi dāpaya svāhā likhetpatre caturthakedalamadhyedhunā proktavārahārṇaḥ kṛtākṣaraḥtadbahiḥ ṣoḍaśadale kādisāntāndviśo likhetadhunā cāṣṭapatrantu padmaṃ tasya bahiścaretsādhyākṣareṇa puṭitaṃ hrīṃbījena tṛtīyakamtayā saṃveṣṭayetpaṃktiṃ tadagre bhūpuraṃ likhethrīṃglauṃ teṣu likhedetadyantraṃ vārāhamadbhutamgomayasyāmbhasā piṣṭaṃ lekhanadravyamīritamsvarṇapatrekhilāvāptī rājate cāyurāpyatebhūphale kṣaumavastre syādbhūrjje saṃsāramānyatājanmacandraṃ vinā dhāryyaṃ tadbhavedakhileṣṭadamdikṣu muktāśuddharāgairbhājayennātra saṃśayaḥsasādhyaṃ praṇavaṃ tasya madhyakoṇāṣṭake ca hramgavatyai dakṣiṇadale dhāriṇyai dakṣapaścimesvāhā vāyudale lekhyā glauṃhrīmomīśapatraketatrādyavīthyāṃ praṇavaṃ namo bhagavate varāparavīthyāṃ mātṛkārṇāṃstato bhūpuramālikhetbāhau dhṛte jagadvaśyaṃ pūrṇāyuḥ sukhamedhateādau ṣaṭkoṇamālikhya tanmadhye praṇavaṃ caretbāhye dhruvaṃ jabhadhṛtī vahirvṛttadvayaṃ carettadbahirdvādaśadalaṃ tatraikaikākṣaraṃ nyasetvṛttadvayāntarālaṃ ca māyābījaiḥ praveṣṭayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yogyamutpannamiti bhāvayetdadyādabhaktyā pūjanaṃ yathāmunayojeśapadmajāḥvakre tucchandāṃsi hṛdi devatāmnamaḥ kroṃ kīlāya niyogo'susthitāvitipañcatattvaṃ samuccārya dīrghākāraṃ tathaiva catādṛkṭavargaṃ śrotrakādi caeṃ tuṃ ca vāgādīni tadātmanepūrvoktamoṃ pavargaṃ ca tādṛśamca antādṛgyavargaṃ mana-ādi cahastatalānte nyasedevameva hikroṃ kramato nyasya hṛtpadmāṣṭadaleṣu cahaṃ ṣaṃ yaṃ ca vaṃ ca saṃ śaṃ kṣaṃ iti vargataḥdhyānaṃ yadatraiva tadbravīmi śṛṇu priyekarābjai raktāṃ trinetrāmpraṇamāmi devīmpunastaduktvāmama tu vāṅmanaścakṣuruccarettiṣṭhantu vahnijāyāntamuktvā tāraṃ tato japetprāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā mātṛkānyāsamācaratpāpanāśāya yogasiddhiḥ phalaṃ kramātjapasyādau japasyānte kṛto yadiyāvacchaktoniyamyāsuṃ manasaiva manuṃ japetprāṇāyāmatrayaṃ proktaṃ yadanyanmanasā kṛtamsārddhaṃ saptavyāhṛtipūrvikāmmadhyamūlādyāvadagramaṅguṣṭhena nipīḍyatejānupradakṣiṇī kuryādyāvatkālena hastakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvātriṃśatpatrake lekhyaṃ śalāmekaikamakṣaramnṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyahamevamagre tu prāgbhāge kakārādīnsabindukānśakārādīnvāmabhāge nyasya hyauṃ ca tathā likhetrogādhihṛdvastravarṇacaturvargaphala pradamprāgaṣṭa patraṃ rekhāśca pañca syurdakṣiṇetarāḥtasyāgrimagatā rekhāḥ phaṇākārā vivardhayetphaṇāsu lekhyaṃ krauṃ bījaṃ koṣṭhe ślokamanuṣṭubhamsamastarogabhūtādikṛtyāpīḍāpahārakamaṣṭapatrakarṇikāyāṃ sādhyākhyāṃ karmasaṃyutāmcaturaścaturo varṇānanupatraṃ tato likhetyantraṃ kṣudrāmayaharaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ paramveśmabhūpurayugmena koṇeṣu kṣauṃ samālikhetramyaṃ navapadaṃ kṛtvā kalaśaṃ sthāpayedihavastrayugmasamāyuktamāvāhya nṛhariṃ vibhumaṣṭādhikaṃ tato mantraṃ sahasraṃ prajapetsudhīḥamiṣiñcanmṛtyumukhādavaśyaṃ sa nivarttatebhojayeddevatābuddhyā bhūdevāṃstoṣayettathālabhetaihikasiddhiṃ sa paratrāpi ca modateṣaṭkoṇakarṇikāmadhye hṛllekhāṃ sādhyasaṃyutāmbahiraṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā svaradvandvaṃ likhettataḥp. 794)nṛsiṃhānuṣṭmmanorbahirvṛttadvayaṃ likhetnṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyahamlikheccintāmaṇeḥ kūṭaṃ koṇeṣu prāgudīritamviṣarogaripukleśabhūtagrahabhayādikam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvarogapraśamanaṃ sarvaśatruvināśanamtatkarṇikāyāṃ praṇavaṃ tanmadhye cāmukaṃ jahilikhejjvālāvarttine ca krauṃ bījaṃ ca jahidvayamjapasampātasaṃsiddhaṃ rakṣohṛdrogaśatruhṛtdadhivāmanadevasya vaidikānāṃ viśeṣataḥsasādhyaṃ praṇavaṃ madhye ṣoḍaśasvaraveṣṭitamdaleṣvekekaśo varṇānkrameṇa ca likhennamaḥsvāheti ca namoyuktaṃ praṇavābhyāṃ ca sampuṭambhūrje gandhāṣṭakādyena likhitaṃ śrīdharāpradamkṛtvā cāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tanmadhye sādhyasaṃyutamnamo nārāyaṇāyeti likhedekaikamakṣaramoṃ namo viṣṇave brūyātsurānte pataye mahāvṛttatrayaṃ tataḥ kuryyādantarvīthyāṃ suveṣṭayetbāhyavīthyāṃ mātṛkābhiriti yantraṃ prakīrttitamādau sulikhya ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tanmadhye vṛttamālikhetsādhakākhyāṃ karmanāma madhye caiva samālikhetśrībījaṃ tacca sakalaṃ praṇavābhyāṃ ca sampuṭetṣaṭkoṇapārśvayormāyābījaṃ cāgre ca manmathamvāgbhavena bahiṣpadmamaṣṭapatraṃ sakeśarampatrāgreṣu likhenmālāmantravarṇāṃstathaiva carakṣoghnaviśadāyeti madhureti padaṃ tataḥbalāyeti ca rāmāya viṣṇave nama ityayamtadbāhyeṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ śrībījaṃ keśarāṣṭakenamo nārāyaṇāyeti tadbāhyerkadalaṃ likhetakārādikṣakārāntānantyapatre ca saptakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāro namo bhagavate vāsudevāya sa smṛtaḥnamaḥ pratyekavarṇaṃ tu dalamadhye samālikhetaṃghaṃ kramācca bījāni bāhye ṣoḍaśapatrakedalasya purvabhāgeṣu rāmasyānuṣṭubarṇakāndaśāsyāntaka māṃ rakṣa dehi dāpaya me śriyampurā nṛsiṃhayantre ca kathitotra nigadyatenṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyahamkṣrauṃbījaṃ ca caturdikṣu haṃbījaṃ ca vidikṣu casādhitaṃ japapūjābhyāṃ homasaṃpātakena carakṣākaraṃ maheśāni mahadaiśvaryavardhanambhuktimuktipradaṃ caiva gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥādau sulikhya ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tanmadhye bījamālikhetsādhakākhyāṃ tadūrdhvaṃ tu karma madhye samālikhetśrībījena ca rāmāya namo varṇaiḥ praveṣṭayetetaivarṇaiśca daśabhirveṣṭayetkoṇaṣaṭkakamhrīṃ śrīmiti ca koṇāgre koṇapārśveṣu haṃ likhetdaleṣu pūrvayantroktamālāmantrārṇakāṁllikhetsabindukaiśca tadbāhye bhūpure kṣrauṃ diśāsu casarveṣṭaphaladaṃ mokṣadāyakaṃ śrīkaraṃ parammūlārṇānvasukoṇeṣu ṣaḍdīrghaṃrī ca sandhiṣudakṣiṇe kāmabījaṃ ca bahiraṣṭadalaṃ likhetdalamadhye likhettasya bahirvṛttatrayaṃ caretkādikṣāntairbahirvīthyāṃ tadbahirbhūpuraṃ caretkīrttilakṣmīvijayadaṃ rāmayantraṃ na saṃśayaḥṣaṭkoṇāntarlikhetkāmaṃ sādhyākhyāṃ karmasaṃyutām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bāhye daśadalaṃ padmaṃ tatkiñjalkeṣu saṃlikhetvāsudevāya kavacaṃ phaṭsvāhānto nakhākṣaraḥp. 797)koṇeṣu madanākrāntaṃ bhūgṛhaṃ racayettataḥhemapaṭṭe vidhānena guṭikīkṛtya pūjitamgopālayantrametaddhi puṇyavadbhiḥ kare dhṛtamkīrtyādivardhanaṃ caiva putrapautravivardhanametadyantraṃ smarettatra japennaśyati tatkṣaṇātādauvṛttaṃ samālikhya tanmadhye glauṃ samālikhettāro namaśca kṛṣṇāya daleṣvekaikamakṣaramācakrāya tataḥ svāhā prathamoyaṃ ṣaḍakṣaraḥsucakrāya tataḥ svāhā tṛtīyopi ṣaḍakṣaraḥasurāntakacakrāya svāhāntoyaṃ navākṣaraḥtadbāhyeṣṭādaśadalaṃ tatra varṇānimāṁllikhettadbāhyejinapatreṣu kṛṣṇagāyatrivarṇakāntannaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pracodayāttadbāhye dantapatreṣu gopālānuṣṭhubhaṃ likhetvallabhāyāgnijāyānto mantroyaṃ radavarṇakaḥdvitīyāṃ mātṛkāvarṇairāṃkrīṃbhyāṃ ca tṛtīyikāmdharmakāmārthaphaladaṃ śatrūndasyūnnivārayetputrapautrapradaṃ loke bhūtavetālanāśanamabhaktāya na dātavyaṃ na devabrāhmaṇadviṣelikhetsasādhyaṃ glauṃbījaṃ tacca samyakpraveṣṭayetkoṇeṣu saṃlikhedvarṇānpatrākṣaramanostathāgopījanavallabhāya svāhā mantro daśākṣaraḥtadbahiṣṣoḍaśadalaṃ keśareṣu svarāṁllikhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatkeśareṣu cālikhyadalamadhye ca pūrvavatvṛttadvayāntarvīthyāmāṃkrāṃbījābhyāṃ praveṣṭayetaṣṭārṇakaikavarṇantu manumetaṃ sudurlabhampadmamaṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā karṇikāyāṃ samālikhetdaleṣu saṃlikhedvarṇāṃścaturaścaturomanoḥkhagapataṅgādyupadravānnāśayapadaṃ vadettadantarālavīthyāṃ tu kādikṣāntāṁllikhetkramātpradāya lakṣmaṇetyuktvā dātre sītāpadaṃ vadetdarppahāyeti sarveti ṅento duṣṭavināśanaḥpataṅgādiduṣṭasattvavināśanapadaṃ vadettadbahiścaturasraṃ ca yantrametatsulekhayetgogale vātha saṃlekhyaṃ rocanānābhikeśaraiḥbālagrahāmayavyāghrabhayādyaṃ kramaśo haretkuryyādaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ samālikhettataścādyadale lekhyā a-umāstāravarṇakāḥcaturthe dakṣiṇā ceti mūrttaye pañcame likhetccha svāhetyaṣṭame patre vṛttayorantare tataḥcatuṣkoṇe caturthasya vargasya prathamākṣaramlikhecchaivāṣṭagandhena bhūrjje dhāryyaṃ sadāgalekṛtyāpasmārabhūtādināśanaṃ sarvakāmadamlikhedaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ likheddhruvamvidikpatreṣu so lekhyo bahirbhūpuramālikhetyantraṃ mṛtyuñjayasyedaṃ japahomādisādhitamgraharogaviṣādīnāṃ nāśanaṃ mṛtyubhañjanametadyaḥ pūjayennityamapamṛtyurvinaśyati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ālikhyāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ samālikhetbaṭukāyetyakṣarāṇi bahiḥ ṣoḍaśapatrakelekhya ekaikavarṇoyaṃ bahiḥṣoḍaśapatrakekakārādisakārāntānbahirbhupūramālikhetśrīpadaṃ duritavyādhiduṣṭagrahanikarttanamiti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte daivatayantrakathanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśaḥ prakāśaḥrakṣasā nihatā yena tvatto labdhavarā apicāturyugāṃtānākalpasaṃsthitānsiddhidāyakāntāraṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ lakṣmīṃ hrīṃhrīṃhuṃ ca samuccaretprakṛtyākṛtivedārṇairbindurudrasvarānvitaiḥdvitīyakūṭametatsyādādyantakṛtavarṇakaiḥādyantasiddhākṛtyabdhivarṇairīśasvarānvitaiḥtāro namo hanumate prakaṭeti parākramalīkṛtajagattritaya vajradeha jvaleti carudrāvatāra laṃketi purīdahana saṃvadettaka sītāśvāsaneti vadedvāyusuteti canandakara kapisainyaprākati tato vadetkāraṇadroṇaparveti totpāṭanapadaṃ vadetakṣakumārakaccheti dahaneti padaṃ tataḥbrahmāstreti brahmaśaktigrahamuktvā ca lakṣmaṇasamānayana bāleti saṃvadedbhānumaṇḍalaindrajidvadhakāreti ṇeti sītetirañjakakumbhakarṇādivadhakṛtparāyaṇapadaṃ vadetsamudravyomapadataḥ samullaṅghana saṃvadetna svāmivacanetyuktvā sampāditārjaneti ca

sanskrit: dīnbhīṣaya padānte śabdodayapadaṃ vadetcaleti sakaletyuktvā mantrāgapadato vadetp. 801)jvaroccāṭana sarveti vadecca vighnanāśanasarvaduṣṭapadānte ca nibarhaṇapadaṃ tathāsarvaśatrucchedaneti vadenmama parasya canapuṃsakātmakaṃ sarvānte vadejjīvaṃpadaṃ tataḥsampādayadvayam nānāmunidhyeya tato vadetsevakānkuruyugmaṃ ca sarvaśastrāstra saṃvadethāhāhā pāhi pāhīti prāguktaṃ kūṭapañcakamvṛttāni parasainyāni kṣobhayadvitayaṃ mamasarvaduṣṭadurjaneti mukhyāni kīlayadvayammālāmantro hanumato nāganāgaśarākṣaraḥtāro namo bhagavate cāñjaneyāya hṛnmanuḥtāro namo bhagavate śikhā vāyusutāya cabrahmāstranivāraṇāya naravakttrāstramantrakaḥkuṇḍaladvayasaṃśobhi mukhāmbhojaṃ smarenmuhuḥayutañca puraścaryyā rāmasyāgre śivasya cajitendriyaścaṇakāśī hanumaddhyānatatparaḥmahārogādiśāntyarthamaṣṭottarasahasrakamgrahādayaśca naśyanti tathā sarvebhicārakāḥdhyāyaṃstathākṣahantāraṃ saṃgrāme vijayeta cap. 802)ayutenāpyavicchinnasandhimāpnotyasaṃśayamhauṃbījaṃ samyaguccāryya pūrvoktaṃ kūṭapañcakamjagatīchanda uddiṣṭaṃ hanumāndevatā mataḥṣaḍbījaiḥ prathamairnyāsaḥ ṣaḍaṅgosya prakīrtitaḥ

sanskrit: daha saṃhāraya dvirdvirdvirmohayapadaṃ vadetvatsadyaḥ padamuccāryya prāṇinaḥ padamuccaretbandhaya dviḥpātaya dvirmameti ca parasya cahrāṃhruṃ tridhā ca phaṭsvāhā mantroyaṃ samudīritaḥvadennamo hanumate mahābalaparākramakinī ḍāpadamuccāryya kinī yakṣiṇikā ca pūvadedbhairavavetālagraheti brahmarākṣasābhañjayadvitayaṃ procya vadeddvedhā nirāsayabandhaṃdvedhā mocaya dvirmāmenaṃ ca padaṃ vadethāhāhraṃhraṃ tridhā huṃphaṭsvāhāyamudito manuḥpuṃstrīnapuṃsakānbhūtabhaviṣyadvarttamoccarettathā saṅkarajātijātānpadaṃ caiva samuccaretsamatāpuruśaktīti sametāndhanurā vadetvakānmantrisacivasakhīnuktvātyantikānkṣaṇātnānopāyairmārayadviḥ śatrūṃśchedayacchedayabhindhibhindhi ca samprocya tvagninā jvālayadvayampādatalākramaṇena tanuṃ caiva śilātalekrudhā ceti padaṃ procya nakhairdvedhā vidārayadvirdhvaṃsaya trāsaya dvirvadetpaścādbhayāturānbhasmībhūtāṃstato dvedhā vadedutpāṭayeti casarvatra māṃ vadedenaṃ rakṣarakṣa ca hā punaḥvedapañcatrivarṇoyaṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakaḥmahābhayāni sarveti vyāghrataskara saṃvadetkṛtrimopaviṣamahāsaṃgrāme ca padaṃ vadetdvirgrāsaya troṭaya dvirbhañjaya stambhaya tridhā

sanskrit: syājjinamātrastu madhyamaḥkumbhake siddhe siddhissyādrājayogajāsiddhe kriyāyogasya siddhayaḥkumbhako reco yadā tulyaḥ prajāyatejaghanye tu madhyaṃ madhye parekhilamprāṇāyāmavidhiḥ prokto mayā tubhyaṃ varānanecittajñādevatāyāstu hṛdaye dhāraṇaṃ matamvijñānamatastatprāpakastu saḥchando mantrārthacchādanāttu vāsādhakeṣṭaṃ dadātīti devatā parikīrtitānamaskuryānmukhyāṅguṣṭhena saṃspṛśetanāmātarjanībhyāṃ sā cākṛṣṭābhyāmiheṣyateyasmāttasmādvaṣaḍiti kriyateṃgulimadhyayākavacaṃ tarjanyānāmayā'pi tattasmāttaduktaṃ tatra vauṣaṭ tarjanyādyaistu tatsmṛtamviṣṇvādike rudrādau tu netratrayātmakamtatphaṭ karābhyāṃ prapaṃcyatecaikaviṃśatiḥ proktāḥ kāmanābhedatopi catadrahasyannirūpyateyannyāsādupacaryādyā dharmāḥ siddhāntisādhakegāyatrī chandaḥ śaktiḥ svarāssmṛtāḥca karabhe tathābinduyuktānkrameṇaiva svarānnyāso'yamādimaḥsamācaretsvarāṁlḷkārādīṃstathā dakṣatalādapi

sanskrit: mahāvīreti māmenaṃ rakṣarakṣa tridhātridhāsarvapīḍāharo rāmavaśakṛdbhāgyadāyakaḥtāro namo hanumate vadetsarvagrahānitibhūteti ca bhaviṣyacca varttamānānpadaṃ vadetuccāṭayadvayaṃ procya pareti ca balāni cahrāṃhrīṃhrūṃdvistrayaṃ phaṭ ca svāhāntoyaṃ manurmataḥparakṛtayantramantraparāhaṃkārasaṃvadetdṛṣṭirogādikānprocya dvistrāsaya nivārayaityevāyaṃ manuḥ proktassarvāpattinivārakaḥlakṣmaṇaprāṇadātre ca sītāśokavināśakaḥduṣṭavināśanāyeti ripucaurapadaṃ vadetduṣṭasattvavināśeti nāya huṃphaḍ hutāṅganāviśeṣatopamṛtyośca nāśako rāmavallabhaḥuccāṭaya huṃphaṭ ca svāhānto manurīritaḥmahāvīrotra hanumāndevatā samprakīrtitaḥekādaśakūṭapūrvaṃ nāmanyāsaṃ samācarethanumānrāmadūtaśca lakṣmaṇaprāṇadāyakaḥnetrāntamevaṃ kṛtvā tu laṅkāprāsādabhañjakaḥsaptāhājjāyate siddhirvāyuputraprasādataḥdaśa vāsaraparyyantaṃ rājaśatrubhayaṃ harettenābhimantritaṃ dattaṃ sarvaṃ saphalatāṃ vrajetcarcitaṃ parabādhādi tasya naśyatyasaṃśayamdāsatāṃ yāti devopi manuṣyeṣu ca kā kathāprakāreṇa mahābīrajvaritaḥ śāntitāmiyātdvādaśārṇaprayogāṃśca nikhilāṃstatra kārayet

sanskrit: śālmalīkusumaṃ tālaṃ haridrāmalakīphalamuccāṭārthaṃ niśi hunecchleṣmāntakavibhītakānvaśyārthaṃ homayeddrākṣāmapūpānatha guggulampañcakhādyairnālikerairikṣubhiḥ kadalīphalaiḥsaubhāgyārthaṃ tu kāśmīrakastūrītvaksamīraṇaiḥdhattūraphalapuṣpāṇi samidho mohane smṛtāḥ****?ddhṛtāni kūṭāni pañca tānyeva mantrataḥp. 808)tatoñjanāsutaḥ proktaḥ sītāśokavināśakaḥkaperetāni nāmāni kūṭapūrvāṇi santi cadhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ vijñeyaṃ dvādaśārṇavatnavagrahādimantrāṇāṃ bījānyekādaśaiva tutaddhyānapūjānyāsāda jñaya ca dvādaśārṇavatnamo bhagavate procya āñjaneyāya saṃvadetsvāhā śaktiścāñjaneyo rudramūrttiḥ suro mataḥdvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgāni tathāṃguṣṭhādiṣu nyasetkirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ dhyāyedvānaranāyakamayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāttilaiḥjapitvā kṣudrarogebhyo mucyate divasatrayātmahāroganivṛttyai tu sahasraṃ tridinaṃ japetrākṣasaughaṃ vinighnantamacirājjayati dviṣaḥprajapyāyutamātraṃ tu sandhiṃ kuryyādviruddhayoḥśatrūṇāṃ pradahedgrāmānacirādeva sādhakaḥyo yāti socirātsveṣṭaṃ sādhayitvā gṛhaṃ vrajetāyurllakṣmyaḥ pravarghante tasya naśyantyupadravāḥṣaḍdīrghayuktā hṛllekhā praṇavenaiva sampuṭā

sanskrit: ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṅgavidhirīritaḥp. 809)etatprabhāvājjhaṭiti cādhivyādhivivarjitaḥprasthānakāle japatāṃ naśyeyustaskarādayaḥaṣṭagandhairlikhedrūpaṃ kapirājasya sundaramjayatyarigaṇānsarvāndarśanādeva niścitamdhvajamādāyoparāge saṃsparśānmokṣaṇāvadhigacchedraṇe dhvajaṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyanterayocirāthāṃhuṃ hanumate hṛcca ṅentaṃ kapipatiṃ tataḥhāntaṃ jinamitārṇoyaṃ munyādi dvādaśārṇavatgadaṃ duṣṭaṃ nūtanena paṭenācchādayettataḥtadādāya jvaladvahnau yaścaivaṃ triḥ pratāpayetsaptakṛtvastato mantrī śakaladvitayaṃ khaluyakṛdvṛddhau caivameva dakṣapārśve samācaretvajrakāya vajratuṇḍa vadetkapilapiṅgalataḍijjihva mahāraudra daṃṣṭrotkaṭa kahadvayamlaṃkeśvaravadhāyānte mahāsetupadantataḥehyehi bhagavanprocya mahābalaparākramamahāraudrapadamprocya dīrghapucchena veṣṭayabāṇanetrenduvarṇotra mālāmantro'khileṣṭadaḥataḥ parampravakṣyāmi kārtavīryyārjunasya caiti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte hanumanmantrakathanaṃ nāma catustriṃśaḥ prakāśaḥetattvayā purā proktaṃ tasya mantrānprabrūhi mepañcāmnāyagatānmantrānarjunasya bravīmitedharmādīnāṃ pādabhedāddevi tulyaṃ bravīmi tetripād dvayoranindyastu bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥ

sanskrit: sārūpyampādahīnaṃ syātsāyujyampūrṇamucyateyamaiśca niyamairyuktaḥ pūrṇadharmastu kevalaḥsvadharmeṇārjjitaṃ dravyaṃ kevalaṃ tatra sādhanamtena kālasvarūpatvaṃ tatkaivalyamprakīrttitamūrddhvena dakṣiṇenaikadīpādikramatokhilāḥtatra saṃkaraśūdrādyā viprāntāścādhikāriṇaḥhīnasevā tūttamānāṃ rāsabhārohaṇaṃ yathāyaḥ sudarśanacakrasyāvatāraḥ kṣitimaṇḍalevedhā dharenduśāntyāḍhyo nidrārghīśāgnibinduyukrepho bindvāsanonanto vahnijau karṇasaṃsthitauūnaviṃśativarṇoyantārādirnakhavarṇakaḥkārttavīryyārjuno devo bījaṃ śaktidhruvaśca hṛtūṃhaṃ śikhā samākhyātā kroṃśrīṃ kavacamīritamhṛdaye jaṭhare nābhau jaghane guhyadeśakevinyasedbījadaśakampraṇavadvayamadhyagamp. 811)bhruvoḥ śrutyostathaivākṣṇornasi vakttre galeṃsayoḥsarveṣṭasiddhaye dhyāyetkārttavīryyārjjuneśvaramdhyeyo raktāṃśukoṣṇīṣī nānākalpavirājitaḥdadhaṭṭaṃkāraśabdaiśca trāsitākhiladurjanaḥbhūpālamukuṭāghṛṣṭapādapadmobjalocanaḥvaiṣṇave tu yajetpīṭhe padmaṃ daśadalaṃ caretagnīśāsuravāyavyakoṇeṣu hṛdayādikāḥkhaḍgacarmmadharā dhyeyāścandrābhā aṅgamūrttayaḥcaturbhujā rocamonāḥ sarve raktavilocanāḥcauramadavibhañjano mārīmadavibhañjanaḥ

sanskrit: duḥkhanāśo duṣṭanāśo duritāmayanāśakaḥkṣemaṅkarā vaśyakarī śrīkarī ca yaśaskarītadbahirbhūpure pūjyā lokapā astrasaṃyutāḥtilājyataṇḍulairvāpi puraścaryyā sarittaṭeprayogānapi kurvīta śṛṇu tānadhuneśvariśuddhabhūmāvaṣṭagandhairlikhedyantraṃ taducyatephroṃklīṃ oṃ aiṃ ca patreṣu praṇavādyāni saṃlikhetoṃmādidaśavarṇāśca keśareṣu samālikhetveṣṭayetkādikairvarṇaiḥ śeṣaiḥ sahavivarjitaiḥnānākāmaprabhedena bhūvāyvagninabhombhasāmpañcavargāḥ pañca yādyāḥ ṣasahāśca lakṣau kramātmāraṇe taijasaiḥ śāntau vātaiḥ puṣṭau ca pārthivaiḥkumbhaṃ spṛṣṭvā japenmantraṃ sahasraṃ tena secayetvāksiddhaścāpi tejasvī pratāpī vijitendriyaḥsaṃsthāpayedidaṃ yantraṃ vairibhītinivṛttayelikhedaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ sasādhyaṃ cāndramapyutamanubījāṣṭakaṃ cānte dale lekhyaṃ punaśca phaṭtriśaḥ svarānantareṣu tridhoṣmārṇasamanvitānūṣmārṇāṃścaturasre tu vajrāṣṭakasamanvitānsnānārthaṃ ghaṭapānīyamanyatpūrvavadīritamsarṣapāriṣṭalaśunakārpāsairmāryate ripuḥkaṭutailamahiṣyājyaiḥ plutaṃ kṛtvā tu homayetdhattūraistabhyate nimbairdveṣyate vaśyatembujaiḥyavairhutaiḥ śriyaḥ prāptistilairājyairaghakṣayaḥstrīvaśyakṛtpriyaṃgūnāṃ guggulorbhūtaśāntidaḥ

sanskrit: samidho labhate hutvā putrānāyurdhanaṃ sukhamrocanāgomayaiḥ stambho bhūprāptiḥ śālibhirhutaiḥekonaviṃśatyarṇoyaṃ tārādirnakhavarṇakaḥp. 813)svabījādyo daśārṇosāvanye navaśivākṣarāḥsvakāmābhyāṃ tṛtīyosau svabhrūbhyāṃ tu caturthakaḥsvāṃkuśābhyāṃ saptamaḥ syātsvaramābhyāmathāṣṭamaḥeteṣu mantravaryyeṣu svānukūlaṃ manuṃ bhajetdaśamantrā ime proktā yadā syuḥ praṇavādikāḥevaṃ viṃśatimantrāṇāṃ yajanaṃ pūrvavanmanoḥdīrghāḍhyamūlabījena kuryyādeṣāṃ ṣaḍaṅgakamcaturdaśārṇo mantroyamasyejyā pūrvavanmatātāro hṛdbhagavānṅentaḥ kārttavīryyārjunastathātrivedasaptayugmākṣivarṇaiḥ pañcāṅgakaṃ manoḥsarvaduṣṭāntakāyeti tapobalaparākramaiḥjanyacūḍāmaṇirṅentaḥ sarvaśaktimate tataḥtriṣaṣṭivarṇavānproktaḥ smaraṇātsarvasiddhikṛtmāhiṣmatīpatiḥ paścāccaturthaḥ samudīritaḥdaśāsyaśceti ṣaḍbhiḥ syātpadairetaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakamhastairjalaughaṃ rundhantaṃ dhyātvā mattaṃ nṛpottamampūrvavatsarvametasya samārādhanamīritammāhiṣmatyāṃ mantrimadhye samāsīnamalaṃkṛtambāhubhiḥ śaracāpāsigadāmudgaraśūlakānparacakrastenarājabhayaṃ dhyānamudīritamp. 814)trailokyabhīṣaṇaṃ dhyāyedayutāśvarathasthitamdordaṇḍamaṇḍalairbāṇānkṣipantaṃ tīvradhārakān

sanskrit: gajayūthairaśvavāhaiḥ kuṇḍaladyotitāsyakamāhave śatrusaṃghātaṃ jitvā sa sukhamedhateekādaśāvikhyātaṃ dhyānapūjādikaṃ manoḥādau caturdalaṃ padmaṃ cāṣṭāraṃ radapatrakamhrāṁbījamatha patreṣu praṇavaṃ sādhyanāma caekonaviṃśatyarṇasya dvau namo haritārṇakāntadbahiḥ ṣoḍaśadale kāmabījaṃ samālikhetbahistasya prakurvvīta tato vṛtacatuṣṭayamdvitīyāyāṃ kṣakārādikakārāntānvilomataḥtato bījāni ca likhettatpare ca caturdalecuṃ chuṃ juṃ jhuṃ tathāṭuṃṭhuṃḍuṃḍhuṃ ṣoḍaśadale punaḥpunaruktadale kādihāntabījāni saṃlikhetkāryyānurūpaṃ sulikhettadbāhye bhūtalaṃ śubhamahaṃ jānāmi viṣṇuśca tatrepadvetti tadguhaḥrājate rājyalābhāya tāmre rakṣākaraṃ bhavetkaṇṭhe nibaddhametattu bhṛśaṃ rakṣati bālakānkāraskarasya phalake roganāśāya saṃlikhetviśāle kalināśāya samakṣityāṃ śilātalepatākāyāṃ dhvaje vāpi jayadaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥlākṣāmṛgamadādyaiśca likhedvaśyādikarmakṛttadyantrakalaśāsekādvandhyā putraṃ prasūyatetasya saṃsmaraṇādeva hṛtaṃ naṣṭaṃ ca labhyatemunyādikaṃ ca pañcāṅganyāsaḥ sarveṇa kīrtitamahāgajasamārūḍhaṃ madāghūrṇitalocanamdhāvamānamarātīnāṃ vadhārthaṃ saṃsmarennṛpam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ dhyātvāyutaṃ japtvā bhayānyanyāni saṃtaretsuprasannaṃ maṇigaṇālaṅkṛtaṃ dīptatejasamāyurvṛddhaye rogaśāntyai dvādaśārṇaḥ prakīrttitaḥdvātriṃśadarṇamantrasya vidhirevamudāhṛtaḥtannorjunaḥ pracodayātpalāyante gṛhāddūraṃ havanāttarppaṇādapiprāgvanmunyādikaṃ chando gāyattraṃ pūrvavaddhatiḥgāyatrījapamātreṇa mantravīryapravarddhanamhatāścaurā bhaviṣyanti hṛtaṃ dravyaṃ ca sidhyatimahābalāya dhīmahi tannorjjunaḥ pracodayāthuṃ phaṭ svāhā radārṇoyaṃ prokto mantraścaturddaśaḥp. 816) saptasapteṣunavabhiścaturbhiścāṅgapañcakammaṇḍalānmriyate śatrurvikalāṅgotha vā bhavetakharvabhayanāśaḥ syādekaviṃśatibhirddinaiḥhṛtaṃ ca pūrvasaṃproktaṃ dravyaṃ labhyet sattvaramkārttavīryyārjjunāyeti haihayeti padaṃ vadetkareti sarvaduṣṭāntakāyeti ca padaṃ paṭhetāgantukāṃśca pravadeddasyūnvasuvilumpakānsvahastodbhūtamusalasahasrairmarddayadvayamsvahastodbhūtacakrāṇāṃ sahasrairvinikartayatrāsaya dvirmohaya dvirudvāsayayugaṃ vadetdvirbhedaya stambhaya dvirjṛmbhayadvayamāvadetuccāṭayoccāṭayeti vināśayavināśayaśrīkārtavīryyārjuneti sarvaga svālaye vadetcorasamūhānsamyagvadedunmūlayadvayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dattātreyo muniśchando gāyatryanyacca pūrvavatmāhiṣmatīnivāsoyaṃ śiromantro nagākṣaraḥhahaiyādhipatirṅentaḥ kavacasya manurmataḥudagrabāṇāṃścāpāni dadhataṃ sūryasannibhamkārttavīryanṛpaṃ dhyāyedgaṇḍaśobhitakuṇḍalamtrisahasro japaḥ proktaḥ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaretp. 817)cakreṣūnmusalaṃ śūlakuṭhārau pāśameva cabalāḍhyamaruṇaṃ ghoraṃ tattvamātaṅgasaṃsthitamniśītheṣṭottaraśataṃ naṣṭadravyādisiddhayesaṃprārthya mantriṇe corāḥprayacchantyakhilaṃ dhanamjapedaṣṭottaraśataṃ dhyātvā bhūpaṃ samāhitaḥdhyātvaivaṃ sarvapaśavo dhruvamāyānti mocitāḥhṛtaṃ prakāśamāyāti svaṃ svasthāne nacānyathādaśadikṣu japenmaṃtraṃ rāṣṭrāde rakṣaṇaṃ bhavetkṣiptāni mantriṇā yatra tatra rakṣā bhavenniśimunipūjādikaṃ prāgvallakṣamekaṃ puraskriyāprāgvatprayoga ityevamūrddhvāmnāyaḥ prakīrttitaḥaṣṭau śatānyaśītiśca yeṣāṃ saṃsādhanā kalauhindudharmapraloptāro jāyante cakravarttinaḥphiraṅgabhāṣayā mantrāsteṣāṃ saṃsādhanādbhuviiṃgrejā nava gadyāśca laṇḍaneṣvapi bhāvinaḥtadbījapūrvvāḥ sarvepi manavo vāmasiddhidāḥvāmācāreṇa śūdrāṇāmiha loke phalapradaḥatho dīpavidhiṃ vakṣye kārttavīryyapriyaṅkarammāghe ca phālgune māse dīpārambhaḥ praśasyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 818)dvidaivate ca rohiṇyāṃ dīpārambhaḥ praśasyateprītau harṣe ca saubhāgye śobhanāyuṣmatorapieṣu yogeṣu pūrvāhṇe dīpārambhaḥ kṛtaḥ śubhaḥyadi tatra ravervāraḥ śravaṇaṃ bhaṃ tu durlabhamādye hyupoṣya niyato brahmacārī śayīta kauprāṇānāyamya saṃkalpaṃ nyāsānpūrvoditāṃścaretmadhye kāmaṃ samālikhya ṣaṭkoṇeṣu samālikhetkroṃ śrīṃ huṃphaṭ ca pūrvādidiśāsu vilikhetkramātevaṃ vilikhite yantre nidadhyāddīpabhājanamkāṃsyapātraṃ mṛnmayaṃ ca kaniṣṭhaṃ lohajaṃ mṛtauśāntaye mudgacūrṇotthaṃ sandhau godhūmacūrṇajamarkadigvasuṣaṭpañcacatūrāmāṃgulairmitamājyeyutapale pātraṃ palapañcaśatīkṛtamtrisahasre ghṛtapale śarārkapalabhājanamśatekṣiśarasaṃkhyātamevamanyatra kalpayetśatravastasya naśyanti nātra kāryyā vicāraṇājīvedvarṣaśataṃ mantrī pāpāni kṣayamāpnuyuḥtithimānādyāsahasraṃ tantusaṃkhyā vinirmitāsahasrapalasaṃkhyādidaśāntaṃ kāryyagauravāttadardhāṃ vā tadardhāṃ vā sūkṣmāgrāṃ sthūlamulikāmpātrāddakṣiṇadigdeśe muktvāgulacatuṣṭayamdīpaṃ prajvālayettatra gaṇeśasmṛtipūrvakamtaṇḍulāṣṭadale vāpi vidhivatsthāpayed ghaṭametatproktaṃ dvijātīnāṃ vāmibhirvāmabhāgakejalākṣatatilānhaste gṛhītvā mantramuccaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: munidevādiprāgvatkāyasthitāvayamaṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ dakṣahastasya parvakaraṃ dattvā karaśuddhikarastvayamsabindukairaṅgulyādinyāso hṛdādikaḥkrodhādijātapāpanivṛttayedhyāyetpadmavarṇaṃ śvetaṃ śirasi saṃsthitamkādikānrogo hyapamṛtyurvinaśyatikvacitpāvakasaṅkāśā sūkṣmatejassvarūpiṇīsandhyāyenmātṛkākhyasarasvatīmtāṃ namāmipaṅktyośca mūrdhni vaktre nyasetsvarānpadodasta dvatpārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhadeśataḥcaturvarṇāñchādiṣaṭkaṃ tato nyasetvarṇamātrāhīnapāṭhaprapūrakaḥsaṃhāranyāsanāmāsau bindunyāsa itīritaḥantarnyāsātparaṃ bindunyāse syācchukradhāraṇamvāmadakṣiṇamārgeṇa devatādhyānamucyatevarṇeśvarīṃ praṇamata stanabhāranamrāmpatettasmādato binduvisargakauśāktaistṛptiṃ binā sarvaṃ nyāsenāpi vimucyatelokepyavaṃśassyādvihīno brahmatejasāsarpamaṇiṃ te grahītuṃ samudyatāḥvarṇoccāro bhaveditieva mantrādyāḥ ṣaḍaṃgadhyānamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kārttavīryyārjunāyeti vadenmāhiṣmatīpadamsahasrakratuśabdānte dīkṣitāya pdaṃ vadetanusūyāgarbharatnāya huṃphaṭ ca pravadettataḥduṣṭānnāśayayugmaṃ syāttathā pātaya ghātayaanena dīpavaryyeṇa paścimābhimukhena cavadedvarṇāṃstakārādīndaśa tāraṃ hutāṅganāmdattātreyo muniśchandobhitaṃ devorjunaḥ smṛtaḥdhyātvā devaṃ mantrametamaṣṭottarasahasrakamaṃkuśaṃ ca punastāraṃ manuḥ prokto navākṣaraḥevaṃ dīpapradānasya karttāpnotyakhilepsitamtasminnavasare kāryyaṃ siddhambhavati nānyathāatiyatnātkāryyasiddhiṃ kuryyāccaiva vilambataḥvyatyaye sati kāryyasya naiva siddhiḥ prajāyateākhvotvordarśanaṃ duṣṭaṃ gavayasya sukhāvahamp. 820)saśabdā bhayadā karturujjvalā sukhadā gatāpakṣādarvāk tadā gacchedyajamānoyamālayamvartyantaraṃ yadā kuryyātkāryyaṃ sidhyedvilambataḥaśucisparśane vyādhirdīpanāśe tu caurabhīḥpātrārambhe vasupalaiḥ kṛto dīpokhileṣṭadaḥpañcāśatā kṛto dīpaḥ śatruvaśyāya ceṣyateśatena śatrunāśaḥ syātsahasreṇākhilāḥ kriyāḥāsamāpteḥ prakurvīta brahmacaryyañca bhūśayamjapetsahasraṃ pratyekaṃ mantrarājaṃ navākṣaramsahasraṃ prajapedrātrau sobhīṣṭaṃ kṣipramāpnuyātkumbhodakena karttāramabhiṣiñcenmanuṃ smaran
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: palānāṃ tu daśāṃśena mukhyaṃ prāṅmukhyabhājanegurau tuṣṭe dadātīṣṭaṃ kṛtavīryyasuto nṛtaḥpratyutānubhavatyeva hānimeva padepadeduṣṭebhyaḥ kathito mantro vakturduḥkhāvaho bhavettilatailaṃ tu tādṛk syātkanīyojādijaṃ ghṛtamsiddhārthasambhavenātha dviṣatāṃ nāśahetavekāryyasiddhistadā kuryyāttrivāraṃ dīpajaṃ vidhimyathākathaṃcidyaḥ kuryyāddīpadānaṃ svaveśmanip. 821) sarvadā jayamāpnoti putrānpautrāndhanaṃ yaśaḥstutipriyo mahāviṣṇurgaṇeśastarppaṇapriyaḥtasmātteṣāṃ pratoṣāya kuryyāttattu ca tādṛśamataḥ paraṃ kiṃ vaktavyaṃ tatpṛcchata surottamāḥiti śrīmahāmāyāmahākālānumate merutantre śivapraṇīte kārttavīryyārjunamantrakathanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśattamaḥ prakāśaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃhārasṛṣṭisthitayo nyasyante gṛhasevibhiḥvānaprasthāśca yatayo sṛṣṭisthitilayāntramātkalāmātṛkāyā nyāsaṃ tasya ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥmātṛkākhyā niyogobhīṣṭasiddhayekalāmātṛkāyā nyāse vakṣye śṛṇu priyetāṃ namāmiṅentakalānāmāḍhyāṃ namasānvitāmpratiṣṭhā ca vidyāśāṃtistatharddhikāsūkṣmāmṛtā jñānāmṛtā cāpyāyinī tataḥtataḥ kāntirdyutirlakṣmīḥ sthirā sthitiḥcānyā hlādinī prītisaṃyutāsamṛtyukākalāmātṛkeyaṃ sthāne'kārādike nyasetakṣamālāmpustakaṃ ca pāśañcāpikapālakamviṣṇorukārātsañjātāḥ kacavargakalā daśaviṣṇorukārātsañjātāṣṭatavargakalā daśajātāḥ payavargakalā navavarandheyā dadhatya iti sādhakaiḥṭaṅkaṃ varaṃ ca karapallavaiḥkeśavādimātṛkāyāḥ sādhyo nārāyaṇo muniḥastrāya phaṭ |] śaktiśrīkāmaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaretmeghacapalāvarṇaṃ lakṣmīhariṃ bhajenamontā uccāryāḥ sthāne'kārādike nyasetkīrtisaṃyuktaḥ kāntirnārāyaṇānvitādhṛtisaṃyuktaḥ śāntiyuṅmadhusūdanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yukto hṛṣīkeśaśca harṣayālakṣmī yuṅma dhusū'nasarasvatīgadī durgā śāṅgīṃ tu prabhayānvitaḥvāṇīsamāyukto muśalī ca vilāsinīnarakajitsamaddhyā śuddhiyugghariḥbhūdharaḥ kledinīyukto viśvamūrtiśca klinnayābalānujaparāyaṇeprabhāsamāyukto varāho niśayānvitaḥmātṛkoktā yādiyogaśca pūrvavatsyāddakṣiṇāmūrtirgāyatraṃ chanda īritamsvarāñchaktīḥ padornyasetṣaḍdirghasaṃyutaṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍaṅgāni nyasettanautrinetramardhāmbikeśamaniśaṃ vapurāśrayāmaḥṅentaphentakatacchaktiṃ namontā mātṛkāsthalekrodhantathātmānaṃ ṅentaṃ yādidaśasvapiśālmallī yukto lolākṣī yuk trimūrtikaḥbhārabhūtirdīrghamukhyā tithīśo gomukhīyutaḥjhiṇṭīśaścordhvakeśī ca bhautiko vikṛtāsyayāśrīmukhī mahāseno vidyāmukhīyutaḥsarvasiddhigaurīyuktaḥ prakīrtitaḥmantraśaktyā kūrmeśaścāṣṭaśaktiyukproktastvajeśo drāviṇīyutaḥmañjaryā dārukeśaśca rūpiṇītathāṣāḍhī pūtanāyukta īritaḥśaṅkhinīyukto meṣeśastarjanīyutaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kapardinyā dvidaṇḍīśaśca vajrayārecanīyuktaḥ pinākī mādhavīyutaḥrakṣovidāriṇyā bhaguḥ sahajayā yutaḥmahāmāyāyukta etāstu mātṛkāḥrudrāḥ smṛtā raktā dhṛtaśūlakapālakāḥraktotpalakapālābhyāmalaṃkṛtakarāmbujāḥbījapūrvamātṛkānyasane surāḥbhuvaneśī devatātha niyogobhīṣṭasiddhayeprāgvaddhare ṣaḍaṅgaṃ syādaṃguṣṭhādi tathaiva cajagadīśvarī trinayanā padme niṣaṇṇā sukhammātṛkāṇāṃ nyāso nārpatyasādhaneṛṣirbhṛguśca gāyatrīchando mātṛsvarūpiṇīṣaḍaṅgādi śeṣaṃ śrībījapūrvakambhāsvadratnasamujjvalāṃ kucanatāṃ dhyāyejjagatsvāminīmmātṛkānyāsaṃ muniḥ sammohanaḥ smṛtaḥmahādevī pūrvayuktyā ṣaḍaṅgakamdhyāyetsamastajananīṃ navacaṃndracūḍāmmantradoṣā naśyanti bahuvarṇitāḥnyāsaḥ prāṅmātṛkāsamaḥsammohanīṃ trinayanāṃ navacandradūḍāmgaṇeśamātṛkāyāstu munirgaṇaka īritaḥdīrghādyayā cāṅgaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyedgajānanamliṅgitaṃ raktaṃ trinetraṃ gaṇapaṃ bhajevināyakaḥ puṣṭiyutaḥ śāntiyuktaḥ śivottamaḥyukta ekadantaḥ sumedhayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mohinīyukkapardī tu naṭīyutaḥnandayāyuksuyaśāgaṇanāyakau [sureśā iti]trilocanastejovatyā lambodarastu satyayākāmadāyugāmodo madajihvayāyukta ekapādo ramāyutaḥyuktaḥṣaṇmukho bhrukuṭīyutaḥvakratuṇḍo dvirado yāminīyutaḥśaśiprabhāyukto vimatto lolalocanaḥyuktaḥ khaḍgī durbhagayā tathābhaginī gaṇeśo bhoginīyutaḥkāliketi proktā vighneśamātṛkāprapañcayāganyāsoyaṃ vakṣyate bhuktimuktidaḥprapañcayāgasya gaṇakaśchanda īritamnyasettāṃśca gaṃbījaṃ cāpi guhyakeklīṃ glauṃ gamiti pūrvaṣaḍdīrghayugmakamkṛtvā digbandhamācaretprakurvīta gaṇapasyeṣṭasiddhayeairvahantaṃ bhajebījaṃ gaṇakosya munirmataḥyāgasya sāṅgatāsiddhihetaveṣaḍdīrghayuktena kuryādaṅgāni gena tusindūrābhaṃ candramauliṃ sarpabhūṣaṃ galanmadamgaṇapatirdevatā parikīrtitaḥsarvārthasiddhidāyeti sarvaduḥkhapraśeti cagaṃ gāṃ namo vahnigehinī

sanskrit: caturvāraṃ munyādisahitaṃnyasetsvarādisaptavargaistu grahānsapta pravinyasethaṃsaśca sohaṃ svāheti vai punaḥprapañcayāgamantrasya munirbrahmā samīritaḥsamākhyātaṃ devatācinmayātmikampañcavarṇaiḥ prapañcamanusaṃsthitaiḥtāramāyādikairetairyuktairhariharākṣaraiḥpūrṇakṛpāmburāśivadanhṛdikṣakārāntānakārāntānpunarhunetprapañcayāgākhyamātṛkānyāsa īritaḥca tataḥ sveṣṭamantrasya saṃcaretmārgeṇa nyāsānnityaṃ karoti yaḥnyāsakavacacchanno mantrajāpaparapriyaḥakṛtvā nyāsajālaṃ yo mūḍhātmā kurute japamnyāsānāṃ pracaratvena phalānāmapi bhūritāhasauṃ bījena saṃnyasetdvividhaṃ proktaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ tathāsomasūryāgnimaṇḍale na virājitetaddhisaguṇaṃ dhyānamīritamdhyānamiti vedavido viduḥtālugatāṃ caretkṛtvetthaṃ tu yajetpīṭhe nyāsamārgeṇa mantravityajeccandanādyairmānasairbhojanāntakaiḥsmaretkuṇḍaṃ kuṇḍalyagnisamujjvalam

sanskrit: grāhamātaṅgau śāpato yadābhaviṣyati yadā tanmedomajjasambhavāḥgaṇḍakī puṇyā gaṅgātulyā mahānadītanmanukṣetrampuṇyaṃ kṣetraṃ mahītaleśālagrāmaśilā yatra yatra dvāravatī śilāsarvadevaprītikarā bhuktimuktipradāyinīpārthivāṃśaṃ vinā sarve vajrakīṭā bhavantvitimūrteśca na vṛkṣasyāpi pūjanātviṣṇuvacaḥ śrutvā brahmā vacanamabravītkodhikāri ca kena mārgeṇa tadvadapūjyā brāhmaṇādyaiḥ sukhāptayepāpaśamanī malinā pāpadhīkarālakṣmīṃ dhūmābhā harate matimdāridryakāriṇīvakrā samā sarvārthasādhikāpūjāphalaṃ lāñchitayā niṣphalaṃ lāñchanaṃ vinādadyādbahucakrā pradhānatāmvikṛtāvartanābhiśca vittānnaṃ kurute bahuduḥkhadātrī yathā sūkṣmā tathāmṛtamlakṣmīhariḥ sa vijñeyo yatra padmaṃ sacakrakamvijñeyo yaddvāre cakrayugmakamsa vijñeyaḥ prākpaścāccakrayugmakamsūkṣmacakraṃ syācchidraṃ dīrghaṃ vicintayetnīlābho vartulaścātiśobhanaḥsa tu vijñeya ekaṃ vā dvayameva canārāyaṇaḥ śyāmavarṇo nābhau cakraṃ tathonnatam

sanskrit: sarvakāmaphalapradaḥdṛśyante puruṣārthaphalapradaḥbrahmahatyādipāpānāṃ nāśako yogasiddhidaḥpūjayitvā taṃ daridropīśvaro bhavetathavā jāyate nānāsvarṇarekhābhiranvitaḥdṛśyate rekhā sa sarpaviṣanāśakaḥcakrāṇi catvāri pitṛtṛptikṛtsūkṣmadvāraścatuścakro bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥtamabhyarcyāmuyātsvargaṃ viṣayāṃśca samīhitānsame cakre gṛhasthābhīṣṭadāyakaḥcakrayugmamekarekhā tu dakṣiṇepradakṣiṇāvartakṛto vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥpārśvagā rekhā vedaśāstrāgamapradaḥpūjānte pratiṣṭhāṃ nātra kārayetnaiva pujyante sarvakāmaphalārthibhiḥdharmavṛddhiḥ pāpanāśo bhavedihasvayantuliṅgākṛtimānmantrasiddhividhāyakaḥtathā rekhā gatāyuṣṭvapradāyakaḥpradṛśyante socito jñānadāyakaḥbilvapramāṇastejasvī pūjitaḥ strīvaśaṅkaraḥhyantare'dhaśca gopadamtadūrdhvañca śvetā rekhā triśūlabhāktasya sevanādroganāśanamcakramadhye bhavedrekhā mārayedripusantatimpūjanato devī bhavānī suprasīdati

sanskrit: || na dūrvayā yajeddurgāṃ bilvapatrairdivākaramnārkapuṣpairyajeddevīmādityaṃ tagareṇa capravālairvā tadabhāve ca korakaiḥ [mukulam |]| 13- dhātrī | 14- rasālaḥ |]kuryādāvaraṇārcanamgandhapuṣpādyairdevasyāṃgaṃ samarcayetādāvāvaraṇaṃ pūjyaṃ tadante devatāṃ yajetkeśareṣvagnikoṇādau hṛdayādīni pūjayettuṣārasphaṭikaśyāmanīlakṛṣṇāruṇārciṣaḥagnīśāsuravāyavyamadhyadikṣukramātsthitāḥtadādiparivārāṇāṃ prādakṣiṇyena pūjanamdevasyābhimukhaṃ tāssamāsthitāḥteṣāṃ dhyānamathocyatedvibhujaṃ pīṭhavajradharaṃ bhajemeṣavāhaṃ devaraṃ kāntalocanamkāladaṇḍakaraṃ krūraṃ vṛtaṃ dūtairbhayānakaiḥkhaḍgahastañca piṅgalaśmaśrukūrcakamtundilaṃ vande varuṇaṃ yādasāṃ patimvānaprasthasamārūḍhaṃ dhāvantaṃ vegato bhajenārasiṃhāsanārūḍhaṃ pānapātrayutaṃ bhajebhālacandraṃ ca jaṭājūṭadharaṃ sitampīnottuṅgaṃ cakradharamanantaṃ viśvalaṃ bhajehaṃsārūḍhaṃ vedapāṭhaṃ kurvantaṃ tamahaṃ bhajenāmadevyāścaturthyantamudīrayettatostreṇa lakṣayetpūjayettataḥ

sanskrit: [manaḥśilā] bhāskarasya priyaṃ matamnakhaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ sarjarasamekaikāṃśaṃ prakalpayetlākṣā tribhāgā catvāro bhāgāḥ śailajamustayoḥsihlasiddhārthaiḥ śeṣadevadaśāṅgakaḥvitaredbhūmau nāsane na paṭe tathāneṣṭo viṣṇave dārusambhavaḥvibhavairnānāvādyapurassaramghaṇṭāyāssarvasiddhidaḥprakurvīta viśeṣāddhūpadīpayoḥpūjāṃ kārayetsiddhilālasaḥpradarśayeddīpaṃ na ca medādinā kvacitmiśrīkṛtasnehāttāmisraṃ narakaṃ vrajetpaṭhetjyotirdīpoyaṃ pratigṛhyatāmsitāvartirdakṣiṇato vāmato raktavartikāśataṃ samāḥpādyamācamanīyaṃ ca dattvā naivedyamarpayetsaṃsthāpya caturasaṃ ca saṃskuryācchāstramārgataḥ[yamiti mantreṇa] śoṣayetspṛśet |]pradarśyātha gandhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayethemapātrasthitaṃ divyaṃ paramānnaṃ susaṃskṛtamsamuccārya svāhāntaṃ jalamarpayetdakṣiṇe haste jalaṃ dattvā paṭhedidam|] || darśayeddakṣahastena vikacotpalasannibhām

sanskrit: kaniṣṭhānāmikāṃguṣṭhayogaḥ prāṇasya mudrikāsvāhāntamatha ca vyānāya ca tato vadetkaniṣṭhāṃ sarvābhirudānāyāgnigehinīsvarṇādije pātre sutoyaṃ dhenumudrayāsuśītalamjalapātraṃ niveśayetghṛtapakvaṃ dugdhasiddhaṃ sādhitaṃ kevalāgnināpuṣpāñjaliṃ dadyādastramantreṇa bandhanam115) amṛtātmakanaivedyaṃ nama ityuccaretpunaḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā mūlamantraṃ dadejjalampūrvavatsaṃskṛte vahnau devamāvāhya mantravithaviṣā tilairvā pāyasaiḥ śubhaiḥaṅgāvaraṇadevānāmekaikāmāhutiṃ hunetupaviśyāsane mantrairdadyādbhūtabaliṃ tataḥsampūjya tatastebhyo baliṃ haretyoginyopyagnirūpāśca gaṇānāmadhipāścayeprītamanaso bhūtā gṛhṇantvimaṃ balimsmādāya bhūtāni prārthayeditinārācamudrayā visṛjettataḥrakṣodigbhāge pātraṃ tatsthāpayettataḥgṛhītvā tu nirmālyabhojine namaḥpunarāmacamanaṃ dadyātkarodvartaname vacatāmbūlaṃ viṣṇave dvādaśāṅgakamjāvitrīkastūrikeśarairyutammṛganābhitamālābhyāṃ hīnaṃ vidheśvarasya tu
