sanskrit: jātikośayutaṃ tacca maheśituḥtathādarśaṃ kalpayecchatracāmarekuryāddharmakāmārthasiddhayelikhetpadmamaṣṭapatraṃ suśobhanamvalayāñcitaśobhābhiḥ śobhitānghṛtapūritānprāgvattataḥ śrīṃ hrīmiti kramāttatastatpātramuddhṛtya mastakāntaṃ punaḥ punaḥca tataḥ prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caretaṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu nava dve triśataṃ tu vāgṛhītvedaṃ paṭhetpunaḥme deva tvatprasādājjagatpategītastutibhirghaṇṭāvādanapūrvakampaurāṇikādyairvaiśyastu śūdrastu prākṛtādibhiḥnityaṃ tarpaṇasevanamnaraka yāti pitṛbhissaha pāpakṛtduḥkhitāvasminbhavenyatra ca nārakauśṛṇuyādvedaṃ sa nirvaṃśastu nirdhanaḥprājāpatyatrayaṃ kṛtvā tau saṃśuddhau bhaviṣyataḥgṛhāṇārādhanaṃ varamdeveśaṃ ślokairebhiḥ samarpayetca naivedyaṃ tadgṛhāṇānukampayājānāmi tvaṃ gatiḥ parameśvarabhūtānāṃ draṣṭā tvaṃ parameśvarabhaktiravyayāstu sadā tvayiyo devaḥ sohameva hi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūssvāhā |] manunā kuryādbrahmārpaṇaṃ tataḥvācā karmaṇābhyantarā tataḥkṛtaṃ tacca sarvaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ bhavetudvāsayettato devaṃ parivāragaṇaissahavilīnaṃ tu raśmivṛndamaśeṣataḥkṣamayāropayetsvīye hṛdambhoje tu devatāmbrahmādayo devā na viduḥ paramaṃ padammantreṇānena dhyātvā tāṃ sthāpayeddhṛdibrahmādayaḥ sarve surāstiṣṭhanti me hṛdimaṇḍalaṃ kuryāddvāri padmavivarjitmpañcaiva īśānādyaṃ samarcayetprokta īśvarī ca maheśituḥlehyacoṣyānnapānādi nirmālyaṃ pravilepanamnaivedyaśeṣaṃ tu dattvā natvā visarjayetbhāskarāyārcāmacchidrārthaṃ nivedayetsavitre karmadāyinebhāskarasya prasādataḥmantrayedaṣṭadhā punaḥmastake dhāryaṃ mūlamantreṇa mantriṇātadbhaktebhyaḥ svayaṃ bhuktvā tanmayo hi vasetsukhamna doṣaḥ pañcasaṅgameśaivā hyaśaivā vā mucyante pāparāśitaḥtatsambandhiprasādādi gṛhṇannirayamāpnuyāttarpaṇaṃ ca vaidikaṃ tāntrikaṃ tathāmātṛkānyāsaṃ tathā chandarṣidaivatam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantrasnānaṃ devatāyāḥ pūjāṃ pañcopacārikāmjapeccāṣṭottaraṃ śatamsamprārthayeddevaṃ sāyaṃ sandhyāṃ samācaretathāparāhnikaṃ vakṣye tatsthānadaśake bhavetsthāne sarpavyāghrādije bhayetatra snānādikaṃ cintyaṃ kṛtvā mānasapūjanampṛthivīmadhye pūjā devasya cācaretkartavyā sarvāśāpratipattayevakṣye nityaṃ svāsthyādhikasya tatkartavyā sthaṇḍile pratimāsu caravimaṇḍalamālokya pratimāmathavā punaḥsvakartavyaṃ samāpayetgurūnviprāṃstadagre ca vākyametadudīrayetsamprārthya punaḥ pūrvavadācaretdhyānena homena dānatopi vātāntrikapūjādi manasaiva samācaretvāmācāre na sūtakamdevatattvaṃ no vetti sa tu guhyakaḥkṣuttṛḍbhyāmarditaḥ pretastasmāddharmaṃ vicārayetsampūjayeddevaṃ bhāvanākusumādibhiḥjaḍānāmāhnikaṃ vakṣye tathā saṃkṣepakarmaṇimūlamūrtiṣaḍaṅgāni teṣāṃ pūjābhidhīyatenirmalenodakenaiva pūjayetsthiramānasaḥadhikārinimittābhyāṃ bhidyate śatadhā punaḥyathālabdhairviniṣpādyā dravyaiḥ pūjā tu madhyamā

sanskrit: vihitākhilavedoktairbrahmarṣibhirakalmaṣaiḥrājarṣibhistaponiṣṭhairbhagavattattvavedibhiḥstrībālavṛddhamukhyādyairbhaktairakṣuṇṇamānasaiḥno śaktāstantrāṇi tu yuge yugepreritā viprāstattantrapathagāminaḥbhaviṣyanti kṣīṇapuṇyāśca rauravegopaṃ paṭalairviṣṇugopanamkṛtaṃ tantraṃ tasya tatra pradhānatāsamākhyāto yuṣmatpraśnavinirṇayaḥkarma kāryaṃ niḥśreyasāya vaiāhnikaprakāśaḥ pañcamaḥvaidikādyāssarva mantrā na siddhyanti ca yaṃ vināsāraḥ sa tu gopitaḥpurā yacca caryate tatprakīrtitamsa syāttatprakāraṃ bravīmyahampañcāṅgakasvarūpaṃ tadāhuḥ kecana tatra tumantrāstiṣṭhanti vedeṣu tathā tantre ca śābareaghamarṣeṇa sūryārgheṇa japena praṇāmakaiḥhutiryāgastathā cārcā karmataścakrapūjanātbhavatyekādaśāṅgakaḥsarvapāpakṣayaṃ kuryādatha vā siddhibandhakṛtproktena mārgeṇa tasya siddhiradūrataḥkaulikānāṃ vāmināṃ nādhikāritāṛkśākhādhyāyibhiḥ kāryo gaṇako yotha tadvidhiḥsaṅkalpya pūjayitvā gaṇeśvaram

sanskrit: dvirādyoṃnayate tataḥityathātra ṛco vakṣye mābhūcchākhāviparyayaḥdakṣiṇāvāḍrājiniprācotihavirbharantyagnaye ghṛtācīpuruṣāya na mameti santyajettadidānīṃ nigadyateviśvato vṛtvātyatiṣṭhaddaśāṃgulamutāmṛtatvasyeśāno yadannenātirohatibhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ diviviṣvaṅvyakrāmatsāśanānaśane abhipaścāddhūmimatho puraḥgrīṣma idhmaḥ śaraddhaviḥyadyajñaṃ tanvānā abadhnanpuruṣaṃ paśumayajanta sādhyā ṛṣayaśca yepaśūṃstāṃścakre vāyavyānāraṇyāngrāmyāṃśca yetasmādyajustasmādajāyatatasmāttasmājjātā ajāvayaḥkau bāhū kā ūrū pādā ucyeteyadvaiśyaḥ padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyatamukhādindraścāgniśca prāṇādvāyurajāyatabhūmirdiśaḥ śrotrāttathā lokānakalpayanmarudbhyastu dvādaśaikādaśe bhavethavyavāhāgnaye ca tithi saṅkhyakevaiśvānarāyāgnaye ca tathaivāṣṭādaśepi caceti ṛcastāḥ śṛṇu sāmpratammuñcatvaṁhasaḥ

sanskrit: || staumyagniṃ nāthito johavīmi sa no muñcatvaṁhaṃsaḥmuñcatvaṁhaṃsaḥtyārājānaṁ sarathe pāthaṃ ugratau no muñcatamāga saḥmuñcatamāgasaḥ|| yau viśvasya paribhūbabhūvatustauno muñcatamāgasaḥsavitāraṃ nāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatamāgasaḥ|| yayorvāndevau deveṣvaniśitamojastau no muñcatamāgasaḥviśvāndevānnāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatamāgasaḥ|| āsūnhave suyamānūtaye te no muñcantvenasaḥstaumi devānmaruto nāthito johavīmi te no muñcaṃtvenasaḥ|| āsūnhave surāmānūtaye te no muñcaṃtvenasaḥviśvāndevānnāthito johavīmi te no muñcaṃtvenasaḥbhavatāṃ dāśuṣe mayaḥhinu praṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣaḥsuṣṭutetīrupadivā sariṣaḥ pātu naktammuñcatamaṃhasaḥkṛdhāsvasmānaditeranāgāvyenāṁsi śiśratho viṣvagagneevoṣvasmanmuñcatāmaṃhaḥ pratāryagne prataraṃ na āyuḥnānyathāyāvāmitrāvaruṇā yatavyā tanūstaye mamāṁhaso muñcatamyāvāmindrāvaruṇā sahasyā tanūstaye mamāṁhaso muñcatamyāvāmindrāvaruṇā tejasyā tanūstaye mamāṁhasomuñcatamindrāvaruṇābhyāmiti tyāgaḥ sarvatra nānyathāyo vāmindrāvaruṇāvagnau snāmastaṃ vāmetenāvayaje
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yo vāmindrāvaruṇauṣadhīṣu snāmastaṃ vāmetenāvayajetriṣaṣṭivākyaistatrādyā ṛktrivākyātra śāktakaiḥpāvamānībhyo mama tyāgo vācyastvaśāktakaiḥpāvamānyai atho śaivaiḥ pāvamānāya nānyathāmātathā yuñjyānna mama tyāga īritaḥbhūtāni jātavedaḥ punīhi māmtyāgaḥ sopi prakāśyatedevadīvyadagne kratvākratūṁranutyāgaḥ savitre ca ubhe yathānaḥviśvataḥvaiśvadevyai iti vadenna mameti ca sā yathārayīṇāmceti saptamyāṃ tyāga iṣyatemama tyāgoṣṭamyāṃ ca sāyathāpunīhi māpāvamānībhyo daśamyādiṣu tā yathāidaṃ brahma punīhi māsapūtamaśnāti svaditaṃ mātariśvanāduhe kṣīraṃ sarpirmadhūdakamsamhṛto raso brāhmaṇeṣvamṛtagūṃhitamdevairdevīḥ samāhitāḥsambhṛto raso brāhmaṇeṣvamṛtaṃ hitampāvamānyaḥ punantu mām

sanskrit: prājāpatyāya pavitrāya ceti ṣoḍaśīṃ śṛṇuvayaṃ pūtaṃ brahma punīmahevaruṇāya tato vadetūrjayantyā sahitāya jātavedasa ityapikṛtametābhistaiḥ snātaṃ jāhnavajilepunātumāmutaḥsarasvatyai na mama vākyamuccaret ||]pāhyenaso yatkiñcānṛtamūdimatyāgastadvatkṛto yathācakṛma karotu māmanenasamgārhapatyāya navame cāgnaye vadetkarotu mānanehasampitarau mayā tattadagne anṛṇo bhavāmitvagnayethāgregnaye gārhapatyāya cayāni cakṛma karotu māma nenasamyāni cakṛma karotu māma nenasamyāni cakṛma karotu māmanenasamāpastā naḥ śudhantu śundhanīḥhiraṇyavarṇāstata utpunīta naḥaheḍamāno varuṇohabodhyuruśaṁsamā na āyuḥ pramoṣīḥavayakṣva no varuṇaṁ rarāṇo vīhimṛḍīkaṁsuhavo na edhivaiśvānarāyāṣṭarcāntyāgoyamīritaḥdhehi bheṣajamdharmamīmahe

sanskrit: divāsaripaḥ pātu naktamdevānabhiśasteramuco vaiśvānara jātavedo mahitvātavotibhiḥsūryāyakalaśamādāya nair-ṛtyāntu catuṣpathesaha vīkṣetacchāyāṃ tasmiñcchubhāśubhāmoṣadhayaḥ santviti kṣipetvayaṃ dviṣmaḥ |] santu pṛṣṭhataḥ kalaśaṃ kṣipetupaspṛśya svagṛhaṃ praviśettataḥpaśyettoyamadhye chāyāmacchāntadā bhavetāśīrvacogṛhyādbrāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥsamaśnīyāddhaviṣyaṃ brahmacaryabhāktasya nāśārthaṃ kūṣmāṇḍībhistu homayetmārge dāridryādibhirardditaḥlokadvayapratiṣṭhārthaṃ sopi guptaṃ samācaretvarṣaṃ vratametatsamācaretdānaṃ gṛhītvāyutamekakamkaragrahe || devaviprādhikāre cāpadante lakṣamācaretājyabhāgānantaraṃ ca kūṣmāṇḍībhistu homayetviralaiḥ saṃyuktā jvariṇe hitā]ghṛtaṃ vāpi samāśrayetgoghṛtenaiva tadabhāve tu māhiṣamsarvatra yojanā ||] ṛgbhinnā sā ca kathyateādityāstasmānmāmuñcatartasyartena māmutaḥviśvedevāḥ sajoṣasaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pāhyenaso yatkiñcānṛtamūdimacaturthī yā adhunā sā ṛgucyatemuñcantvenaso yatkiñcānṛtamūdimapūrvamudīritātyāgastathāṣṭamyātha socyatena ākṣietattadagne anṛṇo bhavāmi jīvanneva prati tatte dadhāmimātaraṃ prākproktā daśamāhutiḥyadāśasāniśasāprākproktātra dvādaśāhutiḥpūrvoktāṣoḍaśī bhavetvaruṇetyādi pañcarcaḥ pūrvamīritāḥdvāviṃśe tyāgaḥ sā ṛgathocyatetena ṛṇānṛṇava itsamāno yamasya loke adhirajjurāyadvayoriha tyāgo varuṇāya na vai mamanasmabhyamasurapraceto rājannetāṁ siśiśrathaḥkṛtāniathāvayamādityavrate tavānāgaso aditaye syāmadūrāddūramavīvatamtyāgaḥ pañcatriṃśattame mataḥtasmai prasuvāmasitenātyorasmatsamṛcchāte tasmai suprasavāmasiparā yakṣmagūṃ suvāmi teāyurdāyāgnaye tyāgaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśetha tadagrimeagnaye varuṇāyādityai viśvebhyo devebhyaścajaradaṣṭiyathāsatdvayorjātavedasegnaye tyāga ucyate

sanskrit: mogdhi tvagūṃhi vettha yathātathagūṃsvāhājanmakṛtāghānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ nivāraṇamsitāṣṭamyāṃ kṛtanityakriyaḥ śuciḥca ekādaśyāmupoṣaṇamnārāyaṇāyeti sveṣṭabījādikaṃ manumdvijocchiṣṭabhojī tatsevane rataḥjāyate pūrṇe jape no cetpunaścarethomādyārambhadivase mṛnmayaṃ nrvraṇaṃ dṛḍhamtasmiṃstīrthādijaṃ toyaṃ niḥkṣipetkalaśonmitamdvayoścaiva kuryāddhariharārcanamnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādapsu sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitamtoyaṃ saṃprārthya dadyātpuṣpāñjaliṃ tataḥtathā toye dṛṣṭā cetpātakaṃ gatamtataḥ kuryādyadicchāyātinirmalāmantro japtaścedarbudākṣaramgaṇeśasya ravestava tadardhakamapadaṃśastadardhaṃ cetyetatsarvatra gopitamsarvatantreṣu devatānāṃ pṛthakpṛthakmāpūraṃ gaṇeśamanusiddhidamyamunāyāstaṭaṃ kāśyāṃ dineśamanusiddhidamgaṇḍakītīraṃ dvārakā viṣṇusiddhidāvaidyanāthaṃ rāmeśaḥ śivasiddhikṛtsarasvatyāstathātīraṃ śāktaṃmantrasya siddhikṛtaṅgavaṅgakaliṅgāśca kṣudradaivatasiddhidāḥpūrṇagirirvāmamārgasya siddhidāḥ

sanskrit: vidrumākulito deśo gaṇeśasyātivallabhaḥgodhūmadūrvākṣetrāṇi śilā bhānumataḥ priyāśrotriyayuggrāme harermudvaidikāntikevaṭasyārātsaṅgame vipine hradeśakteḥ prītiśca nirjaneśuṣkanadyāṃ ca modante kṣudradevatāḥśavākīrṇe sthāne tuṣyanti vāmakāḥdevālaye syādvaidikodhikaḥśūdrāśca siddhistatra tu vaidikīyuvatyaśca na vartante tatra siddhiradūrataḥbhūchidrādiṣu no vasetsampūjya bhūsutasya balena cabhūmirmantroyaṃ siddhyatāmitivitastipramitānvṛttāngṛhṇīyātkīlakāndaśapaścānnair-ṛtyayormadhye yantramastreṇa kīlayetkīlite mantrī na vighnaiḥ paribhūyatekṣetrapālaṃ pūjayecca gaṇeśvaramsamāśritya kūrmacakraṃ vicārayetparadeśagrāmagṛhabhedātkūrmaścaturvidhaḥlekhyāḥ pūrvāśādiṣu lakṣakaupūrvato lekhyāḥ śrībījaṃ madhyakoṣṭhakevarṇo yasyāṃ diśi vyavasthitaḥvijñeyaṃ svarādvyañjanatastathāmukhasya pārśvayoḥ pāṇī kukṣī pādau tatastataḥjīvanāśo vaire syāddhananāśanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ḷpau jāhau paṣau enau irau ulaugādau jaṭau rākhau budhau ralaupacayoścāpi tarayo ralayorapisthānavargayutaṃ taṣṭamaṣṭabhiścāpi ucyateubhayoḥ kāryamadhikaṃ yasya śeṣakamkiñciddāsatvaṃ pādayoḥ pucchato mṛtiḥkāśyāṃ ca kūrmasthānaṃ na cintayetmantraḥ sarvasiddhiphalapradaḥarthakṛcchaktikṛtpūrvakāṣṭhādau balinārcayetkūrmapṛṣṭhe gṛhaṃ kṛtvā gṛhastho japamācaretsthracittānāṃ cañcalā calacetasāmpratyekamantrayugmantrā japtavyāḥ sarvasiddhidāḥcāṣṭottaraśataṃ punarvarṇasya yojanampañcaviṃśatyā bhasaṅkhyaiḥ sarvadā japetśatātsāmyaṃ tathāṣṭādhiśatātsakalasiddhayaḥmataḥvidrumotthā vaśyakarā mauktikā muktidā matāḥ||] svāgatampadamjvarahantrī tu lākṣāyāḥ śaṃkhasya pitṛtṛptikṛtpadmakāṣṭhodbhavā tuṣṭau devadārūdbhavā niruksarvārthaṃ mohane tāmrajā matācandanotthā śaktikṛcchvetakāṣṭhajāraktacandanabījotthā yakṣiṇyādikasādhanestambhanaṃ rujāmvanyasiddhiḥ śārdūlāttasya devatāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rāsabhāsthnā kṣudrasiddhirmānyatā tu gajāsthibhiḥjapedvipraḥ suvarṇamaṇibhirnṛpaḥrudrākṣasphaṭikendrākṣamadhye kiñcinna dāpayetprotayenmālāṃ gaṇanāthasya mantrakaiḥdvādaśyāṃ vaiṣṇavī mālā protavyā viṣṇumantrataḥaṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ bhūminandanepaṭṭasūtreṇa devyāḥ prītyai tu mālikāūrṇābhirvā vālkalairvā śaivī kārpāsasūtrakaiḥdvijendrapuṇyastrīnirmittaṃ granthivarjitamṣaḍvaktrairvātha kartavyā mitho miśrāṃstu varjayetproktaṃ mukhaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ tu nimnakamadhamaścaṇakābhaḥ syāttato hīno vipattikṛttatastasmānnyūnaṃ nyūnataraṃ tataḥgranthirahitāṃ dṛḍhacakrasamanvitāmpradakṣiṇāvartaḥ sa brahmagranthirucyateśuddha ukteṣvakṣeṣvatandritaḥbrāhmaṇaśreṣṭho japamālākṛte bhṛśamvipro yathā viprāḥ svadharmagāḥpurādhṛto jīrṇo rudrākṣo na śubhaḥ smṛtaḥkāryā nātra muktādi vinyasettathā bhaktādikeṣṭadaḥgṛhasthāśramasaukhyadaḥdharmārthakāmāḥ siddhyanti dhāraṇāttajjapādapividyā vāksiddhiścāpi jāyateśaivagāṇeśaśāktānāṃ hutasiddhistu tajjapāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bāhau dhāraṇātsamare jayaḥsarpaviṣamṛtyurna jāyatetajjapātsarve kāmakrodhādiśatravaḥprasīdanti vāmabāhau sthitoghahāpiśācagrahavetālabrahmarākṣasapannagāḥhayamedhādiyajñānāṃ phalabhāgbhavetpratāpī ca gomedhaphalabhāgbhavetdhṛto dadyātpitṝṇāmakṣayāṅgatimdevamanujairakṣayāṃ labhate gatimkāñcanavarṇāyāḥ śvetāyāścaiva gomayamkṛṣṇavarṇāyā evaṃ pañcāmṛtepi cavarṇavibhāgena pañcagavyāni cāharetgośakṛddviguṇaṃ mūtraṃ sarpirdadyāccaturguṇamyaśasebhiṣiñcāmi |] tvā kuśodakam|] gharṣayetlepayeccandanādibhiḥpadmākāreṇa navamiḥ sthāpite tatra vinyasethrīṃpūrvairmātṛkārṇaiḥ kramādekaikaśo maṇimkevalājyairvā sadyojātādibhiḥ pṛthakhomābhāve japaḥ proktaḥ protayenmālikāṃ tataḥsadyojātādibhirmantraiḥ pūrvavatkṣālanādikamṣaṭtriṃśaddvātriṃśatkaṇṭhamālikāaṣṭottaraśatairyuktamupavītaṃ vidhīyateṣaṭsaṅkhyā dhāraṇakrama īritaḥdhārayannevaṃ dehānte sa śivo bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: home vaiśvadeve surārcanerudrākṣadhārī bhūtvā ca yatkiñcitkarma vaidikamhaste ca karṇayorupavītakepibanmadyaṃ saṅgacchannantyajādiṣudevānpuṣṇanti ye devāḥ paśavastetra vaidikāḥsaṃrakṣaṇārthāya nānyo rudrākṣato bhuvikaṇṭhamāśritya śūkaro mriyate yadirudrākṣadhāraṇātpāpakarmāpi yo nityaṃ rudraloke mahīyatemauḍyānnāsāvāpnoti tatphalamgaṇeśasūryaviṣṇvīśadurgāḥ sampūjya bhaktitaḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ pañcagavye tāṃ sthāpayetryahamgranthayitvā sthaṇḍile tāṃ nidhāpayetsaṃsnāpya śītalena jalena cakuryāddhasauṃmantreṇa sādhakaḥnavagrahānpūjayitvā dikpālāṃścāpi pūjayetdadyādgurave maṇisaṅkhyakamsvarṇapatrasya grāhyamaśvatthapatrakamkīkasādikamālānāṃ kaulikānāñca vāmināmpūjayedādau vastragandhānulepanaiḥpañcāśanmaṇibhiḥ kāryā ṛtumatyā bhage kṣipetśuddhodairmūlamantreṇābhiṣiñcedvijayārasaiḥsveṣṭajape nīlaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ māraṇakarmaṇivaśye pītaṃ kaṣāyantu vikṣepakaraṇe matamhunenmadyapalābhyāṃ ca mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sādhakāṃścāpi bhojayenmaṇisaṅkhyakānyā mālā kṛtā tantu japettayāniyuñjīta japettu sthagito yathātarjanyā na spṛśetsūtraṃ kampayennaiva dhūnayetcālaneṃguṣṭhaścānyamakṣaṃna saṃspṛśettu saṅghaṭṭaṃ naiva kārayetvidveṣaḥ sphuṭite vyādhisambhavaḥvāṃgulimālābhirjapaṃ kuryāttaducyatemūlaparyantā karamālā prakīrtitācānāmikāmūlātkaniṣṭhānukrameṇa cakalpayenmeruṃ madhyānāmādiparvakamproktastathāyantrividhomataḥaṃgulyākhyo japaḥ prokto matonyo na mamaiva caviyuñjīta japakāle kadācanaguṇavānkiñcitsaṅkocayettalammātsaryaṃ kāmaṃ dveṣañca tāḍanamvādyaṃ madhu cchāyāṃ vibhītakakarañjayoḥvarjayedvidvānkartavyānyatha me śṛṇuśrautamaune parasaṅgasya varjanamguroḥ pādapūjāhāranimantraṇepañcayajñāstarpaṇameva casakṛduccarite śabde praṇavaṃ samudīrayetcāvaśyaṃ nyasyāṅgāni tato japetjapenmantraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vā smareddharimsūryogniścandramāḥ kheṭā munayo bhāni tārakāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣutedhovāyugamane patitādikabhāṣaṇepaścājjapenmantramambho'lābhe hariṃ smaretdṛṣṭvācamya caretkarma spṛṣṭvā snānaṃ vidhīyatebahuvastraikavastro vā muktakeśo galāvṛtaḥcintādyākulacitto vā kruddho vāntaḥ kṣudhānvitaḥdhautapādaḥ paścādvā dakṣiṇāmukhaḥraktavastraḥsnigdhavastro dvikacchakaḥparityajya tajjapaṃ punarā caretmaunena daśakumbhamitairjalaiḥsyādakṣarāvṛttiḥ sa tredhā parikīrtitaḥuccanīcaiḥ svaritaiḥ śabdaiḥ spaṣṭapadākṣaraiḥśanairuccārayenmantramīpadoṣṭau pracārayetyadākṣaraśreṇīṃ yathāsthāneṣu coccaretṣaṭkarmakṛdvācikaḥ syātkāyikaḥ sarvasiddhikṛtdevatā nityaṃ stūyamānā prasīdatisantuṣṭo jāyate kṣullako naraḥmahāguṇairvaśyo jāyate guṇavānprabhuḥproktaṃ nityakāmikabhedataḥdvihastañca sundaraṃ mṛdu nirmalamvakṣyante jñānasiddhyāyihājinamśrīvivarddhanamkṛṣṇakambalaḥtyajenniṣiddhaṃ matimāṃstvaniṣiddheṣu saṃviśetdaridraḥ syādvastre sthānavināśanampṛthagupādānāt ||]
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhavetpīḍā niṣiddhaṃ tviṣṭakāsanamsaṃnyāsī snātakaḥ siddhimāpnuyātviprānsantarpya yatnena bhojanācchādanādibhiḥjapaṃ paścāttadanujñāpurassaramtadbahiścaturasraṃ ca tatra kṣetre samarcayetannodakādisampūrṇaṃ balipātraṃ nidhāpayetsiddhāntibhistatra nivedyo manunā surāḥpaścādvighnavighna maheti cagṛhṇagṛhṇasvāheti vai vadetsaparivārāya baliṃ dadyānna bhakṣayetgurūnviprāngaṇeśaṃ paripūjya cakālaḥ sandhye bhūtānyahaḥ kṣapābrahmaśāsanamāsthāya kalpadhvamiha sannidhimsaṅkalpaṃ kuryātsaṃvatsarādikānmāsaṃ pakṣaṃ pañcāṅgameva casvadeśabhedānuccārya kāmanāsahitānvadetjātināmāntaṃ punaḥ śarma ca varma capuraścaryāmetatsaṅkhyajapātmikāmdurgāṃ mahyaṃ natvā ca pūjanamṛṣyādivinyāsamaṅganyāsaṃ tathaiva casamprokṣya tatastāṃ prārthayeditinyastastasmānme siddhidā bhava[gamiti bījam ||] gaṇapateḥ pūrvamuccārya tadanantaramdakṣiṇe paścāccintayenmanasā śivamdhyāyetkaṇṭhamadhye pītavarṇaṃ hiraṇmayama
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: || ājñācakre tataḥ paścādgurormantrasya cātmanaḥgurusvarūpamekaṃ taṃ ṣaṭcakraṃ prati laṅghayetlambayenmūlamantreṇa cādiṣoḍaśacakrakamdevīṃ jātakarmasamārabhettripathasthānaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ caturaṃgulamnāḍīnāṃ veṣṭanaṃ vidyate nṛṇāmtattvacakramiti proktaṃ śuklaṃ kaṇṭhasya madhyagamṣoḍaśāraṃ syātsaptāṃgulapramāṇataḥmantrāṇāṃ cintitasya japasya cautpannaḥ pūrvamādisutasya tunissetuḥ kṣaṇātkṣarati yajvanāmsetumādāya japakarma samārabhancaturdaśasvaronyeṣāṃ candrānusvārasaṃyutaḥcālayetbhavettasya sa japo niṣphalaḥ sadāmālāmantrastu hrīṃ siddhyai namaḥ samprārthayeditikuruṣva me bhadre yaśo vīryaṃ ca vardhayapañcākṣarastato devaṃ sveṣṭaṃ samprārthayeditime deva tvatprasādājjagatpatecārghyatoyena madhyāhnasamaye tvidamnyāsāvasānamakhilaṃ karma kuryātpuroditamtu bhūyaḥ snātvā tato dvijaḥbhojanaṃ kuryātsatataṃ tārakodayebhavecchreṣṭhasteṣāṃ lakṣaṇamucyateraktahastīśaṃkhamadhuśālukaṃ śreṣṭhamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00195 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuvākuśca mūle pāvitryakārakamsatkulasthānajātānāṃ bhikṣāśī cāgrajanmanāmbhikṣālabdhaṃ bhakṣyaṃ vratasthitaiḥtaṇḍulāḥ ṣaṣṭhinīvāraśālijāstrividhā matāḥkaṅgavaśca makuṣṭhāśca yāvannālakaṇaśikācakramardaḥ palaṅkaḥ śatapuṣpikāmṛṇālamusalī ghoṇṭā śatamūlī vidārikākañcyukaśca śṛṅgāṭakakaserukaudugdhaṃ sasāraṃ madhuraṃ payonyattvalapabījakambheṣajaṃ sarvaṃ hitvā mīnānsurāṃ palammāhiṣaṃ cānyadvratasthānāṃ niṣidhyatedeśakulataḥ praśastaṃ sodhamaḥ smṛtaḥmasūrāśca kodravāścaṇakāstridhākṣāraṃ palāṇḍuśca gṛñjanaṃ kācabhojanamparyuṣitaṃ tailaṃ tāmbūlaṃ kṣudradhānyakamdvipakvaṃ ca guḍānnaṃ tālajaṃ phalammantrapūtaṃ pāvanaṃ devadurlabhambhojanaṃ kāryamupastīryāvidhārya casammantrya bhuñjīyāddhṛdayāṇunābhuñjīta tvanyatpatraṃ vivarjitamśayane suśuddhe vasudhātalemūlamantreṇa jitakrodho jitendriyaḥsamutthāya pādaśaucaṃ vidhāya cakuryādyathāśakti tvarpayecca tatheśvarevanasthānāṃ prokto vai brahmavādinām
